sanskrit_iast: yajñaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ /
meaning: यज्ञं व्याख्यास्यामः /

sanskrit_iast: sa tribhir vedair vidhīyate /
meaning: स त्रिभिर् वेदैर् विधीयते /
text_mt: It is prescribed by three Vedas:

sanskrit_iast: ṛgvedena yajurvedena sāmavedena sarvair jyotiṣṭomaḥ /
meaning: ऋग्वेदेन यजुर्वेदेन सामवेदेन सर्वैर् ज्योतिष्टोमः /
text_mt: by the Ṛgveda, the Yajurveda, [and] the Sāmaveda—the Jyotiṣṭoma by all [three];

sanskrit_iast: ṛgvedayajurvedābhyāṃ darśapūrṇamāsau /
meaning: ऋग्वेदयजुर्वेदाभ्यां दर्शपूर्णमासौ /
text_mt: the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices by the Ṛgveda and the Yajurveda;

sanskrit_iast: yajurvedenāgnihotram /
meaning: यजुर्वेदेनाग्निहोत्रम् /
text_mt: the Agnihotra by the Yajurveda.

sanskrit_iast: vidhilakṣaṇāni karmāṇi /
meaning: विधिलक्षणानि कर्माणि /
text_mt: Rites are defined by injunction.

sanskrit_iast: mantrabrāhmaṇayor vedanāmadheyam /
meaning: मन्त्रब्राह्मणयोर् वेदनामधेयम् /
text_mt: The name "Veda" applies to mantra and Brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: karmavidhānaṃ brāhmaṇāni /
meaning: कर्मविधानं ब्राह्मणानि /
text_mt: The Brāhmaṇas are the injunction of rites.

sanskrit_iast: taccheṣo 'rthavādaḥ /
meaning: तच्छेषो ऽर्थवादः /

sanskrit_iast: nindā praśaṃsā /
meaning: निन्दा प्रशंसा /

sanskrit_iast: parakṛtiḥ purākalpaś ca /
meaning: परकृतिः पुराकल्पश् च /
text_mt: the practice of another, and ancient tradition.

sanskrit_iast: ato 'nye mantrāḥ /
meaning: अतो ऽन्ये मन्त्राः /

sanskrit_iast: laukikāḥ prayujyamānā amantrāḥ /
meaning: लौकिकाः प्रयुज्यमाना अमन्त्राः /
text_mt: Everyday [sounds] that are employed are non-mantras,

sanskrit_iast: yathā putrasya nāmadheyaṃ dundubhiśabdaś ca /
meaning: यथा पुत्रस्य नामधेयं दुन्दुभिशब्दश् च /
text_mt: such as the name of a son and the sound of a drum.

sanskrit_iast: yajñakarmārthā mantrāḥ /
meaning: यज्ञकर्मार्था मन्त्राः /
text_mt: Mantras serve for sacrificial rites,

sanskrit_iast: rūpavipratiṣedhāl laukikeṣu /
meaning: रूपविप्रतिषेधाल् लौकिकेषु /
text_mt: because their form is barred from everyday [contexts],

sanskrit_iast: yathā gṛhṇāmi te suprajāstvāya hastam \ imāṃ khanāmy oṣadhīm \\ vaha vapāṃ jātavedaḥ pitṛbhyas \\ iti /
meaning: यथा गृह्णामि ते सुप्रजास्त्वाय हस्तम् \ इमां खनाम्य् ओषधीम् \\ वह वपां जातवेदः पितृभ्यस् \\ इति /
text_mt: such as: "I take thy hand for good offspring"; "I dig this herb"; "Carry the omentum, O Jātavedas, to the fathers."

sanskrit_iast: yathopadiṣṭaṃ brāhmaṇavanto yathārūpam itare /
meaning: यथोपदिष्टं ब्राह्मणवन्तो यथारूपम् इतरे /
text_mt: Those having a Brāhmaṇa [apply] as taught; the others according to their form.

sanskrit_iast: śeṣasya vinidhānam /
meaning: शेषस्य विनिधानम् /

sanskrit_iast: pāriplavārthā dāśatayyaḥ /
meaning: पारिप्लवार्था दाशतय्यः /
text_mt: The verses of the Ṛgveda serve for the cyclical narrative.

sanskrit_iast: uttarayoḥ pavamānayoḥ stomābhyāse sāmāni /
meaning: उत्तरयोः पवमानयोः स्तोमाभ्यासे सामानि /
text_mt: The chants serve for the repetition of the stoma in the two subsequent pavamāna [lauds].

sanskrit_iast: tūṣṇīkeṣu prākṛteṣu yajuḥ /
meaning: तूष्णीकेषु प्राकृतेषु यजुः /
text_mt: In the case of silent archetype [rites], the formula [of the archetype applies].

sanskrit_iast: vedaḥ karmanāmadheyena śrūyamāṇas tadarthaḥ /
meaning: वेदः कर्मनामधेयेन श्रूयमाणस् तदर्थः /
text_mt: A Veda mentioned by the name of a rite serves for that purpose,

sanskrit_iast: yathā vājapeyo yājyāpuronuvākyāś ca /
meaning: यथा वाजपेयो याज्यापुरोनुवाक्याश् च /
text_mt: as the Vājapeya, and the offering and introductory verses.

sanskrit_iast: upām̐śu yajurvedena kriyate /
meaning: उपाम्̐शु यजुर्वेदेन क्रियते /
text_mt: With the Yajurveda, [a rite] is performed inaudibly,

sanskrit_iast: anyatra pravarasaṃvādāśrāvaṇasaṃpraiṣebhyaḥ /
meaning: अन्यत्र प्रवरसंवादाश्रावणसंप्रैषेभ्यः /
text_mt: except for ancestral invocations, dialogues, callings for attention, and ritual directions.

sanskrit_iast: uccair itarābhyām /
meaning: उच्चैर् इतराभ्याम् /

sanskrit_iast: sarvair upām̐śu //
meaning: सर्वैर् उपाम्̐शु //

sanskrit_iast: jyotiṣṭome prāg agnīṣomīyāt /
meaning: ज्योतिष्टोमे प्राग् अग्नीषोमीयात् /
text_mt: in the Jyotiṣṭoma before the Agnīṣomīya [rite].

sanskrit_iast: yāvadartho 'pavṛjyate sa ekamantraḥ /
meaning: यावदर्थो ऽपवृज्यते स एकमन्त्रः /
text_mt: As far as the sense is completed, that is a single mantra.

sanskrit_iast: ādipradiṣṭā mantrā bhavanti /
meaning: आदिप्रदिष्टा मन्त्रा भवन्ति /
text_mt: Mantras are indicated by their beginning.

sanskrit_iast: uttarāsyādinā pūrvasyāntaṃ vidyāt /
meaning: उत्तरास्यादिना पूर्वस्यान्तं विद्यात् /
text_mt: One should know the end of the previous by the beginning of the subsequent [mantra].

sanskrit_iast: mantrāntena karma saṃnipātayet /
meaning: मन्त्रान्तेन कर्म संनिपातयेत् /
text_mt: One should make the rite coincide with the end of the mantra.

sanskrit_iast: kriyamāṇe hautrāṇy ucyante /
meaning: क्रियमाणे हौत्राण्य् उच्यन्ते /
text_mt: While [the action] is being performed, the recitations of the hotṛ are spoken.

sanskrit_iast: ekamantrāṇi karmāṇi /
meaning: एकमन्त्राणि कर्माणि /

sanskrit_iast: samabhyuccīyeran hautrāṇi /
meaning: समभ्युच्चीयेरन् हौत्राणि /
text_mt: The recitations of the hotṛ should be accumulated,

sanskrit_iast: anyatra yājyānuvākyābhyaḥ /
meaning: अन्यत्र याज्यानुवाक्याभ्यः /
text_mt: except for the offering and introductory verses.

sanskrit_iast: yatraikasmin dravye viceṣṭāpṛthaktvenārtho niṣpadyate sakṛd eva tatra mantraṃ brūyāt /
meaning: यत्रैकस्मिन् द्रव्ये विचेष्टापृथक्त्वेनार्थो निष्पद्यते सकृद् एव तत्र मन्त्रं ब्रूयात् /
text_mt: Where the purpose is accomplished on a single substance through distinct movements, one should utter the mantra only once there,

sanskrit_iast: yathā prokṣe yūpacchedane ca /
meaning: यथा प्रोक्षे यूपच्छेदने च /
text_mt: as in sprinkling and cutting the sacrificial post.

sanskrit_iast: dravyapṛthaktve 'bhyāvartate /
meaning: द्रव्यपृथक्त्वे ऽभ्यावर्तते /
text_mt: When the substance is distinct, it is repeated,

sanskrit_iast: yathājyagrahaṇe lavane staraṇe ca /
meaning: यथाज्यग्रहणे लवने स्तरणे च /
text_mt: as in taking the clarified butter, cutting [grass], and strewing [it].

sanskrit_iast: arthapṛthaktvāt kaṇḍūyanamantro 'bhyāvartate /
meaning: अर्थपृथक्त्वात् कण्डूयनमन्त्रो ऽभ्यावर्तते /
text_mt: Because of the distinctness of purpose, the scratching mantra is repeated.

sanskrit_iast: parārthāny ekena kriyeran /
meaning: परार्थान्य् एकेन क्रियेरन् /
text_mt: [Actions] serving for another should be performed with a single [item],

sanskrit_iast: yathā kapālenopavapati yajamānena saṃmitaudumbarī bhavati \\ iti /
meaning: यथा कपालेनोपवपति यजमानेन संमितौदुम्बरी भवति \\ इति /
text_mt: as: "He pours out with a potsherd"; "The udumbara post is commensurate with the sacrificer."

sanskrit_iast: yajurvedenādhvaryuḥ karoti /
meaning: यजुर्वेदेनाध्वर्युः करोति /
text_mt: With the Yajurveda, the adhvaryu acts;

sanskrit_iast: ṛgvedena hotā /
meaning: ऋग्वेदेन होता /

sanskrit_iast: sāmavedenodgātā /
meaning: सामवेदेनोद्गाता /

sanskrit_iast: sarvair brahmā /
meaning: सर्वैर् ब्रह्मा /

sanskrit_iast: vacanalakṣaṇā itare /
meaning: वचनलक्षणा इतरे /

sanskrit_iast: asaṃbhavād vā /
meaning: असंभवाद् वा /

sanskrit_iast: yathāśvamedhe paśukarmasu /
meaning: यथाश्वमेधे पशुकर्मसु /
text_mt: as in the animal rites at the horse sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: āhavanīya āhutayo juhvā hūyante /
meaning: आहवनीय आहुतयो जुह्वा हूयन्ते /
text_mt: Oblations are offered in the āhavanīya fire with the juhū ladle.

sanskrit_iast: uttarataupacāro vihāraḥ //
meaning: उत्तरतौपचारो विहारः //
text_mt: The sacrificial area is approached from the north.

sanskrit_iast: prāṅnyāyāny udaṅnyāyāni vā pradakṣiṇaṃ yajñe karmāṇi karoti /
meaning: प्राङ्न्यायान्य् उदङ्न्यायानि वा प्रदक्षिणं यज्ञे कर्माणि करोति /
text_mt: In the sacrifice, one performs rites tending towards the east or tending towards the north, moving clockwise.

sanskrit_iast: na yajñāṅgenātmānam anyaṃ vābhipariharati /
meaning: न यज्ञाङ्गेनात्मानम् अन्यं वाभिपरिहरति /
text_mt: One does not pass around oneself or another with an implement of the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: na vihārād upaparyāvartate /
meaning: न विहाराद् उपपर्यावर्तते /
text_mt: One does not turn away from the sacrificial area.

sanskrit_iast: antarāṇi yajñāṅgāni bāhyāḥ kartāraḥ /
meaning: अन्तराणि यज्ञाङ्गानि बाह्याः कर्तारः /
text_mt: The implements of the sacrifice are inside; the performers are outside.

sanskrit_iast: prācīnāvītī pitryāṇi karoti /
meaning: प्राचीनावीती पित्र्याणि करोति /
text_mt: Wearing the sacred cord over the right shoulder, one performs rites for the ancestors.

sanskrit_iast: yajñopavītī darśapūrṇamāsayor agnihotre ca /
meaning: यज्ञोपवीती दर्शपूर्णमासयोर् अग्निहोत्रे च /
text_mt: Wearing the sacred cord over the left shoulder, [one acts] in the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices and in the Agnihotra.

sanskrit_iast: aniyamo 'nyatra /
meaning: अनियमो ऽन्यत्र /

sanskrit_iast: codanāsaṃyogāt pradhānāny ekakālāni /
meaning: चोदनासंयोगात् प्रधानान्य् एककालानि /
text_mt: Because of their connection with the injunction, the primary rites occur at one and the same time.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ vibhavanti tantram aṅgāny avibhavanty āvartante /
meaning: तेषां विभवन्ति तन्त्रम् अङ्गान्य् अविभवन्त्य् आवर्तन्ते /
text_mt: The subsidiary rites that suffice serve as a common framework for them; those that do not suffice are repeated.

sanskrit_iast: nānākāleṣu pṛthak /
meaning: नानाकालेषु पृथक् /

sanskrit_iast: yaḥ pradhānasya kālaḥ so 'ṅgānām̐ sa deśaḥ sa kartā so 'gniḥ /
meaning: यः प्रधानस्य कालः सो ऽङ्गानाम्̐ स देशः स कर्ता सो ऽग्निः /
text_mt: Whatever is the time of the primary rite is that of the subsidiary rites; whatever is its place, its agent, its fire [is theirs].

sanskrit_iast: ādhānaprabhṛti yāvajjīvaṃ pātrāṇi dhāryante /
meaning: आधानप्रभृति यावज्जीवं पात्राणि धार्यन्ते /
text_mt: From the setting up of the fires onward, the utensils are kept for life.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ pratitantram̐ sam̐skāro 'bhyāvartate /
meaning: तेषां प्रतितन्त्रम्̐ सम्̐स्कारो ऽभ्यावर्तते /
text_mt: Their consecration is repeated with each sacrificial framework.

sanskrit_iast: sarvakāmau darśapūrṇamāsau /
meaning: सर्वकामौ दर्शपूर्णमासौ /
text_mt: The New- and Full-Moon sacrifices fulfill all desires.

sanskrit_iast: tau samānavidhānau /
meaning: तौ समानविधानौ /

sanskrit_iast: nirdeśād vyavatiṣṭhete /
meaning: निर्देशाद् व्यवतिष्ठेते /
text_mt: They are distinguished on account of specific designation.

sanskrit_iast: tābhyāṃ yāvajjīvaṃ yajate trim̐śataṃ vā varṣāṇi /
meaning: ताभ्यां यावज्जीवं यजते त्रिम्̐शतं वा वर्षाणि /
text_mt: With the two one sacrifices throughout life, or for thirty years.

sanskrit_iast: ekasmin prayoge sarvān kāmān kāmayeta prayogapṛthaktve vaikaikam /
meaning: एकस्मिन् प्रयोगे सर्वान् कामान् कामयेत प्रयोगपृथक्त्वे वैकैकम् /
text_mt: One may desire all desires in a single performance, or one by one in separate performances.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvā paurṇamāsy uttarāmāvāsyā /
meaning: पूर्वा पौर्णमास्य् उत्तरामावास्या /
text_mt: The Full Moon rite is first; the New Moon rite is subsequent.

sanskrit_iast: paurṇamāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyā yajate 'māvāsyāyām amāvāsyayā /
meaning: पौर्णमास्यां पौर्णमास्या यजते ऽमावास्यायाम् अमावास्यया /
text_mt: At full moon one sacrifices with the Full Moon rite; at new moon with the New Moon rite.

sanskrit_iast: āgneyo 'ṣṭākapāla upām̐śuyājaś cāgnīṣomīyo vaiṣṇavaḥ prājāpatyo vāgnīṣomīyaś caikādaśakapālaḥ paurṇamāsyāṃ pradhānāni /
meaning: आग्नेयो ऽष्टाकपाल उपाम्̐शुयाजश् चाग्नीषोमीयो वैष्णवः प्राजापत्यो वाग्नीषोमीयश् चैकादशकपालः पौर्णमास्यां प्रधानानि /
text_mt: The primary rites on the full moon are: [the sacrificial cake] for Agni on eight potsherds, the inaudible offering to Agni-Soma, Viṣṇu, or Prajāpati, and [the cake] for Agni-Soma on eleven potsherds.

sanskrit_iast: nāsomāyājino brāhmaṇasyāgnīṣomīyaḥ puroḍāśo vidyata ity ekeṣām āgneyo 'ṣṭākapāla aindrāgna ekādaśakapālo dvādaśakapālo vāmāvāsyāyām asaṃnayata āgneyaḥ saṃnāyyaṃ ca saṃnayataḥ /
meaning: नासोमायाजिनो ब्राह्मणस्याग्नीषोमीयः पुरोडाशो विद्यत इत्य् एकेषाम् आग्नेयो ऽष्टाकपाल ऐन्द्राग्न एकादशकपालो द्वादशकपालो वामावास्यायाम् असंनयत आग्नेयः संनाय्यं च संनयतः /
text_mt: According to some, the sacrificial cake for Agni-Soma is not prescribed for a brāhmaṇa who has not performed a soma sacrifice; on the new moon, for one who does not offer curd-and-milk, [the primary rites are the cake] for Agni on eight potsherds and [the cake] for Indra-Agni on eleven or twelve potsherds; for one who offers curd-and-milk, [the cake] for Agni and the curd-and-milk oblation.

sanskrit_iast: tadaṅgam itare homāḥ /
meaning: तदङ्गम् इतरे होमाः /

sanskrit_iast: pūrvāṃ paurṇamāsīm upavaset /
meaning: पूर्वां पौर्णमासीम् उपवसेत् /
text_mt: One should fast on the first full-moon day,

sanskrit_iast: saṃpūrṇāṃ vā /
meaning: संपूर्णां वा /

sanskrit_iast: pūrvām amāvāsyām /
meaning: पूर्वाम् अमावास्याम् /

sanskrit_iast: yad ahar vā na dṛṣyate //
meaning: यद् अहर् वा न दृष्यते //

sanskrit_iast: prātar agnihotram̐ hutvānugamayitvāgnihotrikam apoddhṛtya vodita āditye gārhapatyād āhavanīyam uddhṛtya mamāgne varcas \\ ity anvādadhāty uttarayā gārhapatyam uttarayā dakṣiṇāgnim /
meaning: प्रातर् अग्निहोत्रम्̐ हुत्वानुगमयित्वाग्निहोत्रिकम् अपोद्धृत्य वोदित आदित्ये गार्हपत्याद् आहवनीयम् उद्धृत्य ममाग्ने वर्चस् \\ इत्य् अन्वादधात्य् उत्तरया गार्हपत्यम् उत्तरया दक्षिणाग्निम् /
text_mt: Having offered the morning Agnihotra, and having let the Agnihotra fire go out or having set it aside, after the sun has risen, having drawn out the āhavanīya fire from the gārhapatya fire, he fuels it with 'My luster, O Agni...'; with the next [verse] the gārhapatya fire; with the next the dakṣiṇāgni fire.

sanskrit_iast: sarvābhir vāhavanīyam /
meaning: सर्वाभिर् वाहवनीयम् /
text_mt: Or [he fuels] the āhavanīya fire with all [the verses].

sanskrit_iast: avaśiṣṭā vikalpārthāḥ /
meaning: अवशिष्टा विकल्पार्थाः /
text_mt: The remaining [verses] serve as alternatives.

sanskrit_iast: vyāhṛtībhir anvādadhātīty ekeṣām /
meaning: व्याहृतीभिर् अन्वादधातीत्य् एकेषाम् /
text_mt: According to some, he fuels [them] with the sacred utterances.

sanskrit_iast: agniṃ gṛhṇāmi surathaṃ yo mayobhūs \\ ya udyantam ārohati sūryam ahne / \ ādityaṃ jyotiṣāṃ jyotir uttamam \\ śvo yajñāya ramatāṃ devatābhyaḥ / \ vasūn rudrān ādityān \ indreṇa saha devatāḥ / \ tāḥ pūrvaḥ parigṛhṇāmi \ sva āyatane manīṣayā / \ imām ūrjaṃ pañcadaśīṃ ye praviṣṭās \ tān devān parigṛhṇāmi pūrvaḥ / \ agnir havyavāḍ iha tān āvahatu \ paurṇamāsam̐ havir idam eṣāṃ mayi \\ iti paurṇamāsyām āmāvāsyam̐ havir idam eṣāṃ mayi \\ ity amāvāsyāyām iti tisṛbhir āhavanīyam antarāgnī paśavas \\ devasam̐sadam āgaman / \ tān pūrvaḥ parigṛhṇāmi \ sva āyatane manīṣayā \\ ity antarāgnī tiṣṭhañ japati \\ iha prajā viśvarūpā ramantām \ agniṃ gṛhapatim abhi saṃvasānāḥ / \ tāḥ pūrvaḥ parigṛhṇāmi \ sva āyatane manīṣayā / \ iha paśavo viśvarūpā ramantām \ agniṃ gṛhapatim abhi saṃvasānāḥ / \ tān pūrvaḥ parigṛhṇāmi \ sva āyatane manīṣayā \\ iti dvābhyāṃ gārhapatyam ayaṃ pitṛṇām agnis \\ avāḍ ḍhavyā pitṛbhya ā / \ taṃ pūrvaḥ parigṛhṇāmi \\ aviṣaṃ naḥ pituṃ karat \\ iti dakṣiṇāgnim ajasraṃ tvām̐ sabhāpālās \\ vijayabhāgam̐ samindhatām / \ agne dīdāya me sabhya \ vijityai śaradaḥ śatam iti sabhyam annam āvasathīyam \ abhiharāṇi śaradaḥ śatam / \ āvasathe śriyaṃ mantram \ ahir budhniyo niyacchatu \\ ity āvasathyam /
meaning: अग्निं गृह्णामि सुरथं यो मयोभूस् \\ य उद्यन्तम् आरोहति सूर्यम् अह्ने / \ आदित्यं ज्योतिषां ज्योतिर् उत्तमम् \\ श्वो यज्ञाय रमतां देवताभ्यः / \ वसून् रुद्रान् आदित्यान् \ इन्द्रेण सह देवताः / \ ताः पूर्वः परिगृह्णामि \ स्व आयतने मनीषया / \ इमाम् ऊर्जं पञ्चदशीं ये प्रविष्टास् \ तान् देवान् परिगृह्णामि पूर्वः / \ अग्निर् हव्यवाड् इह तान् आवहतु \ पौर्णमासम्̐ हविर् इदम् एषां मयि \\ इति पौर्णमास्याम् आमावास्यम्̐ हविर् इदम् एषां मयि \\ इत्य् अमावास्यायाम् इति तिसृभिर् आहवनीयम् अन्तराग्नी पशवस् \\ देवसम्̐सदम् आगमन् / \ तान् पूर्वः परिगृह्णामि \ स्व आयतने मनीषया \\ इत्य् अन्तराग्नी तिष्ठञ् जपति \\ इह प्रजा विश्वरूपा रमन्ताम् \ अग्निं गृहपतिम् अभि संवसानाः / \ ताः पूर्वः परिगृह्णामि \ स्व आयतने मनीषया / \ इह पशवो विश्वरूपा रमन्ताम् \ अग्निं गृहपतिम् अभि संवसानाः / \ तान् पूर्वः परिगृह्णामि \ स्व आयतने मनीषया \\ इति द्वाभ्यां गार्हपत्यम् अयं पितृणाम् अग्निस् \\ अवाड् ढव्या पितृभ्य आ / \ तं पूर्वः परिगृह्णामि \\ अविषं नः पितुं करत् \\ इति दक्षिणाग्निम् अजस्रं त्वाम्̐ सभापालास् \\ विजयभागम्̐ समिन्धताम् / \ अग्ने दीदाय मे सभ्य \ विजित्यै शरदः शतम् इति सभ्यम् अन्नम् आवसथीयम् \ अभिहराणि शरदः शतम् / \ आवसथे श्रियं मन्त्रम् \ अहिर् बुध्नियो नियच्छतु \\ इत्य् आवसथ्यम् /
text_mt: With three verses: 'I seize the fire having a good chariot, who is wholesome, / who ascends to the rising sun for the day; / the sun, the highest light of lights, / let him rest tomorrow for the sacrifice to the deities. / The Vasus, the Rudras, the Ādityas, / the deities together with Indra, / them I, coming first, grasp / in my own abode with devotion. / Those gods who have entered into this fifteenth nourishment, / them I, coming first, grasp; / may Agni the bearer of oblations bring them hither; / this full-moon oblation of theirs is in me'—at the full moon; 'this new-moon oblation of theirs is in me'—at the new moon, [he fuels] the āhavanīya fire. Standing between the fires, he murmurs: 'The cattle have come between the fires / to the assembly of the gods; / them I, coming first, grasp / in my own abode with devotion.' With two [verses]: 'May multi-formed offspring take delight here, / dwelling together around Agni the lord of the house; / them I, coming first, grasp / in my own abode with devotion. / May multi-formed cattle take delight here, / dwelling together around Agni the lord of the house; / them I, coming first, grasp / in my own abode with devotion'—[he fuels] the gārhapatya fire. With: 'This fire of the Fathers / has carried the oblations to the Fathers; / it I, coming first, grasp; / may it make our food free from poison'—[he fuels] the dakṣiṇāgni fire. With: 'The guardians of the assembly, may they kindle thee, the imperishable, / to share in victory; / shine for me, O sabhya fire, / for victory for a hundred autumns'—[he fuels] the sabhya fire. With: 'May I bring food belonging to the dwelling / for a hundred autumns; / prosperity and mantra in the dwelling / may Ahi Budhnya bestow'—[he fuels] the āvasathya fire.

sanskrit_iast: iti vaitābhiḥ /
meaning: इति वैताभिः /

sanskrit_iast: palāśaśākhām̐ śamīśākhāṃ vāharati /
meaning: पलाशशाखाम्̐ शमीशाखां वाहरति /
text_mt: He fetches a palāśa branch or a śamī branch.

sanskrit_iast: prācīm udīcīṃ prāgudīcīṃ vāhīnāṃ bahuparṇām aśuṣkāgrām /
meaning: प्राचीम् उदीचीं प्रागुदीचीं वाहीनां बहुपर्णाम् अशुष्काग्राम् /
text_mt: [It should be] pointing eastward, northward, or northeastward, unbroken, having many leaves, and having an un-withered tip.

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ kāmayetāpaśuḥ syād ity aparṇāṃ tasmai śuṣkāgrām /
meaning: यं कामयेतापशुः स्याद् इत्य् अपर्णां तस्मै शुष्काग्राम् /
text_mt: For one whom he desires to be devoid of cattle, [he fetches one] without leaves and with a withered tip.

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ kāmayeta paśumān syād iti bahuparṇāṃ tasmai bahuśākhām aśuṣkāgrām /
meaning: यं कामयेत पशुमान् स्याद् इति बहुपर्णां तस्मै बहुशाखाम् अशुष्काग्राम् /
text_mt: For one whom he desires to be rich in cattle, [he fetches one] having many leaves, many twigs, and an un-withered tip.

sanskrit_iast: iṣe tvā \\ iti śākhām ācchinati \\ ūrje tvā \\ iti saṃnamayaty anumārṣṭi vā /
meaning: इषे त्वा \\ इति शाखाम् आच्छिनति \\ ऊर्जे त्वा \\ इति संनमयत्य् अनुमार्ष्टि वा /
text_mt: With 'For food thee!' he cuts off the branch; with 'For strength thee!' he bends it down or strokes it along.

sanskrit_iast: imāṃ prācīm udīcīm \ iṣam ūrjam abhisam̐skṛtām / \ bahuparṇām aśuṣkāgrām \\ harāmi paśupām aham ity āharati /
meaning: इमां प्राचीम् उदीचीम् \ इषम् ऊर्जम् अभिसम्̐स्कृताम् / \ बहुपर्णाम् अशुष्काग्राम् \\ हरामि पशुपाम् अहम् इत्य् आहरति /
text_mt: He brings it with: 'This [branch] pointing east, pointing north, / consecrated for food and strength, / having many leaves, with an un-withered tip, / I bring, as a protector of cattle.'

sanskrit_iast: vāyavaḥ stha \\ iti tayā ṣaḍ vatsān apākaroti //
meaning: वायवः स्थ \\ इति तया षड् वत्सान् अपाकरोति //
text_mt: With 'Ye are the winds' he drives away six calves with it.

sanskrit_iast: darbhair vā sadarbhayety ekeṣām /
meaning: दर्भैर् वा सदर्भयेत्य् एकेषाम् /
text_mt: Or with darbha grass, or [with the branch] accompanied by darbha grass, according to some.

sanskrit_iast: apākṛtānām ekam̐ śākhayopaspṛśati /
meaning: अपाकृतानाम् एकम्̐ शाखयोपस्पृशति /
text_mt: He touches one of those driven away with the branch.

sanskrit_iast: devo vas \\ iti gocaram abhi mātṝḥ prasthāpayati /
meaning: देवो वस् \\ इति गोचरम् अभि मातॄः प्रस्थापयति /
text_mt: With 'May the god [Savitṛ]...' he sends the mothers toward the pasture.

sanskrit_iast: indraṃ nigameṣūpalakṣayed indrayājino mahendraṃ mahendrayājinaḥ /
meaning: इन्द्रं निगमेषूपलक्षयेद् इन्द्रयाजिनो महेन्द्रं महेन्द्रयाजिनः /
text_mt: He should mention Indra in the inserts for one who sacrifices to Indra, Mahendra for one who sacrifices to Mahendra.

sanskrit_iast: prasthitānām ekām̐ śākhayopaspṛśati /
meaning: प्रस्थितानाम् एकाम्̐ शाखयोपस्पृशति /
text_mt: He touches one of those that have set out with the branch.

sanskrit_iast: śuddhā apaḥ suprapāṇe pibantīḥ \ śatam indrāya śarado duhānāḥ / \ rudrasya hetiḥ pari vo vṛṇaktu \\ iti prasthitā anumantrayate /
meaning: शुद्धा अपः सुप्रपाणे पिबन्तीः \ शतम् इन्द्राय शरदो दुहानाः / \ रुद्रस्य हेतिः परि वो वृणक्तु \\ इति प्रस्थिता अनुमन्त्रयते /
text_mt: He follows those that have set out with the mantra: 'Drinking pure waters at a good drinking place, / yielding milk for Indra for a hundred autumns, / may the missile of Rudra avoid you.'

sanskrit_iast: dhruvā asmin \\ iti yajamānasya gṛhān abhi paryāvartate /
meaning: ध्रुवा अस्मिन् \\ इति यजमानस्य गृहान् अभि पर्यावर्तते /
text_mt: With 'Be firm in this [abode]...' he turns back toward the house of the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast: yajamānasya paśūn pāhi \\ ity agniṣṭhe 'nasy agnyagāre vā purastāt pratīcīm̐ śākhām upagūhati paścāt prācīm ity ekeṣām /
meaning: यजमानस्य पशून् पाहि \\ इत्य् अग्निष्ठे ऽनस्य् अग्न्यगारे वा पुरस्तात् प्रतीचीम्̐ शाखाम् उपगूहति पश्चात् प्राचीम् इत्य् एकेषाम् /
text_mt: With 'Protect the cattle of the sacrificer' he tucks the branch into the cart standing near the fire or in the fire-hall from the east pointing westward; according to some, from the west pointing eastward.

sanskrit_iast: devasya tvā \\ ity aśvaparśum asidaṃ vādatte /
meaning: देवस्य त्वा \\ इत्य् अश्वपर्शुम् असिदं वादत्ते /
text_mt: With 'At the impulse of the divine...' he takes up a horse's rib or a sickle.

sanskrit_iast: yajñasya ghoṣad asi \\ iti gārhapatyam upatiṣṭhate /
meaning: यज्ञस्य घोषद् असि \\ इति गार्हपत्यम् उपतिष्ठते /
text_mt: With 'Thou art the proclaimer of the sacrifice' he pays reverence to the gārhapatya fire.

sanskrit_iast: pratyuṣṭam ity āhavanīye gārhapatye vā niṣṭapati /
meaning: प्रत्युष्टम् इत्य् आहवनीये गार्हपत्ये वा निष्टपति /
text_mt: With 'Scorched...' he heats it over the āhavanīya or gārhapatya fire.

sanskrit_iast: preyam agāt \\ urv antarikṣam \\ prehi \\ ity anyatareṇa prācīnam udīcīnaṃ vābhipravrajya yataḥ kutaścid darbhamayaṃ barhir āharati /
meaning: प्रेयम् अगात् \\ उर्व् अन्तरिक्षम् \\ प्रेहि \\ इत्य् अन्यतरेण प्राचीनम् उदीचीनं वाभिप्रव्रज्य यतः कुतश्चिद् दर्भमयं बर्हिर् आहरति /
text_mt: Having walked forth toward the east or north with either 'This one has gone forth...', 'The wide intermediate space...', or 'Go forth!', he fetches sacrificial grass consisting of darbha from wherever [it may be found].

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇo stūpo 'si \\ ity abhipretānām ekam̐ stambam utsṛjati \\ indrasya pariṣūtam asi \\ ity anyaṃ pariṣauti devānām iti vā /
meaning: विष्णो स्तूपो ऽसि \\ इत्य् अभिप्रेतानाम् एकम्̐ स्तम्बम् उत्सृजति \\ इन्द्रस्य परिषूतम् असि \\ इत्य् अन्यं परिषौति देवानाम् इति वा /
text_mt: With 'Thou art the tuft of Viṣṇu' he lets go of one clump among those selected; with 'Thou art enclosed for Indra' or '...for the gods' he encloses another.

sanskrit_iast: tam̐ sarvaṃ dāti /
meaning: तम्̐ सर्वं दाति /

sanskrit_iast: api vā paśūnāṃ tvā bhāgam utsṛjāmi \\ iti pariṣūtasyaikām dve vā darbhanāḍyāv utsṛjati /
meaning: अपि वा पशूनां त्वा भागम् उत्सृजामि \\ इति परिषूतस्यैकाम् द्वे वा दर्भनाड्याव् उत्सृजति /
text_mt: Or with 'I release thee as the share of the cattle' he sets aside one or two darbha blades of that which was enclosed.

sanskrit_iast: idaṃ devānām iti pariṣūtam abhimṛśati \\ idaṃ paśūnām ity utsṛṣṭam avasṛṣṭo gavāṃ bhāgas \\ iti vā /
meaning: इदं देवानाम् इति परिषूतम् अभिमृशति \\ इदं पशूनाम् इत्य् उत्सृष्टम् अवसृष्टो गवां भागस् \\ इति वा /
text_mt: With 'This belongs to the gods' he touches the enclosed [grass]; with 'This belongs to the cattle' or 'Released is the share of the cows' [he touches] that which was set aside.

sanskrit_iast: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave 'śvinor bāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ barhir devasadanam ārabhe \\ iti viśākheṣv abhipadyate /
meaning: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवे ऽश्विनोर् बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्यां बर्हिर् देवसदनम् आरभे \\ इति विशाखेष्व् अभिपद्यते /
text_mt: With 'At the impulse of the divine Savitṛ, with the arms of the Aśvins, with the hands of Pūṣan, I take hold of the sacrificial grass, the seat of the gods' he grasps [it] at the forks.

sanskrit_iast: devebhyas tvordhvabarhirbhyas \\ ity ūrdhvam unmārṣṭi /
meaning: देवेभ्यस् त्वोर्ध्वबर्हिर्भ्यस् \\ इत्य् ऊर्ध्वम् उन्मार्ष्टि /
text_mt: With 'For the gods who have their sacrificial grass upright, thee' he strokes upward.

sanskrit_iast: devabarhir mā tvānvaṅ mā tiryak \\ ity asidaṃ nidadhāti mādho mopari parus ta ṛdhyāsam iti vā //
meaning: देवबर्हिर् मा त्वान्वङ् मा तिर्यक् \\ इत्य् असिदं निदधाति माधो मोपरि परुस् त ऋध्यासम् इति वा //
text_mt: With 'O divine sacrificial grass, may I not cut thee downwards nor crosswise' or 'May I succeed at thy joint, not below, not above' he places the sickle.

sanskrit_iast: yā jātā oṣadhayas \\ devebhyas triyugaṃ purā / \ tāsāṃ parva rādhyāsam \\ paristaram āharan \\ ity abhimantrya /
meaning: या जाता ओषधयस् \\ देवेभ्यस् त्रियुगं पुरा / \ तासां पर्व राध्यासम् \\ परिस्तरम् आहरन् \\ इत्य् अभिमन्त्र्य /
text_mt: Having addressed [it] with: 'Those plants which were born / for the gods three ages ago, / may I succeed at their joint, / bringing the strewn grass,'

sanskrit_iast: ācchettā te mā riṣam ity ācchinatti /
meaning: आच्छेत्ता ते मा रिषम् इत्य् आच्छिनत्ति /
text_mt: he cuts it with 'May I, the cutter, not suffer harm.'

sanskrit_iast: sanakhaṃ muṣṭiṃ dāti /
meaning: सनखं मुष्टिं दाति /

sanskrit_iast: sa prastaraḥ /
meaning: स प्रस्तरः /

sanskrit_iast: srugdaṇḍamātram urvasthikulmimātraṃ vā /
meaning: स्रुग्दण्डमात्रम् उर्वस्थिकुल्मिमात्रं वा /
text_mt: [The prastara] is of the length of the handle of a ladle, or the length of a thigh bone.

sanskrit_iast: etenaiva kalpenetarān dāti /
meaning: एतेनैव कल्पेनेतरान् दाति /
text_mt: He cuts the others according to the very same procedure.

sanskrit_iast: yad anyat pariṣavaṇād utsarjanāc ca /
meaning: यद् अन्यत् परिषवणाद् उत्सर्जनाच् च /
text_mt: Except for the [portions cut during] moving around and discarding.

sanskrit_iast: sarvaṃ yathārthaṃ lutvā /
meaning: सर्वं यथार्थं लुत्वा /
text_mt: Having cut all according to requirement,

sanskrit_iast: devabarhiḥ śatavalśaṃ viroha \\ ity ālavān abhimṛśati /
meaning: देवबर्हिः शतवल्शं विरोह \\ इत्य् आलवान् अभिमृशति /
text_mt: He touches the cut stalks with: 'O divine sacrificial grass, sprout with a hundred shoots!'

sanskrit_iast: sahasravalśā vi vayam̐ ruhema \\ ity ātmānaṃ pratyabhimṛśati /
meaning: सहस्रवल्शा वि वयम्̐ रुहेम \\ इत्य् आत्मानं प्रत्यभिमृशति /
text_mt: He touches himself with: 'May we sprout with a thousand shoots!'

sanskrit_iast: ayujo yujo vā muṣṭīn nidhanāni vā lunoti /
meaning: अयुजो युजो वा मुष्टीन् निधनानि वा लुनोति /
text_mt: He cuts odd or even numbers of handfuls or layers.

sanskrit_iast: adityai rāsnāsi \\ iti pradakṣiṇam̐ śulvam āveṣṭayati /
meaning: अदित्यै रास्नासि \\ इति प्रदक्षिणम्̐ शुल्वम् आवेष्टयति /
text_mt: With: 'You are the girdle for Aditi,' he winds the cord clockwise.

sanskrit_iast: ayupitā yonis \\ iti pratinidadhāti tridhātu pañcadhātu vā dhātaudhātau mantram āvartayati /
meaning: अयुपिता योनिस् \\ इति प्रतिनिदधाति त्रिधातु पञ्चधातु वा धातौधातौ मन्त्रम् आवर्तयति /
text_mt: With: 'An undisturbable womb [are you],' he places it down; having three strands or five strands, he repeats the mantra with each strand.

sanskrit_iast: pṛthivyāḥ saṃpṛcaḥ pāhi \\ iti prāgagram udagagraṃ vā śulbaṃ nidadhāti /
meaning: पृथिव्याः संपृचः पाहि \\ इति प्रागग्रम् उदगग्रं वा शुल्बं निदधाति /
text_mt: With: 'Protect from contact with the earth,' he places the cord with its tips pointed eastward or northward.

sanskrit_iast: aparimitānāṃ parimitāḥ \ saṃnahye sukṛtāya kam / \ eno mā nigāṃ katamac canāham \\ punar utthāya bahulā bhavantu \\ ity abhimantrya susaṃbhṛtā tvāsaṃbhārami \\ iti śulbe nidhanāni saṃbharati /
meaning: अपरिमितानां परिमिताः \ संनह्ये सुकृताय कम् / \ एनो मा निगां कतमच् चनाहम् \\ पुनर् उत्थाय बहुला भवन्तु \\ इत्य् अभिमन्त्र्य सुसंभृता त्वासंभारमि \\ इति शुल्बे निधनानि संभरति /
text_mt: Having addressed [them] with: 'Of the unlimited, [you are] limited, / bound together for good action; / may I not incur any sin whatever; / having risen again, may they become manifold,' he gathers the layers onto the cord with: 'Well-gathered, I gather you.'

sanskrit_iast: alubhitā yonis \\ ity uttame nidhane prastaram ādadhāti /
meaning: अलुभिता योनिस् \\ इत्य् उत्तमे निधने प्रस्तरम् आदधाति /
text_mt: With: 'An unentangled womb [are you],' he places the prastara on the topmost layer.

sanskrit_iast: indrāṇyai saṃnahanam iti saṃnahyati pūṣā te \\ iti pradakṣiṇaṃ granthim āveṣṭya /
meaning: इन्द्राण्यै संनहनम् इति संनह्यति पूषा ते \\ इति प्रदक्षिणं ग्रन्थिम् आवेष्ट्य /
text_mt: He binds [the grass] with: '[You are] the binding for Indrāṇī'; having wound the knot clockwise with: 'May Pūṣan [tie] your [knot],'

sanskrit_iast: sa te \\ iti purastāt pratyañcam upakarṣati paścād vā prāñcam /
meaning: स ते \\ इति पुरस्तात् प्रत्यञ्चम् उपकर्षति पश्चाद् वा प्राञ्चम् /
text_mt: With: 'May he [tie] your [knot],' he tucks it from the front toward the west, or from the back toward the east.

sanskrit_iast: āpas tvām aśvinau tvām \ ṛṣayaḥ sapta māmṛjuḥ / \ barhiḥ sūryasya raśmibhis \\ uṣasāṃ ketum ārabhe \\ ity ārabhate /
meaning: आपस् त्वाम् अश्विनौ त्वाम् \ ऋषयः सप्त मामृजुः / \ बर्हिः सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिस् \\ उषसां केतुम् आरभे \\ इत्य् आरभते /
text_mt: He takes hold of it with: 'The waters have cleansed you, the Aśvins have cleansed you, / the seven seers have cleansed you; / with the rays of the sun, / I take hold of the sacrificial grass, the beacon of the dawns.'

sanskrit_iast: indrasya tvā bāhubhyām udyacche \\ ity udyacchate /
meaning: इन्द्रस्य त्वा बाहुभ्याम् उद्यच्छे \\ इत्य् उद्यच्छते /
text_mt: He lifts it up with: 'With the arms of Indra I lift you up.'

sanskrit_iast: bṛhaspates \\ iti śīrṣann adhinidhāya harati /
meaning: बृहस्पतेस् \\ इति शीर्षन्न् अधिनिधाय हरति /
text_mt: Having placed it upon his head with: '[With the head] of Bṛhaspati,' he carries it.

sanskrit_iast: yau gamanau tau pratyāyanau /
meaning: यौ गमनौ तौ प्रत्यायनौ /
text_mt: The two [mantras] for going are the two for returning.

sanskrit_iast: adityāḥ sada āsīda \\ iti paridhideśe 'ntarvedy anadhaḥ sādayati /
meaning: अदित्याः सद आसीद \\ इति परिधिदेशे ऽन्तर्वेद्य् अनधः सादयति /
text_mt: With: 'Sit upon the seat of Aditi,' he sets it down within the altar, in the area of the enclosing-sticks, not on the bare ground.

sanskrit_iast: devaṃgamam asi \\ ity āsannam abhimantrayate /
meaning: देवंगमम् असि \\ इत्य् आसन्नम् अभिमन्त्रयते /
text_mt: He addresses it when set down with: 'You are reaching the gods.'

sanskrit_iast: adityās tvā pṛṣṭhe sādayāmi \\ iti gārhapatyadeśa upari nidadhāti //
meaning: अदित्यास् त्वा पृष्ठे सादयामि \\ इति गार्हपत्यदेश उपरि निदधाति //
text_mt: With: 'I place you on the back of Aditi,' he sets it down above in the area of the gārhapatya fire.

sanskrit_iast: pālāśaṃ khādiraṃ vaikavim̐śatidārum idhmam̐ saṃnahyati /
meaning: पालाशं खादिरं वैकविम्̐शतिदारुम् इध्मम्̐ संनह्यति /
text_mt: He binds together a fuel bundle of twenty-one pieces of wood, made of palāśa or of khadira.

sanskrit_iast: pañcadaśa sāmidhenyarthāni /
meaning: पञ्चदश सामिधेन्यर्थानि /
text_mt: Fifteen are for the purpose of the kindling verses.

sanskrit_iast: trayaḥ paridhayo 'niyatavṛkṣāḥ satvakkāḥ /
meaning: त्रयः परिधयो ऽनियतवृक्षाः सत्वक्काः /
text_mt: Three enclosing-sticks are from any tree [suitable for sacrifice], with bark.

sanskrit_iast: ārdrā bhavanti te hi sarasās \\ iti vijñāyate śuṣkā bhavanti medhyatvāya \\ iti vijñāyate /
meaning: आर्द्रा भवन्ति ते हि सरसास् \\ इति विज्ञायते शुष्का भवन्ति मेध्यत्वाय \\ इति विज्ञायते /
text_mt: 'They are wet, for they are full of sap,' thus it is known in the Brāhmaṇa; 'They are dry, for the sake of sacrificial fitness,' thus it is known in the Brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: sthaviṣṭho madhyamo 'ṇīyān drāghīyān dakṣiṇārdhyo 'ṇiṣṭho hrasiṣṭha uttarārdhyaḥ /
meaning: स्थविष्ठो मध्यमो ऽणीयान् द्राघीयान् दक्षिणार्ध्यो ऽणिष्ठो ह्रसिष्ठ उत्तरार्ध्यः /
text_mt: The middle one is the thickest; the southern one is thinner and longer; the northern one is the thinnest and shortest.

sanskrit_iast: dve āghārasamidhau /
meaning: द्वे आघारसमिधौ /

sanskrit_iast: anūyājasamid ekavim̐śīti /
meaning: अनूयाजसमिद् एकविम्̐शीति /
text_mt: The kindling-stick for the after-offerings is the twenty-first.

sanskrit_iast: samūlānām amūlānāṃ vā darbhāṇām ayugdhātu śulbaṃ kṛtvā prāgagram udagagraṃ vā nidadhāti /
meaning: समूलानाम् अमूलानां वा दर्भाणाम् अयुग्धातु शुल्बं कृत्वा प्रागग्रम् उदगग्रं वा निदधाति /
text_mt: Having made an odd-stranded cord of darbha grasses, with roots or without roots, he lays it down with its tips pointed eastward or northward.

sanskrit_iast: yat kṛṣṇo rūpaṃ kṛtvā \ prāviśas tvaṃ vanaspatīn / \ tatas tvām ekavim̐śatidhā \ saṃbharāmi susaṃbhṛtā / \ trīn paridhīm̐s tisraḥ samidhas \\ yajñāyur anusaṃcarān / \ upaveṣaṃ mekṣaṇaṃ dhṛṣṭim \\ saṃbharāmi susaṃbhṛtā \\ iti śulba idhmam̐ saṃbharati /
meaning: यत् कृष्णो रूपं कृत्वा \ प्राविशस् त्वं वनस्पतीन् / \ ततस् त्वाम् एकविम्̐शतिधा \ संभरामि सुसंभृता / \ त्रीन् परिधीम्̐स् तिस्रः समिधस् \\ यज्ञायुर् अनुसंचरान् / \ उपवेषं मेक्षणं धृष्टिम् \\ संभरामि सुसंभृता \\ इति शुल्ब इध्मम्̐ संभरति /
text_mt: He gathers the fuel on the cord with: 'When taking the form of a black antelope / you entered the trees of the forest, / from there I gather you in twenty-one parts, / well-gathered; / the three enclosing-sticks, the three kindling-sticks / that accompany the life of the sacrifice, / the fire-stirrer, the stirring stick, the poking stick, / I gather, well-gathered.'

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṇo 'sy ākhareṣṭhas \\ deva puraścara saghyāsaṃ tvā \\ iti saṃnahyati /
meaning: कृष्णो ऽस्य् आखरेष्ठस् \\ देव पुरश्चर सघ्यासं त्वा \\ इति संनह्यति /
text_mt: He ties it with: 'You are the black deer resting in the lair; / O god, move in front; may I be capable of you.'

sanskrit_iast: pūṣā te \\ iti pradakṣiṇaṃ granthim āveṣṭya tenaiva kalpena yathā barhiṣi /
meaning: पूषा ते \\ इति प्रदक्षिणं ग्रन्थिम् आवेष्ट्य तेनैव कल्पेन यथा बर्हिषि /
text_mt: Having wound the knot clockwise with: 'May Pūṣan [tie] your [knot],' [he proceeds] according to the very same procedure as for the sacrificial grass,

sanskrit_iast: vipratipādya vā /
meaning: विप्रतिपाद्य वा /

sanskrit_iast: tenaiva mantreṇa /
meaning: तेनैव मन्त्रेण /

sanskrit_iast: barhiṣā saha nidadhāti /
meaning: बर्हिषा सह निदधाति /
text_mt: He sets it down together with the sacrificial grass.

sanskrit_iast: vedo 'si \ yena tvaṃ deva veda devebhyo vedo 'bhavas tena mahyaṃ vedo bhūyās \\ iti darbhāṇāṃ vedaṃ karoti /
meaning: वेदो ऽसि \ येन त्वं देव वेद देवेभ्यो वेदो ऽभवस् तेन मह्यं वेदो भूयास् \\ इति दर्भाणां वेदं करोति /
text_mt: With: 'You are the veda; by means of which, O divine veda, you became wealth for the gods, by that may you become wealth for me,' he makes the veda of darbha grasses,

sanskrit_iast: vatsajñuṃ mūtakāryaṃ paṅktikāryaṃ trivṛtaṃ vā /
meaning: वत्सज्ञुं मूतकार्यं पङ्क्तिकार्यं त्रिवृतं वा /
text_mt: Shaped like a calf's knee, shaped like a woven basket, shaped like a five-fold [braid], or three-stranded.

sanskrit_iast: vatsajñuṃ paśukāmasya mūtakāryam annādyakāmasya paṅktikāryaṃ prajākāmasya trivṛtaṃ brahmavarcasakāmasya trivṛcchirasaṃ bruvate /
meaning: वत्सज्ञुं पशुकामस्य मूतकार्यम् अन्नाद्यकामस्य पङ्क्तिकार्यं प्रजाकामस्य त्रिवृतं ब्रह्मवर्चसकामस्य त्रिवृच्छिरसं ब्रुवते /
text_mt: They say: [the veda shaped like] a calf's knee is for one desiring cattle; shaped like a woven basket is for one desiring food; shaped like a five-fold [braid] is for one desiring offspring; three-stranded is for one desiring spiritual luster; [and some say it should be] three-stranded at the top.

sanskrit_iast: tṛṇṇāt pradeśe parivāsayati /
meaning: तृण्णात् प्रदेशे परिवासयति /
text_mt: He trims it at a notched spot.

sanskrit_iast: idhmapravraścanāni vedaparivāsanāni ca saha nidadhāti //
meaning: इध्मप्रव्रश्चनानि वेदपरिवासनानि च सह निदधाति //
text_mt: He puts the wood-cuttings and the clippings of the veda together.

sanskrit_iast: antarvedi śākhāyāḥ palāśāni praśātya sarvāṇi mūlataḥ parivāsya /
meaning: अन्तर्वेदि शाखायाः पलाशानि प्रशात्य सर्वाणि मूलतः परिवास्य /
text_mt: Within the altar, having stripped off all the palāśa leaves of the branch and cut it off from the base,

sanskrit_iast: upaveṣo 'si yajñāya tvām \\ pariveṣam adhārayan / \ indrāya haviḥ kṛṇvantaḥ \ śivaḥ śagmo bhavāsi nas \\ iti tam upaveṣaṃ karoti /
meaning: उपवेषो ऽसि यज्ञाय त्वाम् \\ परिवेषम् अधारयन् / \ इन्द्राय हविः कृण्वन्तः \ शिवः शग्मो भवासि नस् \\ इति तम् उपवेषं करोति /
text_mt: He makes it into the fire-stirrer with: 'You are the fire-stirrer; for the sacrifice / they took you as an attendant; / preparing the sacrificial oblation for Indra, / be auspicious and benevolent to us.'

sanskrit_iast: tasyāṃ trivṛddarbhamayaṃ pavitram avidalaṃ karoti /
meaning: तस्यां त्रिवृद्दर्भमयं पवित्रम् अविदलं करोति /
text_mt: Upon it he makes a three-stranded strainer made of darbha grass, without a split.

sanskrit_iast: trivṛtpalāśe darbha iyān prādeśasaṃmitaḥ / yajñe pavitraṃ potṛtamam \\ payo havyaṃ karotu me \\ iti mūle mūlam upasṛjaty agre 'graṃ na granthiṃ karoti /
meaning: त्रिवृत्पलाशे दर्भ इयान् प्रादेशसंमितः / यज्ञे पवित्रं पोतृतमम् \\ पयो हव्यं करोतु मे \\ इति मूले मूलम् उपसृजत्य् अग्रे ऽग्रं न ग्रन्थिं करोति /
text_mt: With: 'Darbha grass of this size, measuring a span, on the three-leaved palāśa branch; / may the most purifying strainer at the sacrifice / make the milk into a sacrificial offering for me,' he joins root to root and tip to tip; he does not make a knot.

sanskrit_iast: vasūnāṃ pavitram asi śatadhāram iti vā /
meaning: वसूनां पवित्रम् असि शतधारम् इति वा /
text_mt: Or with: 'You are the strainer of the Vasus, having a hundred streams.'

sanskrit_iast: sāyam̐ hute 'gnihotre /
meaning: सायम्̐ हुते ऽग्निहोत्रे /

sanskrit_iast: dvaṃdvam̐ sāṃnāyyapātrāṇi prakṣālya nyañci prayunakti /
meaning: द्वंद्वम्̐ सांनाय्यपात्राणि प्रक्षाल्य न्यञ्चि प्रयुनक्ति /
text_mt: Having rinsed the utensils for the curd-and-milk oblation in pairs, he arranges them face down:

sanskrit_iast: agnihotrahavaṇīm ukhām upaveṣam̐ śākhāpavitram abhidhānīṃ nidāne dohanam ayaspātraṃ dārupātraṃ vāpidhānārtham /
meaning: अग्निहोत्रहवणीम् उखाम् उपवेषम्̐ शाखापवित्रम् अभिधानीं निदाने दोहनम् अयस्पात्रं दारुपात्रं वापिधानार्थम् /
text_mt: The Agnihotra-ladle, the pot, the fire-stirrer, the branch-strainer, the halter, the two tethers, the milking-vessel, and a metal pot or a wooden vessel for covering.

sanskrit_iast: samāv apracchinnāgrau darbhau prādeśamātrau pavitre karoti /
meaning: समाव् अप्रच्छिन्नाग्रौ दर्भौ प्रादेशमात्रौ पवित्रे करोति /
text_mt: He makes two strainers out of two equal darbha blades of a span's length, whose tips are not broken off.

sanskrit_iast: pavitre stho vaiṣṇavī \ vāyur vāṃ manasā punātu \\ iti tṛṇaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ vāntardhāya chinatti /
meaning: पवित्रे स्थो वैष्णवी \ वायुर् वां मनसा पुनातु \\ इति तृणं काष्ठं वान्तर्धाय छिनत्ति /
text_mt: With: 'You two are strainers sacred to Viṣṇu; may Vāyu purify you with the mind,' he cuts them, placing a blade of grass or a piece of wood between.

sanskrit_iast: na nakhena \\ imau prāṇāpānau \ yajñasyāṅgāni sarvaśaḥ / \ āpyāyayantau saṃcaratām \\ pavitre havyaśodhane \\ ity abhimantrya /
meaning: न नखेन \\ इमौ प्राणापानौ \ यज्ञस्याङ्गानि सर्वशः / \ आप्याययन्तौ संचरताम् \\ पवित्रे हव्यशोधने \\ इत्य् अभिमन्त्र्य /
text_mt: Not with the fingernail; having addressed them with: 'May these two, the in-breath and the out-breath, / invigorating all the limbs of the sacrifice, / move about, / two strainers that cleanse the sacrificial offering,'

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇor manasā pūte sthas \\ ity adbhir unmārṣṭi /
meaning: विष्णोर् मनसा पूते स्थस् \\ इत्य् अद्भिर् उन्मार्ष्टि /
text_mt: He wipes them upward with water, with: 'You two are purified by the mind of Viṣṇu.'

sanskrit_iast: agnihotrahavaṇyāṃ pavitrāntarhitāyām apa ānīya /
meaning: अग्निहोत्रहवण्यां पवित्रान्तर्हितायाम् अप आनीय /
text_mt: Having poured water into the Agnihotra-ladle in which the two strainers have been placed,

sanskrit_iast: devo vas \\ iti paccho gāyatryodagagrābhyāṃ pavitrābhyāṃ trir utpunāti /
meaning: देवो वस् \\ इति पच्छो गायत्र्योदगग्राभ्यां पवित्राभ्यां त्रिर् उत्पुनाति /
text_mt: With: 'May the god [Savitṛ purify] you,' he purifies [the water] three times, quarter by quarter with the Gāyatrī verse, using the two strainers pointed northward.

sanskrit_iast: āpo devīs \\ ity anumantrayate //
meaning: आपो देवीस् \\ इत्य् अनुमन्त्रयते //
text_mt: He follows with the mantra: 'O divine waters...'

sanskrit_iast: āpo devīḥ śuddhāḥ stha \\ imā pātrāṇi śundhata / \ upātaṅkyāya devānām \\ parṇavalkam uta śundhata \\ iti vā /
meaning: आपो देवीः शुद्धाः स्थ \\ इमा पात्राणि शुन्धत / \ उपातङ्क्याय देवानाम् \\ पर्णवल्कम् उत शुन्धत \\ इति वा /
text_mt: Or with: 'O divine waters, you are pure; / purify these utensils; / and purify the palāśa bark / for the curds of the gods.'

sanskrit_iast: śundhadhvam iti triḥ sarvābhir uttānāni pātrāṇi prokṣati śundhantāṃ viśvakarmāṇi devayajyāyai \ daivyāya karmaṇe śundhadhvam \\ yad vo 'śuddhāḥ parājagmus tad va etena śundhatām iti vā /
meaning: शुन्धध्वम् इति त्रिः सर्वाभिर् उत्तानानि पात्राणि प्रोक्षति शुन्धन्तां विश्वकर्माणि देवयज्यायै \ दैव्याय कर्मणे शुन्धध्वम् \\ यद् वो ऽशुद्धाः पराजग्मुस् तद् व एतेन शुन्धताम् इति वा /
text_mt: With: 'Be purified,' he sprinkles the upright vessels three times with all [the waters], or with: 'May the actions of all be purified for the worship of the gods; be purified for divine work; whatever impurity has overcome you, may it be purified from you by this.'

sanskrit_iast: etā ācaranti madhumad duhānāḥ \ prajāvatīr yaśaso viśvarūpāḥ / \ bahvīr bhavantīr upajāyamānās \\ iha va indro ramayatu gāvas \\ iti gā āyatīḥ pratīkṣate /
meaning: एता आचरन्ति मधुमद् दुहानाः \ प्रजावतीर् यशसो विश्वरूपाः / \ बह्वीर् भवन्तीर् उपजायमानास् \\ इह व इन्द्रो रमयतु गावस् \\ इति गा आयतीः प्रतीक्षते /
text_mt: With: 'These cows approach, yielding sweet milk, / having abundant offspring, glorious, omniform; / becoming many, being born here, / may Indra cause you to delight here, O cows,' he looks at the cows as they arrive.

sanskrit_iast: dhṛṣṭir asi \\ ity upaveṣam ādāya /
meaning: धृष्टिर् असि \\ इत्य् उपवेषम् आदाय /
text_mt: Having taken up the fire-stirrer with: 'You are the poker,'

sanskrit_iast: nirūḍhaṃ janyaṃ bhayam \\ saha tena yaṃ dviṣmas \\ subhūtāya śrayadhvam iti tena gārhapatyād udīco 'ṅgārān nirūhya /
meaning: निरूढं जन्यं भयम् \\ सह तेन यं द्विष्मस् \\ सुभूताय श्रयध्वम् इति तेन गार्हपत्याद् उदीचो ऽङ्गारान् निरूह्य /
text_mt: Having pushed out the embers toward the north from the gārhapatya fire with it, with: 'Banished is foreign danger / along with him whom we hate; / rest for welfare,'

sanskrit_iast: mātariśvanas \\ iti teṣu kumbhīm adhiśrayati /
meaning: मातरिश्वनस् \\ इति तेषु कुम्भीम् अधिश्रयति /
text_mt: With [the words,] 'Of Mātariśvan…' he places the pot over [the coals].

sanskrit_iast: aprasram̐sāya yajñasya \\ ukhe upadadhāmy aham / \ paśubhiḥ saṃnītaṃ bibhṛtām \ indrāya śṛtaṃ dadhi \\ iti vā /
meaning: अप्रस्रम्̐साय यज्ञस्य \\ उखे उपदधाम्य् अहम् / \ पशुभिः संनीतं बिभृताम् \ इन्द्राय शृतं दधि \\ इति वा /
text_mt: Or with: 'For the non-slipping of the sacrifice / I set down the two cooking-pots; / let them hold what has been brought together through cattle, / the boiled [milk and] curd for Indra.'

sanskrit_iast: bhṛgūṇām aṅgirasāṃ tapasā tapyasva \\ ity aṅgāraiḥ parīndhe /
meaning: भृगूणाम् अङ्गिरसां तपसा तप्यस्व \\ इत्य् अङ्गारैः परीन्धे /
text_mt: With [the words,] 'Heat up through the heat of the Bhṛgus, of the Aṅgirases,' he surrounds [it] with coals.

sanskrit_iast: upasṛṣṭāṃ me prabrūtāt \\ iti saṃpreṣyati /
meaning: उपसृष्टां मे प्रब्रूतात् \\ इति संप्रेष्यति /
text_mt: He gives the ritual direction: 'Announce to me [the cow] that has been let loose [to the calf]!'

sanskrit_iast: vasūnāṃ pavitram asi sahasradhāram iti kumbhyāṃ prāgagram̐ śākhāpavitram ādadhāti /
meaning: वसूनां पवित्रम् असि सहस्रधारम् इति कुम्भ्यां प्रागग्रम्̐ शाखापवित्रम् आदधाति /
text_mt: With [the words,] 'You are the strainer of the Vasus, thousand-streamed,' he places the branch-strainer in the pot with its tip pointing eastward.

sanskrit_iast: anvārabhya vācaṃ yacchati dhārayann āste /
meaning: अन्वारभ्य वाचं यच्छति धारयन्न् आस्ते /
text_mt: Having taken hold [of it], he restrains his speech and sits holding [it].

sanskrit_iast: adityai rāsnāsi \\ ity abhidhānīm ādatte //
meaning: अदित्यै रास्नासि \\ इत्य् अभिधानीम् आदत्ते //
text_mt: With [the words,] 'You are Aditi's girdle,' he takes the tethering-rope.

sanskrit_iast: trayastrim̐śo 'si tantūnām \\ pavitreṇa sahāgahi / \ śiveyam̐ rajjur abhidhānī \\ aghniyām upasevatām iti vā /
meaning: त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शो ऽसि तन्तूनाम् \\ पवित्रेण सहागहि / \ शिवेयम्̐ रज्जुर् अभिधानी \\ अघ्नियाम् उपसेवताम् इति वा /
text_mt: Or with: 'You are the thirty-third of the threads; / come along with the strainer; / may this rope, the tethering-rope, auspicious, / attend upon the inviolable cow.'

sanskrit_iast: pūṣāsi \\ iti vatsam upasṛjati /
meaning: पूषासि \\ इति वत्सम् उपसृजति /
text_mt: With [the words,] 'You are Pūṣan,' he lets loose the calf.

sanskrit_iast: dhāvantaṃ vānumantrayate /
meaning: धावन्तं वानुमन्त्रयते /
text_mt: Or he recites over it as it runs.

sanskrit_iast: vihāraṃ gāṃ copasṛṣṭām \ antareṇa mā saṃcāriṣṭa \\ iti saṃpreṣyati na duhyamānām antareṇa yanti vihāraṃ gāṃ ca /
meaning: विहारं गां चोपसृष्टाम् \ अन्तरेण मा संचारिष्ट \\ इति संप्रेष्यति न दुह्यमानाम् अन्तरेण यन्ति विहारं गां च /
text_mt: He gives the ritual direction: 'Do not pass between the sacrificial area and the cow that has been let loose!' They do not pass between the sacrificial area and the cow while she is being milked.

sanskrit_iast: yadi vyaveyāt sāṃnāyyaṃ mā vilopi \\ iti brūyāt /
meaning: यदि व्यवेयात् सांनाय्यं मा विलोपि \\ इति ब्रूयात् /
text_mt: If someone should step between, he should say: 'May the curd-and-milk oblation not be destroyed!'

sanskrit_iast: ūrjaṃ payaḥ pinvamānā ghṛtaṃ ca \ jīvo jīvantīr upa vaḥ sadeyam ity upasannām /
meaning: ऊर्जं पयः पिन्वमाना घृतं च \ जीवो जीवन्तीर् उप वः सदेयम् इत्य् उपसन्नाम् /
text_mt: With [the words,] 'Swelling with refreshment, milk, and clarified butter, / may I, living, sit beside you who are living,' [he recites over the cow] when she has approached.

sanskrit_iast: dyauś cemaṃ yajñaṃ pṛthivī ca saṃduhātām \\ dhātā somena saha vātena vāyuḥ / \ yajamānāya draviṇaṃ dadhātu \\ iti duhyamānām utsaṃ duhanti kalaśaṃ caturbilam iḍāṃ devīṃ madhumatīm̐ suvarvidam / \ tad indrāgnī jinvatam̐ sūnṛtāvat \ tad yajamānam amṛtatve dadhātu \\ iti dhārāghoṣam anumantrayate /
meaning: द्यौश् चेमं यज्ञं पृथिवी च संदुहाताम् \\ धाता सोमेन सह वातेन वायुः / \ यजमानाय द्रविणं दधातु \\ इति दुह्यमानाम् उत्सं दुहन्ति कलशं चतुर्बिलम् इडां देवीं मधुमतीम्̐ सुवर्विदम् / \ तद् इन्द्राग्नी जिन्वतम्̐ सूनृतावत् \ तद् यजमानम् अमृतत्वे दधातु \\ इति धाराघोषम् अनुमन्त्रयते /
text_mt: With [the words,] 'May both heaven and earth milk this sacrifice together; / may Dhātṛ, [and] Vāyu with Soma and the wind, / grant wealth to the sacrificer,' [he recites over her] while she is being milked; with [the verse,] 'They milk the well, the four-spouted jar, / the divine Iḍā, honey-rich, finding the sun; / let Indra and Agni, full of truth, quicken that; / let that place the sacrificer in immortality,' he recites over the sound of the milk-stream.

sanskrit_iast: dogdhā harati /
meaning: दोग्धा हरति /

sanskrit_iast: taṃ pṛcchati kāmadhukṣaḥ pra ṇo brūhi /
meaning: तं पृच्छति कामधुक्षः प्र णो ब्रूहि /
text_mt: He asks him: 'Which [cow] have you milked? Announce to us!'

sanskrit_iast: amūm \\ yasyāṃ devānāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ payo hitam iti \\ asau \\ iti godhug ācaṣṭe /
meaning: अमूम् \\ यस्यां देवानां मनुष्याणां पयो हितम् इति \\ असौ \\ इति गोधुग् आचष्टे /
text_mt: The cow-milker declares: 'That one, in whom the milk of gods and men is deposited—that one.'

sanskrit_iast: sā viśvāyus \\ iti pratyucya /
meaning: सा विश्वायुस् \\ इति प्रत्युच्य /
text_mt: Having responded: 'She is all-life,'

sanskrit_iast: devas tvā savitā punātu vasoḥ pavitreṇa śatadhāreṇa supuvā \\ iti kumbhyām ānayati /
meaning: देवस् त्वा सविता पुनातु वसोः पवित्रेण शतधारेण सुपुवा \\ इति कुम्भ्याम् आनयति /
text_mt: he pours [the milk] into the pot with: 'May the divine Savitṛ purify you with the Vasu's strainer of a hundred streams, well-cleansing.'

sanskrit_iast: yad anyat saṃpraiṣāt tenottare dohayati /
meaning: यद् अन्यत् संप्रैषात् तेनोत्तरे दोहयति /
text_mt: With whatever [mantras are used] other than the ritual direction, he causes the subsequent [cows] to be milked.

sanskrit_iast: sā viśvavyacās \\ iti dvitīyām \\ sā viśvakarmā \\ iti tṛtīyām /
meaning: सा विश्वव्यचास् \\ इति द्वितीयाम् \\ सा विश्वकर्मा \\ इति तृतीयाम् /
text_mt: With 'She is all-encompassing,' [he responds] for the second; with 'She is all-working,' for the third.

sanskrit_iast: tisro dohayitvā bahu dugdhīndrāya devebhyas \\ havyam āpyāyatāṃ punar \ vatsebhyo manuṣyebhyas \\ punar dohāya kalpatām iti triḥ saṃpreṣyati /
meaning: तिस्रो दोहयित्वा बहु दुग्धीन्द्राय देवेभ्यस् \\ हव्यम् आप्यायतां पुनर् \ वत्सेभ्यो मनुष्येभ्यस् \\ पुनर् दोहाय कल्पताम् इति त्रिः संप्रेष्यति /
text_mt: Having caused three [cows] to be milked, he gives the ritual direction three times: 'Milk much for Indra, for the gods! / Let the oblation swell again; / for the calves, for men, / let it be fit for milking again!'

sanskrit_iast: visṛṣṭavāg ananvārabhya //
meaning: विसृष्टवाग् अनन्वारभ्य //
text_mt: Having released his speech, without holding on,

sanskrit_iast: uttarā dohayati tūṣṇīṃ vā /
meaning: उत्तरा दोहयति तूष्णीं वा /
text_mt: he causes the remaining [cows] to be milked, or silently.

sanskrit_iast: sarvāsu dugdhāsu hutaḥ stokas \\ iti vipruṣo 'numantrayate /
meaning: सर्वासु दुग्धासु हुतः स्तोकस् \\ इति विप्रुषो ऽनुमन्त्रयते /
text_mt: When all have been milked, he recites over the drops with: 'Offered is the drop…'

sanskrit_iast: dyauś cemaṃ yajñam iti sāṃnāyyam /
meaning: द्यौश् चेमं यज्ञम् इति सांनाय्यम् /
text_mt: With 'May both heaven and earth… [milk] this sacrifice…' [he recites over] the curd-and-milk oblation.

sanskrit_iast: dohanam̐ saṃkṣālya saṃpṛcyadhvam iti kumbhyāyānayati /
meaning: दोहनम्̐ संक्षाल्य संपृच्यध्वम् इति कुम्भ्यायानयति /
text_mt: Having rinsed the milking vessel, he pours [the water] into the pot with: 'Mix together!'

sanskrit_iast: śrapayitvā tūṣṇīkena sarpiṣābhidhārya /
meaning: श्रपयित्वा तूष्णीकेन सर्पिषाभिधार्य /
text_mt: Having boiled [it], having poured over [it] clarified butter silently,

sanskrit_iast: dṛm̐ha gās \\ dṛm̐ha gopatim \\ mā vo yajñapatī riṣat \\ iti prācīnam udīcīnaṃ prāgudag vā karṣann ivodvāsayati /
meaning: दृम्̐ह गास् \\ दृम्̐ह गोपतिम् \\ मा वो यज्ञपती रिषत् \\ इति प्राचीनम् उदीचीनं प्रागुदग् वा कर्षन्न् इवोद्वासयति /
text_mt: with [the words,] 'Strengthen the cows, strengthen the lord of cows, / may the lord of the sacrifice not harm you,' he removes [it from the fire], as if dragging it toward the east, toward the north, or toward the northeast.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvedyurdugdhaṃ dadhi havirātañcanam ekasyā dvayos tisṛṇāṃ vaikāhe dvyahe tryahe vā saṃtatam abhidugdham aupavasathād bhavati /
meaning: पूर्वेद्युर्दुग्धं दधि हविरातञ्चनम् एकस्या द्वयोस् तिसृणां वैकाहे द्व्यहे त्र्यहे वा संततम् अभिदुग्धम् औपवसथाद् भवति /
text_mt: The sacrificial curd curdled on the previous day, which serves as the coagulant, is from one, from two, or from three [cows], continuously milked over one day, two days, or three days, up to the fast-day.

sanskrit_iast: somena tvātanacmi \\ iti tena śītaṃ budhnaṃ kṛtvātanakti \\ indrasya tvā bhāgam̐ somenātanacmi \\ iti vā /
meaning: सोमेन त्वातनच्मि \\ इति तेन शीतं बुध्नं कृत्वातनक्ति \\ इन्द्रस्य त्वा भागम्̐ सोमेनातनच्मि \\ इति वा /
text_mt: With [the words,] 'With Soma I curdle you,' having made its bottom cool, he curdles [it] with that; or with: 'With Soma I curdle you as the portion of Indra.'

sanskrit_iast: taṇḍulaiḥ parṇavalkaiḥ kvalair badaraiḥ pūtīkair vā /
meaning: तण्डुलैः पर्णवल्कैः क्वलैर् बदरैः पूतीकैर् वा /
text_mt: [He curdles it] with rice grains, with bark of the parṇa tree, with jujubes, with badara fruits, or with pūtīka plants.

sanskrit_iast: yajñasya saṃtatir asi \ yajñasya tvā saṃtatim anusaṃtanomi \\ ity agnihotroccheṣaṇam ānayati tūṣṇīṃ vā /
meaning: यज्ञस्य संततिर् असि \ यज्ञस्य त्वा संततिम् अनुसंतनोमि \\ इत्य् अग्निहोत्रोच्छेषणम् आनयति तूष्णीं वा /
text_mt: With [the words,] 'You are the continuity of the sacrifice; I continue you following the continuity of the sacrifice,' he pours in the residue of the Agnihotra, or silently.

sanskrit_iast: āpo haviḥṣu jāgṛta \ yathā deveṣu jāgratha / \ evam asmin yajñe yajamānāya jāgṛta \\ ity apidhānārthe pātre 'pa ānayati \\ adastam asi viṣṇave tvā \ yajñāyāpidadhāmy aham / \ adbhir ariktena pātreṇa \ yāḥ pūtāḥ pariśerate \\ ity apidadhāti /
meaning: आपो हविःषु जागृत \ यथा देवेषु जाग्रथ / \ एवम् अस्मिन् यज्ञे यजमानाय जागृत \\ इत्य् अपिधानार्थे पात्रे ऽप आनयति \\ अदस्तम् असि विष्णवे त्वा \ यज्ञायापिदधाम्य् अहम् / \ अद्भिर् अरिक्तेन पात्रेण \ याः पूताः परिशेरते \\ इत्य् अपिदधाति /
text_mt: With [the words,] 'O waters, be watchful over the oblations, as you are watchful among the gods; / thus in this sacrifice be watchful for the sacrificer,' he pours water into a vessel meant for covering; with [the verse,] 'You are unbroken; I cover you for Viṣṇu, for the sacrifice, / with a vessel not empty of water, / which [waters] lie around purified,' he covers [it].

sanskrit_iast: yadi mṛnmayam̐ syāt tṛṇaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ vānupravidhyet /
meaning: यदि मृन्मयम्̐ स्यात् तृणं काष्ठं वानुप्रविध्येत् /
text_mt: If it should be made of clay, he should throw in a blade of grass or a piece of wood.

sanskrit_iast: imau parṇaṃ ca darbhaṃ ca \ devānām̐ havyaśodhanau / \ prātar veṣāya gopāya \ viṣṇo havyam̐ hi rakṣasi \\ ity unmucya śākhāpavitraṃ prajñātaṃ nidadhāti /
meaning: इमौ पर्णं च दर्भं च \ देवानाम्̐ हव्यशोधनौ / \ प्रातर् वेषाय गोपाय \ विष्णो हव्यम्̐ हि रक्षसि \\ इत्य् उन्मुच्य शाखापवित्रं प्रज्ञातं निदधाति /
text_mt: With [the verse,] 'These two, the parṇa and the darbha grass, / the purifiers of the oblation of the gods— / guard them for the morning service; / for, O Viṣṇu, you protect the oblation,' having untied the branch-strainer, he puts it down in a known place.

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇo havyam̐ rakṣasva \\ iti sāṃnāyyaṃ gārhapatyadeśa upari nidadhāti //
meaning: विष्णो हव्यम्̐ रक्षस्व \\ इति सांनाय्यं गार्हपत्यदेश उपरि निदधाति //
text_mt: With [the words,] 'O Viṣṇu, protect the oblation,' he puts down the curd-and-milk oblation in the area of the gārhapatya fire, above [the ground].

sanskrit_iast: anyām̐ śākhām āhṛtya tenaiva kalpena tayā darbhair vā prātardohāya vatsān apākaroti yathā sāyaṃdohāya /
meaning: अन्याम्̐ शाखाम् आहृत्य तेनैव कल्पेन तया दर्भैर् वा प्रातर्दोहाय वत्सान् अपाकरोति यथा सायंदोहाय /
text_mt: Having fetched another branch, according to that very procedure, with it or with darbha blades, he drives away the calves for the morning milking just as for the evening milking.

sanskrit_iast: upadhāya kapālāni prātardohaṃ dohayati tasya sāyaṃdohena kalpo vyākhyātaḥ /
meaning: उपधाय कपालानि प्रातर्दोहं दोहयति तस्य सायंदोहेन कल्पो व्याख्यातः /
text_mt: Having arranged the potsherds, he causes the morning milking to be done; its procedure has been explained by the evening milking.

sanskrit_iast: aprasram̐sāya yajñasya \\ ukhe upadadhāmy aham / \ paśubhiḥ saṃnītaṃ bibhṛtām \ indrāya śṛtam iti mantrāntam̐ saṃnamati /
meaning: अप्रस्रम्̐साय यज्ञस्य \\ उखे उपदधाम्य् अहम् / \ पशुभिः संनीतं बिभृताम् \ इन्द्राय शृतम् इति मन्त्रान्तम्̐ संनमति /
text_mt: He adapts the end of the mantra: 'For the non-slipping of the sacrifice / I set down the two cooking-pots; / let them hold what has been brought together through cattle, / boiled for Indra.'

sanskrit_iast: udagagram̐ śākhāpavitram ādadhāti /
meaning: उदगग्रम्̐ शाखापवित्रम् आदधाति /
text_mt: He places the branch-strainer with its tip pointing northward.

sanskrit_iast: nātanakti /
meaning: नातनक्ति /

sanskrit_iast: nāsomayājī saṃnayed atho khalv āhuḥ kāpeyāḥ saṃneyam evāsomayājineti /
meaning: नासोमयाजी संनयेद् अथो खल्व् आहुः कापेयाः संनेयम् एवासोमयाजिनेति /
text_mt: One who has not performed a soma sacrifice should not offer the curd-and-milk oblation; yet indeed the Kāpeyas say: 'Even one who has not performed a soma sacrifice should offer the curd-and-milk oblation.'

sanskrit_iast: aindram̐ sāṃnāyyam̐ someneṣṭvā mahendraṃ yajeta /
meaning: ऐन्द्रम्̐ सांनाय्यम्̐ सोमेनेष्ट्वा महेन्द्रं यजेत /
text_mt: The curd-and-milk oblation is for Indra; having sacrificed with Soma, he should sacrifice to Mahendra.

sanskrit_iast: api vā saṃvatsaraṃ dvau vendram iṣṭvāgnaye vratapataye 'ṣṭākapālaṃ nirupya kāmaṃ mahendraṃ yajeta /
meaning: अपि वा संवत्सरं द्वौ वेन्द्रम् इष्ट्वाग्नये व्रतपतये ऽष्टाकपालं निरुप्य कामं महेन्द्रं यजेत /
text_mt: Or having sacrificed to Indra for a year or for two [years], having assigned [a cake] on eight potsherds to Agni Vratapati, he may sacrifice to Mahendra at will.

sanskrit_iast: aurvo gautamo bhāradvājaḥ śuśruvān grāmaṇī rājanya iti sarvatra kāmaṃ mahendraṃ yajeran /
meaning: और्वो गौतमो भारद्वाजः शुश्रुवान् ग्रामणी राजन्य इति सर्वत्र कामं महेन्द्रं यजेरन् /
text_mt: An Aurva, a Gautama, a Bhāradvāja, a learned Brāhmaṇa, a village headman, [or] a kṣatriya may in all cases sacrifice to Mahendra at will.

sanskrit_iast: paristṛṇīta paridhattāgnim \\ parihito 'gnir yajamānaṃ bhunaktu / \ apām̐ rasa oṣadhīnām̐ suvarṇas \\ niṣkā ime yajamānasya santu \ kāmadughā amutrāmuṣmim̐l loke \\ iti saṃpreṣyati /
meaning: परिस्तृणीत परिधत्ताग्निम् \\ परिहितो ऽग्निर् यजमानं भुनक्तु / \ अपाम्̐ रस ओषधीनाम्̐ सुवर्णस् \\ निष्का इमे यजमानस्य सन्तु \ कामदुघा अमुत्रामुष्मिम्̐ल् लोके \\ इति संप्रेष्यति /
text_mt: He gives the ritual direction: 'Strew around [the fire], enclose the fire; / let the enclosed fire protect the sacrificer; / the sap of the waters, the gold of the plants— / let these golden ornaments belong to the sacrificer, / yielding desires over there in that world!'

sanskrit_iast: darbhair agnīn paristṛṇāti /
meaning: दर्भैर् अग्नीन् परिस्तृणाति /
text_mt: He strews around the fires with darbha grass.

sanskrit_iast: āhavanīyaṃ paristīrya gārhapatyam atha dakṣiṇāgniṃ gārhapatyaṃ vā paristīrya dakṣiṇāgnim athāhavanīyam /
meaning: आहवनीयं परिस्तीर्य गार्हपत्यम् अथ दक्षिणाग्निं गार्हपत्यं वा परिस्तीर्य दक्षिणाग्निम् अथाहवनीयम् /
text_mt: Having strewn around the āhavanīya fire, [he strews around] the gārhapatya fire, then the dakṣiṇāgni fire; or having strewn around the gārhapatya fire, [then] the dakṣiṇāgni fire, then the āhavanīya fire.

sanskrit_iast: udagagrāḥ paścāt purastāc ca bhavanti /
meaning: उदगग्राः पश्चात् पुरस्ताच् च भवन्ति /
text_mt: [The blades] behind and in front have their tips pointing northward.

sanskrit_iast: etat kṛtvopavasaty amāvāsyāyām /
meaning: एतत् कृत्वोपवसत्य् अमावास्यायाम् /
text_mt: Having done this, he fasts on the New Moon day.

sanskrit_iast: paurṇamāsyāṃ tu /
meaning: पौर्णमास्यां तु /

sanskrit_iast: pūrvedyur agnyanvādhānam agniparistaraṇaṃ ca /
meaning: पूर्वेद्युर् अग्न्यन्वाधानम् अग्निपरिस्तरणं च /
text_mt: The fueling of the fires and the strewing around the fires take place on the previous day.

sanskrit_iast: śvo bhūta idhmābarhir vedaṃ ca karoti /
meaning: श्वो भूत इध्माबर्हिर् वेदं च करोति /
text_mt: On the next day he prepares the sacrificial grass and firewood, and the veda.

sanskrit_iast: sadyo vā /
meaning: सद्यो वा /

sanskrit_iast: sarvaṃ kriyate //
meaning: सर्वं क्रियते //

sanskrit_iast: sadyaskālāyām upariṣṭād vedakarmaṇo 'gnīn paristṛṇāti /
meaning: सद्यस्कालायाम् उपरिष्टाद् वेदकर्मणो ऽग्नीन् परिस्तृणाति /
text_mt: When [the performance is] on the same day, he strews around the fires after the rite of the veda.

sanskrit_iast: prātar agnihotram̐ hutvodita āditye paurṇamāsyās tantraṃ prakramayati prāg udayād amāvāsyāyāḥ /
meaning: प्रातर् अग्निहोत्रम्̐ हुत्वोदित आदित्ये पौर्णमास्यास् तन्त्रं प्रक्रमयति प्राग् उदयाद् अमावास्यायाः /
text_mt: Having offered the morning Agnihotra, when the sun has risen, he initiates the framework of the Full Moon rite; before sunrise, [that] of the New Moon rite.

sanskrit_iast: karmaṇe vām iti pāṇī prakṣālya /
meaning: कर्मणे वाम् इति पाणी प्रक्षाल्य /
text_mt: Having washed his hands with: 'For the rite, [I wash] you two,'

sanskrit_iast: yajñasya saṃtatir asi \ yajñasya tvā saṃtatyai stṛṇāmi \ saṃtatyai tvā yajñasya \\ iti gārhapatyāt saṃtatām ulaparājīm̐ stṛṇāty āhavanīyāt tūṣṇīṃ dakṣiṇāṃ tūṣṇīm uttarām /
meaning: यज्ञस्य संततिर् असि \ यज्ञस्य त्वा संतत्यै स्तृणामि \ संतत्यै त्वा यज्ञस्य \\ इति गार्हपत्यात् संतताम् उलपराजीम्̐ स्तृणात्य् आहवनीयात् तूष्णीं दक्षिणां तूष्णीम् उत्तराम् /
text_mt: with [the words,] 'You are the continuity of the sacrifice; I strew you for the continuity of the sacrifice; for the continuity of the sacrifice, you,' he strews an unbroken line of coarse grass from the gārhapatya fire up to the āhavanīya fire; silently to the south, silently to the north.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇenāhavanīyaṃ brahmayajamānayoḥ sadane karoti /
meaning: दक्षिणेनाहवनीयं ब्रह्मयजमानयोः सदने करोति /
text_mt: South of the āhavanīya, he makes the seats for the brahman priest and the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvaṃ brahmaṇe 'paraṃ yajamānāya /
meaning: पूर्वं ब्रह्मणे ऽपरं यजमानाय /
text_mt: The eastern [seat] is for the brahman priest, the western for the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast: uttareṇa gārhapatyaṃ darbhān sam̐stīrya dvaṃdvaṃ pātrāṇi prakṣālya nyañci prayunakti /
meaning: उत्तरेण गार्हपत्यं दर्भान् सम्̐स्तीर्य द्वंद्वं पात्राणि प्रक्षाल्य न्यञ्चि प्रयुनक्ति /
text_mt: Having spread darbha-grass north of the gārhapatya and rinsed the utensils in pairs, he arranges them face downward:

sanskrit_iast: sphyaṃ kapālāni /
meaning: स्फ्यं कपालानि /

sanskrit_iast: agnihotrahavaṇīm̐ śūrpam /
meaning: अग्निहोत्रहवणीम्̐ शूर्पम् /
text_mt: the Agnihotra ladle and the winnowing basket;

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṇājinam̐ śamyām /
meaning: कृष्णाजिनम्̐ शम्याम् /

sanskrit_iast: ulūkhalaṃ musalam /
meaning: उलूखलं मुसलम् /

sanskrit_iast: dṛṣadam upalām /
meaning: दृषदम् उपलाम् /

sanskrit_iast: aratnimātryo bāhumātryo vā mukhavatyo haṃsamukhaprasecanā agrāgrā bhavanti tvaktobilā vāyasapucchya ity ekeṣām̐ hastyoṣṭhya ity ekeṣām /
meaning: अरत्निमात्र्यो बाहुमात्र्यो वा मुखवत्यो हंसमुखप्रसेचना अग्राग्रा भवन्ति त्वक्तोबिला वायसपुच्छ्य इत्य् एकेषाम्̐ हस्त्योष्ठ्य इत्य् एकेषाम् /
text_mt: they measure a cubit or an arm's length, are fitted with spouts, having spouts shaped like a swan's beak, their tips pointing forward; according to some, their openings are level with the rim, resembling a crow's tail; according to others, they are shaped like an elephant's lip;

sanskrit_iast: ājyasthālīṃ kuṭarum /
meaning: आज्यस्थालीं कुटरुम् /

sanskrit_iast: pātrīṃ mekṣaṇam /
meaning: पात्रीं मेक्षणम् /

sanskrit_iast: vedaṃ prāśitraharaṇam /
meaning: वेदं प्राशित्रहरणम् /
text_mt: the bunch of grass and the vessel for taking the prāśitra portion;

sanskrit_iast: praṇītāpraṇayanam iḍāpātraṃ ca /
meaning: प्रणीताप्रणयनम् इडापात्रं च /
text_mt: the vessel for carrying forward the praṇītā water and the iḍā vessel;

sanskrit_iast: ekām anvāhāryasthālīm /
meaning: एकाम् अन्वाहार्यस्थालीम् /
text_mt: and one cooking pot for the anvāhārya rice.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ yāny anādiṣṭavṛkṣāṇi vikaṅkatasya tāni /
meaning: तेषां यान्य् अनादिष्टवृक्षाणि विकङ्कतस्य तानि /
text_mt: Among them, those whose wood is not specified are of vikaṅkata wood.

sanskrit_iast: ahomārthāni tu vāraṇasya /
meaning: अहोमार्थानि तु वारणस्य /
text_mt: Those not used for oblations, however, are of vāraṇa wood.

sanskrit_iast: atra prātardohapātrāṇi prayunakti /
meaning: अत्र प्रातर्दोहपात्राणि प्रयुनक्ति /
text_mt: At this point, he arranges the utensils for the morning milking.

sanskrit_iast: annāsaṃnayataḥ pavitre karoti /
meaning: अन्नासंनयतः पवित्रे करोति /
text_mt: If he does not perform the curd-and-milk oblation, he makes two strainers.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvedyuḥkṛte saṃnayato dhāryete /
meaning: पूर्वेद्युःकृते संनयतो धार्येते /
text_mt: If he performs the curd-and-milk oblation, the two [strainers] made on the preceding day are kept.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣāya tvā \\ iti praṇītāpraṇayanaṃ camasam ādāya //
meaning: दक्षाय त्वा \\ इति प्रणीताप्रणयनं चमसम् आदाय //
text_mt: With the mantra, 'For skill thee,' he takes the praṇītā-cup.

sanskrit_iast: vānaspatyo 'si devebhyaḥ śundhasva \ devebhyaḥ śumbhasva \ devebhyaḥ śudhyasva \\ iti triḥ prakṣālayati /
meaning: वानस्पत्यो ऽसि देवेभ्यः शुन्धस्व \ देवेभ्यः शुम्भस्व \ देवेभ्यः शुध्यस्व \\ इति त्रिः प्रक्षालयति /
text_mt: He rinses it three times with the mantras: 'Thou art made of wood; be purified for the gods,' 'Be cleansed for the gods,' 'Be made pure for the gods.'

sanskrit_iast: kam̐sena brahmavarcasakāmasya praṇayen mṛnmayenānnādyakāmasya /
meaning: कम्̐सेन ब्रह्मवर्चसकामस्य प्रणयेन् मृन्मयेनान्नाद्यकामस्य /
text_mt: For one desirous of spiritual luster, he should bring forward [the water] with a bronze vessel; for one desirous of food, with an earthenware vessel.

sanskrit_iast: apareṇottareṇa vā gārhapatyam upaviśya ko vo gṛhṇāti sa vo gṛhṇātu \ kasmai vo gṛhṇāmi tasmai vo gṛhṇāmi \ poṣāya vas \\ iti pavitrāntarhite pātre 'pa ānayati \\ anayā vo gṛhṇāmi \\ iti pṛthivīṃ manasā dhyāyan /
meaning: अपरेणोत्तरेण वा गार्हपत्यम् उपविश्य को वो गृह्णाति स वो गृह्णातु \ कस्मै वो गृह्णामि तस्मै वो गृह्णामि \ पोषाय वस् \\ इति पवित्रान्तर्हिते पात्रे ऽप आनयति \\ अनया वो गृह्णामि \\ इति पृथिवीं मनसा ध्यायन् /
text_mt: Sitting down behind or to the north of the gārhapatya, he pours water into the vessel with the strainer placed inside it, with the mantra: 'Who takes you? Let him take you. For whom do I take you? For him I take you. For your prosperity'—meditating in his mind on the earth: 'With this [earth] I take you.'

sanskrit_iast: upabilaṃ pūrayitvā /
meaning: उपबिलं पूरयित्वा /

sanskrit_iast: utpūyābhimantrayate /
meaning: उत्पूयाभिमन्त्रयते /

sanskrit_iast: yathā prokṣṇīḥ /
meaning: यथा प्रोक्ष्णीः /

sanskrit_iast: yāḥ purastāt prasravanti \\ upariṣṭāt sarvataś ca yāḥ / \ tābhī raśmipavitrābhis \\ śraddhāṃ yajñam ārabhe \\ iti vā brahmann apaḥ praṇeṣyāmi \ yajamāna vācaṃ yaccha \\ iti saṃpreṣyati /
meaning: याः पुरस्तात् प्रस्रवन्ति \\ उपरिष्टात् सर्वतश् च याः / \ ताभी रश्मिपवित्राभिस् \\ श्रद्धां यज्ञम् आरभे \\ इति वा ब्रह्मन्न् अपः प्रणेष्यामि \ यजमान वाचं यच्छ \\ इति संप्रेष्यति /
text_mt: Or [with the mantra]: 'They that flow forth in the east, from above, and from every side; / with them, purified by rays, I begin the faith, the sacrifice.' He then issues the direction: 'O brahman priest, I shall bring forward the waters; O sacrificer, restrain your speech!'

sanskrit_iast: sarveṣv āmantraṇeṣu prasava ukte karoti /
meaning: सर्वेष्व् आमन्त्रणेषु प्रसव उक्ते करोति /
text_mt: In all addressings, he acts once the impulse has been given.

sanskrit_iast: praṇayan vācaṃ yacchati /
meaning: प्रणयन् वाचं यच्छति /
text_mt: Bringing forward [the water], he restrains his speech.

sanskrit_iast: tām̐ haviṣkṛtā visṛjate /
meaning: ताम्̐ हविष्कृता विसृजते /
text_mt: He releases it at the [call] 'haviskṛt' ('Come, O preparer of the oblation!').

sanskrit_iast: ko vaḥ praṇayati sa vaḥ praṇayatu \\ apo devīḥ praṇayāmi \ yajñam̐ sam̐sādayantu naḥ / \ iraṃ madantīr ghṛtapṛṣṭhā udākus \\ sahasrapoṣaṃ yajamāne nyañcatīs \\ iti sphenopayamya samaṃ prāṇair dhārayamāṇo viṣiñcan harati /
meaning: को वः प्रणयति स वः प्रणयतु \\ अपो देवीः प्रणयामि \ यज्ञम्̐ सम्̐सादयन्तु नः / \ इरं मदन्तीर् घृतपृष्ठा उदाकुस् \\ सहस्रपोषं यजमाने न्यञ्चतीस् \\ इति स्फेनोपयम्य समं प्राणैर् धारयमाणो विषिञ्चन् हरति /
text_mt: With the mantra: 'Who brings you forward? Let him bring you forward. I bring forward the divine waters; let them establish our sacrifice. Refreshing, boiling, with clarified-butter surfaces, swelling, bringing thousandfold prosperity down into the sacrificer,' having supported [the cup] with the wooden sword, holding it level with his breaths, he carries it without spilling.

sanskrit_iast: devā gātuvido gātuṃ yajñāya vindata / \ manasas patinā devena vātād yajñaḥ prayujyatām iti vā /
meaning: देवा गातुविदो गातुं यज्ञाय विन्दत / \ मनसस् पतिना देवेन वाताद् यज्ञः प्रयुज्यताम् इति वा /
text_mt: Or [with the mantra]: 'O path-finding gods, find the path for the sacrifice. / Urged by the lord of thought, the divine [one], let the sacrifice proceed from the wind.'

sanskrit_iast: brahmapūtāḥ stha \ ko vo yunakti sa vo yunaktu \ viśvebhyaḥ kāmebhyo devayajyāyai \\ ity uttareṇāhavanīyaṃ darbheṣu sādayitvā darbhair apidadhāti /
meaning: ब्रह्मपूताः स्थ \ को वो युनक्ति स वो युनक्तु \ विश्वेभ्यः कामेभ्यो देवयज्यायै \\ इत्य् उत्तरेणाहवनीयं दर्भेषु सादयित्वा दर्भैर् अपिदधाति /
text_mt: Having set it down on darbha-grass to the north of the āhavanīya with the mantra: 'You are purified by the brahman. Who yokes you? Let him yoke you, for all desires, for worship of the gods,' he covers it with darbha-grass.

sanskrit_iast: tā neṅgayanty ā sam̐sthānāt /
meaning: ता नेङ्गयन्त्य् आ सम्̐स्थानात् /
text_mt: They do not move them until the conclusion [of the sacrifice].

sanskrit_iast: saṃviśantāṃ daivīr viśaḥ pātrāṇi devayajyāyai \\ iti sapavitreṇa pāṇinā pātrāṇi saṃmṛśati //
meaning: संविशन्तां दैवीर् विशः पात्राणि देवयज्यायै \\ इति सपवित्रेण पाणिना पात्राणि संमृशति //
text_mt: With the mantra, 'Let the divine clans enter the utensils for worship of the gods,' he touches the utensils with the hand holding the strainer.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣāya vānaspatyāsi \\ ity agnihotrahavaṇīm ādatte veṣāya tvā \\ iti śūrpam /
meaning: दक्षाय वानस्पत्यासि \\ इत्य् अग्निहोत्रहवणीम् आदत्ते वेषाय त्वा \\ इति शूर्पम् /
text_mt: With the mantra, 'For skill, made of wood art thou,' he takes the Agnihotra ladle; with 'For work thee,' the winnowing basket.

sanskrit_iast: pratyuṣṭam ity āhavanīye gārhapatye vā niṣṭapati /
meaning: प्रत्युष्टम् इत्य् आहवनीये गार्हपत्ये वा निष्टपति /
text_mt: With the mantra, 'Scorched [is the Rakṣas]...,' he warms them over the āhavanīya or the gārhapatya.

sanskrit_iast: yajamāna havir nirvapsyāmi \\ ity āmantrayate /
meaning: यजमान हविर् निर्वप्स्यामि \\ इत्य् आमन्त्रयते /
text_mt: He addresses [the sacrificer]: 'O sacrificer, I shall mete out the oblation.'

sanskrit_iast: pravasati
meaning: प्रवसति

sanskrit_iast: agne havir nirvapsyāmi \\ ity anubrūyāt /
meaning: अग्ने हविर् निर्वप्स्यामि \\ इत्य् अनुब्रूयात् /
text_mt: he should say: 'O Agni, I shall mete out the oblation.'

sanskrit_iast: urv antarikṣam anvemi \\ iti gacchati /
meaning: उर्व् अन्तरिक्षम् अन्वेमि \\ इति गच्छति /
text_mt: With the mantra, 'I pursue the wide intermediate space,' he goes [to the cart].

sanskrit_iast: apareṇāhavanīyam apareṇa vā gārhapatyaṃ naddhayugam̐ sapariṇatkam̐ śakaṭam avasthitaṃ vrīhimad yavamad vā prāgīṣam udagīṣaṃ vā /
meaning: अपरेणाहवनीयम् अपरेण वा गार्हपत्यं नद्धयुगम्̐ सपरिणत्कम्̐ शकटम् अवस्थितं व्रीहिमद् यवमद् वा प्रागीषम् उदगीषं वा /
text_mt: Behind the āhavanīya or behind the gārhapatya, a cart is stationed, with its yoke tied, covered with an awning, containing rice or barley, its pole facing east or north.

sanskrit_iast: dhūr asi \\ iti tasya dakṣiṇāṃ dhuram ālabhya /
meaning: धूर् असि \\ इति तस्य दक्षिणां धुरम् आलभ्य /
text_mt: Touching its southern yoke with the mantra, 'Thou art the yoke,'

sanskrit_iast: tvaṃ devānām iti savyām īṣām ālabhya japati /
meaning: त्वं देवानाम् इति सव्याम् ईषाम् आलभ्य जपति /
text_mt: and touching the left pole, he murmurs: 'Thou [belongest] to the gods...'

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇus tvākram̐sta \\ iti savye cakre dakṣiṇaṃ pādam ādadhāti /
meaning: विष्णुस् त्वाक्रम्̐स्त \\ इति सव्ये चक्रे दक्षिणं पादम् आदधाति /
text_mt: With the mantra, 'Viṣṇu strode over thee,' he places his right foot on the left wheel.

sanskrit_iast: ahrutam ity ārohati /
meaning: अह्रुतम् इत्य् आरोहति /

sanskrit_iast: mitrasya tvā \\ iti pariṇahaṃ prekṣate /
meaning: मित्रस्य त्वा \\ इति परिणहं प्रेक्षते /
text_mt: With the mantra, 'Of Mitra thee...,' he looks at the awning.

sanskrit_iast: uru vātāya \\ iti pariṇaho dvāram apacchādayati /
meaning: उरु वाताय \\ इति परिणहो द्वारम् अपच्छादयति /
text_mt: With the mantra, 'Broad for the wind,' he uncovers the opening of the awning.

sanskrit_iast: mitrasya tvā \\ iti puroḍāśyān pariṇahaṃ ca prekṣate /
meaning: मित्रस्य त्वा \\ इति पुरोडाश्यान् परिणहं च प्रेक्षते /
text_mt: With the mantra, 'Of Mitra thee...,' he looks at the materials for the sacrificial cake and the awning.

sanskrit_iast: ūrjaṃ dhatsva \\ iti puroḍāśyān abhimṛśati /
meaning: ऊर्जं धत्स्व \\ इति पुरोडाश्यान् अभिमृशति /
text_mt: With the mantra, 'Bestow strength,' he touches the materials for the sacrificial cake.

sanskrit_iast: payo mayi dhehi \\ ity ātmānaṃ pratyabhimṛśati /
meaning: पयो मयि धेहि \\ इत्य् आत्मानं प्रत्यभिमृशति /
text_mt: With the mantra, 'Place milk in me,' he touches himself in turn.

sanskrit_iast: apahatam̐ rakṣas \\ iti tatas tṛṇaṃ loṣṭaṃ vā nirasyāpa upaspṛśya /
meaning: अपहतम्̐ रक्षस् \\ इति ततस् तृणं लोष्टं वा निरस्याप उपस्पृश्य /
text_mt: With the mantra, 'Slain is the Rakṣas,' he casts out from there a piece of grass or a clod of earth and touches water.

sanskrit_iast: daśahotāraṃ vyākhyāya /
meaning: दशहोतारं व्याख्याय /
text_mt: Having recited the Daśahotṛ formula,

sanskrit_iast: yacchantāṃ pañca \ gopīthāya vo nārātaye \\ iti muṣṭiṃ pūrayitvā /
meaning: यच्छन्तां पञ्च \ गोपीथाय वो नारातये \\ इति मुष्टिं पूरयित्वा /
text_mt: he fills a handful with the mantra: 'May the five restrain [you]; for your protection, not for evil,'

sanskrit_iast: srucy opya /
meaning: स्रुच्य् ओप्य /

sanskrit_iast: devasya tvā \\ iti pavitrāntarhite caturo muṣṭīn nirvapati trir yajuṣā tūṣṇīṃ caturtham /
meaning: देवस्य त्वा \\ इति पवित्रान्तर्हिते चतुरो मुष्टीन् निर्वपति त्रिर् यजुषा तूष्णीं चतुर्थम् /
text_mt: With the mantra, 'Of divine Savitṛ thee...,' he metes out four handfuls into [the winnowing basket] with the strainer placed inside it: three times with a yajus, the fourth silently.

sanskrit_iast: nirupyānvāvapati /
meaning: निरुप्यान्वावपति /

sanskrit_iast: etenaiva kalpena yathādevatam uttaraṃ puroḍāśaṃ nirvapati /
meaning: एतेनैव कल्पेन यथादेवतम् उत्तरं पुरोडाशं निर्वपति /
text_mt: By this very procedure, he metes out [the grain for] the second sacrificial cake according to its deity.

sanskrit_iast: pātryāṃ vā nirvapati dakṣiṇataḥ sphyam upakṛṣya sarvāñ śakaṭamantrān uktvā /
meaning: पात्र्यां वा निर्वपति दक्षिणतः स्फ्यम् उपकृष्य सर्वाञ् शकटमन्त्रान् उक्त्वा /
text_mt: Or he metes it out into a vessel, having drawn the wooden sword from the south and recited all the cart-mantras.

sanskrit_iast: idaṃ devānām iti niruptān abhimṛśati \\ idam u naḥ saha \\ iti yato 'dhi nirvapati /
meaning: इदं देवानाम् इति निरुप्तान् अभिमृशति \\ इदम् उ नः सह \\ इति यतो ऽधि निर्वपति /
text_mt: With the mantra, 'This belongs to the gods,' he touches the meted-out grains; with 'And this is ours together,' that from which he metes it out.

sanskrit_iast: sphātyai tvā \\ iti niruptān eva /
meaning: स्फात्यै त्वा \\ इति निरुप्तान् एव /
text_mt: [He touches] only the poured-out [grains] with [the mantra]: 'For abundance thee!'

sanskrit_iast: idam ahaṃ nir varuṇasya pāśāt \\ iti puroḍāśyān ādāya pariṇaha upaniḥsarpati /
meaning: इदम् अहं निर् वरुणस्य पाशात् \\ इति पुरोडाश्यान् आदाय परिणह उपनिःसर्पति /
text_mt: Taking the materials for the cake, he slips out along the enclosure-mat with [the mantra]: 'Here I [step out] free from Varuṇa's bond.'

sanskrit_iast: suvar abhivikhyeṣam iti //
meaning: सुवर् अभिविख्येषम् इति //
text_mt: [With the mantra:] 'May I look upon the light of heaven!'

sanskrit_iast: sarvaṃ yajñam anuvīkṣate /
meaning: सर्वं यज्ञम् अनुवीक्षते /
text_mt: he looks intently upon the entire sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: vaiśvānaraṃ jyotis \\ ity āhavanīyaṃ parekṣate /
meaning: वैश्वानरं ज्योतिस् \\ इत्य् आहवनीयं परेक्षते /
text_mt: With [the mantra]: 'The light of Vaiśvānara,' he looks towards the āhavanīya fire.

sanskrit_iast: dṛm̐hantāṃ duryās \\ iti pratyavarohati /
meaning: दृम्̐हन्तां दुर्यास् \\ इति प्रत्यवरोहति /
text_mt: With [the mantra]: 'Let the homesteads stand firm,' he steps down.

sanskrit_iast: svāhā dyāvāpṛthivībhyām \\ iti skannān anumantrayate \\ urv antarikṣam anvihi \\ iti gacchati /
meaning: स्वाहा द्यावापृथिवीभ्याम् \\ इति स्कन्नान् अनुमन्त्रयते \\ उर्व् अन्तरिक्षम् अन्विहि \\ इति गच्छति /
text_mt: With [the mantra]: 'Svāhā to Heaven and Earth!' he pronounces a mantra over what has spilled. With [the mantra]: 'Go along the wide atmosphere!' he walks [forward].

sanskrit_iast: adityās tvopasthe sādayāmi \\ ity apareṇāhavanīyam apareṇa vā gārhapatyam upasādayati /
meaning: अदित्यास् त्वोपस्थे सादयामि \\ इत्य् अपरेणाहवनीयम् अपरेण वा गार्हपत्यम् उपसादयति /
text_mt: With [the mantra]: 'I set thee down in the lap of Aditi,' he sets [them] down west of the āhavanīya fire, or west of the gārhapatya fire,

sanskrit_iast: yatarasminn agnau śrapayati /
meaning: यतरस्मिन्न् अग्नौ श्रपयति /
text_mt: in whichever fire he cooks [the oblations].

sanskrit_iast: agne havyam̐ rakṣasva \\ iti yathādevataṃ paridadāti /
meaning: अग्ने हव्यम्̐ रक्षस्व \\ इति यथादेवतं परिददाति /
text_mt: With [the mantra]: 'O Agni, protect the sacrificial oblation!' he entrusts [it], according to the respective deity.

sanskrit_iast: saśūkāyām̐ sruci prokṣaṇīḥ sam̐skṛtya yathā purastāt /
meaning: सशूकायाम्̐ स्रुचि प्रोक्षणीः सम्̐स्कृत्य यथा पुरस्तात् /
text_mt: Having prepared the sprinkling-waters in a ladle with a beak, as before,

sanskrit_iast: brahman prokṣiṣyāmi \\ ity āmantrayate /
meaning: ब्रह्मन् प्रोक्षिष्यामि \\ इत्य् आमन्त्रयते /
text_mt: he calls out: 'O brahman priest, I shall sprinkle.'

sanskrit_iast: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave 'śvinor bāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām agnaye vo juṣṭaṃ prokṣāmy amuṣmā amuṣmai \\ iti yathādevataṃ triḥ prokṣati /
meaning: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवे ऽश्विनोर् बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्याम् अग्नये वो जुष्टं प्रोक्षाम्य् अमुष्मा अमुष्मै \\ इति यथादेवतं त्रिः प्रोक्षति /
text_mt: With [the mantra]: 'At the instigation of divine Savitṛ, with the arms of the Aśvins, with the hands of Pūṣan, I sprinkle you, agreeable to Agni, to such-and-such, to such-and-such,' he sprinkles [the oblations] three times according to the respective deity.

sanskrit_iast: nāgnim abhiprokṣet /
meaning: नाग्निम् अभिप्रोक्षेत् /

sanskrit_iast: pātrāṇi prokṣati yathā purastāt /
meaning: पात्राणि प्रोक्षति यथा पुरस्तात् /
text_mt: He sprinkles the vessels, as before.

sanskrit_iast: vātasya dhrājir asi \\ iti kṛṣṇājinam ādatte devasya tvā \\ iti vā /
meaning: वातस्य ध्राजिर् असि \\ इति कृष्णाजिनम् आदत्ते देवस्य त्वा \\ इति वा /
text_mt: With [the mantra]: 'Thou art the rush of the wind,' or with: 'At [the instigation] of divine [Savitṛ]…', he takes up the black antelope skin.

sanskrit_iast: avadhūtam̐ rakṣas \\ ity ūrdhvagrīvaṃ bahirviśasanam utkare trir avadhūnoti /
