text_mt: There are fifteen or seventeen kindling verses.

sanskrit_iast: nirvapaṇakāla indrāya vaimṛdhāya prabhūtān vrīhīn nirvapati /
meaning: निर्वपणकाल इन्द्राय वैमृधाय प्रभूतान् व्रीहीन् निर्वपति /
text_mt: At the time of pouring out the grain, he pours out abundant rice for Indra Vaimṛdha.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇākāle yathāśakti dakṣiṇāṃ dadāti /
meaning: दक्षिणाकाले यथाशक्ति दक्षिणां ददाति /
text_mt: At the time of the priestly gift, he gives a priestly gift according to his ability.

sanskrit_iast: tatra yāthākāmī prakrame /
meaning: तत्र याथाकामी प्रक्रमे /
text_mt: In that matter, there is freedom of choice regarding the setting in motion.

sanskrit_iast: prakramāt tu niyamyate /
meaning: प्रक्रमात् तु नियम्यते /
text_mt: After setting it in motion, however, it is obligatory.

sanskrit_iast: darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ kāmyān kalpān vyākhyāsyāmaḥ /
meaning: दर्शपूर्णमासयोः काम्यान् कल्पान् व्याख्यास्यामः /
text_mt: We shall explain the optional procedures of the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast: anena darśapūrṇamāsābhyām ṛddhikāmo yajeta /
meaning: अनेन दर्शपूर्णमासाभ्याम् ऋद्धिकामो यजेत /
text_mt: One who desires prosperity should sacrifice with these New- and Full-Moon sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast: dve paurṇamāsyau yajeta dve amāvāsye /
meaning: द्वे पौर्णमास्यौ यजेत द्वे अमावास्ये /
text_mt: He should perform two Full Moon rites and two New Moon rites.

sanskrit_iast: yaḥ kāmayetardhnuyām ity ekeṣāṃ paurṇamāsīm eva yajeta /
meaning: यः कामयेतर्ध्नुयाम् इत्य् एकेषां पौर्णमासीम् एव यजेत /
text_mt: According to some, one who desires, "May I prosper," should perform only the Full Moon rite.

sanskrit_iast: bhrātṛvyavān nāmāvāsyāṃ dvyavarārdhyaṃ tryavarārdhyaṃ vā yajeta saṃkrāmesaṃkrāme vajraṃ bhrātṛvyāya praharati /
meaning: भ्रातृव्यवान् नामावास्यां द्व्यवरार्ध्यं त्र्यवरार्ध्यं वा यजेत संक्रामेसंक्रामे वज्रं भ्रातृव्याय प्रहरति /
text_mt: One who has a rival should perform the New Moon rite for at least two or at least three [months]; at each successive step, he hurls the thunderbolt at his rival.

sanskrit_iast: agnīṣomīyāṇi pradhānāni syur bhrātṛvyavato 'bhicaratas titīriṣato vā /
meaning: अग्नीषोमीयाणि प्रधानानि स्युर् भ्रातृव्यवतो ऽभिचरतस् तितीरिषतो वा /
text_mt: The primary rites should be dedicated to Agni-Soma for one who has a rival, one who is practicing sorcery, or one who wishes to cross over [adversity].

sanskrit_iast: sākaṃprasthāyīyena paśukāmo yajeta /
meaning: साकंप्रस्थायीयेन पशुकामो यजेत /
text_mt: One who desires cattle should sacrifice with the Sākaṃprasthāyīya rite.

sanskrit_iast: bahavaḥ sāyaṃdohā bhavanti bahavaḥ prātardohās tair anantaraṃ dohād yajate /
meaning: बहवः सायंदोहा भवन्ति बहवः प्रातर्दोहास् तैर् अनन्तरं दोहाद् यजते /
text_mt: There are many evening milkings and many morning milkings; immediately after the milking, he sacrifices with them.

sanskrit_iast: api vā yathāmāvāsyāyām̐ havir duhanty evaṃ dugdhvātacya nidadhyād yat prātaḥ syāt tac chṛtaṃ kuryāt pātrasam̐sādanakāle yathārthaṃ pātrāṇi prayunakti juhum̐ś caudumbarān mahataś camasām̐s teṣāṃ juhvā kalpo vyākhyātaḥ /
meaning: अपि वा यथामावास्यायाम्̐ हविर् दुहन्त्य् एवं दुग्ध्वातच्य निदध्याद् यत् प्रातः स्यात् तच् छृतं कुर्यात् पात्रसम्̐सादनकाले यथार्थं पात्राणि प्रयुनक्ति जुहुम्̐श् चौदुम्बरान् महतश् चमसाम्̐स् तेषां जुह्वा कल्पो व्याख्यातः /
text_mt: Or rather, just as they milk the sacrificial oblation at the New Moon rite, having thus milked it and curdled it, he should set it down; whatever there is in the morning, he should boil that; at the time of setting down the vessels, he prepares the vessels according to need: the juhū ladles and large cups made of udumbara wood; their ritual procedure is explained by [that of] the juhū ladle.

sanskrit_iast: pracaryāgneyena puroḍāśenāgnīdhre srucau nidhāya saha kumbhībhir atikrāmann āha \\ indrāyānubrūhi \\ āśrāvaya \\ indraṃ yaja \\ iti yāvatyaḥ kumbhyaḥ syus tāvanto brāhmaṇā dakṣiṇata upavītina upottiṣṭheyur dārupātrāṇy ādāya teṣu kumbhīr ānīya sarve yugapaj juhvaty adhvaryor āhutim anujuhvati /
meaning: प्रचर्याग्नेयेन पुरोडाशेनाग्नीध्रे स्रुचौ निधाय सह कुम्भीभिर् अतिक्रामन्न् आह \\ इन्द्रायानुब्रूहि \\ आश्रावय \\ इन्द्रं यज \\ इति यावत्यः कुम्भ्यः स्युस् तावन्तो ब्राह्मणा दक्षिणत उपवीतिन उपोत्तिष्ठेयुर् दारुपात्राण्य् आदाय तेषु कुम्भीर् आनीय सर्वे युगपज् जुह्वत्य् अध्वर्योर् आहुतिम् अनुजुह्वति /
text_mt: Having performed [the offering] with the sacrificial cake for Agni and placed the two offering ladles in the Āgnīdhra [hearth], striding across together with the jars, he says: "Recite for Indra! Call for the response! Sacrifice to Indra!" As many jars as there are, so many Brāhmaṇas wearing the sacred cord over the left shoulder should stand up towards the south, having taken wooden vessels; having poured the jars into them, they all offer simultaneously, offering after the offering of the adhvaryu.

sanskrit_iast: dākṣāyaṇayajñena suvargakāmo yajeta /
meaning: दाक्षायणयज्ञेन सुवर्गकामो यजेत /
text_mt: One who desires heaven should sacrifice with the Dākṣāyaṇayajña.

sanskrit_iast: dve paurṇamāsyau bhavato dve amāvāsye /
meaning: द्वे पौर्णमास्यौ भवतो द्वे अमावास्ये /
text_mt: There are two Full Moon rites and two New Moon rites.

sanskrit_iast: āgneyo 'ṣṭākapālo 'gnīṣomīya ekādaśakapālaḥ pūrvasyāṃ paurṇamāsyām āgneyo 'ṣṭākapāla aindraṃ dadhy uttarasyām āgneyo 'ṣṭākapāla aindrāgna ekādaśakapālaḥ pūrvasyām amāvāsyāyām āgneyo 'ṣṭākapālo maitrāvaruṇy āmikṣottarasyām /
meaning: आग्नेयो ऽष्टाकपालो ऽग्नीषोमीय एकादशकपालः पूर्वस्यां पौर्णमास्याम् आग्नेयो ऽष्टाकपाल ऐन्द्रं दध्य् उत्तरस्याम् आग्नेयो ऽष्टाकपाल ऐन्द्राग्न एकादशकपालः पूर्वस्याम् अमावास्यायाम् आग्नेयो ऽष्टाकपालो मैत्रावरुण्य् आमिक्षोत्तरस्याम् /
text_mt: [There are] an eight-potsherd [cake] for Agni and an eleven-potsherd [cake] for Agni-Soma on the first Full Moon day; an eight-potsherd [cake] for Agni and curd for Indra on the second; an eight-potsherd [cake] for Agni and an eleven-potsherd [cake] for Indra-Agni on the first New Moon day; an eight-potsherd [cake] for Agni and a curd mixture for Mitra-Varuṇa on the second.

sanskrit_iast: tasyaitad vrataṃ nānṛtaṃ vaden na mām̐sam aśnīyān na striyam upeyān nāsya palpūlanena vāsaḥ palpūlayeyur nāñjīta nābhyañjītartau jāyām upeyāt /
meaning: तस्यैतद् व्रतं नानृतं वदेन् न माम्̐सम् अश्नीयान् न स्त्रियम् उपेयान् नास्य पल्पूलनेन वासः पल्पूलयेयुर् नाञ्जीत नाभ्यञ्जीतर्तौ जायाम् उपेयात् /
text_mt: This is his ritual observance: he must not speak untruth, he must not eat meat, he must not approach a woman [sexually], they must not wash his garment with alkaline water, he must not apply eye-salve, nor anoint himself; he may approach his wife [only] in her fertile period.

sanskrit_iast: so 'yaṃ darśapūrṇamasayor ādito vikalpo 'nena darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ vā yajeta /
meaning: सो ऽयं दर्शपूर्णमसयोर् आदितो विकल्पो ऽनेन दर्शपूर्णमासाभ्यां वा यजेत /
text_mt: This is the alternative to the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices from the beginning; or he may sacrifice with these [standard] New- and Full-Moon sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast: tena pañcadaśa varṣāṇīṣṭvotsṛjati darśapūrṇamāsau //
meaning: तेन पञ्चदश वर्षाणीष्ट्वोत्सृजति दर्शपूर्णमासौ //
text_mt: Having sacrificed with it for fifteen years, he abandons the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast: amāvāsyāyām aparāhṇe piṇḍapitṛyajñena yajate /
meaning: अमावास्यायाम् अपराह्णे पिण्डपितृयज्ञेन यजते /
text_mt: In the afternoon on the New Moon day, he sacrifices with the Piṇḍapitṛyajña,

sanskrit_iast: adhivṛkṣasūrye vā /
meaning: अधिवृक्षसूर्ये वा /

sanskrit_iast: yad ahaḥ purastāc candramasaṃ na paśyanti /
meaning: यद् अहः पुरस्ताच् चन्द्रमसं न पश्यन्ति /
text_mt: on the day when they do not see the moon in the east.

sanskrit_iast: dṛśyamāne tūpoṣya śvo bhūte yajate /
meaning: दृश्यमाने तूपोष्य श्वो भूते यजते /
text_mt: If it is visible, however, having fasted, he sacrifices on the next day.

sanskrit_iast: apāṃ medhyaṃ yajñiyam \\ sadevam̐ śivam astu me / \ ācchettā vo mā riṣam \\ jīvāni śaradaḥ śatam iti sakṛdācchinnam̐ samūlaṃ barhir ācchinatti /
meaning: अपां मेध्यं यज्ञियम् \\ सदेवम्̐ शिवम् अस्तु मे / \ आच्छेत्ता वो मा रिषम् \\ जीवानि शरदः शतम् इति सकृदाच्छिन्नम्̐ समूलं बर्हिर् आच्छिनत्ति /
text_mt: He cuts grass cut once with its roots, with: "Sacrificial essence of the waters, accompanied by the gods, may it be auspicious for me! May I, its cutter, not come to harm; may I live a hundred autumns!"

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇāprāgagrair darbhair dakṣiṇāgniṃ paristīrya /
meaning: दक्षिणाप्रागग्रैर् दर्भैर् दक्षिणाग्निं परिस्तीर्य /
text_mt: Having strewn darbha grass around the dakṣiṇāgni fire with the tips pointing south-east,

sanskrit_iast: uttareṇāgniṃ darbhān sam̐stīrya /
meaning: उत्तरेणाग्निं दर्भान् सम्̐स्तीर्य /
text_mt: and having strewn darbha grass north of the fire,

sanskrit_iast: ekaikaśaḥ piṇḍapitṛyajñapātrāṇi prayunakti /
meaning: एकैकशः पिण्डपितृयज्ञपात्राणि प्रयुनक्ति /
text_mt: he sets out one by one the vessels of the Piṇḍapitṛyajña:

sanskrit_iast: sphyam̐ sthālīṃ mekṣaṇaṃ śūrpaṃ kṛṣṇājinam ulūkhalaṃ musalam /
meaning: स्फ्यम्̐ स्थालीं मेक्षणं शूर्पं कृष्णाजिनम् उलूखलं मुसलम् /
text_mt: the wooden sword, the pot, the stirring stick, the winnowing basket, the black antelope skin, the mortar, and the pestle.

sanskrit_iast: apareṇāgniṃ vrīhimac chakaṭam avasthāpyaikapavitrāntarhitām̐ sthālīṃ vrīhibhiḥ pūrayitvā nimṛjya pitṛbhyas tvā juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi \\ iti sakṛd eva śūrpe nirvapati /
meaning: अपरेणाग्निं व्रीहिमच् छकटम् अवस्थाप्यैकपवित्रान्तर्हिताम्̐ स्थालीं व्रीहिभिः पूरयित्वा निमृज्य पितृभ्यस् त्वा जुष्टं निर्वपामि \\ इति सकृद् एव शूर्पे निर्वपति /
text_mt: Having stationed the cart containing rice behind the fire, filled the pot separated by a single strainer with rice, and wiped it clean, he pours it out only once into the winnowing basket with: "For the fathers, agreeable to you, I pour out!"

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇena dakṣiṇāgniṃ dakṣiṇāpūrveṇa dakṣiṇāpareṇa vā pratyagudaggrīvaṃ kṛṣṇājinam āstīryolūkhalam adhivartya /
meaning: दक्षिणेन दक्षिणाग्निं दक्षिणापूर्वेण दक्षिणापरेण वा प्रत्यगुदग्ग्रीवं कृष्णाजिनम् आस्तीर्योलूखलम् अधिवर्त्य /
text_mt: To the south of the dakṣiṇāgni fire, south-east or south-west, having spread the black antelope skin with the neck to the north-west and placed the mortar on it,

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇāprācī patnī tiṣṭhanty avahanti /
meaning: दक्षिणाप्राची पत्नी तिष्ठन्त्य् अवहन्ति /
text_mt: the sacrificer's wife, standing facing south-east, pounds [the grain].

sanskrit_iast: parāpāvam avivekam̐ sakṛt phalīkaroti dakṣiṇāgnau jīvataṇḍulam iva carum̐ śrapayitvotpūtena navanītenānutpūtenājyena vābhighāryodvāsya /
meaning: परापावम् अविवेकम्̐ सकृत् फलीकरोति दक्षिणाग्नौ जीवतण्डुलम् इव चरुम्̐ श्रपयित्वोत्पूतेन नवनीतेनानुत्पूतेनाज्येन वाभिघार्योद्वास्य /
text_mt: He husks it once, without winnowing away and without separating; having cooked the boiled rice-mash on the dakṣiṇāgni fire as if with living grains, and having basted it with purified butter or unpurified clarified butter, and taken it off [the fire]—

sanskrit_iast: mekṣaṇena sthālīpākasyopahatya /
meaning: मेक्षणेन स्थालीपाकस्योपहत्य /
text_mt: having taken [a portion] of the pot-cooked mess with the stirring stick—

sanskrit_iast: somāya pitṛpītāya svadhā namas \\ iti prathamām āhutiṃ juhoti yamāyāṅgirasvate pitṛmate svadhā namas \\ iti dvitīyām agnaye kavyavāhanāya sviṣṭakṛte svadhā namas \\ iti ye mekṣaṇe taṇḍulās tāñ juhoti //
meaning: सोमाय पितृपीताय स्वधा नमस् \\ इति प्रथमाम् आहुतिं जुहोति यमायाङ्गिरस्वते पितृमते स्वधा नमस् \\ इति द्वितीयाम् अग्नये कव्यवाहनाय स्विष्टकृते स्वधा नमस् \\ इति ये मेक्षणे तण्डुलास् ताञ् जुहोति //
text_mt: he makes the first offering with: "To Soma accompanied by the fathers, svadhā! Homage!", the second with: "To Yama accompanied by the Aṅgirases and the fathers, svadhā! Homage!", and with: "To Agni Kavyavāhana, Sviṣṭakṛt, svadhā! Homage!", he offers the grains that are on the stirring stick.

sanskrit_iast: tūṣṇīṃ mekṣaṇam ādadhāti /
meaning: तूष्णीं मेक्षणम् आदधाति /
text_mt: He places the stirring stick [on the fire] silently.

sanskrit_iast: ye rūpāṇi pratimuñcamānās \\ asurāḥ santaḥ svadhayā caranti / \ parāpuro nipuro ye bharanti \\ agniṣ ṭān asmāt praṇunoktu lokāt \\ iti dakṣiṇāgner ekolmukaṃ dhūpāyat parācīnam̐ hṛtvā dakṣiṇenaikasphyādeśe nidadhāti /
meaning: ये रूपाणि प्रतिमुञ्चमानास् \\ असुराः सन्तः स्वधया चरन्ति / \ परापुरो निपुरो ये भरन्ति \\ अग्निष् टान् अस्मात् प्रणुनोक्तु लोकात् \\ इति दक्षिणाग्नेर् एकोल्मुकं धूपायत् पराचीनम्̐ हृत्वा दक्षिणेनैकस्फ्यादेशे निदधाति /
text_mt: With: "Those who, assuming forms, being Asuras, wander with the svadhā, who bring the far-off and near citadels—may Agni drive them from this realm!", having taken a smoking firebrand backwards from the dakṣiṇāgni fire, he places it to the south on the area of a single wooden sword.

sanskrit_iast: apahatā asurā rakṣāṃsi vediṣadas \\ ity avahananadeśe dakṣiṇāṃ dakṣiṇāprācīṃ vā sphyenaikasphyāṃ vedim ullikhya /
meaning: अपहता असुरा रक्षांसि वेदिषदस् \\ इत्य् अवहननदेशे दक्षिणां दक्षिणाप्राचीं वा स्फ्येनैकस्फ्यां वेदिम् उल्लिख्य /
text_mt: With: "Smitten away are the Asuras, the Rakṣases seated on the altar!", having delineated with the wooden sword an altar of the size of a single wooden sword towards the south or towards the south-east in the pounding place,

sanskrit_iast: ud īratām avare \\ ity adbhir avokṣati /
meaning: उद् ईरताम् अवरे \\ इत्य् अद्भिर् अवोक्षति /
text_mt: he sprinkles it with water with: "Let the lower ones arise!"

sanskrit_iast: sakṛdācchinnaṃ barhir urṇāmṛdu \ syonaṃ pitṛbhyas tvā bharāmy aham / \ asmin sīdantu me pitaraḥ somyāḥ \ pitāmahāḥ prapitāmahāś cānugaiḥ saha \\ iti sakṛdācchinnena barhiṣaikasphyām̐ stṛṇāti /
meaning: सकृदाच्छिन्नं बर्हिर् उर्णामृदु \ स्योनं पितृभ्यस् त्वा भराम्य् अहम् / \ अस्मिन् सीदन्तु मे पितरः सोम्याः \ पितामहाः प्रपितामहाश् चानुगैः सह \\ इति सकृदाच्छिन्नेन बर्हिषैकस्फ्याम्̐ स्तृणाति /
text_mt: With: "Grass cut once, soft as wool, pleasant for the fathers, I bring you; upon this let my fathers seated with Soma, grandfathers, and great-grandfathers sit together with their followers!", he strews the altar of a single wooden sword with the grass cut once.

sanskrit_iast: tasyām̐ sthālīpākaṃ nidadhāti /
meaning: तस्याम्̐ स्थालीपाकं निदधाति /
text_mt: Upon it, he sets down the pot-cooked mess.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇata āñjanam abhyañjanaṃ kaśīpūpabarhaṇam udakumbhaṃ ca pratiṣṭhāpayati /
meaning: दक्षिणत आञ्जनम् अभ्यञ्जनं कशीपूपबर्हणम् उदकुम्भं च प्रतिष्ठापयति /
text_mt: To the south, he sets down eye-ointment, unguent, a cushion and headrest, and a water pitcher.

sanskrit_iast: yajamānāḥ prācīnāvīti savyaṃ jānv ācya sakṛdācchinne 'vācīnapāṇir dakṣiṇāpavargām̐s trīn udakāñjalīn ninayati /
meaning: यजमानाः प्राचीनावीति सव्यं जान्व् आच्य सकृदाच्छिन्ने ऽवाचीनपाणिर् दक्षिणापवर्गाम्̐स् त्रीन् उदकाञ्जलीन् निनयति /
text_mt: Wearing the sacred cord over the right shoulder, bending his left knee, with his hand turned downwards, the sacrificer pours out three handfuls of water upon the grass cut in a single stroke, ending towards the south:

sanskrit_iast: mārjayantāṃ pitaraḥ somyāsas \\ mārjayantāṃ pitāmahāḥ somyāsas \\ mārjayantāṃ prapitāmahāḥ somyāsas \\ iti \\ asāv avaneniṅkṣva \\ asāv avaneniṅkṣva \\ iti vā /
meaning: मार्जयन्तां पितरः सोम्यासस् \\ मार्जयन्तां पितामहाः सोम्यासस् \\ मार्जयन्तां प्रपितामहाः सोम्यासस् \\ इति \\ असाव् अवनेनिङ्क्ष्व \\ असाव् अवनेनिङ्क्ष्व \\ इति वा /
text_mt: "May the fathers purify themselves, rich in soma; may the grandfathers purify themselves, rich in soma; may the great-grandfathers purify themselves, rich in soma"; or with: "O [Name], wash yourself! O [Name], wash yourself!"

sanskrit_iast: teṣv avācīnapāṇir dakṣiṇāpavargām̐s trīn piṇḍān dadāti /
meaning: तेष्व् अवाचीनपाणिर् दक्षिणापवर्गाम्̐स् त्रीन् पिण्डान् ददाति /
text_mt: Upon these, with his hand turned downwards, he presents three rice-balls, ending towards the south.

sanskrit_iast: etat te tatāsau \\ viti pitre piṇḍaṃ dadāti /
meaning: एतत् ते ततासौ \\ विति पित्रे पिण्डं ददाति /
text_mt: He presents a rice-ball to his father with: "This for you, father, O [Name]!"

sanskrit_iast: etat te pitāmahāsau \\ iti pitāmahāya \\ etat te prapitāmahāsau \\ iti prapitāmahāya /
meaning: एतत् ते पितामहासौ \\ इति पितामहाय \\ एतत् ते प्रपितामहासौ \\ इति प्रपितामहाय /
text_mt: To the grandfather with: "This for you, grandfather, O [Name]!"; to the great-grandfather with: "This for you, great-grandfather, O [Name]!"

sanskrit_iast: tūṣṇīṃ caturtham /
meaning: तूष्णीं चतुर्थम् /

sanskrit_iast: sa kṛtākṛtaḥ /
meaning: स कृताकृतः /

sanskrit_iast: atha yadi nāmadheyāni na vindyāt svadhā pitṛbhyaḥ pṛthiviṣadbhyas \\ iti pitre piṇḍaṃ dadyāt svadhā pitṛbhyo 'ntarikṣasadbhyas \\ iti pitāmahāya svadhā pitṛbhyo diviṣadbhyas \\ iti prapitāmahāya /
meaning: अथ यदि नामधेयानि न विन्द्यात् स्वधा पितृभ्यः पृथिविषद्भ्यस् \\ इति पित्रे पिण्डं दद्यात् स्वधा पितृभ्यो ऽन्तरिक्षसद्भ्यस् \\ इति पितामहाय स्वधा पितृभ्यो दिविषद्भ्यस् \\ इति प्रपितामहाय /
text_mt: Now, if he should not know the names, he should give a rice-ball to the father with: "Svadhā to the fathers dwelling on the earth!"; to the grandfather with: "Svadhā to the fathers dwelling in the intermediate space!"; to the great-grandfather with: "Svadhā to the fathers dwelling in the sky!"

sanskrit_iast: yadi dvipitaikaikasmin piṇḍe dvaudvāv upalakṣayet /
meaning: यदि द्विपितैकैकस्मिन् पिण्डे द्वौद्वाव् उपलक्षयेत् /
text_mt: If he has two fathers, he should designate two for each rice-ball.

sanskrit_iast: jīvapitā pitāmahāya prapitāmahāyeti dadyāt /
meaning: जीवपिता पितामहाय प्रपितामहायेति दद्यात् /
text_mt: One whose father is living should give [the balls] to the grandfather and to the great-grandfather.

sanskrit_iast: na jīvantam atidadātīty ekeṣām /
meaning: न जीवन्तम् अतिददातीत्य् एकेषाम् /
text_mt: "He does not offer past a living person," according to some.

sanskrit_iast: homāntam eva kuryāt /
meaning: होमान्तम् एव कुर्यात् /

sanskrit_iast: jīvapituḥ piṇḍadānaprabhṛty uttaraṃ lupyate /
meaning: जीवपितुः पिण्डदानप्रभृत्य् उत्तरं लुप्यते /
text_mt: For one whose father is living, the subsequent [rite] beginning from the presentation of the rice-balls is omitted.

sanskrit_iast: nidhāya piṇḍān /
meaning: निधाय पिण्डान् /

sanskrit_iast: āpo devīḥ svadhayā vandamānās \ tā vo gacchantu pitaraḥ syonāḥ / \ ūrjaṃ vahantīḥ satam akṣitodakāḥ kṣīram udakaṃ ghṛtaṃ madhu payaḥ kīlālaṃ parisrutam \ svadhā stha \ tarpayata me pitṝn iti trīn udapātrān ninayati /
meaning: आपो देवीः स्वधया वन्दमानास् \ ता वो गच्छन्तु पितरः स्योनाः / \ ऊर्जं वहन्तीः सतम् अक्षितोदकाः क्षीरम् उदकं घृतं मधु पयः कीलालं परिस्रुतम् \ स्वधा स्थ \ तर्पयत मे पितॄन् इति त्रीन् उदपात्रान् निनयति /
text_mt: he pours out three vessels of water with: "May the divine waters, reverencing with svadhā, / pleasant, approach you, O fathers! / Bringing strength, being inexhaustible waters, milk, water, clarified butter, honey, sap, foaming liquor, surā, / you are svadhā; satisfy my fathers!"

sanskrit_iast: atra pitaro yathābhāgaṃ mandadhvam anusvadham āvṛṣāyadhvam ity uktvā parāṅ āvartate /
meaning: अत्र पितरो यथाभागं मन्दध्वम् अनुस्वधम् आवृषायध्वम् इत्य् उक्त्वा पराङ् आवर्तते /
text_mt: Having said: "Here, O fathers, rejoice according to your shares; become vigorous according to svadhā!", he turns away.

sanskrit_iast: oṣmaṇo vyāvṛtta upāste svāhoṣmaṇo vyathiṣyai \\ ity ūṣmāṇam udyantam anumantrayate /
meaning: ओष्मणो व्यावृत्त उपास्ते स्वाहोष्मणो व्यथिष्यै \\ इत्य् ऊष्माणम् उद्यन्तम् अनुमन्त्रयते /
text_mt: He sits waiting until the steam has ceased; with "Svāhā to the dispersion of steam!" he recites over the rising steam.

sanskrit_iast: vyāvṛtta ūṣmaṇy avyāvṛtte vā \\ amīmadanta pitaro 'nusvadham āvṛṣāyīṣata \\ ity uktvopaparyāvartate /
meaning: व्यावृत्त ऊष्मण्य् अव्यावृत्ते वा \\ अमीमदन्त पितरो ऽनुस्वधम् आवृषायीषत \\ इत्य् उक्त्वोपपर्यावर्तते /
text_mt: Whether the steam has ceased or has not ceased, having said: "The fathers have rejoiced; they have become vigorous according to svadhā," he turns back.

sanskrit_iast: yaḥ sthālyām̐ śeṣas tam avaghreṇa bhakṣayati /
meaning: यः स्थाल्याम्̐ शेषस् तम् अवघ्रेण भक्षयति /
text_mt: Whatever remains in the pot, that he consumes by smelling.

sanskrit_iast: upaspṛśati vā /
meaning: उपस्पृशति वा /

sanskrit_iast: āmayāvy annādyakāmo vā prāśnīyād yo vālam annādyāya san nānnam adyāt tena prāśya /
meaning: आमयाव्य् अन्नाद्यकामो वा प्राश्नीयाद् यो वालम् अन्नाद्याय सन् नान्नम् अद्यात् तेन प्राश्य /
text_mt: One who is sick or one desirous of proper food should eat it; or one who, being fit for proper food, does not eat food, having eaten [of it] with that [mantra].

sanskrit_iast: atrāñjanābhyañjane vāsaś cānupiṇḍaṃ dadāti /
meaning: अत्राञ्जनाभ्यञ्जने वासश् चानुपिण्डं ददाति /
text_mt: Then, alongside each rice-ball, he gives eye-ointment, unguent, and a garment.

sanskrit_iast: āṅkṣvāsau \\ āṅkṣvāsau \\ iti trir āñjanam abhyaṅkṣvāsau \\ abhyaṅkṣvāsau \\ iti trir abhyañjanam /
meaning: आङ्क्ष्वासौ \\ आङ्क्ष्वासौ \\ इति त्रिर् आञ्जनम् अभ्यङ्क्ष्वासौ \\ अभ्यङ्क्ष्वासौ \\ इति त्रिर् अभ्यञ्जनम् /
text_mt: "Anoint your eyes, O [Name]! Anoint your eyes, O [Name]!"—thus thrice eye-ointment; "Anoint your limbs, O [Name]! Anoint your limbs, O [Name]!"—thus thrice unguent.

sanskrit_iast: etāni vaḥ pitaro vāsām̐si \\ ato no 'nyat pitaro mā yūḍhvam iti daśām ūrṇāstukāṃ vā chittvā nyasyati pūrve vayasi /
meaning: एतानि वः पितरो वासाम्̐सि \\ अतो नो ऽन्यत् पितरो मा यूढ्वम् इति दशाम् ऊर्णास्तुकां वा छित्त्वा न्यस्यति पूर्वे वयसि /
text_mt: In early life, having torn off a fringe or a tuft of wool, he throws it down with: "These are your garments, O fathers; / do not take anything else of ours, O fathers!"

sanskrit_iast: svaṃ loma cchittvottare /
meaning: स्वं लोम च्छित्त्वोत्तरे /
text_mt: In later life, having plucked a hair of his own.

sanskrit_iast: namo vaḥ pitaro rasāya \\ iti namaskārair upatiṣṭhate /
meaning: नमो वः पितरो रसाय \\ इति नमस्कारैर् उपतिष्ठते /
text_mt: With: "Homage to you, O fathers, for the sap..." he worships with reverences.

sanskrit_iast: ūrjasvatīḥ svadhayā vandamānās \ tā vo gacchantu pitaraḥ syonāḥ / \ ūrjaṃ vahantīḥ satam akṣitodakāḥ kṣīram udakaṃ ghṛtaṃ madhu payaḥ kīlālaṃ parisrutam \\ svadhā stha \ tarpayat me pitṝn iti trīn udapātān ninayati yathā purastāt //
meaning: ऊर्जस्वतीः स्वधया वन्दमानास् \ ता वो गच्छन्तु पितरः स्योनाः / \ ऊर्जं वहन्तीः सतम् अक्षितोदकाः क्षीरम् उदकं घृतं मधु पयः कीलालं परिस्रुतम् \\ स्वधा स्थ \ तर्पयत् मे पितॄन् इति त्रीन् उदपातान् निनयति यथा पुरस्तात् //
text_mt: As before, he pours out three vessels of water with: "May the energetic waters, reverencing with svadhā, / pleasant, approach you, O fathers! / Bringing strength, being inexhaustible waters, milk, water, clarified butter, honey, sap, foaming liquor, surā, / you are svadhā; satisfy my fathers!"

sanskrit_iast: uttiṣṭhata pitaraḥ preta pūrve \ yamasya panthām anuyātā purāṇam / \ dhattād asmāsu draviṇaṃ yac ca bhadram \\ pra ṇo brūtād bhāgadhān devatāsu \\ iti pitṝn utthāpayati /
meaning: उत्तिष्ठत पितरः प्रेत पूर्वे \ यमस्य पन्थाम् अनुयाता पुराणम् / \ धत्ताद् अस्मासु द्रविणं यच् च भद्रम् \\ प्र णो ब्रूताद् भागधान् देवतासु \\ इति पितॄन् उत्थापयति /
text_mt: He bids the fathers arise with: "Arise, O fathers, go forth, former ones, / follow the ancient path of Yama! / Grant unto us wealth and what is auspicious; / proclaim our portion among the deities!"

sanskrit_iast: pareta pitaras \\ iti pravāhayati /
meaning: परेत पितरस् \\ इति प्रवाहयति /
text_mt: With: "Depart, O fathers!" he sends them away.

sanskrit_iast: yantu pitaro manasā javena \\ iti pitṝn sam̐sādhayati /
meaning: यन्तु पितरो मनसा जवेन \\ इति पितॄन् सम्̐साधयति /
text_mt: With: "May the fathers go with swiftness of mind," he speeds the fathers.

sanskrit_iast: mano nv ā huvāmahe \\ iti tisṛbhir manasvatībhir upatiṣṭhate /
meaning: मनो न्व् आ हुवामहे \\ इति तिसृभिर् मनस्वतीभिर् उपतिष्ठते /
text_mt: He worships with the three mind-verses beginning with: "We invoke the mind..."

sanskrit_iast: akṣann amīmadanta prajāpate \\ iti paṅktiprājāpatyābhyāṃ pratyeti /
meaning: अक्षन्न् अमीमदन्त प्रजापते \\ इति पङ्क्तिप्राजापत्याभ्यां प्रत्येति /
text_mt: He returns with the two paṅkti- and Prajāpati-verses beginning with: "They have eaten, they have rejoiced... O Prajāpati..."

sanskrit_iast: yad antarikṣam iti paṅktyā gārhapatyam upatiṣṭhate /
meaning: यद् अन्तरिक्षम् इति पङ्क्त्या गार्हपत्यम् उपतिष्ठते /
text_mt: With the paṅkti-verse: "Whatever intermediate space...", he worships the gārhapatya fire.

sanskrit_iast: abhūn no dūto haviṣo jātavedās \\ avāḍ ḍhavyāni surabhīṇi kṛtvā / \ prādāḥ pitṛbhyaḥ svadhayā te akṣan \ prajānann agne punar apyehi devān ity ekolmukaṃ pratyapisṛjya /
meaning: अभून् नो दूतो हविषो जातवेदास् \\ अवाड् ढव्यानि सुरभीणि कृत्वा / \ प्रादाः पितृभ्यः स्वधया ते अक्षन् \ प्रजानन्न् अग्ने पुनर् अप्येहि देवान् इत्य् एकोल्मुकं प्रत्यपिसृज्य /
text_mt: Having thrown back the single firebrand with: "Jātavedas has become our messenger for the havis; / having made the offerings fragrant, he has carried them; / you have given them to the fathers; with svadhā they have eaten; / knowing, O Agni, go back again to the gods!"

sanskrit_iast: abhyukṣya dvaṃdvaṃ pātrāṇi prayāharati /
meaning: अभ्युक्ष्य द्वंद्वं पात्राणि प्रयाहरति /
text_mt: Having sprinkled them, he removes the vessels in pairs.

sanskrit_iast: sthālyāṃ piṇḍān pratyavadadhāti /
meaning: स्थाल्यां पिण्डान् प्रत्यवदधाति /
text_mt: He puts the rice-balls back into the cooking pot.

sanskrit_iast: apāṃ tvauṣadhīnām̐ rasaṃ prāśayāmi \ bhūtakṛtaṃ garbhaṃ dhatsva \\ iti madhyamaṃ piṇḍaṃ patnyai prayacchati /
meaning: अपां त्वौषधीनाम्̐ रसं प्राशयामि \ भूतकृतं गर्भं धत्स्व \\ इति मध्यमं पिण्डं पत्न्यै प्रयच्छति /
text_mt: He presents the middle rice-ball to the sacrificer's wife with: "I cause you to eat the sap of waters and plants; / bear an embryo that brings welfare!"

sanskrit_iast: ādhatta pitaro garbham \\ kumāraṃ puṣkarasrajam / \ yatheha puruṣo 'sat \\ iti patnī prāśnāti /
meaning: आधत्त पितरो गर्भम् \\ कुमारं पुष्करस्रजम् / \ यथेह पुरुषो ऽसत् \\ इति पत्नी प्राश्नाति /
text_mt: The sacrificer's wife eats it with: "O fathers, deposit an embryo, / a male child wearing a garland of lotuses, / so that there may be a man here!"

sanskrit_iast: pumām̐saṃ janayati /
meaning: पुमाम्̐सं जनयति /

sanskrit_iast: ye samānāḥ samanasas \\ pitaro yamarājye / \ teṣāṃ lokaḥ svadhā namas \\ yajño deveṣu kalpatām / \ ye sajātāḥ samanasas \\ jīvā jīveṣu māmakāḥ / \ teṣām̐ śrīr mayi kalpatām \ asmim̐l loke śatam̐ samās \\ iti sakṛdācchinnān abhyukṣyāgnāv ādadhāti /
meaning: ये समानाः समनसस् \\ पितरो यमराज्ये / \ तेषां लोकः स्वधा नमस् \\ यज्ञो देवेषु कल्पताम् / \ ये सजाताः समनसस् \\ जीवा जीवेषु मामकाः / \ तेषाम्̐ श्रीर् मयि कल्पताम् \ अस्मिम्̐ल् लोके शतम्̐ समास् \\ इति सकृदाच्छिन्नान् अभ्युक्ष्याग्नाव् आदधाति /
text_mt: Having sprinkled the grass cut in a single stroke, he places it on the fire with: "Those peers of one mind, / the fathers in the realm of Yama: / to them belong the world, svadhā, and homage; / may their sacrifice be effective among the gods! / Those kinsmen of one mind, / who are my living ones among the living: / may their prosperity be established in me / in this world for a hundred years!"

sanskrit_iast: apaḥ piṇḍān abhyavaharati brāhmaṇaṃ vā bhojayati /
meaning: अपः पिण्डान् अभ्यवहरति ब्राह्मणं वा भोजयति /
text_mt: He throws the rice-balls into water, or feeds a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: so 'yam evaṃ vihita evānāhitāgneḥ /
meaning: सो ऽयम् एवं विहित एवानाहिताग्नेः /
text_mt: This rite is prescribed in this very manner for one who has not established the sacred fires.

sanskrit_iast: tatra yāni śrapaṇasaṃyuktāni tāny aupāsane kriyante /
meaning: तत्र यानि श्रपणसंयुक्तानि तान्य् औपासने क्रियन्ते /
text_mt: In that case, whatever actions involve cooking are performed on the aupāsana fire.

sanskrit_iast: atipraṇīta āhutīr juhoti /
meaning: अतिप्रणीत आहुतीर् जुहोति /
text_mt: He pours offerings on the fire brought forward.

sanskrit_iast: yasmiñ juhoti tam upatiṣṭhate /
meaning: यस्मिञ् जुहोति तम् उपतिष्ठते /
text_mt: He attends upon whichever fire he offers into.

sanskrit_iast: atra gārhapatyapravādaḥ parilupyate //
meaning: अत्र गार्हपत्यप्रवादः परिलुप्यते //
text_mt: In this case, any mention of the gārhapatya fire is omitted.

sanskrit_iast: ahaṃ bhūpatir ahaṃ bhuvanapatir ahaṃ mahato bhūtasya patir devena savitrā prasūta ārtvijyaṃ kariṣyāmi \ deva savitar etaṃ tvā vṛṇate bṛhaspatiṃ daivyaṃ brahmāṇam \\ tad ahaṃ manase prabravīmi \ mano gāyatriyai \ gāyatrī triṣṭubhe \ triṣṭub jagatyai \ jagaty anuṣṭubhe \\ anuṣṭug bṛhatyai \ bṛhatī paṅktyai \ paṅktiḥ prajāpataye \ prajāpatir viśvebhyo devebhyas \\ viśve devā bṛhaspataye \ bṛhaspatir devānāṃ brahmāhaṃ manuṣyāṇām \\ bhūr bhuvaḥ suvar iti vṛto brahmā japati /
meaning: अहं भूपतिर् अहं भुवनपतिर् अहं महतो भूतस्य पतिर् देवेन सवित्रा प्रसूत आर्त्विज्यं करिष्यामि \ देव सवितर् एतं त्वा वृणते बृहस्पतिं दैव्यं ब्रह्माणम् \\ तद् अहं मनसे प्रब्रवीमि \ मनो गायत्रियै \ गायत्री त्रिष्टुभे \ त्रिष्टुब् जगत्यै \ जगत्य् अनुष्टुभे \\ अनुष्टुग् बृहत्यै \ बृहती पङ्क्त्यै \ पङ्क्तिः प्रजापतये \ प्रजापतिर् विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यस् \\ विश्वे देवा बृहस्पतये \ बृहस्पतिर् देवानां ब्रह्माहं मनुष्याणाम् \\ भूर् भुवः सुवर् इति वृतो ब्रह्मा जपति /
text_mt: The brahman priest, having been chosen, mutters: "I am the lord of the earth; I am the lord of the world; I am the lord of the great being; impelled by the divine Savitṛ, I shall perform the priestly office. O divine Savitṛ, this one they choose as you, Bṛhaspati, the divine brahman priest. That I declare to the mind; mind to the gāyatrī; gāyatrī to the triṣṭubh; triṣṭubh to the jagatī; jagatī to the anuṣṭubh; anuṣṭubh to the bṛhatī; bṛhatī to the paṅkti; paṅkti to Prajāpati; Prajāpati to the Viśve Devas; the Viśve Devas to Bṛhaspati; Bṛhaspati is the brahman priest of the gods, I of mortals; bhūr bhuvaḥ suvaḥ!"

sanskrit_iast: vācaspate yajñaṃ gopāya \\ ity apareṇāhavanīyaṃ dakṣiṇātikramya /
meaning: वाचस्पते यज्ञं गोपाय \\ इत्य् अपरेणाहवनीयं दक्षिणातिक्रम्य /
text_mt: Having stepped across to the south behind the āhavanīya fire with: "O Lord of Speech, protect the sacrifice!"

sanskrit_iast: ahe daidhiṣavya \\ iti brahmasadanāt tṛṇaṃ nirasyāpa upaspṛśya /
meaning: अहे दैधिषव्य \\ इति ब्रह्मसदनात् तृणं निरस्याप उपस्पृश्य /
text_mt: having tossed away a blade of grass from the seat of the brahman priest with: "O son of a didhiṣū..." and having touched water,

sanskrit_iast: un nivata ud udvataś ca geṣam ity upaviśati /
meaning: उन् निवत उद् उद्वतश् च गेषम् इत्य् उपविशति /
text_mt: he sits down with: "May I reach from the depths and from the heights!"

sanskrit_iast: idam aham arvāgvasoḥ sadane sīdāmi \ prasūto devena savitrā bṛhaspateḥ sadane sīdāmi \ tad agnaye prabravīmi \ tad vāyave \ tat sūryāya \ tat pṛthivyai \\ ity āhavanīyam abhimukha upaviśati /
meaning: इदम् अहम् अर्वाग्वसोः सदने सीदामि \ प्रसूतो देवेन सवित्रा बृहस्पतेः सदने सीदामि \ तद् अग्नये प्रब्रवीमि \ तद् वायवे \ तत् सूर्याय \ तत् पृथिव्यै \\ इत्य् आहवनीयम् अभिमुख उपविशति /
text_mt: With: "Here I sit in the seat of Arvāgvasu; impelled by the divine Savitṛ, I sit in the seat of Bṛhaspati; that I declare to Agni; that to Vāyu; that to Sūrya; that to the Earth," he sits down facing the āhavanīya fire.

sanskrit_iast: ā sam̐sthānād anvāste /
meaning: आ सम्̐स्थानाद् अन्वास्ते /

sanskrit_iast: karmaṇikarmaṇi vācaṃ yacchati /
meaning: कर्मणिकर्मणि वाचं यच्छति /
text_mt: At each ritual act he restrains his speech.

sanskrit_iast: mantravatsu vā karmasu tūṣṇīkeṣu ca yāthākāmī /
meaning: मन्त्रवत्सु वा कर्मसु तूष्णीकेषु च याथाकामी /
text_mt: Or, he restrains it during rites accompanied by mantras, and may do as he pleases during silent ones.

sanskrit_iast: api vā sāmidhenīṣu prayājānūyājeṣu ca vācaṃ yacchati /
meaning: अपि वा सामिधेनीषु प्रयाजानूयाजेषु च वाचं यच्छति /
text_mt: Or rather, he restrains his speech during the sāmidhenī [verses] and during the fore-offerings and after-offerings.

sanskrit_iast: yadi pramatto vyāhared vaiṣṇavīm ṛcaṃ japitvā vyāhṛtīś ca punar vācaṃ yacchati /
meaning: यदि प्रमत्तो व्याहरेद् वैष्णवीम् ऋचं जपित्वा व्याहृतीश् च पुनर् वाचं यच्छति /
text_mt: If he speaks through heedlessness, he restrains his speech again after muttering a verse addressed to Viṣṇu and the vyāhṛtis.

sanskrit_iast: brahmann apaḥ praṇeṣyāmi \\ ity ucyamāne praṇaya yajñam \\ devatā vardhayaitās \ nākasya pṛṣṭhe yajamāno astu / \ saptarṣīṇām̐ sukṛtāṃ yatra lokas \ tatremaṃ yajñaṃ yajamānaṃ ca dhehi \\ oṃ praṇaya \\ iti prasauti /
meaning: ब्रह्मन्न् अपः प्रणेष्यामि \\ इत्य् उच्यमाने प्रणय यज्ञम् \\ देवता वर्धयैतास् \ नाकस्य पृष्ठे यजमानो अस्तु / \ सप्तर्षीणाम्̐ सुकृतां यत्र लोकस् \ तत्रेमं यज्ञं यजमानं च धेहि \\ ओं प्रणय \\ इति प्रसौति /
text_mt: When it is said: "O brahman, I will lead forward the waters," he gives his authorization with: "Lead forward the sacrifice! / Make these deities increase! / Let the sacrificer be upon the vault of heaven! / Where is the world of the seven seers of good deeds, / there place this sacrifice and the sacrificer. / Oṃ, lead forward!"

sanskrit_iast: sarveṣv āmantraṇeṣv oṃkāreṇa prasauti /
meaning: सर्वेष्व् आमन्त्रणेष्व् ओंकारेण प्रसौति /
text_mt: In all addressings, he authorizes with the syllable Om.

sanskrit_iast: yenayena karmaṇāmantrayate sarvatra tenatena prasauti /
meaning: येनयेन कर्मणामन्त्रयते सर्वत्र तेनतेन प्रसौति /
text_mt: With whatever rite one addresses him, he gives authorization for that very rite in every case.

sanskrit_iast: brahman prokṣiṣyāmi \\ ity ucyamāne prokṣa yajñam iti haviṣa idhmābarhiṣaś ca prokṣe /
meaning: ब्रह्मन् प्रोक्षिष्यामि \\ इत्य् उच्यमाने प्रोक्ष यज्ञम् इति हविष इध्माबर्हिषश् च प्रोक्षे /
text_mt: When it is said: "O brahman, I will sprinkle," [he responds] with: "Sprinkle the sacrifice," at the sprinkling of the oblation and of the kindling wood and sacrificial grass.

sanskrit_iast: brahmann uttaraṃ parigrāhaṃ parigrahīṣyāmi \\ ity ucyamāne bṛhaspate parigṛhāṇa vedim \\ svagāvo devāḥ sadanāni santu / \ tasyāṃ barhiḥ prathatām̐ sādhv antar \ ahim̐srā ṇaḥ pṛthivī devy astu \\ ity uttarasmin parigrāhe /
meaning: ब्रह्मन्न् उत्तरं परिग्राहं परिग्रहीष्यामि \\ इत्य् उच्यमाने बृहस्पते परिगृहाण वेदिम् \\ स्वगावो देवाः सदनानि सन्तु / \ तस्यां बर्हिः प्रथताम्̐ साध्व् अन्तर् \ अहिम्̐स्रा णः पृथिवी देव्य् अस्तु \\ इत्य् उत्तरस्मिन् परिग्राहे /
text_mt: When it is said: "O brahman, I will trace out the second enclosing line," [he responds] with: "O Bṛhaspati, enclose the altar! / May the deities possess their seats! / May the sacred grass spread well within it! / May the goddess Earth be harmless to us!" at the second enclosing.

sanskrit_iast: brahman sāmidhenīr anuvakṣyāmi \\ ity ucyamāne prajāpataye 'nubrūhi yajñam iti sāmidhenīṣu /
meaning: ब्रह्मन् सामिधेनीर् अनुवक्ष्यामि \\ इत्य् उच्यमाने प्रजापतये ऽनुब्रूहि यज्ञम् इति सामिधेनीषु /
text_mt: When it is said: "O brahman, I will recite the sāmidhenī [verses]," [he responds] with: "Recite the sacrifice for Prajāpati," at the sāmidhenī [verses].

sanskrit_iast: brahman pravarāyāśrāvayiṣyāmi \\ ity ucyamāne //
meaning: ब्रह्मन् प्रवरायाश्रावयिष्यामि \\ इत्य् उच्यमाने //
text_mt: When it is said: "O brahman, I will call for the ancestral invocation,"—

sanskrit_iast: vācaspate vācam āśrāvayaitām āśrāvaya yajñaṃ deveṣu māṃ manuṣyeṣu \\ iti pravare /
meaning: वाचस्पते वाचम् आश्रावयैताम् आश्रावय यज्ञं देवेषु मां मनुष्येषु \\ इति प्रवरे /
text_mt: —with: "O Lord of Speech, make this speech heard! Make the sacrifice heard among the gods, and me among men!" at the ancestral invocation.

sanskrit_iast: devatā vardhaya \\ iti sarvatrānuṣajati \\ om āśrāvaya \\ iti prasauti /
meaning: देवता वर्धय \\ इति सर्वत्रानुषजति \\ ओम् आश्रावय \\ इति प्रसौति /
text_mt: He attaches: "Make the deities increase!" everywhere, and gives authorization with: "Om, make it heard!"

sanskrit_iast: mitrasya tvā cakṣuṣā prekṣe \\ iti prāśitram avadīyamānaṃ prekṣate /
meaning: मित्रस्य त्वा चक्षुषा प्रेक्षे \\ इति प्राशित्रम् अवदीयमानं प्रेक्षते /
text_mt: With: "With the eye of Mitra I look upon you," he looks at the prāśitra portion being cut off.

sanskrit_iast: ṛtasya pathā paryehi \\ iti paryāhriyamāṇam /
meaning: ऋतस्य पथा पर्येहि \\ इति पर्याह्रियमाणम् /
text_mt: With: "Come around by the path of cosmic order," [he looks at it] being brought around.

sanskrit_iast: sūryasya tvā cakṣuṣā pratipaśyāmi \\ ity āhriyāmānaṃ pratīkṣate /
meaning: सूर्यस्य त्वा चक्षुषा प्रतिपश्यामि \\ इत्य् आह्रियामानं प्रतीक्षते /
text_mt: With: "With the eye of the Sun I gaze back at you," he gazes at it being brought near.

sanskrit_iast: devasya tvā \\ iti pratigṛhya /
meaning: देवस्य त्वा \\ इति प्रतिगृह्य /
text_mt: Having accepted it with: "Of the god you…" [= devasya tvā…],

sanskrit_iast: pṛthivyās tvā nābhau sādayāmīḍāyāḥ pade \\ ity apareṇāhavanīyaṃ vyūhya tṛṇāni prāgdaṇḍam̐ sādayati /
meaning: पृथिव्यास् त्वा नाभौ सादयामीडायाः पदे \\ इत्य् अपरेणाहवनीयं व्यूह्य तृणानि प्राग्दण्डम्̐ सादयति /
text_mt: he sets it down with its handle turned eastward west of the āhavanīya fire after brushing aside the blades of grass, with: "I set you upon the navel of the earth, in the place of Iḍā."

sanskrit_iast: suparṇasya tvā garutmataś cakṣuṣāvapaśyāmi \\ ity avekṣya /
meaning: सुपर्णस्य त्वा गरुत्मतश् चक्षुषावपश्यामि \\ इत्य् अवेक्ष्य /
text_mt: Having looked down upon it with: "With the eye of the winged Suparṇa I look down upon you,"

sanskrit_iast: devasya tvā \\ ity aṅguṣṭhenopamadhyamayā cāṅgulyādāya /
meaning: देवस्य त्वा \\ इत्य् अङ्गुष्ठेनोपमध्यमया चाङ्गुल्यादाय /
text_mt: and having taken it with the thumb and the ring finger with: "Of the god you…,"

sanskrit_iast: agnes tvāsyena prāśnāmi \\ iti prāśnāti /
meaning: अग्नेस् त्वास्येन प्राश्नामि \\ इति प्राश्नाति /
text_mt: he eats it with: "I eat you with the mouth of Agni."

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇasyodareṇa \\ ity asaṃmletyāvagirati /
meaning: ब्राह्मणस्योदरेण \\ इत्य् असंम्लेत्यावगिरति /
text_mt: With: "With the belly of the brāhmaṇa," he swallows it down without chewing.

sanskrit_iast: na dato gamayati /
meaning: न दतो गमयति /

sanskrit_iast: yā apsv antar devatās tā idam̐ śamayantu \ svāhākṛtaṃ jaṭharam indrasya gaccha \\ ity adbhir abhyavaharati /
meaning: या अप्स्व् अन्तर् देवतास् ता इदम्̐ शमयन्तु \ स्वाहाकृतं जठरम् इन्द्रस्य गच्छ \\ इत्य् अद्भिर् अभ्यवहरति /
text_mt: With: "Whichever deities are within the waters, let them pacify this; / made into svāhā, go to the belly of Indra," he rinses it down with water.

sanskrit_iast: ācamya /
meaning: आचम्य /

sanskrit_iast: ghasinā me mā saṃpṛkthās \\ ūrdhvaṃ me nābheḥ sīda \\ indrasya tvā jaṭhare sādayāmi \\ iti nābhideśam abhimṛśati /
meaning: घसिना मे मा संपृक्थास् \\ ऊर्ध्वं मे नाभेः सीद \\ इन्द्रस्य त्वा जठरे सादयामि \\ इति नाभिदेशम् अभिमृशति /
text_mt: he touches the region of the navel with: "Do not unite with my devourer; / sit above my navel; / I place you in the belly of Indra."

sanskrit_iast: vāṅ ma āsann asoḥ prāṇas \\ iti yathārūpaṃ prāṇāyatanāni saṃmṛśati /
meaning: वाङ् म आसन्न् असोः प्राणस् \\ इति यथारूपं प्राणायतनानि संमृशति /
text_mt: With: "Speech in my mouth, breath in my nostrils…," he touches the seats of the vital breaths according to their form.

sanskrit_iast: ariṣṭā viśvāny aṅgāni \\ iti sarvāṇy aṅgāni /
meaning: अरिष्टा विश्वान्य् अङ्गानि \\ इति सर्वाण्य् अङ्गानि /
text_mt: With: "Unharmed be all my limbs," [he touches] all his limbs.

sanskrit_iast: pātraṃ prakṣālya pūrayitvā diśo jinva \\ iti parāñcaṃ ninayati /
meaning: पात्रं प्रक्षाल्य पूरयित्वा दिशो जिन्व \\ इति पराञ्चं निनयति /
text_mt: Having washed the vessel and filled it [with water], he pours it out away from himself with: "Enliven the directions!"

sanskrit_iast: aparaṃ pūrayitvā māṃ jinva \\ ity abhyātmaṃ ninayati /
meaning: अपरं पूरयित्वा मां जिन्व \\ इत्य् अभ्यात्मं निनयति /
text_mt: Having filled another, he pours it out toward himself with: "Enliven me!"

sanskrit_iast: brahmabhāgaṃ parihṛtaṃ na purā sam̐sthānāt prāśnāti /
meaning: ब्रह्मभागं परिहृतं न पुरा सम्̐स्थानात् प्राश्नाति /
text_mt: He does not eat the brahman's portion that has been carried around prior to the conclusion.

sanskrit_iast: brahman brahmāsi \ brahmaṇe tvāhutādya mā mā him̐sīs \\ ahuto mahyam̐ śivo bhava \\ ity antarvedy anvāhāryam āsannam abhimṛśati prajāpater bhāgo 'si \\ iti ca /
meaning: ब्रह्मन् ब्रह्मासि \ ब्रह्मणे त्वाहुताद्य मा मा हिम्̐सीस् \\ अहुतो मह्यम्̐ शिवो भव \\ इत्य् अन्तर्वेद्य् अन्वाहार्यम् आसन्नम् अभिमृशति प्रजापतेर् भागो ऽसि \\ इति च /
text_mt: With: "O brahman, you are the brāhmaṇa; / for the brāhmaṇa, O eater of the offering, do not injure me; / uneaten, be auspicious to me," and with: "You are the portion of Prajāpati," he touches the anvāhārya cooked rice placed inside the altar.

sanskrit_iast: brahman prasthāsyāmas \\ ity ucyamāne deva savitar etat te prāha \ tat pra ca suva pra ca yaja \ bṛhaspatir brahmā \ sa yajñaṃ pāhi sa yajñapatiṃ pāhi sa māṃ pāhi \\ oṃ pratiṣṭha \\ ity anūyājasamidhi /
meaning: ब्रह्मन् प्रस्थास्यामस् \\ इत्य् उच्यमाने देव सवितर् एतत् ते प्राह \ तत् प्र च सुव प्र च यज \ बृहस्पतिर् ब्रह्मा \ स यज्ञं पाहि स यज्ञपतिं पाहि स मां पाहि \\ ओं प्रतिष्ठ \\ इत्य् अनूयाजसमिधि /
text_mt: When it is said: "O brahman, we will proceed," [he responds] at the kindling stick of the after-offerings with: "O god Savitṛ, he has proclaimed this to you; / do you impel it and offer it; / Bṛhaspati is the brahman priest; / protect the sacrifice, protect the lord of the sacrifice, protect me! / Oṃ, proceed!"

sanskrit_iast: bhūmir bhūmim agāt \\ mātā mātaram apyagāt / \ ṛdhyāsma putraiḥ paśubhis \\ yo no dveṣṭi sa bhidyatām iti yat kiṃca yajñe mṛnmayaṃ bhidyeta tad abhimantrayeta /
meaning: भूमिर् भूमिम् अगात् \\ माता मातरम् अप्यगात् / \ ऋध्यास्म पुत्रैः पशुभिस् \\ यो नो द्वेष्टि स भिद्यताम् इति यत् किंच यज्ञे मृन्मयं भिद्येत तद् अभिमन्त्रयेत /
text_mt: With: "Earth has gone to earth, / mother has reached mother; / may we prosper with sons and cattle; / whoever hates us, let him be shattered," he should recite over whatever earthenware is broken in the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: sārvatrikam eke samāmananti /
meaning: सार्वत्रिकम् एके समामनन्ति /
text_mt: Some teach that this applies universally.

sanskrit_iast: brahmabhāgaṃ prāśya /
meaning: ब्रह्मभागं प्राश्य /

sanskrit_iast: ayāḍ agnir jātavedās \\ adabdho 'ntaraḥ pūrvo asmin niṣadya / \ sunvan sanim̐ sa vimucāno vimuñca \ dhehy asmāsu draviṇaṃ jātavedo yac ca bhadram \\ pra ṇo yacchābhivasyo asmān \ saṃ naḥ sṛja sumatyā vājavatyā \\ iti samidham ādhāya hutvopasthāya vā /
meaning: अयाड् अग्निर् जातवेदास् \\ अदब्धो ऽन्तरः पूर्वो अस्मिन् निषद्य / \ सुन्वन् सनिम्̐ स विमुचानो विमुञ्च \ धेह्य् अस्मासु द्रविणं जातवेदो यच् च भद्रम् \\ प्र णो यच्छाभिवस्यो अस्मान् \ सं नः सृज सुमत्या वाजवत्या \\ इति समिधम् आधाय हुत्वोपस्थाय वा /
text_mt: having placed a kindling stick, offered an oblation, or stood up worshiping with: "Agni Jātavedas has sacrificed, / unbeguiled, within, sitting down here first; / pressing out the gift, unloosening, unloose! / Place wealth in us, O Jātavedas, and whatever is auspicious; / bestow upon us greater wealth; / unite us with bounty rich in food,"

sanskrit_iast: yathetaṃ pratiniṣkrāmati /
meaning: यथेतं प्रतिनिष्क्रामति /
text_mt: he goes out the way he came.

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ vihitam iṣṭipaśubandhānāṃ brahmatvaṃ brahmatvam //
meaning: एवं विहितम् इष्टिपशुबन्धानां ब्रह्मत्वं ब्रह्मत्वम् //
text_mt: Thus is prescribed the function of the brahman priest for iṣṭis and animal sacrifices, the function of the brahman priest.

sanskrit_iast: karmabhir niḥśreyasaṃ tāni śabdalakṣaṇāni dhāryante /
meaning: कर्मभिर् निःश्रेयसं तानि शब्दलक्षणानि धार्यन्ते /
text_mt: The highest good is achieved through rites; these are sustained by the defining authority of the Vedic word.

sanskrit_iast: vaidikānām̐ śabdānām̐ smṛtigrahaṇāni laukikāni /
meaning: वैदिकानाम्̐ शब्दानाम्̐ स्मृतिग्रहणानि लौकिकानि /
text_mt: The traditional texts that comprehend Vedic words are worldly.

sanskrit_iast: karmaṇābhyudayo 'karmaṇy apratyavāyo 'niyatānāṃ tu /
meaning: कर्मणाभ्युदयो ऽकर्मण्य् अप्रत्यवायो ऽनियतानां तु /
text_mt: Through the rite, however, there is worldly prosperity; in non-performance there is no transgression for optional [rites].

sanskrit_iast: akarmaṇi doṣo yeṣāṃ loke 'karmaṇy upālambhas tāni niyatāni /
meaning: अकर्मणि दोषो येषां लोके ऽकर्मण्य् उपालम्भस् तानि नियतानि /
text_mt: Obligatory are those rites in the non-performance of which there is a fault, and in the non-performance of which there is reproach in the world.

sanskrit_iast: niḥśreyasabuddhiḥ prajanasaṃbandhāpekṣā /
meaning: निःश्रेयसबुद्धिः प्रजनसंबन्धापेक्षा /
text_mt: The understanding of the highest good depends upon connection with offspring.

sanskrit_iast: atithipūjāgurupūjāsaṃnipāte cābhivādanam /
meaning: अतिथिपूजागुरुपूजासंनिपाते चाभिवादनम् /
text_mt: And in the concurrence of honoring a guest and honoring a teacher, respectful greeting is [first].

sanskrit_iast: tatkāritatvād brāhmaṇarājanyayor vaiśyasya ca vedādhyayanaṃ tan niyatam /
meaning: तत्कारितत्वाद् ब्राह्मणराजन्ययोर् वैश्यस्य च वेदाध्ययनं तन् नियतम् /
text_mt: Because it is caused by that, the study of the Veda by a brāhmaṇa, a kṣatriya, and a vaiśya is obligatory.

sanskrit_iast: teṣām eva brāhmaṇavihitā yajñā yeṣu yajñakārtsnyam avipratiṣiddham /
meaning: तेषाम् एव ब्राह्मणविहिता यज्ञा येषु यज्ञकार्त्स्न्यम् अविप्रतिषिद्धम् /
text_mt: Only for them are the sacrifices prescribed in the Brāhmaṇas, for those in whom the full completeness of the sacrifice is not contradicted,

sanskrit_iast: yathā dravyavattā śarīrakārtsnyaṃ ca /
meaning: यथा द्रव्यवत्ता शरीरकार्त्स्न्यं च /
text_mt: such as possession of wealth and bodily completeness.

sanskrit_iast: yeṣāṃ ca prakṛtiliṅgāni yajñāḥ śrūyante trīn vṛṇīte mantrakṛto vṛṇīte yatharṣi mantrakṛto vṛṇīta iti vijñāyate /
meaning: येषां च प्रकृतिलिङ्गानि यज्ञाः श्रूयन्ते त्रीन् वृणीते मन्त्रकृतो वृणीते यथर्षि मन्त्रकृतो वृणीत इति विज्ञायते /
text_mt: And for those whom sacrifices are revealed with archetypal characteristics, as it is known from the text: "He chooses three, he chooses mantra-makers, he chooses mantra-makers according to the ṛṣis."

sanskrit_iast: gāyatriyā brāhmaṇasya paridadhyāt triṣṭubhā rājanyasya jagatyā vaiśyasyeti /
meaning: गायत्रिया ब्राह्मणस्य परिदध्यात् त्रिष्टुभा राजन्यस्य जगत्या वैश्यस्येति /
text_mt: [And from the text:] "He should gird a brāhmaṇa with the Gāyatrī, a kṣatriya with the Triṣṭubh, and a vaiśya with the Jagatī."

sanskrit_iast: teṣām agnihotraṃ darśapūrṇamāsau ca niyatau /
meaning: तेषाम् अग्निहोत्रं दर्शपूर्णमासौ च नियतौ /
text_mt: For them the Agnihotra and the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices are obligatory.

sanskrit_iast: somejyā brāhmaṇasya /
meaning: सोमेज्या ब्राह्मणस्य /

sanskrit_iast: ādhānād agnihotraṃ darśapūrṇamāsau ca niyatau /
meaning: आधानाद् अग्निहोत्रं दर्शपूर्णमासौ च नियतौ /
text_mt: From the time of establishing the sacred fires, the Agnihotra and the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices are obligatory.

sanskrit_iast: niṣādarathakārayor ādhānād agnihotraṃ darśapūrṇamāsau ca niyamyete /
meaning: निषादरथकारयोर् आधानाद् अग्निहोत्रं दर्शपूर्णमासौ च नियम्येते /
text_mt: For the Niṣāda and the chariot-maker, the Agnihotra and the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices are made obligatory from the time of establishing the sacred fires.

sanskrit_iast: tathā jīvapituḥ /
meaning: तथा जीवपितुः /

sanskrit_iast: upakramād itare niyamyeran /
meaning: उपक्रमाद् इतरे नियम्येरन् /
text_mt: Other [rites] would become obligatory from their commencement.

sanskrit_iast: tatra nityasya dravyasyābhāve sāmānyāt pratinidhiḥ /
meaning: तत्र नित्यस्य द्रव्यस्याभावे सामान्यात् प्रतिनिधिः /
text_mt: There, in the absence of the regular material substance, a substitute [is adopted] on the basis of resemblance.

sanskrit_iast: arthāv āptau dravyasāmānyam /
meaning: अर्थाव् आप्तौ द्रव्यसामान्यम् /
text_mt: When the purpose is attained, resemblance of material substance [governs].

sanskrit_iast: arthavipratiṣedhe tv arthasāmānyam /
meaning: अर्थविप्रतिषेधे त्व् अर्थसामान्यम् /
text_mt: When there is a conflict of purposes, however, resemblance of purpose [governs].

sanskrit_iast: yathā yūpāñjane sarpiṣo 'bhāve tailam /
meaning: यथा यूपाञ्जने सर्पिषो ऽभावे तैलम् /
text_mt: As, in the absence of clarified butter for anointing the sacrificial post, oil [is used].

sanskrit_iast: pratiṣiddhebhyo nivṛttaḥ pratinidhiḥ /
meaning: प्रतिषिद्धेभ्यो निवृत्तः प्रतिनिधिः /
text_mt: A substitute is excluded from forbidden things.

sanskrit_iast: aviśeṣeṇa hi pratiṣedhaḥ śrūyate /
meaning: अविशेषेण हि प्रतिषेधः श्रूयते /
text_mt: For the prohibition is revealed without distinction.

sanskrit_iast: vikalpe pravṛttilakṣaṇaḥ /
meaning: विकल्पे प्रवृत्तिलक्षणः /
text_mt: In case of an option, [the rule] is characterized by undertaking [one of the alternatives].

sanskrit_iast: kṛtsnābhāve pratinidhiḥ /
meaning: कृत्स्नाभावे प्रतिनिधिः /
text_mt: In the absence of the complete [substance], there is a substitute.

sanskrit_iast: mātrāpacāre tena samāpyeta /
meaning: मात्रापचारे तेन समाप्येत /
text_mt: In case of a deficit in quantity, one may complete [the rite] with that [substitute].

sanskrit_iast: dravyābhāve pratinidhir vidhyaparādhe prāyaścittam /
meaning: द्रव्याभावे प्रतिनिधिर् विध्यपराधे प्रायश्चित्तम् /
text_mt: In the absence of a material substance, there is a substitute; in case of a transgression of an injunction, an expiation.

sanskrit_iast: na svāmitvasya bhāryāyāḥ putrasya deśasya kālasyāgner devatāyāḥ karmaṇaḥ śabdasya ca pratinidhir vidyate //
meaning: न स्वामित्वस्य भार्यायाः पुत्रस्य देशस्य कालस्याग्नेर् देवतायाः कर्मणः शब्दस्य च प्रतिनिधिर् विद्यते //
text_mt: There is no substitute for ownership, the wife, the son, the place, the time, the fire, the deity, the rite, and the spoken word.

sanskrit_iast: agnīn ādhāsyamānasya yo aśvatthaḥ śamīgarbhas \ āruroha tve sacā / \ taṃ te harāmi brahmaṇā \ yajñiyaiḥ ketubhiḥ saha \\ ity aśvatthasya śamīgarbhasyāraṇī uddharati /
meaning: अग्नीन् आधास्यमानस्य यो अश्वत्थः शमीगर्भस् \ आरुरोह त्वे सचा / \ तं ते हरामि ब्रह्मणा \ यज्ञियैः केतुभिः सह \\ इत्य् अश्वत्थस्य शमीगर्भस्यारणी उद्धरति /
text_mt: For one who is going to establish the fires, he takes the two fire-drills from an aśvattha tree growing out of a śamī tree with [the mantra]: 'Which aśvattha mounted you, having grown within the śamī, that one I take from you with the sacred word together with sacrificial signs.'

sanskrit_iast: api vāśvatthād evoddhared iyaṃ vai śamī tasyā eṣa garbho yad aśvattha iti vijñāyate /
meaning: अपि वाश्वत्थाद् एवोद्धरेद् इयं वै शमी तस्या एष गर्भो यद् अश्वत्थ इति विज्ञायते /
text_mt: Or he may take them from just an aśvattha tree; 'this [earth] indeed is the śamī, its embryo is that aśvattha,' so it is known [from the Brāhmaṇa].

sanskrit_iast: aśvatthād dhavyavāhād dhi jātām \ agnes tanūṃ yajñiyām̐ saṃbharāmi / \ śāntayonim̐ śamīgarbham \ agnaye prajanayitave \\ iti saṃbharati \\ āyur mayi dhattām āyur yajamāne \\ iti saṃbhṛte abhimantrayate /
meaning: अश्वत्थाद् धव्यवाहाद् धि जाताम् \ अग्नेस् तनूं यज्ञियाम्̐ संभरामि / \ शान्तयोनिम्̐ शमीगर्भम् \ अग्नये प्रजनयितवे \\ इति संभरति \\ आयुर् मयि धत्ताम् आयुर् यजमाने \\ इति संभृते अभिमन्त्रयते /
text_mt: He procures [them] with [the mantra]: 'Born from the aśvattha, carrying the oblation, I collect Agni's sacrificial body, whose womb is calmed, having grown in the śamī, to bring forth Agni.' When they are procured, he addresses them with: 'Bestow long life upon me, long life upon the sacrificer!'

sanskrit_iast: kṛttikā rohiṇī mṛgaśīrṣaṃ punarvasū phalgunyau hastaś citrā viśākhe anūrādhāḥ śroṇā proṣṭhapadāś cottare 'gnyādheyanakṣatrāṇi kṛttikā brāhmaṇasyottare phalgunyau citrā ca rājanyasyāviśiṣṭānītareṣām /
meaning: कृत्तिका रोहिणी मृगशीर्षं पुनर्वसू फल्गुन्यौ हस्तश् चित्रा विशाखे अनूराधाः श्रोणा प्रोष्ठपदाश् चोत्तरे ऽग्न्याधेयनक्षत्राणि कृत्तिका ब्राह्मणस्योत्तरे फल्गुन्यौ चित्रा च राजन्यस्याविशिष्टानीतरेषाम् /
text_mt: Kṛttikās, Rohiṇī, Mṛgaśīrṣa, the two Punarvasus, the two Phalgunīs, Hasta, Citrā, the two Viśākhās, Anūrādhās, Śroṇā, and the latter Proṣṭhapadās are the asterisms for establishing the fires; Kṛttikās is for a brāhmaṇa; the latter Phalgunīs and Citrā are for a rājanya; the remaining ones are undistinguished for the others.

sanskrit_iast: sarveṣāṃ tu kāmyāni /
meaning: सर्वेषां तु काम्यानि /

sanskrit_iast: kṛttikāsv agnim ādadhīta yaḥ kāmayeta mukhyo brahmavarcasī syām /
meaning: कृत्तिकास्व् अग्निम् आदधीत यः कामयेत मुख्यो ब्रह्मवर्चसी स्याम् /
text_mt: One who desires, 'May I be preeminent and endowed with spiritual lustre,' should establish the fire under the Kṛttikās.

sanskrit_iast: kāmaṃ tu me 'gnir gṛhān dāhuko 'stv iti /
meaning: कामं तु मे ऽग्निर् गृहान् दाहुको ऽस्त्व् इति /
text_mt: [Even if he thinks:] 'Let fire burning my houses be at will.'

sanskrit_iast: rohiṇyāṃ yaḥ kāmayeta sarvān rohān rohayeyam iti /
meaning: रोहिण्यां यः कामयेत सर्वान् रोहान् रोहयेयम् इति /
text_mt: One who desires, 'May I attain all ascents,' [should establish it] under Rohiṇī.

sanskrit_iast: mṛgaśirasi yaḥ kāmayeta śrīmān syām iti /
meaning: मृगशिरसि यः कामयेत श्रीमान् स्याम् इति /
text_mt: One who desires, 'May I be prosperous,' under Mṛgaśiras.

sanskrit_iast: yaḥ purā bhadraḥ san pāpīyān syāt sa punarvasvoḥ /
meaning: यः पुरा भद्रः सन् पापीयान् स्यात् स पुनर्वस्वोः /
text_mt: One who, having formerly been prosperous, has become worse off, [should establish it] under the two Punarvasus.

sanskrit_iast: yaḥ kāmayeta dānakāmā me prajāḥ syur iti sa pūrvayoḥ phalgunyoḥ /
meaning: यः कामयेत दानकामा मे प्रजाः स्युर् इति स पूर्वयोः फल्गुन्योः /
text_mt: One who desires, 'May my offspring be generous,' under the two former Phalgunīs.

sanskrit_iast: yaḥ kāmayeta bhagī syām iti sa uttarayoḥ /
meaning: यः कामयेत भगी स्याम् इति स उत्तरयोः /
text_mt: One who desires, 'May I be fortunate,' under the two latter [Phalgunīs].

sanskrit_iast: viparītam eke samāmananti /
meaning: विपरीतम् एके समामनन्ति /
text_mt: Some teach the reverse.

sanskrit_iast: haste yaḥ kāmayeta pra me dīyeteti /
meaning: हस्ते यः कामयेत प्र मे दीयेतेति /
text_mt: One who desires, 'May gifts be given to me,' under Hasta.

sanskrit_iast: citrāyāṃ bhrātṛvyavān /
meaning: चित्रायां भ्रातृव्यवान् /
text_mt: One who has rivals under Citrā.

sanskrit_iast: viśākhayoḥ prajākāmaḥ /
meaning: विशाखयोः प्रजाकामः /
text_mt: One who desires offspring under the two Viśākhās.

sanskrit_iast: anūrādheṣv ṛddhikāmaḥ /
meaning: अनूराधेष्व् ऋद्धिकामः /
text_mt: One who desires prosperity under the Anūrādhās.

sanskrit_iast: śroṇāyāṃ puṣṭikāmaḥ /
meaning: श्रोणायां पुष्टिकामः /

sanskrit_iast: proṣṭhapadeṣu brahmavarcasakāmaḥ /
meaning: प्रोष्ठपदेषु ब्रह्मवर्चसकामः /
text_mt: One who desires spiritual lustre under the Proṣṭhapadās.

sanskrit_iast: sūryanakṣatre vā /
meaning: सूर्यनक्षत्रे वा /

sanskrit_iast: atho khalu yadaivaitam̐ śraddhopanamet tad ādadhīta //
meaning: अथो खलु यदैवैतम्̐ श्रद्धोपनमेत् तद् आदधीत //
text_mt: Moreover, whenever faith attends upon him, then he should establish [the fires].

sanskrit_iast: vasanto brāhmaṇasyādhānakālaḥ /
meaning: वसन्तो ब्राह्मणस्याधानकालः /
text_mt: Spring is the time of establishing [the fires] for a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: grīṣmo hemantaś ca rājanyasya /
meaning: ग्रीष्मो हेमन्तश् च राजन्यस्य /
text_mt: Summer and winter are for a rājanya.

sanskrit_iast: varṣā rathakārasya /
meaning: वर्षा रथकारस्य /

sanskrit_iast: śarad vaiśyasya /
meaning: शरद् वैश्यस्य /

sanskrit_iast: sarveṣām̐ śiśiraḥ /
meaning: सर्वेषाम्̐ शिशिरः /

sanskrit_iast: amāvāsyāyāṃ paurṇamāsyām āpūryamāṇapakṣe vā /
meaning: अमावास्यायां पौर्णमास्याम् आपूर्यमाणपक्षे वा /
text_mt: On the New Moon, on the Full Moon, or during the waxing fortnight,

sanskrit_iast: puṇye nakṣatre /
meaning: पुण्ये नक्षत्रे /

sanskrit_iast: yatra trīṇi saṃnipatitāny ṛtur nakṣatraṃ parva tat samṛddham /
meaning: यत्र त्रीणि संनिपतितान्य् ऋतुर् नक्षत्रं पर्व तत् समृद्धम् /
text_mt: When three coincide—the season, the asterism, and the juncture-day—that is successful.

sanskrit_iast: vipratiṣedha ṛtur nakṣatraṃ ca balīyaḥ /
meaning: विप्रतिषेध ऋतुर् नक्षत्रं च बलीयः /
text_mt: In case of conflict, the season and the asterism are stronger.

sanskrit_iast: somena yakṣyamāṇa ādadhāno nartuṃ na nakṣatram̐ sūrkṣed ity ekeṣām /
meaning: सोमेन यक्ष्यमाण आदधानो नर्तुं न नक्षत्रम्̐ सूर्क्षेद् इत्य् एकेषाम् /
text_mt: According to some, one who is going to sacrifice with Soma when establishing [the fires] should not heed the season nor the asterism.

sanskrit_iast: prācīnam udīcīnaṃ vodavasāya śālīno 'gnīn ādadhīta prācīnapravaṇe devayajane /
meaning: प्राचीनम् उदीचीनं वोदवसाय शालीनो ऽग्नीन् आदधीत प्राचीनप्रवणे देवयजने /
text_mt: Having moved towards the east or towards the north, a settled householder should establish the fires on a sacrificial ground that slopes towards the east.

sanskrit_iast: gṛheṣu yāyāvaraḥ /
meaning: गृहेषु यायावरः /

sanskrit_iast: udīcīnavam̐śā śālā /
meaning: उदीचीनवम्̐शा शाला /

sanskrit_iast: tasyāḥ pūrveṇa madhyamaṃ vam̐śam adhivṛkṣasūrya aupāsanād brāhmaudanikam ādadhāti /
meaning: तस्याः पूर्वेण मध्यमं वम्̐शम् अधिवृक्षसूर्य औपासनाद् ब्राह्मौदनिकम् आदधाति /
text_mt: To the east of its central beam, when the sun is above the trees, he establishes the fire for the brāhmaṇa's porridge from the domestic fire.

sanskrit_iast: niśāyāṃ brahmaudanaṃ catuḥśarāvaṃ nirvapati /
meaning: निशायां ब्रह्मौदनं चतुःशरावं निर्वपति /
text_mt: At night, he measures out the brāhmaṇa's porridge of four cupfuls,

sanskrit_iast: rohite carmaṇi pājake vā /
meaning: रोहिते चर्मणि पाजके वा /
text_mt: upon a red hide or in a winnowing basket,

sanskrit_iast: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave 'śvinor bāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ brahmaṇe prāṇāya juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi \ brahmaṇe 'pānāya \ brahmaṇe vyānāya \ brahmaṇe \\ iti caturtham /
meaning: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवे ऽश्विनोर् बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्यां ब्रह्मणे प्राणाय जुष्टं निर्वपामि \ ब्रह्मणे ऽपानाय \ ब्रह्मणे व्यानाय \ ब्रह्मणे \\ इति चतुर्थम् /
text_mt: with [the mantras]: 'On the impulse of the divine Savitṛ, with the arms of the Aśvins, with the hands of Pūṣan, I measure out what is pleasing to Brahman, to the out-breath; to Brahman, to the in-breath; to Brahman, to the diffused breath;' 'To Brahman' being the fourth.

sanskrit_iast: avahatya payasi carum̐ śrapayati /
meaning: अवहत्य पयसि चरुम्̐ श्रपयति /
text_mt: Having pounded [the grain], he cooks the boiled mess in milk,

sanskrit_iast: caturṣu vodapātreṣu /
meaning: चतुर्षु वोदपात्रेषु /

sanskrit_iast: na nirṇenekti /
meaning: न निर्णेनेक्ति /

sanskrit_iast: nāvasiñcati /
meaning: नावसिञ्चति /

sanskrit_iast: śrapayitvābhighāryodvāsya /
meaning: श्रपयित्वाभिघार्योद्वास्य /
text_mt: Having cooked it, having basted it with clarified butter, and having removed it from the fire,

sanskrit_iast: pra vedhase kavaye medhyāya \ vaco vandāru vṛṣabhāya vṛṣṇe / \ yato bhayam abhayaṃ tan no astu \\ ava devān yaje heḍyān iti juhoti /
meaning: प्र वेधसे कवये मेध्याय \ वचो वन्दारु वृषभाय वृष्णे / \ यतो भयम् अभयं तन् नो अस्तु \\ अव देवान् यजे हेड्यान् इति जुहोति /
text_mt: he offers with: 'To the creator, the poet, the sacrificial, praise-bearing speech to the bull, the manly; from wherever there is fear, let there be freedom from fear for us; I ward off by sacrifice the wrathful gods.'

sanskrit_iast: abhimantrayate vā /
meaning: अभिमन्त्रयते वा /

sanskrit_iast: taṃ caturdhā vyuddhṛtya prabhūtena sarpiṣopasicya /
meaning: तं चतुर्धा व्युद्धृत्य प्रभूतेन सर्पिषोपसिच्य /
text_mt: Having taken it out in four portions and having poured abundant clarified butter over it,

sanskrit_iast: sthālyām̐ sarpiḥśeṣam ānayati /
meaning: स्थाल्याम्̐ सर्पिःशेषम् आनयति /
text_mt: he pours the remnant of the clarified butter into the cooking pot.

sanskrit_iast: anucchindann iva caturbhya ārṣeyebhya ṛtvigbhya upohati /
meaning: अनुच्छिन्दन्न् इव चतुर्भ्य आर्षेयेभ्य ऋत्विग्भ्य उपोहति /
text_mt: As if not leaving anything over, he pushes [a portion] towards each of the four priests who are descended from ṛṣis.

sanskrit_iast: prośitavatsu /
meaning: प्रोशितवत्सु /

sanskrit_iast: yaḥ sthālyām̐ śeṣas tasminn ārdrāḥ sapalāśāḥ //
meaning: यः स्थाल्याम्̐ शेषस् तस्मिन्न् आर्द्राः सपलाशाः //
text_mt: in whatever [clarified butter] is the remnant in the pot, he [places] wet [twigs] with leaves.

sanskrit_iast: stibhikavatīr astibhikā vā prādeśamātrīr lakṣaṇyasyāśvatthasya tisraḥ samidho 'nakti /
meaning: स्तिभिकवतीर् अस्तिभिका वा प्रादेशमात्रीर् लक्षण्यस्याश्वत्थस्य तिस्रः समिधो ऽनक्ति /
text_mt: He anoints three firewood sticks of an auspicious aśvattha tree, either having clusters of shoots or without clusters of shoots, a span long.

sanskrit_iast: citriyād aśvatthāt saṃbhṛtā bṛhatyaḥ \ śarīram abhisam̐skṛtāḥ stha / \ prajāpatinā yajñamukhena saṃmitās \ tisras trivṛdbhir mithunāḥ prajātyai \\ ity abhimantrya /
meaning: चित्रियाद् अश्वत्थात् संभृता बृहत्यः \ शरीरम् अभिसम्̐स्कृताः स्थ / \ प्रजापतिना यज्ञमुखेन संमितास् \ तिस्रस् त्रिवृद्भिर् मिथुनाः प्रजात्यै \\ इत्य् अभिमन्त्र्य /
text_mt: Having addressed them with: 'Collected from the auspicious aśvattha, exalted ones, you are prepared as a body; matched with Prajāpati, the beginning of the sacrifice, three united with threefold [meters] for propagation,'

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaudanika ādadhāti /
meaning: ब्राह्मौदनिक आदधाति /
text_mt: he places [them] on the fire for the brāhmaṇa's porridge.

sanskrit_iast: pra vo vājā abhidyavas \\ haviṣmanto ghṛtācyā / \ devāñ jigāti sumnayuḥ / \ upa tvā juhvo mama \ ghṛtācīr yantu haryata \ agne havyā juṣasva naḥ / \ ud agne tava tad ghṛtāt \\ arcī rocata āhutam / \ nim̐sānaṃ juhvo mukhe \\ iti tisṛbhir gāyatrībhir brāhmaṇasya /
meaning: प्र वो वाजा अभिद्यवस् \\ हविष्मन्तो घृताच्या / \ देवाञ् जिगाति सुम्नयुः / \ उप त्वा जुह्वो मम \ घृताचीर् यन्तु हर्यत \ अग्ने हव्या जुषस्व नः / \ उद् अग्ने तव तद् घृतात् \\ अर्ची रोचत आहुतम् / \ निम्̐सानं जुह्वो मुखे \\ इति तिसृभिर् गायत्रीभिर् ब्राह्मणस्य /
text_mt: For a brāhmaṇa, [he places them] with three gāyatrī verses: 'Forward go your bright powers, full of oblation, with the butter-filled ladle; seeking favor, he approaches the gods. Towards you let my ladles go, butter-filled, delightful; Agni, enjoy our offerings! Upwards from that clarified butter shines your flame when offered, Agni, licking in the mouth of the ladle.'

sanskrit_iast: samidhāgniṃ duvasyata \\ ity eṣā / upa tvāgne haviṣmatīs \\ ghṛtācīr yantu haryata / \ juṣasva samidho mama / \ taṃ tvā samidbhir aṅgiras \ ghṛtena vardhayāmasi / \ bṛhac chocā yaviṣṭhya \\ iti vā /
meaning: समिधाग्निं दुवस्यत \\ इत्य् एषा / उप त्वाग्ने हविष्मतीस् \\ घृताचीर् यन्तु हर्यत / \ जुषस्व समिधो मम / \ तं त्वा समिद्भिर् अङ्गिरस् \ घृतेन वर्धयामसि / \ बृहच् छोचा यविष्ठ्य \\ इति वा /
text_mt: Or with this [verse]: 'Honor Agni with firewood...'; or with: 'Towards you, Agni, let the oblation-bearing, butter-filled [ladles] go, delightful; enjoy my firewood sticks! You as such, O Aṅgiras, do we magnify with firewood sticks, with clarified butter; blaze up greatly, O youngest one!'

sanskrit_iast: samidhyamānaḥ prathamo nu dharmaḥ \ sam aktubhir ajyate viśvavāraḥ / \ śociṣkeśo ghṛtanirṇik pāvakaḥ \ suyajño agnir yajathāya devān / \ ghṛtapratīko ghṛtayonir agnis \\ ghṛtaiḥ samiddho ghṛtam asyānnam / \ ghṛtapruṣas tvā sarito vahanti \ ghṛtaṃ piban suyajā yakṣi devān / \ āyurdā agne \\ iti triṣṭugbhī rājyayasya /
meaning: समिध्यमानः प्रथमो नु धर्मः \ सम् अक्तुभिर् अज्यते विश्ववारः / \ शोचिष्केशो घृतनिर्णिक् पावकः \ सुयज्ञो अग्निर् यजथाय देवान् / \ घृतप्रतीको घृतयोनिर् अग्निस् \\ घृतैः समिद्धो घृतम् अस्यान्नम् / \ घृतप्रुषस् त्वा सरितो वहन्ति \ घृतं पिबन् सुयजा यक्षि देवान् / \ आयुर्दा अग्ने \\ इति त्रिष्टुग्भी राज्ययस्य /
text_mt: "Now being kindled, the first law / is anointed with night's unguents, possessing all booys. / Hair of flame, robed in clarified butter, purifying, / Agni, well-sacrificing, [sacrifices] to the gods for the sacrifice. / Agni, whose face is clarified butter, whose womb is clarified butter, / kindled with portions of clarified butter, clarified butter is his food. / Streams scattering clarified butter carry you; / drinking clarified butter, sacrificing well, sacrifice to the gods! / Giver of life, O Agni..."—with [these] Triṣṭubh verses for a kṣatriya.

sanskrit_iast: tvām agne samidhānaṃ yaviṣṭha \ devā dūtaṃ cakrire havyavāham / \ urujrayasaṃ ghṛtayonim āhutam \\ tveṣaṃ cakṣur dadhire codayanvati / \ tvām agne pradiva āhutaṃ ghṛtena \ sumnāyavaḥ suṣamidhā samīdhīre / \ sa vāvṛdhāna oṣadhībhir ukṣitas \\ uru jrayām̐si pārthivā vitiṣṭhase / \ ghṛtapratīkaṃ va ṛtasya dhūrṣadam \ agniṃ mitraṃ na samidhāna ṛñjate / \ indhāno akro vidatheṣu dīdyat \\ śukravarṇām ud u no yam̐sate dhiyam iti jagatībhir vaiśyasya /
meaning: त्वाम् अग्ने समिधानं यविष्ठ \ देवा दूतं चक्रिरे हव्यवाहम् / \ उरुज्रयसं घृतयोनिम् आहुतम् \\ त्वेषं चक्षुर् दधिरे चोदयन्वति / \ त्वाम् अग्ने प्रदिव आहुतं घृतेन \ सुम्नायवः सुषमिधा समीधीरे / \ स वावृधान ओषधीभिर् उक्षितस् \\ उरु ज्रयाम्̐सि पार्थिवा वितिष्ठसे / \ घृतप्रतीकं व ऋतस्य धूर्षदम् \ अग्निं मित्रं न समिधान ऋञ्जते / \ इन्धानो अक्रो विदथेषु दीद्यत् \\ शुक्रवर्णाम् उद् उ नो यम्̐सते धियम् इति जगतीभिर् वैश्यस्य /
text_mt: "You, O Agni, when being kindled, O youngest one, / the gods have made their messenger, the oblations-bearer. / Wide-ranging, whose womb is clarified butter, who is offered to, / they have set up your dazzling eye in their instigation. / You, O Agni, offered to with clarified butter since ancient times, / seekers of favour have kindled with good firewood. / Growing mighty, sprinkled with plants, / you spread far across earthly spaces. / With face of clarified butter, seated at the yoke of cosmic order, / the kindled [priests] adorn Agni as a friend. / Kindled, steadfast, shining brightly in the assemblies, / may he lift up our bright-hued thought!"—with [these] Jagatī verses for a vaiśya.

sanskrit_iast: dhārayati brāhmaudanikam /
meaning: धारयति ब्राह्मौदनिकम् /
text_mt: He keeps the fire of the rice-for-the-priests burning.

sanskrit_iast: saṃvatsaram ṛtuṃ dvādaśāhaṃ caturahaṃ tryahaṃ dvyaham ekāhaṃ vā /
meaning: संवत्सरम् ऋतुं द्वादशाहं चतुरहं त्र्यहं द्व्यहम् एकाहं वा /
text_mt: [He keeps it burning] for a year, a season, twelve days, four days, three days, two days, or one day.

sanskrit_iast: prayātyanugate caivaṃ vihitaṃ brahmaudanaṃ paktvaitāḥ samidho 'bhyajyādadhyāt /
meaning: प्रयात्यनुगते चैवं विहितं ब्रह्मौदनं पक्त्वैताः समिधो ऽभ्यज्यादध्यात् /
text_mt: If it goes out while traveling, he should cook the rice-for-the-priests in the prescribed manner, anoint these pieces of firewood, and place them on [the fire].

sanskrit_iast: yady enam̐ saṃvatsare 'gnyādheyaṃ nopanamed evaṃ vihitaṃ brahmaudanaṃ paktvaitāḥ samidho 'bhyajyādhāya yadā śaknoty athādhatte /
meaning: यद्य् एनम्̐ संवत्सरे ऽग्न्याधेयं नोपनमेद् एवं विहितं ब्रह्मौदनं पक्त्वैताः समिधो ऽभ्यज्याधाय यदा शक्नोत्य् अथाधत्ते /
text_mt: If the setting up of the sacred fires does not happen for him within the year, having cooked the rice-for-the-priests in the prescribed manner and having anointed these pieces of firewood and laid them on, he sets up the fires whenever he is able.

sanskrit_iast: śva ādhāsyamāno brahmaudanaṃ pacati /
meaning: श्व आधास्यमानो ब्रह्मौदनं पचति /
text_mt: Intending to set up the fires on the morrow, he cooks the rice-for-the-priests.

sanskrit_iast: nānṛtaṃ vadati na mām̐sam aśnāti na striyam upaiti / prajā agne saṃvāsaya \\ āśāś ca paśubhiḥ saha / \ rāṣṭrāṇy asmā ādhehi \ yāny āsan savituḥ save \\ iti gārhapatyāyatane kalmāṣam ajaṃ badhnāti śilpair etām̐ rātriṃ yajamānaṃ jāgarayanti //
meaning: नानृतं वदति न माम्̐सम् अश्नाति न स्त्रियम् उपैति / प्रजा अग्ने संवासय \\ आशाश् च पशुभिः सह / \ राष्ट्राण्य् अस्मा आधेहि \ यान्य् आसन् सवितुः सवे \\ इति गार्हपत्यायतने कल्माषम् अजं बध्नाति शिल्पैर् एताम्̐ रात्रिं यजमानं जागरयन्ति //
text_mt: He speaks no untruth, eats no meat, and does not approach a woman. With: "Settle the offspring together, O Agni, / and the quarters together with the beasts; / confer on him kingdoms / that were in the impulse of Savitṛ!", he binds a spotted he-goat in the gārhapatya fireplace. They keep the sacrificer awake throughout that night with artistic performances.

sanskrit_iast: tataḥ saṃbhārān āharati vaiśvānarasya rūpam ity etair yathārūpam /
meaning: ततः संभारान् आहरति वैश्वानरस्य रूपम् इत्य् एतैर् यथारूपम् /
text_mt: Then he brings the ritual materials, according to their form, with the verses beginning: "The form of Vaiśvānara..."

sanskrit_iast: jātavedo bhuvanasya retas \\ iha siñca tapaso yaj janiṣyate / \ agnim aśvatthād adhi havyavāham \\ śamīgarbhāj janayan yo mayobhūḥ / \ ayaṃ te yonir ṛtviyas \\ iti dvābhyāṃ brāhmaudanika upavyuṣam araṇī niṣṭapati /
meaning: जातवेदो भुवनस्य रेतस् \\ इह सिञ्च तपसो यज् जनिष्यते / \ अग्निम् अश्वत्थाद् अधि हव्यवाहम् \\ शमीगर्भाज् जनयन् यो मयोभूः / \ अयं ते योनिर् ऋत्वियस् \\ इति द्वाभ्यां ब्राह्मौदनिक उपव्युषम् अरणी निष्टपति /
text_mt: With the two [verses]: "O Jātavedas, the seed of the world, / pour here what will be born from heat: / bringing Agni, the bearer of oblations, / from the aśvattha tree born of the womb of the śamī, he who brings joy... / This is your seasonal womb...", he heats the two churning-sticks over the fire of the rice-for-the-priests toward daybreak.

sanskrit_iast: dohyā ca te dugdhabhṛc corvarī \ te te bhāgadheyaṃ prayacchāmi \ tābhyāṃ tvādadhe \\ ity araṇī yajamānāya prayacchati /
meaning: दोह्या च ते दुग्धभृच् चोर्वरी \ ते ते भागधेयं प्रयच्छामि \ ताभ्यां त्वादधे \\ इत्य् अरणी यजमानाय प्रयच्छति /
text_mt: With: "You are the milk-giver and the bearer of milk, you are fertile ground; / to you two I offer your portion; / with them I set you up!", he hands the two churning-sticks to the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast: agnī rakṣām̐si sedhati \ śukraśocir amartyaḥ / \ śuciḥ pāvaka īḍyas \\ ity abhimantryānugamayati brāhmaudanikam /
meaning: अग्नी रक्षाम्̐सि सेधति \ शुक्रशोचिर् अमर्त्यः / \ शुचिः पावक ईड्यस् \\ इत्य् अभिमन्त्र्यानुगमयति ब्राह्मौदनिकम् /
text_mt: Having addressed [it] with: "Agni drives away the demons, / bright-flaming, immortal, / pure, purifying, worthy of praise!", he lets the fire of the rice-for-the-priests go out.

sanskrit_iast: prācīnaṃ brāhmaudanikād gārhapatyāyatanam uddhanti /
meaning: प्राचीनं ब्राह्मौदनिकाद् गार्हपत्यायतनम् उद्धन्ति /
text_mt: He digs up the gārhapatya fireplace to the east of the fire of the rice-for-the-priests.

sanskrit_iast: uddhanyamānam asyā amedhyam \ apa pāpmānaṃ yajamānasya hantu / \ śivā naḥ santu pradiśaś catasraḥ \ śaṃ no mātā pṛthivī tokasātā \\ iti /
meaning: उद्धन्यमानम् अस्या अमेध्यम् \ अप पाप्मानं यजमानस्य हन्तु / \ शिवा नः सन्तु प्रदिशश् चतस्रः \ शं नो माता पृथिवी तोकसाता \\ इति /
text_mt: With: "May the unholy part of this earth being dug up / strike down the evil of the sacrificer; / may the four quarters be auspicious to us, / and Mother Earth bring peace to us in the winning of children!"

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇataḥ purastād vitṛtīyadeśe nedīyāsi gārhapatyasya dakṣiṇāgner āyatanam /
meaning: दक्षिणतः पुरस्ताद् वितृतीयदेशे नेदीयासि गार्हपत्यस्य दक्षिणाग्नेर् आयतनम् /
text_mt: To the south, in front [thereof], nearer in the southeast region, is the fireplace of the dakṣiṇāgni fire.

sanskrit_iast: prācīnaṃ gārhapatyāyatanād āhavanīyāyatanam uddhanti bāhyata itarayoḥ /
meaning: प्राचीनं गार्हपत्यायतनाद् आहवनीयायतनम् उद्धन्ति बाह्यत इतरयोः /
text_mt: He digs up the āhavanīya fireplace to the east of the gārhapatya fireplace, outside the other two.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśasu vikrāmeṣv agnim ādadhītety aviśeṣeṇa śrūyate /
meaning: द्वादशसु विक्रामेष्व् अग्निम् आदधीतेत्य् अविशेषेण श्रूयते /
text_mt: "He should set up the fire at twelve strides", it is heard in general.

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭāsu brāhmaṇasyaikādaśasu rājanyasya dvādaśasu vaiśyasya /
meaning: अष्टासु ब्राह्मणस्यैकादशसु राजन्यस्य द्वादशसु वैश्यस्य /
text_mt: At eight for a brāhmaṇa, at eleven for a kṣatriya, at twelve for a vaiśya.

sanskrit_iast: caturvim̐śatir aparimitaṃ ca sādhāraṇe /
meaning: चतुर्विम्̐शतिर् अपरिमितं च साधारणे /
text_mt: Twenty-four and unmeasured are common to all.

sanskrit_iast: cakṣuṣā prakramān pramimīteti vijñāyate /
meaning: चक्षुषा प्रक्रमान् प्रमिमीतेति विज्ञायते /
text_mt: "One measures the strides with the eye", it is known [from the Brāhmaṇa].

sanskrit_iast: prācīnam āhavanīyāt sabhā tatra sabhyasya prācīnam āvasathaḥ sabhāyās tatrāvasathyasya /
meaning: प्राचीनम् आहवनीयात् सभा तत्र सभ्यस्य प्राचीनम् आवसथः सभायास् तत्रावसथ्यस्य /
text_mt: To the east of the āhavanīya fire is the hall; there is [the fireplace] of the sabhya fire. To the east of the hall is the guest-house; there is [the fireplace] of the āvasathya fire.

sanskrit_iast: evam anupūrvāṇy eṣāṃ karmāṇi kriyante /
meaning: एवम् अनुपूर्वाण्य् एषां कर्माणि क्रियन्ते /
text_mt: Their rites are performed in this sequence.

sanskrit_iast: śaṃ no devīr abhiṣṭaye \\ āpo bhavantu pītaye / \ śaṃ yor abhisravantu nas \\ ity adbhir avokṣati /
meaning: शं नो देवीर् अभिष्टये \\ आपो भवन्तु पीतये / \ शं योर् अभिस्रवन्तु नस् \\ इत्य् अद्भिर् अवोक्षति /
text_mt: With: "May the divine Waters be for our help, / and for drinking; / may they stream forth peace and blessing upon us!", he sprinkles with water.

sanskrit_iast: ud vayaṃ tamasas pari \\ ud u tyam \\ citram ity atra kharahomān eke samāmananti //
meaning: उद् वयं तमसस् परि \\ उद् उ त्यम् \\ चित्रम् इत्य् अत्र खरहोमान् एके समामनन्ति //
text_mt: With: "Up from darkness...", "Up that...", and "The bright...", some hand down the offerings on the mound at this point.

sanskrit_iast: upakḷptāḥ saṃbhārāḥ pañca pārthivāḥ sapta vā /
meaning: उपकॢप्ताः संभाराः पञ्च पार्थिवाः सप्त वा /
text_mt: The ritual materials have been prepared: five or seven derived from the earth,

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ vānaspatyāḥ /
meaning: एवं वानस्पत्याः /

sanskrit_iast: teṣām ekaikaṃ dvaidhaṃ vibhajya /
meaning: तेषाम् एकैकं द्वैधं विभज्य /
text_mt: Having divided each one of them into two parts,

sanskrit_iast: gārhapatyadakṣiṇāgnyor nivapati /
meaning: गार्हपत्यदक्षिणाग्न्योर् निवपति /
text_mt: he scatters them in the gārhapatya and dakṣiṇāgni fireplaces.

sanskrit_iast: ardhām̐s traidhaṃ kṛtvā pūrveṣu /
meaning: अर्धाम्̐स् त्रैधं कृत्वा पूर्वेषु /
text_mt: Having divided the [remaining] halves into three, [he scatters them] in the eastern fires.

sanskrit_iast: agner bhasmāsi \\ iti sikatā nivapati /
meaning: अग्नेर् भस्मासि \\ इति सिकता निवपति /
text_mt: With: "You are the ashes of Agni!", he scatters sand.

sanskrit_iast: saṃjñānam asi kāmadharaṇam ity ūṣān /
meaning: संज्ञानम् असि कामधरणम् इत्य् ऊषान् /
text_mt: With: "You are agreement, the container of desire!", [he scatters] saline soil.

sanskrit_iast: tān nivapan yad adaś candramasi kṛṣṇaṃ tad ihāstu \\ iti manasā dhyāyati /
meaning: तान् निवपन् यद् अदश् चन्द्रमसि कृष्णं तद् इहास्तु \\ इति मनसा ध्यायति /
text_mt: Scattering them, he contemplates mentally: "May that black spot which is in the moon be here!"

sanskrit_iast: udehy agne adhi mātuḥ pṛthivyās \\ viśa āviśa mahataḥ sadhasthāt / \ āśuṃ tvā yo dadhire devayantas \\ havyavāhaṃ bhuvanasya gopām ity ākhūtkaram /
meaning: उदेह्य् अग्ने अधि मातुः पृथिव्यास् \\ विश आविश महतः सधस्थात् / \ आशुं त्वा यो दधिरे देवयन्तस् \\ हव्यवाहं भुवनस्य गोपाम् इत्य् आखूत्करम् /
text_mt: With: "Rise up, O Agni, from Mother Earth; / enter the peoples from the great dwelling-place; / they who seek the gods have appointed you, swift, / the bearer of oblations, the guardian of the world!", [he scatters] earth from a mole-hill.

sanskrit_iast: yat pṛthivyā anāmṛtam \\ saṃbabhūva tve sacā / \ tad agnir agnaye 'dadāt \ tasminn ādhīyatām ayam iti gārhapatyāyatane valmīkavapāṃ nidadhāti /
meaning: यत् पृथिव्या अनामृतम् \\ संबभूव त्वे सचा / \ तद् अग्निर् अग्नये ऽददात् \ तस्मिन्न् आधीयताम् अयम् इति गार्हपत्यायतने वल्मीकवपां निदधाति /
text_mt: With: "What of the earth is immortal, / which came into being along with you, / that Agni gave to Agni; / upon that let this one be set up!", he places the core of an anthill in the gārhapatya fireplace.

sanskrit_iast: yad antarikṣasyānāmṛtam iti dakṣiṇāgnes \\ yad divo 'nāmṛtam ity āhavanīyasya /
meaning: यद् अन्तरिक्षस्यानामृतम् इति दक्षिणाग्नेस् \\ यद् दिवो ऽनामृतम् इत्य् आहवनीयस्य /
text_mt: With: "What of the intermediate space is immortal...", in the fireplace of the dakṣiṇāgni; with: "What of heaven is immortal...", in that of the āhavanīya.

sanskrit_iast: tūṣṇīm itarayoḥ /
meaning: तूष्णीम् इतरयोः /

sanskrit_iast: ut samudrān madhumām̐ ūrmir āgāt \ sāmrājyāya pratarāṃ dadhānāḥ / \ amī ca ye maghavāno vayaṃ ca \\ iṣam ūrjaṃ madhumat saṃbharema \\ iti sūdam /
meaning: उत् समुद्रान् मधुमाम्̐ ऊर्मिर् आगात् \ साम्राज्याय प्रतरां दधानाः / \ अमी च ये मघवानो वयं च \\ इषम् ऊर्जं मधुमत् संभरेम \\ इति सूदम् /
text_mt: With: "The sweet wave has come up from the ocean, / giving further sovereignty; / both those patrons and we, / may we gather sweet sustenance and strength!", [he scatters earth from] a pool.

sanskrit_iast: iyaty agra āsīs \\ iti varāhavihatam /
meaning: इयत्य् अग्र आसीस् \\ इति वराहविहतम् /
text_mt: With: "So large you were at the beginning...", [he scatters earth] rooted up by a boar.

sanskrit_iast: ado devī prathamānā pṛthag yat \\ devair nyuptā vyasarpo mahitvā / \ adṛm̐hathāḥ śarkarābhis triviṣṭapi \\ ajayo lokān pradiśaś catasras \\ iti śarkarās tā nivapan yaṃ dveṣṭi tasya vadhaṃ manasā dhyāyati /
meaning: अदो देवी प्रथमाना पृथग् यत् \\ देवैर् न्युप्ता व्यसर्पो महित्वा / \ अदृम्̐हथाः शर्कराभिस् त्रिविष्टपि \\ अजयो लोकान् प्रदिशश् चतस्रस् \\ इति शर्करास् ता निवपन् यं द्वेष्टि तस्य वधं मनसा ध्यायति /
text_mt: With: "That goddess, spreading abroad severally when / scattered by the gods, you crept forth through greatness; / you became firm with gravel in the third realm of heaven; / you conquered the worlds, the four quarters!", [he scatters] pebbles. Scattering them, he contemplates in his mind the slaying of the one whom he hates.

sanskrit_iast: lauhāny audumbarāṇi pārthivānāṃ vikalpārthāni bhavanti /
meaning: लौहान्य् औदुम्बराणि पार्थिवानां विकल्पार्थानि भवन्ति /
text_mt: Articles of iron and udumbara wood serve as alternatives for those derived from the earth.

sanskrit_iast: yās te śivās tanuvo jātavedas \\ yā antarikṣa uta pārthivīr yāḥ / \ tābhiḥ saṃbhūya sagaṇaḥ sajoṣās \\ hiraṇyayonir vaha havyam agne \\ ity uttarataḥ saṃbhārāṇām̐ suvarṇam̐ hiraṇyam upāsyati /
meaning: यास् ते शिवास् तनुवो जातवेदस् \\ या अन्तरिक्ष उत पार्थिवीर् याः / \ ताभिः संभूय सगणः सजोषास् \\ हिरण्ययोनिर् वह हव्यम् अग्ने \\ इत्य् उत्तरतः संभाराणाम्̐ सुवर्णम्̐ हिरण्यम् उपास्यति /
text_mt: With: "Those auspicious bodies of yours, O Jātavedas, / which are in the intermediate space and which are earthly, / uniting with them, along with your troop, like-minded, / you whose womb is gold, bear the oblation, O Agni!", he throws gold to the north of the ritual materials.

sanskrit_iast: atiprayacchati rajataṃ dveṣyāya yadi dveṣyaṃ na vinden nirasyen nopāsya punar ādadīta //
meaning: अतिप्रयच्छति रजतं द्वेष्याय यदि द्वेष्यं न विन्देन् निरस्येन् नोपास्य पुनर् आददीत //
text_mt: He gives away silver to one whom he hates. If he cannot find one whom he hates, he should cast it away; he should not pick it up again having thrown it.

sanskrit_iast: candram agniṃ candraratham̐ harivrataṃ \ vaiśvānaram apsuṣadam̐ suvarvidam / \ vigāhaṃ tūrṇiṃ taviṣībhir āvṛtam \\ bhūrṇiṃ devāsa iha suśriyaṃ dadhus \\ ity upāstam anumantaraye /
meaning: चन्द्रम् अग्निं चन्द्ररथम्̐ हरिव्रतं \ वैश्वानरम् अप्सुषदम्̐ सुवर्विदम् / \ विगाहं तूर्णिं तविषीभिर् आवृतम् \\ भूर्णिं देवास इह सुश्रियं दधुस् \\ इत्य् उपास्तम् अनुमन्तरये /
text_mt: He should follow the thrown [gold] with the mantra: "The bright Agni, with a gleaming chariot, whose vow is tawny, / Vaiśvānara, dwelling in the waters, finding the sun, / diving deep, swift, covered with powers, / active, the gods have set up here as the giver of splendid prosperity."

sanskrit_iast: puṣkaraparṇa udumbaraḥ śamī vikaṅkato 'śvattho 'śanihato vṛkṣaḥ palāśaś ca /
meaning: पुष्करपर्ण उदुम्बरः शमी विकङ्कतो ऽश्वत्थो ऽशनिहतो वृक्षः पलाशश् च /
text_mt: A lotus leaf, an udumbara tree, a śamī tree, a vikaṅkata tree, an aśvattha tree, a tree struck by lightning, and a palāśa tree [are the tree materials].
