text_mt: With the offering ladle, he causes the fire to leap three times northward with: 'O Rudra, be gracious! O non-Ṛbhu, be gracious! O mischievous one, be gracious! Homage be to thee, O Paśupati; do not injure me!'

sanskrit_iast: srucaṃ nidhāya lepam ādāya /
meaning: स्रुचं निधाय लेपम् आदाय /
text_mt: Having set down the offering ladle and taken the residue,

sanskrit_iast: apa upaspṛśya /
meaning: अप उपस्पृश्य /

sanskrit_iast: pūṣāsi \\ iti dvir aṅgulyā prāśyācamya punaḥ prāśnāti /
meaning: पूषासि \\ इति द्विर् अङ्गुल्या प्राश्याचम्य पुनः प्राश्नाति /
text_mt: having consumed twice with his finger with 'Thou art Pūṣan!' and having sipped water, he consumes again.

sanskrit_iast: srucaṃ darbhām̐ś cādāyodaṅṅ utsṛpya /
meaning: स्रुचं दर्भाम्̐श् चादायोदङ्ङ् उत्सृप्य /
text_mt: Having taken the offering ladle and darbha blades, having glided northwards,

sanskrit_iast: āgneyam̐ retaḥ prajananaṃ me astu \ daśavīram̐ sarvagaṇam̐ svastaye / \ ātmasani prajāsani paśusani \\ abhayasani lokasani vṛṣṭisani / \ agniḥ prajāṃ bahulāṃ me karotu \\ annaṃ payo reto asmāsu dhatta / \ rāyaspoṣam iṣam ūrjam asmāsu dīdharat \\ iti //
meaning: आग्नेयम्̐ रेतः प्रजननं मे अस्तु \ दशवीरम्̐ सर्वगणम्̐ स्वस्तये / \ आत्मसनि प्रजासनि पशुसनि \\ अभयसनि लोकसनि वृष्टिसनि / \ अग्निः प्रजां बहुलां मे करोतु \\ अन्नं पयो रेतो अस्मासु धत्त / \ रायस्पोषम् इषम् ऊर्जम् अस्मासु दीधरत् \\ इति //
text_mt: [he recites:] 'May the fiery seed of Agni be procreation for me, / with ten heroes, with a whole troop, for well-being! / Winner of self, winner of offspring, winner of cattle, / winner of fearlessness, winner of the world, winner of rain! / May Agni make my offspring abundant; / place food, milk, seed in us! / May he uphold abundance of wealth, food, and strength in us!'

sanskrit_iast: prāgdaṇḍayodagdaṇḍayā vā srucā dvir ācāmati dviś ca nirleḍhi /
meaning: प्राग्दण्डयोदग्दण्डया वा स्रुचा द्विर् आचामति द्विश् च निर्लेढि /
text_mt: With the offering ladle whose handle is turned eastwards or northwards, he sips twice and licks twice.

sanskrit_iast: garbhebhyas tvā \ garbhān prīṇīhi \\ iti vā /
meaning: गर्भेभ्यस् त्वा \ गर्भान् प्रीणीहि \\ इति वा /
text_mt: Or with: 'Thee for the embryos!' [and] 'Gratify the embryos!'

sanskrit_iast: sauryam̐ retaḥ prajananaṃ me astu \\ iti prātaḥ /
meaning: सौर्यम्̐ रेतः प्रजननं मे अस्तु \\ इति प्रातः /
text_mt: In the morning, [he recites:] 'May the solar seed be procreation for me!'

sanskrit_iast: srucam adbhiḥ pūrayitvā sarpebhyas tvā \ sarpāñ jinva \\ iti vidhukṣati /
meaning: स्रुचम् अद्भिः पूरयित्वा सर्पेभ्यस् त्वा \ सर्पाञ् जिन्व \\ इति विधुक्षति /
text_mt: Having filled the offering ladle with water, he shakes it out with: 'Thee for the serpents!' [and] 'Quicken the serpents!'

sanskrit_iast: ācamya /
meaning: आचम्य /

sanskrit_iast: srucaṃ darbhaiḥ prakṣālya /
meaning: स्रुचं दर्भैः प्रक्षाल्य /
text_mt: having washed the offering ladle with darbha blades,

sanskrit_iast: pūrayitvā sarpān pipīlikāñ jinva \\ ity apa utsiñcati /
meaning: पूरयित्वा सर्पान् पिपीलिकाञ् जिन्व \\ इत्य् अप उत्सिञ्चति /
text_mt: having filled it, he pours out water with: 'Quicken the serpents and the ants!'

sanskrit_iast: sarpadevajanāñ jinva \\ iti dvitīyāṃ bhūtebhyas tvā \\ iti tṛtīyāṃ mahate devāya \\ iti caturthīm /
meaning: सर्पदेवजनाञ् जिन्व \\ इति द्वितीयां भूतेभ्यस् त्वा \\ इति तृतीयां महते देवाय \\ इति चतुर्थीम् /
text_mt: [He pours out] a second [portion of water] with 'Quicken the divine folk of the serpents!', a third with 'Thee for the beings!', [and] a fourth with 'For the great god!'

sanskrit_iast: srucam adbhiḥ pūrayitvā pṛthivyām amṛtaṃ juhomi svāhā \\ ity apareṇāhavanīyam apareṇa vā gārhapatyaṃ ninayati /
meaning: स्रुचम् अद्भिः पूरयित्वा पृथिव्याम् अमृतं जुहोमि स्वाहा \\ इत्य् अपरेणाहवनीयम् अपरेण वा गार्हपत्यं निनयति /
text_mt: Having filled the offering ladle with water, he pours it out behind the āhavanīya fire or behind the gārhapatya fire with: 'I offer immortality upon the earth, svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: gṛhebhyas tvā \ gṛhān prīṇīhi \\ iti tasyaikadeśam añjalau patnyaḥ /
meaning: गृहेभ्यस् त्वा \ गृहान् प्रीणीहि \\ इति तस्यैकदेशम् अञ्जलौ पत्न्यः /
text_mt: With 'Thee for the houses!' [and] 'Gratify the houses!' [he pours] a portion of it into the folded hands of the sacrificer's wife.

sanskrit_iast: patnī yadi nānvāste sarvaṃ pṛthivyām /
meaning: पत्नी यदि नान्वास्ते सर्वं पृथिव्याम् /
text_mt: If the sacrificer's wife is not sitting nearby, [he pours] all of it upon the earth.

sanskrit_iast: hastaṃ pratāpya srucy avadadhāti srucaṃ vā niṣṭapya haste 'vadadhāti saptarṣibhyas tvā \ saptarṣīñ jinva \\ iti srucodag uddiśati /
meaning: हस्तं प्रताप्य स्रुच्य् अवदधाति स्रुचं वा निष्टप्य हस्ते ऽवदधाति सप्तर्षिभ्यस् त्वा \ सप्तर्षीञ् जिन्व \\ इति स्रुचोदग् उद्दिशति /
text_mt: Having heated his hand, he places it on the offering ladle, or having heated the offering ladle, he places it on his hand, and points northward with the offering ladle with: 'Thee for the Seven Ṛṣis!' [and] 'Quicken the Seven Ṛṣis!'

sanskrit_iast: srucaṃ nidhāya pratyetya sruveṇa gārhapatyadakṣiṇāgnyor juhoti pratyāhuti samidho 'bhyādhāya /
meaning: स्रुचं निधाय प्रत्येत्य स्रुवेण गार्हपत्यदक्षिणाग्न्योर् जुहोति प्रत्याहुति समिधो ऽभ्याधाय /
text_mt: Having put down the offering ladle, having returned, he offers with the dipping ladle into the gārhapatya and dakṣiṇāgni fires, having put on a firewood stick for each oblation.

sanskrit_iast: mayi puṣṭiṃ puṣṭipatir dadhātu \ rāyaspoṣam iṣam ūrjam asmāsu dīdharat / \ agnaye gṛhapataye rayipataye paśupataye puṣṭipataye kāmāyānnādyāya svāhā \\ iti dve gārhapatye juhoti /
meaning: मयि पुष्टिं पुष्टिपतिर् दधातु \ रायस्पोषम् इषम् ऊर्जम् अस्मासु दीधरत् / \ अग्नये गृहपतये रयिपतये पशुपतये पुष्टिपतये कामायान्नाद्याय स्वाहा \\ इति द्वे गार्हपत्ये जुहोति /
text_mt: He offers two oblations in the gārhapatya fire with: 'May the lord of nourishment place nourishment in me! / May he uphold abundance of wealth, food, and strength in us! / For Agni, the lord of the house, lord of wealth, lord of cattle, lord of nourishment, for desire, for the eating of food, svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: annapate 'nnasya no dehi \\ iti dve dakṣiṇāgnau /
meaning: अन्नपते ऽन्नस्य नो देहि \\ इति द्वे दक्षिणाग्नौ /
text_mt: [He offers] two in the dakṣiṇāgni fire with: 'O lord of food, give us of food!'

sanskrit_iast: api vā catasro gārhapatye juhuyāc catasro dakṣiṇāgnau /
meaning: अपि वा चतस्रो गार्हपत्ये जुहुयाच् चतस्रो दक्षिणाग्नौ /
text_mt: Or he may offer four in the gārhapatya fire and four in the dakṣiṇāgni fire.

sanskrit_iast: na vā juhuyāt /
meaning: न वा जुहुयात् /

sanskrit_iast: piprer agniḥ svāṃ tanuvam \ ayāḍ dyāvāpṛthivī \ ūrjam asmāsu dhehi iti sthālyāṃ tṛṇam aṅktvāhavanīye 'nupraharati na vā /
meaning: पिप्रेर् अग्निः स्वां तनुवम् \ अयाड् द्यावापृथिवी \ ऊर्जम् अस्मासु धेहि इति स्थाल्यां तृणम् अङ्क्त्वाहवनीये ऽनुप्रहरति न वा /
text_mt: Having anointed a blade of grass in the pot with: 'Agni has pleased his own body; he has sacrificed to Heaven and Earth; place strength in us!', he throws it into the āhavanīya fire, or he does not.

sanskrit_iast: dyāvāpṛthivībhyāṃ tvā \ dyāvāpṛthivī jinva \\ ity antarvedyām̐ saṃkṣālanaṃ ninayati /
meaning: द्यावापृथिवीभ्यां त्वा \ द्यावापृथिवी जिन्व \\ इत्य् अन्तर्वेद्याम्̐ संक्षालनं निनयति /
text_mt: With the mantra: 'For Heaven and Earth thee; gratify Heaven and Earth,' he pours the wash-water inside the altar.

sanskrit_iast: pariṣiñcati yathā purastāt /
meaning: परिषिञ्चति यथा पुरस्तात् /
text_mt: He sprinkles water around as before.

sanskrit_iast: dīdihi \ dīdyāsaṃ \ dīdidāsi \\ ity upasamindhe /
meaning: दीदिहि \ दीद्यासं \ दीदिदासि \\ इत्य् उपसमिन्धे /
text_mt: With the mantras, 'Shine forth,' 'May I shine,' 'You shine,' he fuels [the fire].

sanskrit_iast: ājyena juhuyāt tejaskāmasya payasā paśukāmasya dadhnendriyakāmasya taṇḍulair ojaskāmasya yavāgvā grāmakāmasyaudanenānnādyakāmasya mām̐sena vīryakāmasya somena brahmavarcasakāmasya /
meaning: आज्येन जुहुयात् तेजस्कामस्य पयसा पशुकामस्य दध्नेन्द्रियकामस्य तण्डुलैर् ओजस्कामस्य यवाग्वा ग्रामकामस्यौदनेनान्नाद्यकामस्य माम्̐सेन वीर्यकामस्य सोमेन ब्रह्मवर्चसकामस्य /
text_mt: He should offer with clarified butter for one desiring splendor, with milk for one desiring cattle, with curd for one desiring sensory power, with husked grains for one desiring vigor, with barley gruel for one desiring a village, with boiled rice for one desiring food and nourishment, with meat for one desiring valor, [and] with soma for one desiring spiritual luster.

sanskrit_iast: yad anyad adhiśrayaṇāt pratiṣecanāc ca tad dadhnas taṇḍulānām̐ somasya ca kriyate /
meaning: यद् अन्यद् अधिश्रयणात् प्रतिषेचनाच् च तद् दध्नस् तण्डुलानाम्̐ सोमस्य च क्रियते /
text_mt: Whatever [rule applies to the ritual] other than placing upon the fire and pouring water around is performed for curd, for husked grains, and for soma.

sanskrit_iast: apāṃ pratyasanakāle darbhatṛṇābhyām ājyaṃ pratyasyet pratiṣekaṃ yavāgūm̐ śrapayati / yathā yavāgūm evaṃ mām̐sam /
meaning: अपां प्रत्यसनकाले दर्भतृणाभ्याम् आज्यं प्रत्यस्येत् प्रतिषेकं यवागूम्̐ श्रपयति / यथा यवागूम् एवं माम्̐सम् /
text_mt: At the time of throwing in water, he should throw in clarified butter with two blades of darbha grass; he cooks the barley gruel [by] pouring [water around]. Meat is prepared in the same manner as barley gruel.

sanskrit_iast: parvaṇi rājanyasyāgnihotraṃ juhuyān nāntarāle /
meaning: पर्वणि राजन्यस्याग्निहोत्रं जुहुयान् नान्तराले /
text_mt: For a kṣatriya, he should offer the Agnihotra on the transition days (parvan), not in the interval.

sanskrit_iast: yat tv asya gṛhe 'nnaṃ kriyate tasmād brāhmaṇāya mukhato haranti tad dhutam asyāgnihotraṃ bhavati ya ṛtam̐ satyam iva vadann ījānaḥ somena syāt tasya sadāgnihotraṃ juhuyāt //
meaning: यत् त्व् अस्य गृहे ऽन्नं क्रियते तस्माद् ब्राह्मणाय मुखतो हरन्ति तद् धुतम् अस्याग्निहोत्रं भवति य ऋतम्̐ सत्यम् इव वदन्न् ईजानः सोमेन स्यात् तस्य सदाग्निहोत्रं जुहुयात् //
text_mt: However, whatever food is prepared in his house, from that they take first of all for a brāhmaṇa: that becomes his offered Agnihotra. If one who has sacrificed with soma should be speaking the truth as if it were cosmic order, for him he should offer the Agnihotra constantly.

sanskrit_iast: ṛte gṛhasya pravāsaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ /
meaning: ऋते गृहस्य प्रवासं व्याख्यास्यामः /
text_mt: We shall explain the journey away from home without the household [fires].

sanskrit_iast: sagṛhastu prayāsyan yatra pañca nava daśa vā sam̐hitā vasati yatra vā navarātraṃ vāstu punar abhyety ekāṃ vasati tatra vāstoṣpatīyaṃ juhoti /
meaning: सगृहस्तु प्रयास्यन् यत्र पञ्च नव दश वा सम्̐हिता वसति यत्र वा नवरात्रं वास्तु पुनर् अभ्येत्य् एकां वसति तत्र वास्तोष्पतीयं जुहोति /
text_mt: When, however, intending to set out with his household, he stays where five, nine, or ten [days] have passed together, or where he returns to a dwelling place for nine nights and stays for one night, there he offers the Vāstoṣpatīya offering.

sanskrit_iast: sarvaṃ bhāṇḍaṃ yāneṣv ādadhāti /
meaning: सर्वं भाण्डं यानेष्व् आदधाति /
text_mt: He places all the household utensils onto the conveyances.

sanskrit_iast: yad anyaj jihīrṣanti pūrvaṃ tat pravahanti /
meaning: यद् अन्यज् जिहीर्षन्ति पूर्वं तत् प्रवहन्ति /
text_mt: Whatever else they wish to transport, they convey that forward first.

sanskrit_iast: ahute vāpoddharanti tasmād deśāt /
meaning: अहुते वापोद्धरन्ति तस्माद् देशात् /
text_mt: Or before the offering is made, they remove [it] from that place.

sanskrit_iast: sarveṣu yukteṣu dakṣiṇo 'gniṣṭhasya yukto bhavati savyasya yoktraṃ parihṛtam anūtsaktam atha vāstoṣpatīyam anudruyottarayā juhoti /
meaning: सर्वेषु युक्तेषु दक्षिणो ऽग्निष्ठस्य युक्तो भवति सव्यस्य योक्त्रं परिहृतम् अनूत्सक्तम् अथ वास्तोष्पतीयम् अनुद्रुयोत्तरया जुहोति /
text_mt: When all [draught-animals] are yoked, the right [animal] of the pole-cart is yoked, the yoking-strap of the left [animal] is passed around and hooked on, then having recited the Vāstoṣpatīya hymn, he offers with the following [verse].

sanskrit_iast: na hute 'bhyādadhāti /
meaning: न हुते ऽभ्यादधाति /

sanskrit_iast: nāvakṣāṇāny asaṃprakṣāpya prayāti /
meaning: नावक्षाणान्य् असंप्रक्षाप्य प्रयाति /
text_mt: He does not depart without extinguishing the embers.

sanskrit_iast: ayaṃ te yonir ṛtviyas \\ iti pṛthagaraṇīṣv agnīn samāropya prayāti /
meaning: अयं ते योनिर् ऋत्वियस् \\ इति पृथगरणीष्व् अग्नीन् समारोप्य प्रयाति /
text_mt: With the mantra, 'This is your seasonal womb,' having caused the fires to mount into the kindling sticks separately, he departs.

sanskrit_iast: atho khalv āhur yad araṇyoḥ samārūḍho naśyed ud asyāgniḥ sīdet punarādheyaḥ syād iti yā te agne yajñiyā tanūs tayehi \\ ārohātmātmānam \ acchā vasūni kṛṇvann asme naryā purūṇi / \ yajño bhūtvā yajñam āsīda svāṃ yoniṃ jātavedo bhuva ājāyamānaḥ sakṣaya ehi \\ ity ātman samāropya prayāti /
meaning: अथो खल्व् आहुर् यद् अरण्योः समारूढो नश्येद् उद् अस्याग्निः सीदेत् पुनराधेयः स्याद् इति या ते अग्ने यज्ञिया तनूस् तयेहि \\ आरोहात्मात्मानम् \ अच्छा वसूनि कृण्वन्न् अस्मे नर्या पुरूणि / \ यज्ञो भूत्वा यज्ञम् आसीद स्वां योनिं जातवेदो भुव आजायमानः सक्षय एहि \\ इत्य् आत्मन् समारोप्य प्रयाति /
text_mt: Now they indeed say: if [the fire] mounted into the kindling sticks should be lost, his fire would perish and would have to be re-established. [Therefore,] having caused [the fire] to mount into himself with the mantra, 'O Agni, with that body of yours which is worthy of sacrifice, come hither, ascend into myself! Providing for us plentiful human goods, becoming sacrifice, sit on the sacrifice, into your own womb, O Jātavedas, being born of the earth, come with your dwelling!', he departs.

sanskrit_iast: yatra vasati tatra prāg astamayān manthati /
meaning: यत्र वसति तत्र प्राग् अस्तमयान् मन्थति /
text_mt: Wherever he stays, there he churns [the fire] before sunset.

sanskrit_iast: upāvaroha jātavedaḥ punas tvam \\ devebhyo havyaṃ vahataḥ prajānan / \ āyuḥ prajām̐ rayim asmāsu dhehi \\ ajasro dīdihi no duroṇe \\ ity ātman samārūḍham araṇyor upāvarohya manthati /
meaning: उपावरोह जातवेदः पुनस् त्वम् \\ देवेभ्यो हव्यं वहतः प्रजानन् / \ आयुः प्रजाम्̐ रयिम् अस्मासु धेहि \\ अजस्रो दीदिहि नो दुरोणे \\ इत्य् आत्मन् समारूढम् अरण्योर् उपावरोह्य मन्थति /
text_mt: With the mantra, 'Descend again, O Jātavedas, knowingly conveying the offering to the gods; bestow upon us life, offspring, [and] wealth; shine unceasingly in our dwelling,' having brought down into the kindling sticks [the fire] that had mounted into himself, he churns.

sanskrit_iast: laukikaṃ vāgnim āhṛtya tasminn upāvarohayate /
meaning: लौकिकं वाग्निम् आहृत्य तस्मिन्न् उपावरोहयते /
text_mt: Or having brought a worldly fire, he causes [the fire] to descend into it.

sanskrit_iast: idam̐ śreyo 'vasānaṃ yad agāt \ syono me dyāvāpṛthivī abhūtām / \ anamīvāḥ pradiśaḥ santu mahyam \\ gomad dhanavad aśvavad dhiraṇyavat puruṣavat suvīravat svāhā \\ ity avasite juhoti /
meaning: इदम्̐ श्रेयो ऽवसानं यद् अगात् \ स्योनो मे द्यावापृथिवी अभूताम् / \ अनमीवाः प्रदिशः सन्तु मह्यम् \\ गोमद् धनवद् अश्ववद् धिरण्यवत् पुरुषवत् सुवीरवत् स्वाहा \\ इत्य् अवसिते जुहोति /
text_mt: When he has settled down, he offers with the mantra, 'This better dwelling that has arrived; may heaven and earth be auspicious to me; may the quarters be free of disease for me, rich in cattle, rich in wealth, rich in horses, rich in gold, rich in men, rich in valiant heroes, svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: darvihomān vyākhyāsyāmaḥ /
meaning: दर्विहोमान् व्याख्यास्यामः /
text_mt: We shall explain ladle-offerings.

sanskrit_iast: juhotīti codyamāne darvihomo yatra ca svāhākāraḥ /
meaning: जुहोतीति चोद्यमाने दर्विहोमो यत्र च स्वाहाकारः /
text_mt: Where it is prescribed, 'He offers,' that is a ladle-offering, and also where there is the utterance 'svāhā'.

sanskrit_iast: tām̐s tūṣṇīkenājyena sakṛdgṛhītenāgreṇāhavanīyaṃ parītya dakṣiṇatas tiṣṭhañ juhvāhavanīye 'dhvaryuḥ svāhākāreṇa juhoti /
meaning: ताम्̐स् तूष्णीकेनाज्येन सकृद्गृहीतेनाग्रेणाहवनीयं परीत्य दक्षिणतस् तिष्ठञ् जुह्वाहवनीये ऽध्वर्युः स्वाहाकारेण जुहोति /
text_mt: With clarified butter taken once silently, having gone around in front of the āhavanīya fire and standing to the south, the adhvaryu offers in the āhavanīya fire with the juhū ladle, with the utterance 'svāhā'.

sanskrit_iast: dviprabhṛtyāhutigaṇeṣu pratyāhuti gṛhītvā pratyāhuti samidho 'bhyādhāya vigrāhaṃ juhoti /
meaning: द्विप्रभृत्याहुतिगणेषु प्रत्याहुति गृहीत्वा प्रत्याहुति समिधो ऽभ्याधाय विग्राहं जुहोति /
text_mt: In groups of offerings starting from two, having scooped [the butter] for each offering, and having placed on a piece of firewood for each offering, he offers separately.

sanskrit_iast: yatra mantragaṇena karma codayet pratimantraṃ tatra juhuyāt /
meaning: यत्र मन्त्रगणेन कर्म चोदयेत् प्रतिमन्त्रं तत्र जुहुयात् /
text_mt: Where a rite is prescribed with a group of mantras, he should offer there for each mantra.

sanskrit_iast: juhotiśabde pradeśān vyākhyāsyāmaḥ /
meaning: जुहोतिशब्दे प्रदेशान् व्याख्यास्यामः /
text_mt: We shall explain the locations [meant] by the word 'he offers'.

sanskrit_iast: svakṛta iriṇe pradare darbhastambe sthāṇāv iti //
meaning: स्वकृत इरिणे प्रदरे दर्भस्तम्बे स्थाणाव् इति //
text_mt: In a natural cleft, a fissure, a clump of darbha grass, [or] on a tree stump.

sanskrit_iast: āhavanīyāpanayo 'nagnau tasminn eva deśe juhoti /
meaning: आहवनीयापनयो ऽनग्नौ तस्मिन्न् एव देशे जुहोति /
text_mt: When the āhavanīya fire is removed, he offers in that very place [even] without fire.

sanskrit_iast: dārśapaurṇamāsikāni pradhānāny uttarasyāṃ tatau codyante 'nyatra somād dharmād darvihomebhyaś ca /
meaning: दार्शपौर्णमासिकानि प्रधानान्य् उत्तरस्यां ततौ चोद्यन्ते ऽन्यत्र सोमाद् धर्माद् दर्विहोमेभ्यश् च /
text_mt: The primary rites of the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices are prescribed for the subsequent ritual extension, except for the soma ritual, the pravargya rite, and the ladle-offerings.

sanskrit_iast: tāni svadharmāṇi /
meaning: तानि स्वधर्माणि /

sanskrit_iast: sādṛśyādv ikāraḥ /
meaning: सादृश्याद्व् इकारः /

sanskrit_iast: sa liṅgena gamyeta /
meaning: स लिङ्गेन गम्येत /

sanskrit_iast: devatāsāmānyena haviḥsāmānyena vā yatra haviḥ pradīyate /
meaning: देवतासामान्येन हविःसामान्येन वा यत्र हविः प्रदीयते /
text_mt: Where an oblation is offered, [similarity is established] by commonality of deity or commonality of sacrificial oblation.

sanskrit_iast: vipratiṣedhe haviḥsāmānyaṃ balīyaḥ /
meaning: विप्रतिषेधे हविःसामान्यं बलीयः /
text_mt: In case of conflict, commonality of sacrificial oblation is stronger.

sanskrit_iast: yathā vaiṣṇavaḥ puroḍāśaḥ /
meaning: यथा वैष्णवः पुरोडाशः /
text_mt: As [in the case of] a sacrificial cake for Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast: ekadevatās tv āgneyavikārā anyatra prakṛtidevatābhyo yathā saumyaś carur aindraḥ puroḍāśa iti /
meaning: एकदेवतास् त्व् आग्नेयविकारा अन्यत्र प्रकृतिदेवताभ्यो यथा सौम्यश् चरुर् ऐन्द्रः पुरोडाश इति /
text_mt: However, [rites with] a single deity are modifications of the Agni offering, except for the archetypal deities; as, for example, the cooked rice offering to Soma, [or] the sacrificial cake offering to Indra.

sanskrit_iast: athetare 'gnīṣomīyasyaindrāgnasya vā /
meaning: अथेतरे ऽग्नीषोमीयस्यैन्द्राग्नस्य वा /
text_mt: Then the other [rites are modifications] of [the offering] to Agni-Soma or to Indra-Agni.

sanskrit_iast: prakṛtau viśiṣṭadharmāṇām uttarasyāṃ tatau samavetānām aṅgavipratiṣedhe mukhyatvaṃ balīyaḥ /
meaning: प्रकृतौ विशिष्टधर्माणाम् उत्तरस्यां ततौ समवेतानाम् अङ्गविप्रतिषेधे मुख्यत्वं बलीयः /
text_mt: In the archetype, when specific rules come together in the subsequent ritual extension, if there is a conflict among subsidiaries, primacy of the main rite is stronger.

sanskrit_iast: mukhyatvād bhūyastvam /
meaning: मुख्यत्वाद् भूयस्त्वम् /
text_mt: Prevalence of number is stronger than primacy.

sanskrit_iast: bhūyastvāt sthānam /
meaning: भूयस्त्वात् स्थानम् /

sanskrit_iast: sthānād vidhiḥ /
meaning: स्थानाद् विधिः /

sanskrit_iast: vidher aṅgam /
meaning: विधेर् अङ्गम् /

sanskrit_iast: aṅgāt pradhānam /
meaning: अङ्गात् प्रधानम् /

sanskrit_iast: darśapūrṇamāsayor vikṛteś ca saṃnipāte darśapūrṇamāsau balīyām̐sau /
meaning: दर्शपूर्णमासयोर् विकृतेश् च संनिपाते दर्शपूर्णमासौ बलीयाम्̐सौ /
text_mt: When the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices and a modification coincide, the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices are stronger.

sanskrit_iast: yāni tviṣṭipaśubandhānāṃ pratyakṣāṇi tāni tatra /
meaning: यानि त्विष्टिपशुबन्धानां प्रत्यक्षाणि तानि तत्र /
text_mt: However, whatever rules are directly taught for the iṣṭis and animal sacrifices belong there [in those rites].

sanskrit_iast: darśapūrṇamāsaprakṛtaya iṣṭipaśubandhās te svadharmāṇaḥ sāmānyād vikāraḥ /
meaning: दर्शपूर्णमासप्रकृतय इष्टिपशुबन्धास् ते स्वधर्माणः सामान्याद् विकारः /
text_mt: The iṣṭis and animal sacrifices have the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices as their archetype; they have their own procedural rules, [and] the modified form [derives] from similarity.

sanskrit_iast: karmasaṃyuktāni dravyāṇi prakṛtau tatsaṃyogād dharmaṃ labhante karmaṇy avidyamāne sahadharmadravyaṃ nivartate /
meaning: कर्मसंयुक्तानि द्रव्याणि प्रकृतौ तत्संयोगाद् धर्मं लभन्ते कर्मण्य् अविद्यमाने सहधर्मद्रव्यं निवर्तते /
text_mt: Substances connected with a rite acquire procedural rules in the archetype through that connection; when the rite is absent, the substance together with its procedural rules ceases.

sanskrit_iast: yathā kṛṣṇaleṣv avahananam /
meaning: यथा कृष्णलेष्व् अवहननम् /
text_mt: As, for instance, pounding in the case of gold pieces.

sanskrit_iast: anyasmim̐ś ca dravye tenārthena saṃyujyamāne dharmāveśaḥ /
meaning: अन्यस्मिम्̐श् च द्रव्ये तेनार्थेन संयुज्यमाने धर्मावेशः /
text_mt: And when another substance is joined for the same purpose, there is transference of procedural rules.

sanskrit_iast: sthālyāṃ kapāladharmaḥ śyāmākeṣu vrīhidharmaḥ /
meaning: स्थाल्यां कपालधर्मः श्यामाकेषु व्रीहिधर्मः /
text_mt: The procedural rule of potsherds [applies] to a cooking pot; the procedural rule of rice [applies] to millet.

sanskrit_iast: yajñotpattau pratiṣiddhe sarvaṃ pratiṣidhyeta /
meaning: यज्ञोत्पत्तौ प्रतिषिद्धे सर्वं प्रतिषिध्येत /
text_mt: When [a rite] is prohibited at the origin of the sacrifice, everything [connected to it] would be prohibited.

sanskrit_iast: na yūpaṃ minvanti nottaravedim upavapanti /
meaning: न यूपं मिन्वन्ति नोत्तरवेदिम् उपवपन्ति /
text_mt: They do not erect a sacrificial post, nor do they scatter the high altar.

sanskrit_iast: anyasmim̐ś ca dravye tenārthena saṃyujyamāne dharmāveṣa utkare vājinam āsādayanty aśve paśūn niyuñjanti paridhau paśūn niyuñjanti /
meaning: अन्यस्मिम्̐श् च द्रव्ये तेनार्थेन संयुज्यमाने धर्मावेष उत्करे वाजिनम् आसादयन्त्य् अश्वे पशून् नियुञ्जन्ति परिधौ पशून् नियुञ्जन्ति /
text_mt: And when another substance is joined for that purpose, there is transference of procedural rules: they place the whey on the rubbish heap; they tether the sacrificial animals to a horse; they tether the sacrificial animals to an enclosing stick.

sanskrit_iast: sāmidhenīṣu vardhamānāsu //
meaning: सामिधेनीषु वर्धमानासु //
text_mt: When the kindling verses increase,

sanskrit_iast: kāṣṭhāni vardhante sam̐hriyamāṇāsu yathāprakṛti /
meaning: काष्ठानि वर्धन्ते सम्̐ह्रियमाणासु यथाप्रकृति /
text_mt: the sticks of firewood increase; when they are reduced, [they remain] as in the archetype.

sanskrit_iast: yathārtham ūhaḥ /
meaning: यथार्थम् ऊहः /

sanskrit_iast: na prakṛtāv ūho vidyate /
meaning: न प्रकृताव् ऊहो विद्यते /
text_mt: There is no adaptation in the archetype.

sanskrit_iast: patnīm̐ saṃnahya \\ upahūto 'yaṃ yajamānas \\ iti /
meaning: पत्नीम्̐ संनह्य \\ उपहूतो ऽयं यजमानस् \\ इति /
text_mt: [For example,] having girded the sacrificer's wife, [the formula remains,] 'Called is this sacrificer.'

sanskrit_iast: tathottarasyāṃ tatau yathāsamāmnātam /
meaning: तथोत्तरस्यां ततौ यथासमाम्नातम् /
text_mt: Likewise, in the subsequent ritual extension, [it is applied] just as handed down.

sanskrit_iast: pratinidhiṣv arthaluptāni na kriyeran yathā lūne lavanamantracchinne chedanamantraḥ /
meaning: प्रतिनिधिष्व् अर्थलुप्तानि न क्रियेरन् यथा लूने लवनमन्त्रच्छिन्ने छेदनमन्त्रः /
text_mt: In the case of substitutes, those whose purpose is lost should not be performed, as the cutting mantra when [the grass] is already cut, or the severing mantra when [the wood] is already severed.

sanskrit_iast: yatra payaḥ śrapaṇārthena śrūyate devas tvā savitotpunātu \\ ity utpavanaṃ saṃnamati payo devāgreṣv agra ity abhimantraṇam evam ājye /
meaning: यत्र पयः श्रपणार्थेन श्रूयते देवस् त्वा सवितोत्पुनातु \\ इत्य् उत्पवनं संनमति पयो देवाग्रेष्व् अग्र इत्य् अभिमन्त्रणम् एवम् आज्ये /
text_mt: Where milk is prescribed for cooking: the [mantra for] purification, "May god Savitṛ purify you...", is adapted, [and] the address is "O milk, first among the gods..." Likewise in the case of clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: carukalpān vyākhyāsyāmaḥ /
meaning: चरुकल्पान् व्याख्यास्यामः /
text_mt: We shall explain the procedures for the caru oblation.

sanskrit_iast: sthālīṃ kapālānām̐ sthāne prayunakti /
meaning: स्थालीं कपालानाम्̐ स्थाने प्रयुनक्ति /
text_mt: He employs a pot in place of the potsherds.

sanskrit_iast: tasya prasiddhamātriṣphalīkṛtebhyaḥ /
meaning: तस्य प्रसिद्धमात्रिष्फलीकृतेभ्यः /
text_mt: Its [procedure] is established [from the general rule] up to the de-husked grains.

sanskrit_iast: prathamena kapālamantreṇa sthālīm upadhāya /
meaning: प्रथमेन कपालमन्त्रेण स्थालीम् उपधाय /
text_mt: Having put the pot on [the fire] with the first potsherd mantra,

sanskrit_iast: śūrpād eva taṇḍulān samopyotpūyādhiśrayaṇamantreṇopya paryagni kṛtvā śrapayitvābhighārya sthālyaivodvāsayati /
meaning: शूर्पाद् एव तण्डुलान् समोप्योत्पूयाधिश्रयणमन्त्रेणोप्य पर्यग्नि कृत्वा श्रपयित्वाभिघार्य स्थाल्यैवोद्वासयति /
text_mt: having poured the rice grains together directly from the winnowing basket, purified [them], poured them into [the pot] with the mantra for setting on the fire, carried fire around [it], cooked [it], basted [it with clarified butter], he takes it off [the fire] in the pot itself.

sanskrit_iast: puroḍāśena puroḍāśagaṇe /
meaning: पुरोडाशेन पुरोडाशगणे /
text_mt: In a group of sacrificial cakes, by means of a sacrificial cake:

sanskrit_iast: yathābhāgaṃ vyāvartadhvam ity ekaikaṃ piṇḍam apacchinatti yathābhāgaṃ vyāvartethām ity avaśiṣṭau /
meaning: यथाभागं व्यावर्तध्वम् इत्य् एकैकं पिण्डम् अपच्छिनत्ति यथाभागं व्यावर्तेथाम् इत्य् अवशिष्टौ /
text_mt: He divides each single lump with "Separate according to your portion"; the remaining two with "Separate both of you according to your portions."

sanskrit_iast: tayor eva devatādeśanam /
meaning: तयोर् एव देवतादेशनम् /
text_mt: The assignment of deity belongs only to the two of them.

sanskrit_iast: carupuroḍāśyān prāg adhivapanād vibhajyeram̐s tatra vibhāgamantraṃ japati samān dvaidhaṃ karoti viṣamān yathābhāgam /
meaning: चरुपुरोडाश्यान् प्राग् अधिवपनाद् विभज्येरम्̐स् तत्र विभागमन्त्रं जपति समान् द्वैधं करोति विषमान् यथाभागम् /
text_mt: The materials for the caru and the sacrificial cake should be divided before pouring onto [the grinding stone]; there he mutters the division mantra; he makes equal [portions into] two parts, unequal [portions] according to their share.

sanskrit_iast: idam amuṣmai cāmuṣmai ca \\ ity ekaikasmin rāśāv ekaikāṃ devatām upalakṣayet /
meaning: इदम् अमुष्मै चामुष्मै च \\ इत्य् एकैकस्मिन् राशाव् एकैकां देवताम् उपलक्षयेत् /
text_mt: He should indicate each single deity for each single heap with, "This for so-and-so, and [this] for so-and-so."

sanskrit_iast: pauṣṇam apacchidya saha puroḍāśyaiḥ pinaṣṭi /
meaning: पौष्णम् अपच्छिद्य सह पुरोडाश्यैः पिनष्टि /
text_mt: Having cut off the portion for Pūṣan, he grinds [it] together with the materials for the sacrificial cake.

sanskrit_iast: adhiśrayaṇakāle mitho vibhajyeran /
meaning: अधिश्रयणकाले मिथो विभज्येरन् /
text_mt: At the time of setting on [the fire], they should be divided from one another.

sanskrit_iast: tatra vibhāgamantraṃ japati /
meaning: तत्र विभागमन्त्रं जपति /
text_mt: There he mutters the division mantra.

sanskrit_iast: nānābījeṣu samaveteṣv ekam ulūkhalaṃ musalam̐ śūrpaṃ kṛṣṇājinaṃ ca /
meaning: नानाबीजेषु समवेतेष्व् एकम् उलूखलं मुसलम्̐ शूर्पं कृष्णाजिनं च /
text_mt: When different types of grains are combined, there are [only] one mortar, pestle, winnowing basket, and black antelope skin.

sanskrit_iast: prathame bīje haviṣkṛtam āhvayaty uttame vācaṃ visṛjate /
meaning: प्रथमे बीजे हविष्कृतम् आह्वयत्य् उत्तमे वाचं विसृजते /
text_mt: At the first grain, he calls the preparer of the oblation; at the last, he releases his speech.

sanskrit_iast: somenāgrayaṇeṣṭyā paśubandhena vāmāvāsyāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ vā yajeta /
meaning: सोमेनाग्रयणेष्ट्या पशुबन्धेन वामावास्यायां पौर्णमास्यां वा यजेत /
text_mt: He may sacrifice on the New Moon or Full Moon day with Soma, with the first-fruits sacrifice (āgrāyaṇeṣṭi), or with an animal sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: saptadaśānubrūyād iṣṭyāḥ paśubandhasya vā pañcadaśabhir vikalperann avikalpo vā //
meaning: सप्तदशानुब्रूयाद् इष्ट्याः पशुबन्धस्य वा पञ्चदशभिर् विकल्पेरन्न् अविकल्पो वा //
text_mt: He should recite seventeen [kindling verses] for the iṣṭi or the animal sacrifice, or they may alternate with fifteen, or there is no alternation.

sanskrit_iast: āgrāyaṇeṣṭiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ /
meaning: आग्रायणेष्टिं व्याख्यास्यामः /
text_mt: We shall explain the first-fruits sacrifice (āgrāyaṇeṣṭi).

sanskrit_iast: tayā nāniṣṭvā navānām oṣadhīnāṃ phalāny aśnāti grāmyāṇām āraṇyānāṃ ca /
meaning: तया नानिष्ट्वा नवानाम् ओषधीनां फलान्य् अश्नाति ग्राम्याणाम् आरण्यानां च /
text_mt: Without having sacrificed with it, he does not eat the fruits of new plants, both cultivated and wild.

sanskrit_iast: vrīhīṇām agrapākasya yajate tathā śyāmākānaṃ yavānām agrapākasya yajate /
meaning: व्रीहीणाम् अग्रपाकस्य यजते तथा श्यामाकानं यवानाम् अग्रपाकस्य यजते /
text_mt: He sacrifices with the first ripened rice; likewise he sacrifices with the first ripened wild rice (śyāmāka) and barley.

sanskrit_iast: tathā vrīhīṇāṃ nirvapaṇakāle purāṇānāṃ vrīhīṇām āgneyam aṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapati navānām itarāṇi /
meaning: तथा व्रीहीणां निर्वपणकाले पुराणानां व्रीहीणाम् आग्नेयम् अष्टाकपालं निर्वपति नवानाम् इतराणि /
text_mt: Likewise, at the time of pouring out the rice, he pours out [an oblation] on eight potsherds to Agni made of old rice, and the others of new [rice]:

sanskrit_iast: āgnendram aindrāgnaṃ vā dvādaśakapālaṃ vaiśvadevaṃ caruṃ payasi śṛtam̐ saumyam̐ śyāmākaṃ caruṃ dyāvāpṛthivyam ekakapālam /
meaning: आग्नेन्द्रम् ऐन्द्राग्नं वा द्वादशकपालं वैश्वदेवं चरुं पयसि शृतम्̐ सौम्यम्̐ श्यामाकं चरुं द्यावापृथिव्यम् एककपालम् /
text_mt: an oblation on twelve potsherds to Indra-Agni or Agni-Indra, a caru to the Viśvedevas cooked in milk, a śyāmāka caru to Soma, and an oblation on a single potsherd to Heaven and Earth.

sanskrit_iast: nānātantram̐ śyāmākam eke samāmananti /
meaning: नानातन्त्रम्̐ श्यामाकम् एके समामनन्ति /
text_mt: Some teach that the śyāmāka [caru has] a separate framework.

sanskrit_iast: upasanne haviṣyaprokṣite śatāyudhāya \\ iti pañcājyānīr juhoti /
meaning: उपसन्ने हविष्यप्रोक्षिते शतायुधाय \\ इति पञ्चाज्यानीर् जुहोति /
text_mt: When the sacrificial oblation has been set down and sprinkled, he offers five clarified butter oblations with "To him who has a hundred weapons..."

sanskrit_iast: purastāt sviṣṭakṛta eke samāmananti /
meaning: पुरस्तात् स्विष्टकृत एके समामनन्ति /
text_mt: Some teach [these to be offered] before the Sviṣṭakṛt offering.

sanskrit_iast: ekakapālānāṃ vaiśvadevīyenaikakapālena kalpo vyākhyātaḥ /
meaning: एककपालानां वैश्वदेवीयेनैककपालेन कल्पो व्याख्यातः /
text_mt: The procedure for [oblations on] a single potsherd has been explained by the single potsherd oblation to the Viśvedevas.

sanskrit_iast: nāviḥpṛṣṭhaṃ karoti /
meaning: नाविःपृष्ठं करोति /

sanskrit_iast: na māsanāmabhir abhijuhoti /
meaning: न मासनामभिर् अभिजुहोति /
text_mt: He does not offer over it with the names of the months.

sanskrit_iast: vrīhibhir iṣṭvā vrīhibhir eva yajetāyavebhyo yavair iṣṭvā yavair eva yajetāvrīhibhyaḥ /
meaning: व्रीहिभिर् इष्ट्वा व्रीहिभिर् एव यजेतायवेभ्यो यवैर् इष्ट्वा यवैर् एव यजेताव्रीहिभ्यः /
text_mt: Having sacrificed with rice, he should sacrifice only with rice until the barley [ripens]; having sacrificed with barley, he should sacrifice only with barley until the rice [ripens].

sanskrit_iast: veṇuvānām̐ śyāmākam eke samāmananti /
meaning: वेणुवानाम्̐ श्यामाकम् एके समामनन्ति /
text_mt: Some teach [an offering of] bamboo seeds [instead of] śyāmāka.

sanskrit_iast: api vā nāgrayaṇeṣṭiṃ kurvīta navair evāmāvāsyāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ vā yajeta /
meaning: अपि वा नाग्रयणेष्टिं कुर्वीत नवैर् एवामावास्यायां पौर्णमास्यां वा यजेत /
text_mt: Or rather, he need not perform the first-fruits sacrifice: he may sacrifice on the New Moon or Full Moon day with the new [grains] themselves.

sanskrit_iast: navair vāgnihotraṃ juhuyād agnihotrīṃ vā navān ādayitvā tasyāḥ kṣīreṇa juhuyāc catuḥśarāvam odanaṃ vā paktvāgrayaṇadevatābhyaḥ sviṣṭakṛccaturthībhyo hutvā tadvyañjanaṃ bhojayati bhojayati //
meaning: नवैर् वाग्निहोत्रं जुहुयाद् अग्निहोत्रीं वा नवान् आदयित्वा तस्याः क्षीरेण जुहुयाच् चतुःशरावम् ओदनं वा पक्त्वाग्रयणदेवताभ्यः स्विष्टकृच्चतुर्थीभ्यो हुत्वा तद्व्यञ्जनं भोजयति भोजयति //
text_mt: Or he may offer the Agnihotra with the new [grains], or having fed the new [grains] to the Agnihotra cow, he may offer with her milk, or having cooked a four-śarāva mess of boiled rice, having offered to the first-fruits deities with Sviṣṭakṛt as the fourth, he feeds [the priests] with sauces made from it; he feeds [them].

sanskrit_iast: aindrāgnena paśunā ṣāṇmāsyeṣāṇmāsye yajata āvṛttimukhaāvṛttimukhe saṃvatsaresaṃvatsare vā /
meaning: ऐन्द्राग्नेन पशुना षाण्मास्येषाण्मास्ये यजत आवृत्तिमुखआवृत्तिमुखे संवत्सरेसंवत्सरे वा /
text_mt: He sacrifices with an animal for Indra-Agni every six months, at each change of the sun's course, or every year;

sanskrit_iast: sauryaḥ prājāpatyo vā /
meaning: सौर्यः प्राजापत्यो वा /

sanskrit_iast: taṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ /
meaning: तं व्याख्यास्यामः /

sanskrit_iast: sūryaṃ te cakṣus \\ iti ṣaḍḍhotāraṃ manasānudrutya sagraham̐ hutvānvārambhaṇīyām iṣṭiṃ nirvapati /
meaning: सूर्यं ते चक्षुस् \\ इति षड्ढोतारं मनसानुद्रुत्य सग्रहम्̐ हुत्वान्वारम्भणीयाम् इष्टिं निर्वपति /
text_mt: Having mentally recited the six-hotṛ formula, "May Sūrya be your eye...", and offered [the oblation] with the cup formula, he pours out the preparatory sacrifice (anvārambhaṇīyā iṣṭi):

sanskrit_iast: āgnāvaiṣṇavam ekādaśakapālam /
meaning: आग्नावैष्णवम् एकादशकपालम् /
text_mt: [an oblation] on eleven potsherds to Agni-Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast: siddham̐ saṃtiṣṭhate /
meaning: सिद्धम्̐ संतिष्ठते /

sanskrit_iast: api vā caturgṛhītam ājyam āgnāvaiṣṇavayarcāhavanīye juhoti /
meaning: अपि वा चतुर्गृहीतम् आज्यम् आग्नावैष्णवयर्चाहवनीये जुहोति /
text_mt: Or rather, he offers clarified butter taken in four ladlings into the āhavanīya fire with a verse to Agni-Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast: śeṣam ājyasya karoti dhārayaty āhavanīyam /
meaning: शेषम् आज्यस्य करोति धारयत्य् आहवनीयम् /
text_mt: He keeps a remnant of the clarified butter; he keeps the āhavanīya fire burning.

sanskrit_iast: uru viṣṇo vikramasva \\ iti sruveṇāhavanīye yūpāhutiṃ juhoti /
meaning: उरु विष्णो विक्रमस्व \\ इति स्रुवेणाहवनीये यूपाहुतिं जुहोति /
text_mt: With "Stride out widely, O Viṣṇu...", he offers the sacrificial post offering into the āhavanīya fire with the dipping spoon.

sanskrit_iast: ājyaśeṣaṃ sruvaṃ cādatte takṣṇe paraśuṃ prayacchati tad gacchanti yatra yūpaṃ chetsyanto bhavanti /
meaning: आज्यशेषं स्रुवं चादत्ते तक्ष्णे परशुं प्रयच्छति तद् गच्छन्ति यत्र यूपं छेत्स्यन्तो भवन्ति /
text_mt: He takes the remnant of clarified butter and the dipping spoon, gives the axe to the carpenter, [and] they go to where they are to cut the sacrificial post.

sanskrit_iast: pālāśaḥ khādiro bailvo rauhītakaś ca yūpyā vṛkṣāḥ /
meaning: पालाशः खादिरो बैल्वो रौहीतकश् च यूप्या वृक्षाः /
text_mt: Trees suitable for a sacrificial post are: palāśa, khadira, bilva, and rohitaka.

sanskrit_iast: pālāśaṃ brahmavarcasakāmasyānnādyakāmasya vā khādiram̐ svargakāmasya bailvaṃ brahmavarcasakāmasya rauhītakaṃ prajākāmasya /
meaning: पालाशं ब्रह्मवर्चसकामस्यान्नाद्यकामस्य वा खादिरम्̐ स्वर्गकामस्य बैल्वं ब्रह्मवर्चसकामस्य रौहीतकं प्रजाकामस्य /
text_mt: A palāśa [post is] for one who desires spiritual lustre or food; a khadira [post] for one who desires heaven; a bilva [post] for one who desires spiritual lustre; a rohitaka [post] for one who desires offspring.

sanskrit_iast: tryavarārdhyān yūpyān vṛkṣān atikramya /
meaning: त्र्यवरार्ध्यान् यूप्यान् वृक्षान् अतिक्रम्य /
text_mt: Having passed by at least three trees suitable for a sacrificial post,

sanskrit_iast: ya ṛjur ūrdhva ūrdhvaśakala ūrdhvaśākhaḥ same bhūmyai svād yone rūḍhaḥ /
meaning: य ऋजुर् ऊर्ध्व ऊर्ध्वशकल ऊर्ध्वशाखः समे भूम्यै स्वाद् योने रूढः /
text_mt: [he selects one] which is straight, lofty, with upward-tending bark, upward-tending branches, [and] which has grown in a level place of the earth from its own origin.

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ kāmayetāpratiṣṭhitaḥ syād ity ārohaṃ tasmai vṛśced yaṃ kāmayetāpaśuḥ syād ity aparṇaṃ tasmai śuṣkāgraṃ kāmayeta paśumān syād iti bahuparṇaṃ tasmai bahuśākham aśuṣkāgram /
meaning: यं कामयेताप्रतिष्ठितः स्याद् इत्य् आरोहं तस्मै वृश्चेद् यं कामयेतापशुः स्याद् इत्य् अपर्णं तस्मै शुष्काग्रं कामयेत पशुमान् स्याद् इति बहुपर्णं तस्मै बहुशाखम् अशुष्काग्रम् /
text_mt: For one whom he wishes, "May he be unestablished," he should cut a tree with an offshoot; for one whom he wishes, "May he be without cattle," a leafless tree with a dried-up top; for one whom he wishes, "May he be rich in cattle," a tree rich in leaves, with many branches, and with an undried top;

sanskrit_iast: pratiṣṭhitaṃ pratiṣṭhākāmasya /
meaning: प्रतिष्ठितं प्रतिष्ठाकामस्य /
text_mt: a firmly rooted [tree] for one who desires stability.

sanskrit_iast: yaḥ pratyaṅṅ upanatastaṃ vṛśced yaḥ prāṅṅ udaṅ vopanataḥ /
meaning: यः प्रत्यङ्ङ् उपनतस्तं वृश्चेद् यः प्राङ्ङ् उदङ् वोपनतः /
text_mt: He should cut one that is bent westward, or one that is bent eastward or northward,

sanskrit_iast: yasya carjoḥ sata īṣad ivāgram upanatam /
meaning: यस्य चर्जोः सत ईषद् इवाग्रम् उपनतम् /
text_mt: and of a straight one, the tip is just slightly bent.

sanskrit_iast: aty anyān agām iti //
meaning: अत्य् अन्यान् अगाम् इति //

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ joṣayate tam upatiṣṭhate /
meaning: यं जोषयते तम् उपतिष्ठते /
text_mt: He stands before the one he prefers.

sanskrit_iast: devas tvā savitā madhvānaktu \\ iti sruveṇa gulphadaghne jānudaghne vā paryaṇakti /
meaning: देवस् त्वा सविता मध्वानक्तु \\ इति स्रुवेण गुल्फदघ्ने जानुदघ्ने वा पर्यणक्ति /
text_mt: With "May god Savitṛ anoint you with honey...", he anoints it all around with the dipping spoon at ankle-height or knee-height.

sanskrit_iast: oṣadhe trāyasvainam ity ūrdhvāgrām oṣadhim antardadhāti svadhite mainam̐ him̐sīs \\ iti paraśunā praharati yaḥ prathamaḥ śakalaḥ parāpatati tam upayacchate /
meaning: ओषधे त्रायस्वैनम् इत्य् ऊर्ध्वाग्राम् ओषधिम् अन्तर्दधाति स्वधिते मैनम्̐ हिम्̐सीस् \\ इति परशुना प्रहरति यः प्रथमः शकलः परापतति तम् उपयच्छते /
text_mt: With "O plant, protect him!" he places a blade of grass with its tip pointing upward [against it]; with "O axe, do not harm him!" he strikes with the axe; the first chip that flies off, he catches.

sanskrit_iast: anakṣasaṅgam̐ sthāṇum ucchim̐ṣan vṛścati gulhadaghnaṃ vā /
meaning: अनक्षसङ्गम्̐ स्थाणुम् उच्छिम्̐षन् वृश्चति गुल्हदघ्नं वा /
text_mt: He cuts it leaving a stump that does not catch an axle, or at ankle-height.

sanskrit_iast: divam agreṇa \\ iti prāñcam udañcaṃ vā prahāpayati /
meaning: दिवम् अग्रेण \\ इति प्राञ्चम् उदञ्चं वा प्रहापयति /
text_mt: With "With your top [reach] the sky...", he causes it to fall toward the east or toward the north.

sanskrit_iast: vanaspate śatavalśo viroha \\ ity āvraścane juhoti sahasravalśā vi vayam̐ ruhema \\ ity ātmānaṃ pratyabhimṛśati /
meaning: वनस्पते शतवल्शो विरोह \\ इत्य् आव्रश्चने जुहोति सहस्रवल्शा वि वयम्̐ रुहेम \\ इत्य् आत्मानं प्रत्यभिमृशति /
text_mt: With "O lord of the forest, grow up with a hundred shoots!" he offers [clarified butter] on the stump; with "May we grow up with a thousand shoots!" he touches himself.

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ tvāyam̐ svadhitis \\ ity anulomaṃ paraśunāṅgān kalpayati /
meaning: यं त्वायम्̐ स्वधितिस् \\ इत्य् अनुलोमं परशुनाङ्गान् कल्पयति /
text_mt: With "Which you this axe...", he trims the limbs along the grain with the axe.

sanskrit_iast: acchinno rāyaḥ suvīras \\ ity agraṃ parivāsayati /
meaning: अच्छिन्नो रायः सुवीरस् \\ इत्य् अग्रं परिवासयति /
text_mt: With "Undivided wealth with good heroes...", he lops off the top.

sanskrit_iast: ekāratniprabhṛtīni brāhmaṇavyākhyātāni kāmyāni yūpapramāṇāni teṣāṃ yāthākāmī /
meaning: एकारत्निप्रभृतीनि ब्राह्मणव्याख्यातानि काम्यानि यूपप्रमाणानि तेषां याथाकामी /
text_mt: The measurements of the sacrificial post according to desire, beginning from one cubit, have been explained in the Brāhmaṇa; one may act according to one's desire among them.

sanskrit_iast: sahopareṇa saṃkhyā syād ā trayastrim̐śadaratneḥ /
meaning: सहोपरेण संख्या स्याद् आ त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शदरत्नेः /
text_mt: The count, along with the portion below ground, may extend up to thirty-three cubits.

sanskrit_iast: tryaratnir vā caturaratnir vā pālāśo nirūḍhapaśubandhasya yūpo 'to 'nye saumyasyādhvarasya /
meaning: त्र्यरत्निर् वा चतुररत्निर् वा पालाशो निरूढपशुबन्धस्य यूपो ऽतो ऽन्ये सौम्यस्याध्वरस्य /
text_mt: For the independent animal sacrifice, the sacrificial post made of palāśa wood is either three cubits or four cubits [long]; other than that, they belong to the soma sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭāśriṃ takṣṇoti nātisthūlaṃ nātyaṇum ataṣṭam uparam /
meaning: अष्टाश्रिं तक्ष्णोति नातिस्थूलं नात्यणुम् अतष्टम् उपरम् /
text_mt: He hews it eight-cornered, neither too thick nor too thin, leaving the portion below ground unhewn.

sanskrit_iast: puraḥpuroṇīyām̐saṃ gopucchaṃ vā /
meaning: पुरःपुरोणीयाम्̐सं गोपुच्छं वा /
text_mt: Tapering forward and forward, or like a cow's tail.

sanskrit_iast: tasyaiva vṛkṣasyāgrataś caṣālaṃ karoti /
meaning: तस्यैव वृक्षस्याग्रतश् चषालं करोति /
text_mt: From the very top of that tree he makes the top-ring.

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭāśriṃ pṛthumātraṃ madhye saṃnatam /
meaning: अष्टाश्रिं पृथुमात्रं मध्ये संनतम् /
text_mt: Eight-cornered, a span in width, curved inward in the middle.

sanskrit_iast: yāvad idaṃ prathamam aṅgulikāṇḍaṃ tāvad ūrdhvaṃ caṣālād yūpasyātirecayati /
meaning: यावद् इदं प्रथमम् अङ्गुलिकाण्डं तावद् ऊर्ध्वं चषालाद् यूपस्यातिरेचयति /
text_mt: He leaves protruding above the top-ring as much of the sacrificial post as this first joint of the finger.

sanskrit_iast: aṅgulimātraṃ kanīyo vāṅguleḥ /
meaning: अङ्गुलिमात्रं कनीयो वाङ्गुलेः /
text_mt: A finger's breadth, or less than a finger's breadth.

sanskrit_iast: dvyaṅgulaṃ tryaṅgulaṃ caturaṅgulaṃ vaiteṣām eva takṣaṇānām̐ svaruṃ karoti /
meaning: द्व्यङ्गुलं त्र्यङ्गुलं चतुरङ्गुलं वैतेषाम् एव तक्षणानाम्̐ स्वरुं करोति /
text_mt: From these very chips he makes a wooden splinter of two fingers' breadth, three fingers' breadth, or four fingers' breadth.

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ kāmayetānyo 'sya lokam abhyārohed ity anyavṛkṣasya svaruṃ caṣālaṃ ca kuryāt /
meaning: यं कामयेतान्यो ऽस्य लोकम् अभ्यारोहेद् इत्य् अन्यवृक्षस्य स्वरुं चषालं च कुर्यात् /
text_mt: If he should desire: 'Let another person mount over this one's world,' he should make the wooden splinter and the top-ring from a different tree.

sanskrit_iast: vedaṃ kṛtvāgreṇāhavanīyam //
meaning: वेदं कृत्वाग्रेणाहवनीयम् //
text_mt: Having fashioned the veda in front of the āhavanīya fire,

sanskrit_iast: rathamātrīṃ vediṃ karoti /
meaning: रथमात्रीं वेदिं करोति /
text_mt: he makes the altar as large as a chariot.

sanskrit_iast: ratheṣāmātrīṃ prācīṃ rathākṣamātrīṃ paścāttiraścīṃ vipathayugamātrīṃ purastādudīcīm /
meaning: रथेषामात्रीं प्राचीं रथाक्षमात्रीं पश्चात्तिरश्चीं विपथयुगमात्रीं पुरस्तादुदीचीम् /
text_mt: Measuring the length of a chariot-pole toward the east, measuring the length of a chariot-axle across at the back, and measuring the length of an open-chariot yoke across at the front toward the north.

sanskrit_iast: api vā ṣaḍaratniṃ prācīṃ caturaratniṃ paścāttiraścīṃ tryaratniṃ purastāttiraścīm asaṃnatā bhavati /
meaning: अपि वा षडरत्निं प्राचीं चतुररत्निं पश्चात्तिरश्चीं त्र्यरत्निं पुरस्तात्तिरश्चीम् असंनता भवति /
text_mt: Or rather, measuring six cubits toward the east, measuring four cubits across at the back, and measuring three cubits across at the front; it does not curve inward.

sanskrit_iast: yat prāguttarasmāt parigrāhāt tat kṛtvā pūrvārdhe veder yūpāvaṭāyāvakāśam avaśiṣya śamyayottaravediṃ vimimīte /
meaning: यत् प्रागुत्तरस्मात् परिग्राहात् तत् कृत्वा पूर्वार्धे वेदेर् यूपावटायावकाशम् अवशिष्य शम्ययोत्तरवेदिं विमिमीते /
text_mt: Having performed that which is prior to the northern enclosing-trace, leaving space for the post-hole in the eastern half of the altar, he measures out the high altar with the yoke-pin.

sanskrit_iast: purastād ucīcīnakumbām̐ śamyāṃ nidhāya vittāyanī me 'si \\ iti sphyenodīcīṃ lekhāṃ likhati /
meaning: पुरस्ताद् उचीचीनकुम्बाम्̐ शम्यां निधाय वित्तायनी मे ऽसि \\ इति स्फ्येनोदीचीं लेखां लिखति /
text_mt: Having placed the yoke-pin in front with its peg-point facing north, he draws a line to the north with the wooden sword, with the mantra: 'You are the finder of wealth for me.'

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇataḥprācīnakumbāṃ nidhāya tiktāyanī me 'si \\ iti dakṣiṇataḥprācīṃ paścādudīcīnakumbāṃ nidhāya \\ avatān mā nāthitam iti paścādudīcīmuttarataḥ prācīnakumbāṃ nidhāya \\ avatān mā vyathitam ity uttarataḥ prācīm abhyantaraṃ parilikhati /
meaning: दक्षिणतःप्राचीनकुम्बां निधाय तिक्तायनी मे ऽसि \\ इति दक्षिणतःप्राचीं पश्चादुदीचीनकुम्बां निधाय \\ अवतान् मा नाथितम् इति पश्चादुदीचीमुत्तरतः प्राचीनकुम्बां निधाय \\ अवतान् मा व्यथितम् इत्य् उत्तरतः प्राचीम् अभ्यन्तरं परिलिखति /
text_mt: Having placed it on the south with its peg-point facing east, [he draws a line] from the south toward the east with the mantra: 'You are the finder of joy for me.' Having placed it behind with its peg-point facing north, [he draws a line] from behind toward the north with the mantra: 'May it protect me, who am distressed.' Having placed it on the north with its peg-point facing east, he draws a line around on the inside toward the east with the mantra: 'May it protect me, who am suffering.'

sanskrit_iast: uttareṇottaraṃ vedyam̐saṃ prakrame cātvālas taṃ parilikhaty anenaiva kalpena yad anyan mantrebhyaḥ /
meaning: उत्तरेणोत्तरं वेद्यम्̐सं प्रक्रमे चात्वालस् तं परिलिखत्य् अनेनैव कल्पेन यद् अन्यन् मन्त्रेभ्यः /
text_mt: North of the northern shoulder of the altar, at the distance of one step, is the cātvāla pit; he marks it all around according to this very procedure, except for the mantras.

sanskrit_iast: devasya tvā \\ ity abhrim ādāya vider agnir nabho nāma \\ iti khanati /
meaning: देवस्य त्वा \\ इत्य् अभ्रिम् आदाय विदेर् अग्निर् नभो नाम \\ इति खनति /
text_mt: Taking the spade with the mantra: 'At the impulse of the god...', he digs with the mantra: 'You are an act of finding; Agni is named Nabhas.'

sanskrit_iast: jānudaghnaṃ trivitastaṃ vā khātvā /
meaning: जानुदघ्नं त्रिवितस्तं वा खात्वा /
text_mt: Having dug knee-deep, or three spans deep,

sanskrit_iast: agne aṅgiras \\ ity abhriṃ praharati /
meaning: अग्ने अङ्गिरस् \\ इत्य् अभ्रिं प्रहरति /
text_mt: he strikes with the spade, with the mantra: 'O Agni, Angiras...'

sanskrit_iast: yo 'syāṃ pṛthivyām iti pām̐sūn apādatte /
meaning: यो ऽस्यां पृथिव्याम् इति पाम्̐सून् अपादत्ते /
text_mt: He takes up the loose earth with the mantra: 'That which is in this earth...'

sanskrit_iast: āyuṣā nāmnehi \\ iti harati /
meaning: आयुषा नाम्नेहि \\ इति हरति /
text_mt: He carries it forward with the mantra: 'Come with life, by name!'

sanskrit_iast: yat te 'nādhṛṣṭam ity uttaravedyāṃ nivapati /
meaning: यत् ते ऽनाधृष्टम् इत्य् उत्तरवेद्यां निवपति /
text_mt: He pours it out onto the high altar with the mantra: 'What of you is unassailable...'

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ dvitīyaṃ haraty evaṃ tṛtīyam //
meaning: एवं द्वितीयं हरत्य् एवं तृतीयम् //
text_mt: Thus he carries a second [shovelful]; thus a third.

sanskrit_iast: yo dvitīyasyām iti dvitīyam apādatte yas tṛtīyasyām iti tṛtīyaṃ tūṣṇīṃ caturtham /
meaning: यो द्वितीयस्याम् इति द्वितीयम् अपादत्ते यस् तृतीयस्याम् इति तृतीयं तूष्णीं चतुर्थम् /
text_mt: He takes up the second with the mantra: 'That which is in the second [earth]...', the third with: 'That which is in the third [earth]...', and silently a fourth.

sanskrit_iast: sim̐hīr asi mahiṣīr asi \\ ity uttaravediṃ karoti /
meaning: सिम्̐हीर् असि महिषीर् असि \\ इत्य् उत्तरवेदिं करोति /
text_mt: With the mantra: 'You are a lioness, you are a buffalo cow...', he forms the high altar.

sanskrit_iast: uru prathasva \\ iti prathayati /
meaning: उरु प्रथस्व \\ इति प्रथयति /
text_mt: With the mantra: 'Spread wide...', he spreads it out.

sanskrit_iast: dhruvāsi \\ iti śamyayā sam̐hanti /
meaning: ध्रुवासि \\ इति शम्यया सम्̐हन्ति /
text_mt: With the mantra: 'You are firm,' he compacts it with the yoke-pin.

sanskrit_iast: devebhyaḥ kalpasva \\ iti kalpayati /
meaning: देवेभ्यः कल्पस्व \\ इति कल्पयति /
text_mt: With the mantra: 'Prepare yourself for the gods,' he fashions it.

sanskrit_iast: devebhyaḥ śundhasva \\ ity adbhiḥ prokṣati /
meaning: देवेभ्यः शुन्धस्व \\ इत्य् अद्भिः प्रोक्षति /
text_mt: With the mantra: 'Purify yourself for the gods,' he sprinkles it with water.

sanskrit_iast: devebhyaḥ śumbhasva \\ iti sikatābhir anuprakirati /
meaning: देवेभ्यः शुम्भस्व \\ इति सिकताभिर् अनुप्रकिरति /
text_mt: With the mantra: 'Adorn yourself for the gods,' he scatters sand over it.

sanskrit_iast: yat te krūraṃ yad āsthitam iti punar evādbhir avokṣati /
meaning: यत् ते क्रूरं यद् आस्थितम् इति पुनर् एवाद्भिर् अवोक्षति /
text_mt: With the mantra: 'Whatever is injured of you, whatever has been trodden upon...', he sprinkles it down again with water.

sanskrit_iast: uttarato dakṣiṇato vā sphyenaikasphyāṃ niḥsārya \\ āpo ripraṃ nirvahata \\ ity apām̐ śeṣaṃ ninayati /
meaning: उत्तरतो दक्षिणतो वा स्फ्येनैकस्फ्यां निःसार्य \\ आपो रिप्रं निर्वहत \\ इत्य् अपाम्̐ शेषं निनयति /
text_mt: Having drawn a line with the wooden sword, either toward the north or toward the south, he pours out the remainder of the water with the mantra: 'O waters, wash away the defilement.'

sanskrit_iast: vibhrāḍ bṛhat pibatu somyaṃ madhu \\ āyur dadhad yajñapatāv avihrutam / \ vātajūto yo abhirakṣati tmanā \ prajāḥ piparti bahudhā virājati \\ ity uttaravedyā antān kalpayati /
meaning: विभ्राड् बृहत् पिबतु सोम्यं मधु \\ आयुर् दधद् यज्ञपताव् अविह्रुतम् / \ वातजूतो यो अभिरक्षति त्मना \ प्रजाः पिपर्ति बहुधा विराजति \\ इत्य् उत्तरवेद्या अन्तान् कल्पयति /
text_mt: With the mantra: 'May the radiant, exalted one drink the sweet soma, / bestowing unimpaired life upon the master of sacrifice; / impelled by the wind, who protects by his own self, / he fosters offspring and shines forth abundantly,' he fashions the borders of the high altar.

sanskrit_iast: catuḥśikhaṇḍe yuvatī kanīne \ ghṛtapratīke bhuvanasya madhye / \ tayor devā adhisaṃvasantas \\ uttame nāka iha mādayantām iti vedim uttaravediṃ ca saṃmṛśati /
meaning: चतुःशिखण्डे युवती कनीने \ घृतप्रतीके भुवनस्य मध्ये / \ तयोर् देवा अधिसंवसन्तस् \\ उत्तमे नाक इह मादयन्ताम् इति वेदिम् उत्तरवेदिं च संमृशति /
text_mt: With the mantra: 'The four-tufted young maidens, / anointed with clarified butter, in the midst of the world; / may the gods dwelling upon them / rejoice here in the highest heaven,' he touches the altar and the high altar.

sanskrit_iast: uttaravedyāṃ madhye goṣpadamātrīm aśvaśaphamātrīṃ prādeśamātrīṃ vottaranābhiṃ karoti /
meaning: उत्तरवेद्यां मध्ये गोष्पदमात्रीम् अश्वशफमात्रीं प्रादेशमात्रीं वोत्तरनाभिं करोति /
text_mt: In the middle of the high altar, he makes a high-altar navel the size of a cow's footprint, or the size of a horse's hoof, or the size of a span.

sanskrit_iast: indraghoṣas tvā vasubhiḥ purastāt pātu \\ iti pradakṣiṇam anuparikrāman pratidiśam uttaravediṃ prokṣati /
meaning: इन्द्रघोषस् त्वा वसुभिः पुरस्तात् पातु \\ इति प्रदक्षिणम् अनुपरिक्रामन् प्रतिदिशम् उत्तरवेदिं प्रोक्षति /
text_mt: Walking around toward the right, he sprinkles the high altar in each direction with the mantra: 'May Indraghoṣa protect you from the east with the Vasus.'

sanskrit_iast: tvaṣṭā tvā rūpair upariṣṭāt pātu \\ ity upariṣṭāt prokṣati /
meaning: त्वष्टा त्वा रूपैर् उपरिष्टात् पातु \\ इत्य् उपरिष्टात् प्रोक्षति /
text_mt: He sprinkles it on top with the mantra: 'May Tvaṣṭṛ protect you from above with the forms.'

sanskrit_iast: śeṣaṃ ninayati yathā purastāt /
meaning: शेषं निनयति यथा पुरस्तात् /
text_mt: He pours out the remainder as before.

sanskrit_iast: audumbaraśākhābhiś channāṃ parivāsayati yadi śvaḥ kālaḥ //
meaning: औदुम्बरशाखाभिश् छन्नां परिवासयति यदि श्वः कालः //
text_mt: Covered with audumbara branches, he lets it rest overnight, if the appointed time is tomorrow.

sanskrit_iast: āhavanīye 'gnipraṇayanāny ādīpayati /
meaning: आहवनीये ऽग्निप्रणयनान्य् आदीपयति /
text_mt: He kindles the firebrands for the carriage of the fire in the āhavanīya fire.

sanskrit_iast: sikatāś copayamanīr upakalpayate /
meaning: सिकताश् चोपयमनीर् उपकल्पयते /
text_mt: And he prepares sand and supporting sticks.

sanskrit_iast: udyacchatīdhmam upayacchaty upyamanīr upayate dhāryamāṇe /
meaning: उद्यच्छतीध्मम् उपयच्छत्य् उप्यमनीर् उपयते धार्यमाणे /
text_mt: He lifts up the firewood and takes hold of the supporting sticks, while the supporting sticks are held underneath.

sanskrit_iast: yat te pāvaka cakṛmā kaccid āgaḥ \ pūrvo yat sann aparo bhavāsi / \ ghṛtena tvaṃ tanuvo vardhayasva \ mā mā him̐sīr adhigataṃ purastāt \\ iti śeṣe juhoti /
meaning: यत् ते पावक चकृमा कच्चिद् आगः \ पूर्वो यत् सन्न् अपरो भवासि / \ घृतेन त्वं तनुवो वर्धयस्व \ मा मा हिम्̐सीर् अधिगतं पुरस्तात् \\ इति शेषे जुहोति /
text_mt: With the mantra: 'Whatever offence we have committed against you, O purifier, / that, being the former, you should become the latter, / do you make your bodies grow with clarified butter; / do not harm me who have come before you,' he offers into the remainder [of the fire].

sanskrit_iast: agnaye praṇīyamānāyānubrūhi \\ iti saṃpreṣyati praṇīyamānāyānubrūhi \\ iti vā /
meaning: अग्नये प्रणीयमानायानुब्रूहि \\ इति संप्रेष्यति प्रणीयमानायानुब्रूहि \\ इति वा /
text_mt: He gives the direction: 'Recite [the introductory verse] for the fire being led forward,' or: 'Recite for [him] being led forward.'

sanskrit_iast: triranūktāyām̐ haraty uttaravediṃ prāpya juhvāṃ pañcagṛhītaṃ gṛhītvā hiraṇyam antardhāyākṣṇayottaravediṃ vyāghārayati /
meaning: त्रिरनूक्तायाम्̐ हरत्य् उत्तरवेदिं प्राप्य जुह्वां पञ्चगृहीतं गृहीत्वा हिरण्यम् अन्तर्धायाक्ष्णयोत्तरवेदिं व्याघारयति /
text_mt: When it has been recited thrice, he carries [the fire] forward; having reached the high altar, having taken a fivefold ladleful in the juhū, interposing gold, he makes crosswise libations on the high altar:

sanskrit_iast: sim̐hīr asi sapatnasāhī svāhā \\ iti dakṣiṇe 'm̐se /
meaning: सिम्̐हीर् असि सपत्नसाही स्वाहा \\ इति दक्षिणे ऽम्̐से /
text_mt: on the southern shoulder, with: 'You are a lioness, overpowering rivals, svāhā';

sanskrit_iast: sim̐hīr asi suprajāvaniḥ svāhā \\ ity uttarasyām̐ śroṇyām /
meaning: सिम्̐हीर् असि सुप्रजावनिः स्वाहा \\ इत्य् उत्तरस्याम्̐ श्रोण्याम् /
text_mt: on the northern hip, with: 'You are a lioness, granting good offspring, svāhā';

sanskrit_iast: sim̐hīr asi rāyaspoṣavaniḥ svāhā \\ iti dakṣiṇasyām̐ śroṇyām /
meaning: सिम्̐हीर् असि रायस्पोषवनिः स्वाहा \\ इति दक्षिणस्याम्̐ श्रोण्याम् /
text_mt: on the southern hip, with: 'You are a lioness, granting increase of wealth, svāhā';

sanskrit_iast: sim̐hīr asy ādityavaniḥ svāhā \\ ity uttare 'm̐se /
meaning: सिम्̐हीर् अस्य् आदित्यवनिः स्वाहा \\ इत्य् उत्तरे ऽम्̐से /
text_mt: on the northern shoulder, with: 'You are a lioness, granting Āditya, svāhā';

sanskrit_iast: sim̐hīr asy āvaha devān devayate yajamānāya svāhā \\ iti madhye /
meaning: सिम्̐हीर् अस्य् आवह देवान् देवयते यजमानाय स्वाहा \\ इति मध्ये /
text_mt: in the middle, with: 'You are a lioness; bring the gods for the sacrificer who serves the gods, svāhā.'

sanskrit_iast: bhūtebhyas tvā \\ iti srucam̐ hiraṇyaṃ codgṛhya /
meaning: भूतेभ्यस् त्वा \\ इति स्रुचम्̐ हिरण्यं चोद्गृह्य /
text_mt: Having raised up the ladle and the gold with the mantra: 'For the living beings, you,'

sanskrit_iast: pautudravaiḥ paridhibhiḥ paridadhāti /
meaning: पौतुद्रवैः परिधिभिः परिदधाति /
text_mt: he encloses [the high altar] with enclosing sticks of pūtudru wood.

sanskrit_iast: viśvāyur asi \\ iti madhyamaṃ dhruvakṣid asi \\ iti dakṣiṇārdhyam acyatakṣid asi \\ ity uttarārdhyam /
meaning: विश्वायुर् असि \\ इति मध्यमं ध्रुवक्षिद् असि \\ इति दक्षिणार्ध्यम् अच्यतक्षिद् असि \\ इत्य् उत्तरार्ध्यम् /
text_mt: The middle one with the mantra: 'You are all-sustaining life'; the southern one with: 'You are firmly dwelling'; the northern one with: 'You are unshakeably dwelling.'

sanskrit_iast: upakḷptāḥ saṃbhārā guggulusugandhitejanaṃ śuklorṇāstukā petvasyāntarāśṛṅge yā /
meaning: उपकॢप्ताः संभारा गुग्गुलुसुगन्धितेजनं शुक्लोर्णास्तुका पेत्वस्यान्तराशृङ्गे या /
text_mt: The prepared materials are: bdellium, fragrant reed-grass, and a tuft of white wool that is between the horns of a ram.

sanskrit_iast: tān agner bhasmāsi \\ iti sakṛd evottaranābhyāṃ nivapati /
meaning: तान् अग्नेर् भस्मासि \\ इति सकृद् एवोत्तरनाभ्यां निवपति /
text_mt: He scatters them all at once into the high-altar navel with the mantra: 'You are the ashes of Agni.'

sanskrit_iast: ūrṇāvantaṃ prathamaḥ sīda yonim ity ucyamāne yajña pratitiṣṭha sumatau suśevās \\ ā tvā vasūni purudhā viśantu / \ dīrgham āyur yajamānāya kṛṇvan \\ athāmṛtena jaritāram aṅdhi \ yajñaḥ pratyaṣṭhāt \\ iti saṃbhāreṣu pratiṣṭhāpayati /
meaning: ऊर्णावन्तं प्रथमः सीद योनिम् इत्य् उच्यमाने यज्ञ प्रतितिष्ठ सुमतौ सुशेवास् \\ आ त्वा वसूनि पुरुधा विशन्तु / \ दीर्घम् आयुर् यजमानाय कृण्वन् \\ अथामृतेन जरितारम् अङ्धि \ यज्ञः प्रत्यष्ठात् \\ इति संभारेषु प्रतिष्ठापयति /
text_mt: While the verse: 'Sit first upon your woolly seat...' is being recited, with the mantra: 'O sacrifice, stand firm in goodwill, kindly; / may riches enter you abundantly; / granting long life to the sacrificer, / then anoint the singer with immortality; / the sacrifice has stood firm,' he establishes [the fire] upon the materials.

sanskrit_iast: agneḥ kulāyam asi \\ iti dakṣiṇata upayamanīr upanivapati /
meaning: अग्नेः कुलायम् असि \\ इति दक्षिणत उपयमनीर् उपनिवपति /
text_mt: With the mantra: 'You are the nest of Agni,' he scatters the supporting [sand] to the south.

sanskrit_iast: manuṣvat tvā nidhīmahi \ manuṣvat samidhīmahi / \ agne manuṣvad aṅgiras \\ devān devāyate yaja \\ ity upasamindhe /
meaning: मनुष्वत् त्वा निधीमहि \ मनुष्वत् समिधीमहि / \ अग्ने मनुष्वद् अङ्गिरस् \\ देवान् देवायते यज \\ इत्य् उपसमिन्धे /
text_mt: With: “Like Manu may we establish you, / like Manu may we kindle you. / Agni, like Manu, O Aṅgiras, / sacrifice to the gods on behalf of him who seeks the gods!” he kindles [the fire].

sanskrit_iast: agnir yajñaṃ nayatu prajānan \ mainaṃ yajñahano 'vidan / \ devebhyo yajñaṃ prabrūtāt \ prapra yajñapatiṃ tira svāhā \ vāyur \ ādityas \\ yajño yajñaṃ nayatu prajānan \ mainaṃ yajñahano 'vidan / \ devebhyo yajñaṃ prabrūtāt \ prapra yajñapatiṃ tira svāhā \\ iti catasro 'timuktīr hutvā /
meaning: अग्निर् यज्ञं नयतु प्रजानन् \ मैनं यज्ञहनो ऽविदन् / \ देवेभ्यो यज्ञं प्रब्रूतात् \ प्रप्र यज्ञपतिं तिर स्वाहा \ वायुर् \ आदित्यस् \\ यज्ञो यज्ञं नयतु प्रजानन् \ मैनं यज्ञहनो ऽविदन् / \ देवेभ्यो यज्ञं प्रब्रूतात् \ प्रप्र यज्ञपतिं तिर स्वाहा \\ इति चतस्रो ऽतिमुक्तीर् हुत्वा /
text_mt: Having offered the four deliverance oblations with: “May Agni lead the sacrifice, knowing it; / may the sacrifice-slayers not find it. / Announce the sacrifice to the gods; / advance the lord of the sacrifice, svāhā! / Vāyu... / Āditya... / May the sacrifice lead the sacrifice, knowing it; / may the sacrifice-slayers not find it. / Announce the sacrifice to the gods; / advance the lord of the sacrifice, svāhā!”—

sanskrit_iast: juhūm̐ sruvaṃ ca saṃmṛjya caturgṛhītenāṣṭagṛhītena dvādaśagṛhītena vā srucaṃ pūrayitvā sapta te \\ iti pūrṇāhutiṃ juhoti //
meaning: जुहूम्̐ स्रुवं च संमृज्य चतुर्गृहीतेनाष्टगृहीतेन द्वादशगृहीतेन वा स्रुचं पूरयित्वा सप्त ते \\ इति पूर्णाहुतिं जुहोति //
text_mt: having wiped clean the juhū and the sruva, filling the ladle with four ladlings, eight ladlings, or twelve ladlings, he offers the full oblation with: “Your seven...”

sanskrit_iast: eṣo 'trāhavanīyo yataḥ praṇīyate sa gārhapatyaḥ /
meaning: एषो ऽत्राहवनीयो यतः प्रणीयते स गार्हपत्यः /
text_mt: This is here the āhavanīya; that from which it is brought forward is the gārhapatya.

sanskrit_iast: āhavanīyaṃ gārhapatyaṃ dakṣiṇāgniṃ cānvādhāyedhmābarhir āharati /
meaning: आहवनीयं गार्हपत्यं दक्षिणाग्निं चान्वाधायेध्माबर्हिर् आहरति /
text_mt: Having fueled the āhavanīya, the gārhapatya, and the dakṣiṇāgni, he brings the firewood and sacrificial grass.

sanskrit_iast: saptadaśa sāmidhenyo na paridhīn idhma upasaṃnahyati /
meaning: सप्तदश सामिधेन्यो न परिधीन् इध्म उपसंनह्यति /
text_mt: There are seventeen enkindling verses; he does not tie the enclosing sticks onto the firewood.

sanskrit_iast: agnīn paristīrya pāṇī prakṣālyolaparājīm̐ stīrtvā /
meaning: अग्नीन् परिस्तीर्य पाणी प्रक्षाल्योलपराजीम्̐ स्तीर्त्वा /
text_mt: Having strewn [grass] around the fires, having washed his hands, having strewn rows of reeds,

sanskrit_iast: yathārthaṃ pāśukāni pātrāṇi prayunakti /
meaning: यथार्थं पाशुकानि पात्राणि प्रयुनक्ति /
text_mt: he lays out the vessels for the animal sacrifice according to need:

sanskrit_iast: sphyam agnihotrahavaṇīm̐ sruvasvadhitī dve juhūvasāhomahavanīṃ dvitīyāṃ dve copabhṛtau pṛṣadājyadhānīṃ dvitīyāṃ dhruvāṃ dve ājyasthālyau dadhidhānīṃ dvitīyāṃ vedaṃ samavattadhānīṃ dve raśane dviguṇāṃ dvivyāyāmāṃ triguṇāṃ trivyāyāmāṃ dve kārṣmaryamayyau vapāśrapaṇyau dviśūlām ekaśūlāṃ ca kumbhīṃ hṛdayaśūlaṃ plakṣaśākhāṃ svaruṃ maitrāvaruṇadaṇḍaṃ yūpaṃ yūpaśakalam araṇī yena cārthaḥ /
meaning: स्फ्यम् अग्निहोत्रहवणीम्̐ स्रुवस्वधिती द्वे जुहूवसाहोमहवनीं द्वितीयां द्वे चोपभृतौ पृषदाज्यधानीं द्वितीयां ध्रुवां द्वे आज्यस्थाल्यौ दधिधानीं द्वितीयां वेदं समवत्तधानीं द्वे रशने द्विगुणां द्विव्यायामां त्रिगुणां त्रिव्यायामां द्वे कार्ष्मर्यमय्यौ वपाश्रपण्यौ द्विशूलाम् एकशूलां च कुम्भीं हृदयशूलं प्लक्षशाखां स्वरुं मैत्रावरुणदण्डं यूपं यूपशकलम् अरणी येन चार्थः /
text_mt: the wooden sword, the agnihotra-ladle, two sruvas and two sacrificial knives, the juhū and the ladle for offering omentum as the second, two upabhṛts and the receptacle for curd-and-butter mixture as the second, the dhruvā, two butter vessels and the curd receptacle as the second, the veda-broom, the container for cut portions, two ropes—one two-stranded and two fathoms long, the other three-stranded and three fathoms long—two omentum-roasting spits made of kārṣmarya wood—one two-pronged and one single-pronged—a pot, a heart-spit, a plakṣa branch, a svaru chip, the staff for the Maitrāvaruṇa, the sacrificial post, a chip of the sacrificial post, two fire-drills, and whatever else is required.

sanskrit_iast: pavitre kṛtvā yajamāna vācaṃ yaccha \\ iti saṃpreṣyati vāgyataḥ pātrāṇi saṃmṛśati /
meaning: पवित्रे कृत्वा यजमान वाचं यच्छ \\ इति संप्रेष्यति वाग्यतः पात्राणि संमृशति /
text_mt: Having made two strainers, he issues the direction: “Sacrificer, restrain your speech!” and, restraining his speech, he touches the vessels.

sanskrit_iast: prokṣiteṣu vācaṃ visṛjate /
meaning: प्रोक्षितेषु वाचं विसृजते /
text_mt: When they have been sprinkled, he releases his speech.

sanskrit_iast: uttaraṃ parigrāhaṃ parigṛhya saṃpraiṣeṇa pratipadyate \\ ājyena dadhnā codehi \\ iti saṃpraiṣasyāntam̐ saṃnamati /
meaning: उत्तरं परिग्राहं परिगृह्य संप्रैषेण प्रतिपद्यते \\ आज्येन दध्ना चोदेहि \\ इति संप्रैषस्यान्तम्̐ संनमति /
text_mt: Having performed the second tracing out [of the altar], he undertakes [the next steps] with a direction: he adapts the end of the direction to: “and come forward with the clarified butter and the curd!”

sanskrit_iast: yat prāg ājyanirvapaṇāt tat kṛtvājyaṃ nirūpya dadhi pṛṣadājyārthaṃ nirvapati /
meaning: यत् प्राग् आज्यनिर्वपणात् तत् कृत्वाज्यं निरूप्य दधि पृषदाज्यार्थं निर्वपति /
text_mt: Having done whatever comes before the scooping out of the clarified butter, and having scooped out the clarified butter, he scoops out curd for the sake of the curd-and-butter mixture.

sanskrit_iast: tasminn ājyadharmāḥ kriyante yad anyad adhiśrayaṇāt /
meaning: तस्मिन्न् आज्यधर्माः क्रियन्ते यद् अन्यद् अधिश्रयणात् /
text_mt: The rites for clarified butter are performed on it, except for placing it on the fire.

sanskrit_iast: ājyagrahaṇakāle juhūpabhṛtoś caturgṛhīte gṛhitvā tṛtīyam ājyasya dadhany ānīya /
meaning: आज्यग्रहणकाले जुहूपभृतोश् चतुर्गृहीते गृहित्वा तृतीयम् आज्यस्य दधन्य् आनीय /
text_mt: At the time of taking the clarified butter, having taken four ladlings into the juhū and upabhṛt, having poured a third portion of the clarified butter into the curd,

sanskrit_iast: jyotir asi viśvarūpaṃ viśveṣāṃ devānām̐ samit \\ iti pañcagṛhītaṃ pṛṣadājyaṃ gṛhṇāti mahīnāṃ payo 'si \\ iti vā /
meaning: ज्योतिर् असि विश्वरूपं विश्वेषां देवानाम्̐ समित् \\ इति पञ्चगृहीतं पृषदाज्यं गृह्णाति महीनां पयो ऽसि \\ इति वा /
text_mt: he takes five ladlings of curd-and-butter mixture with: “You are light, omniform, the kindling-stick of all the gods,” or with: “You are the milk of the great ones.”

sanskrit_iast: yathāprakṛti dhruvāyām /
meaning: यथाप्रकृति ध्रुवायाम् /
text_mt: In the dhruvā, [he takes it] as in the paradigm.

sanskrit_iast: sanneṣv ājyeṣu yūpasaṃmānena pratipadyate /
meaning: सन्नेष्व् आज्येषु यूपसंमानेन प्रतिपद्यते /
text_mt: When the clarified butters have been placed down, he proceeds with the measuring for the sacrificial post.

sanskrit_iast: devasya tvā \\ ity abhrim ādāya parilikhitam iti triḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ yūpāvaṭaṃ parilikhaty ardham antarvedy ardhaṃ bahirvedi /
meaning: देवस्य त्वा \\ इत्य् अभ्रिम् आदाय परिलिखितम् इति त्रिः प्रदक्षिणं यूपावटं परिलिखत्य् अर्धम् अन्तर्वेद्य् अर्धं बहिर्वेदि /
text_mt: Taking the spade with: “At the impulse of the divine...”, he traces around the post-hole three times clockwise with: “It is traced out,” half inside the altar, half outside the altar.

sanskrit_iast: parilikhya \\ agnīd yūpāvaṭaṃ khana \\ uparasaṃmitaṃ dvyaṅgulena tryaṅgulena caturaṅgulena voparam atikhanatāt \\ iti saṃpreṣyati /
meaning: परिलिख्य \\ अग्नीद् यूपावटं खन \\ उपरसंमितं द्व्यङ्गुलेन त्र्यङ्गुलेन चतुरङ्गुलेन वोपरम् अतिखनतात् \\ इति संप्रेष्यति /
text_mt: Having traced it out, he directs: “Āgnīdhra, dig the post-hole! Dig deeper than the butt-end by two finger-breadths, three finger-breadths, or four finger-breadths, measured to the butt-end!”

sanskrit_iast: uparamātraṃ khātvā //
meaning: उपरमात्रं खात्वा //

sanskrit_iast: yat te śilpaḥ parāvadhīt \ takṣā hastena vāśyā / \ āpas te tad yajñiyāḥ \ punantu śucayaḥ śuce \\ iti yūpaṃ prakṣālayati /
meaning: यत् ते शिल्पः परावधीत् \ तक्षा हस्तेन वाश्या / \ आपस् ते तद् यज्ञियाः \ पुनन्तु शुचयः शुचे \\ इति यूपं प्रक्षालयति /
text_mt: he washes the post with: “What the artisan chopped away from you, / the carpenter with his hand [and] the adze, / may the waters, fit for sacrifice, / purify that of yours, pure ones, for the pure!”

sanskrit_iast: yavamatīḥ prokṣaṇīḥ kṛtvā pṛthivyai tvā \\ iti mūlaṃ prokṣati \\ antarikṣāya tvā \\ iti madhyaṃ dive tvā \\ ity agram \\ śundhatāṃ lokaḥ pitṛṣadanas \\ iti yūpāvaṭe 'po 'vanayati /
meaning: यवमतीः प्रोक्षणीः कृत्वा पृथिव्यै त्वा \\ इति मूलं प्रोक्षति \\ अन्तरिक्षाय त्वा \\ इति मध्यं दिवे त्वा \\ इत्य् अग्रम् \\ शुन्धतां लोकः पितृषदनस् \\ इति यूपावटे ऽपो ऽवनयति /
text_mt: Having made sprinkling water with barley, he sprinkles the base with: “For the earth, you!”; the middle with: “For the intermediate space, you!”; the tip with: “For heaven, you!”; and pours water into the post-hole with: “May the realm, the seat of the fathers, be cleansed!”

sanskrit_iast: yavo 'si \\ iti yavaṃ prāsyati pitṝṇām̐ sadanam asi \\ iti prācā barhiṣāvastṛṇāti /
meaning: यवो ऽसि \\ इति यवं प्रास्यति पितॄणाम्̐ सदनम् असि \\ इति प्राचा बर्हिषावस्तृणाति /
text_mt: With: “You are barley,” he throws in barley; with: “You are the seat of the fathers,” he strews it with sacrificial grass pointing eastward.

sanskrit_iast: svāveśo 'si \\ iti pratham aparāpātitam̐ śakalam adhastātvakkam avaṭe 'vadadhāti ghṛtena dyāvāpṛthivī āpṛṇethām̐ svāhā \\ iti hiraṇyam antardhāya sruveṇābhijuhoti /
meaning: स्वावेशो ऽसि \\ इति प्रथम् अपरापातितम्̐ शकलम् अधस्तात्वक्कम् अवटे ऽवदधाति घृतेन द्यावापृथिवी आपृणेथाम्̐ स्वाहा \\ इति हिरण्यम् अन्तर्धाय स्रुवेणाभिजुहोति /
text_mt: With: “You are an easy entrance,” he places into the hole the chip that fell off first, with its bark downward; with: “Fill heaven and earth with ghee, svāhā!” having placed a piece of gold over it, he offers upon it with the sruva.

sanskrit_iast: yūpāyājyamānāyānubrūhi \\ iti saṃpreṣyati \\ ajyamānāyānubrūhi \\ iti vāgreṇāhavanīyaṃ laukikenājyena purastāt pratyaṅ tiṣṭhan yajamāno yūpaśakalenānakti /
meaning: यूपायाज्यमानायानुब्रूहि \\ इति संप्रेष्यति \\ अज्यमानायानुब्रूहि \\ इति वाग्रेणाहवनीयं लौकिकेनाज्येन पुरस्तात् प्रत्यङ् तिष्ठन् यजमानो यूपशकलेनानक्ति /
text_mt: He issues the direction: “Recite [the verses] for the post being anointed!” or: “Recite [the verses] for [it] being anointed!” In front of the āhavanīya, standing to the east and facing west, the sacrificer anoints [the post] with ordinary clarified butter using a chip of the sacrificial post.

sanskrit_iast: laukikeneti /
meaning: लौकिकेनेति /

sanskrit_iast: devasas tvā savitā madhvānaktu \\ ity agram aindram asi \\ iti caṣālam /
meaning: देवसस् त्वा सविता मध्वानक्तु \\ इत्य् अग्रम् ऐन्द्रम् असि \\ इति चषालम् /
text_mt: With: “May the divine Savitṛ anoint you with honey,” [he anoints] the tip; with: “Belonging to Indra are you,” [he anoints] the post-cap.

sanskrit_iast: supippalābhyas tvauṣadhībhyas \\ iti caṣālaṃ pratimuñcati /
meaning: सुपिप्पलाभ्यस् त्वौषधीभ्यस् \\ इति चषालं प्रतिमुञ्चति /
text_mt: With: “For the plants rich in good berries, you,” he attaches the post-cap.

sanskrit_iast: devas tvā savitā madhvānaktu \\ ity āntam agniṣṭhām aśrim anakti /
meaning: देवस् त्वा सविता मध्वानक्तु \\ इत्य् आन्तम् अग्निष्ठाम् अश्रिम् अनक्ति /
text_mt: With: “May the divine Savitṛ anoint you with honey,” he anoints up to the end the corner that faces the fire.

sanskrit_iast: raśanādeśe triḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ parimṛśati madhye vā /
meaning: रशनादेशे त्रिः प्रदक्षिणं परिमृशति मध्ये वा /
text_mt: At the place of the girdle, he strokes it around clockwise three times, or in the middle.

sanskrit_iast: anaktam uparam /
meaning: अनक्तम् उपरम् /

sanskrit_iast: āñjanaprabhṛti yajamāno yūpaṃ nānūtsṛjaty ā parivyayaṇāt /
meaning: आञ्जनप्रभृति यजमानो यूपं नानूत्सृजत्य् आ परिव्ययणात् /
text_mt: From the anointing onward, the sacrificer does not release hold of the sacrificial post until the girding.

sanskrit_iast: yūpāyocchrīyamāṇāyānubrūhi \\ iti saṃpreṣyati \\ ucchrīyamāṇāyānubrūhi \\ iti vā /
meaning: यूपायोच्छ्रीयमाणायानुब्रूहि \\ इति संप्रेष्यति \\ उच्छ्रीयमाणायानुब्रूहि \\ इति वा /
text_mt: He issues the direction: “Recite [the verses] for the post being erected!” or: “Recite [the verses] for [it] being erected!”

sanskrit_iast: ud divam̐ stabhāna \\ antarikṣam ity ucchrayati /
meaning: उद् दिवम्̐ स्तभान \\ अन्तरिक्षम् इत्य् उच्छ्रयति /
text_mt: With: “Prop up the heaven! / The intermediate space...”, he erects it.

sanskrit_iast: te te dhāmāni \\ ity avaṭe 'vadadhāti /
meaning: ते ते धामानि \\ इत्य् अवटे ऽवदधाति /
text_mt: With: “These are your abodes,” he sets it down into the hole.

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇoḥ karmāṇi paśyata \\ iti dvābhyāṃ kalpayaty agnināgniṣṭhāṃ sadiśaṃ minoti //
meaning: विष्णोः कर्माणि पश्यत \\ इति द्वाभ्यां कल्पयत्य् अग्निनाग्निष्ठां सदिशं मिनोति //
text_mt: With the two [verses]: “Look upon the deeds of Viṣṇu...”, he adjusts it; he fixes it with its fire-facing corner aligned with the fire.

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ kāmayeta tejasainaṃ devatābhir indriyeṇa vyardhayeyam ity agniṣṭhāṃ tasyāśrim āhavanīyād itthaṃ vetthaṃ vātināvayet tejasaivainaṃ devatābhir indriyeṇa vyardhayati yaṃ kāmayeta tejasainaṃ devatābhir indriyeṇa samardhyeyam ity agniṣṭhāṃ tasyāśrim āhavanīyena saṃminuyāt /
meaning: यं कामयेत तेजसैनं देवताभिर् इन्द्रियेण व्यर्धयेयम् इत्य् अग्निष्ठां तस्याश्रिम् आहवनीयाद् इत्थं वेत्थं वातिनावयेत् तेजसैवैनं देवताभिर् इन्द्रियेण व्यर्धयति यं कामयेत तेजसैनं देवताभिर् इन्द्रियेण समर्ध्येयम् इत्य् अग्निष्ठां तस्याश्रिम् आहवनीयेन संमिनुयात् /
text_mt: If he should desire of someone: “May I deprive him of fiery energy, deities, and sense-power,” he should slant that corner of his that faces the fire this way or that way away from the āhavanīya: he deprives him indeed of fiery energy, deities, and sense-power. If he should desire of someone: “May I enrich him with fiery energy, deities, and sense-power,” he should fix that corner of his that faces the fire in direct line with the āhavanīya.

sanskrit_iast: agniṃ pratyupanataṃ bahiṣṭhe nirṇutam anāvir uparaṃ saṃminoti /
meaning: अग्निं प्रत्युपनतं बहिष्ठे निर्णुतम् अनाविर् उपरं संमिनोति /
text_mt: He fixes it inclined toward the fire, hidden in the outermost part, with its butt-end not exposed.

sanskrit_iast: brahmavaniṃ tvā \\ iti pradakṣiṇaṃ purīṣeṇa paryūhati /
meaning: ब्रह्मवनिं त्वा \\ इति प्रदक्षिणं पुरीषेण पर्यूहति /
text_mt: With: “You, winning the brahman,” he heaps soil around it clockwise.

sanskrit_iast: brahma dṛm̐ha \\ iti maitrāvaruṇadaṇḍena paridṛm̐hati /
meaning: ब्रह्म दृम्̐ह \\ इति मैत्रावरुणदण्डेन परिदृम्̐हति /
text_mt: With: “Make the brahman firm,” he rams it firm with the Maitrāvaruṇa's staff.

sanskrit_iast: unnambhaya pṛthivīm iti pradakṣiṇam apo 'nupariṣiñcati /
meaning: उन्नम्भय पृथिवीम् इति प्रदक्षिणम् अपो ऽनुपरिषिञ्चति /
text_mt: With: “Make the earth swell,” he sprinkles water around it clockwise.

sanskrit_iast: devasya tvā \\ iti triguṇāṃ trivyāyāmāṃ dārvīm̐ raśanām ādāya /
meaning: देवस्य त्वा \\ इति त्रिगुणां त्रिव्यायामां दार्वीम्̐ रशनाम् आदाय /
text_mt: Taking a three-stranded rope, three fathoms long, made of muñja grass, with: “At the impulse of the divine...”,

sanskrit_iast: idaṃ viṣṇur vicakrame \\ iti saraśanena pāṇinā yūpaṃ trir unmārṣṭi /
meaning: इदं विष्णुर् विचक्रमे \\ इति सरशनेन पाणिना यूपं त्रिर् उन्मार्ष्टि /
text_mt: with: “This Viṣṇu strode out,” he wipes upward along the post three times with the hand holding the rope.

sanskrit_iast: tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam iti yūpasyāgraṃ prekṣate /
meaning: तद् विष्णोः परमं पदम् इति यूपस्याग्रं प्रेक्षते /
text_mt: With: “That highest step of Viṣṇu,” he looks at the top of the post.

sanskrit_iast: yūpāya parivīyamāṇāyānubrūhi \\ iti saṃpreṣyati parivīyamāṇāyānubrūhi \\ iti vā /
meaning: यूपाय परिवीयमाणायानुब्रूहि \\ इति संप्रेष्यति परिवीयमाणायानुब्रूहि \\ इति वा /
text_mt: He issues the direction: “Recite [the verses] for the post being girded!” or: “Recite [the verses] for [it] being girded!”

sanskrit_iast: parivīr asi \\ iti tayā nābhideśe triḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ parivyayati madhye vā /
meaning: परिवीर् असि \\ इति तया नाभिदेशे त्रिः प्रदक्षिणं परिव्ययति मध्ये वा /
text_mt: With: “You are girded,” he winds it around clockwise three times at the level of the navel, or in the middle.

sanskrit_iast: uttaramuttaraṃ guṇaṃ karoti /
meaning: उत्तरमुत्तरं गुणं करोति /
text_mt: He places each subsequent winding higher.

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ kāmayetorjainaṃ vyardhayeyam ity ūrdhvāṃ vā tasyāvācīṃ vāvohet /
meaning: यं कामयेतोर्जैनं व्यर्धयेयम् इत्य् ऊर्ध्वां वा तस्यावाचीं वावोहेत् /
text_mt: If he should desire of someone: “May I deprive him of nourishment,” he should tuck its [end] either facing upward or facing downward.

sanskrit_iast: yadi kāmayeta varṣukaḥ parjanyaḥ syād ity avācīm avohet /
meaning: यदि कामयेत वर्षुकः पर्जन्यः स्याद् इत्य् अवाचीम् अवोहेत् /
text_mt: If he should desire: “May Parjanya bring rain,” he should tuck it facing downward.

sanskrit_iast: yadi kāmayetāvarṣukaḥ syād ity ūrdhvām udūhet /
meaning: यदि कामयेतावर्षुकः स्याद् इत्य् ऊर्ध्वाम् उदूहेत् /
text_mt: If he should desire: “May he not bring rain,” he should tuck it facing upward.

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ kāmayeta stry asya jāyetety upānte tasya vyatiṣajya na praveṣṭayed yaṃ kāmayeta pumān asya jāyetety āntaṃ tasya praveṣṭya sthavimad aṇīyasi pravayati /
meaning: यं कामयेत स्त्र्य् अस्य जायेतेत्य् उपान्ते तस्य व्यतिषज्य न प्रवेष्टयेद् यं कामयेत पुमान् अस्य जायेतेत्य् आन्तं तस्य प्रवेष्ट्य स्थविमद् अणीयसि प्रवयति /
text_mt: If he wishes that a female should be born to him, having intertwined [the girdle] near its end, he should not tuck it in. If he wishes that a male should be born to him, having tucked it in completely to the end, he weaves the thicker [end] into the thinner.

sanskrit_iast: divaḥ sānur asi \\ iti svarum ādatte divaḥ sūnur asi \\ iti vā divaḥ sānūpeṣa \\ iti vā \\ antarikṣasya tvā sānāv avagūhāmi \\ ity uttareṇāgniṣṭhāṃ madhyame guṇe svarum upagūhaty uttame vā //
meaning: दिवः सानुर् असि \\ इति स्वरुम् आदत्ते दिवः सूनुर् असि \\ इति वा दिवः सानूपेष \\ इति वा \\ अन्तरिक्षस्य त्वा सानाव् अवगूहामि \\ इत्य् उत्तरेणाग्निष्ठां मध्यमे गुणे स्वरुम् उपगूहत्य् उत्तमे वा //
text_mt: He takes up the chip of the sacrificial post with: "You are the summit of heaven," or with: "You are the son of heaven," or with: "The summit of heaven..."; with: "I hide you in the summit of the intermediate space," he tucks the chip in to the north of the agniṣṭhā facet in the middle fold [of the girdle], or in the top one.

sanskrit_iast: upakḷptaḥ paśur akūṭo 'karṇo 'kāṇo 'khañjo 'khaṇḍo 'ṣaṇḍho 'ghṛṣṭo 'śloṇo 'saptaśaphaḥ pannadañ chāgo yamānyataro yūthyo mātṛmān pitṛmān bhrātṛmān sakhimām̐s tam̐ snāpayati /
meaning: उपकॢप्तः पशुर् अकूटो ऽकर्णो ऽकाणो ऽखञ्जो ऽखण्डो ऽषण्ढो ऽघृष्टो ऽश्लोणो ऽसप्तशफः पन्नदञ् छागो यमान्यतरो यूथ्यो मातृमान् पितृमान् भ्रातृमान् सखिमाम्̐स् तम्̐ स्नापयति /
text_mt: The animal has been prepared: not hornless, not earless, not one-eyed, not lame, not mutilated, not a gelding, not mangy, not limping, not seven-hoofed, having shed its milk teeth, a he-goat, one of twins, belonging to a herd, having a mother, a father, a brother, and a companion. He bathes it.

sanskrit_iast: iṣe tvā \\ iti barhiṣī ādātte /
meaning: इषे त्वा \\ इति बर्हिषी आदात्ते /
text_mt: With: "For food you [I take]," he takes two blades of sacrificial grass.

sanskrit_iast: upavīr asi \\ iti plakṣaśākhām /
meaning: उपवीर् असि \\ इति प्लक्षशाखाम् /
text_mt: With: "You are the approacher," [he takes] a branch of the plakṣa tree.

sanskrit_iast: indrāgnibhyāṃ tvā juṣṭam upākaromi \\ upo devān daivīr viśaḥ \ prajāpater jāyamānās \\ imaṃ paśuṃ paśupate te \\ iti barhirbhyāṃ plakṣaśākhayā ca paśum upākaroti /
meaning: इन्द्राग्निभ्यां त्वा जुष्टम् उपाकरोमि \\ उपो देवान् दैवीर् विशः \ प्रजापतेर् जायमानास् \\ इमं पशुं पशुपते ते \\ इति बर्हिर्भ्यां प्लक्षशाखया च पशुम् उपाकरोति /
text_mt: With: "I dedicate you acceptable to Indra and Agni," "Approaching the gods, the divine subjects...", "Being born of Prajāpati...", and "This victim for you, O Lord of cattle!", he dedicates the victim with the two blades of grass and the plakṣa branch.

sanskrit_iast: prajānantas \\ ity upākṛtya pañca juhoti /
meaning: प्रजानन्तस् \\ इत्य् उपाकृत्य पञ्च जुहोति /
text_mt: Having dedicated [it], he offers five oblations with: "Knowing..."

sanskrit_iast: paśupateḥ paśavas \\ virūpāḥ sadṛśā uta / \ teṣāṃ yaṃ vivrire devās \ tam̐ svarāḍ anumanyatām iti vā madhye pañcamīṃ juhoti /
meaning: पशुपतेः पशवस् \\ विरूपाः सदृशा उत / \ तेषां यं विव्रिरे देवास् \ तम्̐ स्वराड् अनुमन्यताम् इति वा मध्ये पञ्चमीं जुहोति /
text_mt: Or in the middle he offers the fifth with: / "The victims of the Lord of cattle / are of different forms and similar; / whichever of them the gods chose, / let the sovereign ruler consent to that."

sanskrit_iast: agner janitram asi \\ ity adhimanthanaśakalam ādāyāpareṇāhavanīyaṃ barhiṣi nidadhāti /
meaning: अग्नेर् जनित्रम् असि \\ इत्य् अधिमन्थनशकलम् आदायापरेणाहवनीयं बर्हिषि निदधाति /
