sanskrit_iast: ekādaśasu dvādaśasu vā kapāleṣu pratiprasthātā meṣīm adhiśrayaty aṣṭasu meṣam adhiśrityādhvaryuḥ kāyam ekakapālam adhiśrayati /
meaning: एकादशसु द्वादशसु वा कपालेषु प्रतिप्रस्थाता मेषीम् अधिश्रयत्य् अष्टसु मेषम् अधिश्रित्याध्वर्युः कायम् एककपालम् अधिश्रयति /
text_mt: The pratiprasthātā sets the ewe [to bake] upon eleven or twelve potsherds; having set the ram [to bake] upon eight [potsherds], the adhvaryu sets the single-potsherd [cake] for Ka [to bake].

sanskrit_iast: kumbhīpākyau vā meṣau bhavataḥ /
meaning: कुम्भीपाक्यौ वा मेषौ भवतः /
text_mt: Or both rams are cooked in a pot.

sanskrit_iast: anyeṣāṃ laukikānām āmapeṣāṇām īṣadupataptānāṃ yavānāṃ karambhapātrāṇi kuruto yajamānaḥ patnī ca /
meaning: अन्येषां लौकिकानाम् आमपेषाणाम् ईषदुपतप्तानां यवानां करम्भपात्राणि कुरुतो यजमानः पत्नी च /
text_mt: Out of other, worldly barley, unground [and] slightly parched, the sacrificer and his wife make porridge dishes.

sanskrit_iast: yāvanto yajāmānasya preṣyāmātyāḥ sastrīkās tata ekādhikāni /
meaning: यावन्तो यजामानस्य प्रेष्यामात्याः सस्त्रीकास् तत एकाधिकानि /
text_mt: As many servants and dependants of the sacrificer as there are, along with their wives, one more than that [number of dishes].

sanskrit_iast: uttaraṃ parigrāhaṃ parigṛhya saṃpraiṣeṇa pratipadyate \\ ājyena dadhnā codehi \\ iti saṃpraiṣasyāntam̐ saṃnamataḥ /
meaning: उत्तरं परिग्राहं परिगृह्य संप्रैषेण प्रतिपद्यते \\ आज्येन दध्ना चोदेहि \\ इति संप्रैषस्यान्तम्̐ संनमतः /
text_mt: Having traced the northern boundary, he proceeds with the ritual direction: 'Come forward with the clarified butter and the curd'; thus the two adapt the end of the ritual direction.

sanskrit_iast: āṣāḍhyāṃ yathā phālgunyām evaṃ pṛṣadājyaṃ gṛhṇītaḥ /
meaning: आषाढ्यां यथा फाल्गुन्याम् एवं पृषदाज्यं गृह्णीतः /
text_mt: At the full moon of Āṣāḍha, just as at that of Phālguna, so they take the curd-mixed clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: śrāvaṇyāṃ tu sakṛd ājyasyopastīrya dvir dadhi gṛhītvā sakṛd ājyenābhighārayataḥ /
meaning: श्रावण्यां तु सकृद् आज्यस्योपस्तीर्य द्विर् दधि गृहीत्वा सकृद् आज्येनाभिघारयतः /
text_mt: At the full moon of Śrāvaṇa, however, having under-layered once with clarified butter, having taken curd twice, they baste once with clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: udvāsanaprabhṛtīni karmāṇi pratipadyate /
meaning: उद्वासनप्रभृतीनि कर्माणि प्रतिपद्यते /
text_mt: He proceeds with the rites beginning with the taking off [from the fire].

sanskrit_iast: aindrāgnaparyanteṣv alaṃkṛteṣv anaiḍakībhir ūrṇābhir meṣapratikṛtī lomaśau kurutas tāsv āsv avidyamānāsu kuśorṇāni śleṣayataḥ /
meaning: ऐन्द्राग्नपर्यन्तेष्व् अलंकृतेष्व् अनैडकीभिर् ऊर्णाभिर् मेषप्रतिकृती लोमशौ कुरुतस् तास्व् आस्व् अविद्यमानासु कुशोर्णानि श्लेषयतः /
text_mt: When the oblations up to the one to Indra-Agni have been adorned, they make both ram effigies woolly with sheep's wool; if that is not available, they stick kuśa-grass filaments [onto them].

sanskrit_iast: mārutyāṃ meṣam avadadhāti vāruṇyāṃ meṣīm /
meaning: मारुत्यां मेषम् अवदधाति वारुण्यां मेषीम् /
text_mt: He places the ram into the oblation for the Maruts, and the ewe into the oblation for Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast: uttarasyāṃ vedyām anyāni havīm̐ṣi sādayati dakṣiṇāyāṃ mārutīṃ karambhapātrāṇi ca /
meaning: उत्तरस्यां वेद्याम् अन्यानि हवीम्̐षि सादयति दक्षिणायां मारुतीं करम्भपात्राणि च /
text_mt: On the northern altar he places the other oblations; on the southern [altar] the oblation for the Maruts and the porridge dishes.

sanskrit_iast: āsādya meṣapratikṛtī vipariharato mārutyāṃ meṣīm avadadhāti vāruṇyāṃ meṣam /
meaning: आसाद्य मेषप्रतिकृती विपरिहरतो मारुत्यां मेषीम् अवदधाति वारुण्यां मेषम् /
text_mt: Having placed them, they exchange the two ram effigies: he places the ewe into the oblation for the Maruts, and the ram into the oblation for Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast: tayoḥ paraḥśatāni paraḥsahasrāṇi vā śamīparṇakarīrāṇy upavapataḥ karambhapātreṣu cāvapati /
meaning: तयोः परःशतानि परःसहस्राणि वा शमीपर्णकरीराण्य् उपवपतः करम्भपात्रेषु चावपति /
text_mt: On both of them they scatter more than a hundred or more than a thousand śamī-leaves and karīra-fruits, and he scatters [some] into the porridge dishes.

sanskrit_iast: niramnthyasyāvṛtā nirmanthyena pracarataḥ /
meaning: निरम्न्थ्यस्यावृता निर्मन्थ्येन प्रचरतः /
text_mt: According to the procedure for the churned fire, the two proceed with the churned fire.

sanskrit_iast: vedaṃ nidhāya sāmidhenībhyaḥ saṃpreṣyati /
meaning: वेदं निधाय सामिधेनीभ्यः संप्रेष्यति /
text_mt: Having laid down the grass brush, he gives the ritual direction for the sāmidhenī verses.

sanskrit_iast: saṃmṛṣṭa uttare 'gnāv asaṃmṛṣṭe dakṣiṇe pratiprasthātā patnīṃ pṛcchati patni kati te jārās \\ iti sā yāvataḥ prabrūyāt tān varuṇo gṛhṇātu \\ iti nirdiśati yaj jāram̐ santaṃ na prabrūyāt priyaṃ jñātim̐ rundhyāt /
meaning: संमृष्ट उत्तरे ऽग्नाव् असंमृष्टे दक्षिणे प्रतिप्रस्थाता पत्नीं पृच्छति पत्नि कति ते जारास् \\ इति सा यावतः प्रब्रूयात् तान् वरुणो गृह्णातु \\ इति निर्दिशति यज् जारम्̐ सन्तं न प्रब्रूयात् प्रियं ज्ञातिम्̐ रुन्ध्यात् /
text_mt: When the northern fire has been swept and the southern has not been swept, the pratiprasthātā asks the sacrificer's wife: 'O wife, how many lovers do you have?' As many as she confesses, he indicates: 'May Varuṇa seize them.' If she should not confess someone who is a lover, she would injure a dear relative.

sanskrit_iast: praghāsyān havāmahe \\ iti pratiprasthātā patnīm udānayati /
meaning: प्रघास्यान् हवामहे \\ इति प्रतिप्रस्थाता पत्नीम् उदानयति /
text_mt: With 'We invoke the voracious ones...', the pratiprasthātā leads the sacrificer's wife forward.

sanskrit_iast: aiṣīke śūrpe karambhapātrāṇy uptāni patnī śīrṣann adhi nidhāyāntarā vedī gatvāgreṇa dakṣiṇam agniṃ pratyañcāv avatiṣṭhete yajamānaḥ patnī ca /
meaning: ऐषीके शूर्पे करम्भपात्राण्य् उप्तानि पत्नी शीर्षन्न् अधि निधायान्तरा वेदी गत्वाग्रेण दक्षिणम् अग्निं प्रत्यञ्चाव् अवतिष्ठेते यजमानः पत्नी च /
text_mt: The porridge dishes having been poured into a winnowing basket of reeds, the sacrificer's wife, placing it upon her head, having gone between the two altars, the sacrificer and his wife stand facing west in front of the southern fire.

sanskrit_iast: mo ṣū ṇas \\ iti yajamānaḥ puronuvākyām anvāha yad grāme \\ ity ubhau saṃnigadya śūrpeṇa dakṣiṇe 'gnau juhutaḥ /
meaning: मो षू णस् \\ इति यजमानः पुरोनुवाक्याम् अन्वाह यद् ग्रामे \\ इत्य् उभौ संनिगद्य शूर्पेण दक्षिणे ऽग्नौ जुहुतः /
text_mt: With 'Do not, [O gods]...', the sacrificer recites the introductory verse; having both uttered together, 'What [evil we committed] in the village...', they offer [the dishes] into the southern fire with the winnowing basket.

sanskrit_iast: adhvaryur vā juhoty anvārabhete itarau /
meaning: अध्वर्युर् वा जुहोत्य् अन्वारभेते इतरौ /
text_mt: Or the adhvaryu offers, while the other two touch him from behind.

sanskrit_iast: akran karma karmakṛtas \\ iti viparāyantau japataḥ /
meaning: अक्रन् कर्म कर्मकृतस् \\ इति विपरायन्तौ जपतः /
text_mt: Walking away in opposite directions, they murmur: 'The workers have done the work...'

sanskrit_iast: samārṣṭi dakṣiṇam agnim /
meaning: समार्ष्टि दक्षिणम् अग्निम् /
text_mt: He sweeps the southern fire.

sanskrit_iast: aindrāgnaparyantaiḥ pracarite /
meaning: ऐन्द्राग्नपर्यन्तैः प्रचरिते /
text_mt: When the rites have been performed up to [the oblation for] Indra-Agni,

sanskrit_iast: pratiprasthātā mārutyāḥ pūrveṇa sahāvadānena kṛtsnāṃ meṣīm avadyaty uttareṇa śamīparṇakarīrāṇi /
meaning: प्रतिप्रस्थाता मारुत्याः पूर्वेण सहावदानेन कृत्स्नां मेषीम् अवद्यत्य् उत्तरेण शमीपर्णकरीराणि /
text_mt: the pratiprasthātā cuts off the entire ewe along with the first cutting of the oblation for the Maruts, and the śamī-leaves and karīra-fruits with the second.

sanskrit_iast: adhvaryur vāruṇyāḥ pūrveṇa sahāvadānena kṛtsnaṃ meṣam avadyaty uttareṇa śamīparṇakarīrāṇi /
meaning: अध्वर्युर् वारुण्याः पूर्वेण सहावदानेन कृत्स्नं मेषम् अवद्यत्य् उत्तरेण शमीपर्णकरीराणि /
text_mt: The adhvaryu cuts off the entire ram along with the first cutting of the oblation for Varuṇa, and the śamī-leaves and karīra-fruits with the second.

sanskrit_iast: kāyānubrūhi \ kaṃ yaja \\ iti //
meaning: कायानुब्रूहि \ कं यज \\ इति //
text_mt: 'Recite for Ka; sacrifice to Ka.'

sanskrit_iast: ekakapāle saṃpreṣyati /
meaning: एककपाले संप्रेष्यति /
text_mt: He gives the ritual direction for the single-potsherd oblation.

sanskrit_iast: nabhaś ca nabhasyaś ca \\ iti caturbhir māsanāmabhir ekakapālam abhijuhoti nabhase svāhā nabhasyāya svāhā \\ iti vā /
meaning: नभश् च नभस्यश् च \\ इति चतुर्भिर् मासनामभिर् एककपालम् अभिजुहोति नभसे स्वाहा नभस्याय स्वाहा \\ इति वा /
text_mt: With the four names of the months, 'Nabhas and Nabhasya...', he makes an offering over the single-potsherd cake, or with: 'Svāhā to Nabhas, svāhā to Nabhasya...'

sanskrit_iast: parivatsarīṇām̐ svastim āśāste \\ iti sūktavākasyāśīḥṣu hotānuvartayati /
meaning: परिवत्सरीणाम्̐ स्वस्तिम् आशास्ते \\ इति सूक्तवाकस्याशीःषु होतानुवर्तयति /
text_mt: The hotṛ repeats in the benedictions of the sūktavāka: 'He hopes for the well-being of the full year.'

sanskrit_iast: prahṛteṣu paridhiṣu sam̐srāveṇābhihutya vājinena pracarataḥ /
meaning: प्रहृतेषु परिधिषु सम्̐स्रावेणाभिहुत्य वाजिनेन प्रचरतः /
text_mt: When the enclosing sticks have been thrown [into the fire], having offered over [them] with the remnants, the two proceed with the whey.

sanskrit_iast: yathā purastāt /
meaning: यथा पुरस्तात् /

sanskrit_iast: yan me retaḥ prasicyate \ yan ma ājāyate punaḥ / \ yad vā me pratitiṣṭhati \ tena mā vājinaṃ kuru \ tena suprajasaṃ kuru \ tasya te vājin vājibhir bhakṣaṃ kṛtasya madhumata upahūtasyopahūto bhakṣayāmi \\ iti dakṣiṇe vihāre bhakṣayanti /
meaning: यन् मे रेतः प्रसिच्यते \ यन् म आजायते पुनः / \ यद् वा मे प्रतितिष्ठति \ तेन मा वाजिनं कुरु \ तेन सुप्रजसं कुरु \ तस्य ते वाजिन् वाजिभिर् भक्षं कृतस्य मधुमत उपहूतस्योपहूतो भक्षयामि \\ इति दक्षिणे विहारे भक्षयन्ति /
text_mt: They consume [the whey] in the southern sacrificial area with: 'Whatever semen of mine is poured out, whatever is born to me again, or whatever is firmly established in me, by that make me a possessor of strength; by that make me possessor of good offspring. Of you, O whey, who have been consumed by the strong, sweet, being invited, I consume, being invited.'

sanskrit_iast: ā mā viśantv indavas \\ ā gaglā dhamanīnām / \ rasena me rasaṃ pṛṇa \ tasya te vājin vājibhir bhakṣaṃ kṛtasya madhumata upahūtasyopahūto bhakṣayāmi \\ ity uttare /
meaning: आ मा विशन्त्व् इन्दवस् \\ आ गग्ला धमनीनाम् / \ रसेन मे रसं पृण \ तस्य ते वाजिन् वाजिभिर् भक्षं कृतस्य मधुमत उपहूतस्योपहूतो भक्षयामि \\ इत्य् उत्तरे /
text_mt: In the northern [area, they consume it] with: 'May the drops enter into me, the swelling currents of the vessels. Fill my sap with sap. Of you, O whey, who have been consumed by the strong, sweet, being invited, I consume, being invited.'

sanskrit_iast: sam̐sthāpya vāruṇyā niṣkāsena tuṣaiś cāvabhṛtham avayanti tasya saumikenāvabhṛthena kalpo vyākhyātaḥ /
meaning: सम्̐स्थाप्य वारुण्या निष्कासेन तुषैश् चावभृथम् अवयन्ति तस्य सौमिकेनावभृथेन कल्पो व्याख्यातः /
text_mt: Having concluded, with the scraped-out portion of the oblation for Varuṇa and with the husks, they go down to the purificatory bath; its procedure has been explained by the purificatory bath of the soma sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: na sāma gīyate /
meaning: न साम गीयते /

sanskrit_iast: tūṣṇīm eva paretya /
meaning: तूष्णीम् एव परेत्य /

sanskrit_iast: vāruṇasya dharmeṇa niṣkāsaṃ pratipādya /
meaning: वारुणस्य धर्मेण निष्कासं प्रतिपाद्य /
text_mt: having disposed of the scraped-out portion according to the rule for Varuṇa,

sanskrit_iast: tuṣān ṛjīṣadharmeṇa pratipādayati /
meaning: तुषान् ऋजीषधर्मेण प्रतिपादयति /
text_mt: he disposes of the husks according to the rule for the soma residue.

sanskrit_iast: avabhṛthād udetya vāsasī yasmai kāmayete tasmai dattaḥ /
meaning: अवभृथाद् उदेत्य वाससी यस्मै कामयेते तस्मै दत्तः /
text_mt: Having come up from the purificatory bath, they give their two garments to whomever they wish.

sanskrit_iast: śvo bhūte paurṇamāseneṣṭvodavasāyānudavasāya vā prasūtā devena savitrā \\ ity undati /
meaning: श्वो भूते पौर्णमासेनेष्ट्वोदवसायानुदवसाय वा प्रसूता देवेन सवित्रा \\ इत्य् उन्दति /
text_mt: On the next day, having sacrificed with the full-moon rite, having departed or having not departed, he moistens [the hair] with: 'Impelled by the god Savitṛ...'

sanskrit_iast: yad gharmaḥ paryavartayat \\ antān pṛthivyā divas \\ agnir īśāna ojasā \ varuṇo dhītibhiḥ saha \\ indro marudbhiḥ sakhibhiḥ saha \\ agnis tigmena śociṣā \\ iti nivartanaṃ vāpanaṃ yathā purastāt //
meaning: यद् घर्मः पर्यवर्तयत् \\ अन्तान् पृथिव्या दिवस् \\ अग्निर् ईशान ओजसा \ वरुणो धीतिभिः सह \\ इन्द्रो मरुद्भिः सखिभिः सह \\ अग्निस् तिग्मेन शोचिषा \\ इति निवर्तनं वापनं यथा पुरस्तात् //
text_mt: The turning [of the hair] and the shaving are as before, with: 'When the Gharma overturned the limits of earth and heaven; Agni, ruling through might; Varuṇa along with prayers; Indra along with the Maruts, his companions; Agni with sharp brilliance.'

sanskrit_iast: tataś caturṣu māseṣu kārtikyāṃ mārgaśīrṣyāṃ vā dvyaham̐ sākamedhair yajate /
meaning: ततश् चतुर्षु मासेषु कार्तिक्यां मार्गशीर्ष्यां वा द्व्यहम्̐ साकमेधैर् यजते /
text_mt: Then, after four months, at the full moon of Kārttika or Mārgaśīrṣa, he sacrifices for two days with the Sākamedha offerings.

sanskrit_iast: agnaye 'nīkavate puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapati sākam̐ sūryeṇodyatā sākam̐ raśmibhiḥ pracarantīty ekeṣāṃ marudbhyaḥ sāṃtapanebhyo madhyaṃdine caruṃ na barhir anupraharatīty ekeṣām aparāhṇe gṛhamedhīyāya vatsān apākaroti yāvanto yajamānasyāyajuṣkeṇa vatsān apākarotīty ekeṣām /
meaning: अग्नये ऽनीकवते पुरोडाशम् अष्टाकपालं निर्वपति साकम्̐ सूर्येणोद्यता साकम्̐ रश्मिभिः प्रचरन्तीत्य् एकेषां मरुद्भ्यः सांतपनेभ्यो मध्यंदिने चरुं न बर्हिर् अनुप्रहरतीत्य् एकेषाम् अपराह्णे गृहमेधीयाय वत्सान् अपाकरोति यावन्तो यजमानस्यायजुष्केण वत्सान् अपाकरोतीत्य् एकेषाम् /
text_mt: He offers a cake on eight potsherds to Agni Anīkavat, rising together with the sun; 'they proceed together with its rays,' according to some; at midday a mess of boiled rice to the Santapana Maruts; 'he does not throw the sacrificial grass [into the fire],' according to some; in the afternoon he drives away the calves for the Gṛhamedhīya rite—as many as the sacrificer owns; 'he drives away the calves without a mantra,' according to some.

sanskrit_iast: sāyam̐ hute 'gnihotre gṛhamedhīyasya tantraṃ prakramayati /
meaning: सायम्̐ हुते ऽग्निहोत्रे गृहमेधीयस्य तन्त्रं प्रक्रमयति /
text_mt: In the evening, when the Agnihotra has been offered, he commences the framework of the Gṛhamedhīya rite.

sanskrit_iast: tatra yāvat kriyate tad vyākhyāsyāmaḥ /
meaning: तत्र यावत् क्रियते तद् व्याख्यास्यामः /
text_mt: In that regard, as much as is done, that we shall explain.

sanskrit_iast: agnīn anvādhāya vedaṃ kṛtvāgnīn paristīrya pāṇī prakṣālyolaparājīm̐ stīrtvā yathārthaṃ pātrāṇi prayunakti /
meaning: अग्नीन् अन्वाधाय वेदं कृत्वाग्नीन् परिस्तीर्य पाणी प्रक्षाल्योलपराजीम्̐ स्तीर्त्वा यथार्थं पात्राणि प्रयुनक्ति /
text_mt: Having fueled the fires, fashioned the grass brush, strewn around the fires, washed both hands, strewn a line of coarse grass, he sets out the utensils as needed:

sanskrit_iast: kumbhīṃ tisraś ca pātrīḥ /
meaning: कुम्भीं तिस्रश् च पात्रीः /
text_mt: the pot and three shallow vessels.

sanskrit_iast: nirvapaṇakāle marudbhyo gṛhamedhibhyaḥ prabhūtān vrīhīn nirvapati yāvat payo manyate /
meaning: निर्वपणकाले मरुद्भ्यो गृहमेधिभ्यः प्रभूतान् व्रीहीन् निर्वपति यावत् पयो मन्यते /
text_mt: At the time of offering, he pours out abundant rice grains for the Gṛhamedhin Maruts, as much as he thinks the milk will suffice for.

sanskrit_iast: pavitreṇa gāṃ dohayati /
meaning: पवित्रेण गां दोहयति /
text_mt: He causes a cow to be milked through a strainer.

sanskrit_iast: na taṇḍulān utpunāti yajurutpūtenaiva payasā śrapayatīty ekeṣām /
meaning: न तण्डुलान् उत्पुनाति यजुरुत्पूतेनैव पयसा श्रपयतीत्य् एकेषाम् /
text_mt: He does not winnow the husked rice grains; 'he cooks them in milk purified only with a mantra,' according to some.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇāgnau prativeśam odanaṃ pacati /
meaning: दक्षिणाग्नौ प्रतिवेशम् ओदनं पचति /
text_mt: He cooks a neighboring mess of boiled rice on the dakṣiṇāgni fire.

sanskrit_iast: sphyam ādāya stīrṇāyā veder lomabhyo 'dhi stambayajur harati /
meaning: स्फ्यम् आदाय स्तीर्णाया वेदेर् लोमभ्यो ऽधि स्तम्बयजुर् हरति /
text_mt: Taking the wooden sword, he removes the clump of grass from the hairs of the strewn altar.

sanskrit_iast: uttaraṃ parigrāhaṃ parigṛhya saṃpraiṣeṇa pratipadyate /
meaning: उत्तरं परिग्राहं परिगृह्य संप्रैषेण प्रतिपद्यते /
text_mt: Having traced the northern boundary, he proceeds with the ritual direction.

sanskrit_iast: yad anyad idhmābarhiṣaḥ patnīsaṃnahanāc ca tat saṃpreṣyati /
meaning: यद् अन्यद् इध्माबर्हिषः पत्नीसंनहनाच् च तत् संप्रेष्यति /
text_mt: Whatever is other than the firewood and sacrificial grass and the girding of the sacrificer's wife, that he directs.

sanskrit_iast: yat prāg ājyagrahaṇāt tat kṛtvā dhruvāyām eva gṛhṇāti /
meaning: यत् प्राग् आज्यग्रहणात् तत् कृत्वा ध्रुवायाम् एव गृह्णाति /
text_mt: Having done whatever precedes the scooping of the clarified butter, he scoops it only into the dhruvā ladle.

sanskrit_iast: prokṣaṇīr abhimantrya brahmāṇam āmantrya vediṃ prokṣya prokṣaṇāvaśeṣaṃ ninīya pavitre apisṛjya dhruvām̐ sruvaṃ ca sādayati /
meaning: प्रोक्षणीर् अभिमन्त्र्य ब्रह्माणम् आमन्त्र्य वेदिं प्रोक्ष्य प्रोक्षणावशेषं निनीय पवित्रे अपिसृज्य ध्रुवाम्̐ स्रुवं च सादयति /
text_mt: Having consecrated the sprinkling waters with a mantra, addressed the brahman, sprinkled the altar, poured out the residue of the sprinkling waters, and thrown down the two strainers, he sets down the dhruvā ladle and the spoon.

sanskrit_iast: eṣāsadat \\ iti mantram̐ saṃnamati /
meaning: एषासदत् \\ इति मन्त्रम्̐ संनमति /
text_mt: He adapts the mantra: 'They have sat down.'

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇv asi \ vaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma prājāpatyam ity ājyam abhimantrayate /
meaning: विष्ण्व् असि \ वैष्णवं धाम प्राजापत्यम् इत्य् आज्यम् अभिमन्त्रयते /
text_mt: He addresses the clarified butter with: 'You are Viṣṇu, the abode belonging to Viṣṇu, belonging to Prajāpati.'

sanskrit_iast: yad ānīkavatasya barhis tat sāṃtapanīyasya tad gṛhamedhīyasya tat stīrṇam evety ekeṣām /
meaning: यद् आनीकवतस्य बर्हिस् तत् सांतपनीयस्य तद् गृहमेधीयस्य तत् स्तीर्णम् एवेत्य् एकेषाम् /
text_mt: Whatever was the sacrificial grass of the Anīkavata [offering], that belongs to the Sāṃtapanīya, that to the Gṛhamedhīya; according to some, that very [grass] remains spread.

sanskrit_iast: udvāsanaprabhṛtīni karmāṇi pratipadyate /
meaning: उद्वासनप्रभृतीनि कर्माणि प्रतिपद्यते /
text_mt: He proceeds with the rites beginning with the taking off [from the fire].

sanskrit_iast: śṛtasya haviṣaḥ śaram uddhṛtya prajñātaṃ nidhāya /
meaning: शृतस्य हविषः शरम् उद्धृत्य प्रज्ञातं निधाय /
text_mt: Having removed the cream of the cooked sacrificial oblation and placed it in a known place,

sanskrit_iast: pātrīṣūpastīrya trīn odanān uddharati /
meaning: पात्रीषूपस्तीर्य त्रीन् ओदनान् उद्धरति /
text_mt: having spread an under-layer in the dishes, he ladles out three portions of boiled rice.

sanskrit_iast: niṣkāsitāṃ kumbhīṃ nidadhāti /
meaning: निष्कासितां कुम्भीं निदधाति /
text_mt: He sets down the pot from which [the boiled rice] has been scraped out.

sanskrit_iast: animṛṣṭaṃ darvyudāyuvanam avadhāya /
meaning: अनिमृष्टं दर्व्युदायुवनम् अवधाय /
text_mt: Having inserted the stirring ladle without wiping it,

sanskrit_iast: abhidhāryotpūyālaṃkṛtyaudanān āsādayati /
meaning: अभिधार्योत्पूयालंकृत्यौदनान् आसादयति /
text_mt: having poured clarified butter over them, purified them with strainers, and decorated them, he places the portions of boiled rice [upon the altar].

sanskrit_iast: oḍhāsu devatāsv agnim upavājyājyabhāgābhyāṃ pracarya /
meaning: ओढासु देवतास्व् अग्निम् उपवाज्याज्यभागाभ्यां प्रचर्य /
text_mt: When the deities have been conveyed, having fanned the fire and performed the two clarified butter portions,

sanskrit_iast: juhvām upastīrya sarvebhya odanebhyaḥ samavadāyābhighārya marudbhyo gṛhamedhibhyo 'nubrūhi \ maruto gṛhamedhino yaja \\ iti saṃpreṣyati /
meaning: जुह्वाम् उपस्तीर्य सर्वेभ्य ओदनेभ्यः समवदायाभिघार्य मरुद्भ्यो गृहमेधिभ्यो ऽनुब्रूहि \ मरुतो गृहमेधिनो यज \\ इति संप्रेष्यति /
text_mt: having spread an under-layer in the juhū ladle, taken portions from all the portions of boiled rice, and poured clarified butter over them, he gives the ritual direction: 'Recite [the introductory verse] for the Maruts, the householders; sacrifice to the Maruts, the householders.'

sanskrit_iast: sviṣṭakṛt prāśitram iḍā ca kriyante prāśitāyām amātyebhya odanānupaharanti ye havirbhojanā bhavanti /
meaning: स्विष्टकृत् प्राशित्रम् इडा च क्रियन्ते प्राशितायाम् अमात्येभ्य ओदनानुपहरन्ति ये हविर्भोजना भवन्ति /
text_mt: The Sviṣṭakṛt offering, the prāśitra portion, and the iḍā are made; when [the iḍā] has been eaten, they serve the boiled rice to the members of the household who are eaters of sacrificial oblation.

sanskrit_iast: prativeśapakvasya patny aśnāti /
meaning: प्रतिवेशपक्वस्य पत्न्य् अश्नाति /
text_mt: The sacrificer's wife eats food cooked by a neighbor.

sanskrit_iast: iḍānto gṛhamedhīyaḥ saṃtiṣṭhate /
meaning: इडान्तो गृहमेधीयः संतिष्ठते /
text_mt: The Gṛhamedhīya concludes ending with the iḍā.

sanskrit_iast: āñjate 'bhyañjate 'nu vatsān vāsayanti /
meaning: आञ्जते ऽभ्यञ्जते ऽनु वत्सान् वासयन्ति /
text_mt: They anoint their eyes, anoint their bodies, and stable the calves with [their mothers].

sanskrit_iast: prativeśāś ca pacante /
meaning: प्रतिवेशाश् च पचन्ते /

sanskrit_iast: gāś ca ghnate /
meaning: गाश् च घ्नते /

sanskrit_iast: suhitā etām̐ rātriṃ vasanti pratītā anavartimukhinaḥ /
meaning: सुहिता एताम्̐ रात्रिं वसन्ति प्रतीता अनवर्तिमुखिनः /
text_mt: Well-fed, contented, and showing no signs of distress, they spend this night.

sanskrit_iast: parācīnarātre 'bhivānyavatsāyā agnihotryāś ca vatsau badhnāti /
meaning: पराचीनरात्रे ऽभिवान्यवत्साया अग्निहोत्र्याश् च वत्सौ बध्नाति /
text_mt: In the latter part of the night, he ties up the two calves of the cow suckling an adopted calf and of the Agnihotra cow.

sanskrit_iast: purā prātaragnihotrāt pūrṇadarvyeṇa pracaranti /
meaning: पुरा प्रातरग्निहोत्रात् पूर्णदर्व्येण प्रचरन्ति /
text_mt: Before the morning Agnihotra, they perform the Pūrṇadarvī rite.

sanskrit_iast: darvyām upastīrya śaraniṣkāsasya darvīṃ pūrayitvā nimṛṣṭaṃ darvyudāyuvanam avadāyābhighārya /
meaning: दर्व्याम् उपस्तीर्य शरनिष्कासस्य दर्वीं पूरयित्वा निमृष्टं दर्व्युदायुवनम् अवदायाभिघार्य /
text_mt: Having spread an under-layer in a wooden spoon, filled the wooden spoon with the cream and the scrapings [from the pot], ladled out [what adhered to] the wiped stirring ladle, and poured clarified butter over it,

sanskrit_iast: pūrṇā darvi \\ ity anudrutyarṣabham āhūya dehi me \\ iti tasya ravate gārhapatye juhoti /
meaning: पूर्णा दर्वि \\ इत्य् अनुद्रुत्यर्षभम् आहूय देहि मे \\ इति तस्य रवते गार्हपत्ये जुहोति /
text_mt: having recited: 'Full wooden spoon...', he calls a bull, and when it roars at [the words] 'give unto me', he makes the offering in the gārhapatya fire.

sanskrit_iast: yad ṛṣabho na rūyād brahmāṇam āmantrya tenānujñāto juhuyāt /
meaning: यद् ऋषभो न रूयाद् ब्रह्माणम् आमन्त्र्य तेनानुज्ञातो जुहुयात् /
text_mt: If the bull should not roar, he should address the brahman and, permitted by him, make the offering.

sanskrit_iast: marudbhyaḥ krīḍibhyaḥ puroḍāśam̐ saptakapālaṃ nirvapati sākam̐ sūryenodyatā sākam̐ raśmibhiḥ pracarantīty ekeṣām //
meaning: मरुद्भ्यः क्रीडिभ्यः पुरोडाशम्̐ सप्तकपालं निर्वपति साकम्̐ सूर्येनोद्यता साकम्̐ रश्मिभिः प्रचरन्तीत्य् एकेषाम् //
text_mt: He parcels out a sacrificial cake on seven potsherds for the sportive Maruts; according to some, they perform [this rite] together with the rising sun, together with its rays.

sanskrit_iast: tadānīm eva mahāhavirbhir yajate /
meaning: तदानीम् एव महाहविर्भिर् यजते /
text_mt: At that very time, he sacrifices with the Mahāhavis offerings.

sanskrit_iast: pañca saṃcarāṇi nirupyaindrāgnam ekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapaty aindraṃ caruṃ vaiśvakarmaṇam ekakapālam /
meaning: पञ्च संचराणि निरुप्यैन्द्राग्नम् एकादशकपालं निर्वपत्य् ऐन्द्रं चरुं वैश्वकर्मणम् एककपालम् /
text_mt: Having parceled out the five common oblations, he parcels out [an offering] on eleven potsherds to Indra and Agni, boiled rice to Indra, and [an offering] on one potsherd to Viśvakarman.

sanskrit_iast: kārtikyāṃ yathāṣāḍhyām evaṃ pṛṣadājyaṃ gṛhṇāti mārgaśīrṣyāṃ tu yathā śrāvaṇyām /
meaning: कार्तिक्यां यथाषाढ्याम् एवं पृषदाज्यं गृह्णाति मार्गशीर्ष्यां तु यथा श्रावण्याम् /
text_mt: On the full moon day of Kārttika he takes clotted butter just as on the full moon day of Āṣāḍha, but on the full moon day of Mārgaśīrṣa just as on the full moon day of Śrāvaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: agne ver hotraṃ ver dūtyam \ ūrdhvo adhvare ṣṭhās \\ avatāṃ tvā dyāvāpṛthivī \ ava tvaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī \ ava sviṣṭakṛd indrāya devebhyo bhava \ juṣāṇo asya haviṣo ghṛtasya vīhi svāhā \\ iti srucyam āghāram āghārayati /
meaning: अग्ने वेर् होत्रं वेर् दूत्यम् \ ऊर्ध्वो अध्वरे ष्ठास् \\ अवतां त्वा द्यावापृथिवी \ अव त्वं द्यावापृथिवी \ अव स्विष्टकृद् इन्द्राय देवेभ्यो भव \ जुषाणो अस्य हविषो घृतस्य वीहि स्वाहा \\ इति स्रुच्यम् आघारम् आघारयति /
text_mt: With: 'Agni, enjoy the hotṛ's office, enjoy the messenger's office; stand upright at the sacrifice; may Heaven and Earth protect you; protect Heaven and Earth; become Sviṣṭakṛt to Indra and to the gods; enjoying this sacrificial oblation of ghee, partake of it, svāhā!', he pours the libation with the ladle.

sanskrit_iast: sahaś ca sahasyaś ca \\ iti caturbhir māsanāmabhir ekakapālam abhijuhoti sahase svāhā sahasyāya svāhā \\ iti vā /
meaning: सहश् च सहस्यश् च \\ इति चतुर्भिर् मासनामभिर् एककपालम् अभिजुहोति सहसे स्वाहा सहस्याय स्वाहा \\ इति वा /
text_mt: With the four month-names: 'Sahas and Sahasya...', he makes the offering over the one-potsherd cake, or with: 'To Sahas svāhā, to Sahasya svāhā.'

sanskrit_iast: idāvatsarīṇām̐ svastim āśāste \ divyaṃ dhāmāśāste \\ iti sūktavākasyāśīṣṣu hotānuvartayati /
meaning: इदावत्सरीणाम्̐ स्वस्तिम् आशास्ते \ दिव्यं धामाशास्ते \\ इति सूक्तवाकस्याशीष्षु होतानुवर्तयति /
text_mt: In the benedictions of the Sūktavāka the hotṛ adds: 'He prays for the welfare belonging to the Idāvatsara year; he prays for the divine realm.'

sanskrit_iast: aindrāgnatuṣair avabhṛtham avayanti gamanasaṃyuktaṃ tuṣapratipādanaṃ ca kriyate //
meaning: ऐन्द्राग्नतुषैर् अवभृथम् अवयन्ति गमनसंयुक्तं तुषप्रतिपादनं च क्रियते //
text_mt: With the husks of the Indra-Agni [offering] they step down into the purificatory bath, and the disposal of the husks accompanied by walking is performed.

sanskrit_iast: tadānīm eva mahāpitṛyajñena yajate /
meaning: तदानीम् एव महापितृयज्ञेन यजते /
text_mt: At that very time, he sacrifices with the Mahāpitṛyajña.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇataḥpurastād dakṣiṇāgner yajamānapātrīṃ caturaśrāṃ vediṃ karoti /
meaning: दक्षिणतःपुरस्ताद् दक्षिणाग्नेर् यजमानपात्रीं चतुरश्रां वेदिं करोति /
text_mt: To the southeast of the dakṣiṇāgni fire, he makes a four-cornered altar of the size of the sacrificer's vessel.

sanskrit_iast: tasyāḥ pratidiśam̐ sraktayo bhavanti /
meaning: तस्याः प्रतिदिशम्̐ स्रक्तयो भवन्ति /
text_mt: Its corners point toward the cardinal directions.

sanskrit_iast: avāntaradeśāt tanumadhyāni /
meaning: अवान्तरदेशात् तनुमध्यानि /
text_mt: Its middles are narrowed between the intermediary directions.

sanskrit_iast: sarvatra devapravādamantraṃ devapitṛvat saṃnamati /
meaning: सर्वत्र देवप्रवादमन्त्रं देवपितृवत् संनमति /
text_mt: Everywhere he adapts a mantra mentioning the gods to refer to both gods and ancestors.

sanskrit_iast: yathā pṛthivi devapitṛyajani devānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ pariṣūtam asi \ devapitṛbarhir mā tvānvaṅ mā tiryak \ karmaṇe vāṃ devebhyaḥ pitṛbhyaḥ śakeyam iti /
meaning: यथा पृथिवि देवपितृयजनि देवानां पितॄणां परिषूतम् असि \ देवपितृबर्हिर् मा त्वान्वङ् मा तिर्यक् \ कर्मणे वां देवेभ्यः पितृभ्यः शकेयम् इति /
text_mt: As: 'O earth, place of sacrifice for gods and ancestors, you are surrounded for the gods and ancestors'; 'O sacrificial grass of gods and ancestors, do not go across me, do not go horizontally'; 'May I be capable for the rite, for you two, for gods and ancestors.'

sanskrit_iast: uddhananāntaṃ kṛtvā sarvataḥ pariśrityottarām̐ sraktiṃ dvāraṃ kṛtvā /
meaning: उद्धननान्तं कृत्वा सर्वतः परिश्रित्योत्तराम्̐ स्रक्तिं द्वारं कृत्वा /
text_mt: Having finished up to the digging up, enclosed [the altar] on all sides with screens, and made the northern corner the entrance,

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇāgner aṅgārān āhṛtya madhye veder nyupyopasamādadhāti /
meaning: दक्षिणाग्नेर् अङ्गारान् आहृत्य मध्ये वेदेर् न्युप्योपसमादधाति /
text_mt: having fetched burning coals from the dakṣiṇāgni fire and poured them down in the middle of the altar, he adds firewood to it.

sanskrit_iast: eṣo 'trāhavanīyaḥ /
meaning: एषो ऽत्राहवनीयः /

sanskrit_iast: āhavanīyaṃ gārhapatyaṃ dakṣiṇāgniṃ cānvādhāya /
meaning: आहवनीयं गार्हपत्यं दक्षिणाग्निं चान्वाधाय /
text_mt: Having added fuel to the āhavanīya fire, the gārhapatya fire, and the dakṣiṇāgni fire,

sanskrit_iast: idhmābarhir āharati drāghīyaḥ prākṛtāt samūlaṃ barhir dāty upamūlalūnaṃ vā /
meaning: इध्माबर्हिर् आहरति द्राघीयः प्राकृतात् समूलं बर्हिर् दात्य् उपमूललूनं वा /
text_mt: he brings the firewood and sacrificial grass; he cuts the sacrificial grass longer than usual, together with the roots, or cut near the roots.

sanskrit_iast: dvau paridhī sarvān vopasaṃnahyati /
meaning: द्वौ परिधी सर्वान् वोपसंनह्यति /
text_mt: He ties up two enclosing-sticks, or all [three].

sanskrit_iast: pātrasam̐sādanakāle yathārthaṃ pātrāṇi prayunakti /
meaning: पात्रसम्̐सादनकाले यथार्थं पात्राणि प्रयुनक्ति /
text_mt: At the time of arranging the vessels, he sets up the vessels according to need:

sanskrit_iast: somāya pitṛmate ṣaṭ kapālāni pitṛbhyo barhiṣadbhyo dhānārthaṃ kapālam /
meaning: सोमाय पितृमते षट् कपालानि पितृभ्यो बर्हिषद्भ्यो धानार्थं कपालम् /
text_mt: six potsherds for Soma accompanied by the ancestors; a potsherd for roasted grains for the ancestors seated on the sacrificial grass;

sanskrit_iast: pitṛbhyo 'gniṣvāttebhyo manthārthaṃ vāraṇaṃ pātram̐ śarāvaṃ vā /
meaning: पितृभ्यो ऽग्निष्वात्तेभ्यो मन्थार्थं वारणं पात्रम्̐ शरावं वा /
text_mt: a vessel made of vāraṇa wood or an earthen saucer for the flour-drink for the ancestors consumed by fire.

sanskrit_iast: nirvapaṇakāle 'dhvaryur dakṣiṇataḥ śakaṭam āruhya prācīnāvītī yavān nirvapati /
meaning: निर्वपणकाले ऽध्वर्युर् दक्षिणतः शकटम् आरुह्य प्राचीनावीती यवान् निर्वपति /
text_mt: At the time of parceling out, the adhvaryu, wearing the sacred cord over the right shoulder, having mounted the cart from the south, parcels out barley grains.

sanskrit_iast: uttarato vā yajñopavītī /
meaning: उत्तरतो वा यज्ञोपवीती /
text_mt: Or [he does so] from the north, wearing the sacred cord over the left shoulder.

sanskrit_iast: somāya pitṛmate puroḍāśam̐ ṣaṭkapālaṃ nirvapaty ājyaṃ vā /
meaning: सोमाय पितृमते पुरोडाशम्̐ षट्कपालं निर्वपत्य् आज्यं वा /
text_mt: He parcels out a sacrificial cake on six potsherds for Soma accompanied by the ancestors, or clarified butter;

sanskrit_iast: pitṛbhyo barhiṣadbhyo dhānāḥ pitṛbhyo 'gniṣvāttebhyo manthaṃ yamāya mantham ity ekeṣām /
meaning: पितृभ्यो बर्हिषद्भ्यो धानाः पितृभ्यो ऽग्निष्वात्तेभ्यो मन्थं यमाय मन्थम् इत्य् एकेषाम् /
text_mt: roasted grains for the ancestors seated on the sacrificial grass; a flour-drink for the ancestors consumed by fire; according to some, a flour-drink for Yama.

sanskrit_iast: prokṣaṇyudrekeṇa yavān saṃyutyāvahanti /
meaning: प्रोक्षण्युद्रेकेण यवान् संयुत्यावहन्ति /
text_mt: Having mixed the barley grains with the remainder of the sprinkling water, he pounds them.

sanskrit_iast: triṣphalīkṛteṣu vibhāgamantreṇa ṣaṭkapālam apacchidya pinaṣṭi /
meaning: त्रिष्फलीकृतेषु विभागमन्त्रेण षट्कपालम् अपच्छिद्य पिनष्टि /
text_mt: When they are husked three times, having separated [the portion for] the six-potsherd cake with the division mantra, he grinds it.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇārdhe gārhapatyasya ṣaṭ kapālāny upadhāya prathamena kapālamantreṇa dakṣiṇāgnau bharjanārthaṃ kapālam upadadhāti /
meaning: दक्षिणार्धे गार्हपत्यस्य षट् कपालान्य् उपधाय प्रथमेन कपालमन्त्रेण दक्षिणाग्नौ भर्जनार्थं कपालम् उपदधाति /
text_mt: Having set down six potsherds on the southern half of the gārhapatya fire, he places a potsherd on the dakṣiṇāgni fire for roasting, with the first potsherd mantra.

sanskrit_iast: ṣaṭkapālam adhiśrityādhiśrayaṇamantreṇopya dhānā bharjayati /
meaning: षट्कपालम् अधिश्रित्याधिश्रयणमन्त्रेणोप्य धाना भर्जयति /
text_mt: Having placed [the cake on] six potsherds [on the fire] and poured [the grains into the potsherd] with the placing mantra, he roasts the barley grains.

sanskrit_iast: anupadahyamānāḥ pariśerate //
meaning: अनुपदह्यमानाः परिशेरते //
text_mt: They remain lying so as not to be burned.

sanskrit_iast: akhātā vedir bhavaty uttaraṃ parigrāhaṃ parigṛhya /
meaning: अखाता वेदिर् भवत्य् उत्तरं परिग्राहं परिगृह्य /
text_mt: The altar is unexcavated; having traced the second boundary,

sanskrit_iast: saṃpraiṣeṇa pratipadyate yad anyat patnīsaṃnahanāt tat saṃpreṣyati /
meaning: संप्रैषेण प्रतिपद्यते यद् अन्यत् पत्नीसंनहनात् तत् संप्रेष्यति /
text_mt: he proceeds with the ritual direction; whatever is other than the girding of the sacrificer's wife, he directs.

sanskrit_iast: na patnīm̐ saṃnahyati nānvāste gṛheṣv evāsīnājyam avekṣate /
meaning: न पत्नीम्̐ संनह्यति नान्वास्ते गृहेष्व् एवासीनाज्यम् अवेक्षते /
text_mt: He does not gird the sacrificer's wife, nor does she sit nearby; seated in the house itself, she looks at the clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: yat prāg ājyagrahaṇāt tat kṛtvā pratihṛtya gārhapatya ājyāni gṛhṇāti /
meaning: यत् प्राग् आज्यग्रहणात् तत् कृत्वा प्रतिहृत्य गार्हपत्य आज्यानि गृह्णाति /
text_mt: Having done whatever is prior to the taking of clarified butter, having brought [the vessels] back, he takes the clarified butters at the gārhapatya fire.

sanskrit_iast: sarvāṇi caturgṛhītāni dvir vopabhṛti /
meaning: सर्वाणि चतुर्गृहीतानि द्विर् वोपभृति /
text_mt: All [ladles receive] four ladlefuls, or two in the upabhṛt.

sanskrit_iast: prokṣaṇīr abhimantrya brahmāṇam āmantryedhmaṃ vediṃ barhiś ca prokṣaṇyavaśeṣaṃ ninīya pavitre apisṛjyāgreṣu barhir gṛhītvā /
meaning: प्रोक्षणीर् अभिमन्त्र्य ब्रह्माणम् आमन्त्र्येध्मं वेदिं बर्हिश् च प्रोक्षण्यवशेषं निनीय पवित्रे अपिसृज्याग्रेषु बर्हिर् गृहीत्वा /
text_mt: Having consecrated the sprinkling waters with a mantra, addressed the brahman priest, [and sprinkled] the kindling wood, the altar, and the sacrificial grass, having poured out the remainder of the sprinkling waters, having inserted the two strainers, and having seized the sacrificial grass by its tips,

sanskrit_iast: triḥ prasavyam agniṃ dhūnvan paryety aurdhvaḥ prastaras taṃ dhārayamāṇas trir adhūnvan pratiparyeti /
meaning: त्रिः प्रसव्यम् अग्निं धून्वन् पर्येत्य् और्ध्वः प्रस्तरस् तं धारयमाणस् त्रिर् अधून्वन् प्रतिपर्येति /
text_mt: he walks around [the fire] three times counter-clockwise while shaking [the sacrificial grass] toward the fire; holding that high grass bundle upright, he walks back around three times without shaking it.

sanskrit_iast: dvau paridhī sarvān vā paridadhāti /
meaning: द्वौ परिधी सर्वान् वा परिदधाति /
text_mt: He lays down two enclosing sticks, or all [three].

sanskrit_iast: pratiṣiddhe vidhṛtī tūṣṇīṃ prastaraṃ nyasyaty udvāsanaprabhṛtīni karmāṇi pratipadyate /
meaning: प्रतिषिद्धे विधृती तूष्णीं प्रस्तरं न्यस्यत्य् उद्वासनप्रभृतीनि कर्माणि प्रतिपद्यते /
text_mt: The two separating blades are prohibited; he places down the high grass bundle silently, and proceeds to the rites beginning with the taking off [of the offerings from the fire].

sanskrit_iast: yat prāg alaṃkaraṇāt tat kṛtvā /
meaning: यत् प्राग् अलंकरणात् तत् कृत्वा /
text_mt: Having performed what comes before the decoration [of the oblations],

sanskrit_iast: vibhāgamantreṇa dhānā vibhajya piṣṭānām āvṛtārdhān saktūn kṛtvā /
meaning: विभागमन्त्रेण धाना विभज्य पिष्टानाम् आवृतार्धान् सक्तून् कृत्वा /
text_mt: having divided the roasted grains with the division mantra, and having made groats out of half [of them] according to the procedure for flour,

sanskrit_iast: abhivānyavatsāyai dugdhe vāraṇe pātre 'rdhaśarāve vekṣuśalākayā dakṣiṇāsīno 'nārabhamāṇas triḥ prasavyaṃ mantham upamanthati śalākāstambaṃ manthaṃ karoti /
meaning: अभिवान्यवत्सायै दुग्धे वारणे पात्रे ऽर्धशरावे वेक्षुशलाकया दक्षिणासीनो ऽनारभमाणस् त्रिः प्रसव्यं मन्थम् उपमन्थति शलाकास्तम्बं मन्थं करोति /
text_mt: in the milk of a cow whose calf has been substituted, in a vessel of Varaṇa wood or in half an earthen dish, seated to the south, not grasping [the vessel], he stirs the beverage three times counter-clockwise with a stalk of sugarcane, and makes the beverage with the bundle of stalks.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇāgner ekolmukaṃ dhūpāyat parācīnam apareṇa gārhapatyam atyāhṛtyāgreṇāhavanīyaṃ paryāhṛtya dakṣiṇenāhavanīyam antarvedi nidadhāti /
meaning: दक्षिणाग्नेर् एकोल्मुकं धूपायत् पराचीनम् अपरेण गार्हपत्यम् अत्याहृत्याग्रेणाहवनीयं पर्याहृत्य दक्षिणेनाहवनीयम् अन्तर्वेदि निदधाति /
text_mt: Taking a single smoking firebrand from the dakṣiṇāgni fire facing away, carrying it past west of the gārhapatya fire, carrying it around in front of the āhavanīya fire, he places it within the altar south of the āhavanīya fire.

sanskrit_iast: alaṃkṛtyaikaikaśa ājyāni havīm̐ṣi cāsādayati /
meaning: अलंकृत्यैकैकश आज्यानि हवीम्̐षि चासादयति /
text_mt: Having decorated them, he sets down the clarified butter and the sacrificial oblations one by one.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇata āñjanam abhyañjanaṃ kaśipūpabarhaṇam udakumbhaṃ ca pratiṣṭhāpayati /
meaning: दक्षिणत आञ्जनम् अभ्यञ्जनं कशिपूपबर्हणम् उदकुम्भं च प्रतिष्ठापयति /
text_mt: To the south, he places collyrium, ointment, a grass mat, a pillow, and a jar of water.

sanskrit_iast: yajñopavītaṃ kurute yadi prācīnāvītī bhavati /
meaning: यज्ञोपवीतं कुरुते यदि प्राचीनावीती भवति /
text_mt: He puts on the sacred cord over the left shoulder if he is wearing the sacred cord over the right shoulder.

sanskrit_iast: agnaye devebhyaḥ pitṛbhyaḥ samidhyamānāyānubrūhi \\ iti saṃpreṣyati /
meaning: अग्नये देवेभ्यः पितृभ्यः समिध्यमानायानुब्रूहि \\ इति संप्रेष्यति /
text_mt: He issues the ritual direction: 'Recite [the introductory verses] for the fire being kindled for the gods, for the ancestors.'

sanskrit_iast: uśantas tvā havāmahe \\ ity etām̐ sāmidhenīṃ trir anvāha /
meaning: उशन्तस् त्वा हवामहे \\ इत्य् एताम्̐ सामिधेनीं त्रिर् अन्वाह /
text_mt: He recites this kindling verse three times: 'Desiring you, we call upon you.'

sanskrit_iast: traidham idhmaṃ prativibhajya sarvam ādadhāti /
meaning: त्रैधम् इध्मं प्रतिविभज्य सर्वम् आदधाति /
text_mt: Having divided the kindling wood into three parts, he places all of it [on the fire].

sanskrit_iast: oḍhāsu devatāsv agnim upavājya sruvāghāram āghārya \\ agnīt paridhīm̐ś cāgniṃ ca tristriḥ saṃmṛḍḍhi \\ iti saṃpreṣyati /
meaning: ओढासु देवतास्व् अग्निम् उपवाज्य स्रुवाघारम् आघार्य \\ अग्नीत् परिधीम्̐श् चाग्निं च त्रिस्त्रिः संमृड्ढि \\ इति संप्रेष्यति /
text_mt: When the deities have been conveyed, having fanned the fire and poured the foundational offering with the dipping spoon, he issues the ritual direction: 'Agnīdh, wipe clean the enclosing sticks and the fire three times each.'

sanskrit_iast: saṃmṛṣṭe pravaraṃ pravṛṇīte //
meaning: संमृष्टे प्रवरं प्रवृणीते //
text_mt: When it has been wiped clean, he chooses the ancestral invocation.

sanskrit_iast: sīda hotar ity etāvān pravaraḥ /
meaning: सीद होतर् इत्य् एतावान् प्रवरः /
text_mt: 'Be seated, hotṛ'—this is the extent of the ancestral invocation.

sanskrit_iast: apabarhiṣaḥ prayājān yajati nopabhṛtam̐ samānayate /
meaning: अपबर्हिषः प्रयाजान् यजति नोपभृतम्̐ समानयते /
text_mt: He offers the fore-offerings excluding [the one to] the sacrificial grass; he does not bring together [the butter from] the upabhṛt [into the juhū].

sanskrit_iast: jīvātumantāv ājyabhāgau /
meaning: जीवातुमन्ताव् आज्यभागौ /
text_mt: The two clarified butter portions contain [the word] jīvātu ('life').

sanskrit_iast: tābhyāṃ pracarya /
meaning: ताभ्यां प्रचर्य /

sanskrit_iast: visrasya yajñopavītāni prācīnāvītāni kurvate /
meaning: विस्रस्य यज्ञोपवीतानि प्राचीनावीतानि कुर्वते /
text_mt: they undo their sacred cords and put on the sacred cord over the right shoulder.

sanskrit_iast: ājyāni havīm̐ṣi ca vipariharanti /
meaning: आज्यानि हवीम्̐षि च विपरिहरन्ति /
text_mt: They transpose the clarified butter and the sacrificial oblations.

sanskrit_iast: viparikrāmant yṛtvijaḥ /
meaning: विपरिक्रामन्त् यृत्विजः /
text_mt: The officiating priests step around.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇato juhvām upabhṛtam̐ sādayati /
meaning: दक्षिणतो जुह्वाम् उपभृतम्̐ सादयति /
text_mt: To the south of the juhū he sets down the upabhṛt.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇata upabhṛtaṃ dhruvām /
meaning: दक्षिणत उपभृतं ध्रुवाम् /
text_mt: To the south of the upabhṛt, the dhruvā.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇataḥ puroḍāśaṃ dhānāḥ sādayati dakṣiṇaṃ dhānābhyo mantham /
meaning: दक्षिणतः पुरोडाशं धानाः सादयति दक्षिणं धानाभ्यो मन्थम् /
text_mt: To the south of the sacrificial cake he sets down the roasted grains; to the south of the roasted grains, the beverage.

sanskrit_iast: hotādhvaryur āgnīdhraś ca dakṣiṇā viparikrāmanti /
meaning: होताध्वर्युर् आग्नीध्रश् च दक्षिणा विपरिक्रामन्ति /
text_mt: The hotṛ, the adhvaryu, and the āgnīdhra step around to the south.

sanskrit_iast: uttarato brahmā yajamānaś ca /
meaning: उत्तरतो ब्रह्मा यजमानश् च /
text_mt: The brahman priest and the sacrificer [step around] to the north.

sanskrit_iast: samānatra juhūḥ ṣaṭkapālaś ca /
meaning: समानत्र जुहूः षट्कपालश् च /
text_mt: The juhū and the [cake on] six potsherds remain in the same place.

sanskrit_iast: brahmayajamānāv ity ekeṣām /
meaning: ब्रह्मयजमानाव् इत्य् एकेषाम् /
text_mt: 'The brahman priest and the sacrificer [remain in the same place],' according to some.

sanskrit_iast: sarvebhyo havirbhyaḥ samavadāyaikaikāṃ devatāṃ yajati /
meaning: सर्वेभ्यो हविर्भ्यः समवदायैकैकां देवतां यजति /
text_mt: Having cut off portions from all the sacrificial oblations together, he sacrifices to each single deity.

sanskrit_iast: juhvām upastīrya puroḍāśād avadāya dhānānām upasaṃgṛhṇīte 'tha manthasya /
meaning: जुह्वाम् उपस्तीर्य पुरोडाशाद् अवदाय धानानाम् उपसंगृह्णीते ऽथ मन्थस्य /
text_mt: Having made an under-layering in the juhū, having cut off from the sacrificial cake, he takes in addition from the roasted grains, and then from the beverage.

sanskrit_iast: dvir abhighārayati catur avadānasya triḥ pañcāvattinaḥ /
meaning: द्विर् अभिघारयति चतुर् अवदानस्य त्रिः पञ्चावत्तिनः /
text_mt: He basters twice for one who takes four portions, three times for one who takes five portions.

sanskrit_iast: somāya pitṛmate 'nu svadhā \\ iti saṃpreṣyati dve puronuvākye anvāhaikaikāṃ yājyām̐ sapraṇave syātām /
meaning: सोमाय पितृमते ऽनु स्वधा \\ इति संप्रेष्यति द्वे पुरोनुवाक्ये अन्वाहैकैकां याज्याम्̐ सप्रणवे स्याताम् /
text_mt: He issues the ritual direction: 'Recite svadhā for Soma accompanied by the ancestors.' He recites two introductory verses and one offering verse; they should be with the syllable oṃ.

sanskrit_iast: paridhīm̐r aporṇu \\ ity ucyamāne dakṣiṇam uttaraṃ paridhiṃ madhyamam upasamasyati /
meaning: परिधीम्̐र् अपोर्णु \\ इत्य् उच्यमाने दक्षिणम् उत्तरं परिधिं मध्यमम् उपसमस्यति /
text_mt: While 'Uncover the enclosing sticks' is being said, he draws together the southern and the northern enclosing sticks toward the middle one.

sanskrit_iast: udaṅṅ atikramya \\ ā svadhā \\ ity āśrāvayati /
meaning: उदङ्ङ् अतिक्रम्य \\ आ स्वधा \\ इत्य् आश्रावयति /
text_mt: Having stepped across to the north, he causes to be announced: 'To svadhā!'

sanskrit_iast: astu svadhā \\ iti pratyāśrāvayati somaṃ pitṛmantam̐ svadhā \\ iti saṃpreṣyati ye svadhāmahe \\ ity āgūr bhavati svadhā namas iti vaṣaṭkaroti /
meaning: अस्तु स्वधा \\ इति प्रत्याश्रावयति सोमं पितृमन्तम्̐ स्वधा \\ इति संप्रेष्यति ये स्वधामहे \\ इत्य् आगूर् भवति स्वधा नमस् इति वषट्करोति /
text_mt: He responds: 'May there be svadhā.' He issues the ritual direction: '[Sacrifice] svadhā to Soma accompanied by the ancestors.' The call is: 'We who offer svadhā.' He utters the vaṣaṭ-call: 'Svadhā, homage!'

sanskrit_iast: etenaiva kalpenottarābhyāṃ pracarati /
meaning: एतेनैव कल्पेनोत्तराभ्यां प्रचरति /
text_mt: By this very procedure he performs with the subsequent two [offerings].

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇātikramya juhvām upastīrya dhānānām avadāya puroḍāśād upasaṃgṛhṇīte 'tha manthasya pitṛbhyo barhiṣadbhyo 'nu svadhā \\ iti saṃpreṣyaty udaṅṅ atikramya \\ ā svadhā \\ ity āśrāvayati \\ astu svadhā \\ iti pratyāśrāvayati pitṝn barhiṣadaḥ svadhā \\ iti saṃpreṣyati ye svadhāmahe \\ ity āgūr bhavati svadhā namas \\ iti vaṣaṭkaroti dakṣiṇātikramya juhvām upastīrya manthād avadāya puroḍāśād upasaṃgṛhnīte 'tha dhānānāṃ pitṛbhyo 'gniṣvāttebhyo 'nu svadhā \\ iti saṃpreṣyaty udaṅṅ atikramya \\ ā svadhā \\ ity āśrāvayati \\ astu svadhā \\ iti pratyāśrāvayati pitṝn agniṣvāttān svadhā \\ iti saṃpreṣyati ye svadhāmahe \\ ity āgūr bhavati svadhā namas \\ iti vaṣaṭkaroty etenaiva kalpenāgniṃ kavyavāhanam̐ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ yajati dakṣiṇātikramya juhvām upastīrya puroḍāśād avadāya dhānānām upasaṃgṛhṇīte 'tha manthasya agnaye kavyavāhanāya sviṣṭakṛte 'nu svadhā \\ iti saṃpreṣyaty udaṅṅ atikramya \\ ā svadhā \\ ity āśrāvayati \\ astu svadhā \\ iti pratyāśrāvayati \\ agniṃ kavyavāhanam̐ sviṣṭakṛtam̐ svadhā \\ iti saṃpreṣyati ye svadhāmahe \\ ity āgūr bhavati svadhā namas \\ iti vaṣaṭkaroti //
meaning: दक्षिणातिक्रम्य जुह्वाम् उपस्तीर्य धानानाम् अवदाय पुरोडाशाद् उपसंगृह्णीते ऽथ मन्थस्य पितृभ्यो बर्हिषद्भ्यो ऽनु स्वधा \\ इति संप्रेष्यत्य् उदङ्ङ् अतिक्रम्य \\ आ स्वधा \\ इत्य् आश्रावयति \\ अस्तु स्वधा \\ इति प्रत्याश्रावयति पितॄन् बर्हिषदः स्वधा \\ इति संप्रेष्यति ये स्वधामहे \\ इत्य् आगूर् भवति स्वधा नमस् \\ इति वषट्करोति दक्षिणातिक्रम्य जुह्वाम् उपस्तीर्य मन्थाद् अवदाय पुरोडाशाद् उपसंगृह्नीते ऽथ धानानां पितृभ्यो ऽग्निष्वात्तेभ्यो ऽनु स्वधा \\ इति संप्रेष्यत्य् उदङ्ङ् अतिक्रम्य \\ आ स्वधा \\ इत्य् आश्रावयति \\ अस्तु स्वधा \\ इति प्रत्याश्रावयति पितॄन् अग्निष्वात्तान् स्वधा \\ इति संप्रेष्यति ये स्वधामहे \\ इत्य् आगूर् भवति स्वधा नमस् \\ इति वषट्करोत्य् एतेनैव कल्पेनाग्निं कव्यवाहनम्̐ स्विष्टकृतं यजति दक्षिणातिक्रम्य जुह्वाम् उपस्तीर्य पुरोडाशाद् अवदाय धानानाम् उपसंगृह्णीते ऽथ मन्थस्य अग्नये कव्यवाहनाय स्विष्टकृते ऽनु स्वधा \\ इति संप्रेष्यत्य् उदङ्ङ् अतिक्रम्य \\ आ स्वधा \\ इत्य् आश्रावयति \\ अस्तु स्वधा \\ इति प्रत्याश्रावयति \\ अग्निं कव्यवाहनम्̐ स्विष्टकृतम्̐ स्वधा \\ इति संप्रेष्यति ये स्वधामहे \\ इत्य् आगूर् भवति स्वधा नमस् \\ इति वषट्करोति //
text_mt: Having stepped across to the south, having made an under-layering in the juhū, having cut off from the roasted grains, he takes in addition from the sacrificial cake, and then from the beverage; he issues the ritual direction: 'Recite svadhā for the ancestors seated on the sacrificial grass.' Having stepped across to the north, he causes to be announced: 'To svadhā!' He responds: 'May there be svadhā.' He issues the ritual direction: '[Sacrifice] svadhā to the ancestors seated on the sacrificial grass.' The call is: 'We who offer svadhā.' He utters the vaṣaṭ-call: 'Svadhā, homage!' Having stepped across to the south, having made an under-layering in the juhū, having cut off from the beverage, he takes in addition from the sacrificial cake, and then from the roasted grains; he issues the ritual direction: 'Recite svadhā for the ancestors consumed by fire.' Having stepped across to the north, he causes to be announced: 'To svadhā!' He responds: 'May there be svadhā.' He issues the ritual direction: '[Sacrifice] svadhā to the ancestors consumed by fire.' The call is: 'We who offer svadhā.' He utters the vaṣaṭ-call: 'Svadhā, homage!' By this very procedure he sacrifices to Agni Kavyavāhana as Sviṣṭakṛt: having stepped across to the south, having made an under-layering in the juhū, having cut off from the sacrificial cake, he takes in addition from the roasted grains, and then from the beverage; he issues the ritual direction: 'Recite svadhā for Agni Kavyavāhana Sviṣṭakṛt.' Having stepped across to the north, he causes to be announced: 'To svadhā!' He responds: 'May there be svadhā.' He issues the ritual direction: '[Sacrifice] svadhā to Agni Kavyavāhana Sviṣṭakṛt.' The call is: 'We who offer svadhā.' He utters the vaṣaṭ-call: 'Svadhā, homage!'

sanskrit_iast: mantham eke sviṣṭakṛtam̐ samāmananti /
meaning: मन्थम् एके स्विष्टकृतम्̐ समामनन्ति /
text_mt: Some teach [offering only] the beverage as the Sviṣṭakṛt.

sanskrit_iast: na prāśitram avadyati /
meaning: न प्राशित्रम् अवद्यति /

sanskrit_iast: evam eveḍām avadyati /
meaning: एवम् एवेडाम् अवद्यति /

sanskrit_iast: mantham iḍām avadyati manthād iḍām avadyatīty ekeṣām /
meaning: मन्थम् इडाम् अवद्यति मन्थाद् इडाम् अवद्यतीत्य् एकेषाम् /
text_mt: 'He cuts off the beverage as the iḍā,' or 'He cuts off the iḍā from the beverage,' according to some.

sanskrit_iast: mantham avaghrāṇārthaṃ pariśiṣya /
meaning: मन्थम् अवघ्राणार्थं परिशिष्य /
text_mt: Having left behind the beverage for the purpose of smelling,

sanskrit_iast: iḍāyām̐ haviḥśeṣān saṃśliṣya /
meaning: इडायाम्̐ हविःशेषान् संश्लिष्य /
text_mt: and having gathered the remnants of the sacrificial oblations in the iḍā,

sanskrit_iast: etat te tata \\ iti tisṛṣu sraktīṣu trīn piṇḍān nidadhāti /
meaning: एतत् ते तत \\ इति तिसृषु स्रक्तीषु त्रीन् पिण्डान् निदधाति /
text_mt: with 'This is for you, father,' he places down three rice balls in three corners [of the altar],

sanskrit_iast: pūrvārdhyāyāṃ dakṣiṇārdhyāyāṃ paścārdhyāyām /
meaning: पूर्वार्ध्यायां दक्षिणार्ध्यायां पश्चार्ध्यायाम् /
text_mt: in the eastern part, in the southern part, and in the western part.

sanskrit_iast: lepam uttarasyāṃ nimārṣṭi /
meaning: लेपम् उत्तरस्यां निमार्ष्टि /
text_mt: He wipes off the residue in the northern [part].

sanskrit_iast: atra pitaro yathābhāgaṃ mandadhvam ity uktvodañco niṣkrāmanti /
meaning: अत्र पितरो यथाभागं मन्दध्वम् इत्य् उक्त्वोदञ्चो निष्क्रामन्ति /
text_mt: Having said: 'Here, O ancestors, exhilarate yourselves, each according to his share,' they step out toward the north.

sanskrit_iast: tata āhavanīyam upāyanti /
meaning: तत आहवनीयम् उपायन्ति /
text_mt: Then they approach the āhavanīya fire.

sanskrit_iast: susaṃdṛśaṃ tvā vayam ity āhavanīyam upatiṣṭhante /
meaning: सुसंदृशं त्वा वयम् इत्य् आहवनीयम् उपतिष्ठन्ते /
text_mt: They attend upon the āhavanīya fire with: 'May we, of good sight, [behold] you.'

sanskrit_iast: ātamitos tiṣṭhanti /
meaning: आतमितोस् तिष्ठन्ति /

sanskrit_iast: akṣann amīmadanta hi \\ iti gārhapatyam upatiṣṭhante /
meaning: अक्षन्न् अमीमदन्त हि \\ इति गार्हपत्यम् उपतिष्ठन्ते /
text_mt: They attend upon the gārhapatya fire with: 'They have eaten, they have exhilarated themselves.'

sanskrit_iast: akṣan pitaro 'mīmadanta pitaras \\ iti pratipadyante /
meaning: अक्षन् पितरो ऽमीमदन्त पितरस् \\ इति प्रतिपद्यन्ते /
text_mt: They recite: 'The ancestors have eaten, the ancestors have exhilarated themselves.'

sanskrit_iast: mantham̐ hotāvajighrati /
meaning: मन्थम्̐ होतावजिघ्रति /
text_mt: The hotṛ smells the beverage.

sanskrit_iast: athādhvaryur atha brahmāthāgnīdhro 'tha yajamānaḥ /
meaning: अथाध्वर्युर् अथ ब्रह्माथाग्नीध्रो ऽथ यजमानः /
text_mt: Then the adhvaryu, then the brahman priest, then the āgnīdhra, then the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast: mantham̐ hotāvaghrāyāntarvedi ninayatīty ekeṣām /
meaning: मन्थम्̐ होतावघ्रायान्तर्वेदि निनयतीत्य् एकेषाम् /
text_mt: 'Having smelled the beverage, the hotṛ pours it inside the altar,' according to some.

sanskrit_iast: udakumbham ādāya \\ ayā viṣṭhā janayan karvarāṇi \\ iti triḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ pariṣiñcan paryeti /
meaning: उदकुम्भम् आदाय \\ अया विष्ठा जनयन् कर्वराणि \\ इति त्रिः प्रदक्षिणं परिषिञ्चन् पर्येति /
text_mt: Taking the jar of water, he walks around clockwise three times, sprinkling [water], with: 'Producing different forms through this...'

sanskrit_iast: nidhāya kumbhaṃ trir apariṣiñcan pratiparyeti /
meaning: निधाय कुम्भं त्रिर् अपरिषिञ्चन् प्रतिपर्येति /
text_mt: Having placed down the jar, he walks back around three times without sprinkling.

sanskrit_iast: atrāñjanābhyañjane vāsodānaṃ namaskārān utthāpanīyaṃ pravāhaṇīm̐ sam̐sādhanīṃ manasvatīṃ paṅktiprājāpatyāś ca samāmananti /
meaning: अत्राञ्जनाभ्यञ्जने वासोदानं नमस्कारान् उत्थापनीयं प्रवाहणीम्̐ सम्̐साधनीं मनस्वतीं पङ्क्तिप्राजापत्याश् च समामनन्ति /
text_mt: Here [some teachers] mention the collyrium and ointment, the giving of a garment, the homages, the setting-up verse, the carrying-away verse, the completing verse, the manasvatī verse, and the offerings to Prajāpati in paṅkti metre.

sanskrit_iast: yathā piṇḍapitṛyajñe /
meaning: यथा पिण्डपितृयज्ञे /

sanskrit_iast: vyavacchādayanti pariśritam /
meaning: व्यवच्छादयन्ति परिश्रितम् /
text_mt: They uncover the enclosed [fire].

sanskrit_iast: saṃprasārayanti paridhīn /
meaning: संप्रसारयन्ति परिधीन् /
text_mt: They push apart the enclosing sticks.

sanskrit_iast: visrasya prācīnāvītāni /
meaning: विस्रस्य प्राचीनावीतानि /
text_mt: Having loosened their cords worn over the right shoulder,

sanskrit_iast: yajñopavītāni kurvata ājyāni havīm̐ṣi ca vipariharanti viparikrāmanty ṛtvijo 'pabarhiṣāv anūyājau yajati devau yaja yaja \\ iti pūrvam anūyājam̐ saṃpreṣyati yaja \\ ity uttaram̐ sūktavākaṃ prati hotā nivītaṃ kurute na patnīḥ saṃyājayanti na samiṣṭayajur juhoti sarvam anyat kriyate //
meaning: यज्ञोपवीतानि कुर्वत आज्यानि हवीम्̐षि च विपरिहरन्ति विपरिक्रामन्त्य् ऋत्विजो ऽपबर्हिषाव् अनूयाजौ यजति देवौ यज यज \\ इति पूर्वम् अनूयाजम्̐ संप्रेष्यति यज \\ इत्य् उत्तरम्̐ सूक्तवाकं प्रति होता निवीतं कुरुते न पत्नीः संयाजयन्ति न समिष्टयजुर् जुहोति सर्वम् अन्यत् क्रियते //
text_mt: they put their sacred cords over the left shoulder, carry the clarified butters and sacrificial oblations around, and the priests step around. He performs the two after-offerings without sacred grass. He gives the ritual directions: 'Recite the offering verse for the two gods, recite the offering verse,' for the first after-offering, and 'Recite the offering verse' for the second. During the Sūktavāka the hotṛ wears his cord around his neck. They do not perform the Patnīsaṃyājas. He does not offer the Samiṣṭayajus. Everything else is performed.

sanskrit_iast: raudrām̐s traiyambakān pratipūruṣam ekakapālān nirvapati /
meaning: रौद्राम्̐स् त्रैयम्बकान् प्रतिपूरुषम् एककपालान् निर्वपति /
text_mt: He parcels out one-pot-sherd [cakes] dedicated to Rudra, the Traiyambakas, one for each person,

sanskrit_iast: yāvanto yajamānasyāmātyāḥ sastrīkās tata ekādhikān /
meaning: यावन्तो यजमानस्यामात्याः सस्त्रीकास् तत एकाधिकान् /
text_mt: as many as there are members of the sacrificer's household, including the women, and one more than that.

sanskrit_iast: tūṣṇīm upacaritā bhavanti /
meaning: तूष्णीम् उपचरिता भवन्ति /
text_mt: They are prepared silently.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇārdhe gārhapatyasya śrapyante /
meaning: दक्षिणार्धे गार्हपत्यस्य श्रप्यन्ते /
text_mt: They are baked on the southern half of the gārhapatya fire.

sanskrit_iast: tān abhighāryānabhighārya vā /
meaning: तान् अभिघार्यानभिघार्य वा /
text_mt: Either having smeared them with clarified butter or without smearing them,

sanskrit_iast: mūte mūtayor mūteṣu kośāpidhāne vodvāsya /
meaning: मूते मूतयोर् मूतेषु कोशापिधाने वोद्वास्य /
text_mt: having taken them down into a basket, two baskets, several baskets, or into a covered chest,

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇāgner ekolmukaṃ dhūpāyat parācīnam apareṇa gārhapatyam atyāhṛtyāgrato haranti /
meaning: दक्षिणाग्नेर् एकोल्मुकं धूपायत् पराचीनम् अपरेण गार्हपत्यम् अत्याहृत्याग्रतो हरन्ति /
text_mt: having fetched a single smoking firebrand turned away from the dakṣiṇāgni fire past the west of the gārhapatya fire, they carry it in front.

sanskrit_iast: yāvanto gṛhyāḥ smas \\ iti gārhapatyam upatiṣṭhate /
meaning: यावन्तो गृह्याः स्मस् \\ इति गार्हपत्यम् उपतिष्ठते /
text_mt: He attends upon the gārhapatya fire with: 'As many as we are of the household...'

sanskrit_iast: uttarapūrvam avāntaradeśaṃ gacchanti /
meaning: उत्तरपूर्वम् अवान्तरदेशं गच्छन्ति /
text_mt: They go to the north-eastern intermediate direction.

sanskrit_iast: ākhus te rudra paśus \\ iti vrajann evākhūtkara ekaṃ puroḍāśam upavapati /
meaning: आखुस् ते रुद्र पशुस् \\ इति व्रजन्न् एवाखूत्कर एकं पुरोडाशम् उपवपति /
text_mt: While walking, he deposits one sacrificial cake upon a molehill with: 'The mole is your victim, O Rudra.'

sanskrit_iast: catuṣpatha ekolmukam upasamādhāya saṃparistīrya /
meaning: चतुष्पथ एकोल्मुकम् उपसमाधाय संपरिस्तीर्य /
text_mt: Having set up the single firebrand at a crossroad and strewn around it,

sanskrit_iast: madhyamena palāśaparṇenāntimena vā sarvebhyaḥ puroḍāśebhyaḥ samavadāyābhighārya \\ eṣa te rudra bhāgas \\ iti juhoti /
meaning: मध्यमेन पलाशपर्णेनान्तिमेन वा सर्वेभ्यः पुरोडाशेभ्यः समवदायाभिघार्य \\ एष ते रुद्र भागस् \\ इति जुहोति /
text_mt: having taken a portion from all the sacrificial cakes with the middle palāśa leaf or the end leaf, and having sprinkled it with clarified butter, he offers it with: 'This is your share, O Rudra...'

sanskrit_iast: bheṣajaṃ gave \\ iti dvābhyām upatiṣṭhante /
meaning: भेषजं गवे \\ इति द्वाभ्याम् उपतिष्ठन्ते /
text_mt: They attend [upon the fire] with the two [mantras beginning]: 'A medicine for the cow...'

sanskrit_iast: pratipūruṣaṃ puroḍāśān ādāya /
meaning: प्रतिपूरुषं पुरोडाशान् आदाय /
text_mt: Taking sacrificial cakes, one for each person,

sanskrit_iast: tryambakaṃ yajāmahe \\ iti triḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ catuṣpathaṃ pariyanti /
meaning: त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे \\ इति त्रिः प्रदक्षिणं चतुष्पथं परियन्ति /
text_mt: they circumambulate the crossroad three times sunwise with: 'We sacrifice to Tryambaka...'

sanskrit_iast: tān ūrdhvān udasya bhagavaḥ stha \ bhagasya vo lipsīya \\ iti pratigṛhya parītya yajamānāya samāvapanti /
meaning: तान् ऊर्ध्वान् उदस्य भगवः स्थ \ भगस्य वो लिप्सीय \\ इति प्रतिगृह्य परीत्य यजमानाय समावपन्ति /
text_mt: Tossing them upwards and catching them with: 'You are lordly, may I partake of your fortune,' they walk around and pour them together into the sacrificer's lap.

sanskrit_iast: yadi yajamānasya duhitā patikāmā syāt sā viparīyāt /
meaning: यदि यजमानस्य दुहिता पतिकामा स्यात् सा विपरीयात् /
text_mt: If the sacrificer has a daughter who desires a husband, she should circumambulate counter-sunwise.

sanskrit_iast: tryambakaṃ yajāmahe \ sugandhiṃ pativedanam / \ urvārukam iva bandhanāt \\ mṛtyor mukṣīya mā pates \\ iti parikramya japati //
meaning: त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे \ सुगन्धिं पतिवेदनम् / \ उर्वारुकम् इव बन्धनात् \\ मृत्योर् मुक्षीय मा पतेस् \\ इति परिक्रम्य जपति //
text_mt: Having circumambulated, she whispers: 'We sacrifice to Tryambaka, the sweet-scented finder of a husband; like a cucumber from its stem, may I be freed from death, not from a husband.'

sanskrit_iast: pūrvayoḥ parikramaṇayor yajamānāya samāvapanty uttame patikāmāyai /
meaning: पूर्वयोः परिक्रमणयोर् यजमानाय समावपन्त्य् उत्तमे पतिकामायै /
text_mt: At the first two circumambulations, they pour them together into the sacrificer's lap; at the last, into that of the [daughter] desiring a husband.

sanskrit_iast: tasyām avidyamānāyām̐ sarvatra yajamānāya /
meaning: तस्याम् अविद्यमानायाम्̐ सर्वत्र यजमानाय /
text_mt: When she is not present, in all cases [they pour them] into the sacrificer's lap.

sanskrit_iast: tān mūta upanahya parogavyūtiṃ gatvā vṛkṣa āsajati /
meaning: तान् मूत उपनह्य परोगव्यूतिं गत्वा वृक्ष आसजति /
text_mt: Having tied them up in a basket, he goes beyond a gavyūti and hangs it on a tree,

sanskrit_iast: eṣa te rudra bhāgas \ taṃ juṣasva tenāvasena paro mūjavato 'tīhi \\ avatatadhanvā pinākahastaḥ kṛttivāsom iti trir avatāmyanti /
meaning: एष ते रुद्र भागस् \ तं जुषस्व तेनावसेन परो मूजवतो ऽतीहि \\ अवततधन्वा पिनाकहस्तः कृत्तिवासोम् इति त्रिर् अवताम्यन्ति /
text_mt: with: 'This is your portion, O Rudra; enjoy it; with this provision go beyond the Mūjavats; with unbent bow, pināka in hand, clad in a skin...' They hold their breath three times.

sanskrit_iast: apaḥ pariṣicyāpratīkṣam āyanti /
meaning: अपः परिषिच्याप्रतीक्षम् आयन्ति /
text_mt: Having poured water all around, they return without looking back.

sanskrit_iast: parogoṣṭhe mārjayante /
meaning: परोगोष्ठे मार्जयन्ते /
text_mt: They purify themselves beyond the cowpen.

sanskrit_iast: edho 'sy edhiṣīmahi \\ ity āhavanīye samidho 'bhyādadhāti /
meaning: एधो ऽस्य् एधिषीमहि \\ इत्य् आहवनीये समिधो ऽभ्यादधाति /
text_mt: He puts pieces of firewood on the āhavanīya fire with: 'You are fuel, may we thrive...'

sanskrit_iast: apo anvacāriṣam ity upatiṣṭhante /
meaning: अपो अन्वचारिषम् इत्य् उपतिष्ठन्ते /
text_mt: They attend [upon the fire] with: 'I have followed the waters...'

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ patnī gārhapatye 'bhyādhāyopatiṣṭhate /
meaning: एवं पत्नी गार्हपत्ये ऽभ्याधायोपतिष्ठते /
text_mt: In the same way, the wife places [fuel] on the gārhapatya fire and attends [upon it].

sanskrit_iast: pratyetyādityaṃ ghṛte caruṃ nirvapati /
meaning: प्रत्येत्यादित्यं घृते चरुं निर्वपति /
text_mt: Having returned, he parcels out a mess of cooked grain in ghee for Āditya.

sanskrit_iast: śvo bhūte paurṇamāseneṣṭvodavasāyānudavasāya vā prasūtā devena savitrā \\ ity undanti / yo asyāḥ pṛthivyās tvaci \ nivartayaty oṣadhīs \\ agnir īṣāna ojasā \ varuṇo dhītibhiḥ saha \\ indro marudbhiḥ sakhibhiḥ saha \\ agnis tigmena śociṣā \\ iti nivartanaṃ vāpanaṃ yathā purastāt //
meaning: श्वो भूते पौर्णमासेनेष्ट्वोदवसायानुदवसाय वा प्रसूता देवेन सवित्रा \\ इत्य् उन्दन्ति / यो अस्याः पृथिव्यास् त्वचि \ निवर्तयत्य् ओषधीस् \\ अग्निर् ईषान ओजसा \ वरुणो धीतिभिः सह \\ इन्द्रो मरुद्भिः सखिभिः सह \\ अग्निस् तिग्मेन शोचिषा \\ इति निवर्तनं वापनं यथा पुरस्तात् //
text_mt: On the next day, having sacrificed with the Full Moon rite, whether shifting residence or not, they moisten [the sacrificer's hair] with: 'Impelled by the god Savitṛ...' The turning [of the razor] and the shaving are as before, with: 'He who on the surface of this earth / restores the plants, / Agni, ruler by his power, / Varuṇa together with the prayers, / Indra together with the Maruts as his companions, / Agni with sharp brilliance.'

sanskrit_iast: tato dvyahe tryahe caturahe 'rdhāmāse māsa ṛtau caturṣu vā māseṣu śunāsīrīyeṇa yajate tasya vaiśvadevena kalpo vyākhyātaḥ pañca saṃcarāṇi nirupyaindrāgnaṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapati vaiśvadevaṃ carum indrāya śunāsīrāya puroḍāśaṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ vāyavyaṃ payaḥ sauryam ekakapālaṃ vāyavyā yavāgūḥ pratidhug vendrāya śunāsīrāya puroḍāśaṃ dvādaśakapālam uttamam eke samāmananti /
meaning: ततो द्व्यहे त्र्यहे चतुरहे ऽर्धामासे मास ऋतौ चतुर्षु वा मासेषु शुनासीरीयेण यजते तस्य वैश्वदेवेन कल्पो व्याख्यातः पञ्च संचराणि निरुप्यैन्द्राग्नं द्वादशकपालं निर्वपति वैश्वदेवं चरुम् इन्द्राय शुनासीराय पुरोडाशं द्वादशकपालं वायव्यं पयः सौर्यम् एककपालं वायव्या यवागूः प्रतिधुग् वेन्द्राय शुनासीराय पुरोडाशं द्वादशकपालम् उत्तमम् एके समामनन्ति /
text_mt: Then after two days, three days, four days, a half-month, a month, a season, or four months, he sacrifices with the Śunāsīrīya; its procedure is explained by the Vaiśvadeva; having parceled out the five shared oblations, he parcels out a cake on twelve potsherds for Indra-and-Agni, a mess of cooked grain for the All-gods, a cake on twelve potsherds for Indra Śunāsīra, milk for Vāyu, and a cake on one potsherd for Sūrya; some teach barley gruel or fresh milk for Vāyu, or the cake on twelve potsherds for Indra Śunāsīra as the last.

sanskrit_iast: sam̐sarpo 'si \\ am̐haspatyāya tvā \\ ity uttamena māsanāmnaikakapālam abhijuhoti /
meaning: सम्̐सर्पो ऽसि \\ अम्̐हस्पत्याय त्वा \\ इत्य् उत्तमेन मासनाम्नैककपालम् अभिजुहोति /
text_mt: He offers over the one-pot-sherd [cake] with the last month-name: 'You are Saṃsarpa; for Aṃhaspatya thee!'

sanskrit_iast: anuvatsarīṇām̐ svastim āśāste divyaṃ dhāmāśāste \\ iti sūktavākasyāśīṣṣu hotānuvartayati vatsarīṇām iti vā /
meaning: अनुवत्सरीणाम्̐ स्वस्तिम् आशास्ते दिव्यं धामाशास्ते \\ इति सूक्तवाकस्याशीष्षु होतानुवर्तयति वत्सरीणाम् इति वा /
text_mt: In the blessings of the Sūktavāka, the hotṛ adds: 'He prays for well-being for the coming year, he prays for the heavenly abode,' or '...for the year.'

sanskrit_iast: aparapakṣe samasthan svakāle paurṇamāsayeneṣṭvodavasāyānudavasāya vā prasūtā devena savitrā \\ ity undanti \\ ekaṃ māsam udasṛjat \ parameṣṭhī prajābhyas \ tenābhyo maha āvahat \\ amṛtaṃ martyābhyaḥ \ prajām anu prajāyase \ tad u te martyāmṛtam \\ yena māsā ardhamāsās \\ ṛtavaḥ parivatsarās \\ yena te te prajāpate \\ ījānasya nyavartayan \ tenāham asya brahmaṇā \ nivartayāmi jīvase \\ agnis tigmena śociṣā \\ iti nivartanaṃ vāpanaṃ yathā purastāt //
meaning: अपरपक्षे समस्थन् स्वकाले पौर्णमासयेनेष्ट्वोदवसायानुदवसाय वा प्रसूता देवेन सवित्रा \\ इत्य् उन्दन्ति \\ एकं मासम् उदसृजत् \ परमेष्ठी प्रजाभ्यस् \ तेनाभ्यो मह आवहत् \\ अमृतं मर्त्याभ्यः \ प्रजाम् अनु प्रजायसे \ तद् उ ते मर्त्यामृतम् \\ येन मासा अर्धमासास् \\ ऋतवः परिवत्सरास् \\ येन ते ते प्रजापते \\ ईजानस्य न्यवर्तयन् \ तेनाहम् अस्य ब्रह्मणा \ निवर्तयामि जीवसे \\ अग्निस् तिग्मेन शोचिषा \\ इति निवर्तनं वापनं यथा पुरस्तात् //
text_mt: The rites conclude in the dark fortnight; having sacrificed at its proper time with the Full Moon rite, whether shifting residence or not, they moisten [his hair] with: 'Impelled by the god Savitṛ...' The turning [of the razor] and the shaving are as before, with: 'Parameṣṭhin released one month / for his creatures; / through it he brought great / immortality to mortals. / Following offspring you are born again; / that indeed, mortal, is your immortality. / With which the months, the half-months, / the seasons, the full years— / with which they shaved you, O Prajāpati, / who had sacrificed, / with that sacred formula I shave / his hair for life; / Agni with sharp brilliance.'

sanskrit_iast: saṃtiṣṭhante cāturmāsyāni /
meaning: संतिष्ठन्ते चातुर्मास्यानि /
text_mt: The Cāturmāsyas come to a conclusion.

sanskrit_iast: nainam anījānam̐ somena phālgunī prāpnuyāt /
meaning: नैनम् अनीजानम्̐ सोमेन फाल्गुनी प्राप्नुयात् /
text_mt: The Phālgunī [full moon] should not overtake him without his having sacrificed with soma.

sanskrit_iast: somābhāve paśunā /
meaning: सोमाभावे पशुना /

sanskrit_iast: paśvabhāve punaḥprayogaś cāturmāsyānām /
meaning: पश्वभावे पुनःप्रयोगश् चातुर्मास्यानाम् /
text_mt: In the absence of an animal sacrifice, there is repetition of the Cāturmāsyas.

sanskrit_iast: vaiśvadevena pásukāmo yajeta yasminn asya vasante bhūyiṣṭhaṃ payaḥ syāt /
meaning: वैश्वदेवेन प्áसुकामो यजेत यस्मिन्न् अस्य वसन्ते भूयिष्ठं पयः स्यात् /
text_mt: One desiring cattle should sacrifice with the Vaiśvadeva in that spring in which he would have abundant milk.

sanskrit_iast: vaiśvadevena paśukāmo yajeta yāvat sahasraṃ paśūn prāpnuyāt /
meaning: वैश्वदेवेन पशुकामो यजेत यावत् सहस्रं पशून् प्राप्नुयात् /
text_mt: One desiring cattle should sacrifice with the Vaiśvadeva until he obtains a thousand cattle.

sanskrit_iast: prāpte sahasre svasthānair itarair yajate /
meaning: प्राप्ते सहस्रे स्वस्थानैर् इतरैर् यजते /
text_mt: When a thousand have been obtained, he sacrifices with the other [rites] in their proper places.

sanskrit_iast: śunāsīrīyeṇa yajeta grāmakāmaḥ prajākāmaḥ paśukāmo vṛṣṭikāmo 'nnādyakāmo vā varṇyam udakam anvavasāya tat udakārthān kurvāṇaḥ /
meaning: शुनासीरीयेण यजेत ग्रामकामः प्रजाकामः पशुकामो वृष्टिकामो ऽन्नाद्यकामो वा वर्ण्यम् उदकम् अन्ववसाय तत् उदकार्थान् कुर्वाणः /
text_mt: One desiring a village, one desiring offspring, one desiring cattle, one desiring rain, or one desiring food should sacrifice with the Śunāsīrīya, having moved near flowing water and performing his water-rites there.

sanskrit_iast: pañcasaṃvatsarāṇi vyākhyāsyāmas tantraṃ pañcahotā vaiśvānarapārjanyau ca phālgunyāṃ prayujya dvāvṛt saṃvatsarāv iṣṭvā tṛtīyasya māsaṃ na yajeta caitryāṃ tu prayujya trīn ṛtūn saṃvatsarān iṣṭvā caturthasya māsaṃ na yajetaivaṃ vihitaṃ dvyavarārdhyaṃ tryavarārdhyaṃ vābhyasyed abhyasyet //
meaning: पञ्चसंवत्सराणि व्याख्यास्यामस् तन्त्रं पञ्चहोता वैश्वानरपार्जन्यौ च फाल्गुन्यां प्रयुज्य द्वावृत् संवत्सराव् इष्ट्वा तृतीयस्य मासं न यजेत चैत्र्यां तु प्रयुज्य त्रीन् ऋतून् संवत्सरान् इष्ट्वा चतुर्थस्य मासं न यजेतैवं विहितं द्व्यवरार्ध्यं त्र्यवरार्ध्यं वाभ्यस्येद् अभ्यस्येत् //
text_mt: We shall explain the five-year cycle: having employed the sacrificial framework, the Pañcahotṛ, and the Vaiśvānara and Pārjanya offerings at the Phālgunī full moon, and having sacrificed for two complete years, he should not sacrifice during the month of the third; but having employed them at the Caitrī full moon and having sacrificed for three seasons [or] years, he should not sacrifice during the month of the fourth; he should repeat, he should repeat such a rule having two as the minimum or three as the minimum.

sanskrit_iast: yājamānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ /
meaning: याजमानं व्याख्यास्यामः /
text_mt: We shall explain the duties of the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast: samaste kratāv arthaṃ śrūyamāṇaṃ yajamānaḥ kāmayate /
meaning: समस्ते क्रताव् अर्थं श्रूयमाणं यजमानः कामयते /
text_mt: The sacrificer desires the purpose that is taught in the sacrifice as a whole.

sanskrit_iast: tathā nityeṣu yajñāṅgeṣu yāni tu kāmayatiḥ śrāvayati /
meaning: तथा नित्येषु यज्ञाङ्गेषु यानि तु कामयतिः श्रावयति /
text_mt: Likewise in the regular limbs of the sacrifice, those which [the text] makes heard with [the verb] 'he desires';

sanskrit_iast: yathāghārasyordhvatāyāṃ nīcaistāyāṃ ca /
meaning: यथाघारस्योर्ध्वतायां नीचैस्तायां च /
text_mt: such as in the highness and the lowness of the libation of clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: arthavādā itare /
meaning: अर्थवादा इतरे /

sanskrit_iast: tathānyeṣu yajñāṅgeṣu purīṣavatīṃ karoti prajayaivainaṃ paśubhiḥ purīṣavantaṃ karoti yad yūpaṃ minoti suvargasya lokasya prajñātyai \\ iṣe tvā \\ ūrje tvā \\ iti śākhām ācchinattīṣam evorjaṃ yajamāne dadhātīti /
meaning: तथान्येषु यज्ञाङ्गेषु पुरीषवतीं करोति प्रजयैवैनं पशुभिः पुरीषवन्तं करोति यद् यूपं मिनोति सुवर्गस्य लोकस्य प्रज्ञात्यै \\ इषे त्वा \\ ऊर्जे त्वा \\ इति शाखाम् आच्छिनत्तीषम् एवोर्जं यजमाने दधातीति /
text_mt: likewise in the other limbs of the sacrifice: 'He makes it full of loose earth; through offspring and cattle he makes him full of loose earth'; 'In that he sets up the sacrificial post, it is for the comprehension of the heavenly world'; 'He cuts off the branch with: "For sap thee, for strength thee"; he bestows sap and strength upon the sacrificer.'

sanskrit_iast: dravyaprakalpanaṃ yajamānasya dakṣiṇādānaṃ brahmacaryaṃ japāś ca /
meaning: द्रव्यप्रकल्पनं यजमानस्य दक्षिणादानं ब्रह्मचर्यं जपाश् च /
text_mt: The procuring of the materials belongs to the sacrificer, [as do] the giving of sacrificial gifts, celibacy, and the whispered prayers.

sanskrit_iast: pratyagāśiṣo mantrān akarmakaraṇāñ japati /
meaning: प्रत्यगाशिषो मन्त्रान् अकर्मकरणाञ् जपति /
text_mt: He silently recites the mantras bestowing personal blessings that do not accompany any ritual act.

sanskrit_iast: tathopadiśyamānān upatiṣṭhate 'numantrayate 'bhimantrayate 'bhimṛśati japatīti ca /
meaning: तथोपदिश्यमानान् उपतिष्ठते ऽनुमन्त्रयते ऽभिमन्त्रयते ऽभिमृशति जपतीति च /
text_mt: Likewise, whenever instructed [in the text], he stands in attendance, follows [an action] with a mantra, addresses [an object] with a mantra, touches [an object], or mutters [a mantra].

sanskrit_iast: yāvaduktaṃ karmāṇi karoti /
meaning: यावदुक्तं कर्माणि करोति /
text_mt: He performs the rites only as far as specified.

sanskrit_iast: yāvaduktaṃ patnyāḥ karmāṇi brahmacaryaṃ japāś ca /
meaning: यावदुक्तं पत्न्याः कर्माणि ब्रह्मचर्यं जपाश् च /
text_mt: The rites of the wife, her celibacy, and her muttered prayers are also only as far as specified.

sanskrit_iast: darśapūrṇamāsayor yājamānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ /
meaning: दर्शपूर्णमासयोर् याजमानं व्याख्यास्यामः /
text_mt: We shall explain the duties of the sacrificer in the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast: parvaṇi yajamānaḥ keśaśmaśrūṇi vāpayate /
meaning: पर्वणि यजमानः केशश्मश्रूणि वापयते /
text_mt: On the day of the change of the moon, the sacrificer has his hair and beard shaved.

sanskrit_iast: paurṇamāsyāṃ prātarāśe jāyāpatī sarpirmiśram aśnītaḥ /
meaning: पौर्णमास्यां प्रातराशे जायापती सर्पिर्मिश्रम् अश्नीतः /
text_mt: At the morning meal of the Full Moon rite, the husband and wife eat [food] mixed with clarified butter,

sanskrit_iast: yad anyan māṃsān māṣebhyaś ca /
meaning: यद् अन्यन् मांसान् माषेभ्यश् च /
text_mt: whatever is other than meat and kidney beans.

sanskrit_iast: na suhitau syātām /
meaning: न सुहितौ स्याताम् /

sanskrit_iast: prāg vatsāpākaraṇād amāvāsyāyāṃ kāmaṃ suhitau syātām /
meaning: प्राग् वत्सापाकरणाद् अमावास्यायां कामं सुहितौ स्याताम् /
text_mt: At the New Moon rite, before the calves are driven away, they may eat their fill at will.

sanskrit_iast: agniṃ gṛhṇāmi suratham ity anvādhīyamāneṣu japati /
meaning: अग्निं गृह्णामि सुरथम् इत्य् अन्वाधीयमानेषु जपति /
text_mt: While the fires are being fueled, he mutters: 'I take hold of Agni having a good chariot...'

sanskrit_iast: idam aham agnijyeṣṭhebhyo vasubhyo yajñaṃ pravravīmi \\ idam aham indrajyeṣṭhebhyo rudrebhyo yajñaṃ prabravīmi \\ idam ahaṃ varuṇajyeṣṭhebhya ādityebhyo yajñaṃ prabravīmi \\ ity anvāhiteṣu /
meaning: इदम् अहम् अग्निज्येष्ठेभ्यो वसुभ्यो यज्ञं प्रव्रवीमि \\ इदम् अहम् इन्द्रज्येष्ठेभ्यो रुद्रेभ्यो यज्ञं प्रब्रवीमि \\ इदम् अहं वरुणज्येष्ठेभ्य आदित्येभ्यो यज्ञं प्रब्रवीमि \\ इत्य् अन्वाहितेषु /
text_mt: When the fires have been fueled, [he mutters:] 'Here I declare the sacrifice to the Vasus who have Agni as their chief; here I declare the sacrifice to the Rudras who have Indra as their chief; here I declare the sacrifice to the Ādityas who have Varuṇa as their chief.'

sanskrit_iast: barhiṣā pūrṇamāse vratam upaiti vatsair amāvāsyāyām /
meaning: बर्हिषा पूर्णमासे व्रतम् उपैति वत्सैर् अमावास्यायाम् /
text_mt: At the Full Moon rite, he undertakes the ritual observance with [the cutting of] the sacrificial grass; at the New Moon rite, with [the driving away of] the calves.

sanskrit_iast: aśanam agnyanvādhānaṃ vratopāyanam ity evam anupūrvāṇy eke samāmananti /
meaning: अशनम् अग्न्यन्वाधानं व्रतोपायनम् इत्य् एवम् अनुपूर्वाण्य् एके समामनन्ति /
text_mt: Some teach the order thus: eating, fueling the fires, undertaking the ritual observance.

sanskrit_iast: agnyanvādhānam aśanaṃ vratopāyanam ity eke /
meaning: अग्न्यन्वाधानम् अशनं व्रतोपायनम् इत्य् एके /
text_mt: Others [teach]: fueling the fires, eating, undertaking the ritual observance.

sanskrit_iast: praṇītāsu praṇīyamānāsv āsanneṣu haviḥṣu caitau sādhāraṇau kālau /
meaning: प्रणीतासु प्रणीयमानास्व् आसन्नेषु हविःषु चैतौ साधारणौ कालौ /
text_mt: While the praṇītā waters are being brought forward and when the sacrificial oblations have been set down—these are the two common times [for entering upon the ritual observance].

sanskrit_iast: vidyud asi \\ ity apa upaspṛśya /
meaning: विद्युद् असि \\ इत्य् अप उपस्पृश्य /
text_mt: Having touched water with: 'You are lightning...'

sanskrit_iast: apareṇāhavanīyaṃ dakṣiṇātikramya payasvatīr oṣadhayas \\ ity apa ācāmati /
meaning: अपरेणाहवनीयं दक्षिणातिक्रम्य पयस्वतीर् ओषधयस् \\ इत्य् अप आचामति /
text_mt: and stepping past the āhavanīya fire to the south along its west side, he sips water with: 'The plants full of milk...'

sanskrit_iast: devā deveṣu parākramadhvaṃ prathamā dvitīyeṣu dvitīyās tṛtīyeṣu \ trir ekādaśā iha māvata / \ idam̐ śakeyaṃ yad idaṃ karomi \\ ātmā karoty ātmane \\ idaṃ kariṣye bheṣajam \ idaṃ me viśvabheṣajā / \ aśvinā prāvataṃ yuvam iti devatā upatiṣṭhate /
meaning: देवा देवेषु पराक्रमध्वं प्रथमा द्वितीयेषु द्वितीयास् तृतीयेषु \ त्रिर् एकादशा इह मावत / \ इदम्̐ शकेयं यद् इदं करोमि \\ आत्मा करोत्य् आत्मने \\ इदं करिष्ये भेषजम् \ इदं मे विश्वभेषजा / \ अश्विना प्रावतं युवम् इति देवता उपतिष्ठते /
text_mt: He stands in attendance on the deities with: 'O gods, step forward among the gods, the first among the second, the second among the third; thirty-three [gods], protect me here! May I be able to do this which I am doing; the self acts for the self; I shall make this healing, this all-healing for me; O Aśvins, do you two protect [me]!'

sanskrit_iast: samudraṃ manasā dhyāyan samrāḍ asi \ vratapā asi \ vratānāṃ vratapatir asi \ vratam ārabhe \ tat te prabravīmi \ tac chakeyam \\ tena śakeyam \\ tena rādhyāsam ity ādityam upatiṣṭhate /
meaning: समुद्रं मनसा ध्यायन् सम्राड् असि \ व्रतपा असि \ व्रतानां व्रतपतिर् असि \ व्रतम् आरभे \ तत् ते प्रब्रवीमि \ तच् छकेयम् \\ तेन शकेयम् \\ तेन राध्यासम् इत्य् आदित्यम् उपतिष्ठते /
text_mt: Contemplating the ocean with his mind, he stands in attendance on the Sun with: 'You are sovereign; you are the guardian of observances; you are the lord of observances among observances; I begin the observance; that I declare to you; may I be able to do that; with that may I succeed; thereby may I prosper!'

sanskrit_iast: agne vratapate vrataṃ cariṣyāmi \\ iti brāhmaṇo 'gnim upatiṣṭhate /
meaning: अग्ने व्रतपते व्रतं चरिष्यामि \\ इति ब्राह्मणो ऽग्निम् उपतिष्ठते /
text_mt: A brāhmaṇa sacrificer stands in attendance on Agni with: 'O Agni, lord of observances, I shall perform the observance!'

sanskrit_iast: vāyo vratapate \\ iti vāyum āditya vratapate \\ ity ādityaṃ vratānāṃ vratapate \\ iti vratapatim /
meaning: वायो व्रतपते \\ इति वायुम् आदित्य व्रतपते \\ इत्य् आदित्यं व्रतानां व्रतपते \\ इति व्रतपतिम् /
text_mt: On Vāyu with: 'O Vāyu, lord of observances...'; on the Sun with: 'O Sun, lord of observances...'; on the Lord of Observances with: 'O Lord of Observances among observances...'

sanskrit_iast: ete sādhāraṇā ṛte 'gneḥ /
meaning: एते साधारणा ऋते ऽग्नेः /

sanskrit_iast: yady astamitaḥ syād āhavanīyam evādityopasthānenopatiṣṭhate /
meaning: यद्य् अस्तमितः स्याद् आहवनीयम् एवादित्योपस्थानेनोपतिष्ठते /
text_mt: If [the Sun] has set, he attends upon the āhavanīya fire itself with the formula for attending upon the Sun.

sanskrit_iast: parvaṇi yajamānaḥ svayam agnihotraṃ juhoti //
meaning: पर्वणि यजमानः स्वयम् अग्निहोत्रं जुहोति //
text_mt: On the day of the change of the moon, the sacrificer himself offers the Agnihotra.

sanskrit_iast: yavāgvāmāvāsyāyām̐ saṃnayan /
meaning: यवाग्वामावास्यायाम्̐ संनयन् /
text_mt: With barley gruel on the New Moon day, if he is to perform the curd-and-milk oblation.

sanskrit_iast: tasyā uccheṣaṇam ātañcanārthaṃ nidadhāti /
meaning: तस्या उच्छेषणम् आतञ्चनार्थं निदधाति /
text_mt: He sets aside the remainder of it for curdling [the milk].

sanskrit_iast: nānṛtaṃ vadati na mām̐sam aśnāti na striyam upaiti naitām̐ rātrim aśnāti /
meaning: नानृतं वदति न माम्̐सम् अश्नाति न स्त्रियम् उपैति नैताम्̐ रात्रिम् अश्नाति /
text_mt: He speaks no untruth, eats no meat, approaches no woman, and eats nothing that night.

sanskrit_iast: āraṇyasya sāyam aśnāti /
meaning: आरण्यस्य सायम् अश्नाति /
text_mt: In the evening he eats wild [produce].

sanskrit_iast: ā mārgād ā madhuna ā prāśātikād ity ekeṣām /
meaning: आ मार्गाद् आ मधुन आ प्राशातिकाद् इत्य् एकेषाम् /
text_mt: According to some, [he may eat anything wild] up to deer, up to honey, up to wild rice.

sanskrit_iast: āraṇyāyopavasann apo 'śnīyān na vā kiṃcana /
meaning: आरण्यायोपवसन्न् अपो ऽश्नीयान् न वा किंचन /
text_mt: Fasting with wild [produce], he should drink water, or [consume] nothing at all.

sanskrit_iast: ubhāv agnī upastṛṇate \ devatā upavasantu me / \ ahaṃ grāmyān upavasāmi \ mahyaṃ gopataye paśūn iti paristīryamāṇeṣu japati /
meaning: उभाव् अग्नी उपस्तृणते \ देवता उपवसन्तु मे / \ अहं ग्राम्यान् उपवसामि \ मह्यं गोपतये पशून् इति परिस्तीर्यमाणेषु जपति /
text_mt: While [the areas around] both fires are being strewn with grass, he mutters: 'They strew both fires; let the deities fast for me; I fast for domestic animals, for me, the master of cattle.'

sanskrit_iast: āhavanīyāgāre gārhapatyāgāre vā saṃviśati /
meaning: आहवनीयागारे गार्हपत्यागारे वा संविशति /
text_mt: He lies down to sleep in the hall of the āhavanīya or in the hall of the gārhapatya.

sanskrit_iast: amāvāsyāyāṃ rātriṃ jāgarti /
meaning: अमावास्यायां रात्रिं जागर्ति /
text_mt: On the night of the New Moon, he stays awake.

sanskrit_iast: api vā yathā śaknuyāt tathā kuryāt /
