text_mt: All these are performed in the subsequent [rites].

sanskrit_iast: savanīye paśau savanīyeṣu ca puroḍāśeṣu nāgnyanvādhānaṃ vidyate //
meaning: सवनीये पशौ सवनीयेषु च पुरोडाशेषु नाग्न्यन्वाधानं विद्यते //
text_mt: For the Savanīya animal sacrifice and for the Savanīya sacrificial cakes, there is no fueling of the fires.

sanskrit_iast: prāyaṇīyāyās tantraṃ prakramayati /
meaning: प्रायणीयायास् तन्त्रं प्रक्रमयति /
text_mt: He sets in motion the sacrificial framework of the introductory rite.

sanskrit_iast: tatra yāvat kriyate tad vyākhyāsyāmaḥ /
meaning: तत्र यावत् क्रियते तद् व्याख्यास्यामः /
text_mt: There, we shall explain as much as is performed.

sanskrit_iast: agnīn anvādhāyedhmābarhir āharati /
meaning: अग्नीन् अन्वाधायेध्माबर्हिर् आहरति /
text_mt: Having fueled the fires, he brings the firewood and sacrificial grass.

sanskrit_iast: saptadaśa sāmidhenyo nānūyājasamidham upasaṃnahyati yady anūyājā na bhavanti /
meaning: सप्तदश सामिधेन्यो नानूयाजसमिधम् उपसंनह्यति यद्य् अनूयाजा न भवन्ति /
text_mt: There are seventeen kindling verses; he does not bind on the after-offering stick if there are no after-offerings.

sanskrit_iast: vedaṃ kṛtvāgnīn paristīrya pāṇī prakṣālyolaparājīm̐ stīrtvā yathārthaṃ pātrāṇi prayunakti sthālīṃ kapālānām̐ sthāne prayunakti /
meaning: वेदं कृत्वाग्नीन् परिस्तीर्य पाणी प्रक्षाल्योलपराजीम्̐ स्तीर्त्वा यथार्थं पात्राणि प्रयुनक्ति स्थालीं कपालानाम्̐ स्थाने प्रयुनक्ति /
text_mt: Having made the veda-broom, enclosed the fires with grass, washed his hands, and spread the strew of grass, he arranges the utensils according to need; he arranges an earthen pot instead of potsherds.

sanskrit_iast: nirvapaṇakāle 'dityai prāyaṇīyaṃ caruṃ nirvapati payasi śrapayati /
meaning: निर्वपणकाले ऽदित्यै प्रायणीयं चरुं निर्वपति पयसि श्रपयति /
text_mt: At the time of measuring out the oblation, he measures out the introductory boiled mess of rice for Aditi; he cooks it in milk.

sanskrit_iast: caturgṛhītāny ājyāni gṛhṇāti yady anūyājā na bhavanti /
meaning: चतुर्गृहीतान्य् आज्यानि गृह्णाति यद्य् अनूयाजा न भवन्ति /
text_mt: He takes portions of clarified butter in four ladlings, if there are no after-offerings.

sanskrit_iast: ṣaḍḍhotrā prāyaṇīyam āsādayati /
meaning: षड्ढोत्रा प्रायणीयम् आसादयति /
text_mt: He sets down the introductory oblation with the sixfold Hotṛ formula.

sanskrit_iast: sarvam idhmam ādadhāti sarvam aupabhṛtam̐ samānayate yady anūyājā na bhavanti /
meaning: सर्वम् इध्मम् आदधाति सर्वम् औपभृतम्̐ समानयते यद्य् अनूयाजा न भवन्ति /
text_mt: He puts all the firewood on the fire; he pours together all [the clarified butter] in the upabhṛt ladle, if there are no after-offerings.

sanskrit_iast: ājyabhāgām̐ś caturo yajati pathyām̐ svastiṃ purastād agniṃ dakṣiṇataḥ somaṃ paścāt savitāram uttarato 'ditiṃ madhye haviṣā sthālīṃ niṣkāsaṃ mekṣaṇaṃ ca nidadhāti /
meaning: आज्यभागाम्̐श् चतुरो यजति पथ्याम्̐ स्वस्तिं पुरस्ताद् अग्निं दक्षिणतः सोमं पश्चात् सवितारम् उत्तरतो ऽदितिं मध्ये हविषा स्थालीं निष्कासं मेक्षणं च निदधाति /
text_mt: He offers four clarified butter portions: to Pathyā Svasti in the east, Agni in the south, Soma in the west, Savitṛ in the north, and Aditi in the middle with the oblation; he puts aside the pot, the scrapings, and the stirring stick.

sanskrit_iast: dhruvāyāḥ śeṣaṃ karoti /
meaning: ध्रुवायाः शेषं करोति /
text_mt: He leaves a residue in the dhruvā ladle.

sanskrit_iast: śaṃyvantā kṛtsnā vā /
meaning: शंय्वन्ता कृत्स्ना वा /

sanskrit_iast: na yajamānabhāgam avadyati yadi śaṃyvantā /
meaning: न यजमानभागम् अवद्यति यदि शंय्वन्ता /
text_mt: He does not cut off the sacrificer's portion if it ends with the Śaṃyu-formula.

sanskrit_iast: atra rājño nivapanam eke samāmananti /
meaning: अत्र राज्ञो निवपनम् एके समामनन्ति /
text_mt: Here, some teach the pouring out of King [Soma].

sanskrit_iast: dhruvāśeṣāc caturgṛhītaṃ pañcagṛhītaṃ vā gṛhītvā \\ iyaṃ te śukratanūs \\ iti darbheṇa hiraṇyaṃ niṣṭarkyaṃ baddhvājye 'vadadhāti /
meaning: ध्रुवाशेषाच् चतुर्गृहीतं पञ्चगृहीतं वा गृहीत्वा \\ इयं ते शुक्रतनूस् \\ इति दर्भेण हिरण्यं निष्टर्क्यं बद्ध्वाज्ये ऽवदधाति /
text_mt: Having taken four or five ladlings from the residue in the dhruvā ladle, reciting “This is your bright body,” having tied a piece of gold in a slipknot with a darbha blade, he puts it into the clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: upakḷptā somakrayaṇī samaṅgā bandhumatī yathāgnīṣomīyo babhrur aruṇā rohiṇī vopadhvastā prapīnātha vā rohiṇī piṅgākṣī babhrulomnī śvitropakāśā pṛśnivālā pṛśniśaphaikahāyanī dvihāyanī trihāyaṇī vā jūr asi \\ iti tām īkṣamāṇa etac caturgṛhītaṃ juhoti /
meaning: उपकॢप्ता सोमक्रयणी समङ्गा बन्धुमती यथाग्नीषोमीयो बभ्रुर् अरुणा रोहिणी वोपध्वस्ता प्रपीनाथ वा रोहिणी पिङ्गाक्षी बभ्रुलोम्नी श्वित्रोपकाशा पृश्निवाला पृश्निशफैकहायनी द्विहायनी त्रिहायणी वा जूर् असि \\ इति ताम् ईक्षमाण एतच् चतुर्गृहीतं जुहोति /
text_mt: The soma-purchasing cow is prepared: well-formed, of good pedigree, resembling the Agnīṣomīya [victim], brown, reddish, or red, speckled, very fat, or red with reddish-brown eyes, with brown hair, white-spotted, with a dappled tail, with dappled hooves, one year old, two years old, or three years old; gazing upon her, with “You are swift,” he offers this fourfold ladling.

sanskrit_iast: aparaṃ caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvā śukram asi \\ amṛtam asi \\ iti hiraṇyaṃ ghṛtād uddharati /
meaning: अपरं चतुर्गृहीतं गृहीत्वा शुक्रम् असि \\ अमृतम् असि \\ इति हिरण्यं घृताद् उद्धरति /
text_mt: Taking another fourfold ladling, reciting “You are bright,” “You are immortal,” he lifts the gold out of the clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: vaiśvadevam̐ havis \\ ity abhimantrayate /
meaning: वैश्वदेवम्̐ हविस् \\ इत्य् अभिमन्त्रयते /
text_mt: With “Sacrificial oblation for all the gods,” he recites the mantra over it.

sanskrit_iast: havir asi vaiśvadevam ity avekṣate /
meaning: हविर् असि वैश्वदेवम् इत्य् अवेक्षते /
text_mt: With “You are a sacrificial oblation for all the gods,” he looks at it.

sanskrit_iast: sūryasya cakṣur āruham iti sahiraṇyena pāṇinādityam upatiṣṭhate //
meaning: सूर्यस्य चक्षुर् आरुहम् इति सहिरण्येन पाणिनादित्यम् उपतिष्ठते //
text_mt: With “I have ascended the eye of the sun,” he reveres the sun with the gold in his hand.

sanskrit_iast: cid asi \\ iti somakrayaṇīm̐ sam̐śāsti /
meaning: चिद् असि \\ इति सोमक्रयणीम्̐ सम्̐शास्ति /
text_mt: With “You are thought,” he addresses the soma-purchasing cow.

sanskrit_iast: mitras tvā padi badhnātu \\ iti dakṣiṇe pūrvapāde badhnāti /
meaning: मित्रस् त्वा पदि बध्नातु \\ इति दक्षिणे पूर्वपादे बध्नाति /
text_mt: With “May Mitra bind you by the foot,” he ties [the cord] to her right forefoot.

sanskrit_iast: pūṣādhvanaḥ pātu \\ iti nayati yatra somo 'baddhām akarṇagṛhītāṃ baddhāṃ vā karṇagṛhītām /
meaning: पूषाध्वनः पातु \\ इति नयति यत्र सोमो ऽबद्धाम् अकर्णगृहीतां बद्धां वा कर्णगृहीताम् /
text_mt: With “May Pūṣan protect your paths,” he leads her to where the soma is, either untied and not held by the ear, or tied and held by the ear.

sanskrit_iast: tasyās \\ vasvy asi \\ ity etair mantrair dakṣiṇena pūrvapādena ṣaṭ padāny anunikrāmati /
meaning: तस्यास् \\ वस्व्य् असि \\ इत्य् एतैर् मन्त्रैर् दक्षिणेन पूर्वपादेन षट् पदान्य् अनुनिक्रामति /
text_mt: He follows along six of her right-forefoot footprints with the mantras beginning with “You are Vasvī.”

sanskrit_iast: bṛhaspatis tvā sumne raṇvatu \\ iti saptamaṃ padam abhigṛhṇāti /
meaning: बृहस्पतिस् त्वा सुम्ने रण्वतु \\ इति सप्तमं पदम् अभिगृह्णाति /
text_mt: With “May Bṛhaspati delight you in happiness,” he takes hold of the seventh footprint.

sanskrit_iast: tasmin hiraṇyaṃ nidhāya pṛthivyās tvā mūrdhann ājigharmi \\ ity etac caturgṛhītaṃ juhoti /
meaning: तस्मिन् हिरण्यं निधाय पृथिव्यास् त्वा मूर्धन्न् आजिघर्मि \\ इत्य् एतच् चतुर्गृहीतं जुहोति /
text_mt: Placing the gold upon it, with “I pour you upon the head of the earth,” he offers this fourfold ladling.

sanskrit_iast: apādāya hiraṇyaṃ parilikhitam iti sphyena padaṃ parilikhati yāvad ghṛtam anu visṛtaṃ bhavati tūṣṇīṃ viṣāṇayā cānuparilikhya \\ asme rāyas \\ iti sthālyāṃ padaṃ nivapati /
meaning: अपादाय हिरण्यं परिलिखितम् इति स्फ्येन पदं परिलिखति यावद् घृतम् अनु विसृतं भवति तूष्णीं विषाणया चानुपरिलिख्य \\ अस्मे रायस् \\ इति स्थाल्यां पदं निवपति /
text_mt: Taking away the gold, with “It is circumscribed,” he draws a line around the footprint with the wooden sword as far as the clarified butter has spread; and having silently drawn a line around it with the horn, with “Ours is wealth,” he pours the footprint-[dust] into the pot.

sanskrit_iast: padāyatane sahiraṇyau pāṇī prakṣālya tve rāyas \\ iti padaṃ yajamānāya prayacchati /
meaning: पदायतने सहिरण्यौ पाणी प्रक्षाल्य त्वे रायस् \\ इति पदं यजमानाय प्रयच्छति /
text_mt: Having washed both hands along with the gold at the site of the footprint, with “In you is wealth,” he hands the footprint-[dust] to the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast: tote rāyas \\ iti yajamānaḥ patniyai /
meaning: तोते रायस् \\ इति यजमानः पत्नियै /
text_mt: With “In you is wealth,” the sacrificer hands it to his wife.

sanskrit_iast: māham̐ rāyaspoṣeṇa viyoṣam iti patnī pradīyamānaṃ pratīkṣate /
meaning: माहम्̐ रायस्पोषेण वियोषम् इति पत्नी प्रदीयमानं प्रतीक्षते /
text_mt: With “May I not be separated from abundance of wealth,” the wife gazes at it being handed over.

sanskrit_iast: saṃ devi devyorvaśyā paśyasva \\ iti somakrayaṇyā patnīm̐ saṃkhyāpayati /
meaning: सं देवि देव्योर्वश्या पश्यस्व \\ इति सोमक्रयण्या पत्नीम्̐ संख्यापयति /
text_mt: With “O divine lady, look with the divine Urvaśī,” he causes the wife to look at the soma-purchasing cow.

sanskrit_iast: unnambhaya pṛthivīm iti pada udapātraṃ ninīya traidhaṃ padaṃ prativibhajya gārhapatyasya śīte bhasmani tṛtīyam upavapaty āhavanīye tṛtīyam /
meaning: उन्नम्भय पृथिवीम् इति पद उदपात्रं निनीय त्रैधं पदं प्रतिविभज्य गार्हपत्यस्य शीते भस्मनि तृतीयम् उपवपत्य् आहवनीये तृतीयम् /
text_mt: With “Moisten the earth,” having poured out the water-vessel on the footprint, having divided the footprint-[dust] into three parts, he scatters a third in the cold ashes of the gārhapatya fire, and a third into the āhavanīya fire.

sanskrit_iast: pratiṣiddham ekeṣām āhavanīye /
meaning: प्रतिषिद्धम् एकेषाम् आहवनीये /
text_mt: In the view of some, [scattering it] into the āhavanīya fire is forbidden.

sanskrit_iast: tṛtīyaṃ patniyai prayacchati tat sā gṛheṣu nidhatte /
meaning: तृतीयं पत्नियै प्रयच्छति तत् सा गृहेषु निधत्ते /
text_mt: He hands the third part to the wife; she deposits it in the house.

sanskrit_iast: sūryasya cakṣur āruham ity atrādityopasthānam eke samāmananti /
meaning: सूर्यस्य चक्षुर् आरुहम् इत्य् अत्रादित्योपस्थानम् एके समामनन्ति /
text_mt: Some [teachers] teach standing in attendance on the sun at this point with: 'I have mounted the eye of the sun...'

sanskrit_iast: api panthām agasmahi \\ iti pariśritena śakaṭena cchadiṣmatoddhṛtapūrvaphalakena rājānam accha yāti /
meaning: अपि पन्थाम् अगस्महि \\ इति परिश्रितेन शकटेन च्छदिष्मतोद्धृतपूर्वफलकेन राजानम् अच्छ याति /
text_mt: With: 'We have reached the path...', he goes towards King [Soma] in an enclosed cart provided with a canopy, its front board removed.

sanskrit_iast: uttareṇa rājānam̐ śakaṭaṃ mukhena pratiṣṭhapya \\ amātyo 'si \\ ity abhimantrayate \\ āsmāko 'si \\ iti vā /
meaning: उत्तरेण राजानम्̐ शकटं मुखेन प्रतिष्ठप्य \\ अमात्यो ऽसि \\ इत्य् अभिमन्त्रयते \\ आस्माको ऽसि \\ इति वा /
text_mt: Having halted the cart facing north, to the north of King [Soma], he addresses [him] with: 'You are a companion', or: 'You are ours.'

sanskrit_iast: am̐śunā te am̐śuḥ pṛcyatām ity am̐śūn samudvapati /
meaning: अम्̐शुना ते अम्̐शुः पृच्यताम् इत्य् अम्̐शून् समुद्वपति /
text_mt: With: 'May stalk be joined with your stalk', he scatters the stalks together.

sanskrit_iast: uttareṇa rājānaṃ carmaṇi kṣaumaṃ vāso 'hataṃ mahad dviguṇaṃ caturguṇaṃ vā prācīnadaśam upariṣṭāddaśam āstīrya \\ abhi tyaṃ devam iti tasmin sahiraṇyena pāṇināticchandasarcā rājānaṃ mimīta ekaikayāṅgulyā prasāritayā /
meaning: उत्तरेण राजानं चर्मणि क्षौमं वासो ऽहतं महद् द्विगुणं चतुर्गुणं वा प्राचीनदशम् उपरिष्टाद्दशम् आस्तीर्य \\ अभि त्यं देवम् इति तस्मिन् सहिरण्येन पाणिनातिच्छन्दसर्चा राजानं मिमीत एकैकयाङ्गुल्या प्रसारितया /
text_mt: Having spread out a large, unwashed linen cloth, twofold or fourfold, with fringes to the east and fringes on top, upon a skin to the north of King [Soma], he measures King [Soma] onto it with a gold-bearing hand using the verse in the aticchandas metre: 'Towards that god...', with one outstretched finger at a time.

sanskrit_iast: sarvāsv aṅguṣṭham upanigṛhṇāti /
meaning: सर्वास्व् अङ्गुष्ठम् उपनिगृह्णाति /
text_mt: For each [finger], he holds down the thumb.

sanskrit_iast: yayā prathamaṃ na tayā pañcamaṃ tayaiva daśamam /
meaning: यया प्रथमं न तया पञ्चमं तयैव दशमम् /
text_mt: Not with the one with which [he measures] the first [does he measure] the fifth; with that very one, [he measures] the tenth.

sanskrit_iast: pañcakṛtvo yajuṣā mimīte pañcakṛtvas tūṣṇīm /
meaning: पञ्चकृत्वो यजुषा मिमीते पञ्चकृत्वस् तूष्णीम् /
text_mt: Five times he measures with a yajus; five times silently.

sanskrit_iast: prajābhyas tvā \\ iti pariśiṣṭān am̐śūn upasamūhati /
meaning: प्रजाभ्यस् त्वा \\ इति परिशिष्टान् अम्̐शून् उपसमूहति /
text_mt: With: 'For the creatures, you', he heaps together the remaining stalks.

sanskrit_iast: samudgṛhya vāsaso 'ntān prāṇāya tvā \\ iti kṣaumeṇoṣṇīṣeṇopanahyati /
meaning: समुद्गृह्य वाससो ऽन्तान् प्राणाय त्वा \\ इति क्षौमेणोष्णीषेणोपनह्यति /
text_mt: Gathering up the ends of the cloth, he ties it up with a linen turban, with: 'For out-breath, you.'

sanskrit_iast: vyānāya tvā \\ ity anuśṛnthati
meaning: व्यानाय त्वा \\ इत्य् अनुशृन्थति
text_mt: With: 'For diffused breath, you', he loosens [it].

sanskrit_iast: prajās tvam anuprāṇihi \ prajās tvām anuprāṇantu \\ ity avekṣya \\ eṣa te gāyatro bhāgas \\ ity etair mantrair abhimantrayate //
meaning: प्रजास् त्वम् अनुप्राणिहि \ प्रजास् त्वाम् अनुप्राणन्तु \\ इत्य् अवेक्ष्य \\ एष ते गायत्रो भागस् \\ इत्य् एतैर् मन्त्रैर् अभिमन्त्रयते //
text_mt: Having looked at it with: 'Breathe after the creatures; may the creatures breathe after you', he addresses [it] with these mantras: 'This is your Gāyatra portion...'

sanskrit_iast: tvaṃ viśvebhyo devebhya ṛtūn kalpaya \ dakṣiṇāḥ kalpaya yathartu yathādevatam iti sahiraṇyena pāṇinādityam upatiṣṭhate /
meaning: त्वं विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्य ऋतून् कल्पय \ दक्षिणाः कल्पय यथर्तु यथादेवतम् इति सहिरण्येन पाणिनादित्यम् उपतिष्ठते /
text_mt: With: 'Fashion the seasons for all the gods; fashion the sacrificial gifts according to the season, according to the deity', he stands in attendance on the sun with a gold-bearing hand.

sanskrit_iast: somavikrayiṇe rājānaṃ pradāya taṃ pṛcchati somavikrayin krayyas te somā3s \\ iti /
meaning: सोमविक्रयिणे राजानं प्रदाय तं पृच्छति सोमविक्रयिन् क्रय्यस् ते सोमा3स् \\ इति /
text_mt: Having handed over King [Soma] to the soma-seller, he asks him: 'O soma-seller, is your soma for sale?'

sanskrit_iast: krayyas \\ iti sa pratyāha /
meaning: क्रय्यस् \\ इति स प्रत्याह /
text_mt: 'It is for sale', he replies.

sanskrit_iast: daśabhiḥ krīṇāti /
meaning: दशभिः क्रीणाति /

sanskrit_iast: sapta gāvo hiraṇyaṃ vāso 'jā ca trīṇy etāni /
meaning: सप्त गावो हिरण्यं वासो ऽजा च त्रीण्य् एतानि /
text_mt: Seven cows, gold, a cloth, and a she-goat: these are the three [other items].

sanskrit_iast: daśa gāvo bhavanty athaitāni trīṇīty ekeṣām /
meaning: दश गावो भवन्त्य् अथैतानि त्रीणीत्य् एकेषाम् /
text_mt: According to some [teachers], there are ten cows, and then these three [other items].

sanskrit_iast: api vā caturbhir eva /
meaning: अपि वा चतुर्भिर् एव /

sanskrit_iast: gavā caitaiś ca tribhiḥ /
meaning: गवा चैतैश् च त्रिभिः /
text_mt: with a cow and these three.

sanskrit_iast: gavaikavim̐śātidakṣiṇasya /
meaning: गवैकविम्̐शातिदक्षिणस्य /
text_mt: [The soma is bought] with a cow for [a sacrifice] with a sacrificial gift of twenty-one [cows].

sanskrit_iast: trim̐śatā sahasradakṣiṇasya /
meaning: त्रिम्̐शता सहस्रदक्षिणस्य /
text_mt: With thirty for one with a sacrificial gift of a thousand [cows]:

sanskrit_iast: saptavim̐śatir gāvo hiraṇyaṃ vāso 'jā ca trīṇy etāni /
meaning: सप्तविम्̐शतिर् गावो हिरण्यं वासो ऽजा च त्रीण्य् एतानि /
text_mt: twenty-seven cows, gold, a cloth, and a she-goat: these are the three [other items].

sanskrit_iast: trim̐śad gāvo bhavanty athaitāni trīṇīty ekeṣām /
meaning: त्रिम्̐शद् गावो भवन्त्य् अथैतानि त्रीणीत्य् एकेषाम् /
text_mt: According to some [teachers], there are thirty cows, and then these three [other items].

sanskrit_iast: śatena vājapeye dvābhyām̐ rājasūye sahasreṇāśvamedhe /
meaning: शतेन वाजपेये द्वाभ्याम्̐ राजसूये सहस्रेणाश्वमेधे /
text_mt: With a hundred at the Vājapeya; with two [hundred] at the Rājasūya; with a thousand at the Aśvamedha.

sanskrit_iast: somaṃ te krīṇāmi \\ iti krīṇāti /
meaning: सोमं ते क्रीणामि \\ इति क्रीणाति /
text_mt: He buys with: 'I buy soma from you.'

sanskrit_iast: somaṃ mahāntaṃ bahvardham̐ śobhamānam iti voktvaikaikam anudiśati /
meaning: सोमं महान्तं बह्वर्धम्̐ शोभमानम् इति वोक्त्वैकैकम् अनुदिशति /
text_mt: Or, having said: 'The great soma, having much value, shining', he assigns each one [of the articles]:

sanskrit_iast: kalayā te krīṇāni kuṣṭayā te krīṇāni \ śaphena te krīṇāni \ padā te krīṇāni \\ iti gos trīn pādān prasaṃkhyāya gavā te krīṇāni \\ iti gām /
meaning: कलया ते क्रीणानि कुष्टया ते क्रीणानि \ शफेन ते क्रीणानि \ पदा ते क्रीणानि \\ इति गोस् त्रीन् पादान् प्रसंख्याय गवा ते क्रीणानि \\ इति गाम् /
text_mt: Having counted three feet of the cow with: 'I would buy from you with a sixteenth-part; I would buy from you with an eighth-part; I would buy from you with a hoof; I would buy from you with a foot', [he assigns] the cow with: 'I would buy from you with a cow.'

sanskrit_iast: bhūyo vātaḥ somo rājārhati \\ iti somavikrayyā saṃpadaḥ pratyāha /
meaning: भूयो वातः सोमो राजार्हति \\ इति सोमविक्रय्या संपदः प्रत्याह /
text_mt: Until the completion [of the bargain], the soma-seller replies: 'King Soma is worth more than that.'

sanskrit_iast: bhūya evārhati \\ ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: भूय एवार्हति \\ इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: 'He is indeed worth more', [says] the adhvaryu.

sanskrit_iast: śukraṃ te śukreṇa krīṇāmi \\ iti hiraṇyam /
meaning: शुक्रं ते शुक्रेण क्रीणामि \\ इति हिरण्यम् /
text_mt: [He assigns] the gold with: 'I buy bright with bright from you.'

sanskrit_iast: tapasas tanūr asi \\ ity ajām /
meaning: तपसस् तनूर् असि \\ इत्य् अजाम् /
text_mt: The she-goat with: 'You are the body of ascetic toil.'

sanskrit_iast: dhenvā te krīṇāmi \\ iti dhenum /
meaning: धेन्वा ते क्रीणामि \\ इति धेनुम् /
text_mt: A milch cow with: 'I buy from you with a milch cow.'

sanskrit_iast: ṛṣabheṇa te krīṇāmi \\ ity ṛṣabhaṃ vatsatareṇa sāṇḍenety ekeṣām /
meaning: ऋषभेण ते क्रीणामि \\ इत्य् ऋषभं वत्सतरेण साण्डेनेत्य् एकेषाम् /
text_mt: A bull with: 'I buy from you with a bull'; according to some [teachers], with an uncastrated bull calf.

sanskrit_iast: anaḍuhā te krīṇāmi \\ ity anaḍvāham /
meaning: अनडुहा ते क्रीणामि \\ इत्य् अनड्वाहम् /
text_mt: A draft-ox with: 'I buy from you with a draft-ox.'

sanskrit_iast: mithunābhyāṃ gobhyāṃ krīṇāmi \\ iti mithunau gāvau /
meaning: मिथुनाभ्यां गोभ्यां क्रीणामि \\ इति मिथुनौ गावौ /
text_mt: A pair of cattle with: 'I buy with a pair of cattle.'

sanskrit_iast: vāsasā te krīṇāmi \\ iti vāsaḥ /
meaning: वाससा ते क्रीणामि \\ इति वासः /
text_mt: A cloth with: 'I buy from you with a cloth.'

sanskrit_iast: daśabhiḥ saṃpādayati bhūyasa eke somakrayaṇān āmananti //
meaning: दशभिः संपादयति भूयस एके सोमक्रयणान् आमनन्ति //
text_mt: He completes [the purchase] with ten; some [teachers] prescribe more soma-purchasing articles:

sanskrit_iast: pañcadaśabhiḥ krīṇāti saptadaśabhiḥ krīṇāti caturvim̐śatyā krīṇāty aparimitābhiḥ krīṇāti krīṇāmi \\ ity antato vadati /
meaning: पञ्चदशभिः क्रीणाति सप्तदशभिः क्रीणाति चतुर्विम्̐शत्या क्रीणात्य् अपरिमिताभिः क्रीणाति क्रीणामि \\ इत्य् अन्ततो वदति /
text_mt: he buys with fifteen, he buys with seventeen, he buys with twenty-four, he buys with an unlimited number; at the end, he says: 'I buy.'

sanskrit_iast: saṃpādya samyat te gor \ asme candrāṇi \\ iti hiraṇyaṃ pratyādatte /
meaning: संपाद्य सम्यत् ते गोर् \ अस्मे चन्द्राणि \\ इति हिरण्यं प्रत्यादत्ते /
text_mt: Having completed [the purchase], he takes back the gold with: 'As your cow was bound... In us be the shining [riches].'

sanskrit_iast: asme te bandhur iti śuklām ūrṇāstukāṃ yajamānāya prayacchati /
meaning: अस्मे ते बन्धुर् इति शुक्लाम् ऊर्णास्तुकां यजमानाय प्रयच्छति /
text_mt: With: 'In us is your kin', he gives a tuft of white wool to the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast: tāṃ vitananakāle daśāpavitrasya nābhiṃ karoti /
meaning: तां वितननकाले दशापवित्रस्य नाभिं करोति /
text_mt: At the time of stretching [the filter], he makes it the navel of the fringed straining cloth.

sanskrit_iast: śuklānām āvikorṇānām amote dve daśāpavitre bhavato 'daśākam anyatarat /
meaning: शुक्लानाम् आविकोर्णानाम् अमोते द्वे दशापवित्रे भवतो ऽदशाकम् अन्यतरत् /
text_mt: There are two woven sheep's wool straining cloths of white wool; one of them is without fringes.

sanskrit_iast: udakena kledayitvā kṛṣṇām ūrṇāstukām idam aham̐ sarpāṇāṃ dandaśūkānāṃ grīvā upagrathnāmi \\ ity upagrathya somavikrayiṇi tamas \\ iti tayā somavikrayiṇam̐ rarāṭe vidhyati /
meaning: उदकेन क्लेदयित्वा कृष्णाम् ऊर्णास्तुकाम् इदम् अहम्̐ सर्पाणां दन्दशूकानां ग्रीवा उपग्रथ्नामि \\ इत्य् उपग्रथ्य सोमविक्रयिणि तमस् \\ इति तया सोमविक्रयिणम्̐ रराटे विध्यति /
text_mt: Having moistened a tuft of black wool with water and tied it into a knot with: 'Here I tie up the necks of serpents, of biting pests', he strikes the soma-seller on the forehead with it, [saying]: 'Darkness be upon the soma-seller!'

sanskrit_iast: svajā asi \ svabhūr asi \\ asmai karmaṇe jātas \\ ṛtena tvā gṛhṇāmi \\ ṛtena naḥ pāhi \\ iti somavikrayiṇo rājānam apādatte /
meaning: स्वजा असि \ स्वभूर् असि \\ अस्मै कर्मणे जातस् \\ ऋतेन त्वा गृह्णामि \\ ऋतेन नः पाहि \\ इति सोमविक्रयिणो राजानम् अपादत्ते /
text_mt: With: 'You are self-born, you are self-existent; born for this rite; through truth I take you; through truth protect us', he takes King [Soma] away from the soma-seller.

sanskrit_iast: yadi kṛcchrāyetāpaiva hareta /
meaning: यदि कृच्छ्रायेतापैव हरेत /
text_mt: If he should cause trouble, he should simply take it away by force.

sanskrit_iast: indrasyorum āviśa dakṣiṇam iti yajamānasyorau rājānam āsādayati /
meaning: इन्द्रस्योरुम् आविश दक्षिणम् इति यजमानस्योरौ राजानम् आसादयति /
text_mt: With: 'Enter the right thigh of Indra', he sets King [Soma] upon the thigh of the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast: nīva gṛhṇīte /
meaning: नीव गृह्णीते /

sanskrit_iast: adhvaryav ā śaktavai \\ iti yajamānaḥ prācchati \\ āśakāma \\ ity adhvaryuḥ katham āśakata \\ iti viṣṇum̐ stomam arutsmahi \ bṛhaspatiṃ chandām̐sy utthāya yajūm̐ṣi vi parvatā ajihata \ sutaraṇā apo atāriṣam ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: अध्वर्यव् आ शक्तवै \\ इति यजमानः प्राच्छति \\ आशकाम \\ इत्य् अध्वर्युः कथम् आशकत \\ इति विष्णुम्̐ स्तोमम् अरुत्स्महि \ बृहस्पतिं छन्दाम्̐स्य् उत्थाय यजूम्̐षि वि पर्वता अजिहत \ सुतरणा अपो अतारिषम् इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: The sacrificer asks: 'O adhvaryu, have we been able?' 'We have been able', [replies] the adhvaryu. 'How have you been able?' The adhvaryu [replies]: 'We have held fast to Viṣṇu, the stoma; to Bṛhaspati, the metres; rising up, the yajuses; the mountains have given way; I have crossed the waters easy to cross.'

sanskrit_iast: svān abhrāja \\ iti somakrayaṇān anudiśati /
meaning: स्वान् अभ्राज \\ इति सोमक्रयणान् अनुदिशति /
text_mt: With: 'Self-luminous...', he assigns the soma-purchasing [articles].

sanskrit_iast: rudas tvāvartayatu \\ iti somakrayaṇīm āvṛtyānyayā gavā niṣkrīya yajamānasya goṣv apisṛjati /
meaning: रुदस् त्वावर्तयतु \\ इति सोमक्रयणीम् आवृत्यान्यया गवा निष्क्रीय यजमानस्य गोष्व् अपिसृजति /
text_mt: With: 'May Rudra turn you back', having turned back the soma-purchasing cow and ransomed her with another cow, he sends her into the cattle of the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣatā varatrākāṇḍena somavikrayiṇam apakṣāmaṃ nāśayati //
meaning: पृषता वरत्राकाण्डेन सोमविक्रयिणम् अपक्षामं नाशयति //
text_mt: With a dappled strap of leather, he chases away the soma-seller, [who is rendered] powerless.

sanskrit_iast: adityāḥ sado 'si \\ iti śakaṭasya nīḍe kṛṣṇājinaṃ prācīnagrīvam uttaralomāstṛṇāti prattam̐ rājānam adityāḥ sada āsīda \\ iti tasminn āsādayati /
meaning: अदित्याः सदो ऽसि \\ इति शकटस्य नीडे कृष्णाजिनं प्राचीनग्रीवम् उत्तरलोमास्तृणाति प्रत्तम्̐ राजानम् अदित्याः सद आसीद \\ इति तस्मिन्न् आसादयति /
text_mt: With: 'You are the seat of Aditi', he spreads a black antelope skin inside the body of the cart, with its neck to the east and fleece turned upwards, and on it he places King [Soma], who has been handed over, with: 'Sit on the seat of Aditi.'

sanskrit_iast: astabhnād dyām ity āsannam abhimantrayate /
meaning: अस्तभ्नाद् द्याम् इत्य् आसन्नम् अभिमन्त्रयते /
text_mt: With: 'He propped up the sky...', he addresses [him] when seated.

sanskrit_iast: āsādayatīty ekeṣām /
meaning: आसादयतीत्य् एकेषाम् /

sanskrit_iast: vaneṣu vy antarikṣaṃ tatāna \\ iti vāsasā paryānahyati /
meaning: वनेषु व्य् अन्तरिक्षं ततान \\ इति वाससा पर्यानह्यति /
text_mt: With: 'He spread out the atmosphere in the trees', he ties [him] around with a cloth.

sanskrit_iast: ud u tyaṃ jātavedasam iti kṛṣṇājinenordhvagrīveṇa bahirlomnāpidadhāti taraṇir viśvadarśatas \\ iti vā /
meaning: उद् उ त्यं जातवेदसम् इति कृष्णाजिनेनोर्ध्वग्रीवेण बहिर्लोम्नापिदधाति तरणिर् विश्वदर्शतस् \\ इति वा /
text_mt: With: 'Up that all-knowing god...', he covers [him] with a black antelope skin with the neck turned upward and fleece outward, or with: 'The swift, seen by all...'

sanskrit_iast: usrāv etaṃ dhūrṣāhau \\ ity anaḍvāhāv upāsajati /
meaning: उस्राव् एतं धूर्षाहौ \\ इत्य् अनड्वाहाव् उपासजति /
text_mt: With: 'Come, you two bulls that bear the yoke', he yokes the two draft-oxen.

sanskrit_iast: dhūr asi \\ iti dhurāv abhimṛśati /
meaning: धूर् असि \\ इति धुराव् अभिमृशति /
text_mt: With: 'You are the yoke', he touches the two yoke-pins.

sanskrit_iast: vāruṇam asi \\ iti śakaṭam utkhidati /
meaning: वारुणम् असि \\ इति शकटम् उत्खिदति /
text_mt: With: 'You belong to Varuṇa', he pushes the cart forward.

sanskrit_iast: prāgīṣam avasthāpya varuṇasyottabhnātu \\ ity upastabhnoti /
meaning: प्रागीषम् अवस्थाप्य वरुणस्योत्तभ्नातु \\ इत्य् उपस्तभ्नोति /
text_mt: Having halted [the cart] with the shaft pointing east, with “May it prop up Varuṇa's [seat],” he props it up.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇam anaḍvāhaṃ yunakti /
meaning: दक्षिणम् अनड्वाहं युनक्ति /
text_mt: He yokes the southern ox.

sanskrit_iast: vāruṇam asi \\ iti yoktraṃ parikarṣati /
meaning: वारुणम् असि \\ इति योक्त्रं परिकर्षति /
text_mt: With “You belong to Varuṇa,” he pulls the yoking-strap around.

sanskrit_iast: varuṇasya skambhanir asi \\ iti śamyām avagūhati /
meaning: वरुणस्य स्कम्भनिर् असि \\ इति शम्याम् अवगूहति /
text_mt: With “You are the prop of Varuṇa,” he pushes down the yoke-pin.

sanskrit_iast: pratyasto varuṇasya pāśas \\ iti yoktrapāśaṃ pratyasyati /
meaning: प्रत्यस्तो वरुणस्य पाशस् \\ इति योक्त्रपाशं प्रत्यस्यति /
text_mt: With “The snare of Varuṇa is cast back,” he fastens the noose of the yoking-strap.

sanskrit_iast: balīvardaṃ cābhinidadhāti /
meaning: बलीवर्दं चाभिनिदधाति /
text_mt: And he presses upon the bullock.

sanskrit_iast: evam uttaram anaḍvāhaṃ yunakti /
meaning: एवम् उत्तरम् अनड्वाहं युनक्ति /
text_mt: In the same way, he yokes the northern ox.

sanskrit_iast: hariṇī śāke bibhrad antareṣām̐ subrahmaṇya upasarpati palāśaśākhe śamīśākhe vā /
meaning: हरिणी शाके बिभ्रद् अन्तरेषाम्̐ सुब्रह्मण्य उपसर्पति पलाशशाखे शमीशाखे वा /
text_mt: Holding two green leafy twigs between them, the subrahmaṇya approaches—either two palāśa twigs or two śamī twigs.

sanskrit_iast: śakaṭam anvārabhya somāya rājñe krītāya prohyamāṇāyānubrūhi \ brahman vācaṃ yaccha \ subrahmaṇya subrahmaṇyām āhvaya \\ iti saṃpreṣyati /
meaning: शकटम् अन्वारभ्य सोमाय राज्ञे क्रीताय प्रोह्यमाणायानुब्रूहि \ ब्रह्मन् वाचं यच्छ \ सुब्रह्मण्य सुब्रह्मण्याम् आह्वय \\ इति संप्रेष्यति /
text_mt: Touching the cart from behind, he directs: “Recite for King Soma who has been purchased and is being driven forward; O brahman, restrain your speech; O subrahmaṇya, chant the Subrahmaṇyā litany.”

sanskrit_iast: trir anūktāyāṃ pracyavasya bhuvaspate \\ iti prāñco 'bhiprayāya pradakṣiṇam āvartante /
meaning: त्रिर् अनूक्तायां प्रच्यवस्य भुवस्पते \\ इति प्राञ्चो ऽभिप्रयाय प्रदक्षिणम् आवर्तन्ते /
text_mt: When it has been recited three times, with “Move on, O lord of the world,” they advance toward the east and turn keeping their right side to it.

sanskrit_iast: api panthām agasmahi \\ ity uttareṇa rājānaṃ pūrvāv atikrāmato yajamāno 'dhvaryuś ca /
meaning: अपि पन्थाम् अगस्महि \\ इत्य् उत्तरेण राजानं पूर्वाव् अतिक्रामतो यजमानो ऽध्वर्युश् च /
text_mt: With “We have reached the path,” the sacrificer and the adhvaryu, being in front, step across to the north of King [Soma].

sanskrit_iast: prajvalayanty agnīn āhavanīye varṣiṣṭham ādadhāti /
meaning: प्रज्वलयन्त्य् अग्नीन् आहवनीये वर्षिष्ठम् आदधाति /
text_mt: They kindle the fires; he puts the largest [piece of firewood] on the āhavanīya fire.

sanskrit_iast: upakḷpto 'gnīṣomīyaḥ samaṅgo bandhumān yathā nirūḍhapaśubandhe lohas tūparaḥ śmaśrulaḥ sthūlaḥ pīvā //
meaning: उपकॢप्तो ऽग्नीषोमीयः समङ्गो बन्धुमान् यथा निरूढपशुबन्धे लोहस् तूपरः श्मश्रुलः स्थूलः पीवा //
text_mt: The Agnīṣomīya [victim] is prepared: well-formed, of good pedigree, as in the independent animal sacrifice, copper-colored, hornless, bearded, thick, fat,

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṇaśveto lohitaśveto vā tena karṇagṛhītena yajamāno rājānaṃ pratīkṣate /
meaning: कृष्णश्वेतो लोहितश्वेतो वा तेन कर्णगृहीतेन यजमानो राजानं प्रतीक्षते /
text_mt: black and white, or red and white; with it held by the ear, the sacrificer awaits King [Soma].

sanskrit_iast: audumbary āsandy aratnimātraśīrṣaṇyānūcyā nābhidaghnapādā mauñjavivānā tām adhvaryava udgṛhṇanti /
meaning: औदुम्बर्य् आसन्द्य् अरत्निमात्रशीर्षण्यानूच्या नाभिदघ्नपादा मौञ्जविवाना ताम् अध्वर्यव उद्गृह्णन्ति /
text_mt: There is a stool made of udumbara wood, with headpiece and footpiece of a cubit's length, with legs of navel-height, woven with muñja grass; the adhvaryus lift it up.

sanskrit_iast: agreṇa prāgvam̐śaṃ vāruṇam asi \\ iti śakaṭam akkhidaty udagīṣam avasthāpya /
meaning: अग्रेण प्राग्वम्̐शं वारुणम् असि \\ इति शकटम् अक्खिदत्य् उदगीषम् अवस्थाप्य /
text_mt: In front of the eastern hall, having stopped the cart with its pole pointing northward without shaking it, [the adhvaryu says:] “You belong to Varuṇa.”

sanskrit_iast: varuṇas tvottabhnātu \\ ity upastabhnoti /
meaning: वरुणस् त्वोत्तभ्नातु \\ इत्य् उपस्तभ्नोति /
text_mt: He props it up with: “May Varuṇa prop you up.”

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇam anaḍvāhaṃ vimuñcati /
meaning: दक्षिणम् अनड्वाहं विमुञ्चति /
text_mt: He unyokes the southern ox.

sanskrit_iast: vāruṇam asi \\ iti yoktraṃ parikarṣati /
meaning: वारुणम् असि \\ इति योक्त्रं परिकर्षति /
text_mt: He pulls off the yoke-strap with: “You belong to Varuṇa.”

sanskrit_iast: varuṇasya skambhasarjanir asi \\ iti śamyāṃ pravṛhati /
meaning: वरुणस्य स्कम्भसर्जनिर् असि \\ इति शम्यां प्रवृहति /
text_mt: He pulls out the yoke-pin with: “You are the prop-releaser of Varuṇa.”

sanskrit_iast: vicṛto varuṇasya pāśas \\ iti yoktrapāśaṃ vicṛntati /
meaning: विचृतो वरुणस्य पाशस् \\ इति योक्त्रपाशं विचृन्तति /
text_mt: He unfastens the loop of the yoke-strap with: “The noose of Varuṇa is unfastened.”

sanskrit_iast: unmukto varuṇasya pāśas \\ ity abhidhānīm unmuñcati /
meaning: उन्मुक्तो वरुणस्य पाशस् \\ इत्य् अभिधानीम् उन्मुञ्चति /
text_mt: He unfastens the halter with: “The noose of Varuṇa is released.”

sanskrit_iast: evam uttaram anaḍvāhaṃ vimuñcati /
meaning: एवम् उत्तरम् अनड्वाहं विमुञ्चति /
text_mt: In the same way, he unyokes the northern ox.

sanskrit_iast: avimucyottaram ātithyāyās tantraṃ prakramayati /
meaning: अविमुच्योत्तरम् आतिथ्यायास् तन्त्रं प्रक्रमयति /
text_mt: Without unyoking the northern [ox], he initiates the sacrificial framework of the guest offering (ātithyā);

sanskrit_iast: ubhau vā vimucya /
meaning: उभौ वा विमुच्य /

sanskrit_iast: agnīn anvādhāyedhmābarhir āharati /
meaning: अग्नीन् अन्वाधायेध्माबर्हिर् आहरति /
text_mt: Having fueled the fires, he brings the fuel and sacred grass.

sanskrit_iast: saptadaśa sāmidhenyaḥ /
meaning: सप्तदश सामिधेन्यः /
text_mt: There are seventeen kindling verses (sāmidhenīs).

sanskrit_iast: ikṣuśalāke vidhṛtī /
meaning: इक्षुशलाके विधृती /

sanskrit_iast: kārṣmaryamayān paridhīn idhma upasaṃnahyaty āśvavālaṃ prastaraṃ barhiṣi /
meaning: कार्ष्मर्यमयान् परिधीन् इध्म उपसंनह्यत्य् आश्ववालं प्रस्तरं बर्हिषि /
text_mt: He ties enclosing sticks made of kārṣmarya wood to the fuel, and the prastara bunch made of cane-reed to the sacred grass.

sanskrit_iast: nirvapaṇakāle vaiṣṇavaṃ navakapālaṃ patnyā hastena nirvapati /
meaning: निर्वपणकाले वैष्णवं नवकपालं पत्न्या हस्तेन निर्वपति /
text_mt: At the time of portioning out, he portions out [the rice] for Viṣṇu on nine potsherds with the hand of the sacrificer's wife;

sanskrit_iast: patnyā vā hastāt /
meaning: पत्न्या वा हस्तात् /

sanskrit_iast: anvārabdhāyāṃ vā srucā /
meaning: अन्वारब्धायां वा स्रुचा /
text_mt: or with the offering ladle while she maintains contact.

sanskrit_iast: agner ātithyam asi \\ ity etaiḥ pañcabhis triṣu sāvitraṃ juṣṭaṃ cānuṣajati /
meaning: अग्नेर् आतिथ्यम् असि \\ इत्य् एतैः पञ्चभिस् त्रिषु सावित्रं जुष्टं चानुषजति /
text_mt: With these five [formulas beginning with]: “You are the guest offering of Agni,” he subjoins the formula addressed to Savitṛ and the formula containing “agreeable” (juṣṭa) in the three [offerings].

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇum evottareṣu nigameṣūpalakṣayet /
meaning: विष्णुम् एवोत्तरेषु निगमेषूपलक्षयेत् /
text_mt: He should refer only to Viṣṇu in the subsequent insertion formulas.

sanskrit_iast: yat prāg udvapanāt tat kṛtvottaram anaḍvāhaṃ vimuñcati tenaiva kalpena yadi purastād avimukto bhavati /
meaning: यत् प्राग् उद्वपनात् तत् कृत्वोत्तरम् अनड्वाहं विमुञ्चति तेनैव कल्पेन यदि पुरस्ताद् अविमुक्तो भवति /
text_mt: Having performed what is prior to taking off [the cake from the potsherds], he unyokes the northern ox according to that same procedure, if it was not unyoked beforehand.

sanskrit_iast: vāruṇam asi \\ iti rājño vāso 'pādatte /
meaning: वारुणम् असि \\ इति राज्ञो वासो ऽपादत्ते /
text_mt: With: “You belong to Varuṇa,” he removes the garment of King [Soma];

sanskrit_iast: varuṇo 'si dhṛtavratas \\ iti rājānam //
meaning: वरुणो ऽसि धृतव्रतस् \\ इति राजानम् //
text_mt: with: “You are Varuṇa, of sustained observances,” [he addresses] King [Soma].

sanskrit_iast: acchinnapatraḥ prajā upāvarohośann uśatīḥ syonaḥ syonās \\ ity upāvaharati /
meaning: अच्छिन्नपत्रः प्रजा उपावरोहोशन्न् उशतीः स्योनः स्योनास् \\ इत्य् उपावहरति /
text_mt: With: “With unbroken leaves, descend to the offspring, you longing for them who long for you, gentle, to the gentle,” he takes him down.

sanskrit_iast: atrāsandyā udgrahaṇam eke samāmananti /
meaning: अत्रासन्द्या उद्ग्रहणम् एके समामनन्ति /
text_mt: Here, some teach the lifting up of the stool.

sanskrit_iast: urv antarikṣam iti gacchati /
meaning: उर्व् अन्तरिक्षम् इति गच्छति /
text_mt: With: “The wide intermediate space,” he goes.

sanskrit_iast: yā te dhāmāni \\ iti saumyarcā rājānaṃ pūrveṇa dvāreṇa prāgvam̐śaṃ prapādayati /
meaning: या ते धामानि \\ इति सौम्यर्चा राजानं पूर्वेण द्वारेण प्राग्वम्̐शं प्रपादयति /
text_mt: With the verse addressed to Soma: “Whatever your abodes,” he brings King [Soma] into the eastern hall through the eastern door.

sanskrit_iast: urv antarikṣaṃ vīhi \\ ity apareṇāhavanīyaṃ dakṣiṇātiharati /
meaning: उर्व् अन्तरिक्षं वीहि \\ इत्य् अपरेणाहवनीयं दक्षिणातिहरति /
text_mt: With: “Traverse the wide intermediate space,” he carries him over to the south behind the āhavanīya fire.

sanskrit_iast: varuṇasyartasadanir asi \\ iti dakṣiṇenāhavanīyam āsandīṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati /
meaning: वरुणस्यर्तसदनिर् असि \\ इति दक्षिणेनाहवनीयम् आसन्दीं प्रतिष्ठापयति /
text_mt: With: “You are the seat of cosmic order of Varuṇa,” he sets down the stool south of the āhavanīya fire.

sanskrit_iast: adityāḥ sado 'si \\ iti tasyāṃ kṛṣṇājinaṃ prācīnagrīvam uttaralomāstṛṇāti /
meaning: अदित्याः सदो ऽसि \\ इति तस्यां कृष्णाजिनं प्राचीनग्रीवम् उत्तरलोमास्तृणाति /
text_mt: With: “You are the seat of Aditi,” he spreads upon it a black antelope skin with its neck to the east and its hairy side upward.

sanskrit_iast: prattam̐ rājānam adityāḥ sada āsīda \\ iti tasminn āsādayati /
meaning: प्रत्तम्̐ राजानम् अदित्याः सद आसीद \\ इति तस्मिन्न् आसादयति /
text_mt: With: “Given, sit upon the seat of Aditi, O King,” he sets King [Soma] down upon it;

sanskrit_iast: varuṇasyartasadanam āsīda \\ iti vā /
meaning: वरुणस्यर्तसदनम् आसीद \\ इति वा /
text_mt: or with: “Sit upon the seat of cosmic order of Varuṇa.”

sanskrit_iast: vaneṣu vy antarikṣaṃ tatāna \\ iti vāsasā pariśrayati /
meaning: वनेषु व्य् अन्तरिक्षं ततान \\ इति वाससा परिश्रयति /
text_mt: With: “He extended the intermediate space in the forests,” he encloses him with a garment.

sanskrit_iast: varuṇo 'si \\ iti rājānam abhimantrayate varuṇāya tvā \\ iti vā /
meaning: वरुणो ऽसि \\ इति राजानम् अभिमन्त्रयते वरुणाय त्वा \\ इति वा /
text_mt: With: “You are Varuṇa,” he addresses King [Soma] with a mantra, or with: “To Varuṇa, you.”

sanskrit_iast: evā vandasva varuṇaṃ bṛhantam \\ namasyā dhīram amṛtasya gopām / \ sa naḥ śarma trivaruthaṃ vi yam̐sat \ pātaṃ no dyāvāpṛthivī upasthe \\ iti vāruṇyarcā rājānaṃ paricarati /
meaning: एवा वन्दस्व वरुणं बृहन्तम् \\ नमस्या धीरम् अमृतस्य गोपाम् / \ स नः शर्म त्रिवरुथं वि यम्̐सत् \ पातं नो द्यावापृथिवी उपस्थे \\ इति वारुण्यर्चा राजानं परिचरति /
text_mt: With the verse addressed to Varuṇa: “Thus praise great Varuṇa; bow to the wise guardian of immortality. May he extend to us threefold protection; protect us, O Heaven and Earth, in your lap,” he attends upon King [Soma].

sanskrit_iast: yatra kvacāsīdedaitayaivāsīdet /
meaning: यत्र क्वचासीदेदैतयैवासीदेत् /
text_mt: Wherever he sits down, he should sit down with this very [verse].

sanskrit_iast: agnim̐ rājānaṃ cāntareṇa mā saṃcāriṣṭa \\ iti saṃpreṣyati /
meaning: अग्निम्̐ राजानं चान्तरेण मा संचारिष्ट \\ इति संप्रेष्यति /
text_mt: He issues the direction: “Do not pass between the fire and King [Soma].”

sanskrit_iast: udvapanaprabhṛtīni karmāṇi pratipadyate /
meaning: उद्वपनप्रभृतीनि कर्माणि प्रतिपद्यते /
text_mt: He undertakes the rites beginning with taking off [the cake from the potsherds].

sanskrit_iast: gārhapatye nava kapālāny upadadhāti /
meaning: गार्हपत्ये नव कपालान्य् उपदधाति /
text_mt: He places nine potsherds on the gārhapatya fire.

sanskrit_iast: caturgṛhītāny ājyāni gṛhṇāti /
meaning: चतुर्गृहीतान्य् आज्यानि गृह्णाति /
text_mt: He takes clarified butter in four ladlings.

sanskrit_iast: caturhotrātithyam āsādayati /
meaning: चतुर्होत्रातिथ्यम् आसादयति /
text_mt: He sets down the guest offering with the caturhotṛ formula.

sanskrit_iast: saṃbhārayajūm̐ṣi vyākhyāya nirmanthyasyāvṛtā nirmanthyena pracarati /
meaning: संभारयजूम्̐षि व्याख्याय निर्मन्थ्यस्यावृता निर्मन्थ्येन प्रचरति /
text_mt: Having recited the materials formulas, he proceeds with the fire produced by friction according to the procedure for churning fire.

sanskrit_iast: vedaṃ nidhāya sāmidhenībhyaḥ saṃpreṣyati /
meaning: वेदं निधाय सामिधेनीभ्यः संप्रेष्यति /
text_mt: Having deposited the veda, he issues the direction for the kindling verses.

sanskrit_iast: sarvam idhmam ādadhāti sarvam aupabhṛtam̐ samānayate /
meaning: सर्वम् इध्मम् आदधाति सर्वम् औपभृतम्̐ समानयते /
text_mt: He places all the fuel [on the fire], and pours together all [the clarified butter] in the upabhṛt ladle.

sanskrit_iast: ājyabhāgābhyāṃ pracarya viṣṇum̐ haviṣā yajati /
meaning: आज्यभागाभ्यां प्रचर्य विष्णुम्̐ हविषा यजति /
text_mt: Having proceeded with the two clarified butter portions, he sacrifices to Viṣṇu with the sacrificial oblation.

sanskrit_iast: dhruvāyāḥ śeṣaṃ karoti /
meaning: ध्रुवायाः शेषं करोति /
text_mt: He leaves a remnant in the dhruvā ladle.

sanskrit_iast: iḍāntātithyā saṃtiṣṭhate /
meaning: इडान्तातिथ्या संतिष्ठते /
text_mt: The guest offering concludes with the iḍā.

sanskrit_iast: dhruvāśeṣāt \\ āpataye tvā gṛhṇāmi \\ iti kam̐se camase vā tānūnaptram̐ samavadyati caturavattaṃ pañcāvattaṃ vā /
meaning: ध्रुवाशेषात् \\ आपतये त्वा गृह्णामि \\ इति कम्̐से चमसे वा तानूनप्त्रम्̐ समवद्यति चतुरवत्तं पञ्चावत्तं वा /
text_mt: From the remnant in the dhruvā ladle, with: “I take you for the Lord of the Descent,” he cuts portions of the tānūnaptra into a bronze vessel or a wooden cup, in four cuttings or in five cuttings.

sanskrit_iast: avaśiṣṭo vikalpārtho yadi caturavattam /
meaning: अवशिष्टो विकल्पार्थो यदि चतुरवत्तम् /
text_mt: The remaining [remnant] serves the purpose of option if there is a four-fold cutting.

sanskrit_iast: tat \\ anādhṛṣṭam asi \\ iti sarvartvijaḥ samavamṛśanti /
meaning: तत् \\ अनाधृष्टम् असि \\ इति सर्वर्त्विजः समवमृशन्ति /
text_mt: All the officiating priests touch it together with: “You are unassailable.”

sanskrit_iast: samavamṛṣṭaṃ prajāpatau tvā manasi juhomi \\ iti trir avaghrāyāntarvedi ninayati /
meaning: समवमृष्टं प्रजापतौ त्वा मनसि जुहोमि \\ इति त्रिर् अवघ्रायान्तर्वेदि निनयति /
text_mt: Having smelled three times that which has been touched together, with: “I offer you in the mind, in Prajāpati,” he pours it within the altar area;

sanskrit_iast: pratiṣiddham ekeṣām /
meaning: प्रतिषिद्धम् एकेषाम् /

sanskrit_iast: asaṃcara utsiñcatīty ekeṣām /
meaning: असंचर उत्सिञ्चतीत्य् एकेषाम् /
text_mt: According to some, he pours it out where there is no walking.

sanskrit_iast: agnīn madanty āpā3s \\ iti pṛcchati /
meaning: अग्नीन् मदन्त्य् आपा3स् \\ इति पृच्छति /
text_mt: He asks: “O Agnīdh, are the waters bubbling?”

sanskrit_iast: madanti devīr amṛtā ṛtāvṛdhas \\ ity agnīdhraḥ pratyāha /
meaning: मदन्ति देवीर् अमृता ऋतावृधस् \\ इत्य् अग्नीध्रः प्रत्याह /
text_mt: The agnīdhra answers: “The divine, immortal ones, increasers of truth, are bubbling.”

sanskrit_iast: tābhir ādrava \\ iti saṃpreṣyati /
meaning: ताभिर् आद्रव \\ इति संप्रेष्यति /
text_mt: He issues the direction: “Run up with them.”

sanskrit_iast: madantībhiḥ pāṇīn prakṣālayante brahmā rājānaṃ visram̐sayati /
meaning: मदन्तीभिः पाणीन् प्रक्षालयन्ते ब्रह्मा राजानं विस्रम्̐सयति /
text_mt: They wash their hands with the boiled water; the brahman unties King [Soma].

sanskrit_iast: am̐śuram̐śus \\ iti tam̐ sarve sahiraṇyaiḥ pāṇibhir āpyāyayanti /
meaning: अम्̐शुरम्̐शुस् \\ इति तम्̐ सर्वे सहिरण्यैः पाणिभिर् आप्याययन्ति /
text_mt: With: “Stalk by stalk,” all swell him with hands holding gold.

sanskrit_iast: pratyupanaddhe 'pa upaspṛśya \\ eṣṭā rāyas \\ iti prastare nihnuvate savyānnīcaḥ pāṇīnkṛtvā dakṣiṇānuttānān //
meaning: प्रत्युपनद्धे ऽप उपस्पृश्य \\ एष्टा रायस् \\ इति प्रस्तरे निह्नुवते सव्यान्नीचः पाणीन्कृत्वा दक्षिणानुत्तानान् //
text_mt: When he is tied up again, having touched water, with: “Desired are the riches,” they make homage on the prastara bunch, making their left hands turned downward and their right hands turned upward.

sanskrit_iast: pravargyeṇa pracaryopasadā pracaraty upasadā vā pracarya pravargyeṇa pracarati /
meaning: प्रवर्ग्येण प्रचर्योपसदा प्रचरत्य् उपसदा वा प्रचर्य प्रवर्ग्येण प्रचरति /
text_mt: Having proceeded with the Pravargya, he proceeds with the Upasad; or having proceeded with the Upasad, he proceeds with the Pravargya.

sanskrit_iast: yad ātithyāyā barhis tad upasadāṃ tad agnīṣomīyasya tat prastaraparidhi /
meaning: यद् आतिथ्याया बर्हिस् तद् उपसदां तद् अग्नीषोमीयस्य तत् प्रस्तरपरिधि /
text_mt: What is the sacrificial grass of the hospitality rite serves for the Upasad rites, for the animal sacrifice to Agni and Soma; that constitutes the prastara-bunch and the enclosing sticks.

sanskrit_iast: stīrṇaṃ prastarabarhir upasatsu śayāḥ paridhayaḥ /
meaning: स्तीर्णं प्रस्तरबर्हिर् उपसत्सु शयाः परिधयः /
text_mt: The prastara-bunch and sacrificial grass remain strewn during the Upasad rites; the enclosing sticks remain lying in place.

sanskrit_iast: upasadas tantraṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ /
meaning: उपसदस् तन्त्रं व्याख्यास्यामः /
text_mt: We shall explain the sacrificial framework of the Upasad rites.

sanskrit_iast: tasyām ājyam̐ haviḥ /
meaning: तस्याम् आज्यम्̐ हविः /

sanskrit_iast: agniḥ somo viṣṇur devatāḥ /
meaning: अग्निः सोमो विष्णुर् देवताः /
text_mt: Agni, Soma, and Viṣṇu are the deities.

sanskrit_iast: upām̐śuyājena kalpo vyākhyātaḥ /
meaning: उपाम्̐शुयाजेन कल्पो व्याख्यातः /
text_mt: The ritual procedure is explained by [that of] the inaudible offering.

sanskrit_iast: agnīn anvādhāya ṣoḍaśadārum idhmam̐ saṃnahyati /
meaning: अग्नीन् अन्वाधाय षोडशदारुम् इध्मम्̐ संनह्यति /
text_mt: Having fueled the fires, he binds together firewood of sixteen sticks.

sanskrit_iast: vedaṃ kṛtvāgnīn paristīrya pāṇī prakṣālyolaparājīm̐ stīrtvā yathārtham ājyapātrāṇi prayunakti sphyam̐ sruvam̐ sruca ājyasthālīṃ yena cārthaḥ /
meaning: वेदं कृत्वाग्नीन् परिस्तीर्य पाणी प्रक्षाल्योलपराजीम्̐ स्तीर्त्वा यथार्थम् आज्यपात्राणि प्रयुनक्ति स्फ्यम्̐ स्रुवम्̐ स्रुच आज्यस्थालीं येन चार्थः /
text_mt: Having made the grass broom, strewn around the fires, washed his hands, and strewn a row of coarse grass, he sets out the clarified butter vessels as required: the wooden sword, the dipping spoon, the offering ladles, the clarified butter pot, and whatever else is required.

sanskrit_iast: pavitre kṛtvā yajamāna vācaṃ yaccha \\ iti saṃpreṣyati vāgyataḥ pātrāṇi saṃmṛśati prokṣiteṣu vācaṃ visṛjate /
meaning: पवित्रे कृत्वा यजमान वाचं यच्छ \\ इति संप्रेष्यति वाग्यतः पात्राणि संमृशति प्रोक्षितेषु वाचं विसृजते /
text_mt: Having made two strainers, he gives the ritual direction: 'O sacrificer, restrain your speech!' Restraining his speech, he touches the vessels; when they have been sprinkled, he releases his speech.

sanskrit_iast: sphyam ādāya stīrṇāyā veder lomabhyo 'dhi stambayajur haraty uttaraṃ parigrāhaṃ parigṛhya saṃpraiṣeṇa pratipadyate /
meaning: स्फ्यम् आदाय स्तीर्णाया वेदेर् लोमभ्यो ऽधि स्तम्बयजुर् हरत्य् उत्तरं परिग्राहं परिगृह्य संप्रैषेण प्रतिपद्यते /
text_mt: Taking the wooden sword, he removes the clump of grass with a yajus-mantra from the hairs of the strewn altar, and having marked out the northern boundary line, he proceeds with the ritual direction.

sanskrit_iast: yad anyad barhiṣaḥ patnīsaṃnahanāc ca tat saṃpreṣyati /
meaning: यद् अन्यद् बर्हिषः पत्नीसंनहनाच् च तत् संप्रेष्यति /
text_mt: He gives ritual directions for whatever [remains to be done] other than the sacrificial grass and the girding of the sacrificer's wife.

sanskrit_iast: yat prāg ājyagrahaṇāt tat kṛtvā dhruvāyām eva gṛhṇāti /
meaning: यत् प्राग् आज्यग्रहणात् तत् कृत्वा ध्रुवायाम् एव गृह्णाति /
text_mt: Having performed whatever comes before the taking of clarified butter, he takes [it] into the dhruvā ladle alone.

sanskrit_iast: prokṣaṇīr abhimantrya brahmāṇam āmantryedhmaṃ vediṃ ca prokṣya prokṣaṇyavaśeṣaṃ ninīya pavitre apisṛjyāgnim abhimantrya pūrvām āghārasamidham ādhāya dhruvām̐ sruvaṃ ca sādayati \\ eṣāsadat \\ iti mantram̐ saṃnamati viṣṇv asi \ vaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma prājāpatyam ity ājyam abhimantrayate /
meaning: प्रोक्षणीर् अभिमन्त्र्य ब्रह्माणम् आमन्त्र्येध्मं वेदिं च प्रोक्ष्य प्रोक्षण्यवशेषं निनीय पवित्रे अपिसृज्याग्निम् अभिमन्त्र्य पूर्वाम् आघारसमिधम् आधाय ध्रुवाम्̐ स्रुवं च सादयति \\ एषासदत् \\ इति मन्त्रम्̐ संनमति विष्ण्व् असि \ वैष्णवं धाम प्राजापत्यम् इत्य् आज्यम् अभिमन्त्रयते /
text_mt: Having consecrated the sprinkling waters, called upon the brahman priest, sprinkled the firewood and the altar, poured out the remnant of the sprinkling waters, discarded the two strainers, consecrated the fire, and laid on the fire the first firewood stick for the pouring of clarified butter, he sets down the dhruvā ladle and the dipping spoon. He adapts the mantra, 'She has sat down...' He consecrates the clarified butter with, 'You are Viṣṇu, the domain of Viṣṇu, belonging to Prajāpati.'

sanskrit_iast: vedaṃ nidhāya sāmidhenībhyaḥ saṃpreṣyati navadhedhmaṃ prativibhajya sarvam idhmam ādadhāti /
meaning: वेदं निधाय सामिधेनीभ्यः संप्रेष्यति नवधेध्मं प्रतिविभज्य सर्वम् इध्मम् आदधाति /
text_mt: Having laid down the grass broom, he gives the ritual direction for the kindling verses. Dividing the firewood into nine parts, he places all the firewood [on the fire].

sanskrit_iast: oḍhāsu devatāsv agnim upavājya sruvāghāram āghārya \\ agnīt paridhīm̐ś cāgniṃ ca tristriḥ saṃmṛḍḍhi \\ iti saṃpreṣyati saṃmṛṣṭe pravaraṃ pravṛṇīte yathā mahāpitṛyajñe sīda hotar ity uktvā //
meaning: ओढासु देवतास्व् अग्निम् उपवाज्य स्रुवाघारम् आघार्य \\ अग्नीत् परिधीम्̐श् चाग्निं च त्रिस्त्रिः संमृड्ढि \\ इति संप्रेष्यति संमृष्टे प्रवरं प्रवृणीते यथा महापितृयज्ञे सीद होतर् इत्य् उक्त्वा //
text_mt: When the deities have been carried [by the kindling verses], having fanned the fire and poured the libation of clarified butter with the dipping spoon, he gives the ritual direction: 'O Agnīdh, wipe clean the enclosing sticks and the fire three times each!' When it is wiped, he recites the ancestral invocation as in the Great Ancestral Sacrifice, having said, 'Be seated, O hotṛ!'

sanskrit_iast: dhruvāyā aṣṭau juhvāṃ gṛhṇāti catur upabhṛti /
meaning: ध्रुवाया अष्टौ जुह्वां गृह्णाति चतुर् उपभृति /
text_mt: He takes eight [spoonfuls] from the dhruvā ladle into the juhū ladle, [and] four into the upabhṛt ladle.

sanskrit_iast: sādayati srucau hotādāpayati /
meaning: सादयति स्रुचौ होतादापयति /
text_mt: He sets down the two offering ladles; the hotṛ causes [the sacrificer] to take hold [of him].

sanskrit_iast: ghṛtavatīm adhvaryo srucam āsyasva \\ ity ucyamāne juhūpabhṛtāv ādāya sakṛd atikrāntas tisro devatā yajati /
meaning: घृतवतीम् अध्वर्यो स्रुचम् आस्यस्व \\ इत्य् उच्यमाने जुहूपभृताव् आदाय सकृद् अतिक्रान्तस् तिस्रो देवता यजति /
text_mt: While 'O adhvaryu, bring forward the offering ladle containing clarified butter' is being said, taking the juhū and upabhṛt ladles, having stepped across once, he sacrifices to the three deities.

sanskrit_iast: uttarataḥ prathamāyāḥ puronuvākyām̐ saṃpreṣyati dakṣiṇata itarayoḥ /
meaning: उत्तरतः प्रथमायाः पुरोनुवाक्याम्̐ संप्रेष्यति दक्षिणत इतरयोः /
text_mt: To the north, he gives the ritual direction for the introductory verse of the first [deity]; to the south for the other two.

sanskrit_iast: yaj juhvām ājyaṃ tasyārdhenāgniṃ yajaty ardhena somam /
meaning: यज् जुह्वाम् आज्यं तस्यार्धेनाग्निं यजत्य् अर्धेन सोमम् /
text_mt: With half of the clarified butter that is in the juhū ladle he sacrifices to Agni; with half to Soma.

sanskrit_iast: yad upabhṛti taj juhvām ānīya tena viṣṇum /
meaning: यद् उपभृति तज् जुह्वाम् आनीय तेन विष्णुम् /
text_mt: Pouring what is in the upabhṛt ladle into the juhū ladle, with that [he sacrifices] to Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast: pratyākramya yā te agne 'yāśayā tanūs \\ iti sruveṇopasadaṃ juhoti /
meaning: प्रत्याक्रम्य या ते अग्ने ऽयाशया तनूस् \\ इति स्रुवेणोपसदं जुहोति /
text_mt: Stepping back, he offers the Upasad oblation with the dipping spoon, with 'Agni, that body of yours which rests in iron...'

sanskrit_iast: madantībhiḥ pāṇīn prakṣālayante brahmā rājānaṃ visram̐sayaty āpyāyayanti nihnuvate ca yathā purastād dakṣiṇottānaiḥ pūrvāhṇe savyottānair aparāhṇe /
meaning: मदन्तीभिः पाणीन् प्रक्षालयन्ते ब्रह्मा राजानं विस्रम्̐सयत्य् आप्याययन्ति निह्नुवते च यथा पुरस्ताद् दक्षिणोत्तानैः पूर्वाह्णे सव्योत्तानैर् अपराह्णे /
text_mt: They wash their hands with boiled water. The brahman priest loosens King [Soma]. They swell [him] up and make atonement as before—with the right [palms] turned upwards in the forenoon, with the left [palms] turned upwards in the afternoon.

sanskrit_iast: agnīddevapatnīrvyācakṣva subrahmaṇya subrahmaṇyāmāhvayeti saṃpreṣyati /
meaning: अग्नीद्देवपत्नीर्व्याचक्ष्व सुब्रह्मण्य सुब्रह्मण्यामाह्वयेति संप्रेष्यति /
text_mt: He gives the ritual direction: 'O Agnīdh, declare the wives of the gods! O Subrahmaṇya, chant the Subrahmaṇyā formula!'

sanskrit_iast: vāg vāyoḥ patnī \\ ity apareṇa gārhapatyam upaviśyāgnīdhro devapatnīr vyācaṣṭe senendrasya \ dhenā \\ iti vā /
meaning: वाग् वायोः पत्नी \\ इत्य् अपरेण गार्हपत्यम् उपविश्याग्नीध्रो देवपत्नीर् व्याचष्टे सेनेन्द्रस्य \ धेना \\ इति वा /
text_mt: Sitting down west of the gārhapatya fire, the Agnīdhra priest declares the wives of the gods with, 'Speech is the wife of Vāyu...', or with, 'The army of Indra, the milk-cow...'

sanskrit_iast: subrahmaṇyaḥ subrahmaṇyām āhvayati /
meaning: सुब्रह्मण्यः सुब्रह्मण्याम् आह्वयति /
text_mt: The Subrahmaṇya priest chants the Subrahmaṇyā formula.

sanskrit_iast: anūpasadam etāni kriyante /
meaning: अनूपसदम् एतानि क्रियन्ते /
text_mt: These [rites] are performed following each Upasad.

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ trirātram̐ sāyaṃprātaḥ pravargyopasadbhyāṃ pracarati /
meaning: एवं त्रिरात्रम्̐ सायंप्रातः प्रवर्ग्योपसद्भ्यां प्रचरति /
text_mt: In this manner, he performs the Pravargya and Upasad rites evening and morning for three nights:

sanskrit_iast: supūrvāhṇe paurvāhṇikībhyām̐ svaparāhṇa āparāhṇikībhyām /
meaning: सुपूर्वाह्णे पौर्वाह्णिकीभ्याम्̐ स्वपराह्ण आपराह्णिकीभ्याम् /
text_mt: the forenoon ones in the early forenoon, the afternoon ones in the late afternoon.

sanskrit_iast: yā te agne 'yāśayā tanūs \\ iti prathame 'hani sāyaṃprātaḥ sruvapradānāṃ juhoti /
meaning: या ते अग्ने ऽयाशया तनूस् \\ इति प्रथमे ऽहनि सायंप्रातः स्रुवप्रदानां जुहोति /
text_mt: On the first day, evening and morning, he offers the oblation given with the dipping spoon with, 'Agni, that body of yours which rests in iron...'

sanskrit_iast: yā te agne rajāśaya \\ iti dvitīye /
meaning: या ते अग्ने रजाशय \\ इति द्वितीये /
text_mt: On the second [day], with, 'Agni, that body of yours which rests in silver...'

sanskrit_iast: yā te agne harāśaya \\ iti tṛtīye /
meaning: या ते अग्ने हराशय \\ इति तृतीये /
text_mt: On the third [day], with, 'Agni, that body of yours which rests in gold...'

sanskrit_iast: yadi puro yudhyeyur ayaḥ prathamāyām avadhāya juhuyāt /
meaning: यदि पुरो युध्येयुर् अयः प्रथमायाम् अवधाय जुहुयात् /
text_mt: If they should fight against citadels, he should offer having placed iron in the first [offering];

sanskrit_iast: rajatam̐ hiraṇyaṃ madhyamāyām /
meaning: रजतम्̐ हिरण्यं मध्यमायाम् /
text_mt: silver gold in the middle [offering];

sanskrit_iast: haritam uttamāyām /
meaning: हरितम् उत्तमायाम् /

sanskrit_iast: yadi saṅgrāmaṃ yudhyeyur ity ekeṣām /
meaning: यदि सङ्ग्रामं युध्येयुर् इत्य् एकेषाम् /
text_mt: According to some, [this is done] if they should fight a battle.

sanskrit_iast: ayajñasaṃyuktaḥ kalpaḥ /
meaning: अयज्ञसंयुक्तः कल्पः /
text_mt: This procedure is not connected with the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: madhyamābhyāṃ paurvāhṇikībhyāṃ pravargyopasadbhyāṃ pracaryāgreṇa prāgvam̐śaṃ trīn prācaḥ prakramān prakramya śaṅkuṃ nihanti sa paścārdhe vedeḥ /
meaning: मध्यमाभ्यां पौर्वाह्णिकीभ्यां प्रवर्ग्योपसद्भ्यां प्रचर्याग्रेण प्राग्वम्̐शं त्रीन् प्राचः प्रक्रमान् प्रक्रम्य शङ्कुं निहन्ति स पश्चार्धे वेदेः /
text_mt: Having performed the middle forenoon Pravargya and Upasad rites, having paced three steps eastward in front of the eastern hall, he drives in a peg; that is in the western half of the altar.

sanskrit_iast: vimime tvā payasvatīṃ devānām \\ dhenum̐ sudughām anapasphurantīm \ indraḥ somaṃ pibatu kṣemo astu nas \\ iti ṣaṭtrim̐śat prācaḥ prakramān prakramya śaṅkuṃ nihanti sa pūrvārdhe /
meaning: विमिमे त्वा पयस्वतीं देवानाम् \\ धेनुम्̐ सुदुघाम् अनपस्फुरन्तीम् \ इन्द्रः सोमं पिबतु क्षेमो अस्तु नस् \\ इति षट्त्रिम्̐शत् प्राचः प्रक्रमान् प्रक्रम्य शङ्कुं निहन्ति स पूर्वार्धे /
text_mt: With 'I measure you out, yielding milk for the gods, a cow yielding good milk, not kicking away; let Indra drink soma, let there be security for us', having paced thirty-six steps eastward, he drives in a peg; that is in the eastern half.

sanskrit_iast: paścārdhyāc chaṅkoḥ pañcadaśa dakṣiṇataḥ pañcadaśottarataḥ prakramya śaṅkū nihanti te śroṇī pūrvārdhyāc chaṅkor dvādaśa dakṣiṇato dvādaśottarataḥ prakramya śaṅkū nihanti tāv aṃsau /
meaning: पश्चार्ध्याच् छङ्कोः पञ्चदश दक्षिणतः पञ्चदशोत्तरतः प्रक्रम्य शङ्कू निहन्ति ते श्रोणी पूर्वार्ध्याच् छङ्कोर् द्वादश दक्षिणतो द्वादशोत्तरतः प्रक्रम्य शङ्कू निहन्ति ताव् अंसौ /
text_mt: Having paced fifteen steps south from the peg of the western half and fifteen steps north, he drives in two pegs; those are the two hips. Having paced twelve steps south from the peg of the eastern half and twelve steps north, he drives in two pegs; those are the two shoulders.

sanskrit_iast: akṣṇayā mānena saṃpādya pradakṣiṇam̐ spandyayā paryātanoti /
meaning: अक्ष्णया मानेन संपाद्य प्रदक्षिणम्̐ स्पन्द्यया पर्यातनोति /
text_mt: Having checked the measurements diagonally, he stretches the measuring cord around in a clockwise direction.

sanskrit_iast: anvātanoti pṛṣṭhyām /
meaning: अन्वातनोति पृष्ठ्याम् /

sanskrit_iast: tāṃ karoti yathā darśapūrṇamāsayor yad anyat saṃnāmāt /
meaning: तां करोति यथा दर्शपूर्णमासयोर् यद् अन्यत् संनामात् /
text_mt: He prepares it as in the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices, except for the modifications of the mantras.

sanskrit_iast: sphyena vighanena parśvā paraśunā ca /
meaning: स्फ्येन विघनेन पर्श्वा परशुना च /
text_mt: With the wooden sword, the wooden mallet, the rib bone, and the axe [he prepares it].

sanskrit_iast: yat prāg uttarasmāt parigrāhāt tat kṛtvottaravedyāḥ kalpena daśapadām uttaravediṃ karoti /
meaning: यत् प्राग् उत्तरस्मात् परिग्राहात् तत् कृत्वोत्तरवेद्याः कल्पेन दशपदाम् उत्तरवेदिं करोति /
text_mt: Having performed whatever comes before the second boundary line, he constructs the high altar of ten paces according to the procedure for the high altar.

sanskrit_iast: am̐hīyasīṃ purastād ity ekeṣām /
meaning: अम्̐हीयसीं पुरस्ताद् इत्य् एकेषाम् /
text_mt: According to some, narrower in the front.

sanskrit_iast: uttareṇottaraṃ vedyam̐saṃ prakrame cātvālaḥ paścād dvādaśasūtkaro vidyate 'parimite vā /
meaning: उत्तरेणोत्तरं वेद्यम्̐सं प्रक्रमे चात्वालः पश्चाद् द्वादशसूत्करो विद्यते ऽपरिमिते वा /
text_mt: To the north of the northern shoulder of the altar, at a distance of one step, is the pit; behind it, at twelve [steps], is found the heap of rubbish, or at an unspecified distance.

sanskrit_iast: tāv antareṇa vedeḥ saṃcaraḥ /
meaning: ताव् अन्तरेण वेदेः संचरः /
text_mt: Between those two is the pathway to the altar.

sanskrit_iast: prācīnam āgnīdhrāt pratīcīnaṃ cātvālād ity ekeṣām /
meaning: प्राचीनम् आग्नीध्रात् प्रतीचीनं चात्वालाद् इत्य् एकेषाम् /
text_mt: According to some, eastward from the Agnīdhra's shed and westward from the pit.

sanskrit_iast: udumbaraśākhābhiś channāṃ parivāsayati /
meaning: उदुम्बरशाखाभिश् छन्नां परिवासयति /
text_mt: Covered with branches of udumbara, he leaves it overnight.

sanskrit_iast: śvo bhūte //
meaning: श्वो भूते //

sanskrit_iast: uttamābhyāṃ paurvāhṇikībhyāṃ pravargyopasadbhyāṃ pracaryārdhavrataṃ pradāya tadānīm evāparāhṇikībhyāṃ pravargyopasadbhyāṃ pracarati /
meaning: उत्तमाभ्यां पौर्वाह्णिकीभ्यां प्रवर्ग्योपसद्भ्यां प्रचर्यार्धव्रतं प्रदाय तदानीम् एवापराह्णिकीभ्यां प्रवर्ग्योपसद्भ्यां प्रचरति /
text_mt: Having performed the final forenoon Pravargya and Upasad rites and given half the fast-milk, he performs the afternoon Pravargya and Upasad rites at that very time.

sanskrit_iast: pravargyam udvāsyopasadam upaiti yadi pūrvo bhavati /
meaning: प्रवर्ग्यम् उद्वास्योपसदम् उपैति यदि पूर्वो भवति /
text_mt: Having set aside the Pravargya, he approaches the Upasad, if [the Pravargya] comes first.

sanskrit_iast: ardhavrataṃ pradāyāgner āvṛtāgniṃ praṇīyāgnyāyatana ūrṇāstukāṃ nidhāyāgniṃ pratiṣṭhāpyāmikṣāyai maitrāvaruṇyai sāyaṃdohāya vatsān apākaroti /
meaning: अर्धव्रतं प्रदायाग्नेर् आवृताग्निं प्रणीयाग्न्यायतन ऊर्णास्तुकां निधायाग्निं प्रतिष्ठाप्यामिक्षायै मैत्रावरुण्यै सायंदोहाय वत्सान् अपाकरोति /
text_mt: Having given half the fast-milk, having brought forward the fire according to the ritual procedure for the fire, having placed a tuft of wool in the fireplace and established the fire, he separates the calves for the evening milking for the curd oblation to Mitra and Varuṇa;

sanskrit_iast: indrāya ca dadhigharmāya gharmadugho vatsam /
meaning: इन्द्राय च दधिघर्माय घर्मदुघो वत्सम् /
text_mt: and the calf of the cow yielding milk for the heated pot, for the curdled-milk pot-offering to Indra.

sanskrit_iast: sarvāṇy aindrāṇi bhavantīty ekeṣām /
meaning: सर्वाण्य् ऐन्द्राणि भवन्तीत्य् एकेषाम् /
text_mt: According to some, all belong to Indra.

sanskrit_iast: agnivaty uttaraṃ parigrāhaṃ parigṛhṇāti /
meaning: अग्निवत्य् उत्तरं परिग्राहं परिगृह्णाति /
text_mt: He marks out the second boundary line while [the altar] possesses the fire.

sanskrit_iast: na parigṛhītām aprokṣitām adhicaraty āstaraṇāt /
meaning: न परिगृहीताम् अप्रोक्षिताम् अधिचरत्य् आस्तरणात् /
text_mt: One does not walk upon it when it has been marked out and is not sprinkled, until the strewing [of the grass].

sanskrit_iast: sutyārthāni kāṣṭhāni māhāvedikaṃ ca barhir upakḷptaṃ bhavati tūṣṇīkābhir adbhiḥ kāṣṭhāni vediṃ barhiś ca tristriḥ prokṣati /
meaning: सुत्यार्थानि काष्ठानि माहावेदिकं च बर्हिर् उपकॢप्तं भवति तूष्णीकाभिर् अद्भिः काष्ठानि वेदिं बर्हिश् च त्रिस्त्रिः प्रोक्षति /
text_mt: The wooden sticks for the soma-pressing days and the sacrificial grass for the great altar are prepared; he sprinkles the wooden sticks, the altar, and the sacrificial grass three times each with water without mantras.

sanskrit_iast: tūṣṇīṃ barhiṣā vedim̐ stṛṇāti yathā darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ /
meaning: तूष्णीं बर्हिषा वेदिम्̐ स्तृणाति यथा दर्शपूर्णमासयोः /
text_mt: Silently he strews the altar with sacrificial grass as in the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast: ā ghā ye agnim indhate \ stṛṇanti barhir ānuṣak / \ yeṣām indro yuvā sakhā \\ iti staraṇīm eke samāmananti //
meaning: आ घा ये अग्निम् इन्धते \ स्तृणन्ति बर्हिर् आनुषक् / \ येषाम् इन्द्रो युवा सखा \\ इति स्तरणीम् एके समामनन्ति //
text_mt: "Indeed, those who kindle the fire, / who strew the sacred grass continuously, / whose youthful friend is Indra—" / with this [verse], some teachers instruct to strew [the sacred grass].

sanskrit_iast: upakḷpte śakaṭe maṇḍalacakre prayuktapūrve tayoḥ purāṇān granthīn visrasya prakṣālya navān kurvanti cchadiṣmatī yugyakṛte kṛtvāgreṇa prāgvam̐śam avasthāpya yuñjate manas \\ ity auttaravedike juhoti /
meaning: उपकॢप्ते शकटे मण्डलचक्रे प्रयुक्तपूर्वे तयोः पुराणान् ग्रन्थीन् विस्रस्य प्रक्षाल्य नवान् कुर्वन्ति च्छदिष्मती युग्यकृते कृत्वाग्रेण प्राग्वम्̐शम् अवस्थाप्य युञ्जते मनस् \\ इत्य् औत्तरवेदिके जुहोति /
text_mt: When the two carts, having round wheels and having been used before, are prepared, [the priests] untie their old knots, wash them, and make new ones; having fitted them with thatched roofs and readied them with yokes, and having placed them in front of the eastern hall, he offers on the high altar fire with: "They yoke their mind..."

sanskrit_iast: devaśrutau \\ iti padatṛtīyasyaikadeśena patnī dakṣiṇasya havirdhānasya dakṣiṇām akṣadhuraṃ dakṣiṇenottānena triḥ parācīnam upānakty evam uttarasya /
meaning: देवश्रुतौ \\ इति पदतृतीयस्यैकदेशेन पत्नी दक्षिणस्य हविर्धानस्य दक्षिणाम् अक्षधुरं दक्षिणेनोत्तानेन त्रिः पराचीनम् उपानक्त्य् एवम् उत्तरस्य /
text_mt: With the part of the third quarter beginning with "O you who are heard by the gods," the sacrificer's wife anoints the southern axle-pole of the southern soma-cart three times outward with the palm of her right hand turned upward; likewise the northern [cart's axle-pole].

sanskrit_iast: sarvā upānaktīty ekeṣām /
meaning: सर्वा उपानक्तीत्य् एकेषाम् /
text_mt: According to some, she anoints all [the axle-poles].

sanskrit_iast: ājyena cety ekeṣām /
meaning: आज्येन चेत्य् एकेषाम् /

sanskrit_iast: havirdhānābhyāṃ pravartyamānābhyām anubrūhi \\ iti saṃpreṣyati pravartyamānābhyām anubrūhi \\ iti vā /
meaning: हविर्धानाभ्यां प्रवर्त्यमानाभ्याम् अनुब्रूहि \\ इति संप्रेष्यति प्रवर्त्यमानाभ्याम् अनुब्रूहि \\ इति वा /
text_mt: He gives the direction: "Recite for the two soma-carts being moved forward!" or: "Recite for the two being moved forward!"

sanskrit_iast: trir anūkāyāṃ prācī pretam iti samudgṛhṇantaḥ prācī pravartayanti /
meaning: त्रिर् अनूकायां प्राची प्रेतम् इति समुद्गृह्णन्तः प्राची प्रवर्तयन्ति /
text_mt: When [the verse] has been recited three times, taking hold [of them], they roll them forward toward the east with: "Go forward toward the east!"

sanskrit_iast: suvāg deva duryām̐ āvada \\ ity abhimantrayate yady akṣa utsarjet /
meaning: सुवाग् देव दुर्याम्̐ आवद \\ इत्य् अभिमन्त्रयते यद्य् अक्ष उत्सर्जेत् /
text_mt: If the axle should creak, he addresses it with: "O divine [axle], speak sweet-sounding words to the homesteads!"

sanskrit_iast: yatra vedim avakrāmatas tad dakṣiṇasya havirdhānasyottarasyāṃ vartanyāṃ vedyante hiraṇyaṃ nidhāya \\ idaṃ viṣṇus \\ iti juhoti /
meaning: यत्र वेदिम् अवक्रामतस् तद् दक्षिणस्य हविर्धानस्योत्तरस्यां वर्तन्यां वेद्यन्ते हिरण्यं निधाय \\ इदं विष्णुस् \\ इति जुहोति /
text_mt: Where they step upon the altar, there, having placed a piece of gold in the northern track of the southern soma-cart at the edge of the altar, he offers with: "Through this Vishnu..."

sanskrit_iast: irāvatī dhenumatī ity evaṃ pratiprasthātottarasya /
meaning: इरावती धेनुमती इत्य् एवं प्रतिप्रस्थातोत्तरस्य /
text_mt: The pratiprasthātṛ [offers likewise] for the northern [cart] with: "Rich in food, rich in cows..."

sanskrit_iast: adhvaryur dakṣiṇasya havirdhānasya karmāṇi karoti pratiprasthātottarasya /
meaning: अध्वर्युर् दक्षिणस्य हविर्धानस्य कर्माणि करोति प्रतिप्रस्थातोत्तरस्य /
text_mt: The adhvaryu performs the rites for the southern soma-cart, the pratiprasthātṛ for the northern.

sanskrit_iast: apa janyaṃ bhayaṃ nuda \\ apa cakrāṇi vartaya \ gṛham̐ somasya gacchatam \ indrasya sam̐sadam iti paścārdhe veder vitṛtīyadeśe manasā hotā padā janyaṃ bhayaṃ pratinudaty adhvaryur yajamāno brahmā vā /
meaning: अप जन्यं भयं नुद \\ अप चक्राणि वर्तय \ गृहम्̐ सोमस्य गच्छतम् \ इन्द्रस्य सम्̐सदम् इति पश्चार्धे वेदेर् वितृतीयदेशे मनसा होता पदा जन्यं भयं प्रतिनुदत्य् अध्वर्युर् यजमानो ब्रह्मा वा /
text_mt: With: "Ward off fear born of strangers, turn away the wheels, go to the house of Soma, to the assembly of Indra," the hotṛ mentally repels fear born of strangers with his foot in the western half of the altar at a distance of one third, or the adhvaryu, the sacrificer, or the brahman priest [does so].

sanskrit_iast: apareṇottaravediṃ trīn pratīcaḥ prakramān prativikramya \\ atra ramethām ity abhitaḥ pṛṣṭhyāṃ nabhyasthe sthāpayataḥ /
meaning: अपरेणोत्तरवेदिं त्रीन् प्रतीचः प्रक्रमान् प्रतिविक्रम्य \\ अत्र रमेथाम् इत्य् अभितः पृष्ठ्यां नभ्यस्थे स्थापयतः /
text_mt: Stepping back three steps westward to the west of the high altar, with: "Rest here!" both place them on both sides of the backbone-line, resting on their hubs,

sanskrit_iast: yathārtham̐ havirdhānayoḥ //
meaning: यथार्थम्̐ हविर्धानयोः //
text_mt: in accordance with the purpose of the two soma-carts;

sanskrit_iast: antarālaṃ kurutaḥ /
meaning: अन्तरालं कुरुतः /

sanskrit_iast: vaiṣṇavam asi \ viṣṇus tvottabhnātu \\ ity upastabhnutaḥ /
meaning: वैष्णवम् असि \ विष्णुस् त्वोत्तभ्नातु \\ इत्य् उपस्तभ्नुतः /
text_mt: Both prop them up with: "You belong to Vishnu; may Vishnu prop you up!"

sanskrit_iast: purastādunnate bhavataḥ /
meaning: पुरस्तादुन्नते भवतः /
text_mt: They are elevated in the front.

sanskrit_iast: divo vā viṣṇav uta vā pṛthivyās \\ ity āśīr padayarcā dakṣiṇasya havirdhānasya dakṣiṇaṃ karṇātardam apareṇa methīṃ nihanti viṣṇor nu kam ity uttarasyottaraṃ karṇātardam apareṇa pratiprasthātā /
meaning: दिवो वा विष्णव् उत वा पृथिव्यास् \\ इत्य् आशीर् पदयर्चा दक्षिणस्य हविर्धानस्य दक्षिणं कर्णातर्दम् अपरेण मेथीं निहन्ति विष्णोर् नु कम् इत्य् उत्तरस्योत्तरं कर्णातर्दम् अपरेण प्रतिप्रस्थाता /
text_mt: With the verse containing a prayer, "Either from the sky, O Vishnu, or from the earth...," [the adhvaryu] drives in a peg to the west of the southern ear-piercing hole of the southern soma-cart; the pratiprasthātṛ, with: "Now Vishnu's..." [drives in a peg] to the west of the northern ear-piercing hole of the northern [cart].

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇor dhruvam asi \\ iti tatraite nibadhnītaḥ /
meaning: विष्णोर् ध्रुवम् असि \\ इति तत्रैते निबध्नीतः /
text_mt: Both tie these [carts] there with: "You are the firm point of Vishnu!"

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇor dhruvo 'si \\ iti granthī kurutas tau prajñātau bhavataḥ /
meaning: विष्णोर् ध्रुवो ऽसि \\ इति ग्रन्थी कुरुतस् तौ प्रज्ञातौ भवतः /
text_mt: With: "You are the firm [knot] of Vishnu," both tie knots; these are clearly distinguishable.

sanskrit_iast: ūrdhvāḥ śamyāḥ samutkṛṣyopariṣṭāt pariveṣṭayato yathāsuṣṭhu /
meaning: ऊर्ध्वाः शम्याः समुत्कृष्योपरिष्टात् परिवेष्टयतो यथासुष्ठु /
text_mt: Pulling up the vertical yoke-pins, both wrap [the ropes] above as securely as possible.

sanskrit_iast: paryantyāḥ sthūṇā minutaḥ /
meaning: पर्यन्त्याः स्थूणा मिनुतः /
text_mt: They erect the outer boundary-posts,

sanskrit_iast: yathāgreṇa kharam̐ saṃcaro bhavati /
meaning: यथाग्रेण खरम्̐ संचरो भवति /
text_mt: so that there is passage in front of the mound.

sanskrit_iast: agreṇa havirdhāne sthūṇe nihatya tayor udagagraṃ vam̐śaṃ nidhāya prāco vam̐śān ādadhāti /
meaning: अग्रेण हविर्धाने स्थूणे निहत्य तयोर् उदगग्रं वम्̐शं निधाय प्राचो वम्̐शान् आदधाति /
text_mt: Having driven in two posts in front of the soma-carts and having placed across them a bamboo beam pointing north, he places bamboo beams pointing east.

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇoḥ pṛṣṭham asi \\ iti madhyamaṃ chadir adhi nidadhāti /
meaning: विष्णोः पृष्ठम् असि \\ इति मध्यमं छदिर् अधि निदधाति /
text_mt: With: "You are the back of Vishnu," he places the middle thatched roof on top.

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇo rarāṭam asi \\ iti purastād rarāṭīṃ pariśrayati /
meaning: विष्णो रराटम् असि \\ इति पुरस्ताद् रराटीं परिश्रयति /
text_mt: With: "You are the forehead of Vishnu," he fastens the forehead-mat in front.

sanskrit_iast: tejanī rarāṭyaiṣīkī prācyanūkāṇḍā madhye vitatāṃ tāṃ vam̐śe nibadhnāti /
meaning: तेजनी रराट्यैषीकी प्राच्यनूकाण्डा मध्ये विततां तां वम्̐शे निबध्नाति /
text_mt: The forehead-mat is made of reeds, woven with its stalks pointing east, spread out in the middle; he ties it to the bamboo beam.

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇoḥ śnyaptre sthas \\ iti rarāṭyā antau vyavāsyati /
meaning: विष्णोः श्न्यप्त्रे स्थस् \\ इति रराट्या अन्तौ व्यवास्यति /
text_mt: With: "You two are Vishnu's corner-fasteners," he fastens down the two ends of the forehead-mat.

sanskrit_iast: kaṭām̐s tejanīś ca pravartaṃ chadiṣām antarāleṣv anvavasyanti /
meaning: कटाम्̐स् तेजनीश् च प्रवर्तं छदिषाम् अन्तरालेष्व् अन्ववस्यन्ति /
text_mt: They fasten mats and reed cushions continuously into the spaces between the thatched roofs.

sanskrit_iast: tān antarvartā ity ācakṣate /
meaning: तान् अन्तर्वर्ता इत्य् आचक्षते /
text_mt: These they call the internal coverings.

sanskrit_iast: pari tvā girvaṇo giras \\ ity abhitaḥ pariśrayataḥ /
meaning: परि त्वा गिर्वणो गिरस् \\ इत्य् अभितः परिश्रयतः /
text_mt: With: "The songs, O lover of songs, around you...," both enclose it all around with mats.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvam aparaṃ ca dvāre kurutaḥ /
meaning: पूर्वम् अपरं च द्वारे कुरुतः /
text_mt: Both make a western and an eastern door.

sanskrit_iast: adhvaryur dakṣiṇāṃ dvāreyīṃ pariṣīvyati pratiprasthātottarām /
meaning: अध्वर्युर् दक्षिणां द्वारेयीं परिषीव्यति प्रतिप्रस्थातोत्तराम् /
text_mt: The adhvaryu sews the southern door-frame, the pratiprasthātṛ the northern.

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇoḥ syūr asi \\ iti sīvyataḥ /
meaning: विष्णोः स्यूर् असि \\ इति सीव्यतः /
text_mt: Both sew with: "You are the stitch of Vishnu!"

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇor dhruvo 'si \\ iti granthī kurutas tau prajñātau bhavataḥ /
meaning: विष्णोर् ध्रुवो ऽसि \\ इति ग्रन्थी कुरुतस् तौ प्रज्ञातौ भवतः /
text_mt: Both tie knots with: "You are the firm [knot] of Vishnu!"; these are clearly distinguishable.

sanskrit_iast: vaiṣṇavam asi \ viṣṇave tvā \\ iti saṃmitam abhimṛśataḥ /
meaning: वैष्णवम् असि \ विष्णवे त्वा \\ इति संमितम् अभिमृशतः /
text_mt: Both touch the measured soma-shed with: "You belong to Vishnu; for Vishnu, you!"

sanskrit_iast: pra tad viṣṇuḥ stavate vīryāya \ mṛgo na bhīmaḥ kucaro giriṣṭhāḥ / \ yasyoruṣu triṣu vikramaṇeṣu \\ adhikṣiyanti bhuvanāni viśvā \\ iti saṃmitād dhavirdhānāt prāg upaniṣkrāmataḥ /
meaning: प्र तद् विष्णुः स्तवते वीर्याय \ मृगो न भीमः कुचरो गिरिष्ठाः / \ यस्योरुषु त्रिषु विक्रमणेषु \\ अधिक्षियन्ति भुवनानि विश्वा \\ इति संमिताद् धविर्धानात् प्राग् उपनिष्क्रामतः /
text_mt: With: "Vishnu is praised for this his manly deed, like a fearful wild beast roaming anywhere, dwelling on the mountains, in whose three wide strides all creatures dwell," both step out toward the east from the measured soma-shed.

sanskrit_iast: upaniṣkramya vā japataḥ /
meaning: उपनिष्क्रम्य वा जपतः /
text_mt: Or having stepped out, both murmur [it].

sanskrit_iast: trīn prācaḥ prakramān prakramya japata ity ekeṣām //
meaning: त्रीन् प्राचः प्रक्रमान् प्रक्रम्य जपत इत्य् एकेषाम् //
text_mt: According to some, having stepped forward three steps toward the east, both murmur [it].

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇasya havirdhānasya purokṣaṃ catvāra uparavā bhavanty avāntaradeśeṣu prādeśamukhāḥ prādeśāntarālā bāhumātrāḥ saṃtṛṇṇā adhastād vidhṛtā upariṣṭāt /
meaning: दक्षिणस्य हविर्धानस्य पुरोक्षं चत्वार उपरवा भवन्त्य् अवान्तरदेशेषु प्रादेशमुखाः प्रादेशान्तराला बाहुमात्राः संतृण्णा अधस्ताद् विधृता उपरिष्टात् /
text_mt: In front of the axle of the southern soma-cart are four sounding-holes in the intermediate directions, a span wide in aperture, a span apart from each other, an arm's length deep, pierced through underneath, and separated on top.

sanskrit_iast: abhrerādānaṃ parilekhanaṃ ca yūpe vyākhyātam /
meaning: अभ्रेरादानं परिलेखनं च यूपे व्याख्यातम् /
text_mt: Taking the spade and delineating have been explained in [the section on] the sacrificial post.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvayor dakṣiṇaṃ parilikhyāparayor uttaraṃ parilikhaty aparayor dakṣiṇaṃ pūrvayoruttaram /
meaning: पूर्वयोर् दक्षिणं परिलिख्यापरयोर् उत्तरं परिलिखत्य् अपरयोर् दक्षिणं पूर्वयोरुत्तरम् /
text_mt: Having delineated the southern of the two eastern [holes], he delineates the northern of the two western; [then] the southern of the two western, [then] the northern of the two eastern.

sanskrit_iast: evam anupūrvāṇy eṣāṃ karmāṇi kriyante /
meaning: एवम् अनुपूर्वाण्य् एषां कर्माणि क्रियन्ते /
text_mt: In this regular order, their rites are performed.

sanskrit_iast: rakṣohaṇo valaganano vaiṣṇavān khanāmi \\ iti khanati /
meaning: रक्षोहणो वलगननो वैष्णवान् खनामि \\ इति खनति /
text_mt: He digs with: "Rakṣas-slaying, spell-destroying, sacred to Vishnu, I dig you!"

sanskrit_iast: rakṣohaṇo valagahano vaiṣṇavān niṣkhidāmi \\ iti niṣkhidati /
meaning: रक्षोहणो वलगहनो वैष्णवान् निष्खिदामि \\ इति निष्खिदति /
text_mt: He clears out with: "Rakṣas-slaying, spell-destroying, sacred to Vishnu, I pull you out!"

sanskrit_iast: bṛhann asi \\ ity abhriṃ praharati /
meaning: बृहन्न् असि \\ इत्य् अभ्रिं प्रहरति /
text_mt: With: "You are great!" he strikes with the spade.

sanskrit_iast: virāḍ asi \\ iti bāhum upāvaharati bāhū vā /
meaning: विराड् असि \\ इति बाहुम् उपावहरति बाहू वा /
text_mt: With: "You are luminous!" he thrusts his arm, or both arms, down.

sanskrit_iast: idam ahaṃ taṃ valagam udvapāmi \\ iti pām̐sūn udvapati /
meaning: इदम् अहं तं वलगम् उद्वपामि \\ इति पाम्̐सून् उद्वपति /
text_mt: With: "Here I cast out that secret spell!" he throws out the dust.

sanskrit_iast: idam enam adharaṃ karomi \\ ity uparavabile 'vabādhate /
meaning: इदम् एनम् अधरं करोमि \\ इत्य् उपरवबिले ऽवबाधते /
text_mt: With: "Here I make him lower!" he presses down in the opening of the sounding-hole.

sanskrit_iast: nirasto balagas \\ iti harati /
meaning: निरस्तो बलगस् \\ इति हरति /
text_mt: With: "Cast out is the spell!" he carries [the dust] away.

sanskrit_iast: avabāḍho durasyus \\ iti yatra kharaṃ kariṣyan bhavati tasmin deśe nivapati /
meaning: अवबाढो दुरस्युस् \\ इति यत्र खरं करिष्यन् भवति तस्मिन् देशे निवपति /
text_mt: With: "Pressed down is the malicious one!" he pours it out at that place where he intends to make the mound.

sanskrit_iast: evam itareṣu /
meaning: एवम् इतरेषु /

sanskrit_iast: uttareṇottareṇa mantreṇa bāhum upāvaharaty uttareṇottareṇa ca chandasā nigṛhṇāti /
meaning: उत्तरेणोत्तरेण मन्त्रेण बाहुम् उपावहरत्य् उत्तरेणोत्तरेण च छन्दसा निगृह्णाति /
text_mt: With each successive mantra he thrusts his arm down, and with each successive metre he presses down.

sanskrit_iast: gāyatraṃ traiṣṭubhaṃ jāgatam ānuṣṭubham ity āmnātāni chandāṃsi /
meaning: गायत्रं त्रैष्टुभं जागतम् आनुष्टुभम् इत्य् आम्नातानि छन्दांसि /
text_mt: Gāyatrī, Triṣṭubh, Jagatī, and Anuṣṭubh are the metres handed down [for this purpose].

sanskrit_iast: virāḍ asi \\ iti pūrvayor dakṣiṇaṃ yajamāno 'vamṛśati samrāḍ asi \\ ity aparayor uttaram adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: विराड् असि \\ इति पूर्वयोर् दक्षिणं यजमानो ऽवमृशति सम्राड् असि \\ इत्य् अपरयोर् उत्तरम् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: With: "You are luminous!" the sacrificer reaches down into the southern of the two eastern [sounding-holes]; with: "You are sovereign!" the adhvaryu [reaches down into] the northern of the two western.

sanskrit_iast: saṃmṛśa imān āyuṣe varcase ca \ devānāṃ nidhir asi dveṣoyavanas \\ yuyodhy asmad dveṣām̐si yāni kāni cakṛma \ devānām idaṃ nihitaṃ yad asti \\ athābhāhi pradiśaś catasraḥ \ kṛṇvāno anyām̐ adharān sapatnān ity adhastāt saṃmṛśataḥ /
meaning: संमृश इमान् आयुषे वर्चसे च \ देवानां निधिर् असि द्वेषोयवनस् \\ युयोध्य् अस्मद् द्वेषाम्̐सि यानि कानि चकृम \ देवानाम् इदं निहितं यद् अस्ति \\ अथाभाहि प्रदिशश् चतस्रः \ कृण्वानो अन्याम्̐ अधरान् सपत्नान् इत्य् अधस्तात् संमृशतः /
text_mt: Both touch each other's hands underneath with: "Touch these for life and for lustre; you are the treasure of the gods, the remover of haters; ward off from us haters, whatever deeds we have done; this which is the deposit of the gods, now shine out over the four quarters, putting the other rivals below!"

sanskrit_iast: kim atra \\ ity adhvaryuḥ pṛcchati bhadram iti yajamānaḥ pratyāha tan nau saha \\ ity adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: किम् अत्र \\ इत्य् अध्वर्युः पृच्छति भद्रम् इति यजमानः प्रत्याह तन् नौ सह \\ इत्य् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: "What is here?" asks the adhvaryu. "Auspiciousness!" replies the sacrificer. "May it be together for the two of us!" [says] the adhvaryu.

sanskrit_iast: svarāḍ asi \\ ity aparayor dakṣiṇaṃ yajamāno 'vamṛśati viśvārāḍ asi \\ iti pūrvayor uttaram adhvaryuḥ /
meaning: स्वराड् असि \\ इत्य् अपरयोर् दक्षिणं यजमानो ऽवमृशति विश्वाराड् असि \\ इति पूर्वयोर् उत्तरम् अध्वर्युः /
text_mt: With: "You are self-ruler!" the sacrificer reaches down into the southern of the two western [sounding-holes]; with: "You are all-ruler!" the adhvaryu [reaches down into] the northern of the two eastern.

sanskrit_iast: saṃmṛśato yathā purastāt /
meaning: संमृशतो यथा पुरस्तात् /
text_mt: Both touch each other's hands as before.

sanskrit_iast: kim atra \\ iti yajamānaḥ pṛcchati bhadram ity achvaryuḥ pratyāha tan me \\ iti yajamānaḥ /
meaning: किम् अत्र \\ इति यजमानः पृच्छति भद्रम् इत्य् अछ्वर्युः प्रत्याह तन् मे \\ इति यजमानः /
text_mt: "What is here?" asks the sacrificer. "Auspiciousness!" replies the adhvaryu. "May it be for me!" [says] the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast: rakṣohaṇo valagahanaḥ prokṣāmi vaiṣṇavān iti //
meaning: रक्षोहणो वलगहनः प्रोक्षामि वैष्णवान् इति //
text_mt: [With the mantra,] "Slayers of the Rakṣases, slayers of sorceries, I sprinkle you belonging to Viṣṇu,"

sanskrit_iast: yavamatībhir adbhir uparavām̐s triḥ prokṣati /
meaning: यवमतीभिर् अद्भिर् उपरवाम्̐स् त्रिः प्रोक्षति /
text_mt: he sprinkles the sounding-holes three times with water containing barley.

sanskrit_iast: rakṣohaṇo valagahano 'vanayāmi vaiṣṇavān iti yavamatīr apo 'vanayati /
meaning: रक्षोहणो वलगहनो ऽवनयामि वैष्णवान् इति यवमतीर् अपो ऽवनयति /
text_mt: [With the mantra,] "Slayers of the Rakṣases, slayers of sorceries, I pour you belonging to Viṣṇu," he pours down the water containing barley.

sanskrit_iast: yavo 'si \\ iti yavaṃ prāsyati /
meaning: यवो ऽसि \\ इति यवं प्रास्यति /
text_mt: [With the mantra,] "You are barley..." he casts in a barley-corn.

sanskrit_iast: rakṣohaṇo valagahano 'vastṛṇāmi vaiṣṇavān iti prācā barhiṣāvastṛṇāti /
meaning: रक्षोहणो वलगहनो ऽवस्तृणामि वैष्णवान् इति प्राचा बर्हिषावस्तृणाति /
