text_mt: Having poured them onto the lower pressing stone and sprinkled them with the Vasatīvarī waters, lifting up the pressing stone with, "Do not fear, do not tremble," he addresses the two pressing boards with, "O two pressing boards, being firm..."

sanskrit_iast: anāgasas tvā vayam \ indreṇa preṣitā upa \ vāyuṣ ṭe astv am̐śabhūs \\ mitras te astv am̐śabhūs \\ varuṇas te astv am̐śabhūs \\ ahataḥ somo rājā \\ iti yatra mūlaṃ tṛṇaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ vā paśyati tasmin deśe same praharati /
meaning: अनागसस् त्वा वयम् \ इन्द्रेण प्रेषिता उप \ वायुष् टे अस्त्व् अम्̐शभूस् \\ मित्रस् ते अस्त्व् अम्̐शभूस् \\ वरुणस् ते अस्त्व् अम्̐शभूस् \\ अहतः सोमो राजा \\ इति यत्र मूलं तृणं काष्ठं वा पश्यति तस्मिन् देशे समे प्रहरति /
text_mt: With, "We [approach] you guiltless, sent forward by Indra; may Vāyu be a stalk-sharer for you; may Mitra be a stalk-sharer for you; may Varuṇa be a stalk-sharer for you; unslain is King Soma," he strikes upon an even place where he sees a root, a blade of grass, or a piece of wood.

sanskrit_iast: tṛṇam antardhāyābhiṣuṇotīty ekeṣām /
meaning: तृणम् अन्तर्धायाभिषुणोतीत्य् एकेषाम् /
text_mt: According to some, he presses having placed a blade of grass between.

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭaukṛtvo 'gre 'bhiṣutya nigrābham upaiti yathā purastāt /
meaning: अष्टौकृत्वो ऽग्रे ऽभिषुत्य निग्राभम् उपैति यथा पुरस्तात् /
text_mt: Having pressed eight times at the beginning, he proceeds to the nigrābha as before.

sanskrit_iast: apāttānām am̐śūnāṃ dvābhyām upāśm̐upātram apidhāyottarataḥ pratiprasthātopayacchati /
meaning: अपात्तानाम् अम्̐शूनां द्वाभ्याम् उपाश्म्̐उपात्रम् अपिधायोत्तरतः प्रतिप्रस्थातोपयच्छति /
text_mt: The pratiprasthātṛ supports [the Upāṃśu vessel] from the north, having covered the Upāṃśu vessel with two of the stalks that were taken.

sanskrit_iast: vācaspataye pavasva vājin \\ iti tasminn añjalinādhvaryuḥ somam āsiñcati /
meaning: वाचस्पतये पवस्व वाजिन् \\ इति तस्मिन्न् अञ्जलिनाध्वर्युः सोमम् आसिञ्चति /
text_mt: The adhvaryu pours the Soma into it with his joined palms with, "Flow for the lord of speech, O vigorous one!"

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ vihito dvitīyas tṛtīyaś cābhiṣavaḥ /
meaning: एवं विहितो द्वितीयस् तृतीयश् चाभिषवः /
text_mt: In this manner the second and third pressings are performed.

sanskrit_iast: api vaikādaśakṛtvo dvitīyam abhiṣuṇoti dvādaśakṛtvas tṛtīyam /
meaning: अपि वैकादशकृत्वो द्वितीयम् अभिषुणोति द्वादशकृत्वस् तृतीयम् /
text_mt: Or rather, he presses eleven times the second [time], and twelve times the third [time].

sanskrit_iast: apoddhṛtya pūrvāv am̐śū anyābhyāṃ dvitīye pātram apidhāyopayacchaty anyābhyāṃ tṛtīye devo devānām iti dvitīye somam āsiñcati madhumatīr na iṣas kṛdhi \\ iti tṛtīye /
meaning: अपोद्धृत्य पूर्वाव् अम्̐शू अन्याभ्यां द्वितीये पात्रम् अपिधायोपयच्छत्य् अन्याभ्यां तृतीये देवो देवानाम् इति द्वितीये सोमम् आसिञ्चति मधुमतीर् न इषस् कृधि \\ इति तृतीये /
text_mt: Taking away the previous two stalks, he covers the vessel with two other [stalks] and supports it during the second [pressing], and with two other [stalks] during the third; he pours the Soma into it with, "A god of the gods..." at the second, and with, "Make our nourishments full of sweetness," at the third.

sanskrit_iast: na sādayati /
meaning: न सादयति /

sanskrit_iast: svāṃkṛto 'si \\ ity uttiṣṭhati /
meaning: स्वांकृतो ऽसि \\ इत्य् उत्तिष्ठति /
text_mt: He stands up with, "You are made self-consecrated."

sanskrit_iast: urv antarikṣam iti gacchati /
meaning: उर्व् अन्तरिक्षम् इति गच्छति /
text_mt: He moves forward with, "[Through] the wide atmosphere..."

sanskrit_iast: uttareṇa hotāram atikramya //
meaning: उत्तरेण होतारम् अतिक्रम्य //
text_mt: Stepping beyond to the north of the hotṛ,

sanskrit_iast: manas tvāṣṭu \\ ity uttaraṃ paridhisaṃdhim anvavatiṣṭhate /
meaning: मनस् त्वाष्टु \\ इत्य् उत्तरं परिधिसंधिम् अन्ववतिष्ठते /
text_mt: he positions himself along the northern junction of the enclosing sticks with, "May the mind take delight in you."

sanskrit_iast: uttaraṃ paridhisaṃdhim anvavahṛtya svāhā tvā subhavaḥ sūryāya \\ iti dakṣiṇāprāñcam ṛjuṃ dīrgham̐ saṃtataṃ juhoti /
meaning: उत्तरं परिधिसंधिम् अन्ववहृत्य स्वाहा त्वा सुभवः सूर्याय \\ इति दक्षिणाप्राञ्चम् ऋजुं दीर्घम्̐ संततं जुहोति /
text_mt: Lowering [the cup] along the northern junction of the enclosing sticks, he makes a continuous, long, straight offering towards the southeast with, "Svāhā to you, well-born, for Sūrya!"

sanskrit_iast: devebhyas tvā marīcipebhyas \\ iti madhyame paridhāv abhyantaraṃ lepaṃ nimārṣṭi /
meaning: देवेभ्यस् त्वा मरीचिपेभ्यस् \\ इति मध्यमे परिधाव् अभ्यन्तरं लेपं निमार्ष्टि /
text_mt: He wipes the residue on the inner side of the middle enclosing stick with, "To the gods who drink the rays..."

sanskrit_iast: yadi kāmayeta varṣukaḥ parjanyaḥ syād iti brāhmaṇavyākhyātam /
meaning: यदि कामयेत वर्षुकः पर्जन्यः स्याद् इति ब्राह्मणव्याख्यातम् /
text_mt: If he should desire: 'May Parjanya bring rain,' that has been explained in the Brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: āgrayaṇasthālyām̐ saṃpātam avanayati /
meaning: आग्रयणस्थाल्याम्̐ संपातम् अवनयति /
text_mt: He pours the remnant into the Āgrayaṇa trough.

sanskrit_iast: eṣa te yoniḥ \ prāṇāya tvā \\ iti pātram̐ sādayati /
meaning: एष ते योनिः \ प्राणाय त्वा \\ इति पात्रम्̐ सादयति /
text_mt: He sets down the vessel with, "This is your womb; for the in-breath [I take] you."

sanskrit_iast: tasminn am̐śum avadadhāti sa pariśeta ā tṛtīyasavanāt /
meaning: तस्मिन्न् अम्̐शुम् अवदधाति स परिशेत आ तृतीयसवनात् /
text_mt: He puts a stalk into it; that remains lying there until the third pressing.

sanskrit_iast: abhicaratas tu grahaṃ gṛhītvā amuṣya tvā prāṇe sādayāmi \\ iti sādayet tam̐ sāvitreṇādāya \\ amuṃ jahy atha tvā hoṣyāmi \\ ity abhimantrya praharṣiṇo madirasya made mṛṣāsāv astu \\ iti juhoti /
meaning: अभिचरतस् तु ग्रहं गृहीत्वा अमुष्य त्वा प्राणे सादयामि \\ इति सादयेत् तम्̐ सावित्रेणादाय \\ अमुं जह्य् अथ त्वा होष्यामि \\ इत्य् अभिमन्त्र्य प्रहर्षिणो मदिरस्य मदे मृषासाव् अस्तु \\ इति जुहोति /
text_mt: In the case of one practicing malevolent rites, however, having drawn the cup, he should deposit it with: 'I deposit you in the out-breath of so-and-so'; having taken it with the Savitṛ mantra, having consecrated it with: 'Kill so-and-so, then I will make offering with you', he offers it with: 'In the intoxication of the exhilarating, rapturous [draught], let so-and-so come to ruin!'

sanskrit_iast: ā hotor aprāṇann āsīta /
meaning: आ होतोर् अप्राणन्न् आसीत /

sanskrit_iast: yadi dūre syād ā tamitos tiṣṭhet /
meaning: यदि दूरे स्याद् आ तमितोस् तिष्ठेत् /
text_mt: If [the enemy] is far away, he should stand until he is out of breath.

sanskrit_iast: dveṣyasya nāma gṛhṇāti /
meaning: द्वेष्यस्य नाम गृह्णाति /
text_mt: He names the person he hates.

sanskrit_iast: devām̐śo yasmai tveḍe tat satyam apariplutā bhaṅgyena \ hato 'sau phaṭ \\ iti yo 'syām̐śur āśliṣṭa urasi vastre bāhau vā taṃ juhoti /
meaning: देवाम्̐शो यस्मै त्वेडे तत् सत्यम् अपरिप्लुता भङ्ग्येन \ हतो ऽसौ फट् \\ इति यो ऽस्याम्̐शुर् आश्लिष्ट उरसि वस्त्रे बाहौ वा तं जुहोति /
text_mt: With: 'Divine shoot, the truth for which I praise you is undisturbed by breaking; slain is so-and-so, phaṭ!', he offers whichever shoot of his has adhered to his chest, garment, or arm.

sanskrit_iast: mahābhiṣavāya paryupaviśante purastād adhvaryur dakṣiṇataḥ pratiprasthātā paścān neṣṭottarata unnetā /
meaning: महाभिषवाय पर्युपविशन्ते पुरस्ताद् अध्वर्युर् दक्षिणतः प्रतिप्रस्थाता पश्चान् नेष्टोत्तरत उन्नेता /
text_mt: For the great pressing they sit around: the adhvaryu on the east, the pratiprasthātā on the south, the neṣṭṛ on the west, [and] the unnetṛ on the north.

sanskrit_iast: rājānam apādatte yāvantaṃ prātaḥsavanāyāptaṃ manyate pratyupanahyetaraṃ nidadhāti tam upare nyupya \\ uśik tvaṃ deva soma \\ iti ye 'dābhyā am̐śavas teṣām ekaikam anusavanam apisṛjati yat te somādābhyaṃ nāma jāgṛvi \\ iti copām̐śupāvanānāṃ dvaudvau /
meaning: राजानम् अपादत्ते यावन्तं प्रातःसवनायाप्तं मन्यते प्रत्युपनह्येतरं निदधाति तम् उपरे न्युप्य \\ उशिक् त्वं देव सोम \\ इति ये ऽदाभ्या अम्̐शवस् तेषाम् एकैकम् अनुसवनम् अपिसृजति यत् ते सोमादाभ्यं नाम जागृवि \\ इति चोपाम्̐शुपावनानां द्वौद्वौ /
text_mt: He takes up King [Soma] as much as he thinks sufficient for the morning pressing; having tied up the other portion, he puts it down; having scattered it upon the lower pressing stone, with: 'Desirous are you, divine Soma', he adds one of the adābhya shoots at each pressing, and with: 'What name of yours, O Soma, is undeceived, watchful', two of the upāṃśusavana shoots each.

sanskrit_iast: tān upare nyupya vasatīvarībhir upasṛjya dakṣiṇaiḥ pāṇibhir grāvabhir yathārtham abhiṣutya nigrābham upayanti yathā purastāt /
meaning: तान् उपरे न्युप्य वसतीवरीभिर् उपसृज्य दक्षिणैः पाणिभिर् ग्रावभिर् यथार्थम् अभिषुत्य निग्राभम् उपयन्ति यथा पुरस्तात् /
text_mt: Having scattered them upon the lower pressing stone, having moistened them with the vasatīvarī waters, having pressed as appropriate with the stones held in their right hands, they perform the nigrābha as before.

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ vihito dvitīyas tṛtīyaś cābhiṣavaḥ /
meaning: एवं विहितो द्वितीयस् तृतीयश् चाभिषवः /
text_mt: In this manner the second and third pressings are prescribed.

sanskrit_iast: trirabhiṣutam̐ rājānam ādhavanīye sam̐siñcanti /
meaning: त्रिरभिषुतम्̐ राजानम् आधवनीये सम्̐सिञ्चन्ति /
text_mt: They pour the thrice-pressed King [Soma] into the ādhavanīya vessel.

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ vihito dvitīyas tṛtīyaś ca paryāyaḥ /
meaning: एवं विहितो द्वितीयस् तृतीयश् च पर्यायः /
text_mt: In this manner the second and third rounds are prescribed.

sanskrit_iast: uttame 'bhiṣave susaṃbhṛtam̐ rājānaṃ kṛtvā pavitreṇa prapīḍyopare grāvṇaḥ saṃmukhān kṛtvā tebhya ṛjīṣaṃ vyapohati /
meaning: उत्तमे ऽभिषवे सुसंभृतम्̐ राजानं कृत्वा पवित्रेण प्रपीड्योपरे ग्राव्णः संमुखान् कृत्वा तेभ्य ऋजीषं व्यपोहति /
text_mt: At the final pressing, having well collected King [Soma], having squeezed it through the strainer, having placed the pressing stones face to face upon the lower pressing stone, he clears the soma residue from them.

sanskrit_iast: ṛjīṣamukhān karoti /
meaning: ऋजीषमुखान् करोति /

sanskrit_iast: prāñcam udgātāro droṇakalaśaṃ grāvasv adhyūhanti /
meaning: प्राञ्चम् उद्गातारो द्रोणकलशं ग्रावस्व् अध्यूहन्ति /
text_mt: The udgātṛs place the droṇakalaśa trough facing east upon the pressing stones.

sanskrit_iast: adhokṣam upakarṣanti /
meaning: अधोक्षम् उपकर्षन्ति /

sanskrit_iast: pavitraṃ te vitataṃ brahmaṇaspate \ prabhur gātrāṇi paryeṣi viśvataḥ / \ ataptatanūr na tad āmo aśnute \ śṛtāsa id vahantas tat samāśata \\ iti tasminn udīcīnadaśaṃ pavitram udgātāro vitatya dhārayanti /
meaning: पवित्रं ते विततं ब्रह्मणस्पते \ प्रभुर् गात्राणि पर्येषि विश्वतः / \ अतप्ततनूर् न तद् आमो अश्नुते \ शृतास इद् वहन्तस् तत् समाशत \\ इति तस्मिन्न् उदीचीनदशं पवित्रम् उद्गातारो वितत्य धारयन्ति /
text_mt: With: 'Your strainer is stretched out, O Brahmaṇaspati; powerful, you encompass the limbs from every side; one whose body is unheated, raw, does not attain it; only the matured, bearing it, have fully attained it', the udgātṛs hold the strainer stretched out in it with its fringe pointing north.

sanskrit_iast: etayaivādhvaryur abhimantrayate /
meaning: एतयैवाध्वर्युर् अभिमन्त्रयते /
text_mt: With this very [verse] the adhvaryu consecrates it.

sanskrit_iast: tasya yajamāno nābhiṃ karoti /
meaning: तस्य यजमानो नाभिं करोति /
text_mt: The sacrificer forms its navel.

sanskrit_iast: hotṛcamasena cāsmin saṃtatāṃ dhārām̐ srāvayati /
meaning: होतृचमसेन चास्मिन् संततां धाराम्̐ स्रावयति /
text_mt: And with the hotṛ's cup, he causes a continuous stream to flow into it.

sanskrit_iast: ādhavanīyād unnetodañcanena hotṛcamasa ānayati /
meaning: आधवनीयाद् उन्नेतोदञ्चनेन होतृचमस आनयति /
text_mt: With a ladle the unnetṛ brings [soma] from the ādhavanīya vessel into the hotṛ's cup.

sanskrit_iast: sravatyā dhārāyā grahān gṛhṇāti /
meaning: स्रवत्या धाराया ग्रहान् गृह्णाति /
text_mt: From the flowing stream he draws the cups.

sanskrit_iast: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \\ antar yaccha \\ ity antaryāmam /
meaning: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \\ अन्तर् यच्छ \\ इत्य् अन्तर्यामम् /
text_mt: He draws the antaryāma cup with: 'You are taken with a base; hold within!'

sanskrit_iast: tasyopām̐śunā kalpo vyākhyātaḥ /
meaning: तस्योपाम्̐शुना कल्पो व्याख्यातः /
text_mt: Its procedure is explained by [that of] the upāṃśu cup.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇena hotāram atikramya vāk tvāṣṭu \\ iti dakṣiṇaṃ paridhisaṃdhim anvavatiṣṭhate dakṣiṇaṃ paridhisaṃdhim anvavahṛtya svāhā tvā subhavaḥ sūryāya \\ iti prāñcam udañcam ṛjuṃ dīrtham̐ saṃtataṃ juhoti /
meaning: दक्षिणेन होतारम् अतिक्रम्य वाक् त्वाष्टु \\ इति दक्षिणं परिधिसंधिम् अन्ववतिष्ठते दक्षिणं परिधिसंधिम् अन्ववहृत्य स्वाहा त्वा सुभवः सूर्याय \\ इति प्राञ्चम् उदञ्चम् ऋजुं दीर्थम्̐ संततं जुहोति /
text_mt: Having stepped past the hotṛ to the south, he stands along the southern junction of the enclosing sticks with: 'May speech fashion you!'; having brought it down along the southern junction of the enclosing sticks, he offers it in a continuous, straight, long stream directed east and north, with: 'Hail to you, good-natured one, for Sūrya!'

sanskrit_iast: na paridhau lepaṃ nimārṣṭi nāgrayaṇasthālyām̐ saṃpātam avanayati /
meaning: न परिधौ लेपं निमार्ष्टि नाग्रयणस्थाल्याम्̐ संपातम् अवनयति /
text_mt: He does not wipe off the residue on an enclosing stick, nor does he pour the residue into the āgrayaṇa vessel.

sanskrit_iast: eṣa te yonir \ apānāya tvā \\ iti pātram̐ sādayati /
meaning: एष ते योनिर् \ अपानाय त्वा \\ इति पात्रम्̐ सादयति /
text_mt: He deposits the cup with: 'This is your womb; for down-breath, you!'

sanskrit_iast: nām̐śum avadadhāti /
meaning: नाम्̐शुम् अवदधाति /

sanskrit_iast: te antareṇa vyānāya tvā \\ ity upām̐śusavanaṃ grāvāṇam̐ sam̐spṛṣṭam upām̐śupātreṇa sādayati /
meaning: ते अन्तरेण व्यानाय त्वा \\ इत्य् उपाम्̐शुसवनं ग्रावाणम्̐ सम्̐स्पृष्टम् उपाम्̐शुपात्रेण सादयति /
text_mt: Between them he deposits the upāṃśusavana stone touching the upāṃśu cup, with: 'For diffused breath, you!'

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ kāmayeta pramāyukaḥ syād ity asam̐spṛṣṭau tasya sādayed yaṃ kāmayeta sarvam āyur iyād iti sam̐spṛṣṭau tasya sādayet /
meaning: यं कामयेत प्रमायुकः स्याद् इत्य् असम्̐स्पृष्टौ तस्य सादयेद् यं कामयेत सर्वम् आयुर् इयाद् इति सम्̐स्पृष्टौ तस्य सादयेत् /
text_mt: For one whom he wishes should die prematurely, he should deposit the two not touching; for one whom he wishes should live a full lifespan, he should deposit the two touching.

sanskrit_iast: ubhāv udite juhoty atvaramāṇaḥ /
meaning: उभाव् उदिते जुहोत्य् अत्वरमाणः /
text_mt: Not hurrying, he offers both after [the sun] has risen.

sanskrit_iast: tvaramāṇas tv anudita upāṃśum udite 'ntaryāmam /
meaning: त्वरमाणस् त्व् अनुदित उपांशुम् उदिते ऽन्तर्यामम् /
text_mt: Hurrying, however, [he offers] the upāṃśu before sunrise [and] the antaryāma after sunrise.

sanskrit_iast: ubhāv anudita ity ekeṣām //
meaning: उभाव् अनुदित इत्य् एकेषाम् //
text_mt: 'Both before sunrise', according to some [teachers].

sanskrit_iast: rathaṃtarasāmny aindravāyavāgrān gṛhṇīyāt /
meaning: रथंतरसाम्न्य् ऐन्द्रवायवाग्रान् गृह्णीयात् /
text_mt: At a sacrifice having the Rathaṃtara-sāman, he should draw the cups beginning with the aindravāyava.

sanskrit_iast: bṛhatsāmni śukrāgrān /
meaning: बृहत्साम्नि शुक्राग्रान् /

sanskrit_iast: ubhayasāmni yāthākāmī /
meaning: उभयसाम्नि याथाकामी /
text_mt: At one having both sāmans, as he pleases.

sanskrit_iast: aindravāyavān gṛhṇīyād vaikārike pṛṣṭhasaṃyoge /
meaning: ऐन्द्रवायवान् गृह्णीयाद् वैकारिके पृष्ठसंयोगे /
text_mt: He should draw the aindravāyava cups at a modified combination of pṛṣṭha stotras.

sanskrit_iast: aindravāyavāgrāñ jyeṣṭhabandhur gṛhṇīteti nitye kāmye /
meaning: ऐन्द्रवायवाग्राञ् ज्येष्ठबन्धुर् गृह्णीतेति नित्ये काम्ये /
text_mt: 'One who has eldest brothers should draw those beginning with the aindravāyava'—[such are] optional [rules] in the regular [rite].

sanskrit_iast: aindravāyavāgrān gṛhṇīyād āmayāvina iti brāhmaṇavyākhyātāni kāmyāni grahaṇāni teṣāṃ yāthākāmī /
meaning: ऐन्द्रवायवाग्रान् गृह्णीयाद् आमयाविन इति ब्राह्मणव्याख्यातानि काम्यानि ग्रहणानि तेषां याथाकामी /
text_mt: 'One who is diseased should draw those beginning with the aindravāyava'—the optional drawings are explained by the Brāhmaṇa; among them [he acts] as he pleases.

sanskrit_iast: purastād aindravāyavād gṛhyante sanne sādyante /
meaning: पुरस्ताद् ऐन्द्रवायवाद् गृह्यन्ते सन्ने साद्यन्ते /
text_mt: They are drawn before the aindravāyava cup; when it is deposited, they are deposited.

sanskrit_iast: aindravāyavaṃ gṛhṇāti /
meaning: ऐन्द्रवायवं गृह्णाति /
text_mt: He draws the aindravāyava cup.

sanskrit_iast: ā vāyo bhūṣa \\ ity anudrutya pātram upayacchati \\ upayāmagṛhīto 'si \ vāyave tvā \\ iti tasmin gṛhṇāti /
meaning: आ वायो भूष \\ इत्य् अनुद्रुत्य पात्रम् उपयच्छति \\ उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \ वायवे त्वा \\ इति तस्मिन् गृह्णाति /
text_mt: Having recited: 'Come, O Vāyu, adorn...', he holds the cup under; he draws into it with: 'You are taken with a base; for Vāyu, you!'

sanskrit_iast: pātram apayamya \\ indravāyū ity anudrutya punar evopayacchati \\ upayāmagṛhīto 'si \\ indravāyubhyāṃ tvā \\ iti tasmin punar gṛhṇāti /
meaning: पात्रम् अपयम्य \\ इन्द्रवायू इत्य् अनुद्रुत्य पुनर् एवोपयच्छति \\ उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \\ इन्द्रवायुभ्यां त्वा \\ इति तस्मिन् पुनर् गृह्णाति /
text_mt: Having moved the cup away, having recited: 'O Indra and Vāyu...', he again holds it under; he draws into it again with: 'You are taken with a base; for Indra and Vāyu, you!'

sanskrit_iast: yad avyāpṛtaṃ pavitraṃ tena parimṛjya \\ eṣa te yoniḥ \ sajoṣābhyāṃ tvā \\ ity āyatane sādayati /
meaning: यद् अव्यापृतं पवित्रं तेन परिमृज्य \\ एष ते योनिः \ सजोषाभ्यां त्वा \\ इत्य् आयतने सादयति /
text_mt: Having wiped it with the strainer that is not in use, he deposits it in its place with: 'This is your womb; for the two closely associated ones, you!'

sanskrit_iast: purastādupayāmā yajuṣā gṛhyanta upariṣṭādupayāmā ṛcā /
meaning: पुरस्तादुपयामा यजुषा गृह्यन्त उपरिष्टादुपयामा ऋचा /
text_mt: Those with the upayāma formula at the beginning are drawn with a Yajus; those with the upayāma formula at the end are drawn with a Ṛc.

sanskrit_iast: sarvagrahāṇāṃ parimārjanaṃ yathāyonisādanaṃ ca /
meaning: सर्वग्रहाणां परिमार्जनं यथायोनिसादनं च /
text_mt: For all cups, there is wiping clean and placing in their respective places.

sanskrit_iast: ayaṃ vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā \\ iti maitrāvaruṇam \\ rāyā vayam̐ sasavām̐so madema \ havyena devā yavasena gāvaḥ / \ tāṃ dhenuṃ mitrāvaruṇā yuvaṃ nas \\ viśvāhā dhattam anapasphurantīm iti tam̐ śṛtaśītena payasā śrītvā sādayati /
meaning: अयं वां मित्रावरुणा \\ इति मैत्रावरुणम् \\ राया वयम्̐ ससवाम्̐सो मदेम \ हव्येन देवा यवसेन गावः / \ तां धेनुं मित्रावरुणा युवं नस् \\ विश्वाहा धत्तम् अनपस्फुरन्तीम् इति तम्̐ शृतशीतेन पयसा श्रीत्वा सादयति /
text_mt: With the mantra: “This is for you both, O Mitra and Varuṇa…”, he draws the cup for Mitra and Varuṇa. Having mixed it with boiled milk that has cooled down, with the verse: “May we rejoice, having won wealth; may the gods rejoice with the oblation, the cattle with grass; O Mitra and Varuṇa, bestow upon us that cow, giving milk every day, unresisting”, he sets it down.

sanskrit_iast: ayaṃ venas \\ iti śukram̐ hiraṇyena śrīṇāti /
meaning: अयं वेनस् \\ इति शुक्रम्̐ हिरण्येन श्रीणाति /
text_mt: With: “This longing bird…”, he mixes the Śukra cup with gold.

sanskrit_iast: taṃ pratnathā \\ iti manthinam /
meaning: तं प्रत्नथा \\ इति मन्थिनम् /
text_mt: With: “Him in the ancient manner…”, he draws the Manthin cup.

sanskrit_iast: mano na yeṣu havaneṣu juhvat \\ vipaḥ śacyā vanutho dravantā / \ ā yaḥ śaryābhis tuvinṛmṇo asya \\ aśrīṇītādiśaṃ gabhastau \\ iti saktubhir manthinam̐ śrīṇāty ātmānam anabhidhvam̐sayann itarām̐ś ca grahān /
meaning: मनो न येषु हवनेषु जुह्वत् \\ विपः शच्या वनुथो द्रवन्ता / \ आ यः शर्याभिस् तुविनृम्णो अस्य \\ अश्रीणीतादिशं गभस्तौ \\ इति सक्तुभिर् मन्थिनम्̐ श्रीणात्य् आत्मानम् अनभिध्वम्̐सयन्न् इतराम्̐श् च ग्रहान् /
text_mt: With: “Mind-like, when offering at those invocations, you two, running, win wisdom by your skill; he who, of great might, mixed his arrow with reed shafts in his hand…”, he mixes the Manthin cup with barley meal, without scattering it upon himself and the other cups.

sanskrit_iast: ye devā divy ekādaśa stha \\ iti sthālyāgrayaṇam āgrayaṇo 'si \\ iti vā purastādupayāmena yajuṣā /
meaning: ये देवा दिव्य् एकादश स्थ \\ इति स्थाल्याग्रयणम् आग्रयणो ऽसि \\ इति वा पुरस्तादुपयामेन यजुषा /
text_mt: With the verse: “O gods who are eleven in the sky…”, using a pot, he draws the Āgrayaṇa cup; or with the Yajus having the upayāma at the beginning: “You are the Āgrayaṇa…”.

sanskrit_iast: dvābhyāṃ dhārābhyāṃ gṛhṇāti /
meaning: द्वाभ्यां धाराभ्यां गृह्णाति /
text_mt: He draws it in two continuous streams.

sanskrit_iast: ya āgrayaṇasthālyām̐ somas tasyaikadeśam anyasmin pātre niṣicya dvitīyāṃ dhārāṃ karoti /
meaning: य आग्रयणस्थाल्याम्̐ सोमस् तस्यैकदेशम् अन्यस्मिन् पात्रे निषिच्य द्वितीयां धारां करोति /
text_mt: Having poured a portion of the soma that is in the Āgrayaṇa pot into another vessel, he makes the second stream.

sanskrit_iast: vidad yatī saramā rugṇam adres \\ mahi pāthaḥ pūrvyam̐ sadhriyak kaḥ / \ agraṃ nayat supady akṣarāṇām \ acchā ravaṃ prathamā jānatī gāt \\ iti purorucam abhicarataḥ kuryāt /
meaning: विदद् यती सरमा रुग्णम् अद्रेस् \\ महि पाथः पूर्व्यम्̐ सध्रियक् कः / \ अग्रं नयत् सुपद्य् अक्षराणाम् \ अच्छा रवं प्रथमा जानती गात् \\ इति पुरोरुचम् अभिचरतः कुर्यात् /
text_mt: For one who is practicing sorcery, he should use the puroruc: “Finding the broken [opening] of the rock, Saramā going forward made great food united from of old; fleet of foot, first knowing, she went toward the roar to lead the front of the syllables”.

sanskrit_iast: trim̐śat trayaś ca \\ iti bhrātṛvyavataḥ /
meaning: त्रिम्̐शत् त्रयश् च \\ इति भ्रातृव्यवतः /
text_mt: For one who has a rival: “And the thirty-three…”.

sanskrit_iast: āgrayaṇaṃ gṛhītvā him iti trir hiṃkaroti śanair agre 'thoccair atha sūccaiḥ somaḥ pavate \\ iti trir āha śanair agre 'thoccair atha sūccaiḥ //
meaning: आग्रयणं गृहीत्वा हिम् इति त्रिर् हिंकरोति शनैर् अग्रे ऽथोच्चैर् अथ सूच्चैः सोमः पवते \\ इति त्रिर् आह शनैर् अग्रे ऽथोच्चैर् अथ सूच्चैः //
text_mt: Having drawn the Āgrayaṇa cup, he makes the sound “him” thrice: softly at first, then loudly, then very loudly. Thrice he says: “The soma purifies itself”: softly at first, then loudly, then very loudly.

sanskrit_iast: asmai brahmaṇe pavate \\ asmai kṣatrāya pavate \\ asmai sunvate yajamānāya pavate \\ iṣa ūrje pavate \\ dbhya oṣadhībhyaḥ pavate \ vanaspatibhyaḥ pavate \ dyāvāpṛthivībhyāṃ pavate \ subhūtāya pavate \ brahmavarcasāya pavate \ yajamānāya pavate \ mahyaṃ jyaiṣṭhyāya pavate \\ iti somam abhimantrya vācaṃ visṛjate /
meaning: अस्मै ब्रह्मणे पवते \\ अस्मै क्षत्राय पवते \\ अस्मै सुन्वते यजमानाय पवते \\ इष ऊर्जे पवते \\ द्भ्य ओषधीभ्यः पवते \ वनस्पतिभ्यः पवते \ द्यावापृथिवीभ्यां पवते \ सुभूताय पवते \ ब्रह्मवर्चसाय पवते \ यजमानाय पवते \ मह्यं ज्यैष्ठ्याय पवते \\ इति सोमम् अभिमन्त्र्य वाचं विसृजते /
text_mt: With the mantras: “It purifies itself for this spiritual power; it purifies itself for this royal power; it purifies itself for this sacrificer pressing [the soma]; it purifies itself for food and sap; it purifies itself for the waters and the plants; it purifies itself for the trees; it purifies itself for heaven and earth; it purifies itself for prosperity; it purifies itself for holy luster; it purifies itself for the sacrificer; it purifies itself for my supremacy”, having addressed the soma with mantras, he releases his speech.

sanskrit_iast: atigrāhyān gṛhṇāti /
meaning: अतिग्राह्यान् गृह्णाति /

sanskrit_iast: agna āyūm̐ṣi pavase \\ ity āgneyam uttiṣṭhann ojasā sahā \\ ity aindraṃ taraṇir viśvadarśatas \\ iti sauryam /
meaning: अग्न आयूम्̐षि पवसे \\ इत्य् आग्नेयम् उत्तिष्ठन्न् ओजसा सहा \\ इत्य् ऐन्द्रं तरणिर् विश्वदर्शतस् \\ इति सौर्यम् /
text_mt: Standing up, with: “O Agni, you purify our life-spans…”, he draws the cup for Agni; with: “Together with might…”, the cup for Indra; with: “Swift, visible to all…”, the cup for Sūrya.

sanskrit_iast: ojas tad asya titviṣe \\ ubhe yat samavartayat / \ indraś carmeva rodasī / \ adṛśram asya ketavas \\ vi raśmayo janām̐ anu / \ bhrājanto agnayo yathā \\ iti vaitābhyām /
meaning: ओजस् तद् अस्य तित्विषे \\ उभे यत् समवर्तयत् / \ इन्द्रश् चर्मेव रोदसी / \ अदृश्रम् अस्य केतवस् \\ वि रश्मयो जनाम्̐ अनु / \ भ्राजन्तो अग्नयो यथा \\ इति वैताभ्याम् /
text_mt: Or, with these two [verses]: “His might was stirred up when he rolled together both the worlds, Indra [stretched them] like a hide”, and “His rays have appeared, his beams across the peoples, shining like fires”.

sanskrit_iast: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \\ indrāya tvā bṛhadvate vayasvata ukthyāyuve \\ iti sthālyokthyam /
meaning: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \\ इन्द्राय त्वा बृहद्वते वयस्वत उक्थ्यायुवे \\ इति स्थाल्योक्थ्यम् /
text_mt: With: “You are taken with a support; for Indra, the mighty, possessed of vigor, longing for the Ukthya, I take you”, he draws the Ukthya cup by means of the pot.

sanskrit_iast: mūrdhānaṃ divo aratiṃ pṛthivyās \\ iti sthālyā dhruvam /
meaning: मूर्धानं दिवो अरतिं पृथिव्यास् \\ इति स्थाल्या ध्रुवम् /
text_mt: With: “Head of heaven, chariot-spoke of the earth…”, he draws the Dhruva cup by means of the pot.

sanskrit_iast: dhruvo 'si \\ iti vā purastādupayāmena yajuṣā /
meaning: ध्रुवो ऽसि \\ इति वा पुरस्तादुपयामेन यजुषा /
text_mt: Or with the Yajus having the upayāma at the beginning: “You are firm…”.

sanskrit_iast: pūrṇam /
meaning: पूर्णम् /

sanskrit_iast: dveṣyasyonam /
meaning: द्वेष्यस्योनम् /

sanskrit_iast: hiraṇye sādayaty āyuṣkāmasya /
meaning: हिरण्ये सादयत्य् आयुष्कामस्य /
text_mt: For one who desires life, he sets it down upon a piece of gold.

sanskrit_iast: taṃ dakṣiṇe havirdhāna āsīno rājaputro gopāyati /
meaning: तं दक्षिणे हविर्धान आसीनो राजपुत्रो गोपायति /
text_mt: A prince seated in the southern havirdhāna shed guards it.

sanskrit_iast: sarvān pūrṇān vṛṣṭikāmasya grahān gṛhṇīyāt /
meaning: सर्वान् पूर्णान् वृष्टिकामस्य ग्रहान् गृह्णीयात् /
text_mt: For one who desires rain, he should draw all the cups full.

sanskrit_iast: yadi kāmayeta yo grāme taṃ grāmān nirūhyeyaṃ yo bahir grāmāt taṃ grāme kuryām iti \\ idam aham amum āmuṣyāyaṇam amuṣyāḥ putram amuṣyā viśa utkhidāmi \\ iti dhruvam utkhidya \\ idam aham amum āmuṣyāyaṇam amuṣyāḥ putram amuṣyāṃ viśi sādayāmi \\ iti taṃ punaḥ sādayed ya eva grāme taṃ grāmān nirūhya yo bahir grāmāt taṃ grāme karoti /
meaning: यदि कामयेत यो ग्रामे तं ग्रामान् निरूह्येयं यो बहिर् ग्रामात् तं ग्रामे कुर्याम् इति \\ इदम् अहम् अमुम् आमुष्यायणम् अमुष्याः पुत्रम् अमुष्या विश उत्खिदामि \\ इति ध्रुवम् उत्खिद्य \\ इदम् अहम् अमुम् आमुष्यायणम् अमुष्याः पुत्रम् अमुष्यां विशि सादयामि \\ इति तं पुनः सादयेद् य एव ग्रामे तं ग्रामान् निरूह्य यो बहिर् ग्रामात् तं ग्रामे करोति /
text_mt: If he should desire: “May I expel him who is in the village from the village, and him who is outside the village may I put into the village”, having lifted the Dhruva cup with the formula: “Here do I tear away so-and-so, of such-and-such lineage, the son of such-and-such woman, from such-and-such clan”, he should set it down again with the formula: “Here do I settle so-and-so, of such-and-such lineage, the son of such-and-such woman, in such-and-such clan”. Thus, having expelled him who is in the village from the village, he puts him who is outside the village into the village.

sanskrit_iast: dhruvam̐ sādayitvā rājānam atipāvayati yāvantaṃ prātaḥsavanāyāptaṃ manyate /
meaning: ध्रुवम्̐ सादयित्वा राजानम् अतिपावयति यावन्तं प्रातःसवनायाप्तं मन्यते /
text_mt: Having set down the Dhruva cup, he strains further so much of king [soma] as he considers sufficient for the morning pressing.

sanskrit_iast: viramati dhārā prapīḍya pavitraṃ nidadhāti /
meaning: विरमति धारा प्रपीड्य पवित्रं निदधाति /
text_mt: The stream ceases; having pressed out the strainer, he sets it down.

sanskrit_iast: maitrāvaruṇacamasīyāś caikadhanaikadeśām̐ś cādhavanīye 'vanīya tiraḥpavitraṃ pūtabhṛty ekadeśam avanayati /
meaning: मैत्रावरुणचमसीयाश् चैकधनैकदेशाम्̐श् चाधवनीये ऽवनीय तिरःपवित्रं पूतभृत्य् एकदेशम् अवनयति /
text_mt: Having poured the soma meant for the Maitrāvaruṇa’s cup and a portion of the Ekadhana waters into the Ādhavanīya vessel, he pours a portion into the Pūtabhṛt vessel through the strainer.

sanskrit_iast: ata ūrdhvaṃ pūtabhṛti tiraḥpavitram evāvanīyate /
meaning: अत ऊर्ध्वं पूतभृति तिरःपवित्रम् एवावनीयते /
text_mt: Henceforward, it is poured into the Pūtabhṛt vessel only through the strainer.

sanskrit_iast: pavamānagrahān gṛhṇāti /
meaning: पवमानग्रहान् गृह्णाति /
text_mt: He draws the Pavamāna cups.

sanskrit_iast: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \ prajāpataye tvā \\ iti droṇakalaśam abhimṛśet \\ indrāya tvā \\ ity ādhavanīyaṃ viśvebhyas tvā devebhyas \\ iti pūtabhṛtam /
meaning: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \ प्रजापतये त्वा \\ इति द्रोणकलशम् अभिमृशेत् \\ इन्द्राय त्वा \\ इत्य् आधवनीयं विश्वेभ्यस् त्वा देवेभ्यस् \\ इति पूतभृतम् /
text_mt: With: “You are taken with a support; for Prajāpati I take you”, he touches the Droṇakalaśa; with: “For Indra I take you”, the Ādhavanīya; with: “For the All-Gods I take you”, the Pūtabhṛt.

sanskrit_iast: niḥsarpantaḥ samanvārabhante //
meaning: निःसर्पन्तः समन्वारभन्ते //
text_mt: Creeping out, they hold on to one another from behind.

sanskrit_iast: adhvaryuṃ prastotānvārabhate prastotāraṃ pratihartā pratihartāram udgātodgātāraṃ brahmā brahmāṇaṃ yajamāno yajamānaṃ brahmety ekeṣām /
meaning: अध्वर्युं प्रस्तोतान्वारभते प्रस्तोतारं प्रतिहर्ता प्रतिहर्तारम् उद्गातोद्गातारं ब्रह्मा ब्रह्माणं यजमानो यजमानं ब्रह्मेत्य् एकेषाम् /
text_mt: The prastotṛ holds on to the adhvaryu; the pratihartṛ to the prastotṛ; the udgātṛ to the pratihartṛ; the brahman priest to the udgātṛ; the sacrificer to the brahman priest; or according to some, the brahman priest to the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast: niḥsṛpya yas te drapsaḥ skandati \\ iti tisro yas te drapsaḥ skandati yas te am̐śuḥ \ svaḥ paraś ca yo divaḥ puraḥ / \ ayaṃ devo bṛhaspatiḥ \ saṃ tat siñcatu rādhasā \\ iti vaipruṣān saptahotāraṃ ca hutvodañcaḥ prahvā bahiṣpavamānāya sarpanti /
meaning: निःसृप्य यस् ते द्रप्सः स्कन्दति \\ इति तिस्रो यस् ते द्रप्सः स्कन्दति यस् ते अम्̐शुः \ स्वः परश् च यो दिवः पुरः / \ अयं देवो बृहस्पतिः \ सं तत् सिञ्चतु राधसा \\ इति वैप्रुषान् सप्तहोतारं च हुत्वोदञ्चः प्रह्वा बहिष्पवमानाय सर्पन्ति /
text_mt: Having crept out, having offered the three drops-oblations with: “Whatever drop of yours falls down…”, and the Saptahotṛ formula, or with the verse: “Whatever drop of yours falls down, whatever stalk of yours, from the front of heaven and what is beyond the sky; may this divine Bṛhaspati unite that through his bounty”, bent forward facing north, they creep forward for the Bahiṣpavamāna hymn.

sanskrit_iast: gāyatraḥ panthās \\ vasavo devatā \\ avṛkeṇāparipareṇa pathā svasti vasūn aśīya / \ vāg agregā agra etv ṛjugās \\ ity adhvaryuḥ pūrvo barhirmuṣṭim īṣad iva vidhūnvan sarpati /
meaning: गायत्रः पन्थास् \\ वसवो देवता \\ अवृकेणापरिपरेण पथा स्वस्ति वसून् अशीय / \ वाग् अग्रेगा अग्र एत्व् ऋजुगास् \\ इत्य् अध्वर्युः पूर्वो बर्हिर्मुष्टिम् ईषद् इव विधून्वन् सर्पति /
text_mt: With: “The path belongs to the Gāyatrī, the Vasus are the deities; may I safely reach the Vasus by a path free from wolves and free from danger; let Speech, leading the front, go at the front, walking straight”, the adhvaryu, being the foremost, creeps while gently shaking a handful of sacred grass.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇena cātvālam upaviśyāntarvedi cātvālam avekṣamāṇā bahiṣpavamānena stuvate /
meaning: दक्षिणेन चात्वालम् उपविश्यान्तर्वेदि चात्वालम् अवेक्षमाणा बहिष्पवमानेन स्तुवते /
text_mt: Having sat down to the south of the pit, looking at the pit within the sacrificial enclosure, they chant the Bahiṣpavamāna hymn.

sanskrit_iast: vāyur hiṃkartā \\ iti prastotre barhirmuṣṭiṃ prayacchan stotram upākaroti \\ asarjy asarji \ vāg asarji \\ aindram̐ saho 'sarji \\ upāvartadhvam \ abhisarpa yajamāna \\ iti /
meaning: वायुर् हिंकर्ता \\ इति प्रस्तोत्रे बर्हिर्मुष्टिं प्रयच्छन् स्तोत्रम् उपाकरोति \\ असर्ज्य् असर्जि \ वाग् असर्जि \\ ऐन्द्रम्̐ सहो ऽसर्जि \\ उपावर्तध्वम् \ अभिसर्प यजमान \\ इति /
text_mt: Saying: “Vāyu is the one who makes the sound ‘him’”, handing over the handful of sacred grass to the prastotṛ, he brings about the chant: “It has been released, it has been released! Speech has been released! Indra’s might has been released! Turn toward [it]! Creep forward, O sacrificer!”

sanskrit_iast: sarvān pavamānān evam /
meaning: सर्वान् पवमानान् एवम् /

sanskrit_iast: upāvartadhvam iti barhirbhyām itarāṇi stotrāṇi /
meaning: उपावर्तध्वम् इति बर्हिर्भ्याम् इतराणि स्तोत्राणि /
text_mt: For the other chants, [he introduces them] with two blades of sacred grass, saying: “Turn toward [it]”.

sanskrit_iast: stūyamānaṃ bahiṣpavamānaṃ brāhmaṇāḥ samabhisarpanti dveṣyaṃ paribādhante //
meaning: स्तूयमानं बहिष्पवमानं ब्राह्मणाः समभिसर्पन्ति द्वेष्यं परिबाधन्ते //
text_mt: While the Bahiṣpavamāna is being chanted, Brahmins creep close together; they ward off the hated enemy.

sanskrit_iast: agnīd agnīn vihara \ barhiḥ stṛṇāhi \ puroḍāśām̐ alaṃkuru \ pratiprasthātaḥ paśunehi \\ iti stuta uttiṣṭhan saṃpreṣyati /
meaning: अग्नीद् अग्नीन् विहर \ बर्हिः स्तृणाहि \ पुरोडाशाम्̐ अलंकुरु \ प्रतिप्रस्थातः पशुनेहि \\ इति स्तुत उत्तिष्ठन् संप्रेष्यति /
text_mt: When the hymn has been chanted, rising up, he gives the ritual directions: “O Agnīdh, distribute the fires; spread the sacred grass; garnish the sacrificial cakes; O Pratiprasthātṛ, come with the animal oblation”.

sanskrit_iast: havirdhāne praviśya viṣṇo tvaṃ no antamas \\ iti grahān upatiṣṭhate pātrāṇi ca saṃmṛśati /
meaning: हविर्धाने प्रविश्य विष्णो त्वं नो अन्तमस् \\ इति ग्रहान् उपतिष्ठते पात्राणि च संमृशति /
text_mt: Entering the havirdhāna shed, he waits upon the cups with the formula: “O Viṣṇu, you are nearest to us…”, and touches the vessels.

sanskrit_iast: āgnīdhrīyād āgnīdhro 'ṅgārān āhṛtya tair eva mantrair yathānyuptaṃ dhiṣṇiyān viharati /
meaning: आग्नीध्रीयाद् आग्नीध्रो ऽङ्गारान् आहृत्य तैर् एव मन्त्रैर् यथान्युप्तं धिष्णियान् विहरति /
text_mt: The Āgnīdhra priest, having brought embers from the Āgnīdhra hearth, distributes them over the dhiṣṇya hearths with the same mantras according to their placement.

sanskrit_iast: adhvaryuś catuś camase rājānaṃ gṛhītvā pañcagṛhītaṃ cājyaṃ purastāt pratyaṅṅ āsīnas tair eva mantrai yathānyuptaṃ dhiṣṇiyān vyāghārayati /
meaning: अध्वर्युश् चतुश् चमसे राजानं गृहीत्वा पञ्चगृहीतं चाज्यं पुरस्तात् प्रत्यङ्ङ् आसीनस् तैर् एव मन्त्रै यथान्युप्तं धिष्णियान् व्याघारयति /
text_mt: The adhvaryu, taking the king [soma] four times into the cup and clarified butter taken five times [into the ladle], sitting in front facing west, pours libations across the dhiṣṇya hearths with the same mantras according to their placement.

sanskrit_iast: somenāhavanīyam āgnīdhrīyam̐ hotrīyaṃ mārjālīyaṃ cājyenetarān /
meaning: सोमेनाहवनीयम् आग्नीध्रीयम्̐ होत्रीयं मार्जालीयं चाज्येनेतरान् /
text_mt: With soma, [he pours libations on] the āhavanīya, the Āgnīdhra, the Hotṛ's hearth, and the Mārjālīya hearth; with clarified butter, on the others.

sanskrit_iast: atihāya vaṣaṭkaroti /
meaning: अतिहाय वषट्करोति /

sanskrit_iast: vyākhyātaḥ somasya bhakṣaḥ /
meaning: व्याख्यातः सोमस्य भक्षः /
text_mt: The consumption of soma has been explained.

sanskrit_iast: saṃtatam anupṛṣṭhyaṃ barhiḥ stīrtvāgnīdhraḥ puroḍāśān alaṃkaroti /
meaning: संततम् अनुपृष्ठ्यं बर्हिः स्तीर्त्वाग्नीध्रः पुरोडाशान् अलंकरोति /
text_mt: Having spread the sacred grass continuously along the spine of the altar, the Āgnīdhra priest garnishes the sacrificial cakes.

sanskrit_iast: aiti paśunā /
meaning: ऐति पशुना /

sanskrit_iast: yā vāṃ kaśā madhumatī \\ ity āśvinaṃ graham adhvaryur gṛhṇāti /
meaning: या वां कशा मधुमती \\ इत्य् आश्विनं ग्रहम् अध्वर्युर् गृह्णाति /
text_mt: With "What honey-rich whip of yours...", the adhvaryu draws the cup for the Aśvins.

sanskrit_iast: pariplavayā droṇakalaśād upastīrya pūtabhṛta unnīya droṇakalaśād abhighārayati /
meaning: परिप्लवया द्रोणकलशाद् उपस्तीर्य पूतभृत उन्नीय द्रोणकलशाद् अभिघारयति /
text_mt: Having made an under-layer from the wooden trough with the dipping-spoon, having drawn [the soma] from the pūtabhṛt, he bastes it from the wooden trough.

sanskrit_iast: sarvagrahāṇām eṣa kalpaḥ /
meaning: सर्वग्रहाणाम् एष कल्पः /
text_mt: This is the rule for all cups.

sanskrit_iast: tam̐ sādayitvā trivṛtā yūpaṃ parivīyāgneyaṃ paśum̐ savanīyam upākaroti /
meaning: तम्̐ सादयित्वा त्रिवृता यूपं परिवीयाग्नेयं पशुम्̐ सवनीयम् उपाकरोति /
text_mt: Having placed it down, having bound the sacrificial post with a three-strand rope, he dedicates the victim dedicated to Agni for the soma-pressing.

sanskrit_iast: tasya rūpaniyamo na vidyate /
meaning: तस्य रूपनियमो न विद्यते /
text_mt: For this, there is no restriction of form [or colour].

sanskrit_iast: hutāyāṃ vapāyāṃ prasṛpsyanto grahāvakalaśair upasthāya saṃprasarpanti /
meaning: हुतायां वपायां प्रसृप्स्यन्तो ग्रहावकलशैर् उपस्थाय संप्रसर्पन्ति /
text_mt: When the omentum has been offered, intending to creep forth, having paid homage to the cups and troughs, they creep forth together.

sanskrit_iast: dvau samudrau \\ iti droṇakalaśādhavanīyau /
meaning: द्वौ समुद्रौ \\ इति द्रोणकलशाधवनीयौ /
text_mt: With "Two oceans...", [he pays homage to] the wooden trough and the ādhavanīya trough.

sanskrit_iast: dve dradhasī iti pūtabhṛtam /
meaning: द्वे द्रधसी इति पूतभृतम् /
text_mt: With "Two wide realms...", to the pūtabhṛt.

sanskrit_iast: paribhūr agnim iti sarvasomam /
meaning: परिभूर् अग्निम् इति सर्वसोमम् /
text_mt: With "Encompassing Agni...", to all the soma.

sanskrit_iast: prāṇāya me \\ ity upām̐śupātram apānāya me \\ ity antaryāmaṃ vyānāya me \\ ity upām̐śusavanaṃ grāvāṇaṃ vāce me \\ ity aindravāyavaṃ dakṣakratubhyāṃ me \\ iti maitrāvaruṇaṃ cakṣurbhyāṃ me \\ iti śukrāmanthinau śrotrāya me \\ ity āśvinam ātmane me \\ ity āgrayaṇam aṅgebhyo me \\ ity ukthyam āyuṣe me \\ iti dhurvaṃ vīryāya me \\ ity atigrāhyām̐s tejase me \\ ojase me \ varcase me \\ iti vaitair yathārūpaṃ varcodā varcase pavasva \\ iti sarvatrānuṣajati //
meaning: प्राणाय मे \\ इत्य् उपाम्̐शुपात्रम् अपानाय मे \\ इत्य् अन्तर्यामं व्यानाय मे \\ इत्य् उपाम्̐शुसवनं ग्रावाणं वाचे मे \\ इत्य् ऐन्द्रवायवं दक्षक्रतुभ्यां मे \\ इति मैत्रावरुणं चक्षुर्भ्यां मे \\ इति शुक्रामन्थिनौ श्रोत्राय मे \\ इत्य् आश्विनम् आत्मने मे \\ इत्य् आग्रयणम् अङ्गेभ्यो मे \\ इत्य् उक्थ्यम् आयुषे मे \\ इति धुर्वं वीर्याय मे \\ इत्य् अतिग्राह्याम्̐स् तेजसे मे \\ ओजसे मे \ वर्चसे मे \\ इति वैतैर् यथारूपं वर्चोदा वर्चसे पवस्व \\ इति सर्वत्रानुषजति //
text_mt: With "For my out-breath", [he pays homage to] the upāṃśu cup; with "For my in-breath", to the antaryāma; with "For my cross-breath", to the pressing-stone for the upāṃśu; with "For my voice", to that for Indra and Vāyu; with "For my will and intellect", to that for Mitra and Varuṇa; with "For my two eyes", to the śukra and manthin cups; with "For my ear", to that for the Aśvins; with "For myself", to the āgrayaṇa cup; with "For my limbs", to the ukthya cup; with "For my life", to the dhruva cup; with "For my strength", to the additional cups; or with "For my heat-energy", "For my power", "For my lustre" [respectively], according to their form, he appends everywhere: "bestowing lustre, clarify yourself for lustre!"

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇor jaṭharam asi \\ iti droṇakalaśam indrasya jaṭharam asi \\ ity ādhavanīyaṃ viśveṣāṃ devānāṃ jaṭharam asi \\ iti pūtabhṛtaṃ varcodā me varcase pavasva \\ iti sarvatrānuṣajati /
meaning: विष्णोर् जठरम् असि \\ इति द्रोणकलशम् इन्द्रस्य जठरम् असि \\ इत्य् आधवनीयं विश्वेषां देवानां जठरम् असि \\ इति पूतभृतं वर्चोदा मे वर्चसे पवस्व \\ इति सर्वत्रानुषजति /
text_mt: With "You are the belly of Viṣṇu", [he pays homage to] the wooden trough; with "You are the belly of Indra", to the ādhavanīya; with "You are the belly of all the gods", to the pūtabhṛt; and he appends everywhere: "bestowing lustre, clarify yourself for my lustre!"

sanskrit_iast: ko 'si ko nāma \\ iti sarvam̐ rājānam aviśeṣeṇa /
meaning: को ऽसि को नाम \\ इति सर्वम्̐ राजानम् अविशेषेण /
text_mt: With "Who are you? What is your name?", [he looks at] all the soma-king without distinction.

sanskrit_iast: bubhūṣan brahmavarcasakāma āmayāvy annādyakāmo 'bhicaran vāvekṣeta /
meaning: बुभूषन् ब्रह्मवर्चसकाम आमयाव्य् अन्नाद्यकामो ऽभिचरन् वावेक्षेत /
text_mt: One wishing for prosperity, or one desirous of spiritual brilliance, or one who is sick, or one desirous of food, or one practicing sorcery, should look [at it].

sanskrit_iast: sphyaḥ svastir ity utkare vedikaraṇāni saṃnyastāni yathārūpam /
meaning: स्फ्यः स्वस्तिर् इत्य् उत्करे वेदिकरणानि संन्यस्तानि यथारूपम् /
text_mt: With "The wooden sword is well-being...", [he looks at] the implements for making the altar deposited on the rubbish heap, according to their forms.

sanskrit_iast: yajñiyā yajñakṛtaḥ stha \\ iti sarvāṇi /
meaning: यज्ञिया यज्ञकृतः स्थ \\ इति सर्वाणि /
text_mt: With "You are worthy of sacrifice, makers of the sacrifice", [he addresses] all of them.

sanskrit_iast: upa mā dyāvāpṛthivī iti dyāvāpṛthivī /
meaning: उप मा द्यावापृथिवी इति द्यावापृथिवी /
text_mt: With "May heaven and earth [summon] me", [he looks at] heaven and earth.

sanskrit_iast: upāstāvas \\ iti yatra bahiṣpavamānena stuvate /
meaning: उपास्तावस् \\ इति यत्र बहिष्पवमानेन स्तुवते /
text_mt: With "The praise-song has approached...", [he looks] where they chant with the bahiṣpavamāna hymn.

sanskrit_iast: upa kalaśas \\ iti droṇakalaśam upa somas \\ iti somam upāgnis \\ ity agnim upa devās \\ iti devān upa yajñas \\ iti yajñam upa mā hotrā upahave hvayantām iti hotrakān /
meaning: उप कलशस् \\ इति द्रोणकलशम् उप सोमस् \\ इति सोमम् उपाग्निस् \\ इत्य् अग्निम् उप देवास् \\ इति देवान् उप यज्ञस् \\ इति यज्ञम् उप मा होत्रा उपहवे ह्वयन्ताम् इति होत्रकान् /
text_mt: With "The trough has approached...", [he addresses] the wooden trough; with "The soma has approached...", the soma; with "Agni has approached...", Agni; with "The gods have approached...", the gods; with "The sacrifice has approached...", the sacrifice; with "May the priestly invocations summon me to the invitation", the secondary priests.

sanskrit_iast: hvayatām \\ hvayetām \\ hvayantām iti yathārūpam̐ sarvatrānuṣajati /
meaning: ह्वयताम् \\ ह्वयेताम् \\ ह्वयन्ताम् इति यथारूपम्̐ सर्वत्रानुषजति /
text_mt: He appends everywhere: "May he summon", "May the two summon", or "May they summon", according to their form.

sanskrit_iast: namo 'gnaye makhaghne \ makhasya mā yaśo 'ryāt \\ ity āhavanīyam upatiṣṭhate /
meaning: नमो ऽग्नये मखघ्ने \ मखस्य मा यशो ऽर्यात् \\ इत्य् आहवनीयम् उपतिष्ठते /
text_mt: With "Homage to Agni, the slayer of Makha; may the glory of Makha attain me", he pays homage to the āhavanīya fire.

sanskrit_iast: namo rudrāya makhaghne \ namaskṛtyā mā pāhi \\ ity āgnīdhram /
meaning: नमो रुद्राय मखघ्ने \ नमस्कृत्या मा पाहि \\ इत्य् आग्नीध्रम् /
text_mt: With "Homage to Rudra, the slayer of Makha; protect me from paying homage [only to destruction]", to the āgnīdhra fire.

sanskrit_iast: nama indrāya makhaghne \\ indriyaṃ me vīryaṃ mā nirvadhīs \\ iti hotrīyam /
meaning: नम इन्द्राय मखघ्ने \\ इन्द्रियं मे वीर्यं मा निर्वधीस् \\ इति होत्रीयम् /
text_mt: With "Homage to Indra, the slayer of Makha; do not strike down my virility and strength", to the hotṛ's hearth.

sanskrit_iast: namo yamāya makhagne \ namaskṛtyā mā pāhi \\ iti mārjālīyam /
meaning: नमो यमाय मखग्ने \ नमस्कृत्या मा पाहि \\ इति मार्जालीयम् /
text_mt: With "Homage to Yama, the slayer of Makha; protect me from paying homage [only to destruction]", to the mārjālīya fire.

sanskrit_iast: dṛḍhe sthaḥ śithire ity adhiṣvaṇaphalake /
meaning: दृढे स्थः शिथिरे इत्य् अधिष्वणफलके /
text_mt: With "You two are firm, loose...", [he pays homage to] the two pressing-boards.

sanskrit_iast: dyāvāpṛthivī samīkṣata ity ekeṣām /
meaning: द्यावापृथिवी समीक्षत इत्य् एकेषाम् /
text_mt: According to some, he looks at heaven and earth.

sanskrit_iast: sūryo mā devo divyād am̐hasas pātu \\ iti sūryaṃ vāyur antarikṣāt \\ iti vāyum agniḥ pṛthivyās \\ ity agniṃ yamaḥ pitṛbhyas \\ iti yamaṃ sarasvatī manuṣyebhyas \\ iti sarasvatīṃ pātu pātu \\ iti sarvatrānuṣajati /
meaning: सूर्यो मा देवो दिव्याद् अम्̐हसस् पातु \\ इति सूर्यं वायुर् अन्तरिक्षात् \\ इति वायुम् अग्निः पृथिव्यास् \\ इत्य् अग्निं यमः पितृभ्यस् \\ इति यमं सरस्वती मनुष्येभ्यस् \\ इति सरस्वतीं पातु पातु \\ इति सर्वत्रानुषजति /
text_mt: With "May divine Sūrya protect me from celestial distress", [he pays homage to] Sūrya; with "Vāyu from the intermediate space", to Vāyu; with "Agni from the earth", to Agni; with "Yama from the ancestors", to Yama; with "Sarasvatī from human beings", to Sarasvatī; and he appends everywhere: "May [he/she] protect, may [he/she] protect!"

sanskrit_iast: devī dvārau \\ iti dvāryau namaḥ sadase \\ iti sadas \\ namaḥ sadasaspataye \\ iti sadasaspatiṃ namaḥ sakhīnāṃ purogāṇāṃ cakṣuṣe \\ ity ṛtvijas \\ namo dive \\ iti divaṃ namaḥ pṛthivyai \\ iti pṛthivīm /
meaning: देवी द्वारौ \\ इति द्वार्यौ नमः सदसे \\ इति सदस् \\ नमः सदसस्पतये \\ इति सदसस्पतिं नमः सखीनां पुरोगाणां चक्षुषे \\ इत्य् ऋत्विजस् \\ नमो दिवे \\ इति दिवं नमः पृथिव्यै \\ इति पृथिवीम् /
text_mt: With "O divine two door-leaves", [he pays homage to] the two door-leaves; with "Homage to the sadas-hut", to the sadas-hut; with "Homage to the lord of the sadas-hut", to the lord of the sadas-hut; with "Homage to the eye of the friends going in front", to the officiating priests; with "Homage to heaven", to heaven; with "Homage to earth", to the earth.

sanskrit_iast: ahe daidhiṣavya \\ iti yatra niṣatsyan bhavati tatas tṛṇaṃ loṣṭaṃ vā nirasyāpa upaspṛśya \\ un nivata ud udvataś ca geṣam ity upaviśati /
meaning: अहे दैधिषव्य \\ इति यत्र निषत्स्यन् भवति ततस् तृणं लोष्टं वा निरस्याप उपस्पृश्य \\ उन् निवत उद् उद्वतश् च गेषम् इत्य् उपविशति /
text_mt: With "O snake residing in the grass...", having discarded a grass blade or a clod of earth from where he is about to sit, and having touched water, he sits down with "May I go forth up from the valleys and up from the heights".

sanskrit_iast: sadaḥ prasṛpya dakṣiṇārdhaṃ parekṣeta \\ āganta pitaras \\ iti /
meaning: सदः प्रसृप्य दक्षिणार्धं परेक्षेत \\ आगन्त पितरस् \\ इति /
text_mt: Having crept into the sadas-hut, he should look over to the southern half with "Come, O ancestors!".

sanskrit_iast: atra paśuṃ viśāsti /
meaning: अत्र पशुं विशास्ति /

sanskrit_iast: śrapyamāṇaḥ sarvāṇi savanāni pariśete tṛtīyasavane vā śrapyate /
meaning: श्रप्यमाणः सर्वाणि सवनानि परिशेते तृतीयसवने वा श्रप्यते /
text_mt: While being cooked, it lies beside [the fire] during all the pressings, or it is cooked at the third pressing.

sanskrit_iast: puroḍāśān āsādya taiḥ samavadāya pracarati /
meaning: पुरोडाशान् आसाद्य तैः समवदाय प्रचरति /
text_mt: Having placed the sacrificial cakes [in order] and having cut portions from them together, he proceeds.

sanskrit_iast: juhūpabhṛtor upastīryāvadāyābhighārya prātaḥ prātaḥsāvasyendrāya puroḍāśānām anubrūhi \ prataḥ prātaḥsāvasyendrāya puroḍāśān prasthitān preṣya \\ iti saṃpreṣyati /
meaning: जुहूपभृतोर् उपस्तीर्यावदायाभिघार्य प्रातः प्रातःसावस्येन्द्राय पुरोडाशानाम् अनुब्रूहि \ प्रतः प्रातःसावस्येन्द्राय पुरोडाशान् प्रस्थितान् प्रेष्य \\ इति संप्रेष्यति /
text_mt: Having made an under-layer in the juhū and upabhṛt, having cut the portions and basted them, he directs: "For the morning pressing, recite for Indra [the invitation] for the sacrificial cakes! For the morning pressing, prompt [the hotṛ] for Indra [with the offering verse] for the set-out sacrificial cakes!".

sanskrit_iast: aupabhṛtaṃ juhvāṃ paryasya \\ agnaye 'nubrūhi \\ agnaye preṣya \\ iti sviṣṭakṛti saṃpreṣyati /
meaning: औपभृतं जुह्वां पर्यस्य \\ अग्नये ऽनुब्रूहि \\ अग्नये प्रेष्य \\ इति स्विष्टकृति संप्रेष्यति /
text_mt: Having poured over the portion in the upabhṛt into the juhū, he directs for the Sviṣṭakṛt offering: "Recite for Agni! Prompt [the hotṛ] for Agni!".

sanskrit_iast: prāśitram iḍā ca kriyete prāśitram avadāya neḍām avadyati /
meaning: प्राशित्रम् इडा च क्रियेते प्राशित्रम् अवदाय नेडाम् अवद्यति /
text_mt: The prāśitra portion and the iḍā are made; or having cut the prāśitra portion, he does not cut the iḍā.

sanskrit_iast: dvidevatyeṣu marutvatīyayor ādityagrahe sāvitre hāriyojane ca yājyānuvākye /
meaning: द्विदेवत्येषु मरुत्वतीययोर् आदित्यग्रहे सावित्रे हारियोजने च याज्यानुवाक्ये /
text_mt: For the cups for two deities, for the two Marutvatīya cups, for the Āditya cup, for the Sāvitra cup, and for the Hāriyojana cup, there are both an introductory verse and an offering verse.

sanskrit_iast: yājyaivetarāsu somāhutiṣu /
meaning: याज्यैवेतरासु सोमाहुतिषु /
text_mt: For the other soma libations, there is only an offering verse.

sanskrit_iast: ubhayīṣv āśrutapratyāśrute yājyāsaṃpraiṣaś ca vyākhyātaḥ /
meaning: उभयीष्व् आश्रुतप्रत्याश्रुते याज्यासंप्रैषश् च व्याख्यातः /
text_mt: For both kinds, the call and the answering call, and the direction for the offering verse, have been explained.

sanskrit_iast: puronuvākyāvatīṣu puronuvākyāsaṃpreṣaḥ /
meaning: पुरोनुवाक्यावतीषु पुरोनुवाक्यासंप्रेषः /
text_mt: For those having an introductory verse, there is a direction for the introductory verse.

sanskrit_iast: grahaṃ camasaṃ vādāyāśrāvayati yathā darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ /
meaning: ग्रहं चमसं वादायाश्रावयति यथा दर्शपूर्णमासयोः /
text_mt: Taking the cup or the drinking cup, he calls for the response, just as in the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast: āgnīdhrāgāre dakṣiṇāmukhas tiṣṭhann āgnīdhraḥ sphyaṃ dhārayan pratyāśrāvayati tad vyākhyātam /
meaning: आग्नीध्रागारे दक्षिणामुखस् तिष्ठन्न् आग्नीध्रः स्फ्यं धारयन् प्रत्याश्रावयति तद् व्याख्यातम् /
text_mt: Standing in the āgnīdhra's shed facing south, holding the wooden sword, the āgnīdhra gives the response; that has been explained.

sanskrit_iast: saṃpraiṣās tv ekadhanā yājyāḥ /
meaning: संप्रैषास् त्व् एकधना याज्याः /
text_mt: However, the directions have the offering verses as their single property.

sanskrit_iast: tatrādhvaryur āśrāvya pratyāśrāvite \\ amuṣmai preṣya \\ iti maitrāvaruṇaṃ preṣyati sa hotāraṃ codayati /
meaning: तत्राध्वर्युर् आश्राव्य प्रत्याश्राविते \\ अमुष्मै प्रेष्य \\ इति मैत्रावरुणं प्रेष्यति स होतारं चोदयति /
text_mt: There, having called for the response, when the response has been given, the adhvaryu directs the maitrāvaruṇa: "Prompt [the hotṛ] for such-and-such [deity]!"; he urges the hotṛ.

sanskrit_iast: vaṣaṭkṛte juhoty anuvaṣaṭkṛte hutvā harati bhakṣam /
meaning: वषट्कृते जुहोत्य् अनुवषट्कृते हुत्वा हरति भक्षम् /
text_mt: When the vaṣaṭ-call has been uttered, he offers; when the second vaṣaṭ-call has been uttered, having offered, he carries away the portion to be consumed.

sanskrit_iast: sarvasomānām eṣa kalpaḥ /
meaning: सर्वसोमानाम् एष कल्पः /
text_mt: This is the rule for all somas.

sanskrit_iast: dvidevatyartugraheṣv ādityagrahasāvitrayoś ca nānuvaṣaṭkāro vidyate kṛtākṛtaḥ śukrāmanthinoḥ pātnīvate ca /
meaning: द्विदेवत्यर्तुग्रहेष्व् आदित्यग्रहसावित्रयोश् च नानुवषट्कारो विद्यते कृताकृतः शुक्रामन्थिनोः पात्नीवते च /
text_mt: In the case of the cups for two deities, the season cups, the Āditya cup, and the Sāvitra cup, there is no second vaṣaṭ-call; it is optional in the case of the śukra and manthin cups, and in the case of the cup for Agni accompanied by the wives [of the gods].

sanskrit_iast: dvidevatyaiḥ pracarataḥ /
meaning: द्विदेवत्यैः प्रचरतः /
text_mt: The two [adhvaryu and pratiprasthātā] proceed with the cups for two deities.

sanskrit_iast: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \ vāyava indravāyubhyāṃ tvā \\ ity aindravāyavasyaikadeśam ādityapātreṇa pratiprasthātā pratinirgrāhyaṃ gṛhṇāti /
meaning: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \ वायव इन्द्रवायुभ्यां त्वा \\ इत्य् ऐन्द्रवायवस्यैकदेशम् आदित्यपात्रेण प्रतिप्रस्थाता प्रतिनिर्ग्राह्यं गृह्णाति /
text_mt: With "You are taken with a support; for Vāyu, for Indra and Vāyu, thee!", the pratiprasthātā takes a supplementary drawing of a portion of that for Indra and Vāyu with the cup for the Ādityas.

sanskrit_iast: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \ vākṣasad asi \\ iti ca droṇakalaśād dvitīyam /
meaning: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \ वाक्षसद् असि \\ इति च द्रोणकलशाद् द्वितीयम् /
text_mt: And with "You are taken with a support; you are speech-abiding", a second from the wooden trough.

sanskrit_iast: aindravāyavam adhvaryur ādatte droṇakalaśāc ca pariplavayā rājānaṃ pratinigrāhyaṃ pratiprasthātā /
meaning: ऐन्द्रवायवम् अध्वर्युर् आदत्ते द्रोणकलशाच् च परिप्लवया राजानं प्रतिनिग्राह्यं प्रतिप्रस्थाता /
text_mt: The adhvaryu takes the cup for Indra and Vāyu, and the pratiprasthātā takes the soma-king from the wooden trough with the dipping-spoon as a supplementary drawing.

sanskrit_iast: upaniṣkramya \\ adhvaro yajño 'yam astu devās \\ iti pariplavayāghārayati yathopām̐śur huto bhavati /
meaning: उपनिष्क्रम्य \\ अध्वरो यज्ञो ऽयम् अस्तु देवास् \\ इति परिप्लवयाघारयति यथोपाम्̐शुर् हुतो भवति /
text_mt: Having stepped out, with "May this sacrifice be non-injurious, O gods...", he pours a stream with the dipping-spoon just as the upāṃśu cup was offered.

sanskrit_iast: vāyava indravāyubhyām anubrūhi \ vāyava indravāyubhyāṃ preṣya \\ iti saṃpreṣyati /
meaning: वायव इन्द्रवायुभ्याम् अनुब्रूहि \ वायव इन्द्रवायुभ्यां प्रेष्य \\ इति संप्रेष्यति /
text_mt: He directs: "For Vāyu, for Indra and Vāyu, recite! For Vāyu, for Indra and Vāyu, prompt!".

sanskrit_iast: vaṣaṭkṛte juhutaḥ punar vaṣaṭkṛte juhutaḥ /
meaning: वषट्कृते जुहुतः पुनर् वषट्कृते जुहुतः /
text_mt: When the vaṣaṭ-call has been uttered, the two make the offering; when the second vaṣaṭ-call has been uttered, the two make the offering.

sanskrit_iast: adhvaryoḥ pātre pratiprasthātā saṃpātam avanayati tasyaikadeśam adhvaryuḥ pratiprasthātuḥ pātre /
meaning: अध्वर्योः पात्रे प्रतिप्रस्थाता संपातम् अवनयति तस्यैकदेशम् अध्वर्युः प्रतिप्रस्थातुः पात्रे /
text_mt: The pratiprasthātā pours the residue into the cup of the adhvaryu; the adhvaryu pours a portion of it into the cup of the pratiprasthātā.

sanskrit_iast: devebhyas tvā \\ ity ādityasthālyāṃ pratiprasthātā saṃpātam avanayati //
meaning: देवेभ्यस् त्वा \\ इत्य् आदित्यस्थाल्यां प्रतिप्रस्थाता संपातम् अवनयति //
text_mt: With "Thee for the gods", the pratiprasthātā pours the residue into the Āditya vessel.

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇav uru krama \\ ity apidadhāti /
meaning: विष्णव् उरु क्रम \\ इत्य् अपिदधाति /
text_mt: With "Stride out wide, O Viṣṇu!", he covers it.

sanskrit_iast: mayi vasuḥ purovasus \\ ity adhvaryur hotre bhakṣaṃ prayacchati /
meaning: मयि वसुः पुरोवसुस् \\ इत्य् अध्वर्युर् होत्रे भक्षं प्रयच्छति /
text_mt: With "Vasu is in me, Purovasu...", the adhvaryu gives the draught to the hotṛ.

sanskrit_iast: tenaiva hotā pratigṛhṇāti /
meaning: तेनैव होता प्रतिगृह्णाति /
text_mt: With that very [mantra] the hotṛ receives it.

sanskrit_iast: evam uttarābhyāṃ yathādaivataṃ pracarataḥ /
meaning: एवम् उत्तराभ्यां यथादैवतं प्रचरतः /
text_mt: In this manner the two proceed with the subsequent two [cups] according to their deities.

sanskrit_iast: nottarayor droṇakalaśād gṛhṇāti nottarayor āghāro vidyate /
meaning: नोत्तरयोर् द्रोणकलशाद् गृह्णाति नोत्तरयोर् आघारो विद्यते /
text_mt: For the subsequent two, he does not draw from the droṇakalaśa; nor is there any pouring [of clarified butter] for the subsequent two.

sanskrit_iast: uttareṇottareṇa mantreṇa sakṛd gṛhṇāti sakṛj juhutaḥ /
meaning: उत्तरेणोत्तरेण मन्त्रेण सकृद् गृह्णाति सकृज् जुहुतः /
text_mt: With each subsequent mantra he draws once; the two offer once.

sanskrit_iast: uttareṇottareṇādityasthālyāṃ pratiprasthātā saṃpātam avanayati tenaiva sarvatrāpidadhāti /
meaning: उत्तरेणोत्तरेणादित्यस्थाल्यां प्रतिप्रस्थाता संपातम् अवनयति तेनैव सर्वत्रापिदधाति /
text_mt: With each subsequent [mantra] the pratiprasthātā pours the residue into the ādityasthālī; with that very [mantra] he covers it in every case.

sanskrit_iast: uttareṇottareṇādhvaryur hotre bhakṣaṃ prayacchaty etenaiva hotā pratigṛhṇāti /
meaning: उत्तरेणोत्तरेणाध्वर्युर् होत्रे भक्षं प्रयच्छत्य् एतेनैव होता प्रतिगृह्णाति /
text_mt: With each subsequent [mantra] the adhvaryu gives the draught to the hotṛ; with this very [mantra] the hotṛ receives it.

sanskrit_iast: diteḥ putrāṇām aditer akāriṣam \ uruśarmaṇāṃ bṛhatāṃ varūthinām / \ yeṣāṃ dhāmāni nihitāni dhāmaśas \\ citrair yajanti bhuvanāni viśvā \\ iti vā sarvatrāpidadhāti /
meaning: दितेः पुत्राणाम् अदितेर् अकारिषम् \ उरुशर्मणां बृहतां वरूथिनाम् / \ येषां धामानि निहितानि धामशस् \\ चित्रैर् यजन्ति भुवनानि विश्वा \\ इति वा सर्वत्रापिदधाति /
text_mt: Or, with "Of the sons of Diti, of Aditi I have performed... who have wide shelter, are mighty, well protected, whose abodes are fixed according to their stations, they sacrifice to all the worlds with wonderful [oblations]", he covers it in every case.

sanskrit_iast: yadi kāmayeta pāpam asya sam̐syād iti pratiprasthānena pūrvo gṛhītvā pūrvas tiṣṭhañ juhuyāt pūrvo hutvā sādayet /
meaning: यदि कामयेत पापम् अस्य सम्̐स्याद् इति प्रतिप्रस्थानेन पूर्वो गृहीत्वा पूर्वस् तिष्ठञ् जुहुयात् पूर्वो हुत्वा सादयेत् /
text_mt: If he should desire: "May evil befall him", having drawn first with the pratiprasthāna, standing first he should offer; having offered first, he should set [it] down.

sanskrit_iast: yadi kāmayeta samāvad vīryo bhrātṛvyeṇa syād iti yugapadgṛhṇīto yugapajjuhuto yugapatsādayataḥ /
meaning: यदि कामयेत समावद् वीर्यो भ्रातृव्येण स्याद् इति युगपद्गृह्णीतो युगपज्जुहुतो युगपत्सादयतः /
text_mt: If he should desire: "May he be of equal vigor with his rival", the two draw together, offer together, set down together.

sanskrit_iast: dhārāgrahakāle gṛhṇātīty ekeṣām /
meaning: धाराग्रहकाले गृह्णातीत्य् एकेषाम् /
text_mt: According to some, he draws at the time of drawing the streams.

sanskrit_iast: atra pātrāṇy utsādayati /
meaning: अत्र पात्राण्य् उत्सादयति /
text_mt: At this point, he sets aside the vessels.

sanskrit_iast: yadi kāmayeta yo grāme taṃ grāmān nirūhya yo bahir grāmāt taṃ grāme kuryād iti \\ idam aham amum āmuṣyāyaṇam amuṣya putram amuṣyai viśo nirūhāmi \\ ity adhvaryuḥ pātraṃ nirūhya \\ idam aham amum āmuṣyāyaṇam amuṣya putram amuṣyāṃ viśi sādayāmi \\ iti pratiprasthānam̐ sādayed ayajñasaṃyuktaḥ kalpaḥ /
meaning: यदि कामयेत यो ग्रामे तं ग्रामान् निरूह्य यो बहिर् ग्रामात् तं ग्रामे कुर्याद् इति \\ इदम् अहम् अमुम् आमुष्यायणम् अमुष्य पुत्रम् अमुष्यै विशो निरूहामि \\ इत्य् अध्वर्युः पात्रं निरूह्य \\ इदम् अहम् अमुम् आमुष्यायणम् अमुष्य पुत्रम् अमुष्यां विशि सादयामि \\ इति प्रतिप्रस्थानम्̐ सादयेद् अयज्ञसंयुक्तः कल्पः /
text_mt: If he should desire: "The one who is in the village, him having expelled from the village, the one who is outside the village, him he should place in the village", then the adhvaryu, having moved the vessel aside with "Here I expel such-and-such, of such-and-such lineage, the son of such-and-such, from such-and-such clan", should set down the pratiprasthāna vessel with "Here I set down such-and-such, of such-and-such lineage, the son of such-and-such, in such-and-such clan"; this is a rite not connected with the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: ādhavanīyaṃ pūtabhṛty avanīya daśābhiḥ kalaśaṃ mṛṣṭvā nyuñjati /
meaning: आधवनीयं पूतभृत्य् अवनीय दशाभिः कलशं मृष्ट्वा न्युञ्जति /
text_mt: Having poured the ādhavanīya into the pūtabhṛt and wiped the tub with the fringed ends, they turn [the droṇakalaśa] upside down.

sanskrit_iast: hotā brahmodgātā yajamānaḥ sadasyaś ceti madhyataḥkāriṇo maitrāvaruṇo brāhmaṇācchaṃsī potā neṣṭācchāvāka āgnīdhraś ca hotrakāḥ /
meaning: होता ब्रह्मोद्गाता यजमानः सदस्यश् चेति मध्यतःकारिणो मैत्रावरुणो ब्राह्मणाच्छंसी पोता नेष्टाच्छावाक आग्नीध्रश् च होत्रकाः /
text_mt: The hotṛ, the brahman, the udgātṛ, the yajamāna, and the sadasya—these are the central officiants; the maitrāvaruṇa, the brāhmaṇācchaṃsī, the potṛ, the neṣṭṛ, the acchāvāka, and the āgnīdhra are the subordinate hotṛs.

sanskrit_iast: ubhaye camasino bhavanti sarveṣāṃ pratipuruṣaṃ camasādhvaryavaḥ //
meaning: उभये चमसिनो भवन्ति सर्वेषां प्रतिपुरुषं चमसाध्वर्यवः //
text_mt: Both [groups] possess cups; for each person there are cup-adhvaryus.

sanskrit_iast: unnīyamānebhyo 'nubrūhi \ hotuś camasam anūnnayadhvam \ ubhayataḥśukrān kurudhvam \ acchāvākasya camasādhvaryo mā tvam unneṣṭhāḥ \ pratiprasthātaḥ prokṣitāprokṣitāñ chakalān upakalpaya \\ unnetaḥ somaṃ prabhāvaya \\ iti saṃpreṣyati /
meaning: उन्नीयमानेभ्यो ऽनुब्रूहि \ होतुश् चमसम् अनून्नयध्वम् \ उभयतःशुक्रान् कुरुध्वम् \ अच्छावाकस्य चमसाध्वर्यो मा त्वम् उन्नेष्ठाः \ प्रतिप्रस्थातः प्रोक्षिताप्रोक्षिताञ् छकलान् उपकल्पय \\ उन्नेतः सोमं प्रभावय \\ इति संप्रेष्यति /
text_mt: He directs: "Recite for those [cups] that are being filled! Fill along after the hotṛ's cup! Make them pure on both sides! O cup-adhvaryu of the acchāvāka, do not fill! O pratiprasthātā, arrange the consecrated and unconsecrated splinters! O unnetṛ, make the soma abundant!"

sanskrit_iast: hotṛcamasamukhyān daśa camasān unnayaty anyān acchāvākacamasāt /
meaning: होतृचमसमुख्यान् दश चमसान् उन्नयत्य् अन्यान् अच्छावाकचमसात् /
text_mt: He fills the ten cups, headed by the hotṛ's cup, [and] the others except the cup of the acchāvāka.

sanskrit_iast: pariplavayonnetā droṇakalaśād upastīrya pūtabhṛta unnīya droṇakalaśād abhighārayati /
meaning: परिप्लवयोन्नेता द्रोणकलशाद् उपस्तीर्य पूतभृत उन्नीय द्रोणकलशाद् अभिघारयति /
text_mt: Having under-layered from the droṇakalaśa with the pariplavā, having drawn from the pūtabhṛt, the unnetṛ pours over [it] from the droṇakalaśa.

sanskrit_iast: sarvacamasānām eṣa kalpaḥ /
meaning: सर्वचमसानाम् एष कल्पः /
text_mt: This is the rule for all cups.

sanskrit_iast: prasthiteṣv evonnīyamāne sūkte tasmin parihite sāvitreṇa grahāv ādadāte /
meaning: प्रस्थितेष्व् एवोन्नीयमाने सूक्ते तस्मिन् परिहिते सावित्रेण ग्रहाव् आददाते /
text_mt: While the hymn being recited for the filled [cups] is well underway, when it is concluded, the two take up the two cups with the Sāvitra [mantra]:

sanskrit_iast: śukram adhvaryur manthinaṃ pratiprasthātā /
meaning: शुक्रम् अध्वर्युर् मन्थिनं प्रतिप्रस्थाता /
text_mt: the adhvaryu the śukra, the pratiprasthātā the manthin.

sanskrit_iast: ādadate camasām̐ś camasādhvaravaḥ /
meaning: आददते चमसाम्̐श् चमसाध्वरवः /
text_mt: The cup-adhvaryus take up their cups.

sanskrit_iast: prokṣitābhyām̐ śakalābhyām̐ śukrāmanthināv apidhattas \\ apanuttau śaṇḍāmarkau saha tena yaṃ dviṣmas \\ ity aprokṣitābhyām adhastāt pām̐sūn apadhvam̐sayatas tābhyāṃ caivopayacchataḥ
meaning: प्रोक्षिताभ्याम्̐ शकलाभ्याम्̐ शुक्रामन्थिनाव् अपिधत्तस् \\ अपनुत्तौ शण्डामर्कौ सह तेन यं द्विष्मस् \\ इत्य् अप्रोक्षिताभ्याम् अधस्तात् पाम्̐सून् अपध्वम्̐सयतस् ताभ्यां चैवोपयच्छतः
text_mt: With the two consecrated splinters they cover the śukra and manthin; with "Driven away are Śaṇḍa and Marka together with the one whom we hate", with the two unconsecrated [splinters] they brush off the dust beneath, and with those very two they hold [them] underneath.

sanskrit_iast: stuto 'si janadhās \\ devās tvā śukrapāḥ praṇayantu \\ iti śukram adhvaryur harati stuto 'si janadhās \\ devās tvā manthipāḥ praṇayantu \\ iti manthinaṃ pratiprasthātā /
meaning: स्तुतो ऽसि जनधास् \\ देवास् त्वा शुक्रपाः प्रणयन्तु \\ इति शुक्रम् अध्वर्युर् हरति स्तुतो ऽसि जनधास् \\ देवास् त्वा मन्थिपाः प्रणयन्तु \\ इति मन्थिनं प्रतिप्रस्थाता /
text_mt: With "You are praised, people-supporting; may the gods who drink the pure lead you forward", the adhvaryu carries the śukra; with "You are praised, people-supporting; may the gods who drink the manthin lead you forward", the pratiprasthātā [carries] the manthin.

sanskrit_iast: tāv ādānāv eke samāmananti \\ urv antarikṣam iti gacchataḥ /
meaning: ताव् आदानाव् एके समामनन्ति \\ उर्व् अन्तरिक्षम् इति गच्छतः /
text_mt: Some tradition prescribes these two [mantras] for the taking up. With "The wide midspace..." the two walk forward.

sanskrit_iast: āyuḥ saṃdhattaṃ taṃ me jinvatam \\ prāṇam̐ saṃdhattaṃ taṃ me jinvatam \ apānam̐ saṃdhattaṃ taṃ me jinvatam \\ vyānam̐ saṃdhattaṃ taṃ me jinvatam \\ cakṣuḥ saṃdhattaṃ tan me jinvatam \\ śrotram̐ saṃdhattaṃ tan me jinvatam \\ manaḥ saṃdhattaṃ tan me jinvatam \\ vācam̐ saṃdhattaṃ tāṃ me jinvatam ity agreṇa havirdhāne aratnī pātre vā saṃdhattaḥ /
meaning: आयुः संधत्तं तं मे जिन्वतम् \\ प्राणम्̐ संधत्तं तं मे जिन्वतम् \ अपानम्̐ संधत्तं तं मे जिन्वतम् \\ व्यानम्̐ संधत्तं तं मे जिन्वतम् \\ चक्षुः संधत्तं तन् मे जिन्वतम् \\ श्रोत्रम्̐ संधत्तं तन् मे जिन्वतम् \\ मनः संधत्तं तन् मे जिन्वतम् \\ वाचम्̐ संधत्तं तां मे जिन्वतम् इत्य् अग्रेण हविर्धाने अरत्नी पात्रे वा संधत्तः /
text_mt: With "Unite life-span, invigorate that for me! Unite the in-breath, invigorate that for me! Unite the out-breath, invigorate that for me! Unite the diffused breath, invigorate that for me! Unite sight, invigorate that for me! Unite hearing, invigorate that for me! Unite the mind, invigorate that for me! Unite speech, invigorate that for me!", in front of the two havirdhāna carts the two bring their elbows or the two vessels into contact.

sanskrit_iast: anādhṛṣṭāsi \\ ity aṅguṣṭhābhyām uttaravedim ākramete /
meaning: अनाधृष्टासि \\ इत्य् अङ्गुष्ठाभ्याम् उत्तरवेदिम् आक्रमेते /
text_mt: With "You are unassailable...", they step onto the high altar with their thumbs.

sanskrit_iast: tāṃ viparihantau viparikrāmataḥ /
meaning: तां विपरिहन्तौ विपरिक्रामतः /
text_mt: Crossing over one another, they walk around it.

sanskrit_iast: suvīrāḥ prajāḥ prajanayan parīhi \ śukraḥ śukraśociṣā \\ iti dakṣiṇenādhvaryur harati suprajāḥ prajāḥ prajanayan parīhi \ manthī manthiśociṣā \\ ity uttareṇa pratiprasthātā /
meaning: सुवीराः प्रजाः प्रजनयन् परीहि \ शुक्रः शुक्रशोचिषा \\ इति दक्षिणेनाध्वर्युर् हरति सुप्रजाः प्रजाः प्रजनयन् परीहि \ मन्थी मन्थिशोचिषा \\ इत्य् उत्तरेण प्रतिप्रस्थाता /
text_mt: With "Generate heroic offspring as you go around, pure with pure brilliance", the adhvaryu carries [his cup] on the south; with "Generate good offspring as you go around, manthin with manthin-brilliance", the pratiprasthātā on the north.

sanskrit_iast: jinvethām̐ supathyā madhvā vītam iti yajamāno 'nuyantrayate 'greṇāhavanīyam /
meaning: जिन्वेथाम्̐ सुपथ्या मध्वा वीतम् इति यजमानो ऽनुयन्त्रयते ऽग्रेणाहवनीयम् /
text_mt: With "Invigorate with good paths, pursue with sweetness", the yajamāna follows with the mantra in front of the āhavanīya fire.

sanskrit_iast: abhito yūpaṃ purastāt pratyañcāv avatiṣṭhete /
meaning: अभितो यूपं पुरस्तात् प्रत्यञ्चाव् अवतिष्ठेते /
text_mt: On both sides of the sacrificial post, in front, the two stand facing west.

sanskrit_iast: paścāt prāñcaś camasādhvaryavaḥ /
meaning: पश्चात् प्राञ्चश् चमसाध्वर्यवः /
text_mt: Behind, facing east, are the cup-adhvaryus.

sanskrit_iast: saṃjagmānau diva ā pṛthivyāḥs \ śukraḥ śukraśociṣā \\ ity adhvaryuḥ saṃjagmānau diva ā pṛthivyās \\ manthī manthiśociṣā \\ iti pratiprasthātāratnī pātre vā saṃdhattaḥ //
meaning: संजग्मानौ दिव आ पृथिव्याःस् \ शुक्रः शुक्रशोचिषा \\ इत्य् अध्वर्युः संजग्मानौ दिव आ पृथिव्यास् \\ मन्थी मन्थिशोचिषा \\ इति प्रतिप्रस्थातारत्नी पात्रे वा संधत्तः //
text_mt: The adhvaryu with "Joined together from heaven and earth, pure with pure brilliance", the pratiprasthātā with "Joined together from heaven and earth, manthin with manthin-brilliance", the two bring their elbows or the two vessels into contact.

sanskrit_iast: āyuḥ sthas \\ āyur me dhattam \ āyur yajñāya dhattam \ āyur yajñapataye dhattam \\ prāṇaḥ sthaḥ \ prāṇaṃ me dhattam \\ prāṇaṃ yajñāya dhattam \\ prāṇaṃ yajñapataye dhattam \\ cakṣuḥ sthas \\ cakṣur me dhattam \\ cakṣur yajñāya dhattam \\ cakṣur yajñapataye dhattam \\ śrotram̐ sthaḥ \ śrotraṃ me dhattam \\ śrotraṃ yajñāya dhattam \\ śrotraṃ yajñapataye dhattam \\ tau devau śukrāmanthinau kalpayatam \\ daivīr viśaḥ kalpayatam \\ mānuṣīr iṣam ūrjam asmāsu dhattam \\ prāṇān paśuṣu prajāṃ mayi ca yajamāne ca \\ ity abhimantrayete /
meaning: आयुः स्थस् \\ आयुर् मे धत्तम् \ आयुर् यज्ञाय धत्तम् \ आयुर् यज्ञपतये धत्तम् \\ प्राणः स्थः \ प्राणं मे धत्तम् \\ प्राणं यज्ञाय धत्तम् \\ प्राणं यज्ञपतये धत्तम् \\ चक्षुः स्थस् \\ चक्षुर् मे धत्तम् \\ चक्षुर् यज्ञाय धत्तम् \\ चक्षुर् यज्ञपतये धत्तम् \\ श्रोत्रम्̐ स्थः \ श्रोत्रं मे धत्तम् \\ श्रोत्रं यज्ञाय धत्तम् \\ श्रोत्रं यज्ञपतये धत्तम् \\ तौ देवौ शुक्रामन्थिनौ कल्पयतम् \\ दैवीर् विशः कल्पयतम् \\ मानुषीर् इषम् ऊर्जम् अस्मासु धत्तम् \\ प्राणान् पशुषु प्रजां मयि च यजमाने च \\ इत्य् अभिमन्त्रयेते /
text_mt: They address [the cups] with the mantra: "You two are life-span; place life-span in me, place life-span in the sacrifice, place life-span in the lord of the sacrifice! You two are breath; place breath in me, place breath in the sacrifice, place breath in the lord of the sacrifice! You two are sight; place sight in me, place sight in the sacrifice, place sight in the lord of the sacrifice! You two are hearing; place hearing in me, place hearing in the sacrifice, place hearing in the lord of the sacrifice! Do you two gods, Śukra and Manthin, arrange! Arrange the divine subjects! Place human refreshment and strength in us, breaths in animals, offspring in me and in the yajamāna!"

sanskrit_iast: prokṣitau śakalāv abhyādhattaḥ śukrasyādhiṣṭhānam asi \ śukraiṣā te samit \ tayā samidhyasva \\ ity adhvaryur manthino 'dhiṣṭhānam asi \ manthinn eṣā te samit \ tayā samidhyasva \\ iti pratiprasthātā /
meaning: प्रोक्षितौ शकलाव् अभ्याधत्तः शुक्रस्याधिष्ठानम् असि \ शुक्रैषा ते समित् \ तया समिध्यस्व \\ इत्य् अध्वर्युर् मन्थिनो ऽधिष्ठानम् असि \ मन्थिन्न् एषा ते समित् \ तया समिध्यस्व \\ इति प्रतिप्रस्थाता /
text_mt: They lay on the two consecrated splinters: the adhvaryu with "You are the base of the śukra; O pure one, this is your kindling stick, kindle with it!"; the pratiprasthātā with "You are the base of the manthin; O manthin, this is your kindling stick, kindle with it!"

sanskrit_iast: nirastaḥ śaṇḍas \\ nirasto markas \\ apanuttau śaṇḍāmarkau saha tena yaṃ dviṣmas \\ ity aprokṣitau bahirvedi nirasyato 'pa upaspṛśya /
meaning: निरस्तः शण्डस् \\ निरस्तो मर्कस् \\ अपनुत्तौ शण्डामर्कौ सह तेन यं द्विष्मस् \\ इत्य् अप्रोक्षितौ बहिर्वेदि निरस्यतो ऽप उपस्पृश्य /
text_mt: With "Cast away is Śaṇḍa, cast away is Marka; driven away are Śaṇḍa and Marka together with the one whom we hate", they cast away the two unconsecrated [splinters] outside the altar, having touched water.

sanskrit_iast: prātaḥ prātaḥsāvasya śukravato manthivato madhuścuta indrāya somān prasthitān preṣya \ madhyataḥkāriṇāṃ camasādhvaryavo vaṣaṭkṛtānuvaṣaṭkṛtāñ juhuta \ hotrakāṇāṃ camasādhvaryavaḥ sakṛtsakṛd dhutvā śukrasyābhyunnīyopāvartadhvam iti saṃpreṣyati /
meaning: प्रातः प्रातःसावस्य शुक्रवतो मन्थिवतो मधुश्चुत इन्द्राय सोमान् प्रस्थितान् प्रेष्य \ मध्यतःकारिणां चमसाध्वर्यवो वषट्कृतानुवषट्कृताञ् जुहुत \ होत्रकाणां चमसाध्वर्यवः सकृत्सकृद् धुत्वा शुक्रस्याभ्युन्नीयोपावर्तध्वम् इति संप्रेष्यति /
text_mt: He directs: "For the morning pressing, prompt for Indra the somas that are set forth, possessing the śukra, possessing the manthin, dripping honey! O cup-adhvaryus of the central officiants, offer [the cups] at the vaṣaṭ and the anu-vaṣaṭ! O cup-adhvaryus of the subordinate hotṛs, having offered once each, having poured in [soma] from the śukra, return!"

sanskrit_iast: vaṣaṭkṛte sarve yugapaj juhvati /
meaning: वषट्कृते सर्वे युगपज् जुह्वति /
text_mt: When the vaṣaṭ is uttered, all offer simultaneously.

sanskrit_iast: sa prathamaḥ saṃkṛtir viśvakarmā \ sa prathamo mitro varuṇo agniḥ / \ sa prathamo bṛhaspatiś cikitvān \\ tasmā indrāya sutam ājuhomi svāhā \\ ity adhvaryus tasmai mitrāya sutam ājuhomi svāhā \\ iti pratiprasthātā /
meaning: स प्रथमः संकृतिर् विश्वकर्मा \ स प्रथमो मित्रो वरुणो अग्निः / \ स प्रथमो बृहस्पतिश् चिकित्वान् \\ तस्मा इन्द्राय सुतम् आजुहोमि स्वाहा \\ इत्य् अध्वर्युस् तस्मै मित्राय सुतम् आजुहोमि स्वाहा \\ इति प्रतिप्रस्थाता /
text_mt: The adhvaryu [offers] with: 'He is the first ordainer, Viśvakarman; he is the first Mitra, Varuṇa, Agni; he is the first wise Bṛhaspati; to that Indra I offer the pressed [juice], svāhā!'; the pratiprasthātā with: 'To that Mitra I offer the pressed [juice], svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: sānuvaṣaṭkārāv eke samāmananty ananuvaṣaṭkārāv eke 'nyataram̐ sānuvaṣaṭkāram eke /
meaning: सानुवषट्काराव् एके समामनन्त्य् अननुवषट्काराव् एके ऽन्यतरम्̐ सानुवषट्कारम् एके /
text_mt: Some teach both with the secondary vaṣaṭ-call, some both without the secondary vaṣaṭ-call, [and] some one or the other with the secondary vaṣaṭ-call.

sanskrit_iast: uttarataḥpurastād bahiṣparidhy āhavanīyād aṅgāraṃ nirvartya \\ eṣa te rudra bhāgas \\ iti tasminn etaṃ manthinaḥ sam̐srāvaṃ pratiprasthātā sarvahutaṃ juhoti /
meaning: उत्तरतःपुरस्ताद् बहिष्परिध्य् आहवनीयाद् अङ्गारं निर्वर्त्य \\ एष ते रुद्र भागस् \\ इति तस्मिन्न् एतं मन्थिनः सम्̐स्रावं प्रतिप्रस्थाता सर्वहुतं जुहोति /
text_mt: Having removed a burning coal from the āhavanīya fire to the north-east outside the enclosing sticks, the pratiprasthātā offers this residue of the manthin [cup] entirely into it with: 'This is your share, O Rudra!'

sanskrit_iast: madhyataḥkāriṇāṃ camasādhvaryavo 'nuvaṣaṭkṛte juhvati /
meaning: मध्यतःकारिणां चमसाध्वर्यवो ऽनुवषट्कृते जुह्वति /
text_mt: The camasādhvaryus of the central officiants offer when the secondary vaṣaṭ-call is uttered.

sanskrit_iast: praitu hotuś camasaḥ pra brahmaṇaḥ prodgātuḥ pra yajamānasya pra sadasyasya \\ iti saṃpreṣyati /
meaning: प्रैतु होतुश् चमसः प्र ब्रह्मणः प्रोद्गातुः प्र यजमानस्य प्र सदस्यस्य \\ इति संप्रेष्यति /
text_mt: He directs: 'Let the hotṛ's cup go forth! Let the brahman's go forth! Let the udgātṛ's go forth! Let the sacrificer's go forth! Let the sadasya's go forth!'

sanskrit_iast: sado bhakṣān haranti /
meaning: सदो भक्षान् हरन्ति /

sanskrit_iast: sūdavac chukrapātram̐ sādayati /
meaning: सूदवच् छुक्रपात्रम्̐ सादयति /
text_mt: He deposits the śukra cup together with its residue.

sanskrit_iast: hotrakāṇāṃ camasādhvaryavaḥ sakṛtsakṛd dhutvā śukrasyābhyunnīyopāvartante /
meaning: होत्रकाणां चमसाध्वर्यवः सकृत्सकृद् धुत्वा शुक्रस्याभ्युन्नीयोपावर्तन्ते /
text_mt: The camasādhvaryus of the minor priests, having offered once each and having drawn up from the śukra [vessel], return.

sanskrit_iast: tair adhvaryuḥ pracarati /
meaning: तैर् अध्वर्युः प्रचरति /
text_mt: With them the adhvaryu proceeds.

sanskrit_iast: maitrāvaruṇacamasam ādāya praśāstar yaja \\ iti saṃpreṣyati vaṣaṭkṛtānuvaṣaṭkṛte hutvā camasādhvaryave prayacchati sado bhakṣam̐ harati /
meaning: मैत्रावरुणचमसम् आदाय प्रशास्तर् यज \\ इति संप्रेष्यति वषट्कृतानुवषट्कृते हुत्वा चमसाध्वर्यवे प्रयच्छति सदो भक्षम्̐ हरति /
text_mt: Taking the cup of the maitrāvaruṇa, he directs: 'Director, recite the yājyā!'; having offered at the vaṣaṭ-call and at the secondary vaṣaṭ-call, he hands it to the camasādhvaryu; he carries the portion to the sadas.

sanskrit_iast: evam uttaraiḥ pracarati //
meaning: एवम् उत्तरैः प्रचरति //
text_mt: In this manner he proceeds with the subsequent [cups].

sanskrit_iast: brahman yaja \\ iti brāhmaṇāccham̐sinaṃ potar yaja \\ iti potāraṃ neṣṭar yaja \\ iti neṣṭāram agnīd yaja \\ ity āgnīdhram /
meaning: ब्रह्मन् यज \\ इति ब्राह्मणाच्छम्̐सिनं पोतर् यज \\ इति पोतारं नेष्टर् यज \\ इति नेष्टारम् अग्नीद् यज \\ इत्य् आग्नीध्रम् /
text_mt: 'Brahman priest, recite the yājyā!', to the brāhmaṇācchaṃsin; 'Potṛ, recite the yājyā!', to the potṛ; 'Neṣṭṛ, recite the yājyā!', to the neṣṭṛ; 'Agnīdh, recite the yājyā!', to the āgnīdhra.

sanskrit_iast: tasya camasam ādāya sado gacchati sa hotur ācaṣṭe \\ ayāḍ agnīt \\ iti /
meaning: तस्य चमसम् आदाय सदो गच्छति स होतुर् आचष्टे \\ अयाड् अग्नीत् \\ इति /
text_mt: Taking his cup, he goes to the sadas; he reports to the hotṛ: 'The Agnīdh has sacrificed.'

sanskrit_iast: sa bhadram akar yo naḥ somaṃ pāyayiṣyati \\ iti hotā pratyāha /
meaning: स भद्रम् अकर् यो नः सोमं पाययिष्यति \\ इति होता प्रत्याह /
text_mt: The hotṛ replies: 'He has done well, who will cause us to drink soma.'

sanskrit_iast: homābhiṣavābhyām adhvaryor bhakṣo vaṣaṭkārāc ca vaṣaṭkartṝṇām̐ samākhyānāc camasinām /
meaning: होमाभिषवाभ्याम् अध्वर्योर् भक्षो वषट्काराच् च वषट्कर्तॄणाम्̐ समाख्यानाच् चमसिनाम् /
text_mt: The consuming [of soma] by the adhvaryu is due to offering and pressing, by the vaṣaṭ-callers due to the vaṣaṭ-call, and by the cup-holders due to title.

sanskrit_iast: vaṣaṭkartā pūrvo bhakṣayati tato 'dhvaryur jaghanyaś camasī /
meaning: वषट्कर्ता पूर्वो भक्षयति ततो ऽध्वर्युर् जघन्यश् चमसी /
text_mt: The vaṣaṭ-caller consumes first, then the adhvaryu, [and] the cup-holder last.

sanskrit_iast: homayor vaṣaṭkāravyavāye bhakṣavyavāye vaṣaṭkārayoś ca homavyavāye pratiśeṣaṃ pratigrahaṇaṃ ca bhakṣaḥ /
meaning: होमयोर् वषट्कारव्यवाये भक्षव्यवाये वषट्कारयोश् च होमव्यवाये प्रतिशेषं प्रतिग्रहणं च भक्षः /
text_mt: When there is an intervention of a vaṣaṭ-call between two offerings, or an intervention of consumption, and when there is an intervention of an offering between two vaṣaṭ-calls, consumption consists of taking up each respective remainder.

sanskrit_iast: nānāgṛhītayoś ca samavāye /
meaning: नानागृहीतयोश् च समवाये /
text_mt: And when two [oblations] drawn separately are brought together;

sanskrit_iast: na vaiśyarājanyayoḥ somabhakṣaṇaṃ vidyate /
meaning: न वैश्यराजन्ययोः सोमभक्षणं विद्यते /
text_mt: Consuming soma is not prescribed for a vaiśya or a rājanya.

sanskrit_iast: yady abrāhmaṇaḥ somaṃ pipāsen nyagrodhastibhinīr āhṛtya tāḥ saṃpiṣya dadhany unmṛjya yad anyām̐ś camasān unnayaty athaitaṃ yajamānacamasam ata unnayati yad anyām̐ś camasāñ juhvaty athaitasya darbhataruṇenopahatyāntaḥparidhy āhavanīyād aṅgāraṃ nirvartya \\ ahaṃ tvad asmi \\ iti juhoti yad anyām̐ś camasān bhakṣayaty athaitasya camasasya yajamāno bhakṣayati /
meaning: यद्य् अब्राह्मणः सोमं पिपासेन् न्यग्रोधस्तिभिनीर् आहृत्य ताः संपिष्य दधन्य् उन्मृज्य यद् अन्याम्̐श् चमसान् उन्नयत्य् अथैतं यजमानचमसम् अत उन्नयति यद् अन्याम्̐श् चमसाञ् जुह्वत्य् अथैतस्य दर्भतरुणेनोपहत्यान्तःपरिध्य् आहवनीयाद् अङ्गारं निर्वर्त्य \\ अहं त्वद् अस्मि \\ इति जुहोति यद् अन्याम्̐श् चमसान् भक्षयत्य् अथैतस्य चमसस्य यजमानो भक्षयति /
text_mt: If a non-Brahmin wishes to drink soma, having fetched shoots of the banyan tree, ground them, and mixed them into curds: when he draws the other cups, he draws this cup of the sacrificer from that; when they offer the other cups, having touched this [mixture] with a tender blade of darbha-grass and moved an ember aside from the āhavanīya inside the enclosure-sticks, he offers with, "I am from you"; when they consume the other cups, then the sacrificer consumes from this cup.

sanskrit_iast: dvidevatyān bhakṣayanti /
meaning: द्विदेवत्यान् भक्षयन्ति /
text_mt: They consume [the soma of] the cups for dual deities:

sanskrit_iast: hotādhvaryuḥ pratiprasthātā ca /
meaning: होताध्वर्युः प्रतिप्रस्थाता च /
text_mt: The hotṛ, the adhvaryu, and the pratiprasthātā.

sanskrit_iast: evam anupūrvāḥ /
meaning: एवम् अनुपूर्वाः /

sanskrit_iast: anyonyasminn upahavam icchante /
meaning: अन्योन्यस्मिन्न् उपहवम् इच्छन्ते /
text_mt: They request an invitation from one another.

sanskrit_iast: upahvayasva \\ ity āmantraṇaḥ /
meaning: उपह्वयस्व \\ इत्य् आमन्त्रणः /
text_mt: "Invite me!" is the address.

sanskrit_iast: upahūtas \\ iti prativacanaḥ /
meaning: उपहूतस् \\ इति प्रतिवचनः /
text_mt: "You are invited," is the response.

sanskrit_iast: yatra kvacaikakāle bhakṣayeyur anyonyasminn upahavam iccheran /
meaning: यत्र क्वचैककाले भक्षयेयुर् अन्योन्यस्मिन्न् उपहवम् इच्छेरन् /
text_mt: Whenever they consume at the same time, they should request an invitation from one another.

sanskrit_iast: dvir aindravāyavaṃ bhakṣayati sakṛtsakṛd itarau /
meaning: द्विर् ऐन्द्रवायवं भक्षयति सकृत्सकृद् इतरौ /
text_mt: He consumes the Aindravāyava [cup] twice, the other two once each.

sanskrit_iast: purastād aindravāyavaṃ prāṇeṣūpanigrāhaṃ purastān maitrāvaruṇaṃ cakṣuṣor upanigrāham̐ sarvataḥ parihāram āśvinam̐ śrotrayor upanigrāham /
meaning: पुरस्ताद् ऐन्द्रवायवं प्राणेषूपनिग्राहं पुरस्तान् मैत्रावरुणं चक्षुषोर् उपनिग्राहम्̐ सर्वतः परिहारम् आश्विनम्̐ श्रोत्रयोर् उपनिग्राहम् /
text_mt: Holding the Aindravāyava cup close to the vital breaths from the front, holding the Maitrāvaruṇa cup close to the eyes from the front, turning the Āśvina cup around all sides and holding it close to the ears.

sanskrit_iast: sarvān bhakṣayitvā nānutsṛjanty āvanayanāt /
meaning: सर्वान् भक्षयित्वा नानुत्सृजन्त्य् आवनयनात् /
text_mt: Having consumed them all, they do not let them go until the pouring out.
