sanskrit_iast: hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayaḥ pāvakās \\ ity eṣā hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayaḥ pāvakās \\ vṛtraṃ bhitvā \ pracakramur hitvāvadyam āpaḥ / \ śataṃ pavitrā vitatā hy āsām \\ tābhir no devaḥ savitā punātu / \ āpo asmān mātaraḥ śudhantu \\ iti ca śaṅkhini hrade hiraṇyam avadhāya sthāvarāsu snāti /
meaning: हिरण्यवर्णाः शुचयः पावकास् \\ इत्य् एषा हिरण्यवर्णाः शुचयः पावकास् \\ वृत्रं भित्वा \ प्रचक्रमुर् हित्वावद्यम् आपः / \ शतं पवित्रा वितता ह्य् आसाम् \\ ताभिर् नो देवः सविता पुनातु / \ आपो अस्मान् मातरः शुधन्तु \\ इति च शङ्खिनि ह्रदे हिरण्यम् अवधाय स्थावरासु स्नाति /
text_mt: With the verse, "Golden-colored, pure, purifying...", with "Golden-colored, pure, purifying, having cleaved Vṛtra, the waters set forth leaving behind defilement; a hundred purifiers are spread out for them; with them may the divine Savitṛ purify us," and with "May the waters, our mothers, purify us," having placed gold in a deep pond having conches, he bathes in standing waters.

sanskrit_iast: yal lomaśam avakāśaṃ tīrthaṃ tasmin snāti kuṇḍe snātīty ekeṣām /
meaning: यल् लोमशम् अवकाशं तीर्थं तस्मिन् स्नाति कुण्डे स्नातीत्य् एकेषाम् /
text_mt: He bathes in a sacred bathing place that has grassy margins; according to some, he bathes in a water-basin.

sanskrit_iast: ud ābhyaḥ śucir ā pūta emi \\ iti snātvodgāhate /
meaning: उद् आभ्यः शुचिर् आ पूत एमि \\ इति स्नात्वोद्गाहते /
text_mt: Having bathed, he emerges with: "I come out of these, pure and purified."

sanskrit_iast: upaspṛśyācamaya //
meaning: उपस्पृश्याचमय //

sanskrit_iast: dīkṣāsi \ tanūr asi tāṃ tvā śivām̐ syonāṃ paridhiṣīya \\ iti kṣaumaṃ vāso 'hataṃ mahat paridhatte somasya tanūr asi \ tanuvaṃ me pāhi \\ iti ca /
meaning: दीक्षासि \ तनूर् असि तां त्वा शिवाम्̐ स्योनां परिधिषीय \\ इति क्षौमं वासो ऽहतं महत् परिधत्ते सोमस्य तनूर् असि \ तनुवं मे पाहि \\ इति च /
text_mt: With: "You are consecration, you are the body; may I put you on, auspicious and soft," and with: "You are Soma's body; protect my body," he puts on an unwashed, large linen garment.

sanskrit_iast: sūryasya vāso 'si \ nīvir nāma \\ ūrjam asmāsu dhehi \\ iti tasya nīvim anuparikalpayate /
meaning: सूर्यस्य वासो ऽसि \ नीविर् नाम \\ ऊर्जम् अस्मासु धेहि \\ इति तस्य नीविम् अनुपरिकल्पयते /
text_mt: With: "You are the garment of the sun, called the hem; place vigor in us," he arranges its hem.

sanskrit_iast: ūrje tvā \\ ity aśnāti \\ ūrjam asmāsu dhehi \\ iti vā yad asya manasaḥ priyaṃ sarpirmiśraṃ dadhi madhu vābhyupasekam /
meaning: ऊर्जे त्वा \\ इत्य् अश्नाति \\ ऊर्जम् अस्मासु धेहि \\ इति वा यद् अस्य मनसः प्रियं सर्पिर्मिश्रं दधि मधु वाभ्युपसेकम् /
text_mt: With: "For vigor, thee," or with: "Place vigor in us," he eats whatever is pleasing to his heart: mixed with clarified butter, or curd, or honey as a topping.

sanskrit_iast: āśito bhavati /
meaning: आशितो भवति /

sanskrit_iast: kanīyaḥkanīyo 'ta ūrdhvaṃ vratayati /
meaning: कनीयःकनीयो ऽत ऊर्ध्वं व्रतयति /
text_mt: From then on, he consumes less and less of the fasting-food.

sanskrit_iast: mahīnāṃ payo 'si \\ iti darbhapuñjīlābhyāṃ gavyaṃ navanītam̐ samudyauti varcodhā asi \ varco mayi dhehi \\ iti tenābhyaṅkte mukham agre 'nulomam itarāṇy aṅgāni svabhyakto bhavati /
meaning: महीनां पयो ऽसि \\ इति दर्भपुञ्जीलाभ्यां गव्यं नवनीतम्̐ समुद्यौति वर्चोधा असि \ वर्चो मयि धेहि \\ इति तेनाभ्यङ्क्ते मुखम् अग्रे ऽनुलोमम् इतराण्य् अङ्गानि स्वभ्यक्तो भवति /
text_mt: With: "You are the milk of the great ones," he mixes cow's butter with two tufts of darbha grass; with: "You are the bestower of luster; place luster in me," he anoints himself with it: his face first, then the other limbs downwards; he is well-anointed.

sanskrit_iast: vṛtrasya kanīnikāsi \\ iti traikakudenāñjanenāṅkte /
meaning: वृत्रस्य कनीनिकासि \\ इति त्रैककुदेनाञ्जनेनाङ्क्ते /
text_mt: With: "You are the pupil of Vṛtra's eye," he anoints his eyes with ointment from Mount Trikakud.

sanskrit_iast: tasminn avidyamāne yenaiva kenacit /
meaning: तस्मिन्न् अविद्यमाने येनैव केनचित् /
text_mt: In the absence of that, with whatever [ointment is available].

sanskrit_iast: satūlayā śareṣīkayā darbheṣīkayā vā darbhapuñjīlena vābhyantaram anidhāvayam̐s trir ekaikaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ pūrvam āṅkte /
meaning: सतूलया शरेषीकया दर्भेषीकया वा दर्भपुञ्जीलेन वाभ्यन्तरम् अनिधावयम्̐स् त्रिर् एकैकं दक्षिणं पूर्वम् आङ्क्ते /
text_mt: With a reed stalk having tufts, or with a stalk of darbha grass, or with a bunch of darbha grass, not letting it run into the interior, he anoints each [eye] three times, the right one first.

sanskrit_iast: dvir vā savyam /
meaning: द्विर् वा सव्यम् /

sanskrit_iast: dvir dakṣiṇam̐ sakṛt savyam ity ekeṣām /
meaning: द्विर् दक्षिणम्̐ सकृत् सव्यम् इत्य् एकेषाम् /
text_mt: According to some, twice the right, once the left.

sanskrit_iast: na punar niṣecayati /
meaning: न पुनर् निषेचयति /

sanskrit_iast: tasya te pavitrapate pavitreṇa \\ iti pāvyamāno japati citpatir mā punātu \ vākpatir mā punātu \ devo mā savitā punātu \\ iti ca pavamānaḥ suvarjanas \\ iti caitam anuvākam //
meaning: तस्य ते पवित्रपते पवित्रेण \\ इति पाव्यमानो जपति चित्पतिर् मा पुनातु \ वाक्पतिर् मा पुनातु \ देवो मा सविता पुनातु \\ इति च पवमानः सुवर्जनस् \\ इति चैतम् अनुवाकम् //
text_mt: While being purified, he whispers: "With that purifier of yours, O lord of the purifier...", and: "May the lord of thought purify me; may the lord of speech purify me; may the divine Savitṛ purify me," and this section beginning with "Pavamāna, who possesses the heavenly world...".

sanskrit_iast: ā vo devāsa īmahe \\ iti pūrveṇa dvāreṇa prāgvam̐śaṃ praviśañ japati /
meaning: आ वो देवास ईमहे \\ इति पूर्वेण द्वारेण प्राग्वम्̐शं प्रविशञ् जपति /
text_mt: With: "We approach you, O gods," he whispers while entering the eastern hall by the eastern door.

sanskrit_iast: vidyud asi \\ ity apa upaspṛśyāpareṇāhavanīyaṃ dakṣiṇātikramya dakṣiṇata upaviśati /
meaning: विद्युद् असि \\ इत्य् अप उपस्पृश्यापरेणाहवनीयं दक्षिणातिक्रम्य दक्षिणत उपविशति /
text_mt: Having touched water with the mantra, "You are lightning," [and] stepped across to the south behind the āhavanīya fire, he sits down to the south.

sanskrit_iast: tasyaiṣa eva saṃcara ā sutyāyāḥ /
meaning: तस्यैष एव संचर आ सुत्यायाः /
text_mt: This indeed is his movement until the soma-pressing.

sanskrit_iast: indrāgnī dyāvāpṛthivī ity āhavanīyam abhimantrayate /
meaning: इन्द्राग्नी द्यावापृथिवी इत्य् आहवनीयम् अभिमन्त्रयते /
text_mt: With [the mantra], "Indra and Agni, heaven and earth," he addresses the āhavanīya fire.

sanskrit_iast: antarvedi kṛṣṇājinasyāstīrṇasya \\ ṛksāmayoḥ śilpe sthas \\ iti śuklakṛṣṇe rājī ālabhate /
meaning: अन्तर्वेदि कृष्णाजिनस्यास्तीर्णस्य \\ ऋक्सामयोः शिल्पे स्थस् \\ इति शुक्लकृष्णे राजी आलभते /
text_mt: He touches the white and black stripes of the black antelope skin spread inside the altar with [the mantra], "You two are the artistic creations of the ṛc and saman."

sanskrit_iast: suśarmāsi \\ iti dakṣiṇato bhasatta ārohati \\ imāṃ dhiyam̐ śikṣamāṇasya deva \\ iti ca sutrāmāṇaṃ pṛthivīṃ dyām anehasam iti ca \\ imām̐ su nāvam āruham iti vā /
meaning: सुशर्मासि \\ इति दक्षिणतो भसत्त आरोहति \\ इमां धियम्̐ शिक्षमाणस्य देव \\ इति च सुत्रामाणं पृथिवीं द्याम् अनेहसम् इति च \\ इमाम्̐ सु नावम् आरुहम् इति वा /
text_mt: With [the mantra], "You are good shelter," he steps onto [it] from the south on the rump portion, and with [the mantra], "O god, of him who strives after this thought," and with [the verse], "The well-protecting earth, the blameless heaven," or with [the verse], "May I embark on this good ship."

sanskrit_iast: āhaṃ dīkṣām aruham ṛtasya patnīṃ gāyatreṇa chandasā brahmaṇā ca \\ ṛtam̐ satye 'dhāyi \ satyam ṛte 'dhāyi \\ ṛtaṃ ca me satyaṃ cābhūtām \\ jyotir abhūvam \\ suvar agamam \\ suvargaṃ lokaṃ nākasya pṛṣṭhaṃ bradhnasya viṣṭapam agamam ity āruhya japati /
meaning: आहं दीक्षाम् अरुहम् ऋतस्य पत्नीं गायत्रेण छन्दसा ब्रह्मणा च \\ ऋतम्̐ सत्ये ऽधायि \ सत्यम् ऋते ऽधायि \\ ऋतं च मे सत्यं चाभूताम् \\ ज्योतिर् अभूवम् \\ सुवर् अगमम् \\ सुवर्गं लोकं नाकस्य पृष्ठं ब्रध्नस्य विष्टपम् अगमम् इत्य् आरुह्य जपति /
text_mt: Having stepped onto [it], he mutters: "I have mounted the consecration, the wife of cosmic order, with the gāyatrī meter and with the brahman. / Cosmic order has been placed in truth; truth has been placed in cosmic order. / Cosmic order and truth have become mine. / I have become light; / I have gone to heaven; / I have gone to the heavenly world, to the back of the firmament, to the summit of the sun."

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇoḥ śarmāsi \\ iti kṛṣṇājinena dakṣiṇam am̐saṃ pracchādayati /
meaning: विष्णोः शर्मासि \\ इति कृष्णाजिनेन दक्षिणम् अम्̐सं प्रच्छादयति /
text_mt: With [the mantra], "You are Viṣṇu's shelter," he covers his right shoulder with the black antelope skin.

sanskrit_iast: nakṣatrāṇāṃ mātīkāśāt pāhi \\ iti vāsasā śiraḥ praveṣṭayate /
meaning: नक्षत्राणां मातीकाशात् पाहि \\ इति वाससा शिरः प्रवेष्टयते /
text_mt: With [the mantra], "Protect me from the sight of the stars," he wraps his head with the cloth.

sanskrit_iast: prattayā kṛṣṇaviṣāṇayā kṛṣyai tvā susasyāyās \\ iti veder loṣṭam uddhanti /
meaning: प्रत्तया कृष्णविषाणया कृष्यै त्वा सुसस्यायास् \\ इति वेदेर् लोष्टम् उद्धन्ति /
text_mt: With the handed-over black buck's horn, he digs up a clod of earth from the altar with [the mantra], "For agriculture, for rich grain, thee!"

sanskrit_iast: supippalābhyas tvauṣadhībhyas \\ iti śirasi kaṇḍūyate /
meaning: सुपिप्पलाभ्यस् त्वौषधीभ्यस् \\ इति शिरसि कण्डूयते /
text_mt: With [the mantra], "For the herbs bearing good fruit, thee!" he scratches his head.

sanskrit_iast: viṣāṇe viṣyaitaṃ granthim \\ yad asya gulphidam̐ hṛdi \ mano yad asya gulphidam ity avaśiṣṭāny aṅgāni /
meaning: विषाणे विष्यैतं ग्रन्थिम् \\ यद् अस्य गुल्फिदम्̐ हृदि \ मनो यद् अस्य गुल्फिदम् इत्य् अवशिष्टान्य् अङ्गानि /
text_mt: With [the mantra], "O horn, loosen this knot / which is tangled in his heart, / the mind which is tangled in him," [he scratches] the remaining limbs.

sanskrit_iast: sūpasthā devo vanaspatis \\ ūrdhvo mā pāhy odṛcas \\ iti daṇḍaṃ pratigṛhṇāti //
meaning: सूपस्था देवो वनस्पतिस् \\ ऊर्ध्वो मा पाह्य् ओदृचस् \\ इति दण्डं प्रतिगृह्णाति //
text_mt: With [the mantra], "The divine tree, providing good lap; / standing upright, protect me until the end of the rite," he receives the staff.

sanskrit_iast: agnir dīkṣitaḥ pṛthivī dīkṣā tayāgnir dīkṣayā dīkṣito yayāgnir dīkṣayā dīkṣitaḥ sā mā dīkṣā dīkṣayatu tayā dīkṣayā dīkṣe
meaning: अग्निर् दीक्षितः पृथिवी दीक्षा तयाग्निर् दीक्षया दीक्षितो ययाग्निर् दीक्षया दीक्षितः सा मा दीक्षा दीक्षयतु तया दीक्षया दीक्षे
text_mt: "Agni is consecrated; the earth is the consecration. With that consecration with which Agni is consecrated, with whichever consecration Agni is consecrated, may that consecration consecrate me; with that consecration I consecrate myself.

sanskrit_iast: vāyur dīkṣito 'ntarikṣaṃ dīkṣā tayā vāyurdīkṣayā dīkṣito yayā vāyurdīkṣayā dīkṣitaḥ sā mā dīkṣā dīkṣāyatu tayā dīkṣayā dīkṣe \\
meaning: वायुर् दीक्षितो ऽन्तरिक्षं दीक्षा तया वायुर्दीक्षया दीक्षितो यया वायुर्दीक्षया दीक्षितः सा मा दीक्षा दीक्षायतु तया दीक्षया दीक्षे \\
text_mt: Vāyu is consecrated; the intermediate space is the consecration. With that consecration with which Vāyu is consecrated, with whichever consecration Vāyu is consecrated, may that consecration consecrate me; with that consecration I consecrate myself.

sanskrit_iast: ādityo dīkṣito dyaur dīkṣā tayādityo dīkṣayā dīkṣito yayādityo dīkṣayā dīkṣitaḥ sā mā dīkṣā dīkṣayatu tayā dīkṣayā dīkṣe
meaning: आदित्यो दीक्षितो द्यौर् दीक्षा तयादित्यो दीक्षया दीक्षितो ययादित्यो दीक्षया दीक्षितः सा मा दीक्षा दीक्षयतु तया दीक्षया दीक्षे
text_mt: Āditya is consecrated; the sky is the consecration. With that consecration with which Āditya is consecrated, with whichever consecration Āditya is consecrated, may that consecration consecrate me; with that consecration I consecrate myself.

sanskrit_iast: candramā dīkṣito nakṣatrāṇi dīkṣā tayā candramā dīkṣayā dīkṣito yayā candramā dīkṣayā dīkṣitaḥ sā mā dīkṣā dīkṣayatu tayā dīkṣayā dīkṣe
meaning: चन्द्रमा दीक्षितो नक्षत्राणि दीक्षा तया चन्द्रमा दीक्षया दीक्षितो यया चन्द्रमा दीक्षया दीक्षितः सा मा दीक्षा दीक्षयतु तया दीक्षया दीक्षे
text_mt: The moon is consecrated; the constellations are the consecration. With that consecration with which the moon is consecrated, with whichever consecration the moon is consecrated, may that consecration consecrate me; with that consecration I consecrate myself.

sanskrit_iast: varuṇo rājā dīkṣita āpo dīkṣā tayā varuṇo rājā dīkṣayā dīkṣito yayā varuṇo rājā dīkṣayā dīkṣitaḥ sā mā dīkṣā dīkṣayatu tayā dīkṣayā dīkṣe
meaning: वरुणो राजा दीक्षित आपो दीक्षा तया वरुणो राजा दीक्षया दीक्षितो यया वरुणो राजा दीक्षया दीक्षितः सा मा दीक्षा दीक्षयतु तया दीक्षया दीक्षे
text_mt: King Varuṇa is consecrated; the waters are the consecration. With that consecration with which King Varuṇa is consecrated, with whichever consecration King Varuṇa is consecrated, may that consecration consecrate me; with that consecration I consecrate myself.

sanskrit_iast: somo rājā dīkṣita oṣadhayo dīkṣā tayā somo rājā dīkṣayā dīkṣito yayā somo rājā dīkṣayā dīkṣitaḥ sā mā dīkṣā dīkṣayatu tayā dīkṣayā dīkṣe
meaning: सोमो राजा दीक्षित ओषधयो दीक्षा तया सोमो राजा दीक्षया दीक्षितो यया सोमो राजा दीक्षया दीक्षितः सा मा दीक्षा दीक्षयतु तया दीक्षया दीक्षे
text_mt: King Soma is consecrated; the herbs are the consecration. With that consecration with which King Soma is consecrated, with whichever consecration King Soma is consecrated, may that consecration consecrate me; with that consecration I consecrate myself.

sanskrit_iast: prāṇo dīkṣito vāg dīkṣā tayā prāṇo dīkṣayā dīkṣito yayā prāṇo dīkṣayā dīkṣitaḥ sā mā dīkṣā dīkṣayatu tayā dīkṣayā dīkṣe
meaning: प्राणो दीक्षितो वाग् दीक्षा तया प्राणो दीक्षया दीक्षितो यया प्राणो दीक्षया दीक्षितः सा मा दीक्षा दीक्षयतु तया दीक्षया दीक्षे
text_mt: Out-breath is consecrated; speech is the consecration. With that consecration with which out-breath is consecrated, with whichever consecration out-breath is consecrated, may that consecration consecrate me; with that consecration I consecrate myself.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatir dīkṣito mano dīkṣā tayā prajāpatir dīkṣayā dīkṣito yayā prajāpatir dīkṣayā dīkṣitaḥ sā mā dīkṣā dīkṣayatu tayā dīkṣayā dīkṣe
meaning: प्रजापतिर् दीक्षितो मनो दीक्षा तया प्रजापतिर् दीक्षया दीक्षितो यया प्रजापतिर् दीक्षया दीक्षितः सा मा दीक्षा दीक्षयतु तया दीक्षया दीक्षे
text_mt: Prajāpati is consecrated; the mind is the consecration. With that consecration with which Prajāpati is consecrated, with whichever consecration Prajāpati is consecrated, may that consecration consecrate me; with that consecration I consecrate myself.

sanskrit_iast: vācā me vāg dīkṣatām agnaye samaṣṭavā u \ prāṇena me prāṇo dīkṣatāṃ vāyave samaṣṭavā u \ cakṣuṣā me cakṣur dīkṣatām̐ sūryāya samaṣṭavā u \ manasā me mano dīkṣatāṃ prajāpataye samaṣṭavā u \ dyauś ca pṛthivī cāhaś ca rātriś ca kṛṣiś ca vṛṣṭiś ca tviṣiś cāpacitiś cāpaś cauṣadhayaś cork ca sūnṛtā ca tā mā dīkṣamāṇam anu dīkṣantām \\ bhūr bhuvaḥ suvaḥ \ satyaṃ ma ātmā \ śraddhā me kṣitis \ tapo me pratiṣṭhā \ śraddhā satyaṃ gṛhapatis \\ iti keśinīṃ dīkṣāṃ japitvā
meaning: वाचा मे वाग् दीक्षताम् अग्नये समष्टवा उ \ प्राणेन मे प्राणो दीक्षतां वायवे समष्टवा उ \ चक्षुषा मे चक्षुर् दीक्षताम्̐ सूर्याय समष्टवा उ \ मनसा मे मनो दीक्षतां प्रजापतये समष्टवा उ \ द्यौश् च पृथिवी चाहश् च रात्रिश् च कृषिश् च वृष्टिश् च त्विषिश् चापचितिश् चापश् चौषधयश् चोर्क् च सूनृता च ता मा दीक्षमाणम् अनु दीक्षन्ताम् \\ भूर् भुवः सुवः \ सत्यं म आत्मा \ श्रद्धा मे क्षितिस् \ तपो मे प्रतिष्ठा \ श्रद्धा सत्यं गृहपतिस् \\ इति केशिनीं दीक्षां जपित्वा
text_mt: May my speech be consecrated together with speech for attainment unto Agni; may my out-breath be consecrated together with out-breath for attainment unto Vāyu; may my eye be consecrated together with the eye for attainment unto Sūrya; may my mind be consecrated together with the mind for attainment unto Prajāpati. Sky and earth, day and night, agriculture and rain, splendour and honour, waters and herbs, and strength and benevolent speech—may they follow me in consecration as I am consecrated. / Bhūr bhuvaḥ suvaḥ! Truth is my soul; faith is my dwelling; ascetic heat is my support; faith and truth are the householder." Having muttered this Keśin-consecration,

sanskrit_iast: svāhā yajñaṃ manasā \\ iti dve aṅgulī nirbhujati svāhā dyāvāpṛthivībhyām iti dve svāhoror antarikṣāt \\ iti dve svāhā yajñaṃ vātād ārabhe \\ iti muṣṭī kṛtvā \\ eṣṭrīḥ stha \\ iti catasro 'ṅgulīrutsṛjati tābhiryathāsukhaṃ carati vācaṃ ca yacchati /
meaning: स्वाहा यज्ञं मनसा \\ इति द्वे अङ्गुली निर्भुजति स्वाहा द्यावापृथिवीभ्याम् इति द्वे स्वाहोरोर् अन्तरिक्षात् \\ इति द्वे स्वाहा यज्ञं वाताद् आरभे \\ इति मुष्टी कृत्वा \\ एष्ट्रीः स्थ \\ इति चतस्रो ऽङ्गुलीरुत्सृजति ताभिर्यथासुखं चरति वाचं च यच्छति /
text_mt: he bends down two fingers with [the formula], "Svāhā, the sacrifice with the mind!"; two with, "Svāhā, to heaven and earth!"; two with, "Svāhā, from the broad intermediate space!"; having formed fists with, "Svāhā, I commence the sacrifice from the wind!", he releases four fingers with, "You are seekers!" With them he acts at ease, and restrains his speech.

sanskrit_iast: yadi pramatto vyāhared vaiṣṇavīm āgnāvaiṣṇavīm̐ sārasvatīṃ bārhaspatyām ity anūcya vyāhṛtīś ca punar vācaṃ yacchati /
meaning: यदि प्रमत्तो व्याहरेद् वैष्णवीम् आग्नावैष्णवीम्̐ सारस्वतीं बार्हस्पत्याम् इत्य् अनूच्य व्याहृतीश् च पुनर् वाचं यच्छति /
text_mt: If through negligence he should utter [speech], having recited a [verse] addressed to Viṣṇu, to Agni and Viṣṇu, to Sarasvatī, or to Bṛhaspati, and the sacred utterances, he restrains his speech again.

sanskrit_iast: nānṛtaṃ vadati /
meaning: नानृतं वदति /

sanskrit_iast: na mām̐sam aśnāti /
meaning: न माम्̐सम् अश्नाति /

sanskrit_iast: na striyam upaiti /
meaning: न स्त्रियम् उपैति /

sanskrit_iast: nopary āste /
meaning: नोपर्य् आस्ते /

sanskrit_iast: na niṣṭhīvate /
meaning: न निष्ठीवते /

sanskrit_iast: na dato dhavate /
meaning: न दतो धवते /

sanskrit_iast: nāviṣkurute /
meaning: नाविष्कुरुते /

sanskrit_iast: nānatau smayetāpigṛhya smayeta /
meaning: नानतौ स्मयेतापिगृह्य स्मयेत /
text_mt: He should not smile without covering [his mouth]; he should smile having covered [it].

sanskrit_iast: abaddhaṃ manas ity amedhyaṃ dṛṣṭvā japati /
meaning: अबद्धं मनस् इत्य् अमेध्यं दृष्ट्वा जपति /
text_mt: Having seen an impure thing, he mutters, "Unbound is the mind."

sanskrit_iast: undatīr balaṃ dhatta \\ ity abhivṛṣyamāṇo japati /
meaning: उन्दतीर् बलं धत्त \\ इत्य् अभिवृष्यमाणो जपति /
text_mt: Being rained upon, he mutters, "O wetting [waters], bestow strength!"

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇena vihāraṃ dīkṣitāgāre viharati //
meaning: दक्षिणेन विहारं दीक्षितागारे विहरति //
text_mt: He moves about south of the sacrificial area in the shed for the consecrated.

sanskrit_iast: nānyatra kṛṣṇājinād āste śete vā /
meaning: नान्यत्र कृष्णाजिनाद् आस्ते शेते वा /
text_mt: He does not sit or lie down anywhere other than on the black antelope skin.

sanskrit_iast: nainam anyatra dīkṣitavimitāt sūryo 'bhinimrocen nābhyudiyāt /
meaning: नैनम् अन्यत्र दीक्षितविमितात् सूर्यो ऽभिनिम्रोचेन् नाभ्युदियात् /
text_mt: The sun should neither set nor rise over him anywhere other than inside the hut of the consecrated.

sanskrit_iast: naktam eva mūtrapurīṣe kuryād divā vā chāyāyām /
meaning: नक्तम् एव मूत्रपुरीषे कुर्याद् दिवा वा छायायाम् /
text_mt: Only at night should he discharge urine and feces, or by day in the shade.

sanskrit_iast: mūtraṃ cikīrṣan \\ iyaṃ te yajñiyā tanūr iti viṣāṇayā loṣṭaṃ kiṃcid vopahatya tad ādāya \\ apo muñcāmi na prajām \ am̐homucaḥ svāhākṛtāḥ pṛthivīm āviśata \\ iti prasrāvayaty apa upaspṛśyācamya pṛthivyām̐ saṃbhava \\ iti tat pratinidadhāti pṛthivyāḥ saṃbhava \\ iti vā /
meaning: मूत्रं चिकीर्षन् \\ इयं ते यज्ञिया तनूर् इति विषाणया लोष्टं किंचिद् वोपहत्य तद् आदाय \\ अपो मुञ्चामि न प्रजाम् \ अम्̐होमुचः स्वाहाकृताः पृथिवीम् आविशत \\ इति प्रस्रावयत्य् अप उपस्पृश्याचम्य पृथिव्याम्̐ संभव \\ इति तत् प्रतिनिदधाति पृथिव्याः संभव \\ इति वा /
text_mt: Wishing to pass urine, having struck a clod of earth or something [similar] with the horn with [the formula], "This is your sacrificial body," and having taken it, he urinates with [the formula], "I release the waters, not offspring; released from distress, consecrated with svāhā, enter the earth!"; having touched water and sipped, he puts it back with, "Be born upon the earth!", or with, "Be born from the earth!"

sanskrit_iast: nainam̐ śūdro 'nupraviśati /
meaning: नैनम्̐ शूद्रो ऽनुप्रविशति /
text_mt: A Śūdra does not enter after him.

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇena rājanyena vaiśyena vā saṃbhāṣeta /
meaning: ब्राह्मणेन राजन्येन वैश्येन वा संभाषेत /
text_mt: He should converse with a Brāhmaṇa, a Rājanya, or a Vaiśya.

sanskrit_iast: na kaṃcana pratyuttiṣṭhati /
meaning: न कंचन प्रत्युत्तिष्ठति /
text_mt: He does not rise up to meet anyone.

sanskrit_iast: nābhivādayate /
meaning: नाभिवादयते /

sanskrit_iast: sarva evainam abhivādayeran sarvān evābhivadet /
meaning: सर्व एवैनम् अभिवादयेरन् सर्वान् एवाभिवदेत् /
text_mt: All indeed should greet him, and he should address all.

sanskrit_iast: yady enam̐ śūdreṇa saṃbhāṣopeyād eteṣāṃ varṇānām ekaṃ brūyād imam itthaṃ vicakṣva \\ iti /
meaning: यद्य् एनम्̐ शूद्रेण संभाषोपेयाद् एतेषां वर्णानाम् एकं ब्रूयाद् इमम् इत्थं विचक्ष्व \\ इति /
text_mt: If a conversation with a Śūdra should occur to him, he should say to one of these [three] classes: "Report this to him thus."

sanskrit_iast: laukikīṃ vācaṃ vadan nāmadheyeṣu vicakṣaṇaṃ canasitaṃ cāntato dadhāti /
meaning: लौकिकीं वाचं वदन् नामधेयेषु विचक्षणं चनसितं चान्ततो दधाति /
text_mt: When speaking worldly speech, he adds 'vicakṣaṇa' (far-seeing) or 'canasita' (pleasing) at the end of names.

sanskrit_iast: na pacati na dadāti na kāṃcanāhutiṃ juhoty anyatra kratusaṃyuktābhyaḥ /
meaning: न पचति न ददाति न कांचनाहुतिं जुहोत्य् अन्यत्र क्रतुसंयुक्ताभ्यः /
text_mt: He does not cook, he does not give, he does not offer any oblation except those connected with the sacrificial rite.

sanskrit_iast: tad ahar dīkṣito rātriṃ jāgarti /
meaning: तद् अहर् दीक्षितो रात्रिं जागर्ति /
text_mt: On the day he is consecrated, he stays awake during the night.

sanskrit_iast: na vrataṃ bhavati /
meaning: न व्रतं भवति /

sanskrit_iast: nakṣatraṃ dṛṣṭvā tūṣṇīm eva vācaṃ visṛjate /
meaning: नक्षत्रं दृष्ट्वा तूष्णीम् एव वाचं विसृजते /
text_mt: Having seen a constellation, he releases his speech silently.

sanskrit_iast: yatrainaṃ vratapradaḥ saṃpreṣyati tasmin kāle vācaṃ yacchati //
meaning: यत्रैनं व्रतप्रदः संप्रेष्यति तस्मिन् काले वाचं यच्छति //
text_mt: At whatever time the one who gives the fast-food issues the direction, at that time he restrains his speech.

sanskrit_iast: yāḥ paśūnām ṛṣabhe vācas tāḥ sūryo agre śukro agre tāḥ prahiṇyo yathābhāgaṃ vo atra \ śivā nastāḥ punar āyantu vācas \\ ity udyantam ādityam upatiṣṭhate /
meaning: याः पशूनाम् ऋषभे वाचस् ताः सूर्यो अग्रे शुक्रो अग्रे ताः प्रहिण्यो यथाभागं वो अत्र \ शिवा नस्ताः पुनर् आयन्तु वाचस् \\ इत्य् उद्यन्तम् आदित्यम् उपतिष्ठते /
text_mt: With the verse, "Those voices of the animals that are in the bull, those the sun in the beginning, the bright one in the beginning, sent forth according to your share here; / may those auspicious voices come back to us," he attends upon the rising sun.

sanskrit_iast: udita āditye vrataṃ kṛṇuta \\ iti saṃpreṣyati /
meaning: उदित आदित्ये व्रतं कृणुत \\ इति संप्रेष्यति /
text_mt: When the sun has risen, he gives the direction: "Prepare the fast-food!"

sanskrit_iast: evam astamite /
meaning: एवम् अस्तमिते /

sanskrit_iast: madhyaṃdine madhyarātre ca vratayati /
meaning: मध्यंदिने मध्यरात्रे च व्रतयति /
text_mt: At midday and at midnight he consumes the fast-food.

sanskrit_iast: nainam adīkṣitā vratayantaṃ paśyanti /
meaning: नैनम् अदीक्षिता व्रतयन्तं पश्यन्ति /
text_mt: The uninitiated do not see him consuming the fast food.

sanskrit_iast: payo brāhmaṇasya yavāgū rājanyasyāmikṣā vaiśyasya /
meaning: पयो ब्राह्मणस्य यवागू राजन्यस्यामिक्षा वैश्यस्य /
text_mt: Milk is for a brāhmaṇa, barley gruel for a rājanya, curd-curds for a vaiśya.

sanskrit_iast: ekadugdhaṃ yavāgūṃ vaikadugdhe /
meaning: एकदुग्धं यवागूं वैकदुग्धे /
text_mt: Or the milk of a single cow, or barley gruel cooked in the milk of a single cow.

sanskrit_iast: yadi dadhīyād etad asmai dadhi kuryuḥ /
meaning: यदि दधीयाद् एतद् अस्मै दधि कुर्युः /
text_mt: If he should desire curd, they should make this curd for him.

sanskrit_iast: yadyan nīyād dhānā asmā anvāvapeyuḥ saktūn vāsmā anvāvapeyur ghṛtaṃ vāsmā anvāvapeyuḥ /
meaning: यद्यन् नीयाद् धाना अस्मा अन्वावपेयुः सक्तून् वास्मा अन्वावपेयुर् घृतं वास्मा अन्वावपेयुः /
text_mt: If he should desire solid food, they should scatter parched grains into it for him, or they should scatter roasted barley flour into it for him, or they should scatter clarified butter into it for him.

sanskrit_iast: api vāgnihotrahaviṣām ekaṃ vratayet /
meaning: अपि वाग्निहोत्रहविषाम् एकं व्रतयेत् /
text_mt: Or he may consume one of the Agnihotra sacrificial oblations as fast food.

sanskrit_iast: sārvavarṇikā ete vratakalpāḥ /
meaning: सार्ववर्णिका एते व्रतकल्पाः /
text_mt: These fast-food rules apply to all social classes.

sanskrit_iast: sarveṣām upasatsu stanakalpāḥ /
meaning: सर्वेषाम् उपसत्सु स्तनकल्पाः /
text_mt: During the upasad rites, the rules regarding the teats apply to all.

sanskrit_iast: uruvyacā asi janadhāḥ svabhakṣo mā pāhi \\ iti kam̐saṃ vratapradānam anumantrayate /
meaning: उरुव्यचा असि जनधाः स्वभक्षो मा पाहि \\ इति कम्̐सं व्रतप्रदानम् अनुमन्त्रयते /
text_mt: With 'You are wide-extending, supporter of people, having your own food; protect me', he recites over the metal cup containing the fast food.

sanskrit_iast: daivīṃ dhiyaṃ manāmahe \\ iti hastāv avanenikte /
meaning: दैवीं धियं मनामहे \\ इति हस्ताव् अवनेनिक्ते /
text_mt: With 'We invoke divine wisdom', he washes both hands.

sanskrit_iast: ye devā manojātā manoyujas \\ iti vratayati /
meaning: ये देवा मनोजाता मनोयुजस् \\ इति व्रतयति /
text_mt: With 'Which gods, mind-born, mind-yoked', he consumes the fast food.

sanskrit_iast: śivāḥ pītā bhavatha yajñiyāso yūyam āpas \\ asmākaṃ yonāv udare suśevāḥ / \ irāvatīḥ pururūpā anāgasaḥ \ śivā no bhavatha pītaye \\ ity udakaṃ pibati yadāpītaṃ bhavati yadā pipāsati /
meaning: शिवाः पीता भवथ यज्ञियासो यूयम् आपस् \\ अस्माकं योनाव् उदरे सुशेवाः / \ इरावतीः पुरुरूपा अनागसः \ शिवा नो भवथ पीतये \\ इत्य् उदकं पिबति यदापीतं भवति यदा पिपासति /
text_mt: With 'Auspicious when drunk may you be, sacrificial waters, gracious to our belly, our womb; rich in food, manifold, sinless, be auspicious to us for drinking', he drinks water whenever it has been drunk or whenever he is thirsty.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇenāhavanīyaṃ prāṅ śete /
meaning: दक्षिणेनाहवनीयं प्राङ् शेते /
text_mt: He lies down south of the āhavanīya fire, facing east,

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇena pārśvena /
meaning: दक्षिणेन पार्श्वेन /

sanskrit_iast: nottānaḥ śayīta /
meaning: नोत्तानः शयीत /

sanskrit_iast: nāgneḥ parāṅ paryāvarteta /
meaning: नाग्नेः पराङ् पर्यावर्तेत /
text_mt: He should not turn away from the fire.

sanskrit_iast: agne tvam̐ su jāgṛhi \\ iti svapsyann āhavanīyam upatiṣṭhate /
meaning: अग्ने त्वम्̐ सु जागृहि \\ इति स्वप्स्यन्न् आहवनीयम् उपतिष्ठते /
text_mt: About to sleep, he reverences the āhavanīya fire with 'O Agni, do you keep good watch'.

sanskrit_iast: viśve devā abhi mām āvavṛtran \\ ity upaparyāvartate yady apaparyāvarteta /
meaning: विश्वे देवा अभि माम् आववृत्रन् \\ इत्य् उपपर्यावर्तते यद्य् अपपर्यावर्तेत /
text_mt: With 'May all the gods turn toward me', he turns towards [the fire] if he should have turned away.

sanskrit_iast: punar manaḥ punar āyur ma āgāt \ punaś cakṣuḥ punaḥ śrotraṃ ma āgāt \ punaḥ prāṇaḥ punar ākūtaṃ ma āgāt \ punaś cittaṃ punar ādhītaṃ ma āgāt \\ vaiśvānaro me 'dabdhas tanūpās \\ antas tiṣṭhatu duritāni viśvā / \ vaiśvānaro viśvabhṛd viśvaśaṃbhūs \\ avabādhatāṃ duritāni viśvā \ sa no divā sa riṣaḥ pātu naktam \\ tvam agne vratapā asi \\ iti pratibudhya japati /
meaning: पुनर् मनः पुनर् आयुर् म आगात् \ पुनश् चक्षुः पुनः श्रोत्रं म आगात् \ पुनः प्राणः पुनर् आकूतं म आगात् \ पुनश् चित्तं पुनर् आधीतं म आगात् \\ वैश्वानरो मे ऽदब्धस् तनूपास् \\ अन्तस् तिष्ठतु दुरितानि विश्वा / \ वैश्वानरो विश्वभृद् विश्वशंभूस् \\ अवबाधतां दुरितानि विश्वा \ स नो दिवा स रिषः पातु नक्तम् \\ त्वम् अग्ने व्रतपा असि \\ इति प्रतिबुध्य जपति /
text_mt:
Having awakened, he mutters: 'Back mind, back life has come to me; back sight, back hearing has come to me; back breath, back intention has come to me; back thought, back meditation has come to me. May Vaiśvānara, unbeguiled, the protector of my body, abide within against all misfortunes. May Vaiśvānara, all-sustaining, all-beneficent, thrust away all misfortunes. May he protect us from injury by day, he by night. You, O Agni, are the protector of the ritual observance'.

He should repeat: 'You, O Agni, are the protector of the ritual observance', whenever he utters words unsuited for an initiated person,

sanskrit_iast: tvam agne vratapā asi \\ ity anubrūyād yadyad īkṣitavādaṃ vadet /
meaning: त्वम् अग्ने व्रतपा असि \\ इत्य् अनुब्रूयाद् यद्यद् ईक्षितवादं वदेत् /

sanskrit_iast: muṣṭī vācaṃ ca visarjayitvā /
meaning: मुष्टी वाचं च विसर्जयित्वा /
text_mt: having released his fists and his speech.

sanskrit_iast: dīkṣaṇīyāprabhṛtīyaṃ vṛttiḥ /
meaning: दीक्षणीयाप्रभृतीयं वृत्तिः /
text_mt: This conduct begins from the initiation rite.

sanskrit_iast: daṇḍān na cchidyate na pratimucya kṛṣṇājinaṃ caṃkramyate kṛṣṇaviṣāṇayā kaṇḍūyate 'pigṛhya smayata ity upayogaprabhṛtīny etāni vratāni bhavanti //
meaning: दण्डान् न च्छिद्यते न प्रतिमुच्य कृष्णाजिनं चंक्रम्यते कृष्णविषाणया कण्डूयते ऽपिगृह्य स्मयत इत्य् उपयोगप्रभृतीन्य् एतानि व्रतानि भवन्ति //
text_mt: He is not separated from his staff; he does not walk about having taken off the black-antelope skin; he scratches himself with the black-antelope horn; covering [his mouth], he smiles—these ritual observances begin from their application.

sanskrit_iast: pūṣā sanyā \\ iti sanīhārān sam̐śāsti /
meaning: पूषा सन्या \\ इति सनीहारान् सम्̐शास्ति /
text_mt: With 'Pūṣan through gifts', he instructs those who carry the gifts.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśāhaṃ bhikṣācaryaṃ caraty aparimite dīkṣākalpe parimite yāthākāmī /
meaning: द्वादशाहं भिक्षाचर्यं चरत्य् अपरिमिते दीक्षाकल्पे परिमिते याथाकामी /
text_mt: He carries out the begging tour for twelve days when the initiation procedure is indefinite; when it is definite, at will.

sanskrit_iast: hiraṇyaṃ vāso gāmaśvaṃ chāgaṃ meṣaṃ ca yāvat parimitā gāva ekaikam itareṣāṃ jātīnām /
meaning: हिरण्यं वासो गामश्वं छागं मेषं च यावत् परिमिता गाव एकैकम् इतरेषां जातीनाम् /
text_mt: Gold, a garment, a cow, a horse, a goat, and a ram—as many cattle as are prescribed, and one of each of the other kinds.

sanskrit_iast: tāni pratigṛhṇāti candram asi \\ ity etair yathārūpam /
meaning: तानि प्रतिगृह्णाति चन्द्रम् असि \\ इत्य् एतैर् यथारूपम् /
text_mt: He accepts them with 'You are the moon' and so forth, according to their form.

sanskrit_iast: devaḥ savitā \\ iti sarvatrānuṣajati /
meaning: देवः सविता \\ इति सर्वत्रानुषजति /
text_mt: He subjoins 'May the god Savitṛ...' everywhere.

sanskrit_iast: vāyave tvā \\ iti tāsāṃ yā naśyet tām anudiśet /
meaning: वायवे त्वा \\ इति तासां या नश्येत् ताम् अनुदिशेत् /
text_mt: Whichever of them should perish, he should assign it with 'To Vāyu, you'.

sanskrit_iast: varuṇāya tvā \\ ity apsu magnām /
meaning: वरुणाय त्वा \\ इत्य् अप्सु मग्नाम् /
text_mt: One drowned in water with 'To Varuṇa, you'.

sanskrit_iast: nirṛtyai tvā \\ ity avasannām /
meaning: निरृत्यै त्वा \\ इत्य् अवसन्नाम् /
text_mt: One sunk down [in mud or exhaustion] with 'To Nirṛti, you'.

sanskrit_iast: rudrāya tvā \\ iti sarpadaṣṭāṃ marudbhyas tvā \\ iti hrādunihatām aśanihatāṃ vā \\ indrāya tvā \\ iti meṣkahatāṃ yamāya tvā \\ iti mahādevahatāṃ mṛtyave tvā \\ ity avijñātena mṛtyunā /
meaning: रुद्राय त्वा \\ इति सर्पदष्टां मरुद्भ्यस् त्वा \\ इति ह्रादुनिहताम् अशनिहतां वा \\ इन्द्राय त्वा \\ इति मेष्कहतां यमाय त्वा \\ इति महादेवहतां मृत्यवे त्वा \\ इत्य् अविज्ञातेन मृत्युना /
text_mt: One bitten by a snake with 'To Rudra, you'; one struck by hail or struck by lightning with 'To the Maruts, you'; one struck by a wolf with 'To Indra, you'; one struck by Mahādeva with 'To Yama, you'; one struck by an unknown death with 'To Death, you'.

sanskrit_iast: anudiṣṭām adhigamya yajamāno goṣu na cārayet /
meaning: अनुदिष्टाम् अधिगम्य यजमानो गोषु न चारयेत् /
text_mt: Having recovered one that was assigned, the sacrificer should not pasture it among the cattle.

sanskrit_iast: yadi prayāyāt pṛthag araṇīṣv agnīn samāropya rathena prayāti /
meaning: यदि प्रयायात् पृथग् अरणीष्व् अग्नीन् समारोप्य रथेन प्रयाति /
text_mt: If he should set forth, having mounted the fires separately onto the kindling sticks, he sets forth in a chariot.

sanskrit_iast: rathe 'vidyamāne rathāṅgena saha /
meaning: रथे ऽविद्यमाने रथाङ्गेन सह /
text_mt: If there is no chariot, along with a chariot part.

sanskrit_iast: yady apo nāvyās taraty araṇī rathaṃ cādhāya saha tarati /
meaning: यद्य् अपो नाव्यास् तरत्य् अरणी रथं चाधाय सह तरति /
text_mt: If he crosses navigable waters, having placed the kindling sticks and the chariot [in the boat], he crosses along with them.

sanskrit_iast: yady apo 'nāvyā rathena tarati harati caināḥ /
meaning: यद्य् अपो ऽनाव्या रथेन तरति हरति चैनाः /
text_mt: If he crosses non-navigable waters, he crosses by chariot and conveys them across.

sanskrit_iast: yady avagāheta devīr āpas \\ ity avagāheta /
meaning: यद्य् अवगाहेत देवीर् आपस् \\ इत्य् अवगाहेत /
text_mt: If he should plunge into the water, he should plunge in with 'Divine waters'.

sanskrit_iast: acchinnaṃ tantuṃ pṛthivyā anugeṣam \ apām̐ setur asi \\ iti loṣṭaṃ vimṛdgann ā pārād gantos tarati /
meaning: अच्छिन्नं तन्तुं पृथिव्या अनुगेषम् \ अपाम्̐ सेतुर् असि \\ इति लोष्टं विमृद्गन्न् आ पाराद् गन्तोस् तरति /
text_mt: With 'May I follow the unbroken thread of the earth. You are the dam across the waters', crushing a clod of earth, he crosses over until reaching the other bank,

sanskrit_iast: pṛthivyāḥ saṃbhava \\ iti //
meaning: पृथिव्याः संभव \\ इति //
text_mt: with 'Originated from the earth'.

sanskrit_iast: sikatā loṣṭān vā madhye tīrayoś ca nyasyati pṛthivyā saṃbhava \\ iti vā /
meaning: सिकता लोष्टान् वा मध्ये तीरयोश् च न्यस्यति पृथिव्या संभव \\ इति वा /
text_mt: He throws sand or clods of earth in the middle and at the two banks, or with 'Originated from the earth'.

sanskrit_iast: atra devayajanādhyavasānam eke samāmananti /
meaning: अत्र देवयजनाध्यवसानम् एके समामनन्ति /
text_mt: Here, some teachers hand down the taking possession of the place of sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: prāgvam̐śasya madhyamam̐ sthūṇārājam ālabhyainaṃ mantraṃ japati /
meaning: प्राग्वम्̐शस्य मध्यमम्̐ स्थूणाराजम् आलभ्यैनं मन्त्रं जपति /
text_mt: Touching the middle main post of the eastern hall, he mutters this mantra.

sanskrit_iast: ekarātraṃ dīkṣito rājānaṃ krīṇāti dvyahe tryahe caturahe 'parimite vā /
meaning: एकरात्रं दीक्षितो राजानं क्रीणाति द्व्यहे त्र्यहे चतुरहे ऽपरिमिते वा /
text_mt: Initiated for one night, he buys king [Soma], or on the second day, on the third day, on the fourth day, or after an indefinite time.

sanskrit_iast: prattaṃ padaṃ tote rāyas \\ iti patnyai prayacchati tava te rāyas \\ iti vā /
meaning: प्रत्तं पदं तोते रायस् \\ इति पत्न्यै प्रयच्छति तव ते रायस् \\ इति वा /
text_mt: With 'Given is the footprint; for you is wealth', he hands over [the dust of the footprint] to the sacrificer's wife, or with 'Yours is that wealth'.

sanskrit_iast: krīyamāṇasya rājño dakṣiṇata āste /
meaning: क्रीयमाणस्य राज्ञो दक्षिणत आस्ते /
text_mt: He sits south of the king [Soma] while he is being bought.

sanskrit_iast: krīte some maitrāvaruṇāya daṇḍaṃ prayacchati /
meaning: क्रीते सोमे मैत्रावरुणाय दण्डं प्रयच्छति /
text_mt: When the soma has been bought, he hands over the staff to the maitrāvaruṇa priest,

sanskrit_iast: śvaḥ sutyāyāṃ vā kriyamāṇāyām /
meaning: श्वः सुत्यायां वा क्रियमाणायाम् /
text_mt: or when the pressing day is about to take place on the morrow.

sanskrit_iast: vayaḥ suparṇās iti pratyaporṇute śiro 'gre 'nupūrvam itarāṇy aṅgāni /
meaning: वयः सुपर्णास् इति प्रत्यपोर्णुते शिरो ऽग्रे ऽनुपूर्वम् इतराण्य् अङ्गानि /
text_mt: With 'The winged birds', he uncovers himself, first the head and then the other limbs in order.

sanskrit_iast: mitro na ehi sumitradhās \\ ity ūrāv āsannam̐ rājānamupasvaja upaiva gṛhṇīte /
meaning: मित्रो न एहि सुमित्रधास् \\ इत्य् ऊराव् आसन्नम्̐ राजानमुपस्वज उपैव गृह्णीते /
text_mt: With 'Come to us as Mitra, conferring good friends', he embraces king [Soma] who has approached his thighs, and indeed takes hold of him.

sanskrit_iast: ud āyuṣā \\ ity uttiṣṭhati /
meaning: उद् आयुषा \\ इत्य् उत्तिष्ठति /
text_mt: With 'Up with life', he stands up.

sanskrit_iast: urv antarikṣam iti gacchati /
meaning: उर्व् अन्तरिक्षम् इति गच्छति /
text_mt: With 'The wide intermediate space', he walks.

sanskrit_iast: śakaṭaṃ prāpyādhvaryave rājānaṃ pradadāti /
meaning: शकटं प्राप्याध्वर्यवे राजानं प्रददाति /
text_mt: Having reached the cart, he hands over king [Soma] to the adhvaryu.

sanskrit_iast: namo mitrasya varuṇasya cakṣase \\ iti prāgvam̐śam ohyamānaṃ pratīkṣate /
meaning: नमो मित्रस्य वरुणस्य चक्षसे \\ इति प्राग्वम्̐शम् ओह्यमानं प्रतीक्षते /
text_mt: With 'Homage to the eye of Mitra and Varuṇa', he looks at him being carried to the eastern hall.

sanskrit_iast: anu me dīkṣāṃ dīkṣāpatir manyatām iti tānūnapram̐ samavamṛśati /
meaning: अनु मे दीक्षां दीक्षापतिर् मन्यताम् इति तानूनप्रम्̐ समवमृशति /
text_mt: With 'May the lord of initiation approve my initiation', he touches the tānūnaptra butter.

sanskrit_iast: tantriṣu vrateṣu pratipanno bhakṣayati yad adhvaryur nāvajighrati /
meaning: तन्त्रिषु व्रतेषु प्रतिपन्नो भक्षयति यद् अध्वर्युर् नावजिघ्रति /
text_mt: Engaged in the fast-food observances belonging to the ritual framework, he consumes what the adhvaryu does not smell.

sanskrit_iast: agne vratapate \\ ity avāntaradīkṣām upaiti /
meaning: अग्ने व्रतपते \\ इत्य् अवान्तरदीक्षाम् उपैति /
text_mt: With 'O Agni, lord of vows', he enters upon the intermediate initiation.

sanskrit_iast: saṃtarāṃ mekhalām̐ samāyacchate saṃtarāṃ muṣṭī kurute taptavrato bhavati madantībhir udakārthān kurute //
meaning: संतरां मेखलाम्̐ समायच्छते संतरां मुष्टी कुरुते तप्तव्रतो भवति मदन्तीभिर् उदकार्थान् कुरुते //
text_mt: He tightens his girdle closer; he clenches his fists tighter; he is one whose fast food is hot; he performs matters concerning water with boiled water.

sanskrit_iast: vyākhyātaṃ pāṇiprakṣālanam āpyāyanaṃ nihnavanaṃ ca /
meaning: व्याख्यातं पाणिप्रक्षालनम् आप्यायनं निह्नवनं च /
text_mt: The washing of the hands, the swelling [of soma], and the reverential shrinking are explained.

sanskrit_iast: yā te agne rudriyā tanūs \\ iti vratayati /
meaning: या ते अग्ने रुद्रिया तनूस् \\ इति व्रतयति /
text_mt: With 'That body of yours, O Agni, which pertains to Rudra', he consumes the fast food.

sanskrit_iast: daikṣam etad ahar vrataparimāṇaṃ bhavati /
meaning: दैक्षम् एतद् अहर् व्रतपरिमाणं भवति /
text_mt: On this day, the measure of the fast-food is that belonging to the consecration.

sanskrit_iast: aupasado 'ta ūrdhvaṃ vratakalpaḥ /
meaning: औपसदो ऽत ऊर्ध्वं व्रतकल्पः /
text_mt: Henceforth is the procedure for the fast-food of the Upasads.

sanskrit_iast: catuḥstanam etām̐ rātriṃ vrataṃ vratayati tristanaṃ madhyame 'hani dvistanam̐ rātrāv ekastanam uttame 'hani /
meaning: चतुःस्तनम् एताम्̐ रात्रिं व्रतं व्रतयति त्रिस्तनं मध्यमे ऽहनि द्विस्तनम्̐ रात्राव् एकस्तनम् उत्तमे ऽहनि /
text_mt: On that night he consumes the fast-food from four teats, on the middle day from three teats, at night from two teats, and on the last day from one teat.

sanskrit_iast: ārāgrām avāntaradīkṣām upeyād iti brāhmaṇavyākhyātāni kāmyāni vrataparimāṇāni teṣāṃ yāthākāmī /
meaning: आराग्राम् अवान्तरदीक्षाम् उपेयाद् इति ब्राह्मणव्याख्यातानि काम्यानि व्रतपरिमाणानि तेषां याथाकामी /
text_mt: With the words, 'One should enter upon the intermediate consecration tapering like an awl,' the optional measures of the fast-food are explained in the Brāhmaṇa; he may choose among them as he desires.

sanskrit_iast: pra tad viṣṇuḥ stavate vīryāya \\ iti saṃmitād dhavirdhānāt prāg upaniṣkramya tair eva mantrair yathānyuptaṃ dhiṣṇiyān upatiṣṭhate /
meaning: प्र तद् विष्णुः स्तवते वीर्याय \\ इति संमिताद् धविर्धानात् प्राग् उपनिष्क्रम्य तैर् एव मन्त्रैर् यथान्युप्तं धिष्णियान् उपतिष्ठते /
text_mt: Stepping out eastward from the measured Havirdhāna cart-shed with the mantra, 'For his prowess is Viṣṇu praised…,' he attends upon the dhiṣṇya hearths with those very mantras, in the order they were strewn:

sanskrit_iast: samrāḍ asi kṛśānus \\ ity āhavanīyaṃ pariṣadyo 'si pavamānas \\ iti yatra bahiṣpavamānena stuvate pratakvāsi nabhasvān iti cātvālam asaṃmṛṣṭo 'si havyasūdas \\ iti paśuśrapaṇam ṛtadhāmāsi suvarjyotis \\ ity audumbarīṃ brahmajyotir asi suvardhāma \\ iti brahmasadanam ajo 'sy ekapāt \\ iti prājihitaṃ gārhapatyam ahir asi budhniyas \\ iti śālāmukhīyaṃ kavyo 'si kavyavāhanas \\ iti dakṣiṇāgnim \\ samūhyo 'si viśvavyacās \\ ity utkaram \\ samudro 'si viśvabharās \\ iti sadaḥ sadasyo 'si malimlucas \\ iti sadasyāyatanam̐ raudram anīkam̐ sarvatrānuṣajati //
meaning: सम्राड् असि कृशानुस् \\ इत्य् आहवनीयं परिषद्यो ऽसि पवमानस् \\ इति यत्र बहिष्पवमानेन स्तुवते प्रतक्वासि नभस्वान् इति चात्वालम् असंमृष्टो ऽसि हव्यसूदस् \\ इति पशुश्रपणम् ऋतधामासि सुवर्ज्योतिस् \\ इत्य् औदुम्बरीं ब्रह्मज्योतिर् असि सुवर्धाम \\ इति ब्रह्मसदनम् अजो ऽस्य् एकपात् \\ इति प्राजिहितं गार्हपत्यम् अहिर् असि बुध्नियस् \\ इति शालामुखीयं कव्यो ऽसि कव्यवाहनस् \\ इति दक्षिणाग्निम् \\ समूह्यो ऽसि विश्वव्यचास् \\ इत्य् उत्करम् \\ समुद्रो ऽसि विश्वभरास् \\ इति सदः सदस्यो ऽसि मलिम्लुचस् \\ इति सदस्यायतनम्̐ रौद्रम् अनीकम्̐ सर्वत्रानुषजति //
text_mt: the āhavanīya with 'You are the sovereign, Kṛśānu'; the place where they chant the Bahiṣpavamāna with 'You are the seated counselor, Pavamāna'; the cātvāla trench with 'You are the darting one, stormy'; the cooking-fire for the victim with 'You are untouched, the pourer of the offering'; the audumbarī pillar with 'You have true domain, celestial light'; the seat of the brahman priest with 'You are brahman-light, celestial domain'; the Prājihita gārhapatya with 'You are the one-footed unborn goat'; the śālāmukhīya fire with 'You are the serpent of the deep'; the dakṣiṇāgni with 'You are the kavya-offering, the conveyor of kavya'; the rubbish heap with 'You are to be gathered, all-pervading'; the sadas hall with 'You are the ocean, all-sustaining'; and the sadasya's seat with 'You are the one seated in the hall, Malimluca'—he attaches the phrase 'Rudrian army' at every mantra.

sanskrit_iast: yatra havirdhāne brahmā rājānaṃ prapādayati tasmin kāle pūrveṇa dvāreṇa havirdhāne praviśya \\ eṣa vo deva savitaḥ somas \\ iti śakaṭe rājānam āsannam abhimantrayate /
meaning: यत्र हविर्धाने ब्रह्मा राजानं प्रपादयति तस्मिन् काले पूर्वेण द्वारेण हविर्धाने प्रविश्य \\ एष वो देव सवितः सोमस् \\ इति शकटे राजानम् आसन्नम् अभिमन्त्रयते /
text_mt: At the time when the brahman priest brings King Soma into the Havirdhāna cart-shed, he enters the Havirdhāna cart-shed by the eastern door and addresses King Soma seated on the cart with the mantra: 'This is your soma, god Savitṛ…'

sanskrit_iast: idam ahaṃ manuṣyo manuṣyān iti pradakṣiṇam āvartate /
meaning: इदम् अहं मनुष्यो मनुष्यान् इति प्रदक्षिणम् आवर्तते /
text_mt: With the mantra, 'Here do I, a mortal, [turn away] from mortals,' he turns around clockwise.

sanskrit_iast: namo devebhyas \\ iti prācīnam añjaliṃ karoti svadhā pitṛbhyas \\ iti dakṣiṇā /
meaning: नमो देवेभ्यस् \\ इति प्राचीनम् अञ्जलिं करोति स्वधा पितृभ्यस् \\ इति दक्षिणा /
text_mt: With the words, 'Homage to the gods,' he makes an anjali toward the east; with 'Svadhā to the fathers,' toward the south.

sanskrit_iast: idam ahaṃ nir varuṇasya pāśāt \\ ity upaniṣkrāmati /
meaning: इदम् अहं निर् वरुणस्य पाशात् \\ इत्य् उपनिष्क्रामति /
text_mt: With the mantra, 'Here do I [step out] from Varuṇa's noose,' he steps out.

sanskrit_iast: suvar abhivikhyeṣam iti sarvaṃ yajñam anuvīkṣate vaiśvānaraṃ jyotis \\ ity āhavanīyaṃ parekṣate /
meaning: सुवर् अभिविख्येषम् इति सर्वं यज्ञम् अनुवीक्षते वैश्वानरं ज्योतिस् \\ इत्य् आहवनीयं परेक्षते /
text_mt: With the mantra, 'May I behold the heavenly light,' he looks at the entire sacrifice; with 'The light belonging to all men,' he looks intently at the āhavanīya.

sanskrit_iast: agne vratapate \\ ity avāntaradīkṣāṃ visṛjate /
meaning: अग्ने व्रतपते \\ इत्य् अवान्तरदीक्षां विसृजते /
text_mt: With the mantra, 'O Agni, lord of observances…,' he releases the intermediate consecration.

sanskrit_iast: vitarāṃ mekhalām̐ samāyacchate vitarāṃ muṣṭī kurute /
meaning: वितरां मेखलाम्̐ समायच्छते वितरां मुष्टी कुरुते /
text_mt: He loosens his girdle a little; he opens his fists a little.

sanskrit_iast: svāhā yajñaṃ vāci vāte visṛje \\ iti muṣṭī vācaṃ ca visarjayitvā yathāsukham ata ūrdhvam̐ hastābhyāṃ carati /
meaning: स्वाहा यज्ञं वाचि वाते विसृजे \\ इति मुष्टी वाचं च विसर्जयित्वा यथासुखम् अत ऊर्ध्वम्̐ हस्ताभ्यां चरति /
text_mt: Having released his fists and his speech with the mantra, 'Svāhā! I release the sacrifice into speech, into the wind,' he acts freely with his hands henceforth.

sanskrit_iast: vartate 'nyā dīkṣitavṛttiḥ /
meaning: वर्तते ऽन्या दीक्षितवृत्तिः /
text_mt: The rest of the conduct of the consecrated one continues.

sanskrit_iast: jāgarty etām̐ rātrim /
meaning: जागर्त्य् एताम्̐ रात्रिम् /

sanskrit_iast: na vrataṃ bhavati daikṣo 'ta ūrdhvaṃ vratakalpaḥ /
meaning: न व्रतं भवति दैक्षो ऽत ऊर्ध्वं व्रतकल्पः /
text_mt: There is no fast-food; henceforth the procedure for the fast-food is that belonging to the consecration.

sanskrit_iast: saptahotrā grāvasv āsannam̐ rājānam abhimṛśati /
meaning: सप्तहोत्रा ग्रावस्व् आसन्नम्̐ राजानम् अभिमृशति /
text_mt: With the Saptahotṛ formula he touches King Soma placed on the pressing-stones.

sanskrit_iast: yatra havirdhānam apaḥ prapādayīta tā anu prapadyate yaśa enam upanāmukaṃ bhavati /
meaning: यत्र हविर्धानम् अपः प्रपादयीत ता अनु प्रपद्यते यश एनम् उपनामुकं भवति /
text_mt: Where water is brought into the Havirdhāna cart-shed, he enters following it; fame approaches him.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśa dhenūḥ paṣṭhauhīr vā garbhiṇīḥ kṛttyadhīvāsaṃ cāṃśāv adhvaryave dadāty evam adābhye /
meaning: द्वादश धेनूः पष्ठौहीर् वा गर्भिणीः कृत्त्यधीवासं चांशाव् अध्वर्यवे ददात्य् एवम् अदाभ्ये /
text_mt: He gives twelve milk cows, or four-year-old pregnant heifers, and an upper garment of hide to the adhvaryu for the Aṃśu cup; similarly for the Adābhya cup.

sanskrit_iast: dhruve gṛhīte na mūtraṃ karoty āvanayanāt /
meaning: ध्रुवे गृहीते न मूत्रं करोत्य् आवनयनात् /
text_mt: When the Dhruva cup has been drawn, he does not urinate until the pouring down.

sanskrit_iast: vasvyai hiṃ kuru \ tasya prastuhi tasyai me 'varuddhyai \\ iti purastād bahiṣpavamānād vyāhṛtīr daśahotāraṃ ca japati /
meaning: वस्व्यै हिं कुरु \ तस्य प्रस्तुहि तस्यै मे ऽवरुद्ध्यै \\ इति पुरस्ताद् बहिष्पवमानाद् व्याहृतीर् दशहोतारं च जपति /
text_mt: Before the Bahiṣpavamāna, he mutters the mystic utterances and the Daśahotṛ formula: 'Make him! for the Vasvī; begin the prelude for her, for my acquisition of her.'

sanskrit_iast: śyeno 'si gāyatrachandās \\ anu tvārabhe \ svasti mā saṃpāraya \\ iti //
meaning: श्येनो ऽसि गायत्रछन्दास् \\ अनु त्वारभे \ स्वस्ति मा संपारय \\ इति //
text_mt: With the mantra, 'You are the falcon, whose meter is the Gāyatrī; I take hold of you from behind; convey me safely across,'

sanskrit_iast: stūyamānam anvārabhate /
meaning: स्तूयमानम् अन्वारभते /
text_mt: he takes hold from behind while the chant is being sung,

sanskrit_iast: madhyamāyāṃ stotrīyāyāṃ vā /
meaning: मध्यमायां स्तोत्रीयायां वा /
text_mt: or at the middle strophic verse.

sanskrit_iast: stutasya stutam asi \\ iti sarvāṇi stotrāṇi stutam̐ stutam anumantrayate /
meaning: स्तुतस्य स्तुतम् असि \\ इति सर्वाणि स्तोत्राणि स्तुतम्̐ स्तुतम् अनुमन्त्रयते /
text_mt: With the mantra, 'Of the chanted you are the chant,' he addresses each stotra after it has been chanted.

sanskrit_iast: śastrasya śastram asi \\ iti sarvāṇi śastrāṇi /
meaning: शस्त्रस्य शस्त्रम् असि \\ इति सर्वाणि शस्त्राणि /
text_mt: With the mantra, 'Of the recited you are the recitation,' all śastras.

sanskrit_iast: indriyāvanto vanāmahe \\ iti sarvatrānuṣajati /
meaning: इन्द्रियावन्तो वनामहे \\ इति सर्वत्रानुषजति /
text_mt: He attaches the phrase 'Endowed with faculty, we win' at every mantra.

sanskrit_iast: bhūr asi śreṣṭho raśmīnām ity aindravāyave hūyamāna ādityam upatiṣṭhate /
meaning: भूर् असि श्रेष्ठो रश्मीनाम् इत्य् ऐन्द्रवायवे हूयमान आदित्यम् उपतिष्ठते /
text_mt: With the mantra, 'You are the earth, best of rays,' while the Aindravāyava cup is being offered, he attends upon the sun.

sanskrit_iast: yo na indravāyū ity aindravāyave hute 'ṅguṣṭham avabādheta yadi śreyasā spardhetāṅguṣṭhenāṅgulīṃ yadi pāpīyasā /
meaning: यो न इन्द्रवायू इत्य् ऐन्द्रवायवे हुते ऽङ्गुष्ठम् अवबाधेत यदि श्रेयसा स्पर्धेताङ्गुष्ठेनाङ्गुलीं यदि पापीयसा /
text_mt: After the Aindravāyava cup has been offered, with the mantra, 'Whoever [plots against] us, O Indra and Vāyu,' he should press down his thumb if he contends with a superior, or press a finger with his thumb if with an inferior.

sanskrit_iast: yo no mitrāvaruṇau \\ iti maitrāvaruṇe yo no 'śvinau \\ ity āśvine /
meaning: यो नो मित्रावरुणौ \\ इति मैत्रावरुणे यो नो ऽश्विनौ \\ इत्य् आश्विने /
text_mt: With 'Whoever [plots against] us, O Mitra and Varuṇa' at the Maitrāvaruṇa cup; with 'Whoever [plots against] us, O Aśvins' at the Āśvina cup.

sanskrit_iast: acchinnasya te rayipate suvīryasya \\ indreṇa sayujo vayam iti śukram̐ hūyamānam anvārabhate /
meaning: अच्छिन्नस्य ते रयिपते सुवीर्यस्य \\ इन्द्रेण सयुजो वयम् इति शुक्रम्̐ हूयमानम् अन्वारभते /
text_mt: With the mantra, 'Of you unbroken, lord of wealth, endowed with great heroes, we, joined with Indra…,' he takes hold from behind while the Śukra cup is being offered.

sanskrit_iast: yatrāsmai camasam āharati taṃ bhakṣayati /
meaning: यत्रास्मै चमसम् आहरति तं भक्षयति /
text_mt: When [the priest] brings him his goblet, he consumes it,

sanskrit_iast: yathetare camasāḥ /
meaning: यथेतरे चमसाः /

sanskrit_iast: gṛhapate yaja \\ ity ucyamāne hotar etad yaja \\ iti saṃpreṣyati svayaṃ vā niṣadya yajati /
meaning: गृहपते यज \\ इत्य् उच्यमाने होतर् एतद् यज \\ इति संप्रेष्यति स्वयं वा निषद्य यजति /
text_mt: When addressed with 'O householder, sacrifice,' he gives the ritual direction: 'O hotṛ, sacrifice this,' or sits down and sacrifices himself.

sanskrit_iast: jyotiṣe hiṃ kuru \ tasyai prastuhi tasyai me 'varuddhyai \\ iti purastād ājyānām ekaikasya stotrasya vyāhṛtīś caturhotāraṃ pañcahotāraṃ ca japati /
meaning: ज्योतिषे हिं कुरु \ तस्यै प्रस्तुहि तस्यै मे ऽवरुद्ध्यै \\ इति पुरस्ताद् आज्यानाम् एकैकस्य स्तोत्रस्य व्याहृतीश् चतुर्होतारं पञ्चहोतारं च जपति /
text_mt: Before each of the Ājya stotras, he mutters the mystic utterances, the Caturhotṛ, and the Pañcahotṛ formulas: 'Make him! for the light; begin the prelude for it, for my acquisition of it.'

sanskrit_iast: iḍāyai hiṃ kuru \ tasyai prastuhi tasyai me 'varuddhyai \\ iti purastān mādhyaṃdināt pavamānād vyāhṛtīś caturhotāraṃ pañcahotāraṃ ca japati /
meaning: इडायै हिं कुरु \ तस्यै प्रस्तुहि तस्यै मे ऽवरुद्ध्यै \\ इति पुरस्तान् माध्यंदिनात् पवमानाद् व्याहृतीश् चतुर्होतारं पञ्चहोतारं च जपति /
text_mt: Before the midday Pavamāna, he mutters the mystic utterances, the Caturhotṛ, and the Pañcahotṛ formulas: 'Make him! for Iḍā; begin the prelude for her, for my acquisition of her.'

sanskrit_iast: suparṇo 'si triṣṭupcchandās \\ anu tvā rabhe \ svasti mā saṃpāraya \\ iti stūyamānam anvārabhate //
meaning: सुपर्णो ऽसि त्रिष्टुप्च्छन्दास् \\ अनु त्वा रभे \ स्वस्ति मा संपारय \\ इति स्तूयमानम् अन्वारभते //
text_mt: With the mantra, 'You are the fair-winged bird, whose meter is the Triṣṭubh; I take hold of you from behind; convey me safely across,' he takes hold from behind while the chant is being sung.

sanskrit_iast: vyākhyātam̐ śukrasyānvārambhaṇam /
meaning: व्याख्यातम्̐ शुक्रस्यान्वारम्भणम् /
text_mt: Taking hold from behind at the Śukra cup has been explained.

sanskrit_iast: sanneṣu nārāśam̐seṣu dakṣiṇena vedim avasthitā dakṣiṇā dadāti /
meaning: सन्नेषु नाराशम्̐सेषु दक्षिणेन वेदिम् अवस्थिता दक्षिणा ददाति /
text_mt: When the Nārāśaṃsa goblets are set down, standing south of the altar, he gives the sacrificial gifts:

sanskrit_iast: gavām̐ saptaikavim̐śatiś caturvim̐śatiḥ ṣaṣṭiḥ śatam̐ sahasraṃ dvādaśaśatam̐ sarvavedasam aparimitā vā /
meaning: गवाम्̐ सप्तैकविम्̐शतिश् चतुर्विम्̐शतिः षष्टिः शतम्̐ सहस्रं द्वादशशतम्̐ सर्ववेदसम् अपरिमिता वा /
text_mt: seven, twenty-one, twenty-four, sixty, a hundred, a thousand, twelve hundred cows, or all his possessions, or an unlimited number.

sanskrit_iast: manthaudanatilamāṣā hiraṇyaṃ vāso 'virajā ca niyuktāny etāni bhavanti /
meaning: मन्थौदनतिलमाषा हिरण्यं वासो ऽविरजा च नियुक्तान्य् एतानि भवन्ति /
text_mt: Stirred beverage, boiled rice, sesame, black beans, gold, cloth, sheep, and goat are mandatory [gifts].

sanskrit_iast: ano ratho 'dhīvāso 'śvaḥ puruṣo hastī vāniyuktāni /
meaning: अनो रथो ऽधीवासो ऽश्वः पुरुषो हस्ती वानियुक्तानि /
text_mt: A cart, a chariot, an upper garment, a horse, a man, or an elephant are optional [gifts].

sanskrit_iast: tās \\ rūpeṇa vo rūpam abhyaimi \\ iti hiraṇyam ājyaṃ cādāyābhyeti /
meaning: तास् \\ रूपेण वो रूपम् अभ्यैमि \\ इति हिरण्यम् आज्यं चादायाभ्येति /
text_mt: Taking gold and clarified butter, he approaches them with the mantra: 'By form I approach your form…'

sanskrit_iast: tutho vo viśvavedā vibhajatu \\ iti madhyam avakramya vibhajati /
meaning: तुथो वो विश्ववेदा विभजतु \\ इति मध्यम् अवक्रम्य विभजति /
text_mt: Stepping into their midst, he distributes them with the mantra: 'May Tutha, all-knowing, distribute you…'

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśadvādaśa madhyataḥkāribhyaḥ ṣaṭṣaḍ ardhibhyaś catasraścatasras tṛtīyibhyas tisrastisraḥ pādibhyaḥ /
meaning: द्वादशद्वादश मध्यतःकारिभ्यः षट्षड् अर्धिभ्यश् चतस्रश्चतस्रस् तृतीयिभ्यस् तिस्रस्तिस्रः पादिभ्यः /
text_mt: Twelve each to the chief priests, six each to the half-share recipients, four each to the third-share recipients, and three each to the quarter-share recipients.

sanskrit_iast: evam̐ śeṣam /
meaning: एवम्̐ शेषम् /

sanskrit_iast: hotādhvaryur brahmodgātā ca madhyataḥkāriṇaḥ /
meaning: होताध्वर्युर् ब्रह्मोद्गाता च मध्यतःकारिणः /
text_mt: The hotṛ, adhvaryu, brahman, and udgātṛ are the chief priests.

sanskrit_iast: maitrāvaruṇaḥ pratiprasthātā brāhmaṇāccham̐sī prastotā cārdhino 'cchāvāko neṣṭāgnīdhraḥ pratihartā ca tṛtīyinaḥ śeṣāḥ pādinaḥ /
meaning: मैत्रावरुणः प्रतिप्रस्थाता ब्राह्मणाच्छम्̐सी प्रस्तोता चार्धिनो ऽच्छावाको नेष्टाग्नीध्रः प्रतिहर्ता च तृतीयिनः शेषाः पादिनः /
text_mt: The maitrāvaruṇa, pratiprasthātā, brāhmaṇācchaṃsin, and prastotṛ are the half-share recipients; the acchāvāka, neṣṭṛ, āgnīdhra, and pratihartṛ are the third-share recipients; the remaining ones are the quarter-share recipients.

sanskrit_iast: etat te agne rādha aiti somacyutam iti vibhaktā ānayati /
meaning: एतत् ते अग्ने राध ऐति सोमच्युतम् इति विभक्ता आनयति /
text_mt: With 'This is thy gift, O Agni, coming, stirred by Soma,' he brings them forward after dividing them.

sanskrit_iast: agreṇa prāgvam̐śam apareṇa sado dakṣiṇenāgnīdhrīyam antareṇa cātvālotkarāv udīcīr utsṛjati /
meaning: अग्रेण प्राग्वम्̐शम् अपरेण सदो दक्षिणेनाग्नीध्रीयम् अन्तरेण चात्वालोत्कराव् उदीचीर् उत्सृजति /
text_mt: To the front of the eastern hall, to the west of the sadas, to the south of the āgnīdhra shed, between the cātvāla and the heap of rubbish, he releases them heading north.

sanskrit_iast: ṛtasya pathā preta candradakṣiṇās \\ iti gacchantīr anumantrayate /
meaning: ऋतस्य पथा प्रेत चन्द्रदक्षिणास् \\ इति गच्छन्तीर् अनुमन्त्रयते /
text_mt: He follows them as they depart with the mantra, 'Go forth along the path of Ṛta, gifts shining like gold!'

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇam adya rādhyāsam ṛṣim ārṣeyam iti hiraṇyaṃ dakṣiṇābhāgaṃ cādāyāgnīdhram abhyeti /
meaning: ब्राह्मणम् अद्य राध्यासम् ऋषिम् आर्षेयम् इति हिरण्यं दक्षिणाभागं चादायाग्नीध्रम् अभ्येति /
text_mt: With 'May I today satisfy the brāhmaṇa, the ṛṣi descendant of ṛṣis,' he approaches the āgnīdhra shed, having taken gold and a portion of the sacrificial fee.

sanskrit_iast: etenaiva mantreṇa hiraṇyaṃ dakṣiṇābhāgaṃ cāgnīdhre dadāti /
meaning: एतेनैव मन्त्रेण हिरण्यं दक्षिणाभागं चाग्नीध्रे ददाति /
text_mt: With that very mantra, he gives the gold and the portion of the sacrificial fee in the āgnīdhra shed.

sanskrit_iast: vi suvaḥ paśya vy antarikṣam iti sadaḥ prekṣate /
meaning: वि सुवः पश्य व्य् अन्तरिक्षम् इति सदः प्रेक्षते /
text_mt: With 'Look out upon heaven, look out upon the mid-region,' he gazes at the sadas.

sanskrit_iast: asmaddātrā devatrā gacchata \\ iti dakṣiṇāḥ /
meaning: अस्मद्दात्रा देवत्रा गच्छत \\ इति दक्षिणाः /
text_mt: With 'Gifts from us, go to the gods!' [he gazes at] the sacrificial gifts.

sanskrit_iast: pūrveṇa dvāreṇa sadaḥ praviśya //
meaning: पूर्वेण द्वारेण सदः प्रविश्य //
text_mt: Having entered the sadas by the eastern door,

sanskrit_iast: ātreyāya hiraṇyam uttamaṃ dadāti tenaiva mantreṇa yenāgnīdhre /
meaning: आत्रेयाय हिरण्यम् उत्तमं ददाति तेनैव मन्त्रेण येनाग्नीध्रे /
text_mt: he gives the best gold to an Ātreya, with the very mantra used in the āgnīdhra shed.

sanskrit_iast: tasminn avidyamāne ya ārṣeyo 'nūcāno 'nūcānaputras tasmai tāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt /
meaning: तस्मिन्न् अविद्यमाने य आर्षेयो ऽनूचानो ऽनूचानपुत्रस् तस्मै तां दक्षिणां दद्यात् /
text_mt: If he is not present, one should give that sacrificial fee to whoever is of ṛṣi descent, learned in the Vedas, and the son of a learned father.

sanskrit_iast: athartvigbhyo dakṣiṇābhāgān brahman manas te dadāmi tad anena niṣkrīṇāmi \\ iti brahmaṇe brahmasadana āsīnāya \\ idaṃ dadāmi \\ iti yad dāsyan bhavati tad anudiśati brahmaṇe /
meaning: अथर्त्विग्भ्यो दक्षिणाभागान् ब्रह्मन् मनस् ते ददामि तद् अनेन निष्क्रीणामि \\ इति ब्रह्मणे ब्रह्मसदन आसीनाय \\ इदं ददामि \\ इति यद् दास्यन् भवति तद् अनुदिशति ब्रह्मणे /
text_mt: Then, for the portions of the sacrificial fees to the priests: with 'O Brahman, I give you the mind; that I redeem with this,' to the brahman seated on the brahman's seat, he specifies with 'I give this' whatever he is about to give to the brahman.

sanskrit_iast: evam itarebhyaḥ /
meaning: एवम् इतरेभ्यः /

sanskrit_iast: hotar vācaṃ te dadāmi tam anena niṣkrīṇāmi \\ iti hotre hotṛṣadana āsīnāya /
meaning: होतर् वाचं ते ददामि तम् अनेन निष्क्रीणामि \\ इति होत्रे होतृषदन आसीनाय /
text_mt: With 'O Hotṛ, I give you speech; that I redeem with this,' to the hotṛ seated on the hotṛ's seat.

sanskrit_iast: adhvaryo prāṇaṃ te dadāmi tam anena niṣkrīṇāmi \\ ity adhvaryave havirdhāna āsīnāya /
meaning: अध्वर्यो प्राणं ते ददामि तम् अनेन निष्क्रीणामि \\ इत्य् अध्वर्यवे हविर्धान आसीनाय /
text_mt: With 'O Adhvaryu, I give you the breath; that I redeem with this,' to the adhvaryu seated in the havirdhāna shed.

sanskrit_iast: udgātaś cakṣus te dadāmi tad anena niṣkrīṇāmi \\ ity udgātra audumbaryām āsīnāya /
meaning: उद्गातश् चक्षुस् ते ददामि तद् अनेन निष्क्रीणामि \\ इत्य् उद्गात्र औदुम्बर्याम् आसीनाय /
text_mt: With 'O Udgātṛ, I give you the eye; that I redeem with this,' to the udgātṛ seated near the audumbarī post.

sanskrit_iast: hotrakāḥ śrotraṃ vo dadāmi tad anena niṣkrīṇāmi \\ iti hotrakebhyo 'ntaḥsadasaṃ yathādhiṣṇiyamā sīnebhyaḥ /
meaning: होत्रकाः श्रोत्रं वो ददामि तद् अनेन निष्क्रीणामि \\ इति होत्रकेभ्यो ऽन्तःसदसं यथाधिष्णियमा सीनेभ्यः /
text_mt: With 'O Hotrakas, I give you hearing; that I redeem with this,' to the hotrakas seated within the sadas according to their dhiṣṇya hearths.

sanskrit_iast: pratiprasthātre ca havirdhāna āsīnāya /
meaning: प्रतिप्रस्थात्रे च हविर्धान आसीनाय /
text_mt: And to the pratiprasthātṛ seated in the havirdhāna shed.

sanskrit_iast: yathāśraddham̐ sadasyāya camasādhvaryubhyaḥ prasarpakebhyaś ca dadāti /
meaning: यथाश्रद्धम्̐ सदस्याय चमसाध्वर्युभ्यः प्रसर्पकेभ्यश् च ददाति /
text_mt: According to his faith, he gives to the sadasya, to the camasādhvaryus, and to the spectators.

sanskrit_iast: sadasyātmānaṃ te dadāmi tam anena niṣkrīṇāmi \\ iti sadasyāyāntaḥsadasaṃ dakṣiṇārdha āsīnāya /
meaning: सदस्यात्मानं ते ददामि तम् अनेन निष्क्रीणामि \\ इति सदस्यायान्तःसदसं दक्षिणार्ध आसीनाय /
text_mt: With 'O Sadasya, I give you the self; that I redeem with this,' to the sadasya seated in the southern half within the sadas.

sanskrit_iast: camasādhvaryavo 'ṅgāni vo dadāmi tāny anena niṣkrīṇāmi \\ iti camasādhvaryubhyo havirdhāna āsīnebhyaḥ /
meaning: चमसाध्वर्यवो ऽङ्गानि वो ददामि तान्य् अनेन निष्क्रीणामि \\ इति चमसाध्वर्युभ्यो हविर्धान आसीनेभ्यः /
text_mt: With 'O Camasādhvaryus, I give you the limbs; those I redeem with this,' to the camasādhvaryus seated in the havirdhāna shed.

sanskrit_iast: prasarpakā lomāni vo dadāmi tāny anena niṣkrīṇāmi \\ iti prasarpakebhyo 'ntaḥsadasaṃ dakṣiṇārdha āsīnebhyaḥ /
meaning: प्रसर्पका लोमानि वो ददामि तान्य् अनेन निष्क्रीणामि \\ इति प्रसर्पकेभ्यो ऽन्तःसदसं दक्षिणार्ध आसीनेभ्यः /
text_mt: With 'O Spectators, I give you the body hairs; those I redeem with this,' to the spectators seated in the southern half within the sadas.

sanskrit_iast: idaṃ dadāmi \\ iti sarvatrānuṣajati /
meaning: इदं ददामि \\ इति सर्वत्रानुषजति /
text_mt: He connects 'I give this' everywhere.

sanskrit_iast: na bhīto dadāti /
meaning: न भीतो ददाति /

sanskrit_iast: na yācamānāya /
meaning: न याचमानाय /

sanskrit_iast: na kaṇvakāśyapebhyaḥ /
meaning: न कण्वकाश्यपेभ्यः /

sanskrit_iast: na vīṇāgāthibhyaḥ /
meaning: न वीणागाथिभ्यः /

sanskrit_iast: nānṛtvije /
meaning: नानृत्विजे /

sanskrit_iast: na jñātaye /
meaning: न ज्ञातये /

sanskrit_iast: nāprasṛptāya /
meaning: नाप्रसृप्ताय /

sanskrit_iast: nāśrotriyāya /
meaning: नाश्रोत्रियाय /

sanskrit_iast: nābrāhmaṇāya /
meaning: नाब्राह्मणाय /

sanskrit_iast: vedavide dadyāt /
meaning: वेदविदे दद्यात् /

sanskrit_iast: yām anyo dīyamānāṃ pratyācakṣīta yaṃ dviṣyāt tasmai tāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt /
meaning: याम् अन्यो दीयमानां प्रत्याचक्षीत यं द्विष्यात् तस्मै तां दक्षिणां दद्यात् /
text_mt: The sacrificial fee which another might reject when offered, he should give to one whom he hates.

sanskrit_iast: sa hānyayā pratigṛhṇīyāt /
meaning: स हान्यया प्रतिगृह्णीयात् /
text_mt: He indeed would receive it through another.

sanskrit_iast: antataḥ pratihartre dadāty ātreyāya vā /
meaning: अन्ततः प्रतिहर्त्रे ददात्य् आत्रेयाय वा /
text_mt: Finally he gives to the pratihartṛ or to an Ātreya.

sanskrit_iast: na marutvatīyayor anūktā dadyāt /
meaning: न मरुत्वतीययोर् अनूक्ता दद्यात् /
text_mt: He should not give after the recitation of the two [śastras] to the Maruts.

sanskrit_iast: yadi dadyād anūbandhyāvapāyām̐ hutāyāṃ dadyād udavasānīyāyāṃ veṣṭhau //
meaning: यदि दद्याद् अनूबन्ध्यावपायाम्̐ हुतायां दद्याद् उदवसानीयायां वेष्ठौ //
text_mt: If he should give, he should give when the omentum of the anūbandhyā cow has been offered, or at the concluding iṣṭi.

sanskrit_iast: nītāsu dakṣiṇāsu hariṇasya raghuṣyato 'dhiśīrṣāṇi bheṣajam̐ sakṣetriyaṃ viṣāṇayā viṣūcīnam anīnaśat \\ ity unmucya kṛṣṇaviṣāṇām anu tvā hariṇo mṛgaḥ \ padbhiś caturbhir akramīt \\ māhir bhūmnā pṛdākur iti cātvāle prāsyati /
meaning: नीतासु दक्षिणासु हरिणस्य रघुष्यतो ऽधिशीर्षाणि भेषजम्̐ सक्षेत्रियं विषाणया विषूचीनम् अनीनशत् \\ इत्य् उन्मुच्य कृष्णविषाणाम् अनु त्वा हरिणो मृगः \ पद्भिश् चतुर्भिर् अक्रमीत् \\ माहिर् भूम्ना पृदाकुर् इति चात्वाले प्रास्यति /
text_mt: When the sacrificial fees have been conveyed away, having untied the black buck horn with 'The head-cure of the swift deer has destroyed through the horn the congenital disease in all directions,' he throws it into the cātvāla pit with 'The deer, the beast, has walked after thee with four feet. Do not, through the ground, [become] a serpent, a viper!'

sanskrit_iast: rathaṃtare varaṃ dadāti /
meaning: रथंतरे वरं ददाति /
text_mt: He gives a boon at the Rathaṃtara [sāman].

sanskrit_iast: vāmedevye varaṃ dadāti /
meaning: वामेदेव्ये वरं ददाति /
text_mt: He gives a boon at the Vāmadevya [sāman].

sanskrit_iast: niṣkevalye varaṃ dadāti /
meaning: निष्केवल्ये वरं ददाति /
text_mt: He gives a boon at the Niṣkevalya [śastra].

sanskrit_iast: ādityagraham̐ hūyamānam anvārabhate /
meaning: आदित्यग्रहम्̐ हूयमानम् अन्वारभते /
text_mt: He touches [the adhvaryu] while the āditya cup is being offered.

sanskrit_iast: āyuṣe hiṃ kuru \ tasyai prastuhi tasyai me 'varuddhyai \\ iti purastād ārbhavāt pavamānād vyāhṛtīḥ pañcahotāraṃ ca japati /
meaning: आयुषे हिं कुरु \ तस्यै प्रस्तुहि तस्यै मे ऽवरुद्ध्यै \\ इति पुरस्ताद् आर्भवात् पवमानाद् व्याहृतीः पञ्चहोतारं च जपति /
text_mt: Before the Ārbhava Pavamāna chant, he mutters the mystical utterances and the five-hotṛ mantra with 'Utter hiṃ for life! Sing the prastāva for it, for my attainment of it!'

sanskrit_iast: saghāsi jagatīchandās \\ anu tvārabhe \ svasti mā saṃpāraya \\ iti stūyamānam anvārabhate /
meaning: सघासि जगतीछन्दास् \\ अनु त्वारभे \ स्वस्ति मा संपारय \\ इति स्तूयमानम् अन्वारभते /
text_mt: While the laud is being chanted, he touches [the udgātṛ] with 'Thou art powerful, having the jagatī meter; I follow thee; take me across safely!'

sanskrit_iast: yatra svaṃ camasaṃ nyante trīn puroḍāśaśakalān dakṣiṇata upāsyati /
meaning: यत्र स्वं चमसं न्यन्ते त्रीन् पुरोडाशशकलान् दक्षिणत उपास्यति /
text_mt: Where they put down their own cup, he casts three pieces of the sacrificial cake to the south.

sanskrit_iast: tat kṛtvā prācīnāvītaṃ kṛtvā ṣaḍḍhotāraṃ vyākhyāya dānaprabhṛtīn pratyāyanāntān piṇḍapitṛyajñamantrāñ japati /
meaning: तत् कृत्वा प्राचीनावीतं कृत्वा षड्ढोतारं व्याख्याय दानप्रभृतीन् प्रत्यायनान्तान् पिण्डपितृयज्ञमन्त्राञ् जपति /
text_mt: Having done that, having worn the sacred cord over the right shoulder, and having recited the six-hotṛ mantra, he mutters the Piṇḍapitṛyajña mantras beginning with the gift and ending with the return.

sanskrit_iast: yajñāyajñiye varaṃ dadāti /
meaning: यज्ञायज्ञिये वरं ददाति /
text_mt: He gives a boon at the Yajñāyajñīya [sāman].

sanskrit_iast: purastād agniṣṭomastotrād vyāhṛtīḥ saptahotāraṃ ca japati /
meaning: पुरस्ताद् अग्निष्टोमस्तोत्राद् व्याहृतीः सप्तहोतारं च जपति /
text_mt: Before the Agniṣṭoma stotra, he mutters the mystical utterances and the seven-hotṛ mantra.

sanskrit_iast: subhūr asi śreṣṭho raśmīnāṃ priyo devānām̐ sam̐sādhanīyaḥ / \ taṃ svā subho devā abhisaṃviśantu \\ iṣo 'si \ tveṣo 'si nṛmṇo 'si \ yaho 'si \ vrato 'si \ svo 'si \ cāraṇo 'si \ śūdro 'si \\ āryo 'si \ tasya ta iṣasya tveṣasya nṛmṇasya yahvasya vratasya svasya cāraṇasya śūdrasya cāryasya ca bhukṣiṣīya \ yathā tvam̐ sūryo 'si viśvadarśata evam ahaṃ viśvadarśato bhūyāsam ity agniṣṭomaṃ niṣpādyādityam upatiṣṭhate yady astamitaḥ syād āhavanīyam evādityopasthānenopatiṣṭhate /
meaning: सुभूर् असि श्रेष्ठो रश्मीनां प्रियो देवानाम्̐ सम्̐साधनीयः / \ तं स्वा सुभो देवा अभिसंविशन्तु \\ इषो ऽसि \ त्वेषो ऽसि नृम्णो ऽसि \ यहो ऽसि \ व्रतो ऽसि \ स्वो ऽसि \ चारणो ऽसि \ शूद्रो ऽसि \\ आर्यो ऽसि \ तस्य त इषस्य त्वेषस्य नृम्णस्य यह्वस्य व्रतस्य स्वस्य चारणस्य शूद्रस्य चार्यस्य च भुक्षिषीय \ यथा त्वम्̐ सूर्यो ऽसि विश्वदर्शत एवम् अहं विश्वदर्शतो भूयासम् इत्य् अग्निष्टोमं निष्पाद्यादित्यम् उपतिष्ठते यद्य् अस्तमितः स्याद् आहवनीयम् एवादित्योपस्थानेनोपतिष्ठते /
text_mt: Having brought the Agniṣṭoma to completion, with 'Thou art good, the best of rays, dear to the gods, accomplishable; to thee may the gods, O good one, assemble! Thou art food, thou art brilliance, thou art manly strength, thou art youth, thou art the vow, thou art one's own, thou art wandering, thou art a śūdra, thou art an ārya; may I enjoy that food, brilliance, manly strength, youth, vow, one's own, wandering, śūdra, and ārya of thine; just as thou, O Sun, art visible to all, so may I be visible to all,' he reveres the sun; if it has set, he reveres the āhavanīya fire with the very reverence to the sun.

sanskrit_iast: vyākhyāto hāriyojanaḥ /
meaning: व्याख्यातो हारियोजनः /
text_mt: The hāriyojana libation has been explained.

sanskrit_iast: dadhidrapsaḥ /
meaning: दधिद्रप्सः /

sanskrit_iast: apsuṣomaḥ /
meaning: अप्सुषोमः /

sanskrit_iast: mindayopasthānam /
meaning: मिन्दयोपस्थानम् /

sanskrit_iast: śakalābhyādhānam /
meaning: शकलाभ्याधानम् /

sanskrit_iast: sakhyavisarjanaṃ ca /
meaning: सख्यविसर्जनं च /

sanskrit_iast: huteṣu samiṣṭayajuḥṣu agninā devena pṛtanā jayāmi \\ iti jāgatān viṣṇukramān krāmati /
meaning: हुतेषु समिष्टयजुःषु अग्निना देवेन पृतना जयामि \\ इति जागतान् विष्णुक्रमान् क्रामति /
text_mt: When the samiṣṭayajus formulas have been offered, he strides the viṣṇukrama strides in the jagatī meter with 'With god Agni I conquer the armies!'

sanskrit_iast: upasṛjan dharuṇaṃ mātre mātaraṃ dharuṇo dhayan / \ rāyaspoṣam iṣam ūrjam asmāsu dīdharat \\ ity upaniṣkrāmann audumbarīm utkhidati /
meaning: उपसृजन् धरुणं मात्रे मातरं धरुणो धयन् / \ रायस्पोषम् इषम् ऊर्जम् अस्मासु दीधरत् \\ इत्य् उपनिष्क्रामन्न् औदुम्बरीम् उत्खिदति /
text_mt: With the mantra, 'Releasing the calf to the mother, the calf suckling the mother; may he maintain abundant wealth, food, and sap among us,' he touches the audumbarī pillar as he steps out.

sanskrit_iast: ava te heḍo varuṇa \\ ity unmucya kṛṣṇājinaṃ cātvāle prāsyati /
meaning: अव ते हेडो वरुण \\ इत्य् उन्मुच्य कृष्णाजिनं चात्वाले प्रास्यति /
text_mt: With the mantra, 'Avert your wrath, O Varuṇa…,' he takes off the black antelope skin and casts it into the cātvāla trench.

sanskrit_iast: ud u tyam \\ citram iti dvābhyām ādityam upatiṣṭhate yady astamitaḥ syād āhavanīyam evādityopasthānenopatiṣṭhate /
meaning: उद् उ त्यम् \\ चित्रम् इति द्वाभ्याम् आदित्यम् उपतिष्ठते यद्य् अस्तमितः स्याद् आहवनीयम् एवादित्योपस्थानेनोपतिष्ठते /
text_mt: With the two verses, 'Up that [all-knowing god]…' and 'The wonderful [face of the gods]…,' he attends upon the sun; if it has set, he attends upon the āhavanīya fire itself with the prayer to the sun.

sanskrit_iast: vyākhyātaṃ nidhanopāyanam /
meaning: व्याख्यातं निधनोपायनम् /
text_mt: The approach to the musical finale has been explained.

sanskrit_iast: sumitriyā ca mārjanam /
meaning: सुमित्रिया च मार्जनम् /

sanskrit_iast: indriyāj jyaiṣṭhyāc chraiṣṭhyān mā yoṣam ity unmucya kṛṣṇājinam abhyukṣya nidadhāti yadi purastād aprāstaṃ bhavati /
meaning: इन्द्रियाज् ज्यैष्ठ्याच् छ्रैष्ठ्यान् मा योषम् इत्य् उन्मुच्य कृष्णाजिनम् अभ्युक्ष्य निदधाति यदि पुरस्ताद् अप्रास्तं भवति /
text_mt: With the mantra, 'May I not be separated from faculty, seniority, or pre-eminence,' he takes off the black antelope skin, sprinkles it with water, and sets it down, if it was not cast away earlier.

sanskrit_iast: sumitrā nas \\ ity abhipragāhyānupamajjantau sahaśiraskau snāto 'nyonyasya pṛṣṭhaṃ prakṣālayataḥ pratīpam āplavamānau gāhete /
meaning: सुमित्रा नस् \\ इत्य् अभिप्रगाह्यानुपमज्जन्तौ सहशिरस्कौ स्नातो ऽन्योन्यस्य पृष्ठं प्रक्षालयतः प्रतीपम् आप्लवमानौ गाहेते /
text_mt: Having stepped into the water with 'Propitious to us…,' without submerging their heads, with their heads [wet], they bathe, wash each other's backs, and plunge in swimming against the current.

sanskrit_iast: vi te muñcāmi raśanās \\ iti mekhalāṃ yajamāno visram̐sayate /
meaning: वि ते मुञ्चामि रशनास् \\ इति मेखलां यजमानो विस्रम्̐सयते /
text_mt: With the mantra, 'I loosen your bonds…,' the sacrificer unties his girdle.

sanskrit_iast: imaṃ viṣyāmi \\ iti yoktrapāśaṃ patnī /
meaning: इमं विष्यामि \\ इति योक्त्रपाशं पत्नी /
text_mt: With the mantra, 'I untie this [noose of Varuṇa]…,' the wife [unties] the loop of her yoke-halter.

sanskrit_iast: mekhalāṃ yoktraṃ jālaṃ dīkṣitavasane ca praplāvya somopanahanaṃ yajamānaḥ paridhatte somapariśrayaṇaṃ patnī /
meaning: मेखलां योक्त्रं जालं दीक्षितवसने च प्रप्लाव्य सोमोपनहनं यजमानः परिधत्ते सोमपरिश्रयणं पत्नी /
text_mt: Having set floating [in the water] the girdle, the yoke-strap, the netting, and the two garments worn during consecration, the sacrificer puts on the cloth that was used for tying up the soma, and the sacrificer's wife puts on the cloth that was used for enclosing the soma.

sanskrit_iast: tāv ahatavāsasāv uditaḥ /
meaning: ताव् अहतवाससाव् उदितः /
text_mt: The two come out wearing unwashed garments.

sanskrit_iast: te udayanīyāyām adhvaryave dattaḥ //
meaning: ते उदयनीयायाम् अध्वर्यवे दत्तः //
text_mt: They give those two [garments] to the adhvaryu at the concluding rite.

sanskrit_iast: vyākhyātam unnayanam /
meaning: व्याख्यातम् उन्नयनम् /

sanskrit_iast: mahīyā /
meaning: महीया /

sanskrit_iast: samidabhyādhānam /
meaning: समिदभ्याधानम् /

sanskrit_iast: upasthānaṃ ca /
meaning: उपस्थानं च /

sanskrit_iast: apareṇa śālāmukhīyam upaviśya juhvāṃ pañcagṛhītaṃ gṛhītvā kṛṣṇājinam upastha ādhāya mayīndra indriyaṃ jyaiṣṭhyam̐ śraiṣṭhyaṃ dadhātu \\ iti juhoti /
meaning: अपरेण शालामुखीयम् उपविश्य जुह्वां पञ्चगृहीतं गृहीत्वा कृष्णाजिनम् उपस्थ आधाय मयीन्द्र इन्द्रियं ज्यैष्ठ्यम्̐ श्रैष्ठ्यं दधातु \\ इति जुहोति /
text_mt: Having sat down behind the śālāmukhīya fire, having scooped five ladlings into the juhū ladle, and having placed the black-antelope skin upon his lap, he offers with: 'May Indra place in me vigor, seniority, and excellence!'

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṇājinaṃ pra vāpayate /
meaning: कृष्णाजिनं प्र वापयते /
text_mt: He has the black-antelope skin thrown away,

sanskrit_iast: srugavadhānaṃ vā kurute /
meaning: स्रुगवधानं वा कुरुते /
text_mt: or he makes it a place to put the offering ladles,

sanskrit_iast: haviṣo vātha peṣaṇam /
meaning: हविषो वाथ पेषणम् /

sanskrit_iast: punardīkṣāyā evainan nidhatte /
meaning: पुनर्दीक्षाया एवैनन् निधत्ते /
text_mt: or he puts it away for another consecration,

sanskrit_iast: putrāya vainad brahmacāriṇe vā dadyāt /
meaning: पुत्राय वैनद् ब्रह्मचारिणे वा दद्यात् /
text_mt: or he may give it to a son or to a Vedic student,

sanskrit_iast: yadi purastādaprāstaṃ bhavati /
meaning: यदि पुरस्तादप्रास्तं भवति /
text_mt: if it has not been thrown away previously.

sanskrit_iast: udayanīyāyāṃ vratam upaiti /
meaning: उदयनीयायां व्रतम् उपैति /
text_mt: At the concluding rite, he enters upon the ritual observance.

sanskrit_iast: anūbandhyāvapāyām̐ hutāyāṃ dakṣiṇasyāṃ vediśroṇyāṃ pariśrite yajamānasya keśaśmaśrūṇi vāpayate 'tra dadāti yad dāsyan bhavati /
meaning: अनूबन्ध्यावपायाम्̐ हुतायां दक्षिणस्यां वेदिश्रोण्यां परिश्रिते यजमानस्य केशश्मश्रूणि वापयते ऽत्र ददाति यद् दास्यन् भवति /
text_mt: When the omentum of the concluding animal sacrifice has been offered, in an enclosure on the southern hip of the altar, he causes the hair and beard of the sacrificer to be shaved; here he gives whatever he intends to give.

sanskrit_iast: vyākhyātaḥ svaruhṛdayaśūlo yūpopasthānaṃ ca /
meaning: व्याख्यातः स्वरुहृदयशूलो यूपोपस्थानं च /
text_mt: The chip from the sacrificial post, the heart-spit, and the worship of the sacrificial post are explained.

sanskrit_iast: mithunau gāvau maitrāvaruṇyām āmikṣāyāṃ dadāti /
meaning: मिथुनौ गावौ मैत्रावरुण्याम् आमिक्षायां ददाति /
text_mt: He gives a pair of cattle at the curd mixture for Mitra-Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast: saktuhome hūyamāne \\ ayaṃ no nabhasā puras \\ ity agnim upatiṣṭhate /
meaning: सक्तुहोमे हूयमाने \\ अयं नो नभसा पुरस् \\ इत्य् अग्निम् उपतिष्ठते /
text_mt: While the roasted-barley-meal oblation is being offered, he worships Agni with: 'This one before us with the vapor…'

sanskrit_iast: sa tvaṃ no nabhasaspate \\ iti vāyum \\ deva sam̐sphāna \\ ity ādityam /
meaning: स त्वं नो नभसस्पते \\ इति वायुम् \\ देव सम्̐स्फान \\ इत्य् आदित्यम् /
text_mt: Vāyu with: 'Do thou, O lord of the vapor…', [and] Āditya with: 'O divine Samsphāna…'

sanskrit_iast: anaḍvāham anaḍuho vā hiraṇyam audavasānīyāyāṃ dadāti /
meaning: अनड्वाहम् अनडुहो वा हिरण्यम् औदवसानीयायां ददाति /
text_mt: At the audavasānīyā rite, he gives a draft ox, or gold to the value of a draft ox;

sanskrit_iast: yathāśakti pūrṇāhutau /
meaning: यथाशक्ति पूर्णाहुतौ /
text_mt: at the full offering [of that rite], according to his capacity.

sanskrit_iast: apavṛtte ṣoḍaśinaḥ stotre tam evāśvam aśvatarīṃ vā dakṣiṇāṃ dadāti //
meaning: अपवृत्ते षोडशिनः स्तोत्रे तम् एवाश्वम् अश्वतरीं वा दक्षिणां ददाति //
text_mt: When the chant of the ṣoḍaśin has ended, he gives that very horse or a mule as sacrificial gift.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇāṃ pratigrahīṣyan pratigṛhya vā saptadaśakṛtvo 'pāniti /
meaning: दक्षिणां प्रतिग्रहीष्यन् प्रतिगृह्य वा सप्तदशकृत्वो ऽपानिति /
text_mt: When about to receive, or after having received, a sacrificial gift, he exhales seventeen times.

sanskrit_iast: barhiṣā pratīyād gāṃ vāśvaṃ vā /
meaning: बर्हिषा प्रतीयाद् गां वाश्वं वा /
text_mt: With sacrificial grass he should accept a cow or a horse;

sanskrit_iast: annena puruṣam /
meaning: अन्नेन पुरुषम् /

sanskrit_iast: gandhena ca priyodyena ca talpam /
meaning: गन्धेन च प्रियोद्येन च तल्पम् /
text_mt: and with fragrance and pleasant speech, a couch.

sanskrit_iast: barhiḥ pratyuttiṣṭhati barhir vai dakṣiṇāyāḥ priyaṃ dhāma priyo dakṣiṇāyā bhavaty enaṃ dakṣiṇāgacchati /
meaning: बर्हिः प्रत्युत्तिष्ठति बर्हिर् वै दक्षिणायाः प्रियं धाम प्रियो दक्षिणाया भवत्य् एनं दक्षिणागच्छति /
text_mt: Sacrificial grass stands ready: sacrificial grass is indeed the dear abode of the sacrificial gift; he becomes dear to the sacrificial gift, and the sacrificial gift comes to him.

sanskrit_iast: devā vai varuṇam ayājayan sa yasyaiyasyai devatāyai dakṣiṇām anayat tām avlīnāt te 'bruvan vyāvṛtya pratigṛhṇāma tathā no dakṣiṇā na vleṣyatīti te vyāvṛtya pratyagṛhṇan tato vai tān dakṣiṇā nāvlīnād ya evaṃ vidvān vyāvṛtya dakṣiṇāṃ pratigṛhṇāti nainaṃ dakṣiṇā vlīnātīti /
meaning: देवा वै वरुणम् अयाजयन् स यस्यैयस्यै देवतायै दक्षिणाम् अनयत् ताम् अव्लीनात् ते ऽब्रुवन् व्यावृत्य प्रतिगृह्णाम तथा नो दक्षिणा न व्लेष्यतीति ते व्यावृत्य प्रत्यगृह्णन् ततो वै तान् दक्षिणा नाव्लीनाद् य एवं विद्वान् व्यावृत्य दक्षिणां प्रतिगृह्णाति नैनं दक्षिणा व्लीनातीति /
text_mt: [The Brāhmaṇa says:] 'The gods sacrificed for Varuṇa. To whatever deity he brought a sacrificial gift, that [deity] crushed it. They said: Let us accept it by turning away, so that the sacrificial gift will not crush us. They accepted it by turning away. Then indeed the sacrificial gift did not crush them. He who, knowing thus, accepts a sacrificial gift by turning away—him the sacrificial gift does not crush.'

sanskrit_iast: vyāvṛtya pratigrahaṇam /
meaning: व्यावृत्य प्रतिग्रहणम् /
text_mt: The acceptance is by turning away.

sanskrit_iast: tān trīṇāṃ dakṣiṇānāṃ darśayati //
meaning: तान् त्रीणां दक्षिणानां दर्शयति //
text_mt: He shows them for three sacrificial gifts.

sanskrit_iast: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave 'śvinor bāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ pratigṛhṇāmi \ rājā tvā varuṇo nayatu devi dakṣiṇe 'gnaye hiraṇyam \\ tenāmṛtatvam aśyām \\ vayo dātre bhūyān mayo mahyam astu pratigrahītre \ ka idaṃ kasmā adāt \ kāmaḥ kāmāya \ kāmo dātā \ kāmaḥ pratigrahītā \ kāmam̐ samudram āviśa \ kāmena tvā pratigṛhṇāmi \ kāmaitat te \\ eṣā te kāma dakṣiṇā \\ uttānas tvāṅgīrasaḥ pratigṛhṇātu \ somāya vāsas \\ gnās tvākṛntan \\ apaso 'tanvata \ varūtrayo 'vayan \\ avadhiyo apṛñcata \ rudrāya gām \\ varuṇāyāśvam \\ prajāpataye puruṣam \\ manave talpam \\ tvaṣṭre 'jām \\ pūṣṇe 'vim \\ nirṛtyā aśvataragardabhau \ himavato hastinam \\ gandharvāpsarābhyaḥ sragalaṃkaraṇe \ viśvebhyo devebhyo dhānyam \\ vāce 'nnam \\ brahmaṇa odanam \\ samudrāyāpas \\ uttānāyāṅgīrasāyānas \\ vaiśvānarāya ratham \\ vaiśvānaraḥ pratnathā nākam āruhat \\ divaḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhandamānaḥ sumanmabhiḥ \ sa pūrvavaj janayaj jantave dhanam \\ samānam ajmā pariyāti jāgṛvis \\ iti vaiśvānaryarcā rathaṃ pratigṛhṇāti /
