sanskrit_iast: yady ukhye bhriyamāṇe kāmayeta varṣed iti sūryo apo vigāhate \ raśmibhir vājasā tamaḥ / \ bodhā stotre vayovṛdhaḥ // \ pari yo raśminā divas \\ antān mame pṛthivyāḥ / \ ubhe āpaprau rodasī mahitvā // \ bahiṣṭhebhir viharan yāsi tantum \ avavyayann asitaṃ deva vasvaḥ / \ davidhvato raśmayaḥ sūryasya \ carmevāvādhus tamo apsv antar ity etābhis tisṛbhis tisraḥ samidha ādadhyāt //
meaning: यद्य् उख्ये भ्रियमाणे कामयेत वर्षेद् इति सूर्यो अपो विगाहते \ रश्मिभिर् वाजसा तमः / \ बोधा स्तोत्रे वयोवृधः // \ परि यो रश्मिना दिवस् \\ अन्तान् ममे पृथिव्याः / \ उभे आपप्रौ रोदसी महित्वा // \ बहिष्ठेभिर् विहरन् यासि तन्तुम् \ अवव्ययन्न् असितं देव वस्वः / \ दविध्वतो रश्मयः सूर्यस्य \ चर्मेवावाधुस् तमो अप्स्व् अन्तर् इत्य् एताभिस् तिसृभिस् तिस्रः समिध आदध्यात् //
text_mt: If, while [the fire] is being carried in the ukhā pot, he should desire that it rain, he should put on three pieces of firewood with these three [verses]: "The sun plunges into the waters, / with rays, winning strength, [dispelling] darkness; / be mindful of the praise, O increasers of vigor! // Who with a ray measured around / the ends of heaven and earth; / he filled both worlds with greatness. // Spreading abroad with the outermost [rays], you follow the web, / weaving down the dark [cover], O god, for wealth; / the quivering rays of the sun / have laid down the darkness within the waters, like a hide."

sanskrit_iast: yady ukhye bhriyamāṇe kāmayeta na varṣed iti \\ adṛśram asya ketavas \\ vi raśmayo janām̐ anu / \ bhrājanto agnayo yathā // \ taraṇir viśvadarśatas \\ ity eṣā // divo rukma urucakṣā udeti \ dūrearthas taraṇir bhrājamānaḥ / \ nūnaṃ janāḥ sūryeṇa prasūtās \\ āyann arthāni kṛṇvann apām̐si \\ ity etābhis tisraḥ samidha ādadhyāt //
meaning: यद्य् उख्ये भ्रियमाणे कामयेत न वर्षेद् इति \\ अदृश्रम् अस्य केतवस् \\ वि रश्मयो जनाम्̐ अनु / \ भ्राजन्तो अग्नयो यथा // \ तरणिर् विश्वदर्शतस् \\ इत्य् एषा // दिवो रुक्म उरुचक्षा उदेति \ दूरेअर्थस् तरणिर् भ्राजमानः / \ नूनं जनाः सूर्येण प्रसूतास् \\ आयन्न् अर्थानि कृण्वन्न् अपाम्̐सि \\ इत्य् एताभिस् तिस्रः समिध आदध्यात् //
text_mt: If, while [the fire] is being carried in the ukhā pot, he should desire that it not rain, he should put on three pieces of firewood with these [verses]: "His banners have appeared, / his rays across the peoples, / shining like fires"; / "Crossing, visible to all..." is this one; / "The disc of heaven, wide-eyed, rises, / far-aiming, crossing, brilliant; / now men impelled by the sun / go to their aims, performing works."

sanskrit_iast: yady ukhye bhriyamāṇe kiṃcin naśyet \\ agne 'bhyāvartin \\ iti catasṛbhir upatiṣṭhate / vindaty evaitad iti vijñāyate //
meaning: यद्य् उख्ये भ्रियमाणे किंचिन् नश्येत् \\ अग्ने ऽभ्यावर्तिन् \\ इति चतसृभिर् उपतिष्ठते / विन्दत्य् एवैतद् इति विज्ञायते //
text_mt: If, while [the fire] is being carried in the ukhā pot, anything should be lost, he reveres [the fire] with the four [verses beginning with:] "O Agni, turning toward us..."; he surely finds it, so it is known [from the Brāhmaṇa].

sanskrit_iast: ud u tvā viśve devās \\ ity ukhyam udyacchate //
meaning: उद् उ त्वा विश्वे देवास् \\ इत्य् उख्यम् उद्यच्छते //
text_mt: With "Up have all the gods...", he lifts up the fire in the ukhā pot.

sanskrit_iast: sīda tvaṃ mātur asyā upasthe \\ iti catasṛbhir dvīṣe śakaṭa āsādayati //
meaning: सीद त्वं मातुर् अस्या उपस्थे \\ इति चतसृभिर् द्वीषे शकट आसादयति //
text_mt: With the four [verses beginning with:] "Sit down on the lap of this mother...", he places it on a two-poled cart.

sanskrit_iast: tūṣṇīm itarāv agnī āsādya pred agne jyotiṣmān iti prayāti //
meaning: तूष्णीम् इतराव् अग्नी आसाद्य प्रेद् अग्ने ज्योतिष्मान् इति प्रयाति //
text_mt: Having silently placed the other two fires, he sets out with: "Go forward, O Agni, full of light..."

sanskrit_iast: akrandad agnis \\ ity akṣaśabdam abhimantrayate //
meaning: अक्रन्दद् अग्निस् \\ इत्य् अक्षशब्दम् अभिमन्त्रयते //
text_mt: With "Agni has roared...", he consecrates the sound of the axle.

sanskrit_iast: adhyavasāyaudumbarīm̐ samidhaṃ ghṛtānuṣiktām atithivatyokhye 'bhyādadhāti samidhāgniṃ duvasyata \\ iti gāyatryā brahmaṇasya / pra prāyam agnis \\ iti triṣṭubhā rājanyasya / jagatyā vaiśyasya //
meaning: अध्यवसायौदुम्बरीम्̐ समिधं घृतानुषिक्ताम् अतिथिवत्योख्ये ऽभ्यादधाति समिधाग्निं दुवस्यत \\ इति गायत्र्या ब्रह्मणस्य / प्र प्रायम् अग्निस् \\ इति त्रिष्टुभा राजन्यस्य / जगत्या वैश्यस्य //
text_mt: Having shifted [the settlement], he puts on the fire in the ukhā pot a piece of udumbara firewood smeared with clarified butter, accompanied by the verse for the guest: with a gāyatrī verse, "Tend Agni with firewood...", in the case of a brāhmaṇa; with a triṣṭubh verse, "Forth went this Agni...", in the case of a rājanya; with a jagatī verse in the case of a vaiśya.

sanskrit_iast: indhane vratane 'dhyavasāne ca sarvāsu saṃnipātitāsu ghṛtānuṣiktāṃ prathamām ādadhāti //
meaning: इन्धने व्रतने ऽध्यवसाने च सर्वासु संनिपातितासु घृतानुषिक्तां प्रथमाम् आदधाति //
text_mt: At kindling, at taking the vow-food, and at shifting, when all [occasions] coincide, he puts on the first [piece of firewood] smeared with clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: yady ukhāṃ bhasmābhisam̐sīded ukhyam ādāyodakāntaṃ gatvā \\ imam̐ suyonim̐ suvratam̐ hiraṇmayam ( prapyātam agne sarirasya madhye / \ utsaṃ juṣasva madhumantam ūrva \ samudriyam̐ sadanam āviśasva ) iti dvābhyām ukhyam upāvaharati //
meaning: यद्य् उखां भस्माभिसम्̐सीदेद् उख्यम् आदायोदकान्तं गत्वा \\ इमम्̐ सुयोनिम्̐ सुव्रतम्̐ हिरण्मयम् ( प्रप्यातम् अग्ने सरिरस्य मध्ये / \ उत्सं जुषस्व मधुमन्तम् ऊर्व \ समुद्रियम्̐ सदनम् आविशस्व ) इति द्वाभ्याम् उख्यम् उपावहरति //
text_mt: If the ashes should settle over the ukhā pot, having taken the fire in the ukhā pot and gone to the edge of water, he takes down the fire in the ukhā pot with two [verses]: "This good womb, good-vowed, golden, (swollen, O Agni, in the midst of the water; / enjoy the honey-rich spring, the cavern; / enter your oceanic seat.)"

sanskrit_iast: āpo devīḥ pratigṛbhṇīta bhamasitat \\ iti tisṛbhir apsu bhasma praveśayati //
meaning: आपो देवीः प्रतिगृभ्णीत भमसितत् \\ इति तिसृभिर् अप्सु भस्म प्रवेशयति //
text_mt: With the three [verses beginning with:] "O divine waters, receive the ashes...", he introduces the ashes into the water.

sanskrit_iast: bhasmanaḥ pratyādāya prasadya bhasmanā yonim iti dvābhyām ukhyāyāṃ pratyavadadhāti //
meaning: भस्मनः प्रत्यादाय प्रसद्य भस्मना योनिम् इति द्वाभ्याम् उख्यायां प्रत्यवदधाति //
text_mt: Taking back [some] of the ashes, he puts it back down into the ukhā pot with the two [verses beginning with:] "Having settled into the womb with ashes..."

sanskrit_iast: punar ūrjā \ saha rayyā \\ iti dvābhyāṃ pratyeti //
meaning: पुनर् ऊर्जा \ सह रय्या \\ इति द्वाभ्यां प्रत्येति //
text_mt: With the two [verses:] "Back with vigor...", "Together with wealth...", he returns.

sanskrit_iast: punas tvādityā rudrā vasavaḥ samindhatām ity upasamindhe //
meaning: पुनस् त्वादित्या रुद्रा वसवः समिन्धताम् इत्य् उपसमिन्धे //
text_mt: With "Again let the Ādityas, the Rudras, the Vasus kindle you", he kindles [the fire].

sanskrit_iast: bodhā \ sa bodhi \\ iti // bodhavatībhyām upatiṣṭhate //
meaning: बोधा \ स बोधि \\ इति // बोधवतीभ्याम् उपतिष्ठते //
text_mt: He reveres [it] with the two verses containing the word 'awake', [namely:] "Awake...", "Be awake..."

sanskrit_iast: nityam apsu bhasmapraveśanaṃ kṛtvā dīkṣitasya kṛtāsv iṣṭakāsu akṛtāsv iṣṭakānām̐ sam̐sargārthaṃ bhavati //
meaning: नित्यम् अप्सु भस्मप्रवेशनं कृत्वा दीक्षितस्य कृतास्व् इष्टकासु अकृतास्व् इष्टकानाम्̐ सम्̐सर्गार्थं भवति //
text_mt: The regular throwing of the ashes into water having been performed for the consecrated [sacrificer], if the bricks have been made, [the remaining ashes] are for the mixing of the bricks if they have not been made.

sanskrit_iast: purīṣe paśukāmaḥ kurvīta //
meaning: पुरीषे पशुकामः कुर्वीत //
text_mt: One who desires cattle should make [the bricks] with the loose earth [of the altar].

sanskrit_iast: apsu yāyāvaraḥ pravapet //
meaning: अप्सु यायावरः प्रवपेत् //
text_mt: A nomad should throw [the ashes] into water.

sanskrit_iast: tisro rātrīr dīkṣitaḥ syāt / ṣaḍ rātrīr dīkṣitaḥ syād iti brāhmaṇavyākhyātāḥ kāmyā dīkṣākalpās teṣāṃ yāthākāmī //
meaning: तिस्रो रात्रीर् दीक्षितः स्यात् / षड् रात्रीर् दीक्षितः स्याद् इति ब्राह्मणव्याख्याताः काम्या दीक्षाकल्पास् तेषां याथाकामी //
text_mt: He should remain consecrated for three nights, or he should remain consecrated for six nights; these optional rules for consecration are explained in the Brāhmaṇa; among them there is freedom of choice.

sanskrit_iast: dīkṣitasyeṣṭakāḥ karoti māsaprabhṛtiṣu dīkṣākalpeṣu purastād adīkṣitasyetareṣūpariṣṭāt prājāpatyāt paśoḥ //
meaning: दीक्षितस्येष्टकाः करोति मासप्रभृतिषु दीक्षाकल्पेषु पुरस्ताद् अदीक्षितस्येतरेषूपरिष्टात् प्राजापत्यात् पशोः //
text_mt: He makes the bricks of the consecrated [sacrificer] previously in the consecration-options of a month and so forth; for one not consecrated [he makes them] afterwards, in the other [options], after the animal sacrifice to Prajāpati.

sanskrit_iast: mṛnmayīr iṣṭakā aviṣamāś caturaśrās tāsāṃ tisro maṇḍaleṣṭakā ṛjulekhā dakṣiṇāvṛtaḥ savyāvṛtaś ca tryālikhitāḥ //
meaning: मृन्मयीर् इष्टका अविषमाश् चतुरश्रास् तासां तिस्रो मण्डलेष्टका ऋजुलेखा दक्षिणावृतः सव्यावृतश् च त्र्यालिखिताः //
text_mt: The earthen bricks are even and square; among them, three are disc-bricks, marked with straight lines, turned to the right and turned to the left, marked with three lines.

sanskrit_iast: nirmanthyena lohinīḥ pacanti //
meaning: निर्मन्थ्येन लोहिनीः पचन्ति //
text_mt: They bake them red with fire produced by friction.

sanskrit_iast: na kṛṣṇāṃ na lakṣmaṇāṃ na bhinnāṃ copadadhāti //
meaning: न कृष्णां न लक्ष्मणां न भिन्नां चोपदधाति //
text_mt: He does not lay down [a brick that is] black, nor one that is spotted, nor one that is broken.

sanskrit_iast: puṣkaraparṇam̐ rukmo hiraṇmayaḥ puruṣaḥ srucau sapta svayamātṛṇṇāḥ śarkarā hiraṇyeṣṭakāḥ pañca ghṛteṣṭakā dūrvāstambaḥ kūrma ulūkhalaṃ musalaṃ śūrpam aśmānaḥ paśuśirām̐si sarpaśiraś cāmṛnmayīr iṣṭakāḥ //
meaning: पुष्करपर्णम्̐ रुक्मो हिरण्मयः पुरुषः स्रुचौ सप्त स्वयमातृण्णाः शर्करा हिरण्येष्टकाः पञ्च घृतेष्टका दूर्वास्तम्बः कूर्म उलूखलं मुसलं शूर्पम् अश्मानः पशुशिराम्̐सि सर्पशिरश् चामृन्मयीर् इष्टकाः //
text_mt: The lotus leaf, the gold disc, the golden man, the two offering ladles, seven naturally perforated [stones], gravel, the five gold bricks, the five butter bricks, a clump of dūrvā grass, the tortoise, the mortar, the pestle, the winnowing basket, stones, the heads of animals, and the snake head are non-earthen bricks.

sanskrit_iast: yāvad agnimānā mantrā yathārthaṃ lokaṃpṛṇā jānudaghnam̐ sāhasraṃ cinvīta prathamaṃ cinvānaḥ / nābhidaghnaṃ dviṣāhasraṃ dvitīyam / āsyadaghnaṃ triṣāhasraṃ tṛtīyam / uttaramuttaraṃ jyāyām̐sam //
meaning: यावद् अग्निमाना मन्त्रा यथार्थं लोकंपृणा जानुदघ्नम्̐ साहस्रं चिन्वीत प्रथमं चिन्वानः / नाभिदघ्नं द्विषाहस्रं द्वितीयम् / आस्यदघ्नं त्रिषाहस्रं तृतीयम् / उत्तरमुत्तरं ज्यायाम्̐सम् //
text_mt: There are as many mantras as the measure of the fire; the space-fillers are according to need. Piling for the first time, he should pile a thousand-[brick altar] knee-high; the second time, a two-thousand-[brick altar] navel-high; the third time, a three-thousand-[brick altar] mouth-high; each subsequent one greater.

sanskrit_iast: mahāntaṃ bṛhantam aparimitaṃ svargakāmaś cinvīteti vājasaneyakam //
meaning: महान्तं बृहन्तम् अपरिमितं स्वर्गकामश् चिन्वीतेति वाजसनेयकम् //
text_mt: One who desires heaven should pile [an altar that is] great, vast, and boundless: so says the Vājasaneyaka [tradition].

sanskrit_iast: apavṛtte dīkṣāparimāṇe \\ apeta vīta \\ iti devayajanam adhyavasyati //
meaning: अपवृत्ते दीक्षापरिमाणे \\ अपेत वीत \\ इति देवयजनम् अध्यवस्यति //
text_mt: When the measure of consecration has ended, with "Depart, disperse...", he settles upon the sacrificial ground.

sanskrit_iast: uddhatya citer āyatanaṃ vyāyāmamātram // caturaśraṃ parimaṇḍalaṃ vā \\ apeta vīta \\ iti hariṇyā palāśaśākhayā sam̐sṛjyādbhir avokṣya \\ agner bhasmāsi \\ iti sikatā navapati //
meaning: उद्धत्य चितेर् आयतनं व्यायाममात्रम् // चतुरश्रं परिमण्डलं वा \\ अपेत वीत \\ इति हरिण्या पलाशशाखया सम्̐सृज्याद्भिर् अवोक्ष्य \\ अग्नेर् भस्मासि \\ इति सिकता नवपति //
text_mt: Having raised [the earth] of the site of the altar to the measure of an arm's span—either square or round—he sweeps it with a green palāśa branch with [the mantra], 'Go away, depart...', sprinkles it with water, and scatters sand with [the mantra], 'You are the ashes of Agni...'.

sanskrit_iast: saṃjñanam asi kāmadharaṇam ity ūṣān //
meaning: संज्ञनम् असि कामधरणम् इत्य् ऊषान् //
text_mt: With [the formula], 'You are the concord, the bearer of desires...', [he scatters] saline earth.

sanskrit_iast: tān nivapan yad adaś candramasi kṛṣṇaṃ tad ihāstu \\ iti manasā dhyāyati //
meaning: तान् निवपन् यद् अदश् चन्द्रमसि कृष्णं तद् इहास्तु \\ इति मनसा ध्यायति //
text_mt: While scattering it, he meditates in his mind: 'What dark spot is there on the moon, let that be here.'

sanskrit_iast: saṃ yā vaḥ priyās tanuvas \\ ity ūṣān sikatāś ca sam̐sṛjyānuvyūhati //
meaning: सं या वः प्रियास् तनुवस् \\ इत्य् ऊषान् सिकताश् च सम्̐सृज्यानुव्यूहति //
text_mt: With [the formula], 'Together with your dear bodies...', he mixes the saline earth and the sand together and levels them.

sanskrit_iast: citaḥ stha paricitas \\ ity ekavim̐śatyā śarkarābhir gārhapatyaciter āyatanaṃ pariśrayati //
meaning: चितः स्थ परिचितस् \\ इत्य् एकविम्̐शत्या शर्कराभिर् गार्हपत्यचितेर् आयतनं परिश्रयति //
text_mt: With [the formula], 'You are piled, closely piled...', he encloses the site of the gārhapatya altar with twenty-one pebbles.

sanskrit_iast: tisrastisraḥ sam̐hitāḥ karoti //
meaning: तिस्रस्तिस्रः सम्̐हिताः करोति //
text_mt: He places them in joined sets of three each.

sanskrit_iast: ayam̐ so agnis \\ iti catasṛbhir gārhapatyacitau catasraḥ prācīr iṣṭakā upadadhāti //
meaning: अयम्̐ सो अग्निस् \\ इति चतसृभिर् गार्हपत्यचितौ चतस्रः प्राचीर् इष्टका उपदधाति //
text_mt: With the four [verses beginning with], 'This is that Agni...', he lays down four bricks facing east on the gārhapatya altar.

sanskrit_iast: iḍām agne \\ ayaṃ te yonir ṛtviyas \\ iti dve purastādūrdhvasam̐hite cid asi \ paricid asi \\ iti dve paścādūrdhvasam̐hite lokaṃ pṛṇa chidraṃ pṛṇa \\ ity avaśiṣṭaṃ trayodaśabhir lokaṃpṛṇābhiḥ pracchādayati //
meaning: इडाम् अग्ने \\ अयं ते योनिर् ऋत्वियस् \\ इति द्वे पुरस्तादूर्ध्वसम्̐हिते चिद् असि \ परिचिद् असि \\ इति द्वे पश्चादूर्ध्वसम्̐हिते लोकं पृण छिद्रं पृण \\ इत्य् अवशिष्टं त्रयोदशभिर् लोकंपृणाभिः प्रच्छादयति //
text_mt: With [the two mantras], 'Iḍā, O Agni...' and 'This is your seasonal womb...', [he lays down] two [bricks] facing east joined vertically; with [the two mantras], 'You are piling' and 'You are enclosing', [he lays down] two [bricks] facing west joined vertically; with [the mantra], 'Fill the world, fill the gap...', he covers the remainder with thirteen space-filling [bricks].

sanskrit_iast: dvābhyāṃdvābhyāṃ mantrābhyām ekaikāṃ lokaṃpṛṇām upadadhāti //
meaning: द्वाभ्यांद्वाभ्यां मन्त्राभ्याम् एकैकां लोकंपृणाम् उपदधाति //
text_mt: He lays down each space-filling [brick] with two mantras each.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvayopadhāya sūdadohasābhimṛśati //
meaning: पूर्वयोपधाय सूददोहसाभिमृशति //
text_mt: Having laid it down with the former [mantra], he touches it with the sūdadohas [verse].

sanskrit_iast: sarvāsv iṣṭakāsu tayādevatam antato dadhāti //
meaning: सर्वास्व् इष्टकासु तयादेवतम् अन्ततो दधाति //
text_mt: On all the bricks, he performs the tayādevata formula at the end.

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṇo 'śvaḥ śyāvo vottaratas tiṣṭhati //
meaning: कृष्णो ऽश्वः श्यावो वोत्तरतस् तिष्ठति //
text_mt: A black horse, or a dark-brown one, stands to the north.

sanskrit_iast: tam ālabhya cātvālāt purīṣam āhṛtya pṛṣṭo divi \\ ity anuvyūhati //
meaning: तम् आलभ्य चात्वालात् पुरीषम् आहृत्य पृष्टो दिवि \\ इत्य् अनुव्यूहति //
text_mt: Having touched it and brought loose soil from the cātvāla, he spreads it out with [the verse], 'Seen in the sky...'.

sanskrit_iast: sā citir bhavati //
meaning: सा चितिर् भवति //

sanskrit_iast: pañcacitīkaṃ cinvīta prathamaṃ cinvānas tricitīkaṃ dvitīyam ekacitīkaṃ tṛtīyam //
meaning: पञ्चचितीकं चिन्वीत प्रथमं चिन्वानस् त्रिचितीकं द्वितीयम् एकचितीकं तृतीयम् //
text_mt: One who piles for the first time should pile [an altar] of five layers; [one who piles] for the second time, of three layers; [one who piles] for the third time, of one layer.

sanskrit_iast: ekacitīko nityaḥ kalpaḥ //
meaning: एकचितीको नित्यः कल्पः //
text_mt: The single-layer [altar] is the regular procedure.

sanskrit_iast: sam itam iti catasṛbhir gārhapatyacitāv ukhyaṃ nivapati //
meaning: सम् इतम् इति चतसृभिर् गार्हपत्यचिताव् उख्यं निवपति //
text_mt: With the four [verses beginning with], 'Assemble...', he pours the fire of the pot into the gārhapatya altar.

sanskrit_iast: māteva putram iti śikyād ukhāṃ nirūhati //
meaning: मातेव पुत्रम् इति शिक्याद् उखां निरूहति //
text_mt: With [the mantra], 'Like a mother her son...', he removes the pot from the net-sling.

sanskrit_iast: atraivaike pūraṇam āmananti na riktām avekṣeta //
meaning: अत्रैवैके पूरणम् आमनन्ति न रिक्ताम् अवेक्षेत //
text_mt: Right here some teach the filling [of it]; he should not look at it empty.

sanskrit_iast: yad asya pāre rajasas \\ iti vaiśvānaryā śikyam ādatte //
meaning: यद् अस्य पारे रजसस् \\ इति वैश्वानर्या शिक्यम् आदत्ते //
text_mt: With the vaiśvānara verse, 'What on the farther shore of the mist...', he takes up the net-sling.

sanskrit_iast: nairṛtīr iṣṭakāḥ kṛṣṇās tisras tuṣapakvāḥ śikyam̐ rukmasūtram āsandīṃ cādāya dakṣiṇāparam avāntaradeśam̐ hṛtvā svakṛta iriṇe pradare vā namaḥ su te nirṛte \\ iti parācīr asam̐spṛṣṭā upadadhāti //
meaning: नैरृतीर् इष्टकाः कृष्णास् तिस्रस् तुषपक्वाः शिक्यम्̐ रुक्मसूत्रम् आसन्दीं चादाय दक्षिणापरम् अवान्तरदेशम्̐ हृत्वा स्वकृत इरिणे प्रदरे वा नमः सु ते निरृते \\ इति पराचीर् असम्̐स्पृष्टा उपदधाति //
text_mt: Having taken three black bricks sacred to Nirṛti baked with chaff, the net-sling, the gold plate's cord, and the stool, and having carried them to the south-western quarter to a natural cleft or chasm, he lays [the bricks] down facing away, not touching each other, with [the mantra], 'Reverence be well to you, O Nirṛti...'.

sanskrit_iast: ( tasyeṣṭakābhiḥ pāśam abhyupadadhāti) //
meaning: ( तस्येष्टकाभिः पाशम् अभ्युपदधाति) //
text_mt: ([The adhvaryu] places the snare upon it with the bricks.)

sanskrit_iast: ( yasyās te asyāḥ krūra āsañ juhomi \\ ity etābhis tisṛbhiḥ parācīr asam̐spṛṣṭā dakṣiṇāpavargam ) //
meaning: ( यस्यास् ते अस्याः क्रूर आसञ् जुहोमि \\ इत्य् एताभिस् तिसृभिः पराचीर् असम्̐स्पृष्टा दक्षिणापवर्गम् ) //
text_mt: (With these three [verses beginning with], 'In whose cruel mouth of yours I offer...', [he lays them down] facing away, not touching each other, ending towards the south.)

sanskrit_iast: na tayādevataṃ karoti //
meaning: न तयादेवतं करोति //

sanskrit_iast: yat te devī nirṛtir ābabandha \\ iti śikyam adhinyasyati //
meaning: यत् ते देवी निरृतिर् आबबन्ध \\ इति शिक्यम् अधिन्यस्यति //
text_mt: With [the mantra], 'What the goddess Nirṛti has bound on you...', he throws the net-sling down upon [them].

sanskrit_iast: atrāsandīm̐ rukmasūtraṃ ca nidadhāti //
meaning: अत्रासन्दीम्̐ रुक्मसूत्रं च निदधाति //
text_mt: Here he deposits the stool and the cord of the gold plate.

sanskrit_iast: yad asya pāre rajasas \\ iti vaiśvānaryā pariṣiñcati //
meaning: यद् अस्य पारे रजसस् \\ इति वैश्वानर्या परिषिञ्चति //
text_mt: With the vaiśvānara verse, 'What on the farther shore of the mist...', he pours water around.

sanskrit_iast: namo bhūtyai \\ iti pradakṣiṇam āvartate //
meaning: नमो भूत्यै \\ इति प्रदक्षिणम् आवर्तते //
text_mt: With [the formula], 'Reverence to prosperity', he turns clockwise.

sanskrit_iast: śaṃ no devīr abhiṣṭaye \\ iti mārjayante //
meaning: शं नो देवीर् अभिष्टये \\ इति मार्जयन्ते //
text_mt: With [the verse], 'May the divine [waters] be for our help...', they cleanse themselves.

sanskrit_iast: ūrjaṃ bibhrad vasumanāḥ sumedhās \\ gṛhān aimi manasā modamānaḥ suvarcāḥ / \ aghoreṇa cakṣuṣāham̐ śivena \ gṛhāṇāṃ paśyan vaya uttirāṇi \\ ity apratīkṣam āyanti //
meaning: ऊर्जं बिभ्रद् वसुमनाः सुमेधास् \\ गृहान् ऐमि मनसा मोदमानः सुवर्चाः / \ अघोरेण चक्षुषाहम्̐ शिवेन \ गृहाणां पश्यन् वय उत्तिराणि \\ इत्य् अप्रतीक्षम् आयन्ति //
text_mt: With [the verse], 'Bearing vigor, of good mind, well-inspired, / I go to my home rejoicing in mind, full of splendor; / with a benign, auspicious eye, / beholding the houses, may I rise up in strength', they return without looking back.

sanskrit_iast: niveśanaḥ saṃgamano vasūnām ity āhavanīyam upatiṣṭhante / gārhapatyaṃ vā //
meaning: निवेशनः संगमनो वसूनाम् इत्य् आहवनीयम् उपतिष्ठन्ते / गार्हपत्यं वा //
text_mt: With [the verse], 'The settler, the gatherer of treasures...', they pay reverence to the āhavanīya fire, or to the gārhapatya fire.

sanskrit_iast: prāyaṇīyena pracarite rājānaṃ nyupya vediṃ kṛtvā samūlaṃ haritaṃ darbhastambaṃ madhye 'gner nikhāya juhvā pañcagṛhītaṃ gṛhītvā sajūr abdo 'yāvabhis \\ iti samudgṛhṇan darbhastambe pañcāhutīr juhoti //
meaning: प्रायणीयेन प्रचरिते राजानं न्युप्य वेदिं कृत्वा समूलं हरितं दर्भस्तम्बं मध्ये ऽग्नेर् निखाय जुह्वा पञ्चगृहीतं गृहीत्वा सजूर् अब्दो ऽयावभिस् \\ इति समुद्गृह्णन् दर्भस्तम्बे पञ्चाहुतीर् जुहोति //
text_mt: When the introductory rite has been performed, having poured down King [Soma] and constructed the vedi, having buried a clump of green darbha grass with its roots in the middle of the fire[-altar], and having taken five ladlings [of clarified butter] in the juhū, he offers five oblations on the clump of darbha grass, drawing it up with [the formula], 'Together with the year, with the half-months...'.

sanskrit_iast: yāvān puruṣa ūrdhvabāhus tāvatā veṇunāgniṃ vimimīte //
meaning: यावान् पुरुष ऊर्ध्वबाहुस् तावता वेणुनाग्निं विमिमीते //
text_mt: He measures out the fire-altar with a bamboo measuring-rod that is as long as a man with his arms raised.

sanskrit_iast: trīn prācaḥ puruṣām̐ś catura udīcas tiryañcaṃ puruṣamātrāṇi pakṣapucchāni bhavanti //
meaning: त्रीन् प्राचः पुरुषाम्̐श् चतुर उदीचस् तिर्यञ्चं पुरुषमात्राणि पक्षपुच्छानि भवन्ति //
text_mt: Three man-lengths eastward, four northward across; the wings and the tail are one man-length each.

sanskrit_iast: ātmā catuḥpuruṣo 'ratninā dakṣiṇato dakṣiṇaṃ pakṣaṃ pravardhayati //
meaning: आत्मा चतुःपुरुषो ऽरत्निना दक्षिणतो दक्षिणं पक्षं प्रवर्धयति //
text_mt: The body is four man-lengths; by a cubit on the south he extends the southern wing.

sanskrit_iast: prādeśena vitastyā vā paścāt puccham aratninottarata uttaraṃ pakṣam //
meaning: प्रादेशेन वितस्त्या वा पश्चात् पुच्छम् अरत्निनोत्तरत उत्तरं पक्षम् //
text_mt: By a span or a vitasti [he extends] the tail at the back; by a cubit on the north, the northern wing.

sanskrit_iast: syonā pṛthivi bhava \\ anṛkṣarā niveśanī / \ yacchā naḥ śarma saprathāḥ / \ baḍ itthā parvatānām iti dvābhyāṃ vimitam agnim ākramante //
meaning: स्योना पृथिवि भव \\ अनृक्षरा निवेशनी / \ यच्छा नः शर्म सप्रथाः / \ बड् इत्था पर्वतानाम् इति द्वाभ्यां विमितम् अग्निम् आक्रमन्ते //
text_mt: With the two [verses], 'Be pleasant, O earth, thornless, a resting-place; / grant us shelter of wide extent' and 'Truly thus of the mountains...', they step onto the measured fire-altar.

sanskrit_iast: saṃ varatrā dadhātana \\ iti saṃpreṣyati //
meaning: सं वरत्रा दधातन \\ इति संप्रेष्यति //
text_mt: He gives the direction with [the verse], 'Fasten the straps...'.

sanskrit_iast: niṣkṛtāhāvam avaṭam ity avaṭam āhāvām̐ś ca khanati //
meaning: निष्कृताहावम् अवटम् इत्य् अवटम् आहावाम्̐श् च खनति //
text_mt: With [the verse], 'The pit with prepared trough...', he digs the pit and the troughs.

sanskrit_iast: udriṇam̐ siñce akṣitam ity avaṭād āhāveṣūdakam utsiñcati //
meaning: उद्रिणम्̐ सिञ्चे अक्षितम् इत्य् अवटाद् आहावेषूदकम् उत्सिञ्चति //
text_mt: With [the verse], 'I pour out the water-abounding, unexhausted...', he pours out water from the pit into the troughs.

sanskrit_iast: teṣu balīvardān pāyayanti //
meaning: तेषु बलीवर्दान् पाययन्ति //
text_mt: They make the oxen drink at them.

sanskrit_iast: ud yojanam antaryāmam \ īṣāṃ khagalyam̐ śapham / \ aṣṭrāṃ tālaṃ pratīnāham \ ubhe maṇḍūkyau yujau \\ iti yugalāṅgalam̐ saṃprasārayati //
meaning: उद् योजनम् अन्तर्यामम् \ ईषां खगल्यम्̐ शफम् / \ अष्ट्रां तालं प्रतीनाहम् \ उभे मण्डूक्यौ युजौ \\ इति युगलाङ्गलम्̐ संप्रसारयति //
text_mt: With [the verse], 'The fastening upward, the restraining inside, / the pole, the cross-bar, the pin, / the goad, the span, the yoke-tie, / both the frogs, the two yoke-pins', he stretches out the yoke and the plow.

sanskrit_iast: ( sīrā yuñjanti \\ iti dvābhyāṃ sīraṃ yunakti / ṣaḍgavaṃ dvādaśagavaṃ caturvim̐śatigavaṃ vā ) // sīrā yuñjanti \\ iti dve pūṣā yunaktu savitā yunaktu \ bṛhaspatir vo yunaktu \\ agnes tejasā sūryasya varcasā \\ iti tisṛbhir yunakti ṣaḍgavaṃ dvādaśagavaṃ vety ekeṣām //
meaning: ( सीरा युञ्जन्ति \\ इति द्वाभ्यां सीरं युनक्ति / षड्गवं द्वादशगवं चतुर्विम्̐शतिगवं वा ) // सीरा युञ्जन्ति \\ इति द्वे पूषा युनक्तु सविता युनक्तु \ बृहस्पतिर् वो युनक्तु \\ अग्नेस् तेजसा सूर्यस्य वर्चसा \\ इति तिसृभिर् युनक्ति षड्गवं द्वादशगवं वेत्य् एकेषाम् //
text_mt: (With the two [verses beginning with], 'They harness the plows...', he harnesses the plow, [drawn by] six oxen, twelve oxen, or twenty-four oxen.) According to some, with the two [verses], 'They harness the plows...', and with the three [formulas], 'May Pūṣan harness, may Savitṛ harness', 'May Bṛhaspati harness you', and 'With the brilliance of Agni, with the splendor of the sun...', he harnesses [the team of] six oxen or twelve oxen.

sanskrit_iast: uṣṭārayor bilvayor \ atho ābandhanīyayoḥ / \ sarveṣāṃ vidma vo nāma \ vāhāḥ kīlālapeśasas \\ iti yuktān anumantrayate //
meaning: उष्टारयोर् बिल्वयोर् \ अथो आबन्धनीययोः / \ सर्वेषां विद्म वो नाम \ वाहाः कीलालपेशसस् \\ इति युक्तान् अनुमन्त्रयते //
text_mt: With [the verse], 'Of the two draft-oxen, of the two bilvas, / and of the two to be fastened, / of all of you we know the name, / O draft-oxen shaped like sweet drink', he consecrates the yoked [oxen].

sanskrit_iast: brahma jajñānam ity eṣā / anāptā yā vaḥ prathamā \ yasyāṃ karmāṇi kṛṇvate / \ vīrān no atra mā dabhan \\ tad va etat puro dadhe // \ pary ū ṣu pra dhanva vājasātaye \ pari vṛtrāṇi sakṣaṇiḥ / \ dviṣas taradhyai ṛṇayā na īyase // \ sahasradhāre 'va te samasvaran \ divo nāke madhujihvā asaścataḥ / \ asya spaśo na nimiṣanti bhūrṇayaḥ \ padepade pāśinaḥ santi setavas \\ iti brahmavarmāṇi juhoti //
meaning: ब्रह्म जज्ञानम् इत्य् एषा / अनाप्ता या वः प्रथमा \ यस्यां कर्माणि कृण्वते / \ वीरान् नो अत्र मा दभन् \\ तद् व एतत् पुरो दधे // \ पर्य् ऊ षु प्र धन्व वाजसातये \ परि वृत्राणि सक्षणिः / \ द्विषस् तरध्यै ऋणया न ईयसे // \ सहस्रधारे ऽव ते समस्वरन् \ दिवो नाके मधुजिह्वा असश्चतः / \ अस्य स्पशो न निमिषन्ति भूर्णयः \ पदेपदे पाशिनः सन्ति सेतवस् \\ इति ब्रह्मवर्माणि जुहोति //
text_mt: With [the verses], 'The prayer born first...', this one, 'That first [prayer] of yours which was unobtained, / in which rites are performed, / may they not harm our heroes here; / that of yours I place in front', 'Run forth swiftly for the winning of prize, / overcoming obstacles; / you speed like a debt-collector to overcome foes', and 'In the thousand-streamed one they resounded together, / clinging sweet-tongued to the vault of heaven; / his watchful spies do not blink; / at every step there are bondsmen, binders', he offers the brahma-armor oblations.

sanskrit_iast: udasthād gojid dhanajid aśvajit \\ hiraṇyajit sūnṛtayā parīvṛtaḥ / \ ekacakreṇa savitā rathena \\ ūrjaṃ bhāgaṃ pṛthivīm etv āpṛṇan \\ iti lāṅgalam ucchrayati //
meaning: उदस्थाद् गोजिद् धनजिद् अश्वजित् \\ हिरण्यजित् सूनृतया परीवृतः / \ एकचक्रेण सविता रथेन \\ ऊर्जं भागं पृथिवीम् एत्व् आपृणन् \\ इति लाङ्गलम् उच्छ्रयति //
text_mt: With [the verse], 'Up has risen the winner of cattle, winner of wealth, winner of horses, / winner of gold, surrounded by truth; / Savitṛ, with his one-wheeled chariot, / let him go filling the earth with vigor and share', he raises the plow.

sanskrit_iast: malimluco nāmāsi trayodaśo māsas \\ indrasya varmāsi \\ indrasya śarmāsi \\ indrasya varūtham asi \ taṃ tvā prapadye / \ sā me śarma ca varma ca bhava / \ gāyatrīṃ lomabhiḥ praviśāmi / \ triṣṭubhaṃ tvacā praviśāmi / \ jagatīṃ mām̐sena praviśāmi / \ anuṣṭubham asthnā praviśāmi /
meaning: मलिम्लुचो नामासि त्रयोदशो मासस् \\ इन्द्रस्य वर्मासि \\ इन्द्रस्य शर्मासि \\ इन्द्रस्य वरूथम् असि \ तं त्वा प्रपद्ये / \ सा मे शर्म च वर्म च भव / \ गायत्रीं लोमभिः प्रविशामि / \ त्रिष्टुभं त्वचा प्रविशामि / \ जगतीं माम्̐सेन प्रविशामि / \ अनुष्टुभम् अस्थ्ना प्रविशामि /
text_mt: [He recites]: 'Your name is Malimluca, the thirteenth month; / you are the armor of Indra; / you are the shelter of Indra; / you are the defense of Indra; / I resort to you as such; / be you shelter and armor to me. / I enter the gāyatrī with my body-hairs; / I enter the triṣṭubh with my skin; / I enter the jagatī with my flesh; / I enter the anuṣṭubh with my bones;'

sanskrit_iast: paṅktiṃ majjñā praviśāmi / \ aindrāgnaṃ varma bahulaṃ yad ugram \\ viśve devā nātividhyanti sūrāḥ / \ tan nas trāyatāṃ tan no viśvato mahat \\ āyuṣmanto jarām upagacchema devās \\ iti vimitam agnim ākramante //
meaning: पङ्क्तिं मज्ज्ञा प्रविशामि / \ ऐन्द्राग्नं वर्म बहुलं यद् उग्रम् \\ विश्वे देवा नातिविध्यन्ति सूराः / \ तन् नस् त्रायतां तन् नो विश्वतो महत् \\ आयुष्मन्तो जराम् उपगच्छेम देवास् \\ इति विमितम् अग्निम् आक्रमन्ते //
text_mt: 'I enter the paṅkti [metre] with my marrow. / May the thick, fierce armour of Indra and Agni, / which all the valiant gods do not pierce, / protect us; may that great [armour] from every side [protect] us! / Long-lived, may we reach old age, O gods!' With this [mantra], they step onto the measured area [for] the fire altar.

sanskrit_iast: lāṅgalaṃ pavīravam iti dvābhyāṃ kṛṣati //
meaning: लाङ्गलं पवीरवम् इति द्वाभ्यां कृषति //
text_mt: With two [verses beginning] 'The lance-pointed plough…', he ploughs.

sanskrit_iast: kīnāśā balīvardān ajanti //
meaning: कीनाशा बलीवर्दान् अजन्ति //
text_mt: Ploughmen drive the bullocks.

sanskrit_iast: pucchaśiro 'dhi kṛṣati //
meaning: पुच्छशिरो ऽधि कृषति //

sanskrit_iast: prakṣiṇam āvartayaṃs tisrastisraḥ sītāḥ sam̐hitāḥ kṛṣanti kāmaṃ kāmadughe dhukṣva \\ iti //
meaning: प्रक्षिणम् आवर्तयंस् तिस्रस्तिस्रः सीताः सम्̐हिताः कृषन्ति कामं कामदुघे धुक्ष्व \\ इति //
text_mt: Turning clockwise, they plough three furrows each time, joined together, with the mantra: 'Milk forth desire, O wish-granting cow!'

sanskrit_iast: sītāṃ pratyavekṣate //
meaning: सीतां प्रत्यवेक्षते //

sanskrit_iast: ghṛtena sītā \\ iti sītāntarālān saṃmṛśati //
meaning: घृतेन सीता \\ इति सीतान्तरालान् संमृशति //
text_mt: With 'The furrow [is moist] with ghee…', he touches the spaces between the furrows.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇasmāt pakṣād uttaraṃ pakṣam abhikṛṣati //
meaning: दक्षिणस्मात् पक्षाद् उत्तरं पक्षम् अभिकृषति //
text_mt: From the southern wing, he ploughs towards the northern wing.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇasyāḥ śroṇer uttaram am̐sam uttarasyāḥ śroṇer dakṣiṇam am̐sam itarathā vā dvādaśa saṃpādayati //
meaning: दक्षिणस्याः श्रोणेर् उत्तरम् अम्̐सम् उत्तरस्याः श्रोणेर् दक्षिणम् अम्̐सम् इतरथा वा द्वादश संपादयति //
text_mt: From the southern hip to the northern shoulder, or from the northern hip to the southern shoulder, or otherwise, he produces twelve [furrows].

sanskrit_iast: madhye saṃbhinnā bhavati //
meaning: मध्ये संभिन्ना भवति //
text_mt: In the middle, they meet together.

sanskrit_iast: vimucyadhvam aghniyā devayānās \\ atāriṣma tamasas pāram asya / \ jyotir āpāma \ suvar aganma \\ iti dakṣiṇe 'm̐se balīvardān vimucyottare vā prāca udīco votsṛjati //
meaning: विमुच्यध्वम् अघ्निया देवयानास् \\ अतारिष्म तमसस् पारम् अस्य / \ ज्योतिर् आपाम \ सुवर् अगन्म \\ इति दक्षिणे ऽम्̐से बलीवर्दान् विमुच्योत्तरे वा प्राच उदीचो वोत्सृजति //
text_mt: With 'Unyoke, O unslayable cows traveling on the gods’ paths; / we have crossed over to the further shore of this darkness; / we have attained the light; we have gone to heaven,' having unyoked the bullocks on the southern shoulder or on the northern, he releases them eastward or northward.

sanskrit_iast: tān adhvaryave dadāti //
meaning: तान् अध्वर्यवे ददाति //

sanskrit_iast: pañcadaśodacamasān ninayati //
meaning: पञ्चदशोदचमसान् निनयति //
text_mt: He pours out fifteen cups of water.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśānusītaṃ trīn akṛṣṭe //
meaning: द्वादशानुसीतं त्रीन् अकृष्टे //
text_mt: Twelve along the furrows, three on the unploughed ground.

sanskrit_iast: yā jātā oṣadhayas \\ iti caturdaśabhir oṣadhīr vapati / sapta gramyā oṣadhayaḥ saptāraṇyāḥ //
meaning: या जाता ओषधयस् \\ इति चतुर्दशभिर् ओषधीर् वपति / सप्त ग्रम्या ओषधयः सप्तारण्याः //
text_mt: With the fourteen [verses beginning] 'The plants that were born…', he sows seeds of plants: seven cultivated plants, seven wild.

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṭe grāmyā vapaty anusītam akṛṣṭa āraṇyāḥ /
meaning: कृष्टे ग्राम्या वपत्य् अनुसीतम् अकृष्ट आरण्याः /
text_mt: On the ploughed ground, he sows the cultivated [plants] along the furrows; on the unploughed ground, the wild.

sanskrit_iast: yā oṣadhīnāṃ nādhigacchet tasyāḥ sthāne yavān madhumiśrān vapet //
meaning: या ओषधीनां नाधिगच्छेत् तस्याः स्थाने यवान् मधुमिश्रान् वपेत् //
text_mt: Whichever of the plants he cannot obtain, in place of it he should sow barley mixed with honey.

sanskrit_iast: manasā dhyāyed uptā me 'si \\ iti vā //
meaning: मनसा ध्यायेद् उप्ता मे ऽसि \\ इति वा //
text_mt: Or he should meditate with his mind: 'You are sown for me.'

sanskrit_iast: adhigatāyāṃ yaḥ prathama idhma āgacchati tasminn upanahyati //
meaning: अधिगतायां यः प्रथम इध्म आगच्छति तस्मिन्न् उपनह्यति //
text_mt: When it is obtained, he ties it onto whichever firewood bundle comes first.

sanskrit_iast: ( ye vanaspatīnāṃ phalagrahayas tān idhma upasaṃnahya prokṣet ) //
meaning: ( ये वनस्पतीनां फलग्रहयस् तान् इध्म उपसंनह्य प्रोक्षेत् ) //
text_mt: (Having tied up on the firewood bundle those fruit-bearing shoots of trees, he should sprinkle them with water.)

sanskrit_iast: yat prāg ātithyāyās tat kṛtvā mā no him̐sīj janitā \\ iti catasṛbhir digbhyo loṣṭān samasyati //
meaning: यत् प्राग् आतिथ्यायास् तत् कृत्वा मा नो हिम्̐सीज् जनिता \\ इति चतसृभिर् दिग्भ्यो लोष्टान् समस्यति //
text_mt: Having performed what comes before the ātithyā [rite], with the four [verses beginning] 'May our father not harm us…', he heaps together clods from the quarters,

sanskrit_iast: ye 'ntarvidhād bahirvidham āpannā bhavanti //
meaning: ये ऽन्तर्विधाद् बहिर्विधम् आपन्ना भवन्ति //
text_mt: Which have fallen outside the boundary from within the boundary.

sanskrit_iast: iṣam ūrjam aham ita ādade \\ iti yasyām asya diśi dveṣyaḥ syāt tasyai diśo loṣṭam āharet //
meaning: इषम् ऊर्जम् अहम् इत आददे \\ इति यस्याम् अस्य दिशि द्वेष्यः स्यात् तस्यै दिशो लोष्टम् आहरेत् //
text_mt: With 'I take food and sap from here,' he should bring a clod from whichever quarter his enemy might be in.

sanskrit_iast: tathopakrameta yathā tasyāṃ diśy apavargaḥ syād uttaravedim upavapati / yāvān agnir vyāghāraṇāntaṃ kṛtvā //
meaning: तथोपक्रमेत यथा तस्यां दिश्य् अपवर्गः स्याद् उत्तरवेदिम् उपवपति / यावान् अग्निर् व्याघारणान्तं कृत्वा //
text_mt: He should proceed in such a way that the completion is in that quarter. Having made the altar as large as the fire, up to the end of the besprinkling, he scatters earth on the uttaravedi.

sanskrit_iast: agne tava śravo vayas \\ iti ṣaḍbhiḥ sikatā nivapati //
meaning: अग्ने तव श्रवो वयस् \\ इति षड्भिः सिकता निवपति //
text_mt: With the six [verses beginning] 'Agni, your fame and vigour…', he scatters sand.

sanskrit_iast: citaḥ stha paricitas \\ ity aparimitābhiḥ śarkarābhir āhavanīyaciter āyatanaṃ pariśrayati yathā gārhapatyaciteḥ //
meaning: चितः स्थ परिचितस् \\ इत्य् अपरिमिताभिः शर्कराभिर् आहवनीयचितेर् आयतनं परिश्रयति यथा गार्हपत्यचितेः //
text_mt: With 'You are piled, surrounding…', he encloses the site of the piling of the āhavanīya with an unmeasured number of pebbles, as [he did] for the piling of the gārhapatya.

sanskrit_iast: trisaptābhiḥ paśukāmasya //
meaning: त्रिसप्ताभिः पशुकामस्य //
text_mt: With thrice seven [pebbles] for one who desires cattle.

sanskrit_iast: triṇavābhir bhrātṛvyavataḥ //
meaning: त्रिणवाभिर् भ्रातृव्यवतः //
text_mt: With thrice nine for one who has a rival.

sanskrit_iast: aparimitābhiḥ pariminuyāt //
meaning: अपरिमिताभिः परिमिनुयात् //
text_mt: With an unmeasured number, he should measure around.

sanskrit_iast: ā pyāyasva \ saṃ te \\ iti saumībhyām̐ sikatā vyūhati //
meaning: आ प्यायस्व \ सं ते \\ इति सौमीभ्याम्̐ सिकता व्यूहति //
text_mt: With the two Soma verses, 'Swell up…' and 'May together…', he spreads out the sand.

sanskrit_iast: apivā gāyatriyā brāhmaṇasya vyūhet triṣṭubhā rājanyasya \\ asāvi somo aruṣo vṛṣā haris \\ rājeva dasmo abhi gā acikradat / \ punāno vāraṃ paryety avyayam \\ śyeno na yoniṃ ghṛtavantam āsadam iti jagatyā vaiśyasya //
meaning: अपिवा गायत्रिया ब्राह्मणस्य व्यूहेत् त्रिष्टुभा राजन्यस्य \\ असावि सोमो अरुषो वृषा हरिस् \\ राजेव दस्मो अभि गा अचिक्रदत् / \ पुनानो वारं पर्येत्य् अव्ययम् \\ श्येनो न योनिं घृतवन्तम् आसदम् इति जगत्या वैश्यस्य //
text_mt: Or, he should spread [it] out with a gāyatrī verse for a brāhmaṇa, with a triṣṭubh for a rājanya; with the jagatī verse 'The tawny bull Soma has been pressed, ruddy; / like a king, wondrous, he has bellowed to the cows; / being purified, he goes around the woolen sieve, / a falcon to settle upon his ghee-filled womb' for a vaiśya.

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ kāmayetāpaśuḥ syād ity aparimitya tasya śarkarāḥ sikatā vyūhet / yaṃ kāmayeta paśumānt syād iti parimitya tasya śarkarāḥ sikatā vyūhet //
meaning: यं कामयेतापशुः स्याद् इत्य् अपरिमित्य तस्य शर्कराः सिकता व्यूहेत् / यं कामयेत पशुमान्त् स्याद् इति परिमित्य तस्य शर्कराः सिकता व्यूहेत् //
text_mt: For one whom he desires to be without cattle, he should spread out his sand without counting the pebbles; for one whom he desires to possess cattle, he should spread out his sand having counted the pebbles.

sanskrit_iast: ātithyāprabhṛtīni karmāṇi pratipadyate //
meaning: आतिथ्याप्रभृतीनि कर्माणि प्रतिपद्यते //
text_mt: He takes up the rites beginning with the ātithyā.

sanskrit_iast: prathamābhyāṃ paurvāhṇikībhyāṃ pravargyopasadbhyāṃ pracaryāgreṇa prāgvam̐śam̐ rohite carmaṇy ānaḍuhe prācīnagrīva uttaralomni prathamāyāś citer iṣṭakāḥ sam̐sādayati //
meaning: प्रथमाभ्यां पौर्वाह्णिकीभ्यां प्रवर्ग्योपसद्भ्यां प्रचर्याग्रेण प्राग्वम्̐शम्̐ रोहिते चर्मण्य् आनडुहे प्राचीनग्रीव उत्तरलोम्नि प्रथमायाश् चितेर् इष्टकाः सम्̐सादयति //
text_mt: Having performed the first two forenoon pravargya and upasad rites, he places the bricks of the first layer in front of the eastern hall, on a red ox-hide with its neck facing east and the hair upward.

sanskrit_iast: apivā tisraḥ svayamātṛṇṇāḥ sarvāś ca viśvajyotiṣaḥ //
meaning: अपिवा तिस्रः स्वयमातृण्णाः सर्वाश् च विश्वज्योतिषः //
text_mt: Or the three naturally perforated ones and all the viśvajyotis [bricks].

sanskrit_iast: darbhāgram uṣṭinājyenāvokṣya tāḥ samudyamya cityagnibhyaḥ praṇīyamānebhyo 'nubrūhi \\ iti saṃpreṣyati / praṇīyamānebhyo 'nubrūhi \\ iti vā //
meaning: दर्भाग्रम् उष्टिनाज्येनावोक्ष्य ताः समुद्यम्य चित्यग्निभ्यः प्रणीयमानेभ्यो ऽनुब्रूहि \\ इति संप्रेष्यति / प्रणीयमानेभ्यो ऽनुब्रूहि \\ इति वा //
text_mt: Having sprinkled them with clarified butter using a handful of darbha tips and having lifted them up, he directs: 'Recite for the fires being led to the piling,' or: 'Recite for those being led forth!'

sanskrit_iast: triranūktāyām aśvaprathamāḥ prañco gacchanti //
meaning: त्रिरनूक्तायाम् अश्वप्रथमाः प्रञ्चो गच्छन्ति //
text_mt: When [the invitation] has been recited three times, they walk forward with the horse leading.

sanskrit_iast: uttaravediṃ prāpya prajāpatis tvā sādayatu \ tayā devatayāṅgirasvad dhruvā sīda \\ ity uttaravedim abhimṛśya mayi gṛhṇāmi \ yo no agnis \\ iti dvābhyām ātmann agniṃ gṛhītvā yās te agne samidho yāni dhāma \\ iti svayaṃcityābhimṛśati //
meaning: उत्तरवेदिं प्राप्य प्रजापतिस् त्वा सादयतु \ तया देवतयाङ्गिरस्वद् ध्रुवा सीद \\ इत्य् उत्तरवेदिम् अभिमृश्य मयि गृह्णामि \ यो नो अग्निस् \\ इति द्वाभ्याम् आत्मन्न् अग्निं गृहीत्वा यास् ते अग्ने समिधो यानि धाम \\ इति स्वयंचित्याभिमृशति //
text_mt: Having reached the uttaravedi, having touched the uttaravedi with 'May Prajāpati seat you; with that deity, like Aṅgiras, sit firm,' having taken the fire into himself with the two [mantras] 'I take into myself…' and 'Whichever fire of ours…', he touches it with the self-layering [formula]: 'Whichever are your fire-sticks, O Agni, whichever your places…'

sanskrit_iast: iṣṭakābhir agniṃ cinoty adhvaryur yajamāno brahmā vā svayam agniṃ cinvann ātmann agniṃ gṛhṇīte na svayaṃcityābhimṛśati //
meaning: इष्टकाभिर् अग्निं चिनोत्य् अध्वर्युर् यजमानो ब्रह्मा वा स्वयम् अग्निं चिन्वन्न् आत्मन्न् अग्निं गृह्णीते न स्वयंचित्याभिमृशति //
text_mt: The adhvaryu, the sacrificer, or the brahman priest piles the fire altar with bricks; while piling the fire altar himself, he takes the fire into himself, but does not touch it with the self-layering formula.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇāvṛto dakṣiṇata upadadhāty uttarataḥ savyāvṛta ṛjulekhāḥ paścāt purastāc ca bhavanti //
meaning: दक्षिणावृतो दक्षिणत उपदधात्य् उत्तरतः सव्यावृत ऋजुलेखाः पश्चात् पुरस्ताच् च भवन्ति //
text_mt: Turning clockwise, he lays them down on the south; turning counter-clockwise on the north; behind and in front, they are in straight lines.

sanskrit_iast: tryālikhitā madhye prācīr upadadhāti //
meaning: त्र्यालिखिता मध्ये प्राचीर् उपदधाति //
text_mt: He lays down those with three lines in the middle facing east.

sanskrit_iast: pratīcīr upadadhātīti gaṇeṣu rītivādaḥ / prācīm upadadhāti pratīcīm upadadhātīti kartur mukhavādaḥ purastād anyāḥ pratīcīr upadadhāti / paścād anyāḥ prācīr apavargavādā vacanāt pakṣapuccheṣu śroṇyor am̐sayor ity upadadhāti //
meaning: प्रतीचीर् उपदधातीति गणेषु रीतिवादः / प्राचीम् उपदधाति प्रतीचीम् उपदधातीति कर्तुर् मुखवादः पुरस्ताद् अन्याः प्रतीचीर् उपदधाति / पश्चाद् अन्याः प्राचीर् अपवर्गवादा वचनात् पक्षपुच्छेषु श्रोण्योर् अम्̐सयोर् इत्य् उपदधाति //
text_mt: 'He lays them down facing west' is the rule of arrangement in groups. 'He lays down facing east, he lays down facing west' is the rule concerning the agent's face: he lays down others in front facing west, others behind facing east, because of the rule of completion; according to the injunction, he lays them down on the wings, tail, hips, and shoulders.

sanskrit_iast: śveto 'śvo dakṣiṇatas tiṣṭhati //
meaning: श्वेतो ऽश्वो दक्षिणतस् तिष्ठति //
text_mt: A white horse stands to the south.

sanskrit_iast: tam ālabhyeṣṭakā upadadhāti //
meaning: तम् आलभ्येष्टका उपदधाति //
text_mt: Having touched it, he lays down the bricks.

sanskrit_iast: indraṃ viśvā avīvṛdhan \\ ity aindriyarcākramaṇaṃ pratīṣṭakām upadadhyāt // uttarataḥ paścād upacāro vāgniḥ //
meaning: इन्द्रं विश्वा अवीवृधन् \\ इत्य् ऐन्द्रियर्चाक्रमणं प्रतीष्टकाम् उपदध्यात् // उत्तरतः पश्चाद् उपचारो वाग्निः //
text_mt: With the Indra verse 'All songs have magnified Indra…', he should step on it at every brick laid down; or the approaching of the fire is from the north and west.

sanskrit_iast: vāṅ ma āsan \\ nasoḥ prāṇas \\ ity agnim adhikrāman sarveṣv ākramaṇeṣu japati //
meaning: वाङ् म आसन् \\ नसोः प्राणस् \\ इत्य् अग्निम् अधिक्रामन् सर्वेष्व् आक्रमणेषु जपति //
text_mt: Stepping onto the fire altar, he mutters at all the step-ons: 'Speech in my mouth, breath in my nostrils…'

sanskrit_iast: tat tvā yāmi brahmaṇā vandamānas \\ iti vāruṇyarcā śālāmukhīye juhoti //
meaning: तत् त्वा यामि ब्रह्मणा वन्दमानस् \\ इति वारुण्यर्चा शालामुखीये जुहोति //
text_mt: With the Varuṇa verse 'Praising you with prayer, I ask that of you…', he offers on the śālāmukhīya fire.

sanskrit_iast: abhyasthād viśvāḥ pṛtanā arātīs \\ iti prāñcam aśvaṃ dakṣiṇena pādena darbhastambam ākramayati //
meaning: अभ्यस्थाद् विश्वाः पृतना अरातीस् \\ इति प्राञ्चम् अश्वं दक्षिणेन पादेन दर्भस्तम्बम् आक्रमयति //
text_mt: With 'It has overcome all hostile armies…', he causes the horse, facing east, to step onto a tuft of darbha grass with its right foot.

sanskrit_iast: yad akrandaḥ prathamaṃ jāyamānas \\ iti pradakṣiṇam aśvaṃ paryāṇayati //
meaning: यद् अक्रन्दः प्रथमं जायमानस् \\ इति प्रदक्षिणम् अश्वं पर्याणयति //
text_mt: With 'When first being born you neighed…', he leads the horse around clockwise.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇato dhāryamāṇe \\ apāṃ pṛṣṭham asi \\ iti darbhastambe puṣkaraparṇam adhastāddaṇḍam uttānam upadadhāti //
meaning: दक्षिणतो धार्यमाणे \\ अपां पृष्ठम् असि \\ इति दर्भस्तम्बे पुष्करपर्णम् अधस्ताद्दण्डम् उत्तानम् उपदधाति //
text_mt: While it is held to the south, with 'You are the back of the waters,' he lays down a lotus leaf on the tuft of darbha grass, with its stalk downward and turned upward.

sanskrit_iast: tapo yonir asi \ viśvābhis tvā dhībhir acchidram̐ sajātavanasyāyā upadadhāmi \\ amṛtaṃ yonir brahma yoniḥ kṣatraṃ yoniḥ pṛthivī yonir antarikṣaṃ dyaur yonir diśo yonis \\ iti vā //
meaning: तपो योनिर् असि \ विश्वाभिस् त्वा धीभिर् अच्छिद्रम्̐ सजातवनस्याया उपदधामि \\ अमृतं योनिर् ब्रह्म योनिः क्षत्रं योनिः पृथिवी योनिर् अन्तरिक्षं द्यौर् योनिर् दिशो योनिस् \\ इति वा //
text_mt: With 'You are the womb of heat; with all thoughts I lay you down unbroken, for the affection of kin,' or with 'Immortality is the womb, the brahma is the womb, the kṣatra is the womb, the earth is the womb, the atmosphere is the womb, heaven is the womb, the quarters are the womb.'

sanskrit_iast: brahma jajñānam iti puṣkaraparṇe rukmam adhastānnirbādham upadadhāti //
meaning: ब्रह्म जज्ञानम् इति पुष्करपर्णे रुक्मम् अधस्तान्निर्बाधम् उपदधाति //
text_mt: With 'The brahma born first…', he places a gold plate on the lotus leaf, with its indentations downward.

sanskrit_iast: hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatāgre \\ iti hiraṇmayaṃ puruṣaṃ prāñcam uttānaṃ dakṣiṇato rukmasya drapsaś caskanda \\ ity abhimṛśya puruṣasāmnābhigīyate //
meaning: हिरण्यगर्भः समवर्तताग्रे \\ इति हिरण्मयं पुरुषं प्राञ्चम् उत्तानं दक्षिणतो रुक्मस्य द्रप्सश् चस्कन्द \\ इत्य् अभिमृश्य पुरुषसाम्नाभिगीयते //
text_mt: With 'The Golden Embryo arose in the beginning…', having placed a golden man facing east, lying on his back, to the south of the gold plate, and having touched it with 'The drop leaped down…', he is sung to with the Puruṣasāman.

sanskrit_iast: namo astu sarpebhyas \\ iti tisṛbhiḥ sarpanāmabhir upatiṣṭhate //
meaning: नमो अस्तु सर्पेभ्यस् \\ इति तिसृभिः सर्पनामभिर् उपतिष्ठते //
text_mt: With the three [verses] naming the serpents, beginning 'Homage be to the serpents…', he reveres [it].

sanskrit_iast: kṛṇuṣva pājas \\ iti pañcabhir akṣṇayā puruṣaṃ vyāghārayati yathottaravedim //
meaning: कृणुष्व पाजस् \\ इति पञ्चभिर् अक्ष्णया पुरुषं व्याघारयति यथोत्तरवेदिम् //
text_mt: With the five [verses beginning with:] "Display your vigor...", he sprinkles clarified butter diagonally across the [golden] man, as for the high altar.

sanskrit_iast: ghṛtasya dadhnaś ca pūrṇe srucāv abhitaḥ puruṣam upadadhāti agnes tvā tejasā sādayāmi \\ iti //
meaning: घृतस्य दध्नश् च पूर्णे स्रुचाव् अभितः पुरुषम् उपदधाति अग्नेस् त्वा तेजसा सादयामि \\ इति //
text_mt: He lays down two offering ladles full of clarified butter and curd on both sides of the man, with: "By the brilliance of Agni I place you."

sanskrit_iast: ghṛtasya pūrṇāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ kārṣmaryamayīm indrasya tvaujasā sādayāmi \\ iti dadhnaḥ pūrṇām uttarām audumbarīṃ te upadhāya mūrdhanvatībhyām upatiṣṭhate //
meaning: घृतस्य पूर्णां दक्षिणां कार्ष्मर्यमयीम् इन्द्रस्य त्वौजसा सादयामि \\ इति दध्नः पूर्णाम् उत्तराम् औदुम्बरीं ते उपधाय मूर्धन्वतीभ्याम् उपतिष्ठते //
text_mt: The southern [ladle] made of kārṣmarya wood, full of clarified butter, [he lays down with that mantra]; the northern one made of udumbara wood, full of curd, with: "By the power of Indra I place you." Having laid them down, he reveres [them] with the two verses containing the word 'head'.

sanskrit_iast: apivā tūṣṇīm upadhāya mūrdhanvatībhyām upatiṣṭhate / mūrdhanvatībhyām upadhāya yajurbhyām upatiṣṭhata ity ekeṣām //
meaning: अपिवा तूष्णीम् उपधाय मूर्धन्वतीभ्याम् उपतिष्ठते / मूर्धन्वतीभ्याम् उपधाय यजुर्भ्याम् उपतिष्ठत इत्य् एकेषाम् //
text_mt: Or having laid them down silently, he reveres [them] with the two verses containing the word 'head'. According to some [teachers], having laid them down with the two verses containing the word 'head', he reveres [them] with the two sacrificial formulas.

sanskrit_iast: rukmaṃ vyāghārayati / yathāpuruṣam //
meaning: रुक्मं व्याघारयति / यथापुरुषम् //
text_mt: He sprinkles clarified butter over the disc, as for the man.

sanskrit_iast: dhruvāsi dharuṇā \\ iti svayamātṛṇṇām abhimṛśyāśvenāvaghrāpya prajāpatis tvā sādayatu pṛthivyāḥ pṛṣṭhe vyacasvatīm iti madhye 'gner aviduṣā brāhmaṇena sahopadadhāti / bhūr iti caitayā vyāhṛtyā //
meaning: ध्रुवासि धरुणा \\ इति स्वयमातृण्णाम् अभिमृश्याश्वेनावघ्राप्य प्रजापतिस् त्वा सादयतु पृथिव्याः पृष्ठे व्यचस्वतीम् इति मध्ये ऽग्नेर् अविदुषा ब्राह्मणेन सहोपदधाति / भूर् इति चैतया व्याहृत्या //
text_mt: Having touched the naturally perforated [stone] with: "Firm are you, a supporter...", and having made the horse smell it, he lays it down in the middle of the fire together with an unlearned brāhmaṇa, with: "May Prajāpati seat you on the back of the earth, spacious...", and with this mystical utterance: "Bhūḥ!"

sanskrit_iast: citiṃ juhomi \\ iti svayamātṛṇṇāyām̐ hutvānuprāṇiti //
meaning: चितिं जुहोमि \\ इति स्वयमातृण्णायाम्̐ हुत्वानुप्राणिति //
text_mt: Having offered into the naturally perforated [stone] with: "I offer the layer...", he breathes along [with it].

sanskrit_iast: avidvān brāhmaṇo varaṃ dadāti / ekaṃ dvau trīn vā //
meaning: अविद्वान् ब्राह्मणो वरं ददाति / एकं द्वौ त्रीन् वा //
text_mt: The unlearned brāhmaṇa gives a wish-boon, one, two, or three.

sanskrit_iast: tejo 'si \ tejo me yaccha \ pṛthivīṃ yaccha \ pṛthivyai mā pahi \\ iti hiraṇyeṣṭakām / pṛthivy udapuram annena viṣṭā \ manuṣyās te goptāras \\ iti maṇḍaleṣṭakām / bhūr asi bhuvanasya reta iṣṭakāḥ svargo lokas \\ manasā tvānvārohāmi \ suvar asi suvanasya reta iṣṭakāḥ svargo loko \ manasā tvānvārohāmi \\ ity anvārohe dve upadadhāti //
meaning: तेजो ऽसि \ तेजो मे यच्छ \ पृथिवीं यच्छ \ पृथिव्यै मा पहि \\ इति हिरण्येष्टकाम् / पृथिव्य् उदपुरम् अन्नेन विष्टा \ मनुष्यास् ते गोप्तारस् \\ इति मण्डलेष्टकाम् / भूर् असि भुवनस्य रेत इष्टकाः स्वर्गो लोकस् \\ मनसा त्वान्वारोहामि \ सुवर् असि सुवनस्य रेत इष्टकाः स्वर्गो लोको \ मनसा त्वान्वारोहामि \\ इत्य् अन्वारोहे द्वे उपदधाति //
text_mt: With "You are splendor; grant me splendor; grant the earth; protect me from the earth," [he lays] the gold brick. With "The earth is a city of water, covered with food; men are your guardians," [he lays] the circular brick. With the two [mantras] of ascending: "You are the earth, the seed of being; the bricks are the heavenly world; in mind I ascend to you. You are the sky, the seed of the sky; the bricks are the heavenly world; in mind I ascend to you," he lays the two ascending bricks.

sanskrit_iast: kāṇḍātkāṇḍāt prarohantī \\ iti dvābhyāṃ dūrvāstambam̐ saloṣṭam apracchinnāgraṃ yathāsya svayamātṛṇṇām agraṃ prāpnuyāt //
meaning: काण्डात्काण्डात् प्ररोहन्ती \\ इति द्वाभ्यां दूर्वास्तम्बम्̐ सलोष्टम् अप्रच्छिन्नाग्रं यथास्य स्वयमातृण्णाम् अग्रं प्राप्नुयात् //
text_mt: With the two [mantras beginning with] "Sprouting joint by joint," [he lays] a clump of dūrvā grass with its clod of earth, its tip uncut, so that its tip reaches the naturally perforated [brick].

sanskrit_iast: hiraṇyaśakalau prabāhug iṣṭakāyām adhyūhya yās te agne sūrye rucas \\ iti dvābhyāṃ vāmabhṛtam //
meaning: हिरण्यशकलौ प्रबाहुग् इष्टकायाम् अध्यूह्य यास् ते अग्ने सूर्ये रुचस् \\ इति द्वाभ्यां वामभृतम् //
text_mt: Having placed two gold chips alongside on the brick, with the two [mantras beginning with] "The splendors of yours, O Agni, that are in the sun," [he lays] the vāmabhṛt brick.

sanskrit_iast: virāḍ jyotir adhārayat \\ iti tisro retaḥsicaḥ //
meaning: विराड् ज्योतिर् अधारयत् \\ इति तिस्रो रेतःसिचः //
text_mt: With "Virāj held the light," [he lays] the three seed-shedder [bricks].

sanskrit_iast: dve eke samāmananti //
meaning: द्वे एके समामनन्ति //

sanskrit_iast: tāḥ prathamāyāṃ cityāṃ yūna upadadhyāt / madhyamāyāṃ vivayasaḥ / prathamāyām uttamāyāṃ ca sthavirasya //
meaning: ताः प्रथमायां चित्यां यून उपदध्यात् / मध्यमायां विवयसः / प्रथमायाम् उत्तमायां च स्थविरस्य //
text_mt: He should lay them in the first layer for a young man; in the middle [layer] for a middle-aged man; and in the first and the uppermost [layers] for an old man.

sanskrit_iast: bṛhaspatis tvā sādayatu pṛthivyāḥ pṛṣṭhe jyotiṣmatīm iti viśvajyotiṣam / agner yāny asi \ devānām agner yāny asi \\ iti dve saṃyānyau / madhuś ca mādhavaś ca \\ iti dve ṛtavye / samānatayā devate bhavataḥ //
meaning: बृहस्पतिस् त्वा सादयतु पृथिव्याः पृष्ठे ज्योतिष्मतीम् इति विश्वज्योतिषम् / अग्नेर् यान्य् असि \ देवानाम् अग्नेर् यान्य् असि \\ इति द्वे संयान्यौ / मधुश् च माधवश् च \\ इति द्वे ऋतव्ये / समानतया देवते भवतः //
text_mt: With "May Bṛhaspati seat you on the back of the earth, radiant," [he lays] the all-radiant [brick]. With "You are the path of Agni," and "You are the path of the Agni of the gods," [he lays] two saṃyānī bricks. With "Madhu and Mādhava," [he lays] two seasonal bricks. By their equality, they become two deities.

sanskrit_iast: sarvāsv ṛtavyāsv avakām upadadhāti //
meaning: सर्वास्व् ऋतव्यास्व् अवकाम् उपदधाति //
text_mt: He places avakā plants on all the seasonal bricks.

sanskrit_iast: gharmeṣṭakām upadadhāti / tasyāḥ pravargye mantra āmnātaḥ //
meaning: घर्मेष्टकाम् उपदधाति / तस्याः प्रवर्ग्ये मन्त्र आम्नातः //
text_mt: He lays the gharma brick; its mantra is handed down in the Pravargya [section].

sanskrit_iast: aṣāḍhāsi \\ ity upariṣṭāllakṣmāṇam aṣāḍhāṃ dveṣyasyādhastāllakṣmāṇaṃ yās te agna ārdrā yonayo yāḥ kulāyinīḥ / \ ye te agna indavo yā u nābhayaḥ / \ yās te agne tanuva ūrjo nāma \ tābhis tvam ubhayībhiḥ saṃvidānaḥ / \ iha prajānāṃ tanvā niṣīda \\ iti kulāyinīm //
meaning: अषाढासि \\ इत्य् उपरिष्टाल्लक्ष्माणम् अषाढां द्वेष्यस्याधस्ताल्लक्ष्माणं यास् ते अग्न आर्द्रा योनयो याः कुलायिनीः / \ ये ते अग्न इन्दवो या उ नाभयः / \ यास् ते अग्ने तनुव ऊर्जो नाम \ ताभिस् त्वम् उभयीभिः संविदानः / \ इह प्रजानां तन्वा निषीद \\ इति कुलायिनीम् //
text_mt: With "You are invincible," [he lays] the invincible brick with its mark upward, [or] for one whom he hates with its mark downward. With "Those moist wombs of yours, O Agni, which are nest-like; those drops of yours, O Agni, and which are the navels; those forms of yours, O Agni, named strength—concurring with all those together, sit down here with the body of the creatures," [he lays] the nest-like [brick].

sanskrit_iast: madhu vātā ṛtāyate \\ iti tisṛbhir dadhnā madhumiśreṇa kūrmam abhyanakti //
meaning: मधु वाता ऋतायते \\ इति तिसृभिर् दध्ना मधुमिश्रेण कूर्मम् अभ्यनक्ति //
text_mt: With the three [verses beginning with] "The winds blow honey for him who lives by cosmic order," he anoints a tortoise with curd mixed with honey.

sanskrit_iast: apāṃ gambhīraṃ gaccha \ mā tvā sūryaḥ parītāpsīn mo agnir vaiśvānaraḥ / \ aghoraḥ prajā abhi vipaśya \\ anu tvā divyā vṛṣṭiḥ sacatām // \ sam̐sarpa trīn samudrānt svasalilārgyām̐l lokān \ apāṃpatir vṛṣabha iṣṭakānām / \ tatra gaccha yatra pūrve paretāḥ \ purīṣaṃ vasānaḥ svāṃ yoniṃ yathāyatham ity abhimantrya mahī dyauḥ pṛthivī ca nas \\ catasra āśās \\ iti dvābhyāṃ purastāt pratyañcaṃ jīvantaṃ prāṅmukha upadadhāti // avakābhiḥ parītasya jālenāvacchādya śaṅkubhiḥ pariṇihanti //
meaning: अपां गम्भीरं गच्छ \ मा त्वा सूर्यः परीताप्सीन् मो अग्निर् वैश्वानरः / \ अघोरः प्रजा अभि विपश्य \\ अनु त्वा दिव्या वृष्टिः सचताम् // \ सम्̐सर्प त्रीन् समुद्रान्त् स्वसलिलार्ग्याम्̐ल् लोकान् \ अपांपतिर् वृषभ इष्टकानाम् / \ तत्र गच्छ यत्र पूर्वे परेताः \ पुरीषं वसानः स्वां योनिं यथायथम् इत्य् अभिमन्त्र्य मही द्यौः पृथिवी च नस् \\ चतस्र आशास् \\ इति द्वाभ्यां पुरस्तात् प्रत्यञ्चं जीवन्तं प्राङ्मुख उपदधाति // अवकाभिः परीतस्य जालेनावच्छाद्य शङ्कुभिः परिणिहन्ति //
text_mt: Having addressed [it] with: "Go to the deep of the waters; let not the sun scorch you, nor Agni Vaiśvānara; look upon the creatures without causing terror; may heavenly rain accompany you. Move through the three oceans, the waters of your own world, the lord of waters, the bull among bricks; go there where the forefathers departed, wearing the mantle of earth, to your own womb properly," facing east, he places it living in the front, facing west, with the two [verses beginning with] "May the great heaven and earth of ours," [and] "The four quarters." Having covered [it] with a net enveloped in avakā plants, he fastens it down with pegs.

sanskrit_iast: yac cid dhi tvaṃ gṛhegṛhe \\ ulūkhalaka yujyase / \ iha dyumattama vada \ jayatām iva dundubhis \\ iti dakṣiṇasyām̐ śroṇyām ulūkhalaṃ musalaṃ prayunakti //
meaning: यच् चिद् धि त्वं गृहेगृहे \\ उलूखलक युज्यसे / \ इह द्युमत्तम वद \ जयताम् इव दुन्दुभिस् \\ इति दक्षिणस्याम्̐ श्रोण्याम् उलूखलं मुसलं प्रयुनक्ति //
text_mt: With "Since you are employed in house after house, O mortar, speak here most resplendently, like the drum of victors," he sets the mortar and the pestle upon the right hip [of the altar].

sanskrit_iast: audumbaraṃ prādeśamātraṃ catuḥsrakty ulūkhalam aparimitaṃ musalaṃ bhavati //
meaning: औदुम्बरं प्रादेशमात्रं चतुःस्रक्त्य् उलूखलम् अपरिमितं मुसलं भवति //
text_mt: The mortar is made of udumbara wood, a span in size, and four-cornered; the pestle is of unmeasured size.

sanskrit_iast: uta sma te vanaspate \ vāto vivāty agram iti / atho indrāya pātave \ sunu somam ulūkhala \\ iti sarvauṣadhasya pūrayitvāvahanti //
meaning: उत स्म ते वनस्पते \ वातो विवात्य् अग्रम् इति / अथो इन्द्राय पातवे \ सुनु सोमम् उलूखल \\ इति सर्वौषधस्य पूरयित्वावहन्ति //
text_mt: With "And truly for you, O tree, the wind blows along the top," [and] "Then for Indra to drink, press the soma, O mortar," having filled [it] with all kinds of herbs, he pounds them.

sanskrit_iast: tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam iti madhye 'gner ulūkhalaṃ musalam upadadhāti viṣṇoḥ karmāṇi paśyata \\ iti vā musalam //
meaning: तद् विष्णोः परमं पदम् इति मध्ये ऽग्नेर् उलूखलं मुसलम् उपदधाति विष्णोः कर्माणि पश्यत \\ इति वा मुसलम् //
text_mt: With "That highest step of Viṣṇu," he places the mortar and the pestle in the middle of the fire-altar; or the pestle with "Look upon the deeds of Viṣṇu."

sanskrit_iast: divo vā viṣṇo \\ iti śūrpam //
meaning: दिवो वा विष्णो \\ इति शूर्पम् //
text_mt: With "Either from heaven, O Viṣṇu," [he places] the winnowing basket.

sanskrit_iast: sikatābhir ukhāṃ pūrayati //
meaning: सिकताभिर् उखां पूरयति //
text_mt: He fills the fire-pot with sand,

sanskrit_iast: dadhnā madhunā ghṛtena vā //
meaning: दध्ना मधुना घृतेन वा //
text_mt: or with curd, honey, or clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ kāmayeta kṣodhuk syād ity ūnāṃ tasyopadadhyāt / yaṃ kāmayetānupadasyad annam adyād iti pūrṇāṃ tasyopadadhyāt //
meaning: यं कामयेत क्षोधुक् स्याद् इत्य् ऊनां तस्योपदध्यात् / यं कामयेतानुपदस्यद् अन्नम् अद्याद् इति पूर्णां तस्योपदध्यात् //
text_mt: For him whom he wishes: 'May he be hungry,' he should lay it deficient; for him whom he wishes: 'May he eat inexhaustible food,' he should lay it full.

sanskrit_iast: syūtā devebhir amṛtenāgās \\ ukhām̐ svasāram adhi vedim asthāt / \ satyaṃ pūrvair ṛṣibhiś cākṛpāṇas \\ agniḥ pravidvān iha tat karotu \\ ity ukhām ādāya dhruvāsi pṛthivī \\ iti ca // pṛthivī pṛthivyām̐ sīda \ mātā mātari mātā \ syonā syonāyām \\ kratur devānāṃ mahimānam īmahe \\ agnim̐ sadhasthe sadaneṣu sukratuḥ / \ vaiśvānaraṃ brahmaṇā viśvavyacasam \\ stomasya dhāman nihitaṃ purīṣyam // \ samiddham agnim̐ samidhā samidhyase \\ agnim̐ sadhasthe sadaneṣv acyutam // \ vaiśvānaraṃ brahmaṇā viśvavyacasam \\ stomasya dhāma nidadhe purīṣyam / \ nyayur mātrayā kavayo vayodhasas \\ agnim̐ sadhasthe sadaneṣv āhutam // \ vaiśvānaraṃ brahmaṇā viśvavyacasam \\ stomasya dhāman pavamānam ābhṛtam // \ dhruvāsi pṛthivī \ tayā devatayāṅgirasvad dhruvā sīda \\ iti madhye 'gner ukhām upadadhāti //
meaning: स्यूता देवेभिर् अमृतेनागास् \\ उखाम्̐ स्वसारम् अधि वेदिम् अस्थात् / \ सत्यं पूर्वैर् ऋषिभिश् चाकृपाणस् \\ अग्निः प्रविद्वान् इह तत् करोतु \\ इत्य् उखाम् आदाय ध्रुवासि पृथिवी \\ इति च // पृथिवी पृथिव्याम्̐ सीद \ माता मातरि माता \ स्योना स्योनायाम् \\ क्रतुर् देवानां महिमानम् ईमहे \\ अग्निम्̐ सधस्थे सदनेषु सुक्रतुः / \ वैश्वानरं ब्रह्मणा विश्वव्यचसम् \\ स्तोमस्य धामन् निहितं पुरीष्यम् // \ समिद्धम् अग्निम्̐ समिधा समिध्यसे \\ अग्निम्̐ सधस्थे सदनेष्व् अच्युतम् // \ वैश्वानरं ब्रह्मणा विश्वव्यचसम् \\ स्तोमस्य धाम निदधे पुरीष्यम् / \ न्ययुर् मात्रया कवयो वयोधसस् \\ अग्निम्̐ सधस्थे सदनेष्व् आहुतम् // \ वैश्वानरं ब्रह्मणा विश्वव्यचसम् \\ स्तोमस्य धामन् पवमानम् आभृतम् // \ ध्रुवासि पृथिवी \ तया देवतयाङ्गिरस्वद् ध्रुवा सीद \\ इति मध्ये ऽग्नेर् उखाम् उपदधाति //
text_mt: Having taken the fire-pot with "Sewn by the gods with immortality she has come, the fire-pot, a sister, has mounted the altar; true to his promise with the ancient seers, let Agni the wise do that here," and [with] "You are the firm earth," [and] with "O earth, sit on the earth; mother, in the mother; gracious one, on the gracious one; we seek the greatness, the wisdom of the gods; Agni, wise in wisdom in the common dwelling, in the abodes, Vaiśvānara with sacred formulation, all-pervading, deposited in the realm of the chant, belonging to the earth-mound. The kindled Agni, you are kindled with firewood, Agni in the common dwelling, unshakeable in the abodes, Vaiśvānara with sacred formulation, all-pervading, the realm of the chant is laid down, belonging to the earth-mound. In proper measure the poets, givers of life, approached Agni in the common dwelling, who is offered to in the abodes, Vaiśvānara with sacred formulation, all-pervading, brought as the purifying one in the realm of the chant. You are the firm earth; by that deity sit firm like the Aṅgirases," he lays the fire-pot in the middle of the fire-altar.

sanskrit_iast: upariṣṭād ulūkhalasyety ekeṣām //
meaning: उपरिष्टाद् उलूखलस्येत्य् एकेषाम् //
text_mt: "Above the mortar," say some.

sanskrit_iast: agne yukṣvā hi ye tava \\ iti yuktavatībhyām // ukhāyām ekāhutiṃ juhoti //
meaning: अग्ने युक्ष्वा हि ये तव \\ इति युक्तवतीभ्याम् // उखायाम् एकाहुतिं जुहोति //
text_mt: With the two [verses] containing [the word] "yoke": "O Agni, yoke those [steeds] of yours," he makes a single libation into the fire-pot.

sanskrit_iast: puruṣaśirasaḥ prāṇeṣu hiraṇyaśalkān pratyasyati / ṛce tvā \\ iti dakṣiṇe 'kṣikaṭe / ruce tvā \\ ity uttare bhāse tvā \\ iti dakṣiṇasyāṃ nāsikāyāṃ jyotiṣe tvā \\ ity uttarasyām abhūd idaṃ viśvasya bhuvanasya vājinam ity āsye \\ agnir jyotiṣā jyotiṣmān iti dakṣiṇe karṇe rukmo varcasā varcasvān ity uttare //
meaning: पुरुषशिरसः प्राणेषु हिरण्यशल्कान् प्रत्यस्यति / ऋचे त्वा \\ इति दक्षिणे ऽक्षिकटे / रुचे त्वा \\ इत्य् उत्तरे भासे त्वा \\ इति दक्षिणस्यां नासिकायां ज्योतिषे त्वा \\ इत्य् उत्तरस्याम् अभूद् इदं विश्वस्य भुवनस्य वाजिनम् इत्य् आस्ये \\ अग्निर् ज्योतिषा ज्योतिष्मान् इति दक्षिणे कर्णे रुक्मो वर्चसा वर्चस्वान् इत्य् उत्तरे //
text_mt: He throws gold chips into the vital openings of the human head: with "For the Ṛgveda, to you" into the right eye-socket; with "For splendor, to you" into the left; with "For luster, to you" into the right nostril; with "For light, to you" into the left; with "This spirited one of the whole world has arisen" into the mouth; with "Agni radiant with light" into the right ear; with "The gold ornament lustrous with luster" into the left.

sanskrit_iast: sam it sravanti sarito na dhenās \\ iti śṛtātaṅkyena dadhnā madhumiśreṇa puruṣaśiraḥ pūrayitvā sahasradhā asi \ sahasrāya tvā \\ ity ādāya \\ ādityaṃ garbhaṃ payasā samañjan \\ ity ukhāyām uttānaṃ prākcubukam upadadhāti //
meaning: सम् इत् स्रवन्ति सरितो न धेनास् \\ इति शृतातङ्क्येन दध्ना मधुमिश्रेण पुरुषशिरः पूरयित्वा सहस्रधा असि \ सहस्राय त्वा \\ इत्य् आदाय \\ आदित्यं गर्भं पयसा समञ्जन् \\ इत्य् उखायाम् उत्तानं प्राक्चुबुकम् उपदधाति //
text_mt: Having filled the human head with curd from boiled milk curded by adding milk, mixed with honey, with "Streams flow together like milch cows," and taking it with "You are thousandfold; to the thousand you," he lays it in the fire-pot face upward with the chin pointing eastward, with "Anointing the sun, the embryo, with milk."

sanskrit_iast: ud u tyaṃ citram iti sauryarcābhyām akṣikaṭayor abhijuhoti //
meaning: उद् उ त्यं चित्रम् इति सौर्यर्चाभ्याम् अक्षिकटयोर् अभिजुहोति //
text_mt: With the two verses addressed to Sūrya, "Up that [god]" [and] "The wondrous [face of the gods]," he offers over the two eye-sockets.

sanskrit_iast: paśuśīrṣāny upadadhāti //
meaning: पशुशीर्षान्य् उपदधाति //
text_mt: He lays the animal heads.

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ kāmayetāpaśuḥ syād iti viṣūcīnāni tasyopadadhyāt / yaṃ kāmayeta paśumānt syād iti samīcīnāni tasyopadadhyāt / yaṃ kāmayeta kanīyo 'syānnam̐ syād iti saṃtarāṃ tasya paśuśīrṣāṇy upadadhyāt // yaṃ kāmayeta samāvad asyānnam̐ syād ity abhitas tasya svayamātṛṇṇām upadadhyāt / yaṃ kāmayeta bhūyo 'syānnam̐ syād ity anteṣu tasya vyuduhyopadadhyāt //
meaning: यं कामयेतापशुः स्याद् इति विषूचीनानि तस्योपदध्यात् / यं कामयेत पशुमान्त् स्याद् इति समीचीनानि तस्योपदध्यात् / यं कामयेत कनीयो ऽस्यान्नम्̐ स्याद् इति संतरां तस्य पशुशीर्षाण्य् उपदध्यात् // यं कामयेत समावद् अस्यान्नम्̐ स्याद् इत्य् अभितस् तस्य स्वयमातृण्णाम् उपदध्यात् / यं कामयेत भूयो ऽस्यान्नम्̐ स्याद् इत्य् अन्तेषु तस्य व्युदुह्योपदध्यात् //
text_mt: For him whom he wishes: 'May he be without cattle,' he should lay them facing away; for him whom he wishes: 'May he possess cattle,' he should lay them facing together; for him whom he wishes: 'May his food be scanty,' he should lay the animal heads closer together; for him whom he wishes: 'May his food be of equal measure,' he should lay them on both sides of the naturally perforated [brick]; for him whom he wishes: 'May his food be abundant,' he should lay them, having pushed them apart, at the edges.

sanskrit_iast: vātasya dhrajim iti purastāt pratīcīnam aśvasyopadadhāti / ajasram indum iti paścāt prācīnam ṛṣabhasya / varūtriṃ tvaṣṭus \\ iti dakṣiṇata udīcīnaṃ vṛṣṇer uttarato vā dakṣiṇam \\ yo agnir agner ity uttarato dakṣiṇaṃ bastasya dakṣiṇato vodīcīnaṃ tāny utsargair avyavāyan pradakṣiṇam anu parikrāman pratidiśam upatiṣṭhate // imaṃ mā him̐sīr dvipādam iti puruṣasya / imaṃ mā him̐sīr ekaśapham ity aśvasya / imam̐ samudram ity ṛṣabhasya / imām ūrṇāyum iti vṛṣṇeḥ / ajā hy agner iti bastasya //
meaning: वातस्य ध्रजिम् इति पुरस्तात् प्रतीचीनम् अश्वस्योपदधाति / अजस्रम् इन्दुम् इति पश्चात् प्राचीनम् ऋषभस्य / वरूत्रिं त्वष्टुस् \\ इति दक्षिणत उदीचीनं वृष्णेर् उत्तरतो वा दक्षिणम् \\ यो अग्निर् अग्नेर् इत्य् उत्तरतो दक्षिणं बस्तस्य दक्षिणतो वोदीचीनं तान्य् उत्सर्गैर् अव्यवायन् प्रदक्षिणम् अनु परिक्रामन् प्रतिदिशम् उपतिष्ठते // इमं मा हिम्̐सीर् द्विपादम् इति पुरुषस्य / इमं मा हिम्̐सीर् एकशफम् इत्य् अश्वस्य / इमम्̐ समुद्रम् इत्य् ऋषभस्य / इमाम् ऊर्णायुम् इति वृष्णेः / अजा ह्य् अग्नेर् इति बस्तस्य //
text_mt: With [the mantra] "The rush of the wind…", he places [the head] of the horse in the east, facing west; with "The unceasing drop…", [the head] of the bull in the west, facing east; with "The guardian wife of Tvaṣṭṛ…", [the head] of the ram in the south facing north, or in the north facing south; with "Which fire of fire…", [the head] of the he-goat in the north facing south, or in the south facing north. Stepping around them clockwise without crossing between them, he worships them in each direction with the release-mantras: with "Injure not this two-footed [creature]…", [the head] of the man; with "Injure not this single-hoofed [creature]…", [the head] of the horse; with "This ocean…", [the head] of the bull; with "This woolly [creature]…", [the head] of the ram; with "The she-goat is indeed of Agni…", [the head] of the he-goat.

sanskrit_iast: atha yadi vāyavyasya śiro bhavati //
meaning: अथ यदि वायव्यस्य शिरो भवति //
text_mt: Now, if there is the head of [the beast] sacred to Vāyu:

sanskrit_iast: mukhyasthāne sarvair upadhāya sarvair utsargair upatiṣṭhate //
meaning: मुख्यस्थाने सर्वैर् उपधाय सर्वैर् उत्सर्गैर् उपतिष्ठते //
text_mt: having placed it in the primary position with all [the mantras], he worships it with all the release-mantras;

sanskrit_iast: apivā tasyatasya sthāna upadhāya tasyatasyotsargeṇopatiṣṭhate //
meaning: अपिवा तस्यतस्य स्थान उपधाय तस्यतस्योत्सर्गेणोपतिष्ठते //
text_mt: or, having placed it in the respective place of each, he worships it with the respective release-mantra of each.

sanskrit_iast: namo astu sarpebhyas \\ ity eteṣām ekenottare 'm̐se sarpaśira upadadhāti / viṣūcīnaṃ paśuśirobhiḥ //
meaning: नमो अस्तु सर्पेभ्यस् \\ इत्य् एतेषाम् एकेनोत्तरे ऽम्̐से सर्पशिर उपदधाति / विषूचीनं पशुशिरोभिः //
text_mt: With one of these [mantras beginning with] "Homage be to the serpents…", he places the head of a serpent on the northern shoulder, facing away from the animal heads.

sanskrit_iast: apivā yajur eva vaden nopadadhyāt //
meaning: अपिवा यजुर् एव वदेन् नोपदध्यात् //
text_mt: Or rather, he should only utter the yajus formula and not place [the head].

sanskrit_iast: mā chandas \ tat pṛthivī \\ agnir devatā \ tenarṣiṇā tena brahmaṇā tayā devatayāṅgirasvad dhruvā sīda / \ pramā chandas \ tad antarikṣam \\ vāto devatā / \ pratimā chandas \ tad dyauḥ \ sūryo devatā / \ asrīviś chandas \ tad diśaḥ \ somo devatā / \ virāṭ chandas \ tac cakṣuḥ \ pūṣā devatā / \ gāyatrī chandas \ tad ajā \ bṛhaspatir devatā / \ triṣṭub chandas \ tad dhiraṇyam \ indro devatā / \ jagatī chandas \ tad gauḥ \ prajāpatir devatā / \ anuṣṭup chandas \ tad vāk \\ varuṇo devatā / \ uṣṇihā chandas \ tad āyur \ mitro devatā / \ paṅktiś chandas \ tat kṛṣiḥ \ parjanyo devatā / \ bṛhatī chandas \ tad aśvaḥ \ parameṣṭhī devatā \ tenarṣiṇā tena brahmaṇā tayā devatayāṅgirasvad dhruvā sīda \\ iti dvādaśabhis trir abhyāvartayan ṣaṭtrim̐śatā purastāt pratīcīṃ puruṣākṛtiṃ citiṃ cinoti //
meaning: मा छन्दस् \ तत् पृथिवी \\ अग्निर् देवता \ तेनर्षिणा तेन ब्रह्मणा तया देवतयाङ्गिरस्वद् ध्रुवा सीद / \ प्रमा छन्दस् \ तद् अन्तरिक्षम् \\ वातो देवता / \ प्रतिमा छन्दस् \ तद् द्यौः \ सूर्यो देवता / \ अस्रीविश् छन्दस् \ तद् दिशः \ सोमो देवता / \ विराट् छन्दस् \ तच् चक्षुः \ पूषा देवता / \ गायत्री छन्दस् \ तद् अजा \ बृहस्पतिर् देवता / \ त्रिष्टुब् छन्दस् \ तद् धिरण्यम् \ इन्द्रो देवता / \ जगती छन्दस् \ तद् गौः \ प्रजापतिर् देवता / \ अनुष्टुप् छन्दस् \ तद् वाक् \\ वरुणो देवता / \ उष्णिहा छन्दस् \ तद् आयुर् \ मित्रो देवता / \ पङ्क्तिश् छन्दस् \ तत् कृषिः \ पर्जन्यो देवता / \ बृहती छन्दस् \ तद् अश्वः \ परमेष्ठी देवता \ तेनर्षिणा तेन ब्रह्मणा तया देवतयाङ्गिरस्वद् ध्रुवा सीद \\ इति द्वादशभिस् त्रिर् अभ्यावर्तयन् षट्त्रिम्̐शता पुरस्तात् प्रतीचीं पुरुषाकृतिं चितिं चिनोति //
text_mt: Repeating [them] three times, with thirty-six [formulas comprising these] twelve: "Mā is the metre, that is the earth, Agni is the deity; with that seer, with that sacred word, with that deity, sit firm like Aṅgiras! / Pramā is the metre, that is the atmosphere, Vāta is the deity… / Pratimā is the metre, that is the sky, Sūrya is the deity… / Asrīviś is the metre, that is the quarters, Soma is the deity… / Virāj is the metre, that is the eye, Pūṣan is the deity… / Gāyatrī is the metre, that is the she-goat, Bṛhaspati is the deity… / Triṣṭubh is the metre, that is the gold, Indra is the deity… / Jagatī is the metre, that is the cow, Prajāpati is the deity… / Anuṣṭubh is the metre, that is speech, Varuṇa is the deity… / Uṣṇih is the metre, that is life, Mitra is the deity… / Paṅkti is the metre, that is agriculture, Parjanya is the deity… / Bṛhatī is the metre, that is the horse, Parameṣṭhin is the deity; with that seer, with that sacred word, with that deity, sit firm like Aṅgiras!", he piles a layer in the shape of a man, from the east towards the west.

sanskrit_iast: puruṣaśiro 'syāḥ śiro bhavati //
meaning: पुरुषशिरो ऽस्याः शिरो भवति //
text_mt: The head of the man becomes its head.

sanskrit_iast: tam upadhāya sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ \ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt \\ iti puruṣeṇa nārāyaṇenopatiṣṭhate //
meaning: तम् उपधाय सहस्रशीर्षा पुरुषः \ सहस्राक्षः सहस्रपात् \\ इति पुरुषेण नारायणेनोपतिष्ठते //
text_mt: Having placed it, he worships it with the Puruṣasūkta by Nārāyaṇa: "The Puruṣa has a thousand heads, a thousand eyes, a thousand feet…"

sanskrit_iast: apasyā upadadhāti / apāṃ tvemant sādayāmi \\ iti pañca purastāt pratīcīḥ / arṇave sadane sīda \\ iti pañca dakṣiṇata udīcīḥ / apāṃ tvā sadane sādayāmi \\ iti pañca paścāt prācīḥ / gāyatrī chandas \\ iti pañcottarato dakṣiṇāḥ //
meaning: अपस्या उपदधाति / अपां त्वेमन्त् सादयामि \\ इति पञ्च पुरस्तात् प्रतीचीः / अर्णवे सदने सीद \\ इति पञ्च दक्षिणत उदीचीः / अपां त्वा सदने सादयामि \\ इति पञ्च पश्चात् प्राचीः / गायत्री छन्दस् \\ इति पञ्चोत्तरतो दक्षिणाः //
text_mt: He places the Apasyā bricks: five in the east facing west with "I settle thee in the pathway of the waters…"; five in the south facing north with "Sit in the watery seat…"; five in the west facing east with "I settle thee in the seat of the waters…"; five in the north facing south with "Gāyatrī is the metre…"

sanskrit_iast: ye yajñaṃ samagṛbhṇan \ devā devebhyaḥ pari / \ tān gāyatrī nayatu prajānatī \ svarge loke amṛtaṃ duhānā / \ ye jyotīm̐ṣi saṃdadhati \ svar ārohanto amṛtasya lokam / \ te yantu prajānantas \\ yajñaṃ vidānāḥ sukṛtasya loke / \ ye paśavo medhyāsas \\ yajñasya yonim abhisaṃbabhūvuḥ / \ tān dadante kavayo vipaścitas \\ yajñaṃ vidānāḥ sukṛtasya loke / \ yaḥ panthā vitato devayānas \\ chandobhir vigṛhīta eti / \ tenātiṣṭhad divam antarikṣam \\ yajñaṃ gṛhītvā sukṛtasya lokam / \ yo yajñaḥ sahasradhāras \\ dyāvāpṛthivyor adhi nirmitaḥ / \ tenaitu yajamānaḥ svastyā \ divo 'dhi pṛṣṭham asthāt \\ iti pañca hiraṇyeṣṭakāś catasraḥ pratidiśam ekāṃ madhye //
meaning: ये यज्ञं समगृभ्णन् \ देवा देवेभ्यः परि / \ तान् गायत्री नयतु प्रजानती \ स्वर्गे लोके अमृतं दुहाना / \ ये ज्योतीम्̐षि संदधति \ स्वर् आरोहन्तो अमृतस्य लोकम् / \ ते यन्तु प्रजानन्तस् \\ यज्ञं विदानाः सुकृतस्य लोके / \ ये पशवो मेध्यासस् \\ यज्ञस्य योनिम् अभिसंबभूवुः / \ तान् ददन्ते कवयो विपश्चितस् \\ यज्ञं विदानाः सुकृतस्य लोके / \ यः पन्था विततो देवयानस् \\ छन्दोभिर् विगृहीत एति / \ तेनातिष्ठद् दिवम् अन्तरिक्षम् \\ यज्ञं गृहीत्वा सुकृतस्य लोकम् / \ यो यज्ञः सहस्रधारस् \\ द्यावापृथिव्योर् अधि निर्मितः / \ तेनैतु यजमानः स्वस्त्या \ दिवो ऽधि पृष्ठम् अस्थात् \\ इति पञ्च हिरण्येष्टकाश् चतस्रः प्रतिदिशम् एकां मध्ये //
text_mt: [With the verses:] "Those gods who gathered the sacrifice together from the gods, / let the discerning Gāyatrī lead them, yielding immortality in the heavenly world. / Those who unite the lights, ascending to the light, to the world of immortality, / let them go discerning, knowing the sacrifice, in the world of the well-done. / Those sacrificial animals who were born towards the womb of the sacrifice, / the wise sages offer them, knowing the sacrifice, in the world of the well-done. / The path that is stretched out, travelled by the gods, which goes divided by the metres, / by that he reached heaven and atmosphere, having grasped the sacrifice, to the world of the well-done. / The sacrifice with a thousand streams, which was fashioned upon heaven and earth, / by that let the sacrificer go safely; he has stood upon the back of heaven"—with these [verses he places] five gold bricks: four in each direction and one in the middle.

sanskrit_iast: āyave svāhā \ yoṣkṛte svāhā \ yoṣyatvane svāhā \ viṣṇave svāhā \ bṛhaspataye svāhā \\ iti pañca hiraṇyeṣṭakāś catasraḥ pratidiśam ekāṃ madhye / trivṛt te agne śiras tan me agne śiraḥ \ pañcadaśau te agne bāhū tau me agne bāhū \ saptadaśas te agna ātmā sa me agna ātmā \\ ekavim̐śau te agna ūrū tau me agna ūrū \ triṇavau te agne 'ṣṭhīvantau tau me agne 'ṣṭhīvantau \ trayastrim̐śaṃ te agne pratiṣṭhānaṃ tan me agne pratiṣṭhānam ity etāḥ śirasi pakṣāt puccheṣu śroṇyor am̐sayor upadadhāti / trivṛtte agne śiras tena mābhipāhi \ pañcadaśau te agne bāhū tābhyāṃ mābhipāhi \ sapatadaśas te agna ātmā tena mābhipāhi \\ ekavim̐śau te agna ūrū tābhyāṃ mābhipāhi \ triṇavau te agne 'ṣṭhīvantau tābhyāṃ mābhipāhi \ trayastrim̐śaṃ te agne pratiṣṭhānaṃ tena mābhipāhi \\ ity upahitā yajamāno 'numantrayate //
meaning: आयवे स्वाहा \ योष्कृते स्वाहा \ योष्यत्वने स्वाहा \ विष्णवे स्वाहा \ बृहस्पतये स्वाहा \\ इति पञ्च हिरण्येष्टकाश् चतस्रः प्रतिदिशम् एकां मध्ये / त्रिवृत् ते अग्ने शिरस् तन् मे अग्ने शिरः \ पञ्चदशौ ते अग्ने बाहू तौ मे अग्ने बाहू \ सप्तदशस् ते अग्न आत्मा स मे अग्न आत्मा \\ एकविम्̐शौ ते अग्न ऊरू तौ मे अग्न ऊरू \ त्रिणवौ ते अग्ने ऽष्ठीवन्तौ तौ मे अग्ने ऽष्ठीवन्तौ \ त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शं ते अग्ने प्रतिष्ठानं तन् मे अग्ने प्रतिष्ठानम् इत्य् एताः शिरसि पक्षात् पुच्छेषु श्रोण्योर् अम्̐सयोर् उपदधाति / त्रिवृत्ते अग्ने शिरस् तेन माभिपाहि \ पञ्चदशौ ते अग्ने बाहू ताभ्यां माभिपाहि \ सपतदशस् ते अग्न आत्मा तेन माभिपाहि \\ एकविम्̐शौ ते अग्न ऊरू ताभ्यां माभिपाहि \ त्रिणवौ ते अग्ने ऽष्ठीवन्तौ ताभ्यां माभिपाहि \ त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शं ते अग्ने प्रतिष्ठानं तेन माभिपाहि \\ इत्य् उपहिता यजमानो ऽनुमन्त्रयते //
text_mt: With "To Āyu hail! To the maker of union hail! To unity hail! To Viṣṇu hail! To Bṛhaspati hail!", [he places] five gold bricks: four in each direction and one in the middle. With "The threefold [stoma] is thy head, O Agni; that is my head, O Agni; the fifteenfold [stoma] is thy two arms, O Agni; those are my two arms, O Agni; the seventeenfold [stoma] is thy trunk, O Agni; that is my trunk, O Agni; the twenty-onefold [stoma] is thy two thighs, O Agni; those are my two thighs, O Agni; the thrice-ninefold [stoma] is thy two knees, O Agni; those are my two knees, O Agni; the thirty-threefold [stoma] is thy support, O Agni; that is my support, O Agni"—these he places on the head, on the wings, on the tail, on the hips, and on the shoulders. The sacrificer recites over them when placed: "The threefold [stoma] is thy head, O Agni; by that protect me! The fifteenfold [stoma] is thy two arms; by them protect me! The seventeenfold [stoma] is thy trunk, O Agni; by that protect me! The twenty-onefold [stoma] is thy two thighs, O Agni; by them protect me! The thrice-ninefold [stoma] is thy two knees, O Agni; by them protect me! The thirty-threefold [stoma] is thy support; by that protect me!"

sanskrit_iast: adbhyaḥ saṃbhūtaḥ pṛthivyai rasāc ca \ viśvakarmaṇaḥ samavartatādhi / \ tasya tvaṣṭā vidadhad rūpam eti \ tat puruṣasya viśvam ājānam agre \\ ity etām upadhāya \\ ṛtasad asi \ satyasad asi \ tejaḥsad asi \ varcaḥsad asi \ yaśaḥsad asi \ gṛṇānāsi / \ dhāmāsi \ dhāmyai tvā \ dhāmabhyas tvā \ dhāmasu sīda / \ sanir asi \ sanyai tvā saneyam / \ vittir asi \ vittyai tvā videyam / \ śktir asi \ śaktyai tvā śakeyam / \ bhūtir asi \ bhūtyai tvā bhūyāsam / \ karmāsi \ karmaṇe tvā kriyāsam / \ gūrdo 'si \ gūrdāya tvā \ gūrdebhyas tvā \ gūrde sīda /
meaning: अद्भ्यः संभूतः पृथिव्यै रसाच् च \ विश्वकर्मणः समवर्तताधि / \ तस्य त्वष्टा विदधद् रूपम् एति \ तत् पुरुषस्य विश्वम् आजानम् अग्रे \\ इत्य् एताम् उपधाय \\ ऋतसद् असि \ सत्यसद् असि \ तेजःसद् असि \ वर्चःसद् असि \ यशःसद् असि \ गृणानासि / \ धामासि \ धाम्यै त्वा \ धामभ्यस् त्वा \ धामसु सीद / \ सनिर् असि \ सन्यै त्वा सनेयम् / \ वित्तिर् असि \ वित्त्यै त्वा विदेयम् / \ श्क्तिर् असि \ शक्त्यै त्वा शकेयम् / \ भूतिर् असि \ भूत्यै त्वा भूयासम् / \ कर्मासि \ कर्मणे त्वा क्रियासम् / \ गूर्दो ऽसि \ गूर्दाय त्वा \ गूर्देभ्यस् त्वा \ गूर्दे सीद /
text_mt: Having placed this [brick] with "Produced from the waters and from the sap of the earth, he came into being from Viśvakarman; / Tvaṣṭṛ, fashioning his form, approaches; that was the entire origin of the Puruṣa in the beginning", [he recites:] "Thou art seated in truth; thou art seated in reality; thou art seated in fiery energy; thou art seated in splendour; thou art seated in fame; thou art praised; thou art the abode; for the abode [I set] thee; for the abodes [I set] thee; sit in the abodes! Thou art acquisition; for acquisition may I acquire thee! Thou art finding; for finding may I find thee! Thou art ability; for ability may I be able for thee! Thou art prosperity; for prosperity may I prosper! Thou art ritual action; for ritual action may I perform thee! Thou art exultation; for exultation [I set] thee; for the exultations [I set] thee; sit in exultation!
