sanskrit_iast: yadi kāmayeta viśā kṣatram̐ hanyām iti grāmye 'nuvākyasya gaṇasya trīṇi catvāri vā padāny anūcyāraṇye 'nuvākyasya śeṣeṇa juhoti //
meaning: यदि कामयेत विशा क्षत्रम्̐ हन्याम् इति ग्राम्ये ऽनुवाक्यस्य गणस्य त्रीणि चत्वारि वा पदान्य् अनूच्यारण्ये ऽनुवाक्यस्य शेषेण जुहोति //
text_mt: If he should wish, 'May I strike down the royal power with the common people', having recited three or four feet of a troop belonging to the recitation for the village, he offers with the remainder belonging to the recitation for the wilderness.

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ tribhir ādito yathāsamāmnātaṃ grāme 'nuvākyasya yathā pūrvair evaṃ tribhir uttarair gaṇaiḥ //
meaning: एवं त्रिभिर् आदितो यथासमाम्नातं ग्रामे ऽनुवाक्यस्य यथा पूर्वैर् एवं त्रिभिर् उत्तरैर् गणैः //
text_mt: In this manner with three from the beginning according to the traditional text of the recitation for the village; as with the preceding, so with the three subsequent troops.

sanskrit_iast: yadi kāmayeta kṣatreṇa viśam̐ hanyām ity āraṇye 'nuvākyasya ṣaṭsu padāntarāleṣu ṣaḍ gaṇān opya grāmeṣu vākyaṃ japitvāraṇyena vākyaśeṣaṃ juhoti //
meaning: यदि कामयेत क्षत्रेण विशम्̐ हन्याम् इत्य् आरण्ये ऽनुवाक्यस्य षट्सु पदान्तरालेषु षड् गणान् ओप्य ग्रामेषु वाक्यं जपित्वारण्येन वाक्यशेषं जुहोति //
text_mt: If he desires, 'May I strike down the commoners with the warrior,' he scatters six verse-groups into the six word-intervals of the [formula] to be recited in the wilderness; having muttered the sentence in the settlements, he offers the rest of the sentence with the [formula] of the wilderness.

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ tribhir ādito yathāsamāmnātaṃ grāme 'nuvākyena yathā pūrvair evaṃ tribhir uttarair gaṇaiḥ //
meaning: एवं त्रिभिर् आदितो यथासमाम्नातं ग्रामे ऽनुवाक्येन यथा पूर्वैर् एवं त्रिभिर् उत्तरैर् गणैः //
text_mt: In this manner, from the beginning, with three [verse-groups] according to the traditional text of the [formula] to be recited in the settlement, as with the preceding, so with the three subsequent verse-groups.

sanskrit_iast: na saṃpreṣyati / na saṃmārṣṭi / nānūyājān yajati //
meaning: न संप्रेष्यति / न संमार्ष्टि / नानूयाजान् यजति //
text_mt: He does not issue ritual directions; he does not wipe [the ladles]; he does not sacrifice the after-offerings.

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ kāmayeta kṣatriyaṃ pra svād āyatanāc cyaveteti tasyāraṇye 'nuvākyasya gaṇasyāgniṣṭhaṃ rathavāhanaṃ vā vyaṅgayed ity ayajñasaṃyuktaḥ kalpaḥ //
meaning: यं कामयेत क्षत्रियं प्र स्वाद् आयतनाच् च्यवेतेति तस्यारण्ये ऽनुवाक्यस्य गणस्याग्निष्ठं रथवाहनं वा व्यङ्गयेद् इत्य् अयज्ञसंयुक्तः कल्पः //
text_mt: Whichever kṣatriya he desires should fall away from his own station, he should disjoint the Agniṣṭha or the chariot-chassis belonging to that verse-group of his to be recited in the wilderness: this is the procedure disconnected from the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: vasor dhārāṃ juhoti / ājyenaudumbaryā srucā \\ agnāviṣṇū sajoṣasā \\ ity anudrutya vājaś ca me prasavaś ca me \\ iti saṃtatām ā mantrasamāpanāt //
meaning: वसोर् धारां जुहोति / आज्येनौदुम्बर्या स्रुचा \\ अग्नाविष्णू सजोषसा \\ इत्य् अनुद्रुत्य वाजश् च मे प्रसवश् च मे \\ इति संतताम् आ मन्त्रसमापनात् //
text_mt: He offers the stream of wealth. With clarified butter, using an offering ladle of udumbara wood, having recited along, 'O Agni and Viṣṇu, closely united...,' [he offers] continuously with, 'May food-strength be mine and impulsion be mine...,' up to the completion of the mantra.

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ kāmayeta prāṇānasyānnādyaṃ vicchindyām iti vigrāhaṃ tasya juhuyāt / yaṃ kāmayeta prāṇānasyānnādyam̐ saṃtanuyām iti saṃtatāṃ tasya juhuyāt //
meaning: यं कामयेत प्राणानस्यान्नाद्यं विच्छिन्द्याम् इति विग्राहं तस्य जुहुयात् / यं कामयेत प्राणानस्यान्नाद्यम्̐ संतनुयाम् इति संततां तस्य जुहुयात् //
text_mt: Whose breath and food-eating he desires, 'May I sever them,' for him he should offer with pauses; whose breath and food-eating he desires, 'May I make them continuous,' for him he should offer continuously.

sanskrit_iast: yad ājyam ucchiṣyeta tasmin brahmaudanaṃ paktvā caturo 'dhvaryūn bhojayet tebhyaś catasro dhenūr dakṣiṇā dadyāt //
meaning: यद् आज्यम् उच्छिष्येत तस्मिन् ब्रह्मौदनं पक्त्वा चतुरो ऽध्वर्यून् भोजयेत् तेभ्यश् चतस्रो धेनूर् दक्षिणा दद्यात् //
text_mt: Whatever clarified butter remains, having cooked the brahmaudana porridge in that, he should feed the four adhvaryus; to them he should give four milch cows as the sacrificial gift.

sanskrit_iast: catuḥśarāvam odanaṃ paktvā tad vyañjanaṃ bhojayati //
meaning: चतुःशरावम् ओदनं पक्त्वा तद् व्यञ्जनं भोजयति //
text_mt: Having cooked porridge made of four śarāva measures, he feeds [them with it] seasoned with that.

sanskrit_iast: vājaprasavīyaṃ juhoti / sapta grāmyā oṣadhayaḥ saptāraṇyāḥ / pṛthagannāni dravīkṛtya vājasyemaṃ prasavaḥ suṣave \\ iti caturdaśabhir ṛgbhir audumbareṇa sruveṇaikaikayarcānnamannaṃ juhoti //
meaning: वाजप्रसवीयं जुहोति / सप्त ग्राम्या ओषधयः सप्तारण्याः / पृथगन्नानि द्रवीकृत्य वाजस्येमं प्रसवः सुषवे \\ इति चतुर्दशभिर् ऋग्भिर् औदुम्बरेण स्रुवेणैकैकयर्चान्नमन्नं जुहोति //
text_mt: He offers the vājaprasavīya oblation. There are seven cultivated plants and seven wild plants. Having liquefied the foods separately, with the fourteen verses beginning with, 'This impulsion of food-strength has generated...,' using a dipping spoon of udumbara wood, he offers food by food with each single verse:

sanskrit_iast: pituṃ nu stoṣaṃ mahas \\ dharmāṇaṃ taviṣīm / \ yasya trito vy ojasā \ vṛtraṃ viparvam ardayat // \ svādo pito madho pito \ vayaṃ tvā vavṛmahe / \ asmākamavitā bhava / \ upa naḥ pitav ācara \ śivaḥ śivābhir ūtibhiḥ // \ mayobhūr adviṣeṇyaḥ \ sakhā suśevo advayāḥ / \ tava tye pito rasās \\ rajām̐sy anuviṣṭhitāḥ // \ divi vātā iva śritāḥ / \ tava tye pito dadatas \ tava svādiṣṭha te pito // \ pra svādmāno rasānām \\ tuvigrīvā iverate / \ tve pito mahānām \\ devānāṃ mano hitam // \ akāri cāru ketunā \ tavāhim avasāvadhīt / \ yad ado pito ajagan \ vivasva parvatānām // \ atrā cin no madho pito \ 'raṃ bhakṣāya gamyāḥ / \ yad apām oṣadhīnām \\ pariṃśam āriśāmahe // \ vātāpe pīva id bhava / \ yat te soma gavāśiras \\ yavāśiro bhajāmahe // \ vātāpe pīva id bhava / \ karambha oṣadhe bhava \ pīvo vṛkka udārathiḥ \ vātāpe pīva id bhava / \ taṃ tvā vayaṃ pito \ vacobhir gāvo na havyā suṣūdima // \ devebhyas tvā sadhamādam \ asmabhyaṃ tvā sadhamādam iti hutvāhutvā pātryām̐ saṃpātam avanayet //
meaning: पितुं नु स्तोषं महस् \\ धर्माणं तविषीम् / \ यस्य त्रितो व्य् ओजसा \ वृत्रं विपर्वम् अर्दयत् // \ स्वादो पितो मधो पितो \ वयं त्वा ववृमहे / \ अस्माकमविता भव / \ उप नः पितव् आचर \ शिवः शिवाभिर् ऊतिभिः // \ मयोभूर् अद्विषेण्यः \ सखा सुशेवो अद्वयाः / \ तव त्ये पितो रसास् \\ रजाम्̐स्य् अनुविष्ठिताः // \ दिवि वाता इव श्रिताः / \ तव त्ये पितो ददतस् \ तव स्वादिष्ठ ते पितो // \ प्र स्वाद्मानो रसानाम् \\ तुविग्रीवा इवेरते / \ त्वे पितो महानाम् \\ देवानां मनो हितम् // \ अकारि चारु केतुना \ तवाहिम् अवसावधीत् / \ यद् अदो पितो अजगन् \ विवस्व पर्वतानाम् // \ अत्रा चिन् नो मधो पितो \ ऽरं भक्षाय गम्याः / \ यद् अपाम् ओषधीनाम् \\ परिंशम् आरिशामहे // \ वातापे पीव इद् भव / \ यत् ते सोम गवाशिरस् \\ यवाशिरो भजामहे // \ वातापे पीव इद् भव / \ करम्भ ओषधे भव \ पीवो वृक्क उदारथिः \ वातापे पीव इद् भव / \ तं त्वा वयं पितो \ वचोभिर् गावो न हव्या सुषूदिम // \ देवेभ्यस् त्वा सधमादम् \ अस्मभ्यं त्वा सधमादम् इति हुत्वाहुत्वा पात्र्याम्̐ संपातम् अवनयेत् //
text_mt: "Now I will praise the nourishment, the strength of the great law, / by whose power Trita rent Vṛtra limb from limb. / O sweet nourishment, O honeyed nourishment, we have chosen thee; / be our helper! / Come to us, O nourishment, benevolent with benevolent aids; / conferring delight, not to be hated, an auspicious friend, without deceit! / O nourishment, those saps of thine have spread through the intermediate spaces, / fixed like winds in the sky! / O nourishment, to those who give thine, O sweetest nourishment, to thee, O nourishment, / the sweetnesses of saps burst forth like strong-necked [bulls]! / In thee, O nourishment, the mind of the great gods is placed; / a fair deed was accomplished through thy banner: he slew the serpent through thy aid! / Since there, O nourishment, thou didst go to the expanse of the mountains, / even here, O sweet nourishment, mayest thou come suitable for eating! / When we partake of the portion of waters and plants, / O Vātāpi, become fat! / When, O Soma, we partake of thy milk-blend and barley-blend, / O Vātāpi, become fat! / O plant, become gruel, fat, a kidney, an impeller; / O Vātāpi, become fat! / Thee, such a one, O nourishment, we have prepared with words like cattle with oblations; / for the gods a fellow-rejoicer, for us a fellow-rejoicer!" — having made each offering, he should pour the residue into the pan.

sanskrit_iast: apivā yasyānnasyāgre juhuyāt tasyedhmaṃ kuryāt //
meaning: अपिवा यस्यान्नस्याग्रे जुहुयात् तस्येध्मं कुर्यात् //
text_mt: Or, he should make the kindling-wood of that food with which he offers first.

sanskrit_iast: yajamānāyatana audumbaryām āsīnam agnim anvārabdhaṃ kṛṣṇājine saṃpātair abhiṣiñcati //
meaning: यजमानायतन औदुम्बर्याम् आसीनम् अग्निम् अन्वारब्धं कृष्णाजिने संपातैर् अभिषिञ्चति //
text_mt: With the residues, he sprinkles [the sacrificer] who is seated in the place of the sacrificer on an udumbara seat, who has held onto the fire, on a black antelope skin.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇe vā pakṣāv asmin kṛṣṇājine brāhmaṇaṃ vyāghracarmaṇi rājanyaṃ bastacarmaṇi vaiśyaṃ paśukāmam iti //
meaning: दक्षिणे वा पक्षाव् अस्मिन् कृष्णाजिने ब्राह्मणं व्याघ्रचर्मणि राजन्यं बस्तचर्मणि वैश्यं पशुकामम् इति //
text_mt: Or, on this right wing [of the altar]: a brāhmaṇa on a black antelope skin, a rājanya on a tiger skin, a vaiśya desiring cattle on a goat skin.

sanskrit_iast: nityavad eke samāmananti //
meaning: नित्यवद् एके समामनन्ति //
text_mt: Some hand it down as an obligatory rule.

sanskrit_iast: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave 'śvinor bāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ bṛhaspatim̐ sāmrājyenābhiṣiñcāmi \\ iti brāhmaṇam //
meaning: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवे ऽश्विनोर् बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्यां बृहस्पतिम्̐ साम्राज्येनाभिषिञ्चामि \\ इति ब्राह्मणम् //
text_mt: With, 'At the impulsion of divine Savitṛ, with the arms of the Aśvins, with the hands of Pūṣan, I consecrate thee, Bṛhaspati, to supreme sovereignty,' [he consecrates] a brāhmaṇa;

sanskrit_iast: indram̐ sāmrājyenābhiṣiñcāmi \\ iti rājanyam / agnim̐ sāmrājyenābhiṣiñcāmi \\ iti vaiśyam //
meaning: इन्द्रम्̐ साम्राज्येनाभिषिञ्चामि \\ इति राजन्यम् / अग्निम्̐ साम्राज्येनाभिषिञ्चामि \\ इति वैश्यम् //
text_mt: with, 'I consecrate thee, Indra, to supreme sovereignty,' a rājanya; with, 'I consecrate thee, Agni, to supreme sovereignty,' a vaiśya.

sanskrit_iast: purastāt pratyaṅtiṣṭhan paścāt prāṅmukham āsīnaṃ śīrṣato 'bhiṣicyāmukhād anvavasrāvayati //
meaning: पुरस्तात् प्रत्यङ्तिष्ठन् पश्चात् प्राङ्मुखम् आसीनं शीर्षतो ऽभिषिच्यामुखाद् अन्ववस्रावयति //
text_mt: Standing in front facing west, he sprinkles [the sacrificer] who is seated behind facing east, beginning from the head, and lets [the liquid] flow down as far as the mouth.

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṇāyai śvetavatsāyai payasā dadhnā vaudumbarīm̐ srucaṃ pūrayitvā naktoṣāsā \\ ity āhutiṃ juhoti //
meaning: कृष्णायै श्वेतवत्सायै पयसा दध्ना वौदुम्बरीम्̐ स्रुचं पूरयित्वा नक्तोषासा \\ इत्य् आहुतिं जुहोति //
text_mt: Having filled the offering ladle of udumbara wood with milk or curd from a black cow with a white calf, he offers an oblation with, 'Night and Dawn...'

sanskrit_iast: ṛtāṣāḍ ṛtadhāmā \\ iti ṣaḍbhiḥ paryāyair dvādaśagṛhītena dvādaśa rāṣṭrabhṛto juhoti //
meaning: ऋताषाड् ऋतधामा \\ इति षड्भिः पर्यायैर् द्वादशगृहीतेन द्वादश राष्ट्रभृतो जुहोति //
text_mt: With the six sections beginning with, 'Abiding by truth, of truthful abode...,' he offers twelve rāṣṭrabhṛt offerings with twelve drawings [of butter].

sanskrit_iast: paryāyam anudrutya tasmai svāhā \\ iti pūrvām āhutiṃ juhoti //
meaning: पर्यायम् अनुद्रुत्य तस्मै स्वाहा \\ इति पूर्वाम् आहुतिं जुहोति //
text_mt: Having recited the section along, he offers the first oblation with, 'To him svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: tābhyaḥ svāhā \\ ity uttarām // bhuvanasya pate \\ iti rathamukhe pañcāhutīr juhoti // daśa vā paryāyai rathyasyāhavanīye dhāryamāṇam̐ rathaśiro 'bhi juhoti / rathaśirasā juhotīty ekeṣām //
meaning: ताभ्यः स्वाहा \\ इत्य् उत्तराम् // भुवनस्य पते \\ इति रथमुखे पञ्चाहुतीर् जुहोति // दश वा पर्यायै रथ्यस्याहवनीये धार्यमाणम्̐ रथशिरो ऽभि जुहोति / रथशिरसा जुहोतीत्य् एकेषाम् //
text_mt: With, 'To them svāhā!' [he offers] the second. With, 'O Lord of the world...,' he offers five oblations on the front part of the chariot. Or, with the ten sections, he offers over the chariot-head of the chariot held over the āhavanīya fire; 'he offers with the chariot-head,' is the view of some.

sanskrit_iast: samudgṛhītam̐ ratham adhvaryor āvasatham̐ haranti / anunayanti trīn aśvām̐ś catura ity ekeṣām //
meaning: समुद्गृहीतम्̐ रथम् अध्वर्योर् आवसथम्̐ हरन्ति / अनुनयन्ति त्रीन् अश्वाम्̐श् चतुर इत्य् एकेषाम् //
text_mt: They carry the lifted-up chariot to the residence of the adhvaryu. They lead along three horses, or four according to some.

sanskrit_iast: tān sarathān adhvaryave dadāti //
meaning: तान् सरथान् अध्वर्यवे ददाति //
text_mt: He gives them along with the chariot to the adhvaryu.

sanskrit_iast: samudro 'si nabhasvān ity añjalinā trīn vātanāmāni juhoti //
meaning: समुद्रो ऽसि नभस्वान् इत्य् अञ्जलिना त्रीन् वातनामानि जुहोति //
text_mt: With, 'Thou art the ocean, rich in vapor...,' he offers three wind-names with cupped hands;

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṇājinapuṭena vā //
meaning: कृष्णाजिनपुटेन वा //

sanskrit_iast: agna udadhe yā ta iṣur yuvā nāma \\ iti pañcabhiḥ paryāyaiḥ pradakṣiṇam anuparikrāman pratidiśaṃ pañcājyāhutīr juhoti / madhya uttamena prāṅmukhaḥ / samīcī nāmāsi prācī dik \\ iti ṣaḍbhiḥ paryāyair dadhnā madhumiśreṇa ṣaṇ mahāhutīr juhoti / yathā sarpāhutīr yās te agne sūrye rucas \\ iti tisro ruco juhoti //
meaning: अग्न उदधे या त इषुर् युवा नाम \\ इति पञ्चभिः पर्यायैः प्रदक्षिणम् अनुपरिक्रामन् प्रतिदिशं पञ्चाज्याहुतीर् जुहोति / मध्य उत्तमेन प्राङ्मुखः / समीची नामासि प्राची दिक् \\ इति षड्भिः पर्यायैर् दध्ना मधुमिश्रेण षण् महाहुतीर् जुहोति / यथा सर्पाहुतीर् यास् ते अग्ने सूर्ये रुचस् \\ इति तिस्रो रुचो जुहोति //
text_mt: With the five sections beginning with, 'O Agni, the receptacle of water, what arrow of thine is named Youthful...,' circumambulating clockwise, he offers five clarified-butter oblations in each quarter, facing east in the center with the last. With the six sections beginning with, 'United art thou, the eastern quarter...,' he offers six great oblations with curd mixed with honey. As with the serpent-oblations, he offers three luster-oblations with, 'What lusters are thine in the sun, O Agni...'

sanskrit_iast: suvar ṇa gharma svāhā \\ iti pañcārkāhutīr hutvā //
meaning: सुवर् ण घर्म स्वाहा \\ इति पञ्चार्काहुतीर् हुत्वा //
text_mt: Having offered five arka oblations with, 'To the sun, to the cauldron, svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: vedistaraṇaprabhṛtīni karmāṇi pratipadyate //
meaning: वेदिस्तरणप्रभृतीनि कर्माणि प्रतिपद्यते //
text_mt: he undertakes the rites beginning with the strewing of the altar.

sanskrit_iast: mamāgne \\ ity etenānuvākena pratimantram iṣṭakābhir dhiṣṇiyām̐ś cinoti / ekaikena mantreṇaikaikaṃ dhiṣṇiyam upavarjayati / aṣṭāv āgnīdhrīya upadadhāty aśmā navama ity ekeṣām //
meaning: ममाग्ने \\ इत्य् एतेनानुवाकेन प्रतिमन्त्रम् इष्टकाभिर् धिष्णियाम्̐श् चिनोति / एकैकेन मन्त्रेणैकैकं धिष्णियम् उपवर्जयति / अष्टाव् आग्नीध्रीय उपदधात्य् अश्मा नवम इत्य् एकेषाम् //
text_mt: With this anuvāka beginning with, 'Mine, O Agni...,' he piles up the dhiṣṇiya hearths verse by verse with bricks. With each single mantra he completes each single dhiṣṇiya. He sets down eight on the āgnīdhrīya hearth; a stone is the ninth, according to some.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśa caturvim̐śatiṃ vā hotrīya ekādaśaikavim̐śatiṃ vā praśāstrīye ṣaṇ mārjālīye 'ṣṭāv itareṣu //
meaning: द्वादश चतुर्विम्̐शतिं वा होत्रीय एकादशैकविम्̐शतिं वा प्रशास्त्रीये षण् मार्जालीये ऽष्टाव् इतरेषु //
text_mt: Twelve or twenty-four on the hotṛ's hearth; eleven or twenty-one on the praśāstṛ's hearth; six on the mārjālīya hearth; eight on the others.

sanskrit_iast: tava śriye vyajihīta parvatas \\ gavāṃ gotram udasṛjo yad aṅgiraḥ / \ indreṇa yujā tamasā parīvṛtam \\ bṛhaspate nir apām aubjo arṇavam / \ bṛhaspate ati yad aryo arhāt / \ evā pitre \\ iti tisṛbhir brāhmībhir brahmasadane yamo dādhāra pṛthivīm
meaning: तव श्रिये व्यजिहीत पर्वतस् \\ गवां गोत्रम् उदसृजो यद् अङ्गिरः / \ इन्द्रेण युजा तमसा परीवृतम् \\ बृहस्पते निर् अपाम् औब्जो अर्णवम् / \ बृहस्पते अति यद् अर्यो अर्हात् / \ एवा पित्रे \\ इति तिसृभिर् ब्राह्मीभिर् ब्रह्मसदने यमो दाधार पृथिवीम्
text_mt: With the three verses addressed to Brahman, 'For thy glory the mountain parted, when thou didst release the stall of the cattle, O Aṅgiras; with Indra as thy ally, thou didst drive out the flood of waters enveloped in darkness, O Bṛhaspati! / What [wealth] Bṛhaspati might deserve beyond a stranger... / Thus to the father...' [he places bricks] on the brahman's seat. 'Yama held the earth...'

sanskrit_iast: yamaṃ yo vidyāt sa brūyāt \\ yathaika ṛṣir vijānate //
meaning: यमं यो विद्यात् स ब्रूयात् \\ यथैक ऋषिर् विजानते //
text_mt: 'Whoever might know Yama, he should speak as one sage understands.'

sanskrit_iast: trikadrukebhiḥ patati \ ṣaḍ urvīr ekam id bṛhat / \ gāyatrī triṣṭup chandām̐si \ sarvā tā yama āhitā \\ iti tisṛbhir yāmībhir mārjālīye tveṣaṃ vayam̐ rudraṃ yajñasādhavam
meaning: त्रिकद्रुकेभिः पतति \ षड् उर्वीर् एकम् इद् बृहत् / \ गायत्री त्रिष्टुप् छन्दाम्̐सि \ सर्वा ता यम आहिता \\ इति तिसृभिर् यामीभिर् मार्जालीये त्वेषं वयम्̐ रुद्रं यज्ञसाधवम्
text_mt: With the three verses addressed to Yama, 'He flies with the three Kadrukas, the six expanses, the one great [world]; the Gāyatrī, the Triṣṭubh, the meters, all those are placed in Yama,' [he places bricks] on the mārjālīya hearth. 'Fierce, we, Rudra, the accomplisher of the sacrifice...'

sanskrit_iast: aśyāma te sumatiṃ devayajyayā \ kṣayadvīrasya tava rudra mīḍhvaḥ / \ sumnāyann id viśo asmākam ā cara \\ ariṣṭavīrā juhavāma te haviḥ //
meaning: अश्याम ते सुमतिं देवयज्यया \ क्षयद्वीरस्य तव रुद्र मीढ्वः / \ सुम्नायन्न् इद् विशो अस्माकम् आ चर \\ अरिष्टवीरा जुहवाम ते हविः //
text_mt: "May we obtain your goodwill through worship of the gods, / your goodwill who rule over heroes, o bounteous Rudra! / Approaching with favor, enter into our settlements; / with heroes uninjured may we offer sacrificial oblation to you."

sanskrit_iast: mṛḍā no rudrota no mayaskṛdhi \\ iti tisṛbhī raudrībhiś cātvāle havyaṃ prīṇīhi \ havyam̐ śrīṇīhi \ havyaṃ paca \ havyam̐ śrapaya \ havyam asi \ havyāya tvā \ havyebhyas tvā \ havye sīda \\ ity aṣṭau śāmitre havyasūdas \\ ava te heḍas \\ ud uttamam \\ tat tvā yāmi brahmaṇā vandamānas \\ iti tisṛbhir vāruṇībhir avabhṛthe ( tāsu pracaranti / khaṇḍāḥ kṛṣṇā lakṣmaṇāś cotkara udasyati avaśiṣṭāś ca ) //
meaning: मृडा नो रुद्रोत नो मयस्कृधि \\ इति तिसृभी रौद्रीभिश् चात्वाले हव्यं प्रीणीहि \ हव्यम्̐ श्रीणीहि \ हव्यं पच \ हव्यम्̐ श्रपय \ हव्यम् असि \ हव्याय त्वा \ हव्येभ्यस् त्वा \ हव्ये सीद \\ इत्य् अष्टौ शामित्रे हव्यसूदस् \\ अव ते हेडस् \\ उद् उत्तमम् \\ तत् त्वा यामि ब्रह्मणा वन्दमानस् \\ इति तिसृभिर् वारुणीभिर् अवभृथे ( तासु प्रचरन्ति / खण्डाः कृष्णा लक्ष्मणाश् चोत्कर उदस्यति अवशिष्टाश् च ) //
text_mt: With three verses addressed to Rudra beginning with "Be gracious to us, o Rudra, and grant us joy" at the cātvāla pit, [and] with the eight formulas of the "sacrificial food preparers" at the butcher's fire: "Gratify the sacrificial food;" "Mix the sacrificial food;" "Cook the sacrificial food;" "Boil the sacrificial food;" "You are the sacrificial food;" "For the sacrificial food, thee;" "For the sacrificial foods, thee;" "Sit on the sacrificial food!" [and] with three verses addressed to Varuṇa at the purificatory bath: "Avert your wrath;" "Loosen the highest [bond];" "Praising you with prayer, I entreat that of you"—they perform the rites with these; the broken, black, and marked [bricks] and whatever are left over, he throws onto the rubbish heap.

sanskrit_iast: yat prāg yūpasaṃmānāt tat kṛtvaikayūpam ekādaśa vā yūpān saṃminoti //
meaning: यत् प्राग् यूपसंमानात् तत् कृत्वैकयूपम् एकादश वा यूपान् संमिनोति //
text_mt: Having performed whatever precedes the measuring of the sacrificial post, he erects a single sacrificial post or eleven sacrificial posts.

sanskrit_iast: teṣām agniṣṭhaṃ pūrvedyur ucchrayati //
meaning: तेषाम् अग्निष्ठं पूर्वेद्युर् उच्छ्रयति //
text_mt: Of them, he erects the one standing directly before the fire on the previous day.

sanskrit_iast: atraiva vā / itarāñ śvo vā / agnīṣomīyasya paśupuroḍāśaṃ nirupya devasuvām̐ havīm̐śy anunirvapati \\ agnaye gṛhapataye \\ iti yathāsamāmnātam /
meaning: अत्रैव वा / इतराञ् श्वो वा / अग्नीषोमीयस्य पशुपुरोडाशं निरुप्य देवसुवाम्̐ हवीम्̐श्य् अनुनिर्वपति \\ अग्नये गृहपतये \\ इति यथासमाम्नातम् /
text_mt: Or right here [he erects the others]; or on the next day the others. Having portioned out the animal sacrificial cake of the animal for Agni and Soma, he portions out successively the oblations to the Devasūs with "To Agni the householder" as handed down in the text.

sanskrit_iast: paśupuroḍāśasya devasuvāṃ ca haviṣām̐ samānam̐ sviṣṭakṛdiḍam //
meaning: पशुपुरोडाशस्य देवसुवां च हविषाम्̐ समानम्̐ स्विष्टकृदिडम् //
text_mt: The Sviṣṭakṛt offering and the iḍā of the animal sacrificial cake and of the Devasū oblations are common.

sanskrit_iast: paśukāla ekayūpa ekādaśa paśūn upākaroti ekādaśasu vā //
meaning: पशुकाल एकयूप एकादश पशून् उपाकरोति एकादशसु वा //
text_mt: At the time of the animal sacrifice, he dedicates eleven animals to a single sacrificial post, or to eleven [posts].

sanskrit_iast: agniṃ yunajmi śavasā ghṛtena \\ iti tisṛbhiḥ prātaḥsavane 'gnim abhimṛśati //
meaning: अग्निं युनज्मि शवसा घृतेन \\ इति तिसृभिः प्रातःसवने ऽग्निम् अभिमृशति //
text_mt: With the three [verses beginning with] "I harness the fire with power, with clarified butter...", he touches the fire at the morning pressing.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇākāle hiraṇyapātraṃ madhoḥ pūrṇaṃ śatamānasya kṛtam \\ citraṃ devānām ity avekṣya madhyaṃdine 'śvenāvaghrāpya brahmaṇe dadāti //
meaning: दक्षिणाकाले हिरण्यपात्रं मधोः पूर्णं शतमानस्य कृतम् \\ चित्रं देवानाम् इत्य् अवेक्ष्य मध्यंदिने ऽश्वेनावघ्राप्य ब्रह्मणे ददाति //
text_mt: At the time of the priestly gifts, having looked at a golden vessel full of honey, made of a hundred mānas, with "The wonderful [face] of the gods..." and having made a horse smell it, he gives it to the brahman priest at midday.

sanskrit_iast: adhvaryave kalpāṇīr dakṣiṇā dadyāt //
meaning: अध्वर्यवे कल्पाणीर् दक्षिणा दद्यात् //
text_mt: He should give proper priestly gifts to the adhvaryu.

sanskrit_iast: yad asyānyāś cinuyād yat taṃ dakṣiṇābhir na rādhayed agnim asya vṛñjīta //
meaning: यद् अस्यान्याश् चिनुयाद् यत् तं दक्षिणाभिर् न राधयेद् अग्निम् अस्य वृञ्जीत //
text_mt: If another should pile the fire for him, [or] if he should not gratify him with priestly gifts, the fire would take away [his fortune].

sanskrit_iast: upākṛte yajñāyajñīyasya stotra ekayā prastuta ekasyāṃ vā gītāyām \\ samudre te hṛdayam iti dvābhyām agnim abhimṛśati //
meaning: उपाकृते यज्ञायज्ञीयस्य स्तोत्र एकया प्रस्तुत एकस्यां वा गीतायाम् \\ समुद्रे ते हृदयम् इति द्वाभ्याम् अग्निम् अभिमृशति //
text_mt: When the stotra of the Yajñāyajñīya [sāman] has been brought near, when one verse is being chanted as the prelude or when one has been sung, he touches the fire with the two verses: "Thy heart is in the sea..."

sanskrit_iast: hāriyojanena carite \\ imam̐ stanam ūrjasvantaṃ dhayāpām ity agnivimocanīyām ekāhutiṃ juhoti / vi te muñcāmi \\ iti vā //
meaning: हारियोजनेन चरिते \\ इमम्̐ स्तनम् ऊर्जस्वन्तं धयापाम् इत्य् अग्निविमोचनीयाम् एकाहुतिं जुहोति / वि ते मुञ्चामि \\ इति वा //
text_mt: When the hāriyojana cup has been dealt with, he offers a single oblation for unyoking the fire with "Suck this vigorous breast of the waters..." or with "I unyoke thee..."

sanskrit_iast: ekādaśa samiṣṭayajūm̐ṣi juhoti //
meaning: एकादश समिष्टयजूम्̐षि जुहोति //
text_mt: He offers eleven concluding oblations.

sanskrit_iast: navādhvarikāṇi hutvā --- iṣṭo agnir āhutaḥ svāhā kṛtaḥ pipartu naḥ / \ iṣṭam̐ haviḥ svāhedaṃ namas \\ iti daśamaikādaśe juhoti //
meaning: नवाध्वरिकाणि हुत्वा --- इष्टो अग्निर् आहुतः स्वाहा कृतः पिपर्तु नः / \ इष्टम्̐ हविः स्वाहेदं नमस् \\ इति दशमैकादशे जुहोति //
text_mt: Having offered nine belonging to the Soma rite, he offers the tenth and the eleventh with "May Agni, sacrificed to, offered to, greeted with svāhā, bring us safely across; / the oblation is sacrificed, svāhā! This homage!"

sanskrit_iast: anūbandhyāvapāyām̐ hutāyām \\ yad ākūtāt samasusrot \\ ity etenānuvākena pratimantram ākūtīr juhoti //
meaning: अनूबन्ध्यावपायाम्̐ हुतायाम् \\ यद् आकूतात् समसुस्रोत् \\ इत्य् एतेनानुवाकेन प्रतिमन्त्रम् आकूतीर् जुहोति //
text_mt: When the omentum of the concluding animal sacrifice has been offered, he offers intention-oblations with each mantra of the section beginning with "What flowed together from intention..."

sanskrit_iast: āpaṃ tvāgne manasā \\ iti prayārayann āptībhir agnim upaniṣṭhate //
meaning: आपं त्वाग्ने मनसा \\ इति प्रयारयन्न् आप्तीभिर् अग्निम् उपनिष्ठते //
text_mt: Advancing, he attends upon the fire with the attainment verses beginning with "I have reached thee, o Agni, with my mind..."

sanskrit_iast: ye 'gnayaḥ purīṣyās \\ iti yatra svīyam agniṃ paśyati tam upatiṣṭhate //
meaning: ये ऽग्नयः पुरीष्यास् \\ इति यत्र स्वीयम् अग्निं पश्यति तम् उपतिष्ठते //
text_mt: Wherever he sees his own fire, he attends upon it with "The fires that are in the loose soil..."

sanskrit_iast: upa tvāgne divedive \\ iti tisṛbhir anyeṣām agnīn dṛṣṭvā //
meaning: उप त्वाग्ने दिवेदिवे \\ इति तिसृभिर् अन्येषाम् अग्नीन् दृष्ट्वा //
text_mt: Having seen the fires of others, [he attends upon them] with the three verses beginning with "Unto thee, o Agni, day by day..."

sanskrit_iast: agniṃ citvā sautrāmaṇyā yajeta / maitrāvaruṇyā cāmikṣayā //
meaning: अग्निं चित्वा सौत्रामण्या यजेत / मैत्रावरुण्या चामिक्षया //
text_mt: Having piled the fire, he should sacrifice with the Sautrāmaṇī and with a clotted-curd offering to Mitra and Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast: agniṃ citvā saṃvatsaraṃ na kaṃcana pratyavarohen na pakṣiṇo 'śnīyāt //
meaning: अग्निं चित्वा संवत्सरं न कंचन प्रत्यवरोहेन् न पक्षिणो ऽश्नीयात् //
text_mt: Having piled the fire, he should not descend [to the level of] anyone for a year; he should not eat birds.

sanskrit_iast: yāvajjīvaṃ varṣati na dhāven na rāmām upeyān na dvitīyaṃ citvānyasya striyam upeyāt //
meaning: यावज्जीवं वर्षति न धावेन् न रामाम् उपेयान् न द्वितीयं चित्वान्यस्य स्त्रियम् उपेयात् //
text_mt: As long as he lives, he should not run while it rains; he should not approach a low-caste woman; having piled [the fire] a second time, he should not approach the woman of another.

sanskrit_iast: na tṛtīyaṃ citvā kāṃcanopeyād bhāryāṃ vopeyāt //
meaning: न तृतीयं चित्वा कांचनोपेयाद् भार्यां वोपेयात् //
text_mt: Having piled [the fire] a third time, he should not approach any woman, or he may approach his own wife.

sanskrit_iast: agniṃ citvā ya etasmin saṃvatsare na viroceta / sa kratum ārabhamāṇa ekacitīkam agniṃ cinvīta //
meaning: अग्निं चित्वा य एतस्मिन् संवत्सरे न विरोचेत / स क्रतुम् आरभमाण एकचितीकम् अग्निं चिन्वीत //
text_mt: Having piled the fire, one who does not become distinguished in this [subsequent] year, he, undertaking a sacrifice, should pile a fire of one layer.

sanskrit_iast: salilāya tvā \ sarṇīkāya tvā \\ ity aṣṭau nānāmantrāḥ //
meaning: सलिलाय त्वा \ सर्णीकाय त्वा \\ इत्य् अष्टौ नानामन्त्राः //
text_mt: "To the water, thee;" "To the moving, thee"—these are eight distinct mantras.

sanskrit_iast: yathārthaṃ lokaṃpṛṇāḥ / atha purīṣam //
meaning: यथार्थं लोकंपृणाः / अथ पुरीषम् //
text_mt: [He places] space-filling bricks according to need; then loose soil.

sanskrit_iast: agniṃ citvā ya etasmin saṃvatsare na pratiṣṭhet sa kratum ārabhamāṇa ekacitīkam agniṃ cinvīta saṃyac ca pracetāś ca \\ iti pañca nānāmantrāḥ / yathārthaṃ lokaṃpṛṇāḥ / atha purīṣam //
meaning: अग्निं चित्वा य एतस्मिन् संवत्सरे न प्रतिष्ठेत् स क्रतुम् आरभमाण एकचितीकम् अग्निं चिन्वीत संयच् च प्रचेताश् च \\ इति पञ्च नानामन्त्राः / यथार्थं लोकंपृणाः / अथ पुरीषम् //
text_mt: Having piled the fire, one who is not established in this year, he, undertaking a sacrifice, should pile a fire of one layer; "The restraining one and the wise one"—these are five distinct mantras; [he places] space-filling bricks according to need; then loose soil.

sanskrit_iast: punaścitiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ / sā triṣv artheṣu śrūyate śravaṇārthe vā samṛddhyarthe vā saṃtānārthe vā //
meaning: पुनश्चितिं व्याख्यास्यामः / सा त्रिष्व् अर्थेषु श्रूयते श्रवणार्थे वा समृद्ध्यर्थे वा संतानार्थे वा //
text_mt: We shall explain the repiling; it is prescribed for three purposes: for renown, or for prosperity, or for continuity [of lineage].

sanskrit_iast: śravaṇārthāṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ / yadīṣṭyā yadi paśunā yadi somena yajeta //
meaning: श्रवणार्थां व्याख्यास्यामः / यदीष्ट्या यदि पशुना यदि सोमेन यजेत //
text_mt: We shall explain that for the purpose of renown: whether he sacrifices with an iṣṭi, or with an animal sacrifice, or with Soma.

sanskrit_iast: yatraivāsya pūrvo 'gniś citaḥ syāt tad aparam anvavasāya yajeta //
meaning: यत्रैवास्य पूर्वो ऽग्निश् चितः स्यात् तद् अपरम् अन्ववसाय यजेत //
text_mt: Right where his former fire had been piled, there, moving down to the subsequent [spot], he should sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: apivā yenarṣayas \\ ity aṣṭau nānāmantrā aṣṭau ca lokaṃpṛṇāḥ / atha purīṣam //
meaning: अपिवा येनर्षयस् \\ इत्य् अष्टौ नानामन्त्रा अष्टौ च लोकंपृणाः / अथ पुरीषम् //
text_mt: Or with "Where the ṛṣis..."—these are eight distinct mantras, and eight space-filling bricks; then loose soil.

sanskrit_iast: śvo bhūte 'ṣṭau nānāmantrā ekādaśa lokaṃpṛṇāḥ / atha purīṣam / śvo bhūte etā nānāmantrā dvādaśa ca lokaṃpṛṇāḥ / atha purīṣam / atha samṛddhyarthāṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ / agniṃ citvā ya etasmin saṃvatsare nardhnoti / sa kratum ārabhamāṇas tricitīkam agniṃ cinvīta / salilāya tvā \ sarṇīkāya tvā \\ ity aṣṭau nānāmantrā ekādaśa ca lokaṃpṛṇāḥ / atha purīṣam / śvo bhūta etāś ca nānāmantrā dvādaśa ca lokaṃpṛṇāḥ / atha purīṣam / śvo bhūta etāś ca nānāmantrās trayodaśa ca lokaṃpṛṇāḥ / atha purīṣam / saṃtānārthāyāṃ tu tṛtīyam agniṃ cinvānas tṛtīyasyāṃ citau yenarṣayas \\ ity aṣṭau ca nānāmantrā aparimitāś ca lokaṃpṛṇāḥ / atha purīṣam //
meaning: श्वो भूते ऽष्टौ नानामन्त्रा एकादश लोकंपृणाः / अथ पुरीषम् / श्वो भूते एता नानामन्त्रा द्वादश च लोकंपृणाः / अथ पुरीषम् / अथ समृद्ध्यर्थां व्याख्यास्यामः / अग्निं चित्वा य एतस्मिन् संवत्सरे नर्ध्नोति / स क्रतुम् आरभमाणस् त्रिचितीकम् अग्निं चिन्वीत / सलिलाय त्वा \ सर्णीकाय त्वा \\ इत्य् अष्टौ नानामन्त्रा एकादश च लोकंपृणाः / अथ पुरीषम् / श्वो भूत एताश् च नानामन्त्रा द्वादश च लोकंपृणाः / अथ पुरीषम् / श्वो भूत एताश् च नानामन्त्रास् त्रयोदश च लोकंपृणाः / अथ पुरीषम् / संतानार्थायां तु तृतीयम् अग्निं चिन्वानस् तृतीयस्यां चितौ येनर्षयस् \\ इत्य् अष्टौ च नानामन्त्रा अपरिमिताश् च लोकंपृणाः / अथ पुरीषम् //
text_mt: On the next day, eight distinct mantras and eleven space-filling bricks; then loose soil. On the next day, these distinct mantras and twelve space-filling bricks; then loose soil. Now we shall explain that for the purpose of prosperity: having piled the fire, one who does not prosper in this year, he, undertaking a sacrifice, should pile a fire of three layers; "To the water, thee;" "To the moving, thee"—these are eight distinct mantras and eleven space-filling bricks; then loose soil. On the next day, these distinct mantras and twelve space-filling bricks; then loose soil. On the next day, these distinct mantras and thirteen space-filling bricks; then loose soil. But in the case of that for the purpose of continuity, piling the fire for the third time, in the third layer there are eight distinct mantras beginning with "Where the ṛṣis..." and an unlimited number of space-filling bricks; then loose soil.

sanskrit_iast: kāmyān agnīn vyākhyāsyāmaḥ / teṣām ākṛtivikārā brāhmaṇavyakhyātāḥ //
meaning: काम्यान् अग्नीन् व्याख्यास्यामः / तेषाम् आकृतिविकारा ब्राह्मणव्यख्याताः //
text_mt: We shall explain the optional fires; their modifications of form are explained by the Brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: arthasaṃyogaś cāniyamaś ca tatprayoge chandaścitaṃ cinvīta paśukāma iti / yāni prakṛtau chandām̐si tair agniṃ cinvīta / aṣṭau gāyatrīḥ / mūrdhanvatīḥ purastād upadadhāti //
meaning: अर्थसंयोगश् चानियमश् च तत्प्रयोगे छन्दश्चितं चिन्वीत पशुकाम इति / यानि प्रकृतौ छन्दाम्̐सि तैर् अग्निं चिन्वीत / अष्टौ गायत्रीः / मूर्धन्वतीः पुरस्ताद् उपदधाति //
text_mt: There is both employment of purpose and absence of fixed rule in their practice. "One desiring cattle should pile the metre-pile fire"—he should pile the fire with those metres that are in the archetype; he lays down eight gāyatrī [bricks] bearing heads in the front.

sanskrit_iast: śyenacitaṃ cinvīta suvargakāma iti / vakrapakṣo vyastapucchaḥ śyenākṛtir bhavati //
meaning: श्येनचितं चिन्वीत सुवर्गकाम इति / वक्रपक्षो व्यस्तपुच्छः श्येनाकृतिर् भवति //
text_mt: "One desiring heaven should pile the falcon-pile fire"—it has bent wings and an outspread tail, having the shape of a falcon.

sanskrit_iast: kaṅkacitaṃ cinvīta yaḥ kāmayeta śīrṣanvān amuṣmim̐l loke syām iti / kaṅkākṛtir nirāyatagrīvaḥ śīrṣaṇvān bhavati //
meaning: कङ्कचितं चिन्वीत यः कामयेत शीर्षन्वान् अमुष्मिम्̐ल् लोके स्याम् इति / कङ्काकृतिर् निरायतग्रीवः शीर्षण्वान् भवति //
text_mt: "One who desires 'May I have a head in yonder world' should pile the heron-pile fire"—it has the shape of a heron, with an outstretched neck, possessing a head.

sanskrit_iast: alajacitaṃ cinvīta catuḥsītaṃ pratiṣṭhākāma iti catasraścatasraḥ sītāḥ sam̐hitāḥ kṛṣati //
meaning: अलजचितं चिन्वीत चतुःसीतं प्रतिष्ठाकाम इति चतस्रश्चतस्रः सीताः सम्̐हिताः कृषति //
text_mt: "One desiring a firm standing should pile the alaja-bird-pile fire with four furrows"—he plows sets of four furrows joined together.

sanskrit_iast: praugacitaṃ cinvīta bhrātṛvyavān iti śakaṭākṛtir bhavati //
meaning: प्रौगचितं चिन्वीत भ्रातृव्यवान् इति शकटाकृतिर् भवति //
text_mt: "One having a rival should pile the forepart-of-a-chariot-pile fire"—it has the shape of a cart.

sanskrit_iast: ubhayataḥpraugaṃ cinvīta yaḥ kāmayeta pra jātān bhrātṛvyān nudeya pratijaniṣyamāṇān ity ubhayataḥ śakaṭākṛtir bhavati / yathāvimukhe śakaṭe //
meaning: उभयतःप्रौगं चिन्वीत यः कामयेत प्र जातान् भ्रातृव्यान् नुदेय प्रतिजनिष्यमाणान् इत्य् उभयतः शकटाकृतिर् भवति / यथाविमुखे शकटे //
text_mt: "One who desires 'May I drive away rivals already born and those yet to be born' should pile the fire having a chariot forepart on both sides"—it has the shape of a cart on both sides, like two carts unyoked face-to-face.

sanskrit_iast: rathacakracitaṃ cinvīta bhrātṛvyavān iti parimaṇḍalo bhavati //
meaning: रथचक्रचितं चिन्वीत भ्रातृव्यवान् इति परिमण्डलो भवति //
text_mt: "One having a rival should pile the chariot-wheel-pile fire"—it is circular.

sanskrit_iast: droṇacitaṃ cinvītānnakāma iti dvayāni tu khalu droṇāni caturaśrāṇi parimaṇḍalāni ca tatra yāthākāmī //
meaning: द्रोणचितं चिन्वीतान्नकाम इति द्वयानि तु खलु द्रोणानि चतुरश्राणि परिमण्डलानि च तत्र याथाकामी //
text_mt: "One desiring food should pile the trough-pile fire"—troughs, however, are of two kinds: square and circular; in this matter there is free choice.

sanskrit_iast: paścātsvarur bhavaty anurūpatvāyeti //
meaning: पश्चात्स्वरुर् भवत्य् अनुरूपत्वायेति //
text_mt: "There is a handle at the rear for the sake of correspondence."

sanskrit_iast: samūhyaṃ cinvīta paśukāma iti samūhanniveṣṭakā upadadhāti //
meaning: समूह्यं चिन्वीत पशुकाम इति समूहन्निवेष्टका उपदधाति //
text_mt: "One desiring cattle should pile the gathered-together-pile fire"—he lays down the bricks as if gathering them together.

sanskrit_iast: dikṣu cātvālāt khātvā tebhyaḥ purīṣam abhyūhatīty ekeṣām //
meaning: दिक्षु चात्वालात् खात्वा तेभ्यः पुरीषम् अभ्यूहतीत्य् एकेषाम् //
text_mt: According to some, having dug from the pit in the cardinal directions, he heaps up loose earth for them.

sanskrit_iast: paricāyyaṃ cinvīta grāmakāma iti madhyamām̐ svayamātṛṇṇāṃ pradakṣiṇam iṣṭakāgaṇaiḥ paricinoti //
meaning: परिचाय्यं चिन्वीत ग्रामकाम इति मध्यमाम्̐ स्वयमातृण्णां प्रदक्षिणम् इष्टकागणैः परिचिनोति //
text_mt: With 'One desiring a village should pile the circular altar', he piles [bricks] all around the central naturally perforated brick in a sunwise direction with troops of bricks.

sanskrit_iast: saparicāyyopacāyyaṃ cinvīta grāmakāma iti paricāyyenoktaḥ //
meaning: सपरिचाय्योपचाय्यं चिन्वीत ग्रामकाम इति परिचाय्येनोक्तः //
text_mt: With 'One desiring a village should pile the altar with the outer pile and inner pile', it is explained by the circular altar.

sanskrit_iast: śmaśānacitaṃ cinvīta yaḥ kāmayeta pitṛloka ṛdhnuyām iti caturaśraḥ parimaṇḍalo vā / yathā mahāpaitṛkī vedir ity ekeṣām / tryaśrir ity ekeṣām //
meaning: श्मशानचितं चिन्वीत यः कामयेत पितृलोक ऋध्नुयाम् इति चतुरश्रः परिमण्डलो वा / यथा महापैतृकी वेदिर् इत्य् एकेषाम् / त्र्यश्रिर् इत्य् एकेषाम् //
text_mt: 'One who desires, "May I prosper in the world of the fathers", should pile the funeral-monument altar': it is square or circular; according to some, like the great ancestral vedi; according to some, triangular.

sanskrit_iast: tāpaścitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ //
meaning: तापश्चितं व्याख्यास्यामः //
text_mt: We shall explain the Tāpaścita rite.

sanskrit_iast: saṃvatsaraṃ dīkṣito bhavati //
meaning: संवत्सरं दीक्षितो भवति //
text_mt: He remains consecrated for a year.

sanskrit_iast: saṃvatsare paryāgate rājānaṃ krīṇāti //
meaning: संवत्सरे पर्यागते राजानं क्रीणाति //
text_mt: When the year has revolved, he purchases the King [Soma].

sanskrit_iast: purastād upasadām āgneyam aṣṭākapālaṃ nirvaped aindram ekādaśakapālaṃ vaiśvadevaṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ bārhaspatyaṃ caruṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ trikapālaṃ saṃvatsaram upasado 'nupasadam agniṃ cinoti //
meaning: पुरस्ताद् उपसदाम् आग्नेयम् अष्टाकपालं निर्वपेद् ऐन्द्रम् एकादशकपालं वैश्वदेवं द्वादशकपालं बार्हस्पत्यं चरुं वैष्णवं त्रिकपालं संवत्सरम् उपसदो ऽनुपसदम् अग्निं चिनोति //
text_mt: Before the Upasads, he should apportion an eight-potsherd cake to Agni, an eleven-potsherd cake to Indra, a twelve-potsherd cake to the All-gods, a cooked grain offering to Bṛhaspati, and a three-potsherd cake to Viṣṇu; for a year there are Upasads, and in accordance with each Upasad he piles the fire altar.

sanskrit_iast: dvaudvau māsāv ekaikā citiś catura uttamā trīn māsām̐ś catustanāni vratāni bhavanti / evaṃ tristanāni dvistanāni ekastanāni //
meaning: द्वौद्वौ मासाव् एकैका चितिश् चतुर उत्तमा त्रीन् मासाम्̐श् चतुस्तनानि व्रतानि भवन्ति / एवं त्रिस्तनानि द्विस्तनानि एकस्तनानि //
text_mt: Every two months there is one layer; the final one is four [months] or three months; the milk observances consist of [milk from] four teats; likewise [gradually reduced to milk from] three teats, two teats, and one teat.

sanskrit_iast: yad ṛṣīṇām āgneyaṃ sūktaṃ tena saṃvatsaraṃ cinvīta //
meaning: यद् ऋषीणाम् आग्नेयं सूक्तं तेन संवत्सरं चिन्वीत //
text_mt: With whatever hymn belongs to the Ṛṣis and is addressed to Agni, with that he should pile [the fire altar] for a year.

sanskrit_iast: yāni daśatayīṣv āgneyāni sūktāni teṣām ekaikena sūktenaikaikām iṣṭakām upadadhāti //
meaning: यानि दशतयीष्व् आग्नेयानि सूक्तानि तेषाम् एकैकेन सूक्तेनैकैकाम् इष्टकाम् उपदधाति //
text_mt: Whatever hymns to Agni there are in the Ten Books [of the Ṛgveda], with each single hymn of those he lays down each single brick.

sanskrit_iast: sūktaparimāṇā nānāmantrāḥ / yathārthaṃ lokaṃpṛṇāḥ //
meaning: सूक्तपरिमाणा नानामन्त्राः / यथार्थं लोकंपृणाः //
text_mt: The [bricks] are measured by hymns, with various mantras; the lokaṃpṛṇā bricks according to need.

sanskrit_iast: āvṛttāsūpasatsu tṛtīye saṃvatsare 'bhijitā viśvajitā vā yajeta / sahasradakṣiṇāḥ sarvavedasaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ / parivāsaṃ parivāsam //
meaning: आवृत्तासूपसत्सु तृतीये संवत्सरे ऽभिजिता विश्वजिता वा यजेत / सहस्रदक्षिणाः सर्ववेदसं व्याख्यास्यामः / परिवासं परिवासम् //
text_mt: When the upasads have turned around [and repeated], in the third year one should sacrifice with the Abhijit or the Viśvajit. We shall explain the thousandfold dakṣiṇā and the sacrifice of all one's possessions, year after year.

sanskrit_iast: śaradi vājapeyena yajeta //
meaning: शरदि वाजपेयेन यजेत //
text_mt: In autumn one should sacrifice with the Vājapeya.

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇo rājanyo vā //
meaning: ब्राह्मणो राजन्यो वा //

sanskrit_iast: tasya ṣoḍaśinā kalpo vyākhyātaḥ //
meaning: तस्य षोडशिना कल्पो व्याख्यातः //
text_mt: Its ritual procedure is explained by [that of] the Ṣoḍaśin.

sanskrit_iast: saptadaśaḥ sarvo bhavati //
meaning: सप्तदशः सर्वो भवति //
text_mt: Everything becomes seventeenfold.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatim āpnoti //
meaning: प्रजापतिम् आप्नोति //

sanskrit_iast: saptadaśa dīkṣāḥ / tisra upasadaḥ / ekaviṃśatiṃ prasutaḥ //
meaning: सप्तदश दीक्षाः / तिस्र उपसदः / एकविंशतिं प्रसुतः //
text_mt: There are seventeen consecrations, three upasads, and twenty-one pressing days.

sanskrit_iast: saptadaśāratnir yūpo bailvaś caturaśraḥ khādiraḥ pālāśo vā godhūmapiṣṭacaṣālo 'pi vā tūparaḥ //
meaning: सप्तदशारत्निर् यूपो बैल्वश् चतुरश्रः खादिरः पालाशो वा गोधूमपिष्टचषालो ऽपि वा तूपरः //
text_mt: The sacrificial post is seventeen cubits long, made of bilva wood, four-cornered, or made of khādira or palāśa wood, with a top-ring of wheat dough, or even without a top-ring.

sanskrit_iast: yat prāg upasadbhyas tasmin kṛte pratiprasthātā surāyāḥ kalpena parisrutam̐ surām̐ saṃdadhāti //
meaning: यत् प्राग् उपसद्भ्यस् तस्मिन् कृते प्रतिप्रस्थाता सुरायाः कल्पेन परिस्रुतम्̐ सुराम्̐ संदधाति //
text_mt: When that which precedes the upasads has been performed, the pratiprasthātā brews the parisrut-liquor and the surā according to the procedure for surā.

sanskrit_iast: raśanākāle saptadaśabhir vāsobhir yūpaṃ pariveṣṭayati //
meaning: रशनाकाले सप्तदशभिर् वासोभिर् यूपं परिवेष्टयति //
text_mt: At the time of [girding with] the rope, he wraps the sacrificial post with seventeen garments.

sanskrit_iast: agnīṣomīyasya paśupuroḍāśaṃ nirupya devasuvām̐ havīm̐ṣy anunirvapati agnaye gṛhapataye \\ iti yathāsamāmnātam / paśupuroḍāśasya devasuvāṃ ca haviṣām̐ samānam̐ sviṣṭakṛdiḍam //
meaning: अग्नीषोमीयस्य पशुपुरोडाशं निरुप्य देवसुवाम्̐ हवीम्̐ष्य् अनुनिर्वपति अग्नये गृहपतये \\ इति यथासमाम्नातम् / पशुपुरोडाशस्य देवसुवां च हविषाम्̐ समानम्̐ स्विष्टकृदिडम् //
text_mt: Having apportioned the animal-cake for Agni-and-Soma, he subsequently apportions the oblations to the Devasū deities with 'To Agni Gṛhapati…', as handed down in the traditional text. The Sviṣṭakṛt and iḍā are common to the animal-cake and the oblations to the Devasū deities.

sanskrit_iast: deva savitaḥ prasuva yajñaṃ prasuva yajñapatiṃ bhagāya \\ iti savanādau savādau juhoti //
meaning: देव सवितः प्रसुव यज्ञं प्रसुव यज्ञपतिं भगाय \\ इति सवनादौ सवादौ जुहोति //
text_mt: At the beginning of each pressing and at the beginning of each consecration, he offers with: 'O divine Savitṛ, impel the sacrifice, impel the lord of the sacrifice for good fortune…'.

sanskrit_iast: hiraṇyamālina ṛtvijaḥ sutye 'hani pracaranti //
meaning: हिरण्यमालिन ऋत्विजः सुत्ये ऽहनि प्रचरन्ति //
text_mt: On the soma-pressing day, the officiating priests proceed wearing golden garlands.

sanskrit_iast: pātrasam̐sādanakāle yathārthaṃ pātrāṇi prayunakti / aindrasyātigrāhyapātrasya sthāne pañcaindrāṇy atigrāhyapātrāṇi prayunakti //
meaning: पात्रसम्̐सादनकाले यथार्थं पात्राणि प्रयुनक्ति / ऐन्द्रस्यातिग्राह्यपात्रस्य स्थाने पञ्चैन्द्राण्य् अतिग्राह्यपात्राणि प्रयुनक्ति //
text_mt: At the time of arranging the vessels, he arranges the vessels according to need. In place of the vessel for the atigrāhya-draught to Indra, he arranges five vessels for the atigrāhya-draughts to Indra.

sanskrit_iast: teṣām aindreṇātigrāhyapātreṇa kalpo vyākhyātaḥ //
meaning: तेषाम् ऐन्द्रेणातिग्राह्यपात्रेण कल्पो व्याख्यातः //
text_mt: Their ritual procedure is explained by [that of] the vessel for the atigrāhya-draught to Indra.

sanskrit_iast: ṣoḍaśipātraṃ prayujya saptadaśa prājāpatyāni somagrahapātrāṇi prayunakti //
meaning: षोडशिपात्रं प्रयुज्य सप्तदश प्राजापत्यानि सोमग्रहपात्राणि प्रयुनक्ति //
text_mt: Having arranged the Ṣoḍaśin vessel, he arranges seventeen vessels for the soma draughts dedicated to Prajāpati.

sanskrit_iast: teṣām̐ ṣoḍaśipātreṇa kalpo vyākhyātaḥ / paścādakṣaṃ pratiprasthātopayāmāni saptadaśa surāgrahapātrāṇi kratukaraṇo yathātirātre somagrahakāle \\ upayāmagṛhīto 'si \ nṛṣadaṃ tvā \\ iti pañcabhir aindrasyātigrāhyasya sthāne pañcaindrān atigrāhyān gṛhṇīyāt //
meaning: तेषाम्̐ षोडशिपात्रेण कल्पो व्याख्यातः / पश्चादक्षं प्रतिप्रस्थातोपयामानि सप्तदश सुराग्रहपात्राणि क्रतुकरणो यथातिरात्रे सोमग्रहकाले \\ उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \ नृषदं त्वा \\ इति पञ्चभिर् ऐन्द्रस्यातिग्राह्यस्य स्थाने पञ्चैन्द्रान् अतिग्राह्यान् गृह्णीयात् //
text_mt: Their ritual procedure is explained by [that of] the Ṣoḍaśin vessel. Behind the axle, the pratiprasthātā [arranges] seventeen vessels for the surā draughts with their supporting ladles. Just as at the Atirātra, at the time of the soma draughts which establish the sacrifice, he should draw five atigrāhya-draughts to Indra in place of the single atigrāhya-draught to Indra with the five [formulas beginning]: 'Thou art drawn with a support…', 'Thee, dwelling among men…'.

sanskrit_iast: teṣām aindreṇātigrāhyeṇa kalpo vyākhyātaḥ / ṣoḍaśinaṃ gṛhītvā saptadaśa prājāpatyān somagrahān gṛhṇāti //
meaning: तेषाम् ऐन्द्रेणातिग्राह्येण कल्पो व्याख्यातः / षोडशिनं गृहीत्वा सप्तदश प्राजापत्यान् सोमग्रहान् गृह्णाति //
text_mt: Their ritual procedure is explained by [that of] the atigrāhya-draught to Indra. Having drawn the Ṣoḍaśin, he draws seventeen soma draughts dedicated to Prajāpati.

sanskrit_iast: teṣām̐ ṣoḍaśinā kalpo vyākhyātaḥ / kuvid aṅga \\ iti sarveṣām ekā puroruk \\ ayā viṣṭhā janayan karvarāṇi \\ iti / upayāmaiḥ pratiprasthātā saptadaśa surāgrahān / viparīte grahaṇyāv eke samāmananti //
meaning: तेषाम्̐ षोडशिना कल्पो व्याख्यातः / कुविद् अङ्ग \\ इति सर्वेषाम् एका पुरोरुक् \\ अया विष्ठा जनयन् कर्वराणि \\ इति / उपयामैः प्रतिप्रस्थाता सप्तदश सुराग्रहान् / विपरीते ग्रहण्याव् एके समामनन्ति //
text_mt: Their ritual procedure is explained by [that of] the Ṣoḍaśin. For all of them there is a single introductory verse: 'Will indeed [Indra]…', [and the verse] 'Generating these varied forms in diverse locations…'. With the supporting ladles, the pratiprasthātā [draws] seventeen surā draughts. Some authorities hand down that the drawing ladles are reversed.

sanskrit_iast: vyatiṣaṅgaṃ gṛhṇītaḥ pūrvo 'dhvaryur aparaḥ pratiprasthātā / purokṣam̐ somagrahān sādayati / paścādakṣam̐ surāgrahān //
meaning: व्यतिषङ्गं गृह्णीतः पूर्वो ऽध्वर्युर् अपरः प्रतिप्रस्थाता / पुरोक्षम्̐ सोमग्रहान् सादयति / पश्चादक्षम्̐ सुराग्रहान् //
text_mt: They draw alternately: the adhvaryu first, the pratiprasthātā second. He sets down the soma draughts in front of the axle; the surā draughts behind the axle.

sanskrit_iast: paśukāle trīn kratupaśūn upākaroti / mārutīṃ pṛśniṃ vaśām upākaroti / sārasvatīm ca / meṣīm apannadatīm / meṣam ity ekeṣām / sārasvatīṃ ca meṣam //
meaning: पशुकाले त्रीन् क्रतुपशून् उपाकरोति / मारुतीं पृश्निं वशाम् उपाकरोति / सारस्वतीम् च / मेषीम् अपन्नदतीम् / मेषम् इत्य् एकेषाम् / सारस्वतीं च मेषम् //
text_mt: At the time of the animal sacrifice, he brings up three rite-animals: he brings up a dappled barren cow to the Maruts, and a [victim] to Sarasvatī, a female sheep that has not lost her teeth—a ram according to some—and a ram to Sarasvant.

sanskrit_iast: saptadaśa prājāpatyān paśūn upākaroti //
meaning: सप्तदश प्राजापत्यान् पशून् उपाकरोति //
text_mt: He brings up seventeen animals dedicated to Prajāpati.

sanskrit_iast: śyāmās tūparā ekarūpā iva bhavanti //
meaning: श्यामास् तूपरा एकरूपा इव भवन्ति //
text_mt: They are dark, hornless, and of uniform appearance.

sanskrit_iast: paryagnikṛtānām̐ sārasvatyantān pūrvān ālabhante / sārasvataprabhṛtīn uttarān dhārayanti //
meaning: पर्यग्निकृतानाम्̐ सारस्वत्यन्तान् पूर्वान् आलभन्ते / सारस्वतप्रभृतीन् उत्तरान् धारयन्ति //
text_mt: Of those around which fire has been carried, they seize the earlier ones ending with the one to Sarasvatī; they hold back the later ones beginning with that to Sarasvant.

sanskrit_iast: sarveṣāṃ pratipaśu barhīm̐ṣi vapāśrapaṇyaḥ kumbhyo hṛdayaśūlāḥ plakṣaśākhāś ca tantram agner haraṇam adhrigur uttamaprayājas tathā pūrvaḥ parivapyo 'tantaḥ saṃjñaptahomo raśanām udasanam uttaraḥ parivapyaḥ / vapāśrapaṇīnām anu praharaṇam abhihomo mārjanaṃ varadānaṃ ca //
meaning: सर्वेषां प्रतिपशु बर्हीम्̐षि वपाश्रपण्यः कुम्भ्यो हृदयशूलाः प्लक्षशाखाश् च तन्त्रम् अग्नेर् हरणम् अध्रिगुर् उत्तमप्रयाजस् तथा पूर्वः परिवप्यो ऽतन्तः संज्ञप्तहोमो रशनाम् उदसनम् उत्तरः परिवप्यः / वपाश्रपणीनाम् अनु प्रहरणम् अभिहोमो मार्जनं वरदानं च //
text_mt: For all of them, for each animal, there are sacrificial grass, omentum-cooking forks, cooking pots, heart-spits, and branches of the plakṣa tree; common to all are the carrying of the fire, the Adhrigu formula, the last fore-offering, similarly the first parivapya offering without end, the offering for the quieted victim, the throwing up of the cord, the second parivapya offering, the throwing after of the omentum-cooking forks, the subsequent offering, the wiping, and the giving of a boon.

sanskrit_iast: dākṣiṇau homau hutvā / indrasya vajro 'si vārtraghnas \\ iti ratham upāvaharati //
meaning: दाक्षिणौ होमौ हुत्वा / इन्द्रस्य वज्रो ऽसि वार्त्रघ्नस् \\ इति रथम् उपावहरति //
text_mt: Having offered the two offerings relating to the dakṣiṇā, he brings down the chariot with: 'Thou art the thunderbolt of Indra, the slayer of Vṛtra…'.

sanskrit_iast: apsv antar amṛtam apsu bheṣajam ity aśvān apsu snāpayanti //
meaning: अप्स्व् अन्तर् अमृतम् अप्सु भेषजम् इत्य् अश्वान् अप्सु स्नापयन्ति //
text_mt: They bathe the horses in water with: 'Within the waters is immortality, within the waters is healing…'.

sanskrit_iast: vāyur vā tvā manur vā tvā \\ iti praṣṭivāhinam̐ rathaṃ yunakti //
meaning: वायुर् वा त्वा मनुर् वा त्वा \\ इति प्रष्टिवाहिनम्̐ रथं युनक्ति //
text_mt: With: 'Either Vāyu [yokes] thee, or Manu [yokes] thee…', he yokes the chariot driven with an outrunner.

sanskrit_iast: apāṃ napād āśuheman \\ ity aśvānām̐ rarāṭāni pratisaṃmārṣṭi //
meaning: अपां नपाद् आशुहेमन् \\ इत्य् अश्वानाम्̐ रराटानि प्रतिसंमार्ष्टि //
text_mt: With: 'O Apāṃ Napāt of swift impulsion…', he wipes the foreheads of the horses.

sanskrit_iast: tūṣṇīm itarān ṣoḍaśa rathān yunakti //
meaning: तूष्णीम् इतरान् षोडश रथान् युनक्ति //
text_mt: Silently he yokes the other sixteen chariots.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇākāle saptadaśa rathān dadāti //
meaning: दक्षिणाकाले सप्तदश रथान् ददाति //
text_mt: At the time of the dakṣiṇā, he gives seventeen chariots.

sanskrit_iast: saptadaśa niṣkān saptadaśāśvān saptadaśa hastinaḥ saptadaśa gavām̐ śatāni saptadaśa goyuktāni saptadaśa yānāni saptadaśa sayanāni saptadaśa mahānasāni saptadaśa vāsām̐si saptadaś dāsān saptadaśa dāsīḥ saptadaśājāḥ saptadaśāvīrvayaso vayasam̐ saptadaśāni dadāti //
meaning: सप्तदश निष्कान् सप्तदशाश्वान् सप्तदश हस्तिनः सप्तदश गवाम्̐ शतानि सप्तदश गोयुक्तानि सप्तदश यानानि सप्तदश सयनानि सप्तदश महानसानि सप्तदश वासाम्̐सि सप्तदश् दासान् सप्तदश दासीः सप्तदशाजाः सप्तदशावीर्वयसो वयसम्̐ सप्तदशानि ददाति //
text_mt: He gives seventeen niṣkas, seventeen horses, seventeen elephants, seventeen hundred cattle, seventeen ox-teams, seventeen carriages, seventeen couches, seventeen wagons, seventeen garments, seventeen male slaves, seventeen female slaves, seventeen goats, and seventeen sheep, each seventeen [units] of every age.

sanskrit_iast: saptadaśam̐ saptadaśāni saṃpādayatīty ekeṣām //
meaning: सप्तदशम्̐ सप्तदशानि संपादयतीत्य् एकेषाम् //
text_mt: According to some, he accomplishes seventeen [sets] of seventeen.

sanskrit_iast: anudiṣṭāsu dakṣiṇāsu yajuryuktam̐ ratham adhvaryave dadāti //
meaning: अनुदिष्टासु दक्षिणासु यजुर्युक्तम्̐ रथम् अध्वर्यवे ददाति //
text_mt: When the sacrificial gifts have been formally assigned, he gives the chariot yoked with the yajus to the adhvaryu.

sanskrit_iast: śeṣa sādhāraṇaḥ //
meaning: शेष साधारणः //

sanskrit_iast: agreṇāhavanīyaṃ prāñco rathān avasthāpayanti //
meaning: अग्रेणाहवनीयं प्राञ्चो रथान् अवस्थापयन्ति //
text_mt: In front of the āhavanīya fire, they halt the chariots facing east.

sanskrit_iast: yajuryuktaṃ dakṣiṇārdhyam agreṇāgnīdhram̐ rājaputro 'vasthāya saptadaśa pravyādhān iṣūn asyati prācīnam udīcīnaṃ vā //
meaning: यजुर्युक्तं दक्षिणार्ध्यम् अग्रेणाग्नीध्रम्̐ राजपुत्रो ऽवस्थाय सप्तदश प्रव्याधान् इषून् अस्यति प्राचीनम् उदीचीनं वा //
text_mt: Standing with the chariot yoked with the yajus on the southern side in front of the Āgnīdhra hall, a prince shoots arrows over seventeen bow-shots, eastward or northward.

sanskrit_iast: yatra jaghanyo nipatati tal lakṣanāṃ kurute //
meaning: यत्र जघन्यो निपतति तल् लक्षनां कुरुते //
text_mt: Where the last one falls, there he makes the goal.

sanskrit_iast: yat prāṅ māhendrāt tasmin kṛte pratiprasthātā naivāram̐ saptadaśaśarāvaṃ caturdhā vibhajya bṛhaspataye nirvapati payasi śrapayati //
meaning: यत् प्राङ् माहेन्द्रात् तस्मिन् कृते प्रतिप्रस्थाता नैवारम्̐ सप्तदशशरावं चतुर्धा विभज्य बृहस्पतये निर्वपति पयसि श्रपयति //
text_mt: When that which precedes the Māhendra cup has been performed, the pratiprasthātā, having divided a wild rice mess of seventeen cups into four portions, apportions it for Bṛhaspati and cooks it in milk.

sanskrit_iast: sarpiṣmantaṃ cātvāle 'vadadhāti //
meaning: सर्पिष्मन्तं चात्वाले ऽवदधाति //
text_mt: He places it, mixed with ghee, into the cātvāla.

sanskrit_iast: tam̐ rājaputro gopāyati //
meaning: तम्̐ राजपुत्रो गोपायति //
text_mt: The prince guards it.

sanskrit_iast: cātvāle rathākṣākṛti kāṣṭhaṃ nikhanati //
meaning: चात्वाले रथाक्षाकृति काष्ठं निखनति //
text_mt: In the cātvāla he digs in a post of the shape of a chariot axle.

sanskrit_iast: tasmin rathacakram audumbaraṃ saptadaśāraṃ pratimuñcati //
meaning: तस्मिन् रथचक्रम् औदुम्बरं सप्तदशारं प्रतिमुञ्चति //
text_mt: On it he fits an udumbara chariot wheel having seventeen spokes.

sanskrit_iast: viṣṇoḥ kramo 'si \\ iti yajuryuktam̐ ratham yajamāno 'bhyeti //
meaning: विष्णोः क्रमो ऽसि \\ इति यजुर्युक्तम्̐ रथम् यजमानो ऽभ्येति //
text_mt: With: 'Thou art the stride of Viṣṇu…', the sacrificer approaches the chariot yoked with the yajus.

sanskrit_iast: aṅkau nyaṅkau \\ iti rathacakre abhimṛśati / pakṣasī vā //
meaning: अङ्कौ न्यङ्कौ \\ इति रथचक्रे अभिमृशति / पक्षसी वा //
text_mt: With: 'The two ends, the two lower ends…', he touches the two chariot wheels, or the two sides.

sanskrit_iast: devasyāham̐ savituḥ prasave bṛhaspatinā vājajitā vājaṃ jeṣam iti / brahmaudumbaram̐ rathacakram ārohati //
meaning: देवस्याहम्̐ सवितुः प्रसवे बृहस्पतिना वाजजिता वाजं जेषम् इति / ब्रह्मौदुम्बरम्̐ रथचक्रम् आरोहति //
text_mt: With: 'At the impulse of the divine Savitṛ, with Bṛhaspati who wins the prize, may I win the prize!', the brahman priest mounts the udumbara chariot wheel.

sanskrit_iast: devasyāham̐ savituḥ prasave bṛhaspatinā vājajitā varṣiṣṭhaṃ nākam̐ ruheyam iti yajuryaktam̐ rathaṃ yajamānaḥ //
meaning: देवस्याहम्̐ सवितुः प्रसवे बृहस्पतिना वाजजिता वर्षिष्ठं नाकम्̐ रुहेयम् इति यजुर्यक्तम्̐ रथं यजमानः //
text_mt: With: 'At the impulse of the divine Savitṛ, with Bṛhaspati who wins the prize, may I mount to the highest firmament!', the sacrificer [mounts] the chariot yoked with the yajus.

sanskrit_iast: indrāya vācaṃ vadata \\ iti dundubhīn nihrādayanti //
meaning: इन्द्राय वाचं वदत \\ इति दुन्दुभीन् निह्रादयन्ति //
text_mt: With: 'Utter your voice for Indra!', they beat the drums.

sanskrit_iast: vājasṛta itarān rathān ārohanti //
meaning: वाजसृत इतरान् रथान् आरोहन्ति //
text_mt: The race-runners mount the other chariots.

sanskrit_iast: vājino vājajito vājam̐ sariṣyanta iti naivāram aśvau yujyāv avaghrāpayanti / sarvān vā //
meaning: वाजिनो वाजजितो वाजम्̐ सरिष्यन्त इति नैवारम् अश्वौ युज्याव् अवघ्रापयन्ति / सर्वान् वा //
text_mt: With: 'Ye swift ones, who win the prize, about to run for the prize…', they make the two yoked horses, or all [horses], smell the wild rice.

sanskrit_iast: praprotheṣu ca lepān nimārṣṭi viṣṇoḥ kramo 'si \\ iti yajuryuktam̐ ratham adhvaryur āruhya \\ āśvājani \\ ity aśvājanim ādāya \\ arvāsi \ saptir asi \\ ity aśvān samakṣiṇoti //
meaning: प्रप्रोथेषु च लेपान् निमार्ष्टि विष्णोः क्रमो ऽसि \\ इति यजुर्युक्तम्̐ रथम् अध्वर्युर् आरुह्य \\ आश्वाजनि \\ इत्य् अश्वाजनिम् आदाय \\ अर्वासि \ सप्तिर् असि \\ इत्य् अश्वान् समक्षिणोति //
text_mt: And he wipes the smears onto the horses' nostrils. With: 'Thou art the stride of Viṣṇu…', the adhvaryu mounts the chariot yoked with the yajus, takes the horse-whip with: 'O whip for horses…', and encourages the horses with: 'Thou art a runner…', 'Thou art a steed…'.

sanskrit_iast: paścād itare rathā anabhyāsādayanto 'nuyānti //
meaning: पश्चाद् इतरे रथा अनभ्यासादयन्तो ऽनुयान्ति //
text_mt: Behind him, the other chariots follow, not pressing too close.

sanskrit_iast: vājino vājaṃ dhāvata \\ iti tisṛbhir ādhāvato 'numantrayate / catasṛbhir ity ekeṣām //
meaning: वाजिनो वाजं धावत \\ इति तिसृभिर् आधावतो ऽनुमन्त्रयते / चतसृभिर् इत्य् एकेषाम् //
text_mt: With the three [verses beginning,] 'O steeds, run for the prize,' he follows [the chariots] as they run forward; according to some, with four.

sanskrit_iast: vājinām̐ sāma brahmaudumbare rathacakre tristriḥ parivartamāne gāyati //
meaning: वाजिनाम्̐ साम ब्रह्मौदुम्बरे रथचक्रे त्रिस्त्रिः परिवर्तमाने गायति //
text_mt: The brahman sings the Sāman of the Steeds while the chariot wheel made of udumbara wood revolves three times each.

sanskrit_iast: agnir ekākṣareṇa vācam udajayat \\ ity ujjitīr yajamānaṃ dhāvatsu vācayati //
meaning: अग्निर् एकाक्षरेण वाचम् उदजयत् \\ इत्य् उज्जितीर् यजमानं धावत्सु वाचयति //
text_mt: While they are running, he makes the sacrificer recite the ujjiti mantras [beginning,] 'Agni won speech by the single syllable.'

sanskrit_iast: lakṣaṇaṃ prāpya pradakṣiṇam āvartante //
meaning: लक्षणं प्राप्य प्रदक्षिणम् आवर्तन्ते //
text_mt: Having reached the turning post, they turn around clockwise.

sanskrit_iast: te no arvanto havanaśruto havam iti catasṛbhir ādhāvato 'numantrayate //
meaning: ते नो अर्वन्तो हवनश्रुतो हवम् इति चतसृभिर् आधावतो ऽनुमन्त्रयते //
text_mt: With the four [verses beginning,] 'May those swift coursers, hearing our invocation, [hear our] call,' he follows them as they run back.

sanskrit_iast: tisṛbhir ity ekeṣām //
meaning: तिसृभिर् इत्य् एकेषाम् //

sanskrit_iast: ā mā vājasya prasavo jagamyāt \\ iti pratyāsṛteṣu juhoti //
meaning: आ मा वाजस्य प्रसवो जगम्यात् \\ इति प्रत्यासृतेषु जुहोति //
text_mt: When they have returned, he offers with [the mantra,] 'May the impulse of the prize come to me.'

sanskrit_iast: iyaṃ vaḥ sā satyā saṃdhābhūt \\ iti dundubhivimocanīyām ekām āhutiṃ juhoti //
meaning: इयं वः सा सत्या संधाभूत् \\ इति दुन्दुभिविमोचनीयाम् एकाम् आहुतिं जुहोति //
text_mt: He offers one oblation for the release of the drums with [the mantra,] 'This true agreement of yours has taken place.'

sanskrit_iast: sarvān vopaspṛśati //
meaning: सर्वान् वोपस्पृशति //

sanskrit_iast: vājino vājajito vājam̐ sasṛvām̐sas \\ iti naivāram aśvayugyāv avaghrāpayati / yathāpurastāt praprotheṣu ca lepān nimārṣṭi //
meaning: वाजिनो वाजजितो वाजम्̐ ससृवाम्̐सस् \\ इति नैवारम् अश्वयुग्याव् अवघ्रापयति / यथापुरस्तात् प्रप्रोथेषु च लेपान् निमार्ष्टि //
text_mt: He makes the two yoked horses smell the wild-rice mess with [the mantra,] 'Prize-winning coursers, having run for the prize...'; and, as before, he wipes off the residues on their muzzles.

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṇalaṃkṛṣṇalaṃ vājasṛdbhyaḥ prayacchati //
meaning: कृष्णलंकृष्णलं वाजसृद्भ्यः प्रयच्छति //
text_mt: He gives a kṛṣṇala [gold piece] to each of the chariot-runners.

sanskrit_iast: tāni pratyādāya brahmaṇe dadāti //
meaning: तानि प्रत्यादाय ब्रह्मणे ददाति //
text_mt: Taking them back, he gives them to the brahman.

sanskrit_iast: madhoṣṭhālaṃ ca śatamānasya kṛtam //
meaning: मधोष्ठालं च शतमानस्य कृतम् //
text_mt: And the wheel-cap [or top-piece] made of honey [or mead] and worth a hundred measures.

sanskrit_iast: kṣattrasyolban asi \\ iti tārpyaṃ yajamānaḥ paridhatte / kṣattrasya yonir asi \\ iti darbhamayaṃ patnī //
meaning: क्षत्त्रस्योल्बन् असि \\ इति तार्प्यं यजमानः परिधत्ते / क्षत्त्रस्य योनिर् असि \\ इति दर्भमयं पत्नी //
text_mt: The sacrificer puts on a tārpya garment with [the mantra,] 'You are the womb of dominion'; the sacrificer's wife puts on a garment made of darbha grass with [the mantra,] 'You are the source of dominion.'

sanskrit_iast: jāya ehi suvo rohāva \\ iti patnīṃ yajamāna āmantrayate / rohāva hi \\ iti patnī pratyāha //
meaning: जाय एहि सुवो रोहाव \\ इति पत्नीं यजमान आमन्त्रयते / रोहाव हि \\ इति पत्नी प्रत्याह //
text_mt: The sacrificer invites his wife: 'Wife, come, let us ascend to heaven!' The wife responds: 'Let us indeed ascend.'

sanskrit_iast: ahaṃ nāv ubhayoḥ suvo rokṣyāmi \\ iti yajamānas tvaṃ nāv ubhyoḥ suvo roha \\ iti patnī //
meaning: अहं नाव् उभयोः सुवो रोक्ष्यामि \\ इति यजमानस् त्वं नाव् उभ्योः सुवो रोह \\ इति पत्नी //
text_mt: The sacrificer says, 'I shall ascend to heaven for both of us'; the wife says, 'Ascend to heaven for both of us.'

sanskrit_iast: āyuryajñena kalpatām iti daśabhiḥ kalpaiḥ sarajasi niḥśreṇyā yūpam ārohati / ubhau vā //
meaning: आयुर्यज्ञेन कल्पताम् इति दशभिः कल्पैः सरजसि निःश्रेण्या यूपम् आरोहति / उभौ वा //
text_mt: With the ten kalpa mantras [beginning,] 'May life-breath succeed through sacrifice,' he ascends the sacrificial post by a ladder while holding [a bag of] salt-soil; or both of them [ascend].

sanskrit_iast: suvar devām̐ aganma \\ ity āruhya japati //
meaning: सुवर् देवाम्̐ अगन्म \\ इत्य् आरुह्य जपति //
text_mt: Having ascended, he mutters, 'We have gone to heaven, to the gods.'

sanskrit_iast: vājaś ca prasavaś ca \\ iti dvādaśāhutīr juhoti //
meaning: वाजश् च प्रसवश् च \\ इति द्वादशाहुतीर् जुहोति //
text_mt: He offers twelve oblations with [the mantras beginning,] 'Both prize and impulse...'

sanskrit_iast: trayodaśety ekeṣām //
meaning: त्रयोदशेत्य् एकेषाम् //

sanskrit_iast: purastād yūpārohaṇād eke samāmananti //
meaning: पुरस्ताद् यूपारोहणाद् एके समामनन्ति //
text_mt: Some teach [that this offering takes place] before ascending the sacrificial post.

sanskrit_iast: sam aham āyuṣā saṃ mayāyuḥ \ sam ahaṃ varcasā saṃ mayā varcaḥ \ sam ahaṃ prajayā saṃ mayā prajā \ sam aham̐ rāyaspoṣeṇa saṃ mayā rāyaspoṣas \\ iti yūpam āruhya grahān pratyavekṣate //
meaning: सम् अहम् आयुषा सं मयायुः \ सम् अहं वर्चसा सं मया वर्चः \ सम् अहं प्रजया सं मया प्रजा \ सम् अहम्̐ रायस्पोषेण सं मया रायस्पोषस् \\ इति यूपम् आरुह्य ग्रहान् प्रत्यवेक्षते //
text_mt: Having mounted the sacrificial post, he looks down at the cups with [the mantras,] 'May I be united with life, may life be united with me; may I be united with vigor, may vigor be united with me; may I be united with offspring, may offspring be united with me; may I be united with the increase of wealth, may the increase of wealth be united with me.'

sanskrit_iast: tam āśvatthair ūṣapuṭair dīrghavam̐śaprabaddhair āsyato mahartvijaḥ pratidiśam̐ samarpayanti / śīrṣata ity ekeṣām / āsapuṭair vaiśvam annāya tvā \\ iti purastād adhvaryuḥ / annādyāya tvā \\ iti dakṣiṇato brahmā / vājāya tvā \\ iti paścād dhotā / vājajityāyai tvā \\ ity uttarata udgātā //
meaning: तम् आश्वत्थैर् ऊषपुटैर् दीर्घवम्̐शप्रबद्धैर् आस्यतो महर्त्विजः प्रतिदिशम्̐ समर्पयन्ति / शीर्षत इत्य् एकेषाम् / आसपुटैर् वैश्वम् अन्नाय त्वा \\ इति पुरस्ताद् अध्वर्युः / अन्नाद्याय त्वा \\ इति दक्षिणतो ब्रह्मा / वाजाय त्वा \\ इति पश्चाद् धोता / वाजजित्यायै त्वा \\ इत्य् उत्तरत उद्गाता //
text_mt: The principal priests, using bags of salt-soil made of aśvattha leaves tied to long bamboo poles, throw them at him up to his mouth from each direction; according to some, up to his head; or [they use] mouth-bags made of all kinds [of material]: the adhvaryu from the east with 'For food, thee!'; the brahman from the south with 'For the eating of food, thee!'; the hotṛ from the west with 'For the prize, thee!'; the udgātṛ from the north with 'For winning the prize, thee!'

sanskrit_iast: hantāraṃ vitatya bāhū abhiparyāvartate //
meaning: हन्तारं वितत्य बाहू अभिपर्यावर्तते //
text_mt: Stretching out both arms, he turns toward the smiter.

sanskrit_iast: iyaṃ te rāṇ mitrāya yantrāsi yamanas \\ dhartāsi dharuṇaḥ \ kṛṣyai kṣemāya rayyai poṣāya \\ iti pratyavarohati //
meaning: इयं ते राण् मित्राय यन्त्रासि यमनस् \\ धर्तासि धरुणः \ कृष्यै क्षेमाय रय्यै पोषाय \\ इति प्रत्यवरोहति //
text_mt: He climbs down with [the mantra,] 'This is your kingdom. A supporter are you for Mitra, a restrainer, a holder, a support; for agriculture, for well-being, for wealth, for prosperity.'

sanskrit_iast: agreṇa yūpaṃ bastājinaṃ prācīnagrīvam uttaralomāstṛṇāti //
meaning: अग्रेण यूपं बस्ताजिनं प्राचीनग्रीवम् उत्तरलोमास्तृणाति //
text_mt: In front of the sacrificial post, he spreads out a he-goat skin with the neck to the east and the hairy side facing upward.

sanskrit_iast: tejo 'si \\ iti tasmin rājatam̐ rukmaṃ nidadhāti //
meaning: तेजो ऽसि \\ इति तस्मिन् राजतम्̐ रुक्मं निदधाति //
text_mt: On it he places a silver plate with [the mantra,] 'You are brilliance.'

sanskrit_iast: amṛtam asi \\ iti rukme pādaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayate //
meaning: अमृतम् असि \\ इति रुक्मे पादं प्रतिष्ठापयते //
text_mt: He places his foot upon the plate with [the mantra,] 'You are immortality.'

sanskrit_iast: puṣṭir asi \ prajananam asi \\ iti bastājine //
meaning: पुष्टिर् असि \ प्रजननम् असि \\ इति बस्ताजिने //
text_mt: He places [the other foot] upon the he-goat skin with [the mantra,] 'You are nourishment; you are procreation.'

sanskrit_iast: tasmād āsandīm ārohati //
meaning: तस्माद् आसन्दीम् आरोहति //
text_mt: From there he ascends the throne-chair.

sanskrit_iast: divaṃ proṣṭhinīm āroha tām āruhya prapaśyaikarāṇ manuṣyāṇām edhi \\ ity ārohantam abhimantrayate //
meaning: दिवं प्रोष्ठिनीम् आरोह ताम् आरुह्य प्रपश्यैकराण् मनुष्याणाम् एधि \\ इत्य् आरोहन्तम् अभिमन्त्रयते //
text_mt: He addresses [the sacrificer] as he ascends with [the mantra,] 'Mount the heavenly seat; having mounted it, look forth; be the sole ruler of men.'

sanskrit_iast: māhendraprabhṛtīni karmāṇi pratipadyate //
meaning: माहेन्द्रप्रभृतीनि कर्माणि प्रतिपद्यते //
text_mt: He proceeds with the rites beginning with the Māhendra cup.

sanskrit_iast: tasya stotram upākṛtyābhiṣiñcati yathāgnicityāyām //
meaning: तस्य स्तोत्रम् उपाकृत्याभिषिञ्चति यथाग्निचित्यायाम् //
text_mt: Having brought forward the stotra for it, he consecrates [the sacrificer] by unction as in the piling of the fire altar.

sanskrit_iast: rajasi stuvate saptabhir annapūrvābhir annahomaṃ juhoti grāmyāraṇyānām̐ samavadāya //
meaning: रजसि स्तुवते सप्तभिर् अन्नपूर्वाभिर् अन्नहोमं जुहोति ग्राम्यारण्यानाम्̐ समवदाय //
text_mt: While they chant in the dust [or in the open space], he offers the food-oblation, taking portions together from both cultivated and wild [grains], with the seven [mantras] preceded by [the word] 'food'.

sanskrit_iast: ( mādhyamdinasya savanasya ) madhyama ukthyaparyāye brahmasāmny upākṛte 'tra sārasvataprabhṛtīn uttarān ālabhante //
meaning: ( माध्यम्दिनस्य सवनस्य ) मध्यम उक्थ्यपर्याये ब्रह्मसाम्न्य् उपाकृते ऽत्र सारस्वतप्रभृतीन् उत्तरान् आलभन्ते //
text_mt: When, at the midday pressing, in the middle ukthya round, the Brahmasāman has been introduced, they seize the later [animal victims] beginning with the one for Sarasvatī.

sanskrit_iast: teṣām anabhighāritābhir vapābhiḥ pracarati //
meaning: तेषाम् अनभिघारिताभिर् वपाभिः प्रचरति //
text_mt: He proceeds with their omenta without basting them.

sanskrit_iast: sārasvatasya vapayā pracarya samavadāya prājāpatyānāṃ vapābhiḥ pracarati //
meaning: सारस्वतस्य वपया प्रचर्य समवदाय प्राजापत्यानां वपाभिः प्रचरति //
text_mt: Having proceeded with the omentum of the victim for Sarasvatī, he cuts off portions together and proceeds with the omenta of the victims for Prajāpati.

sanskrit_iast: naivāreṇa pracarati havirāhutiprabhṛtīḍāntā saṃtiṣṭhate //
meaning: नैवारेण प्रचरति हविराहुतिप्रभृतीडान्ता संतिष्ठते //
text_mt: He proceeds with the wild-rice mess, beginning with the oblation offering and concluding with the iḍā.

sanskrit_iast: mahartvijo havirucchiṣṭāśā bhavanti //
meaning: महर्त्विजो हविरुच्छिष्टाशा भवन्ति //
text_mt: The principal priests eat the remnant of the oblation.

sanskrit_iast: paśukāle sārasvatyantānāṃ sarveṣāṃ daivatena pracarati //
meaning: पशुकाले सारस्वत्यन्तानां सर्वेषां दैवतेन प्रचरति //
text_mt: At the time of the animal [portions], he proceeds with the deity offerings of all [victims] ending with the one for Sarasvatī.

sanskrit_iast: ṣoḍaśicamasān unnayann ekasmai camasagaṇāya rājānam atirecayati / taiḥ pracaryātiriktastotrāya hotṛcamasamukhyāmmś camasān unnayati / stutaśastre bhavataḥ / śastraṃ pratigīrya prājāpatyānāṃ mukhyaṃ graham adhvaryur ādatte / ṛtvija itarān //
meaning: षोडशिचमसान् उन्नयन्न् एकस्मै चमसगणाय राजानम् अतिरेचयति / तैः प्रचर्यातिरिक्तस्तोत्राय होतृचमसमुख्याम्म्श् चमसान् उन्नयति / स्तुतशस्त्रे भवतः / शस्त्रं प्रतिगीर्य प्राजापत्यानां मुख्यं ग्रहम् अध्वर्युर् आदत्ते / ऋत्विज इतरान् //
text_mt: Drawing the ṣoḍaśin cups, he leaves over the king [Soma] for one set of cups; having proceeded with them, he draws the cups beginning with the hotṛ's cup for the supplementary stotra; the stotra and śastra take place; having responded to the śastra, the adhvaryu takes the principal cup of the Prājāpatya offerings, and the other priests take the other [cups].

sanskrit_iast: surāgrahāṇāṃ mukhyaṃ pratiprasthātā vājasṛta itarān ādatte / camasām̐ś camasādhvaryavaḥ //
meaning: सुराग्रहाणां मुख्यं प्रतिप्रस्थाता वाजसृत इतरान् आदत्ते / चमसाम्̐श् चमसाध्वर्यवः //
text_mt: The pratiprasthātṛ takes the principal cup of surā, the chariot-runners take the others; and the camasa-adhvaryus take the [soma] cups.

sanskrit_iast: saṃpṛcaḥ stha \ saṃ mā bhadreṇa pṛṅkta \\ iti prāṅ adhvaryuḥ somagrahair uddravati / saṃpṛcaḥ stha \ saṃ mā bhadreṇa pṛṅktām iti vā vipṛcaḥ stha \ vi papmanā pṛṅkta \\ iti pratyaṅ pratiprasthātā surāgrahaiḥ / vipṛcaḥ stha vi papmanā pṛṅktām iti vā //
meaning: संपृचः स्थ \ सं मा भद्रेण पृङ्क्त \\ इति प्राङ् अध्वर्युः सोमग्रहैर् उद्द्रवति / संपृचः स्थ \ सं मा भद्रेण पृङ्क्ताम् इति वा विपृचः स्थ \ वि पप्मना पृङ्क्त \\ इति प्रत्यङ् प्रतिप्रस्थाता सुराग्रहैः / विपृचः स्थ वि पप्मना पृङ्क्ताम् इति वा //
text_mt: The adhvaryu runs forward toward the east with the soma cups with [the mantra,] 'You are combiners; combine me with prosperity'—or, 'May they combine me with prosperity'; the pratiprasthātṛ runs toward the west with the surā cups with [the mantra,] 'You are separators; separate [me] from evil'—or, 'May they separate [me] from evil.'

sanskrit_iast: āhavanīyanyante somagrahair avatiṣṭhante / mārjālīyanyante surāgrahaiḥ pracarati / somagrahair vaṣaṭkārānuvāṣaṭkārau / surāgrahān anuprakampayanti / vyākhyātaḥ somasya bhakṣaḥ //
meaning: आहवनीयन्यन्ते सोमग्रहैर् अवतिष्ठन्ते / मार्जालीयन्यन्ते सुराग्रहैः प्रचरति / सोमग्रहैर् वषट्कारानुवाषट्कारौ / सुराग्रहान् अनुप्रकम्पयन्ति / व्याख्यातः सोमस्य भक्षः //
text_mt: They stop near the āhavanīya fire with the soma cups; he proceeds near the mārjālīya fire with the surā cups; the call of vaṣaṭ and the second vaṣaṭ are made with the soma cups; they shake the surā cups in response; the consumption of the soma has been explained.

sanskrit_iast: virāṭ chandasas \\ iti bhakṣamantram̐ saṃnamati //
meaning: विराट् छन्दसस् \\ इति भक्षमन्त्रम्̐ संनमति //
text_mt: He modifies the consumption mantra to: 'of the Virāj meter.'

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇasyāṃ vediśroṇyāṃ vājasṛto vimāthīkṛtya surāgrahān bhakṣayanti //
meaning: दक्षिणस्यां वेदिश्रोण्यां वाजसृतो विमाथीकृत्य सुराग्रहान् भक्षयन्ति //
text_mt: On the southern hip of the vedi, the chariot-runners, having snatched them mutually, consume the surā cups.

sanskrit_iast: anuyājaiḥ pracarati te vyūḍhāsu srukṣu sārasvataprabhṛtīnām uttareṣāṃ daivatena pracarati //
meaning: अनुयाजैः प्रचरति ते व्यूढासु स्रुक्षु सारस्वतप्रभृतीनाम् उत्तरेषां दैवतेन प्रचरति //
text_mt: He proceeds with the after-offerings; when they are finished and the offering ladles are set apart, he proceeds with the deity offerings of the later [victims] beginning with the one for Sarasvatī.

sanskrit_iast: api vā yatraivetareṣāṃ paśūnāṃ vapābhiḥ pracaret //
meaning: अपि वा यत्रैवेतरेषां पशूनां वपाभिः प्रचरेत् //
text_mt: Or rather, [he proceeds with them] wherever he would proceed with the omenta of the other animals.

sanskrit_iast: yatro haiva havirbhis tad dhavirbhir mārutyā avadānīyān ṛtvigbhya upaharati //
meaning: यत्रो हैव हविर्भिस् तद् धविर्भिर् मारुत्या अवदानीयान् ऋत्विग्भ्य उपहरति //
text_mt: And wherever [he proceeds] with the oblations, there he presents the portions to be cut of the [victim] for the Maruts to the priests.

sanskrit_iast: anavadānīyān vājasṛdbhyas tāni dakṣiṇasyāṃ vediśroṇyāṃ vājasṛto vimāthīkṛtya bhakṣayanti //
meaning: अनवदानीयान् वाजसृद्भ्यस् तानि दक्षिणस्यां वेदिश्रोण्यां वाजसृतो विमाथीकृत्य भक्षयन्ति //
text_mt: The portions not to be cut he presents to the chariot-runners; those the chariot-runners, having snatched them mutually, consume on the southern hip of the vedi.

sanskrit_iast: kakudo rājaputro dhruvagopo naivāragopo vā prāśnāti / ubhau vā / sarvaṃ vā kakudam //
meaning: ककुदो राजपुत्रो ध्रुवगोपो नैवारगोपो वा प्राश्नाति / उभौ वा / सर्वं वा ककुदम् //
text_mt: The king's son, either the defender of the firm [land] or the defender of wild rice, eats of the hump; or both [eat of it]; or [he eats] the entire hump.

sanskrit_iast: saṃtiṣṭhate vājapeyaḥ //
meaning: संतिष्ठते वाजपेयः //
text_mt: The Vājapeya is completed.

sanskrit_iast: vājapeyeneṣṭvā sautrāmaṇyā yajeta //
meaning: वाजपेयेनेष्ट्वा सौत्रामण्या यजेत //
text_mt: Having sacrificed with the Vājapeya, he should sacrifice with the Sautrāmaṇī.

sanskrit_iast: na kaṃcana pratyuttiṣṭhati //
meaning: न कंचन प्रत्युत्तिष्ठति //
text_mt: He does not rise to greet anyone.

sanskrit_iast: śvetacchatrī bhavatīti vijñāyate //
meaning: श्वेतच्छत्री भवतीति विज्ञायते //
text_mt: It is known [from the Brāhmaṇa]: 'He becomes one with a white umbrella.'

sanskrit_iast: rājā rājasūyena svargakāmo yajeta //
meaning: राजा राजसूयेन स्वर्गकामो यजेत //
text_mt: A king desiring heaven should sacrifice with the Rājasūya.

sanskrit_iast: taiṣyāḥ paurṇamāsyāḥ purastāt pañcarātre māsi dīkṣeta //
meaning: तैष्याः पौर्णमास्याः पुरस्तात् पञ्चरात्रे मासि दीक्षेत //
text_mt: He should undergo initiation in the month five days before the full-moon day of the month of Taiṣa.

sanskrit_iast: yathāsyāṃ parasmin saṃvatsare taiṣyāṃ paurṇamāsyām abhiṣecanīyāyokthyāya dīkṣā pravatsyatīti
meaning: यथास्यां परस्मिन् संवत्सरे तैष्यां पौर्णमास्याम् अभिषेचनीयायोक्थ्याय दीक्षा प्रवत्स्यतीति
text_mt: So that, on this same full-moon day of Taiṣa in the following year, the initiation for the Abhiṣecanīya ukthya sacrifice will take place.

sanskrit_iast: jyotiṣṭomenāgniṣṭomena prathamaṃ yajeta //
meaning: ज्योतिष्टोमेनाग्निष्टोमेन प्रथमं यजेत //
text_mt: He should first sacrifice with the Jyotiṣṭoma Agniṣṭoma.

sanskrit_iast: pañcāpavargo bhavati //
meaning: पञ्चापवर्गो भवति //

sanskrit_iast: śatasahasraṃ sarveṣu rājasūyikeṣu someṣu samaśaḥ prativibhajyānvahaṃ dadāti //
meaning: शतसहस्रं सर्वेषु राजसूयिकेषु सोमेषु समशः प्रतिविभज्यान्वहं ददाति //
text_mt: Dividing one hundred thousand equally among all the soma sacrifices of the Rājasūya, he gives [it] day by day.

sanskrit_iast: tathā dakṣiṇā nayet //
meaning: तथा दक्षिणा नयेत् //

sanskrit_iast: yathāsyāhāni svakālāni syuḥ / śeṣam anudiśet //
meaning: यथास्याहानि स्वकालानि स्युः / शेषम् अनुदिशेत् //
text_mt: So that his days have their own proper times; he should assign the remainder.

sanskrit_iast: rājasūyeṣṭipaśubandhānām anvahaṃ codanāt //
meaning: राजसूयेष्टिपशुबन्धानाम् अन्वहं चोदनात् //
text_mt: Because of the day-by-day injunction of the iṣṭis and animal sacrifices of the Rājasūya.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ dakṣiṇāpṛthaktveneṣṭipṛthaktvaṃ pratīyāt //
meaning: तेषां दक्षिणापृथक्त्वेनेष्टिपृथक्त्वं प्रतीयात् //
text_mt: From the distinctness of their sacrificial gifts, one should understand the distinctness of the iṣṭis.

sanskrit_iast: anyaddiśām aveṣṭeḥ pṛthakdakṣiṇāni tāny ekatantrāṇi bhavanti //
meaning: अन्यद्दिशाम् अवेष्टेः पृथक्दक्षिणानि तान्य् एकतन्त्राणि भवन्ति //
text_mt: Except for the Aveṣṭi of the quarters; those have separate sacrificial gifts but share a single sacrificial framework.

sanskrit_iast: śvo bhūta ānumataprabhṛtibhir anvahaṃ yajet //
meaning: श्वो भूत आनुमतप्रभृतिभिर् अन्वहं यजेत् //
text_mt: On the next day, he should sacrifice day by day with [the offerings] beginning with the Ānumata.

sanskrit_iast: anumatyai puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapatīti yathāsamāmnātam / pim̐ṣann ānumataṃ paścād uttarataś ca vyavaśātayati //
meaning: अनुमत्यै पुरोडाशम् अष्टाकपालं निर्वपतीति यथासमाम्नातम् / पिम्̐षन्न् आनुमतं पश्चाद् उत्तरतश् च व्यवशातयति //
text_mt: As traditionally taught: 'He offers a sacrificial cake on eight potsherds to Anumati'; while grinding [the grains for] the Ānumata, he casts [some] aside to the west and to the north.

sanskrit_iast: ye pratyañcaḥ śamyāyā avaśīyante taṃ nairṛtam ekakapālaṃ kuryāt //
meaning: ये प्रत्यञ्चः शम्याया अवशीयन्ते तं नैरृतम् एककपालं कुर्यात् //
text_mt: Those which fall toward the west of the yoke-pin, he should make that [into] a Nairṛta [cake] on one potsherd.

sanskrit_iast: upadhāyānumatasya kapālāni nairṛtasya kapālam upadadhāti //
meaning: उपधायानुमतस्य कपालानि नैरृतस्य कपालम् उपदधाति //
text_mt: Having put down the potsherds for the Ānumata, he puts down the potsherd for the Nairṛta.

sanskrit_iast: āsādyānumataṃ nairṛtena pracarati //
meaning: आसाद्यानुमतं नैरृतेन प्रचरति //
text_mt: Having placed [the cake for] the Ānumata [near the fire], he proceeds with the Nairṛta.

sanskrit_iast: vīhi svāhāhutiṃ juṣāṇas \\ iti sruveṇa gārhapatye juhoti //
meaning: वीहि स्वाहाहुतिं जुषाणस् \\ इति स्रुवेण गार्हपत्ये जुहोति //
text_mt: With the sruva spoon he offers in the gārhapatya fire with: 'Enjoying the offering, savor [it], svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇāgner ekolmukaṃ dhūpayati //
meaning: दक्षिणाग्नेर् एकोल्मुकं धूपयति //
text_mt: He makes a single firebrand from the dakṣiṇāgni fire smoke.

sanskrit_iast: parācīnaṃ dakṣiṇāparam avāntaradeśam̐ hṛtvā svakṛta iriṇe pradare vopasamādhāya juṣāṇā nirṛtir vetu svāhā \\ iti // visraṃsikāyāḥ kāṇḍābhyām̐ sarvahutaṃ nairṛtaṃ juhoti //
meaning: पराचीनं दक्षिणापरम् अवान्तरदेशम्̐ हृत्वा स्वकृत इरिणे प्रदरे वोपसमाधाय जुषाणा निरृतिर् वेतु स्वाहा \\ इति // विस्रंसिकायाः काण्डाभ्याम्̐ सर्वहुतं नैरृतं जुहोति //
text_mt: Carrying it away turned away toward the intermediate southwest quarter, and having added fuel to it in a natural cleft or chasm, with: 'May Nirṛti, enjoying [it], savor [it], svāhā!' he offers the Nairṛta wholly offered with two pieces of a splitting reed;

sanskrit_iast: aṅguṣṭhābhyām eṣa te nirṛte bhāgas \\ iti vā //
meaning: अङ्गुष्ठाभ्याम् एष ते निरृते भागस् \\ इति वा //
text_mt: or with the two thumbs, with: 'This is your share, O Nirṛti!'

sanskrit_iast: vāso 'bhinnāntaṃ dakṣiṇā kṛṣṇaṃ vāsaḥ kṛṣṇadaśam //
meaning: वासो ऽभिन्नान्तं दक्षिणा कृष्णं वासः कृष्णदशम् //
text_mt: The sacrificial gift is an uncut garment, a black garment with black fringes.

sanskrit_iast: apaḥ pariṣicyāpratīkṣam āyanti //
meaning: अपः परिषिच्याप्रतीक्षम् आयन्ति //
text_mt: Having poured water around, they return without looking back.

sanskrit_iast: svāhā namo ya idaṃ cakāra \\ iti punar etya gārhapatye juhoti //
meaning: स्वाहा नमो य इदं चकार \\ इति पुनर् एत्य गार्हपत्ये जुहोति //
text_mt: Having returned, he offers in the gārhapatya fire with: 'Svāhā, homage to him who has done this!'

sanskrit_iast: anumatena pracarati ya udañco 'vaśīyante tān udak paretya śuktyā valmīkavapām uddhatya \\ idam aham amuṣyāmuṣyāyaṇasya kṣetriyam avayaje \\ iti śuktyā valmīkavapāyāṃ juhoti / tām apidadhāti \\ idama ham amuṣyāmuṣyāyaṇasya kṣetriyam apidadhe \\ iti śuktyā valmīkavapayā vā //
