Wise men know his origin; creators seek the station of the rays.' / 'He who shines upon the gods, who is the domestic priest of the gods, who was born before the gods—homage to the bright brahmanic light!' / 'Generating the bright brahmanic light, the gods said that in the beginning: But whatever brāhmaṇa knows you thus, the gods shall be under his control.' / 'Modesty and prosperity are your wives; day and night are your flanks; the constellations your form; the Aśvins your open mouth. Wish for what is sacrificed! Wish for that! Wish for all!' / 'Having entered into beings, the past one moves; he became the lord of beings. His Rājasūya moves in death; let that king assent to this kingship.' / [And] this verse: 'O Prajāpati...' / 'Yours are these worlds, the intermediate quarters and the quarters, the distant realms, the lowlands, and the heights. O Prajāpati, creator of all, whose bow is alive, O god, accept this our oblation' is the last of the latter [verses].

sanskrit_iast: ayaṃ puro bhuvas \\ iti pañcāśataṃ prāṇabhṛtaḥ purastād abhiṣekasya juhoti / prācī diśāṃ vasanta ṛtūnām iti pañcāśatam apānabhṛta upariṣṭāt //
meaning: अयं पुरो भुवस् \\ इति पञ्चाशतं प्राणभृतः पुरस्ताद् अभिषेकस्य जुहोति / प्राची दिशां वसन्त ऋतूनाम् इति पञ्चाशतम् अपानभृत उपरिष्टात् //
text_mt: With 'This one in front is Bhuvas,' he offers fifty prāṇabhṛt offerings prior to the consecration; with 'The east of the quarters, spring of the seasons,' fifty apānabhṛt offerings after.

sanskrit_iast: sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ \ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt \\ iti puruṣeṇa nārāyaṇena śatātṛṇṇam̐ sauvarṇam̐ rukmaṃ yajamānasya śirasi nidadhāti //
meaning: सहस्रशीर्षा पुरुषः \ सहस्राक्षः सहस्रपात् \\ इति पुरुषेण नारायणेन शतातृण्णम्̐ सौवर्णम्̐ रुक्मं यजमानस्य शिरसि निदधाति //
text_mt: With the Puruṣasūkta, 'The Puruṣa has a thousand heads, a thousand eyes, a thousand feet,' he places a golden plaque with a hundred perforations on the head of the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast: prajāpates tvā pṛthivyai bāhubhyām antarikṣasya hastābhyāṃ prajāpatim̐ sāmrājyāyābhiṣiñcāmi \\ iti mahimnor udrekeṇa parṇamayaiḥ pātraiḥ sim̐hacarmaṇy adhyabhiṣiñcati /
meaning: प्रजापतेस् त्वा पृथिव्यै बाहुभ्याम् अन्तरिक्षस्य हस्ताभ्यां प्रजापतिम्̐ साम्राज्यायाभिषिञ्चामि \\ इति महिम्नोर् उद्रेकेण पर्णमयैः पात्रैः सिम्̐हचर्मण्य् अध्यभिषिञ्चति /
text_mt: With 'By the earth, the arms of Prajāpati, by the hands of the atmosphere, I consecrate you, Prajāpati, to supreme sovereignty,' he consecrates him on a lion skin with the residue of the Mahiman [cups] by means of palaśa-wood vessels.

sanskrit_iast: ṛṣabhacarmābhiṣicyāmānasyopariṣṭād dhārayanti //
meaning: ऋषभचर्माभिषिच्यामानस्योपरिष्टाद् धारयन्ति //
text_mt: They hold an ox skin over him while he is being consecrated.

sanskrit_iast: ūrdhvā asya samidho bhavanti \\ iti prājāpatyābhir āprībhir yajamānasya hastaṃ gṛhṇāti //
meaning: ऊर्ध्वा अस्य समिधो भवन्ति \\ इति प्राजापत्याभिर् आप्रीभिर् यजमानस्य हस्तं गृह्णाति //
text_mt: With 'Upright are his pieces of firewood,' [and the remaining] Āprī verses to Prajāpati, he takes the hand of the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast: mṛgo na bhīmas \\ iti vaimṛdhībhyāṃ mukhaṃ vimṛṣṭe //
meaning: मृगो न भीमस् \\ इति वैमृधीभ्यां मुखं विमृष्टे //
text_mt: With the two Vaimṛdha verses beginning 'Like a fearful wild beast,' he wipes his face.

sanskrit_iast: agninā devena pṛtanā jayāmi \\ iti jāgatān viṣṇukramān krāmati //
meaning: अग्निना देवेन पृतना जयामि \\ इति जागतान् विष्णुक्रमान् क्रामति //
text_mt: With 'With god Agni I win the battles,' he strides the Viṣṇu-strides in jagatī metre.

sanskrit_iast: madhuś ca mādhavaś ca \\ iti dvādaśāhutīr juhoti / trayodaśety ekeṣām / vasantāya svāhā \ grīṣmāya svāhā \\ iti juhoti //
meaning: मधुश् च माधवश् च \\ इति द्वादशाहुतीर् जुहोति / त्रयोदशेत्य् एकेषाम् / वसन्ताय स्वाहा \ ग्रीष्माय स्वाहा \\ इति जुहोति //
text_mt: With 'Madhu and Mādhava', he offers twelve oblations; thirteen according to some. He offers with 'Svāhā to spring! Svāhā to summer!'.

sanskrit_iast: havirāsādanaprabhṛtīni karmāṇi pratipadyate //
meaning: हविरासादनप्रभृतीनि कर्माणि प्रतिपद्यते //
text_mt: He undertakes the rites beginning with the placing of the sacrificial oblations.

sanskrit_iast: uttarata upariṣṭād agner vaitase kaṭe 'śvaṃ tūparaṃ gomṛgam iti yathāṅgam anupūrvam // prāñcaḥ kalpayanti //
meaning: उत्तरत उपरिष्टाद् अग्नेर् वैतसे कटे ऽश्वं तूपरं गोमृगम् इति यथाङ्गम् अनुपूर्वम् // प्राञ्चः कल्पयन्ति //
text_mt: To the north, upon the fire, on a reed mat, they arrange facing east the horse, the hornless he-goat, and the wild ox, limb by limb in succession.

sanskrit_iast: pratīco vā dakṣiṇataḥ plakṣaśākhāsv itarān paśūn //
meaning: प्रतीचो वा दक्षिणतः प्लक्षशाखास्व् इतरान् पशून् //
text_mt: Or facing west, to the south, on plakṣa branches, [they arrange] the other animals.

sanskrit_iast: nānākumbhīṣv ete paśavaḥ śrapyante / vapābhiḥ pracaraṇakalpo vyākhyātaḥ //
meaning: नानाकुम्भीष्व् एते पशवः श्रप्यन्ते / वपाभिः प्रचरणकल्पो व्याख्यातः //
text_mt: These animals are cooked in separate pots. The procedure for performing the rites with the omenta has been explained.

sanskrit_iast: kramair atyakramīd vājī \\ iti vaitasena kaṭenāśvaṃ tūparaṃ gomṛgam iti sarvahutaṃ juhoti //
meaning: क्रमैर् अत्यक्रमीद् वाजी \\ इति वैतसेन कटेनाश्वं तूपरं गोमृगम् इति सर्वहुतं जुहोति //
text_mt: With 'By his strides the steed has surpassed', he offers as a complete offering the horse, the hornless goat, and the wild ox on the reed mat.

sanskrit_iast: hutāya svāhā \\ iti hutam abhijuhoti //
meaning: हुताय स्वाहा \\ इति हुतम् अभिजुहोति //
text_mt: With 'Svāhā to the offered!', he pours an oblation over that which has been offered.

sanskrit_iast: ye 'śvasya hutasya gandham ājighranti //
meaning: ये ऽश्वस्य हुतस्य गन्धम् आजिघ्रन्ति //
text_mt: Those who smell the fragrance of the horse when it has been offered—

sanskrit_iast: sarve te puṇyalokā bhavantīti vijñāyate //
meaning: सर्वे ते पुण्यलोका भवन्तीति विज्ञायते //
text_mt: all of them become possessors of holy worlds, so it is known [from the Brāhmaṇa].

sanskrit_iast: stegān dam̐ṣṭrābhyām \\ maṇḍūkāñ jambhyebhir ity ājyam avadānaṃ kṛtvā pratisaṃkhyāyāhutīr juhoti //
meaning: स्तेगान् दम्̐ष्ट्राभ्याम् \\ मण्डूकाञ् जम्भ्येभिर् इत्य् आज्यम् अवदानं कृत्वा प्रतिसंख्यायाहुतीर् जुहोति //
text_mt: With 'Poles with two tusks', and 'Frogs with the teeth', having taken portions of clarified butter, he offers oblations after reciting each.

sanskrit_iast: grāmyān hutvāraṇye 'nuvākyaṃ juhoti dyāvāpṛthivīyam̐ hutvāśvastomīyaṃ juhoti //
meaning: ग्राम्यान् हुत्वारण्ये ऽनुवाक्यं जुहोति द्यावापृथिवीयम्̐ हुत्वाश्वस्तोमीयं जुहोति //
text_mt: Having offered [the portions of] the domestic animals, he offers the section [meant to be recited] in the forest; having offered the one addressed to Heaven and Earth, he offers the aśvastomīya offering.

sanskrit_iast: imā nu kaṃ bhuvanā sīṣadhema \\ indraś ca viśve ca devāḥ / \ yajñaṃ ca nas tanuvaṃ ca prajāṃ ca \\ ādityair indraḥ saha sīṣadhātu / \ ādityair indraḥ sagaṇo marudbhir \ asmabhyaṃ bheṣajākarat / \ agne tvaṃ no antamas \\ iti dvipadām̐ hutvāśvalohitena śṛtena sviṣṭakṛto juhoti //
meaning: इमा नु कं भुवना सीषधेम \\ इन्द्रश् च विश्वे च देवाः / \ यज्ञं च नस् तनुवं च प्रजां च \\ आदित्यैर् इन्द्रः सह सीषधातु / \ आदित्यैर् इन्द्रः सगणो मरुद्भिर् \ अस्मभ्यं भेषजाकरत् / \ अग्ने त्वं नो अन्तमस् \\ इति द्विपदाम्̐ हुत्वाश्वलोहितेन शृतेन स्विष्टकृतो जुहोति //
text_mt: Having offered with the two-line verse 'May we now accomplish these worlds, / Indra and all the gods; / and our sacrifice, our body, and our offspring / may Indra accomplish together with the Ādityas; / Indra together with the Ādityas, accompanied by the Maruts, / has prepared remedies for us; / O Agni, you are nearest to us', he offers the Sviṣṭakṛt offerings with the boiled blood of the horse.

sanskrit_iast: gomṛgakaṇṭhena prathamām āhutiṃ juhoti / aśvaśaphena dvitīyām / ayasmayena kamaṇḍalunā caruṇā vā tṛtīyām //
meaning: गोमृगकण्ठेन प्रथमाम् आहुतिं जुहोति / अश्वशफेन द्वितीयाम् / अयस्मयेन कमण्डलुना चरुणा वा तृतीयाम् //
text_mt: He offers the first oblation with the throat of the wild ox; the second with the hoof of the horse; the third with an iron bowl or a pot.

sanskrit_iast: patnīsaṃyājāntam ahaḥ saṃtiṣṭhate //
meaning: पत्नीसंयाजान्तम् अहः संतिष्ठते //
text_mt: The day concludes with the offerings to the wives of the gods.

sanskrit_iast: śvo bhūte pratāyate sarvastomo 'tirātra uttamo bṛhatsāmā //
meaning: श्वो भूते प्रतायते सर्वस्तोमो ऽतिरात्र उत्तमो बृहत्सामा //
text_mt: On the next day the sarvastoma atirātra sacrifice is performed, as the final one, possessing the Bṛhatsāman.

sanskrit_iast: paśukāla aikādaśinān vāyavyān paśūn upākaroti / prājāpatyam ṛṣabhaṃ tūparaṃ bahurūpaṃ dvādaśam upālambhyam̐ sarvebhyaḥ kāmebhyaḥ //
meaning: पशुकाल ऐकादशिनान् वायव्यान् पशून् उपाकरोति / प्राजापत्यम् ऋषभं तूपरं बहुरूपं द्वादशम् उपालम्भ्यम्̐ सर्वेभ्यः कामेभ्यः //
text_mt: At the time of the animal sacrifice, he brings up the eleven animals dedicated to Vāyu. A hornless, multi-colored bull dedicated to Prajāpati is the twelfth animal to be seized for all desires.

sanskrit_iast: avabhṛthena pracarite purastāt sviṣṭakṛtaḥ //
meaning: अवभृथेन प्रचरिते पुरस्तात् स्विष्टकृतः //
text_mt: When the purificatory bath has been performed, before the Sviṣṭakṛt offering,

sanskrit_iast: ātreyaṃ khalatiṃ viklidham̐ śuklaṃ piṅgalākṣam̐ śipiviṣṭaṃ tilakāvalam avabhṛtham abhyavanīya jumbukāya svāhā \\ iti tasya mūrdhañ juhoti / cumbukāya svāhā \\ ity ekeṣām / mṛtyave svāhā \\ iti dvitīyām / bhrūṇahatyāyai svāhā \\ iti tṛtīyām / brahmahatyāyai svāhā \\ ity ekeṣām //
meaning: आत्रेयं खलतिं विक्लिधम्̐ शुक्लं पिङ्गलाक्षम्̐ शिपिविष्टं तिलकावलम् अवभृथम् अभ्यवनीय जुम्बुकाय स्वाहा \\ इति तस्य मूर्धञ् जुहोति / चुम्बुकाय स्वाहा \\ इत्य् एकेषाम् / मृत्यवे स्वाहा \\ इति द्वितीयाम् / भ्रूणहत्यायै स्वाहा \\ इति तृतीयाम् / ब्रह्महत्यायै स्वाहा \\ इत्य् एकेषाम् //
text_mt: having led into the purificatory bath a member of the Atri family who is bald, blear-eyed, white-spotted, yellow-eyed, leprous, and marked with spots, he makes an offering on his head with the words: 'To Jumbuka, svāhā!' 'To Cumbuka, svāhā!' according to some. He offers a second oblation with: 'To Death, svāhā!' and a third with: 'To the slaughter of an embryo, svāhā!' 'To the slaughter of a brahmin, svāhā!' according to some.

sanskrit_iast: tasmai śatamanoyuktaṃ ca dadāti //
meaning: तस्मै शतमनोयुक्तं च ददाति //
text_mt: To him he gives a hundred [cows] and a cart with oxen yoked to it.

sanskrit_iast: śate vānoyukte cety ekeṣām //
meaning: शते वानोयुक्ते चेत्य् एकेषाम् //
text_mt: Or two hundred [cows] and two carts with oxen yoked to them, according to some.

sanskrit_iast: saha puṇyakṛtaḥ pāpakṛtaś cāvabhṛtham avayanti //
meaning: सह पुण्यकृतः पापकृतश् चावभृथम् अवयन्ति //
text_mt: Those who have done good deeds and those who have done evil deeds go down together to the purificatory bath.

sanskrit_iast: avabhṛthād udetya hastasam̐rabdhā grāmam āyanti //
meaning: अवभृथाद् उदेत्य हस्तसम्̐रब्धा ग्रामम् आयन्ति //
text_mt: Having emerged from the purificatory bath, holding one another by the hand, they go to the village.

sanskrit_iast: saurīr nava śvetā vaśā anūbandhyā bhavanti pañcadaśa vā / chagalaḥ kalmāṣaḥ kikidīvir vidīgaya iti trayas tvāṣṭrāḥ //
meaning: सौरीर् नव श्वेता वशा अनूबन्ध्या भवन्ति पञ्चदश वा / छगलः कल्माषः किकिदीविर् विदीगय इति त्रयस् त्वाष्ट्राः //
text_mt: There are nine white barren cows dedicated to Sūrya as the concluding animal sacrifices, or fifteen. Three animals dedicated to Tvaṣṭṛ: a he-goat, a speckled [animal], and a blue jay (kikidīvi).

sanskrit_iast: pātnīvate saṃtiṣṭhate 'tirātraḥ
meaning: पात्नीवते संतिष्ठते ऽतिरात्रः
text_mt: The Atirātra concludes with the cup for the wives of the gods (pātnīvata).

sanskrit_iast: śvo bhūte tripaśunā paśubandhena bailve triviśākhe yūpe yajata āgneyam aindrāgnam āśvinam / tān paśūn ālabhate / apivā traitānāṃ prathamajam āśvinaṃ kālakābhrum aśvibhyāṃ madhyame viśālayūpe traitānāṃ madhyamajam ūrje dakṣiṇe viśālayūpe traitānām uttamajaṃ pṛthivyā uttare viśālayūpe //
meaning: श्वो भूते त्रिपशुना पशुबन्धेन बैल्वे त्रिविशाखे यूपे यजत आग्नेयम् ऐन्द्राग्नम् आश्विनम् / तान् पशून् आलभते / अपिवा त्रैतानां प्रथमजम् आश्विनं कालकाभ्रुम् अश्विभ्यां मध्यमे विशालयूपे त्रैतानां मध्यमजम् ऊर्जे दक्षिणे विशालयूपे त्रैतानाम् उत्तमजं पृथिव्या उत्तरे विशालयूपे //
text_mt: On the next day, he sacrifices with an animal sacrifice of three animals on a threefold-branched bael-wood sacrificial post: one dedicated to Agni, one to Indra-Agni, and one to the Aśvins. He seizes those animals. Or else, to the Aśvins, on the central branch-post, the first-born dark-brown animal of triplets; to Ūrj, on the southern branch-post, the second-born of the triplets; to Earth, on the northern branch-post, the last-born of the triplets.

sanskrit_iast: paśupuroḍāśaṃ nirupya \\ agnaye 'm̐homuce 'ṣṭākapālam iti daśahaviṣaṃ mṛgāreṣṭiṃ nirvapati //
meaning: पशुपुरोडाशं निरुप्य \\ अग्नये ऽम्̐होमुचे ऽष्टाकपालम् इति दशहविषं मृगारेष्टिं निर्वपति //
text_mt: Having apportioned the sacrificial cake for the animal, he apportions the Mṛgāreṣṭi of ten oblations, beginning with 'To Agni the Freer from Distress, an eight-pot-sherd cake.'

sanskrit_iast: agner manve prathamasya pracetasas \\ iti yājyānuvākyā bhavanti //
meaning: अग्नेर् मन्वे प्रथमस्य प्रचेतसस् \\ इति याज्यानुवाक्या भवन्ति //
text_mt: 'I contemplate Agni the first, the mindful…' are the introductory and offering verses.

sanskrit_iast: paśupuroḍāśānāṃ mṛgāreṣṭeś ca samānam̐ sviṣṭakṛdiḍam //
meaning: पशुपुरोडाशानां मृगारेष्टेश् च समानम्̐ स्विष्टकृदिडम् //
text_mt: The Sviṣṭakṛt and the iḍā are common to the animal cakes and the Mṛgāreṣṭi.

sanskrit_iast: śvo bhūte dvādaśa brahmaudanān anvahaṃ nirvapati / dvādaśābhir veṣṭibhir yajeta //
meaning: श्वो भूते द्वादश ब्रह्मौदनान् अन्वहं निर्वपति / द्वादशाभिर् वेष्टिभिर् यजेत //
text_mt: On the next day, he apportions twelve cooked rice oblations for the priests (brahmaudana) day after day. Or he may sacrifice with twelve isti-sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast: tāsu dvādaśāni śatāny anvahaṃ dadāti //
meaning: तासु द्वादशानि शतान्य् अन्वहं ददाति //
text_mt: At these, he gives twelve hundred [cows] day after day.

sanskrit_iast: piśaṅgās trayo vāsantās iti yathartu yathādaivataṃ yathāsamāmnātam ṛtupaśubhir yajeta //
meaning: पिशङ्गास् त्रयो वासन्तास् इति यथर्तु यथादैवतं यथासमाम्नातम् ऋतुपशुभिर् यजेत //
text_mt: 'Three reddish-brown animals belonging to spring…'—thus according to the season, according to the deity, and as handed down by tradition, he should sacrifice with the seasonal animals.

sanskrit_iast: saṃtiṣṭhate 'śvamedhaḥ //
meaning: संतिष्ठते ऽश्वमेधः //
text_mt: The Aśvamedha concludes.

sanskrit_iast: pañcāhaḥ puruṣamedhaḥ / rājā brāhmaṇo vā / yaḥ kāmayeta sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ jaiṣṭhyam̐ śraiṣṭhyam̐ svārājyam ādhipatyaṃ gaccheyam iti / sa etena yajeta //
meaning: पञ्चाहः पुरुषमेधः / राजा ब्राह्मणो वा / यः कामयेत सर्वेषां भूतानां जैष्ठ्यम्̐ श्रैष्ठ्यम्̐ स्वाराज्यम् आधिपत्यं गच्छेयम् इति / स एतेन यजेत //
text_mt: The Puruṣamedha is a five-day rite. A king or a brāhmaṇa, whoever desires: 'May I attain pre-eminence, excellence, self-rule, and sovereignty over all beings,' should sacrifice with it.

sanskrit_iast: tasyāśvamedhena kalpo vyākhyātaḥ //
meaning: तस्याश्वमेधेन कल्पो व्याख्यातः //
text_mt: Its procedure is explained by [that of] the Aśvamedha.

sanskrit_iast: trayovim̐śatir dīkṣāḥ / dvādaśopasadaḥ / pañca sutyāḥ / ekādaśa yūpā ekādaśāgnīṣomīyā agniṣṭomaḥ prathamaha ukthyo dvitīyam atirātras tṛtīyam ukthyaś caturtham agniṣṭomaḥ pañcamam / madhyame 'hani pauruṣamedhikān paśūn upākaroti //
meaning: त्रयोविम्̐शतिर् दीक्षाः / द्वादशोपसदः / पञ्च सुत्याः / एकादश यूपा एकादशाग्नीषोमीया अग्निष्टोमः प्रथमह उक्थ्यो द्वितीयम् अतिरात्रस् तृतीयम् उक्थ्यश् चतुर्थम् अग्निष्टोमः पञ्चमम् / मध्यमे ऽहनि पौरुषमेधिकान् पशून् उपाकरोति //
text_mt: There are twenty-three initiations, twelve Upasad days, and five soma-pressing days. There are eleven sacrificial posts and eleven animal sacrifices to Agni-Soma. The first day is an Agniṣṭoma, the second an Ukthya, the third an Atirātra, the fourth an Ukthya, and the fifth an Agniṣṭoma. On the middle day, he brings up the human victims belonging to the Puruṣamedha.

sanskrit_iast: deva savitaḥ / \ tat savituḥ \ viśvāni deva savitar iti puruṣān upākariṣyam̐s tisraḥ sāvitrīr juhoti //
meaning: देव सवितः / \ तत् सवितुः \ विश्वानि देव सवितर् इति पुरुषान् उपाकरिष्यम्̐स् तिस्रः सावित्रीर् जुहोति //
text_mt: When he is about to bring up the humans, he offers three Sāvitrī oblations with the mantras: 'God Savitṛ…', 'That [excellent splendor] of Savitṛ…', and 'All [evils], O god Savitṛ…'

sanskrit_iast: aikādaśinān upākṛtya puruṣān upākaroti //
meaning: ऐकादशिनान् उपाकृत्य पुरुषान् उपाकरोति //
text_mt: Having brought up the eleven animals, he brings up the humans.

sanskrit_iast: brahmaṇe brāhmaṇam ālabhata iti yathāsamāmnātam / teṣām aṣṭācatvārim̐śataṃ madhyama upākaroti //
meaning: ब्रह्मणे ब्राह्मणम् आलभत इति यथासमाम्नातम् / तेषाम् अष्टाचत्वारिम्̐शतं मध्यम उपाकरोति //
text_mt: 'He seizes a brāhmaṇa for Brahman,' as handed down in the sacred tradition. Among them, he brings up forty-eight at the middle [post].

sanskrit_iast: ekādaśaikādaśetareṣv avaśiṣṭān madhyame 'ṣṭau vā //
meaning: एकादशैकादशेतरेष्व् अवशिष्टान् मध्यमे ऽष्टौ वा //
text_mt: He brings up eleven at each of the other [posts], and the remainder at the middle post, or eight [at the middle].

sanskrit_iast: uttamān agniyuktān puruṣān sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ \ sahasrākṣaḥ saharsapāt \\ iti puruṣeṇa nārāyaṇena dakṣiṇato brahmābhiṣṭauti //
meaning: उत्तमान् अग्नियुक्तान् पुरुषान् सहस्रशीर्षा पुरुषः \ सहस्राक्षः सहर्सपात् \\ इति पुरुषेण नारायणेन दक्षिणतो ब्रह्माभिष्टौति //
text_mt: With the Puruṣa-hymn [revealed to] Nārāyaṇa, 'The Puruṣa has a thousand heads, a thousand eyes, a thousand feet…', the brahman priest, sitting to the south, praises the last humans who have been bound to the fire.

sanskrit_iast: paryagnikṛtān puruṣān udīco nītvotsṛjyājyena taddevatā āhutīr hutvāthaikādaśinīḥ sam̐sthāpayanti //
meaning: पर्यग्निकृतान् पुरुषान् उदीचो नीत्वोत्सृज्याज्येन तद्देवता आहुतीर् हुत्वाथैकादशिनीः सम्̐स्थापयन्ति //
text_mt: Having led to the north the humans around whom fire has been carried, and having released them, he offers oblations with clarified butter to their respective deities; then they bring the eleven animal sacrifices to a conclusion.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇākāle madhyamaṃ pratirāṣṭrasya yad anyad brāhmaṇād dikṣu cittād bhūmeḥ senābhyaś ca tat puruṣamedhe dadāti //
meaning: दक्षिणाकाले मध्यमं प्रतिराष्ट्रस्य यद् अन्यद् ब्राह्मणाद् दिक्षु चित्ताद् भूमेः सेनाभ्यश् च तत् पुरुषमेधे ददाति //
text_mt: At the time of the sacrificial gift, whatever belongs to the central rival kingdom—except a brāhmaṇa, what is known in the quarters, land, and the armies—that he gives at the Puruṣamedha.

sanskrit_iast: yathāśvamedhe brāhmaṇo yajamānaḥ sarvavedasaṃ dadyāt //
meaning: यथाश्वमेधे ब्राह्मणो यजमानः सर्ववेदसं दद्यात् //
text_mt: As in the Aśvamedha, a brāhmaṇa sacrificer should give all his possessions.

sanskrit_iast: ekādaśa yūpā ekādaśānūbandhyā maitrāvaruṇī vaiśvadevī bārhaspatyā vā //
meaning: एकादश यूपा एकादशानूबन्ध्या मैत्रावरुणी वैश्वदेवी बार्हस्पत्या वा //
text_mt: There are eleven sacrificial posts and eleven concluding animal sacrifices dedicated to Mitra-Varuṇa, the Viśvedevas, or Bṛhaspati.

sanskrit_iast: traidhātavīyodavasānīyā tayeṣṭvā pṛthag araṇīṣv agnīn samārohyottaranārāyaṇenādityam upasthāya gṛheṣu pratyavasyed yān abhiprāpnuyāt tān yajñakratūn ārabheta //
meaning: त्रैधातवीयोदवसानीया तयेष्ट्वा पृथग् अरणीष्व् अग्नीन् समारोह्योत्तरनारायणेनादित्यम् उपस्थाय गृहेषु प्रत्यवस्येद् यान् अभिप्राप्नुयात् तान् यज्ञक्रतून् आरभेत //
text_mt: The concluding rite is the Traidhātavīyā. Having sacrificed with it, having mounted the fires onto the churning-sticks separately, and having attended upon the sun with the Uttaranārāyaṇa hymn, he should settle down at his homes. Whatever sacrificial rites he can undertake, those he should commence.

sanskrit_iast: saṃtiṣṭhate puruṣamedhaḥ //
meaning: संतिष्ठते पुरुषमेधः //
text_mt: The Puruṣamedha concludes.

sanskrit_iast: sarvamedho daśarātraḥ / yaḥ kāmayeta sarvam idaṃ bhaveyam iti / sa etena yajeta / tasya puruṣamedhena kalpo vyākhyātaḥ //
meaning: सर्वमेधो दशरात्रः / यः कामयेत सर्वम् इदं भवेयम् इति / स एतेन यजेत / तस्य पुरुषमेधेन कल्पो व्याख्यातः //
text_mt: The Sarvamedha is a ten-day rite. Whoever desires: 'May I become all this,' should sacrifice with it. Its procedure is explained by [that of] the Puruṣamedha.

sanskrit_iast: tristāvā vedir ekaśatavidho 'gnir agniṣṭut //
meaning: त्रिस्तावा वेदिर् एकशतविधो ऽग्निर् अग्निष्टुत् //
text_mt: The altar is three times the normal size; the fire-altar is of one hundred and one layers; [the first day] is an Agniṣṭut.

sanskrit_iast: agniṣṭomaḥ prathamahaḥ / sarvam āgneyaṃ kriyate //
meaning: अग्निष्टोमः प्रथमहः / सर्वम् आग्नेयं क्रियते //
text_mt: The first day is an Agniṣṭoma; everything is performed as dedicated to Agni.

sanskrit_iast: indrastud ukthyo dvitīyam̐ sarvam aindraṃ kriyate //
meaning: इन्द्रस्तुद् उक्थ्यो द्वितीयम्̐ सर्वम् ऐन्द्रं क्रियते //
text_mt: The second day is an Indrastut-Ukthya; everything is performed as dedicated to Indra.

sanskrit_iast: sūryastud ukthyas tṛtīyam̐ sarvam̐ sauryaṃ kriyate //
meaning: सूर्यस्तुद् उक्थ्यस् तृतीयम्̐ सर्वम्̐ सौर्यं क्रियते //
text_mt: The third day is a Sūryastut-Ukthya; everything is performed as dedicated to Sūrya.

sanskrit_iast: viśvedevastud ukthyaś caturtham̐ sarvaṃ vaiśvadevaṃ kriyate //
meaning: विश्वेदेवस्तुद् उक्थ्यश् चतुर्थम्̐ सर्वं वैश्वदेवं क्रियते //
text_mt: The Viśvedevastut [rite], an ukthya, is the fourth [day]; everything is performed for the Viśvedevas.

sanskrit_iast: āśvamedhikaṃ madhyamaṃ pañcamam / tasminn aśvaṃ medhyam ālabhate //
meaning: आश्वमेधिकं मध्यमं पञ्चमम् / तस्मिन्न् अश्वं मेध्यम् आलभते //
text_mt: The middle [rite] related to the Aśvamedha is the fifth; on it he immolates a sacrificial horse.

sanskrit_iast: pauruṣamedhikaṃ madhyamam̐ ṣaṣṭham / tasmin puruṣān medhyān ālabhate //
meaning: पौरुषमेधिकं मध्यमम्̐ षष्ठम् / तस्मिन् पुरुषान् मेध्यान् आलभते //
text_mt: The middle [rite] related to the Puruṣamedha is the sixth; on it he immolates sacrificial men.

sanskrit_iast: aptoryāmaḥ saptamam / tasmin sarvān medhyān ālabhate //
meaning: अप्तोर्यामः सप्तमम् / तस्मिन् सर्वान् मेध्यान् आलभते //
text_mt: An Aptoryāma is the seventh; on it he immolates all sacrificial [victims].

sanskrit_iast: vapā vapāvatāṃ tvaca utkṛtyāvapānāṃ juhoti //
meaning: वपा वपावतां त्वच उत्कृत्यावपानां जुहोति //
text_mt: Having cut off the omentum of those possessing an omentum, and the skin of those without an omentum, he offers [them].

sanskrit_iast: saṃvṛścauṣadhivanaspatīn ārdrāñ śuṣkām̐ś cānuprakiranti //
meaning: संवृश्चौषधिवनस्पतीन् आर्द्राञ् शुष्काम्̐श् चानुप्रकिरन्ति //
text_mt: Having cut down herbs and trees, both moist and dry, they scatter [them] along.

sanskrit_iast: prātaḥsavane sanneṣu nārāśam̐seṣu cānnamannaṃ juhoti //
meaning: प्रातःसवने सन्नेषु नाराशम्̐सेषु चान्नमन्नं जुहोति //
text_mt: At the morning pressing, when the Nārāśaṃsa [cups] are set down, he offers food by food.

sanskrit_iast: sarvaṃ juhoti sarvasyāptyai sarvasyāvaruddhyā ity evaṃ mādhyaṃdine savane tathā tṛtīyasavane huteṣu haviḥṣu triṇavam aṣṭamam / trayastrim̐śaṃ navamam / viśvajit sarvapṛṣṭho 'tirātro daśamam //
meaning: सर्वं जुहोति सर्वस्याप्त्यै सर्वस्यावरुद्ध्या इत्य् एवं माध्यंदिने सवने तथा तृतीयसवने हुतेषु हविःषु त्रिणवम् अष्टमम् / त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शं नवमम् / विश्वजित् सर्वपृष्ठो ऽतिरात्रो दशमम् //
text_mt: “He offers everything for the attainment of everything, for the securing of everything”—thus at the midday pressing, likewise at the third pressing when the sacrificial oblations have been offered; a triṇava is the eighth; a trayastriṃśa is the ninth; a Viśvajit, all-pṛṣṭha, atirātra is the tenth.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇākāle madhyamaṃ pratirāṣṭrasya yad anyad brāhmaṇād dikṣu vittāt tat sabhūmi puruṣavad dadāti / yathā puruṣamedhe yathā puruṣamedhe //
meaning: दक्षिणाकाले मध्यमं प्रतिराष्ट्रस्य यद् अन्यद् ब्राह्मणाद् दिक्षु वित्तात् तत् सभूमि पुरुषवद् ददाति / यथा पुरुषमेधे यथा पुरुषमेधे //
text_mt: At the time of the sacrificial gift, the middle [part] of the kingdom, whatever besides a brāhmaṇa is property in all directions, that he gives together with the land and with the people; as in the Puruṣamedha, as in the Puruṣamedha.

sanskrit_iast: śrutilakṣaṇaṃ prāyaścittaṃ vidhyaparādhe vidhīyate //
meaning: श्रुतिलक्षणं प्रायश्चित्तं विध्यपराधे विधीयते //
text_mt: An expiation characterized by scripture is prescribed in case of a transgression of a rule.

sanskrit_iast: ekasmin doṣe śrūyamāṇāni samabhyuccīyeran prāyaścittāny arthāntarasaṃyogāt //
meaning: एकस्मिन् दोषे श्रूयमाणानि समभ्युच्चीयेरन् प्रायश्चित्तान्य् अर्थान्तरसंयोगात् //
text_mt: When [several] expiations are taught for a single fault, they should be combined together, because they connect with different purposes.

sanskrit_iast: japo homa ijyā ca //
meaning: जपो होम इज्या च //

sanskrit_iast: doṣanirghātārthāni bhavanti //
meaning: दोषनिर्घातार्थानि भवन्ति //
text_mt: They serve the purpose of eliminating the fault.

sanskrit_iast: anantaraṃ doṣāt kartavyāni //
meaning: अनन्तरं दोषात् कर्तव्यानि //
text_mt: They are to be performed immediately after the fault.

sanskrit_iast: nirhṛte punardoṣe kṛtsnaṃ karma //
meaning: निर्हृते पुनर्दोषे कृत्स्नं कर्म //
text_mt: When the fault has been removed, the entire rite [is to be continued].

sanskrit_iast: tasya nāvacanāt punaḥ prayogaḥ //
meaning: तस्य नावचनात् पुनः प्रयोगः //
text_mt: There is no repetition of it, because there is no instruction [to that effect].

sanskrit_iast: tubhyaṃ tā aṅgirastama \\ ity anvāhitāgniḥ prayāsyañ juhuyāt //
meaning: तुभ्यं ता अङ्गिरस्तम \\ इत्य् अन्वाहिताग्निः प्रयास्यञ् जुहुयात् //
text_mt: With: “Unto you, O most Angiras-like…,” one who has fueled his fires, when intending to set out on a journey, should offer.

sanskrit_iast: pṛthag araṇīṣv agnīn samārohya prayāti //
meaning: पृथग् अरणीष्व् अग्नीन् समारोह्य प्रयाति //
text_mt: Having caused the fires to mount separately into the kindling sticks, he sets out.

sanskrit_iast: yatra vaset tadaitām iṣṭiṃ sam̐sthāpayet //
meaning: यत्र वसेत् तदैताम् इष्टिं सम्̐स्थापयेत् //
text_mt: Where he stays, there he should complete this rite.

sanskrit_iast: yady anvāhitāgner āhavanīyo 'nugacchet \\ anv agnir uṣasām agram akhyat \\ ity anyaṃ praṇīya yo agniṃ deva vītaye \ haviṣmām̐ ā vivāsati / \ tasmai pāvaka mṛḍaya svāhā \\ iti sruvāhutiṃ juhoti //
meaning: यद्य् अन्वाहिताग्नेर् आहवनीयो ऽनुगच्छेत् \\ अन्व् अग्निर् उषसाम् अग्रम् अख्यत् \\ इत्य् अन्यं प्रणीय यो अग्निं देव वीतये \ हविष्माम्̐ आ विवासति / \ तस्मै पावक मृडय स्वाहा \\ इति स्रुवाहुतिं जुहोति //
text_mt: If the āhavanīya of one who has fueled his fires should go out, having brought forward another [fire] with: “Fire has looked along after the vanguard of the dawns…,” he offers an offering with the sruva with: “Whoever, desiring the feast of the gods, O Fire, / serves [you] with oblations, / to him, O purifier, be gracious, svāhā!”

sanskrit_iast: yaḥ kaścanānugacched etad eva prāyaścittam //
meaning: यः कश्चनानुगच्छेद् एतद् एव प्रायश्चित्तम् //
text_mt: Whichever [fire] should go out, this is the very expiation.

sanskrit_iast: mathitvā gārhapatyam //
meaning: मथित्वा गार्हपत्यम् //

sanskrit_iast: praṇayanavarjam āvarteta //
meaning: प्रणयनवर्जम् आवर्तेत //
text_mt: [The ritual acts] are repeated with the exception of the bringing forward.

sanskrit_iast: yā prakṛtir dakṣiṇāgneḥ //
meaning: या प्रकृतिर् दक्षिणाग्नेः //
text_mt: Whatever is the regular archetype of the dakṣiṇāgni [is followed].

sanskrit_iast: bhūr ity upatiṣṭheta //
meaning: भूर् इत्य् उपतिष्ठेत //

sanskrit_iast: manasā vratopāyanīyaṃ yajur japet //
meaning: मनसा व्रतोपायनीयं यजुर् जपेत् //
text_mt: He should mutter mentally the yajus for undertaking the observance.

sanskrit_iast: idaṃ ta ekaṃ para uta ekam \\ tṛtīyena jyotiṣā saṃviśasva / \ saṃveśanas tanuvai cārur edhi \ priye devānāṃ parame janitre \\ ity anvāhitāgner agnim apakṣāyantam ā śamyāparāsāt saṃbharet //
meaning: इदं त एकं पर उत एकम् \\ तृतीयेन ज्योतिषा संविशस्व / \ संवेशनस् तनुवै चारुर् एधि \ प्रिये देवानां परमे जनित्रे \\ इत्य् अन्वाहिताग्नेर् अग्निम् अपक्षायन्तम् आ शम्यापरासात् संभरेत् //
text_mt: With: “This one of yours, and that one beyond; / enter into union with the third light; / be lovely in entering into union with the body, / dear in the highest birthplace of the gods,” he should gather up the fire of one who has fueled his fires that is burning away, up to the throw of a yoke-pin.

sanskrit_iast: parastarām̐ śamyāparāsād apakṣāyantam anu prayāyānvavasāya yajeta //
meaning: परस्तराम्̐ शम्यापरासाद् अपक्षायन्तम् अनु प्रयायान्ववसाय यजेत //
text_mt: If it burns away further than the throw of a yoke-pin, having followed after it and settled down, he should sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: agnaye pathikṛte puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet //
meaning: अग्नये पथिकृते पुरोडाशम् अष्टाकपालं निर्वपेत् //
text_mt: He should assign a sacrificial cake on eight potsherds to Agni Pathikṛt.

sanskrit_iast: patho 'ntikād barhir āharet //
meaning: पथो ऽन्तिकाद् बर्हिर् आहरेत् //
text_mt: He should bring sacred grass from near the road.

sanskrit_iast: anaḍvān dakṣiṇā //
meaning: अनड्वान् दक्षिणा //

sanskrit_iast: śvo bhūte gṛheṣu pratyavasyet //
meaning: श्वो भूते गृहेषु प्रत्यवस्येत् //
text_mt: On the next day, he should settle back into his house.

sanskrit_iast: yasya haviṣe vatsā apākṛtā dhayeyur vāyavyāṃ yavāgūṃ nirvapet //
meaning: यस्य हविषे वत्सा अपाकृता धयेयुर् वायव्यां यवागूं निर्वपेत् //
text_mt: If calves that have been separated suck [the mother cows] for his oblation, he should assign barley gruel to Vāyu.

sanskrit_iast: sā dohasthāne pratīyāt / anyatarasmād apākṛtā dhayeyuḥ //
meaning: सा दोहस्थाने प्रतीयात् / अन्यतरस्माद् अपाकृता धयेयुः //
text_mt: That should take the place of the milk. If they suck when separated from either one [of the two milkings]:

sanskrit_iast: athottarasmai haviṣe vatsān apākṛtyopavaset //
meaning: अथोत्तरस्मै हविषे वत्सान् अपाकृत्योपवसेत् //
text_mt: Then having separated the calves for the next oblation, he should fast.

sanskrit_iast: yasya sāyaṃ dugdham̐ havir ārtim ārcchatīndrāya vrīhīn nirupyopavaset //
meaning: यस्य सायं दुग्धम्̐ हविर् आर्तिम् आर्च्छतीन्द्राय व्रीहीन् निरुप्योपवसेत् //
text_mt: If one's evening-milked sacrificial oblation meets with mishap, having assigned rice grains to Indra, he should fast.

sanskrit_iast: yat prātaḥ syāt tac chṛtaṃ kuryāt //
meaning: यत् प्रातः स्यात् तच् छृतं कुर्यात् //
text_mt: Whatever there is in the morning, that he should boil.

sanskrit_iast: athottara aindraḥ puroḍāśo bhavati //
meaning: अथोत्तर ऐन्द्रः पुरोडाशो भवति //
text_mt: Then the second [offering] is a sacrificial cake to Indra.

sanskrit_iast: prātardohenātra samavadāya pracarati //
meaning: प्रातर्दोहेनात्र समवदाय प्रचरति //
text_mt: Here, cutting portions together with the morning milk, he proceeds.

sanskrit_iast: athottarasmai haviṣe vatsānapākṛtyopavaset //
meaning: अथोत्तरस्मै हविषे वत्सानपाकृत्योपवसेत् //
text_mt: Then having separated the calves for the next oblation, he should fast.

sanskrit_iast: etad eva pratardohasyārtigatasya prāyaścittam //
meaning: एतद् एव प्रतर्दोहस्यार्तिगतस्य प्रायश्चित्तम् //
text_mt: This is the very expiation for the morning milk that has met with mishap.

sanskrit_iast: sāyaṃdohenātra samavadāya pracarati //
meaning: सायंदोहेनात्र समवदाय प्रचरति //
text_mt: Here, cutting portions together with the evening milk, he proceeds.

sanskrit_iast: athottarasmai haviṣe vatsān apākṛtyopavaset //
meaning: अथोत्तरस्मै हविषे वत्सान् अपाकृत्योपवसेत् //
text_mt: Then having separated the calves for the next oblation, he should fast.

sanskrit_iast: yasya sāyaṃprātar dugdham̐ havir ārtim ārcchaty aindraṃ pañcaśarāvam odanaṃ pacet //
meaning: यस्य सायंप्रातर् दुग्धम्̐ हविर् आर्तिम् आर्च्छत्य् ऐन्द्रं पञ्चशरावम् ओदनं पचेत् //
text_mt: If one's both evening- and morning-milked sacrificial oblation meets with mishap, he should cook a five-cup mess of boiled rice for Indra.

sanskrit_iast: agniṃ prathamaṃ puroḍāśena yajeta //
meaning: अग्निं प्रथमं पुरोडाशेन यजेत //
text_mt: He should first sacrifice to Agni with a sacrificial cake.

sanskrit_iast: uttaram indraṃ pañcaśarāveṇa //
meaning: उत्तरम् इन्द्रं पञ्चशरावेण //
text_mt: Next, to Indra with the five-cup mess.

sanskrit_iast: athottarasmai haviṣe vatsān apākṛtyopavaset //
meaning: अथोत्तरस्मै हविषे वत्सान् अपाकृत्योपवसेत् //
text_mt: Then having separated the calves for the next oblation, he should fast.

sanskrit_iast: yasya vratye 'han patny anālambhukā bhavati tām aparudhya yajeta //
meaning: यस्य व्रत्ये ऽहन् पत्न्य् अनालम्भुका भवति ताम् अपरुध्य यजेत //
text_mt: If one's wife becomes menstruating on the day of the observance, having shut her out, he should sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: udakaśulbam̐ stṛṇīyāt //
meaning: उदकशुल्बम्̐ स्तृणीयात् //

sanskrit_iast: tām iṣṭvā trirātre snātām upahūyeta // amūham asmi sā tvam \\ dyaur ahaṃ pṛthivī tvam \\ sāmāham ṛk tvam \\ tāv ehi saṃbhavāva \ saha reto dadhāvahai \ pum̐se putrāya vettavai \ rāyaspoṣāya suprajāstvāya suvīryāya \\ iti / ardha evainām upahvayate saiva tataḥ prāyaścittiḥ //
meaning: ताम् इष्ट्वा त्रिरात्रे स्नाताम् उपहूयेत // अमूहम् अस्मि सा त्वम् \\ द्यौर् अहं पृथिवी त्वम् \\ सामाहम् ऋक् त्वम् \\ ताव् एहि संभवाव \ सह रेतो दधावहै \ पुम्̐से पुत्राय वेत्तवै \ रायस्पोषाय सुप्रजास्त्वाय सुवीर्याय \\ इति / अर्ध एवैनाम् उपह्वयते सैव ततः प्रायश्चित्तिः //
text_mt: Having sacrificed, when she has bathed after three nights, she should be invited: “That [man] am I, this [woman] are you; / heaven am I, earth are you; / the Sāman am I, the Ṛc are you; / come then, let us unite; / let us deposit semen together, / to obtain a male son, / for the increase of wealth, for good offspring, for heroic vigor.” In the middle [of the night] he invites her; that itself is the expiation for it.

sanskrit_iast: yadi sāṃnāyyam agnihotraṃ vā viṣyandeta / yadi vā kīṭo 'vapadyeta / madhyamena palāśaparṇenāntamena vodak paretya prājāpatyayarcā valmīkavapāyāṃ viṣyandamānam avanīya bhūr ity upatiṣṭheta //
meaning: यदि सांनाय्यम् अग्निहोत्रं वा विष्यन्देत / यदि वा कीटो ऽवपद्येत / मध्यमेन पलाशपर्णेनान्तमेन वोदक् परेत्य प्राजापत्ययर्चा वल्मीकवपायां विष्यन्दमानम् अवनीय भूर् इत्य् उपतिष्ठेत //
text_mt: If the curd-and-milk oblation or the Agnihotra should spill, or if an insect should fall into it, having gone north with the middle or the end leaf of a palāśa tree, having poured the spilled liquid upon the mound of an anthill with a verse addressed to Prajāpati, he should worship with: “Bhūḥ.”

sanskrit_iast: madhyamenaiva palāśaparṇena dyāvāpṛthivyayarcāntaḥparidhi kīṭāvapannam avanīya bhūr ity upatiṣṭheta //
meaning: मध्यमेनैव पलाशपर्णेन द्यावापृथिव्ययर्चान्तःपरिधि कीटावपन्नम् अवनीय भूर् इत्य् उपतिष्ठेत //
text_mt: With the middle palāśa leaf itself, having poured that into which an insect has fallen within the enclosing sticks with a verse addressed to Heaven and Earth, he should worship with: “Bhūḥ.”

sanskrit_iast: yadi sāṃnāyyam anyad āgamayet //
meaning: यदि सांनाय्यम् अन्यद् आगमयेत् //
text_mt: If it is the curd-and-milk oblation, he should procure another.

sanskrit_iast: yady agnihotram anyāṃ dugdhvā punar juhuyāt \\ mitro janān kalpayati prajānan \ mitro dādhāra pṛthivīm uta dyām / \ mitraḥ kṛṣṭīr animiṣābhicaṣṭe \ satyāya havyaṃ ghṛtavaj juhota \\ ity abhivṛṣṭam agnihotram̐ hutvānyāṃ dugdhvā punar juhuyāt //
meaning: यद्य् अग्निहोत्रम् अन्यां दुग्ध्वा पुनर् जुहुयात् \\ मित्रो जनान् कल्पयति प्रजानन् \ मित्रो दाधार पृथिवीम् उत द्याम् / \ मित्रः कृष्टीर् अनिमिषाभिचष्टे \ सत्याय हव्यं घृतवज् जुहोत \\ इत्य् अभिवृष्टम् अग्निहोत्रम्̐ हुत्वान्यां दुग्ध्वा पुनर् जुहुयात् //
text_mt: If it is the Agnihotra, having milked another [cow], he should offer again. Having offered the Agnihotra on which rain has fallen with: “Mitra arranges the peoples, knowing well; / Mitra has supported earth and heaven; / Mitra looks upon the settlements unblinking; / offer to the true one the oblation rich in clarified butter,” and having milked another, he should offer again.

sanskrit_iast: yadi pūrvasyām āhutyām̐ hutāyām uttarāhutiḥ skandet pūrvāṃ cottarayābhihutya yatra vettha vanaspate \ devānāṃ guhyā nāmāni / \ tatra havyāni gāmaya \\ iti vānaspatyayarcā samidham ādhāya tūṣṇīm eva punar juhuyāt //
meaning: यदि पूर्वस्याम् आहुत्याम्̐ हुतायाम् उत्तराहुतिः स्कन्देत् पूर्वां चोत्तरयाभिहुत्य यत्र वेत्थ वनस्पते \ देवानां गुह्या नामानि / \ तत्र हव्यानि गामय \\ इति वानस्पत्ययर्चा समिधम् आधाय तूष्णीम् एव पुनर् जुहुयात् //
text_mt: If, when the first offering has been offered, the second offering should spill, having poured over the first with the second, having placed a piece of firewood with a verse addressed to Vanaspati: “Where you know, O lord of the forest, / the secret names of the gods, / there make the oblations go,” he should offer again silently.

sanskrit_iast: yadi pūrvasyām āhutyām̐ hutāyām āhavanīyo 'nugacchet \\ agnir dārau dārāv agnis \\ iti vadann anantare śakale hiraṇye vā juhuyāt //
meaning: यदि पूर्वस्याम् आहुत्याम्̐ हुतायाम् आहवनीयो ऽनुगच्छेत् \\ अग्निर् दारौ दाराव् अग्निस् \\ इति वदन्न् अनन्तरे शकले हिरण्ये वा जुहुयात् //
text_mt: If, when the first offering has been offered, the āhavanīya should go out, saying: “Fire in wood, in wood fire,” he should offer upon an immediate wood chip or upon gold.

sanskrit_iast: yadi purā prayājebhyo bahiṣparidhy āhavanīyāt prācīnam aṅgāro nivartetādhvaryave ca yajamānāya cākam̐ syāt / yadi dakṣiṇā brahmaṇe ca yajamānāya cākam̐ syāt / yadi pratyag ghotre ca patniyai ca yajamānāya cākam̐ syāt / yady udaṅ agnīdhe ca paśubhyaś ca yajamānāya cākam̐ syāt / mā tamo mā yajñas tamat \\ mā yajamānas tat \\ namas te astv āyate \ namo rudra parāyate \ namo yatra niṣīdasi \\ adhvaryuṃ mā mā him̐sīs \\ yajamānaṃ mā him̐sīs \\ iti tam̐ sruvasya budhnenābhividadhyāt // yadi prācīnaṃ nivartetaivam itarāsu dikṣu brahmāṇaṃ mā him̐sīs \\ yajamānaṃ mā him̐sīs \\ iti dakṣiṇato mantram̐ saṃnamati // hotāraṃ mā him̐sīḥ \ patnīṃ mā him̐sīs \\ yajamānaṃ mā him̐sīs \\ iti paścāt / āgnīdhraṃ mā him̐sīs \\ yajamānasya paśūn mā him̐sīs \ yajamānaṃ mā him̐sīs \\ ity uttarataḥ //
meaning: यदि पुरा प्रयाजेभ्यो बहिष्परिध्य् आहवनीयात् प्राचीनम् अङ्गारो निवर्तेताध्वर्यवे च यजमानाय चाकम्̐ स्यात् / यदि दक्षिणा ब्रह्मणे च यजमानाय चाकम्̐ स्यात् / यदि प्रत्यग् घोत्रे च पत्नियै च यजमानाय चाकम्̐ स्यात् / यद्य् उदङ् अग्नीधे च पशुभ्यश् च यजमानाय चाकम्̐ स्यात् / मा तमो मा यज्ञस् तमत् \\ मा यजमानस् तत् \\ नमस् ते अस्त्व् आयते \ नमो रुद्र परायते \ नमो यत्र निषीदसि \\ अध्वर्युं मा मा हिम्̐सीस् \\ यजमानं मा हिम्̐सीस् \\ इति तम्̐ स्रुवस्य बुध्नेनाभिविदध्यात् // यदि प्राचीनं निवर्तेतैवम् इतरासु दिक्षु ब्रह्माणं मा हिम्̐सीस् \\ यजमानं मा हिम्̐सीस् \\ इति दक्षिणतो मन्त्रम्̐ संनमति // होतारं मा हिम्̐सीः \ पत्नीं मा हिम्̐सीस् \\ यजमानं मा हिम्̐सीस् \\ इति पश्चात् / आग्नीध्रं मा हिम्̐सीस् \\ यजमानस्य पशून् मा हिम्̐सीस् \ यजमानं मा हिम्̐सीस् \\ इत्य् उत्तरतः //
text_mt: If before the fore-offerings a burning coal should roll away from the āhavanīya fire outside the enclosing sticks eastward, harm would come to the adhvaryu and the sacrificer; if southward, harm would come to the brahman priest and the sacrificer; if westward, harm would come to the hotṛ, the sacrificer's wife, and the sacrificer; if northward, harm would come to the agnīdh, the livestock, and the sacrificer. [The adhvaryu] should cover it with the bottom of the spoon, saying: ‘Let not darkness [befall], let not the sacrifice faint, / let not the sacrificer faint. / Homage be to you arriving, / homage, O Rudra, departing, / homage where you sit down! / Do not harm the adhvaryu, / do not harm the sacrificer!’ If it rolls away to the east. In the other directions he adapts the mantra: ‘Do not harm the brahman priest, / do not harm the sacrificer’—thus to the south; ‘Do not harm the hotṛ, / do not harm the sacrificer's wife, / do not harm the sacrificer’—thus to the west; ‘Do not harm the āgnīdhra priest, / do not harm the cattle of the sacrificer, / do not harm the sacrificer’—thus to the north.

sanskrit_iast: sahasraśṛṅgo vṛṣabho jātavedāḥ \ stomapṛṣṭho ghṛtavān supratīkaḥ / \ mā no hāsīn metthito net tvā jahāma \ gopoṣaṃ no vīrapoṣaṃ ca yaccha \\ ity enam agnau praharati //
meaning: सहस्रशृङ्गो वृषभो जातवेदाः \ स्तोमपृष्ठो घृतवान् सुप्रतीकः / \ मा नो हासीन् मेत्थितो नेत् त्वा जहाम \ गोपोषं नो वीरपोषं च यच्छ \\ इत्य् एनम् अग्नौ प्रहरति //
text_mt: ‘Thousand-horned bull, Jātavedas, / praise-backed, possessing ghee, of fair appearance, / do not abandon us, being provoked, lest we abandon you; / grant us increase of cattle and increase of heroes!’ / With this [mantra] he throws it into the fire.

sanskrit_iast: prahṛtya vābhijuhuyāt //
meaning: प्रहृत्य वाभिजुहुयात् //
text_mt: Or, having thrown it [into the fire], he should offer over it.

sanskrit_iast: yady āhitāgner agnir mathyamānaḥ kālasaṃnikarṣeṇa na jāyeta yatrānyaṃ paśyet tata āhṛtya vihṛtya hutvātvaramāṇaḥ punar manthet //
meaning: यद्य् आहिताग्नेर् अग्निर् मथ्यमानः कालसंनिकर्षेण न जायेत यत्रान्यं पश्येत् तत आहृत्य विहृत्य हुत्वात्वरमाणः पुनर् मन्थेत् //
text_mt: If the fire of one who has set up the sacred fires, while being churned, is not produced because the time has run short, he should fetch [fire] from wherever he sees another, spread it, make the offering, and then, without hurrying, churn again.

sanskrit_iast: anyam avindann ajāyā dakṣiṇe karṇe juhuyāt //
meaning: अन्यम् अविन्दन्न् अजाया दक्षिणे कर्णे जुहुयात् //
text_mt: Not finding another [fire], he should offer into the right ear of a she-goat.

sanskrit_iast: ajasyety ekeṣām //
meaning: अजस्येत्य् एकेषाम् //

sanskrit_iast: ajasya tu tato nāśnīyāt //
meaning: अजस्य तु ततो नाश्नीयात् //
text_mt: However, one should not eat [the meat] of that he-goat thereafter.

sanskrit_iast: ajām avindan brāhmaṇasya dakṣiṇe haste juhuyāt //
meaning: अजाम् अविन्दन् ब्राह्मणस्य दक्षिणे हस्ते जुहुयात् //
text_mt: Not finding a she-goat, he should offer into the right hand of a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇaṃ tu vasatyai nāparundhyāt //
meaning: ब्राह्मणं तु वसत्यै नापरुन्ध्यात् //
text_mt: However, one should not refuse shelter to that brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇaṃ tv avindan darbhastambe juhuyāt //
meaning: ब्राह्मणं त्व् अविन्दन् दर्भस्तम्बे जुहुयात् //
text_mt: Not finding a brāhmaṇa, he should offer into a clump of darbha grass.

sanskrit_iast: darbhām̐s tu nādhyāsīta //
meaning: दर्भाम्̐स् तु नाध्यासीत //
text_mt: However, one should not sit upon darbha grass.

sanskrit_iast: darbhānn avindann apsu juhuyāt //
meaning: दर्भान्न् अविन्दन्न् अप्सु जुहुयात् //
text_mt: Not finding darbha grass, he should offer into water.

sanskrit_iast: āpas tu na paricakṣītemā bhojanīyā imā abhojanīyā iti //
meaning: आपस् तु न परिचक्षीतेमा भोजनीया इमा अभोजनीया इति //
text_mt: However, one should not disparage waters, saying: ‘These are fit to consume, these are unfit to consume.’

sanskrit_iast: apy abhojanīyasyaitaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ parigṛhṇīyād evāpaḥ //
meaning: अप्य् अभोजनीयस्यैतं संवत्सरं परिगृह्णीयाद् एवापः //
text_mt: For this year he should accept even waters that are unfit to consume.

sanskrit_iast: adbhis tu pādau na prakṣālayīta //
meaning: अद्भिस् तु पादौ न प्रक्षालयीत //
text_mt: However, he should not wash his feet with water.

sanskrit_iast: saṃvatsarikāṇy etāni vratāni bhavanti //
meaning: संवत्सरिकाण्य् एतानि व्रतानि भवन्ति //
text_mt: These ritual observances are to last for a year.

sanskrit_iast: saṃvatsare 'gnaye vratapataye puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet //
meaning: संवत्सरे ऽग्नये व्रतपतये पुरोडाशम् अष्टाकपालं निर्वपेत् //
text_mt: After a year, he should offer an eight-pot-sherd sacrificial cake to Agni Vratapati (Lord of Observances).

sanskrit_iast: agnaye kṣāmavate 'ṣṭākapālam / yady āhitāgner agnir gṛhān dahet //
meaning: अग्नये क्षामवते ऽष्टाकपालम् / यद्य् आहिताग्नेर् अग्निर् गृहान् दहेत् //
text_mt: An eight-pot-sherd [cake] to Agni Kṣāmavat (the Burner), if the fire of one who has set up the sacred fires burns down his house.

sanskrit_iast: agnaye vivicaye 'ṣṭākapālaṃ yasyānyair agnibhir agnayaḥ sam̐sṛjyeran mitho vā //
meaning: अग्नये विविचये ऽष्टाकपालं यस्यान्यैर् अग्निभिर् अग्नयः सम्̐सृज्येरन् मिथो वा //
text_mt: An eight-pot-sherd [cake] to Agni Vivici (the Separator) for him whose fires mingle with other fires or with one another.

sanskrit_iast: agnaye vītaye 'ṣṭākapālaṃ yadi gārhapatyadakṣiṇāgnī sam̐sṛjyeyātām //
meaning: अग्नये वीतये ऽष्टाकपालं यदि गार्हपत्यदक्षिणाग्नी सम्̐सृज्येयाताम् //
text_mt: An eight-pot-sherd [cake] to Agni Vīti (the Feast) if the gārhapatya and dakṣiṇāgni fires mingle together.

sanskrit_iast: agnaye vipṛcaye 'ṣṭākapālaṃ yadi gārhapatyāhavanīyau / gārhapatyadakṣiṇāgnī ity ekeṣām //
meaning: अग्नये विपृचये ऽष्टाकपालं यदि गार्हपत्याहवनीयौ / गार्हपत्यदक्षिणाग्नी इत्य् एकेषाम् //
text_mt: An eight-pot-sherd [cake] to Agni Vipṛc (the Disjoiner) if the gārhapatya and āhavanīya fires [mingle]; ‘if the gārhapatya and dakṣiṇāgni fires [mingle],’ according to some.

sanskrit_iast: agnaye vratabhṛte 'ṣṭākapālaṃ yady abhyādāhyena //
meaning: अग्नये व्रतभृते ऽष्टाकपालं यद्य् अभ्यादाह्येन //
text_mt: An eight-pot-sherd [cake] to Agni Vratabhṛt (the Maintainer of Observances) if [a fire mingles] with a burning fire.

sanskrit_iast: agnaye śucaye 'ṣṭākapālaṃ yadi śavāgninā // agnaye saṃkusukāyāṣṭākapālaṃ yadi sūtakāgninā //
meaning: अग्नये शुचये ऽष्टाकपालं यदि शवाग्निना // अग्नये संकुसुकायाष्टाकपालं यदि सूतकाग्निना //
text_mt: An eight-pot-sherd [cake] to Agni Śuci (the Pure) if [it mingles] with a funeral pyre fire; an eight-pot-sherd [cake] to Agni Saṃkusuka if with a childbirth fire.

sanskrit_iast: saṃkusuko vikusukas \\ vikiro yaś ca viṣkiraḥ / \ māṣājyena naledhmena \ kravyādam̐ śamayāmasi / \ asmin vayaṃ saṃkusuke \\ agnau riprāṇi mṛjmahe / \ abhūma yajñiyāḥ śuddhāḥ \ pra ṇa āyūm̐ṣi tāriṣat \\ iti yājyānuvākye //
meaning: संकुसुको विकुसुकस् \\ विकिरो यश् च विष्किरः / \ माषाज्येन नलेध्मेन \ क्रव्यादम्̐ शमयामसि / \ अस्मिन् वयं संकुसुके \\ अग्नौ रिप्राणि मृज्महे / \ अभूम यज्ञियाः शुद्धाः \ प्र ण आयूम्̐षि तारिषत् \\ इति याज्यानुवाक्ये //
text_mt: ‘Saṃkusuka, Vikusuka, / Vikira, and Viṣkira: / with bean-ghee and reed-kindling / we appease the corpse-devourer. / In this Saṃkusuka / fire we wipe away defilements; / we have become worthy of sacrifice, pure; / may he lengthen our lifespans!’ / These are the offering and introductory verses.

sanskrit_iast: agnaye 'psumate 'ṣṭākapālaṃ yadi vaidyutena //
meaning: अग्नये ऽप्सुमते ऽष्टाकपालं यदि वैद्युतेन //
text_mt: An eight-pot-sherd [cake] to Agni Apsumat (Possessing Waters) if [it mingles] with lightning fire.

sanskrit_iast: sarve saṃnipaterann agnaye vivicaye nirupyāgnaye śucaye nirvapati / vrātabhṛtīṃ tṛtīyām apsumatīṃ caturthīṃ kṣāmavatīm antataḥ parikramayet //
meaning: सर्वे संनिपतेरन्न् अग्नये विविचये निरुप्याग्नये शुचये निर्वपति / व्रातभृतीं तृतीयाम् अप्सुमतीं चतुर्थीं क्षामवतीम् अन्ततः परिक्रमयेत् //
text_mt: If all [such fires] should mingle together, having offered to Agni Vivici, he offers to Agni Śuci; he should arrange the offering to Vratabhṛt as third, that to Apsumat as fourth, and that to Kṣāmavat at the end.

sanskrit_iast: vrātabhṛtīṃ dvitīyām eke samāmananti / vrātapatīm uttamām //
meaning: व्रातभृतीं द्वितीयाम् एके समामनन्ति / व्रातपतीम् उत्तमाम् //
text_mt: Some tradition prescribes the offering to Vratabhṛt as second, and that to Vratapati as last.

sanskrit_iast: garbham̐ sravantam agadam akar \ agnir indras tvaṣṭā bṛhaspatiḥ / \ pṛthivyām avacuścotaitat \\ nābhiprāpnoti nirṛtiṃ parācais \\ ity agnihotrasthālīm̐ sravantīm abhimantrayeta //
meaning: गर्भम्̐ स्रवन्तम् अगदम् अकर् \ अग्निर् इन्द्रस् त्वष्टा बृहस्पतिः / \ पृथिव्याम् अवचुश्चोतैतत् \\ नाभिप्राप्नोति निरृतिं पराचैस् \\ इत्य् अग्निहोत्रस्थालीम्̐ स्रवन्तीम् अभिमन्त्रयेत //
text_mt: ‘The leaking embryo Agni, Indra, / Tvaṣṭṛ, and Bṛhaspati have cured; / let this, which trickled down onto the earth, / not reach Nirṛti far away!’ / With this [mantra] he should recite over a leaking Agnihotra pot.

sanskrit_iast: yasya havir niruptaṃ purastāc candramā abhyudeti tredhā taṇḍulān vibhajed ye madhyamāḥ syus tān agnaye dātre puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālaṃ kuryād ye sthaviṣṭhās tān indrāya pradātre dadham̐ś caruṃ ye 'ṇiṣṭhās tān viṣṇave śipiviṣṭāya śṛte carum agnir evāsmai prajāṃ prajanayatīti //
meaning: यस्य हविर् निरुप्तं पुरस्ताच् चन्द्रमा अभ्युदेति त्रेधा तण्डुलान् विभजेद् ये मध्यमाः स्युस् तान् अग्नये दात्रे पुरोडाशम् अष्टाकपालं कुर्याद् ये स्थविष्ठास् तान् इन्द्राय प्रदात्रे दधम्̐श् चरुं ये ऽणिष्ठास् तान् विष्णवे शिपिविष्टाय शृते चरुम् अग्निर् एवास्मै प्रजां प्रजनयतीति //
text_mt: For him whose sacrificial oblation has been measured out and the moon rises in the east, he should divide the rice grains into three parts: those which are medium-sized he should make into an eight-pot-sherd sacrificial cake for Agni the Giver; those which are largest, into a boiled-rice mess in curd for Indra the Bestower; those which are smallest, into a boiled-rice mess in boiled milk for Viṣṇu Śipiviṣṭa; ‘Agni indeed generates offspring for him,’ so [states a Brāhmaṇa].

sanskrit_iast: anirupte 'bhyudite //
meaning: अनिरुप्ते ऽभ्युदिते //

sanskrit_iast: vyṛddhabhāgbhyo nirvapet //
meaning: व्यृद्धभाग्भ्यो निर्वपेत् //
text_mt: he should measure it out for the deities of the expiatory shares.

sanskrit_iast: tathaikadeśe nirupte 'bhyudite vyṛddhabhāgbhyaḥ śeṣam //
meaning: तथैकदेशे निरुप्ते ऽभ्युदिते व्यृद्धभाग्भ्यः शेषम् //
text_mt: Similarly, if it rises when a portion has been measured out, [he should measure out] the remainder for the deities of the expiatory shares.

sanskrit_iast: tām iṣṭim̐ sam̐sthāpya vatsān apākṛtya śvaḥ sāṃnāyyena yajeta //
meaning: ताम् इष्टिम्̐ सम्̐स्थाप्य वत्सान् अपाकृत्य श्वः सांनाय्येन यजेत //
text_mt: Having concluded that offering, having driven away the calves, he should sacrifice the next day with the curd-and-milk oblation.

sanskrit_iast: agnaye pathikṛte puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālaṃ nirvaped yo darśapūrṇamāsayājī sann amāvāsyāṃ vā paurṇamāsīṃ vātipādayed iti //
meaning: अग्नये पथिकृते पुरोडाशम् अष्टाकपालं निर्वपेद् यो दर्शपूर्णमासयाजी सन्न् अमावास्यां वा पौर्णमासीं वातिपादयेद् इति //
text_mt: He who, being a performer of the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices, fails to perform on the New Moon day or the Full Moon day should offer an eight-pot-sherd sacrificial cake to Agni Pathikṛt (the Maker of Paths).

sanskrit_iast: vi vā etasya yajñaś chidyate yasya yajñe pratate 'ntar etām iṣṭiṃ nirvapanti / ya evāsāv āgneyo 'ṣṭākapālo 'māvāsyāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ tam evāgnaye pathikṛte kuryāt tenaiva panthāṃ punar evaiti na yajñaṃ vicchinattīti vijñāyate //
meaning: वि वा एतस्य यज्ञश् छिद्यते यस्य यज्ञे प्रतते ऽन्तर् एताम् इष्टिं निर्वपन्ति / य एवासाव् आग्नेयो ऽष्टाकपालो ऽमावास्यायां पौर्णमास्यां तम् एवाग्नये पथिकृते कुर्यात् तेनैव पन्थां पुनर् एवैति न यज्ञं विच्छिनत्तीति विज्ञायते //
text_mt: ‘The sacrifice of that person is indeed severed, between whose extended sacrifice they offer this offering; that very eight-pot-sherd [cake] intended for Agni at the New Moon or the Full Moon rite he should assign to Agni Pathikṛt; through that very [offering] he returns to the path and does not sever the sacrifice,’ so it is known [from the Brāhmaṇa].

sanskrit_iast: pravṛttasya kālātinaye 'pravṛttasya vaiśvānary agnaye vratapataye puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet //
meaning: प्रवृत्तस्य कालातिनये ऽप्रवृत्तस्य वैश्वानर्य् अग्नये व्रतपतये पुरोडाशम् अष्टाकपालं निर्वपेत् //
text_mt: When the time has passed for one whose [rite] has commenced, [he should offer a sacrificial cake to Vaiśvānara]; if it has not commenced, an offering to Vaiśvānara [and] an eight-pot-sherd sacrificial cake to Agni Vratapati should be offered.

sanskrit_iast: ya āhitāgniḥ sann avratyam iva caret / ya āhitāgniḥ pravased ity ekeṣām //
meaning: य आहिताग्निः सन्न् अव्रत्यम् इव चरेत् / य आहिताग्निः प्रवसेद् इत्य् एकेषाम् //
text_mt: For one who, being one who has set up the sacred fires, behaves as if lacking ritual observance; ‘for one who, being one who has set up the sacred fires, goes on a journey,’ according to some [teachers].

sanskrit_iast: agnaye vratabhṛte 'ṣṭākapālaṃ ya āhitāgnir ārtijam aśru kuryāt / vrātabhṛtīṃ pravāsa eke samāmananti / vrātapatīm aśrukarmaṇi //
meaning: अग्नये व्रतभृते ऽष्टाकपालं य आहिताग्निर् आर्तिजम् अश्रु कुर्यात् / व्रातभृतीं प्रवास एके समामनन्ति / व्रातपतीम् अश्रुकर्मणि //
text_mt: An eight-pot-sherd [cake] to Agni Vratabhṛt for one who, being one who has set up the sacred fires, sheds tears born of distress; some tradition prescribes the offering to Vratabhṛt in the case of going on a journey, and that to Vratapati in the case of shedding tears.

sanskrit_iast: tvam agne vratabhṛc chucir \ devām̐ āsādayā iha / \ agne havyāya voḍhave // \ vratā nu bibhrad vratapā adābhyas \\ yajā no devām̐ ajaraḥ suvīraḥ / \ dadhad ratnāni suvidāno agne \ gopāya no jīvase jātavedas \\ iti yājyānuvākye //
meaning: त्वम् अग्ने व्रतभृच् छुचिर् \ देवाम्̐ आसादया इह / \ अग्ने हव्याय वोढवे // \ व्रता नु बिभ्रद् व्रतपा अदाभ्यस् \\ यजा नो देवाम्̐ अजरः सुवीरः / \ दधद् रत्नानि सुविदानो अग्ने \ गोपाय नो जीवसे जातवेदस् \\ इति याज्यानुवाक्ये //
text_mt: ‘You, O pure Agni, maintainer of observances, / seat the gods here, / O Agni, to bear the oblation!’ / ‘Bearing observances now, protector of observances, unassailable, / unaging, with good heroes, sacrifice to the gods for us; / bestowing treasures, being well disposed, O Agni, / Jātavedas, protect us so that we may live!’ / These are the offering and introductory verses.

sanskrit_iast: yasmād bhīṣā niṣīdasi \ tato no abhayaṃ kṛdhi / \ prajābhyaḥ sarvābhyo mṛḍa \ namo rudrāya mīḍhuṣe \\ ity abhimantrayeta //
meaning: यस्माद् भीषा निषीदसि \ ततो नो अभयं कृधि / \ प्रजाभ्यः सर्वाभ्यो मृड \ नमो रुद्राय मीढुषे \\ इत्य् अभिमन्त्रयेत //
text_mt: ‘That from fear of which you sit down, / from that make us free from danger! / Have mercy on all our children; / homage to Rudra the bountiful!’ / With this [mantra] he should address [the cow].

sanskrit_iast: yady agnihotry upasṛṣṭopasannā vā niṣīdet \\ udasthād devy aditir viśvarūpī \\ āyur yajñapatāv adhāt / \ indrāya kṛṇvatī bhāgam \\ mitrāya varuṇāya ca \\ iti tām utthāpya dugdhvā brāhmaṇāya dadyāt //
meaning: यद्य् अग्निहोत्र्य् उपसृष्टोपसन्ना वा निषीदेत् \\ उदस्थाद् देव्य् अदितिर् विश्वरूपी \\ आयुर् यज्ञपताव् अधात् / \ इन्द्राय कृण्वती भागम् \\ मित्राय वरुणाय च \\ इति ताम् उत्थाप्य दुग्ध्वा ब्राह्मणाय दद्यात् //
text_mt: If the Agnihotra cow, having been approached or having had the calf let loose to her, should sit down, having raised her with: ‘Divine Aditi, of all shapes, has stood up; / she has placed life in the lord of the sacrifice, / making a portion for Indra, / for Mitra, and for Varuṇa!’ / and having milked her, he should give [the milk] to a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast: yasyānnaṃ nādyād api vaināṃ daṇḍena vipiṣyāvipiṣya votthāpyātman kurvīta sūyavasād bhagavatī hi bhūyās \\ atho vayaṃ bhagavantaḥ syāma / \ addhi tṛṇam aghnye viśvadānīm \\ piba śuddham udakam ācarantī \\ iti darbhastambam ālupya grāsayet //
meaning: यस्यान्नं नाद्याद् अपि वैनां दण्डेन विपिष्याविपिष्य वोत्थाप्यात्मन् कुर्वीत सूयवसाद् भगवती हि भूयास् \\ अथो वयं भगवन्तः स्याम / \ अद्धि तृणम् अघ्न्ये विश्वदानीम् \\ पिब शुद्धम् उदकम् आचरन्ती \\ इति दर्भस्तम्बम् आलुप्य ग्रासयेत् //
text_mt: One whose food one would not eat, or having struck her with a stick, or without having struck her, having made her stand up, he should appropriate her to himself. Plucking a clump of darbha-grass, he should feed it to her with the words: 'May you be fortunate with abundant pasture, and so may we be fortunate. Eat the grass at all times, O cow that should not be killed; drink pure water as you roam.'

sanskrit_iast: yadi duhyamānā vāśyeta yadi vā lohitaṃ duhīta vyutkrāmata \\ ity uktvā dakṣiṇāgniṃ pariśritya tasminn etam̐ śrapayitvā tasminn eva juhuyāt / tāṃ brāhmaṇāya dadyād yam anabhyāgamiṣyan manyeta //
meaning: यदि दुह्यमाना वाश्येत यदि वा लोहितं दुहीत व्युत्क्रामत \\ इत्य् उक्त्वा दक्षिणाग्निं परिश्रित्य तस्मिन्न् एतम्̐ श्रपयित्वा तस्मिन्न् एव जुहुयात् / तां ब्राह्मणाय दद्याद् यम् अनभ्यागमिष्यन् मन्येत //
text_mt: If while being milked she lows, or if she gives blood, having said 'Step away!', having enclosed the dakṣiṇāgni fire and having boiled this [milk] on it, he should offer it into that very fire. He should give her to a brāhmaṇa whom he expects not to return.

sanskrit_iast: yad adya dugdhaṃ pṛthivīm asakta \ yad oṣadhīr apyasarad yad āpaḥ / \ payo gṛheṣu payo aghniyāsu \ payo vatseṣu payo astu tan mayi \\ ity enad abhimantrya yadi duhyamānam̐ skandet samudraṃ vaḥ prahiṇomi \\ ity etayādbhir upaninīya tad eva yādṛk kīdṛg ghutvānyāṃ dugdhvā punar juhuyāt //
meaning: यद् अद्य दुग्धं पृथिवीम् असक्त \ यद् ओषधीर् अप्यसरद् यद् आपः / \ पयो गृहेषु पयो अघ्नियासु \ पयो वत्सेषु पयो अस्तु तन् मयि \\ इत्य् एनद् अभिमन्त्र्य यदि दुह्यमानम्̐ स्कन्देत् समुद्रं वः प्रहिणोमि \\ इत्य् एतयाद्भिर् उपनिनीय तद् एव यादृक् कीदृग् घुत्वान्यां दुग्ध्वा पुनर् जुहुयात् //
text_mt: If while being milked [the milk] spills, having addressed it with the mantra: 'What milk today has adhered to the earth, what has reached the plants, what the waters, let milk be in our houses, milk in the cows, milk in the calves, and let that milk be in me!', having poured water after it with the verse: 'I send you to the ocean…', and having offered whatever of it remains, having milked another cow, he should offer again.

sanskrit_iast: api vā tāṃ caiva duhyād anyāṃ vā yadi bhindyād anyām̐ sthālīṃ nirṇijyāthānyāṃ duhyād udakaṃ tv anuparāsicyam //
meaning: अपि वा तां चैव दुह्याद् अन्यां वा यदि भिन्द्याद् अन्याम्̐ स्थालीं निर्णिज्याथान्यां दुह्याद् उदकं त्व् अनुपरासिच्यम् //
text_mt: Or else he may milk that very same cow, or another one. If [the milk-pail] should break, having cleansed another pot, he should milk another cow, but water must be poured around it.

sanskrit_iast: yadi dugdham̐ skanded yadi hriyamāṇaṃ yady adhiśrīyamāṇaṃ yady adhiśritaṃ yady udvāsyamānaṃ yady udvāsitam anyām abhiduhyāt //
meaning: यदि दुग्धम्̐ स्कन्देद् यदि ह्रियमाणं यद्य् अधिश्रीयमाणं यद्य् अधिश्रितं यद्य् उद्वास्यमानं यद्य् उद्वासितम् अन्याम् अभिदुह्यात् //
text_mt: If the milked milk spills, whether while being carried, or while being placed over [the fire], or when placed over [the fire], or while being removed, or when removed, he should milk another cow.

sanskrit_iast: atha yady unnītam̐ skanded yadi dvir yadi trir na tad ādriyetety ekeṣām / caturtham unnīyamānam̐ skandet sthālyām̐ śeṣam ānīya tataś caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvā vāruṇīm ṛcam anūcya vāruṇyarcā juhuyāt //
meaning: अथ यद्य् उन्नीतम्̐ स्कन्देद् यदि द्विर् यदि त्रिर् न तद् आद्रियेतेत्य् एकेषाम् / चतुर्थम् उन्नीयमानम्̐ स्कन्देत् स्थाल्याम्̐ शेषम् आनीय ततश् चतुर्गृहीतं गृहीत्वा वारुणीम् ऋचम् अनूच्य वारुण्यर्चा जुहुयात् //
text_mt: Now, if what has been ladled out spills, whether a second time or a third time, one should pay no regard to it, according to some. If it spills while being ladled out a fourth time, having poured what remains in the pot, and having then taken four ladlings from it, having recited an introductory verse to Varuṇa, he should make an offering with a verse to Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast: yady unnītam̐ skandet punar abhyunnīya hotavyam athājyena vāruṇīm ṛcam anūcya vāruṇyarcā juhuyāt //
meaning: यद्य् उन्नीतम्̐ स्कन्देत् पुनर् अभ्युन्नीय होतव्यम् अथाज्येन वारुणीम् ऋचम् अनूच्य वारुण्यर्चा जुहुयात् //
text_mt: If what has been ladled out spills, it must be ladled out again and offered; then, having recited an introductory verse to Varuṇa, he should make an offering with clarified butter with a verse to Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast: yady uddrutasya skanded yat tato hutvā punar eyād yajñaṃ vicchindyād yatra skandet taṃ niṣadya punar gṛhṇīyāt tad eva yādṛk kīdṛg ghutvānyāṃ dugdhvā punar juhuyāt //
meaning: यद्य् उद्द्रुतस्य स्कन्देद् यत् ततो हुत्वा पुनर् एयाद् यज्ञं विच्छिन्द्याद् यत्र स्कन्देत् तं निषद्य पुनर् गृह्णीयात् तद् एव यादृक् कीदृग् घुत्वान्यां दुग्ध्वा पुनर् जुहुयात् //
text_mt: If [the milk] of one who has run forward should spill: if, having offered from that, he were to go back, he would break the sacrifice; having sat down where it spilled, he should take [more]; having offered just that, whatever it may be like, having milked another [cow], he should offer again.

sanskrit_iast: yadi prācīnam̐ hriyamāṇam̐ skandet prajāpater viśvabhṛti tanvāṃ hutam asi \\ ity abhimantrayāthājyena vāruṇīm ṛcam anūcya vāruṇyarcā juhuyāt //
meaning: यदि प्राचीनम्̐ ह्रियमाणम्̐ स्कन्देत् प्रजापतेर् विश्वभृति तन्वां हुतम् असि \\ इत्य् अभिमन्त्रयाथाज्येन वारुणीम् ऋचम् अनूच्य वारुण्यर्चा जुहुयात् //
text_mt: If [the milk] being carried eastward should spill, he addresses it with: 'You are offered in the all-sustaining body of Prajāpati', and then with clarified butter, having recited an introductory verse to Varuṇa, he should offer with an offering verse to Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast: yadi puraḥ parāhṛtam̐ skanded anūddhṛtya punar abhyunnīya hotavyam athājyena vāruṇīm ṛcam anūcya vāruṇyarcā juhuyāt //
meaning: यदि पुरः पराहृतम्̐ स्कन्देद् अनूद्धृत्य पुनर् अभ्युन्नीय होतव्यम् अथाज्येन वारुणीम् ऋचम् अनूच्य वारुण्यर्चा जुहुयात् //
text_mt: If [the milk] carried forward to the east should spill, having drawn [the fire] afterward [and] having drawn up [milk] again, it must be offered; then with clarified butter, having recited an introductory verse to Varuṇa, he should offer with an offering verse to Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast: yadi pura upasannam ahutam̐ skandet tad eva yādṛk kīdṛkca hutvānyāṃ dugdhvā punar juhuyāt //
meaning: यदि पुर उपसन्नम् अहुतम्̐ स्कन्देत् तद् एव यादृक् कीदृक्च हुत्वान्यां दुग्ध्वा पुनर् जुहुयात् //
text_mt: If it should spill in front after being placed near, without being offered, having offered just that, whatever it may be like, having milked another [cow], he should offer again.

sanskrit_iast: askān dyauḥ pṛthivīm \ askān ṛṣabho yuvā gāḥ / \ skannemā viśvā bhuvanā \ skanno yajñaḥ prajanayatu / \ askān ajani prājani \\ ā skannāj jāyate vṛṣā / \ skannāt prajaniṣīmahi \\ ity agnihotram̐ skannam abhimantrayādbhir upaninayet //
meaning: अस्कान् द्यौः पृथिवीम् \ अस्कान् ऋषभो युवा गाः / \ स्कन्नेमा विश्वा भुवना \ स्कन्नो यज्ञः प्रजनयतु / \ अस्कान् अजनि प्राजनि \\ आ स्कन्नाज् जायते वृषा / \ स्कन्नात् प्रजनिषीमहि \\ इत्य् अग्निहोत्रम्̐ स्कन्नम् अभिमन्त्रयाद्भिर् उपनिनयेत् //
text_mt: With: 'Heaven leaped upon earth; / the young bull leaped upon the cows; / spilled are all these worlds; / may the spilled sacrifice bring forth. / It has leaped, it was born, it was brought forth; / from what is spilled a bull is born; / from what is spilled may we bring forth progeny', having addressed the spilled Agnihotra [milk], he should pour water around [it].

sanskrit_iast: yadi sāyam̐ skanded ā hotoḥ prātar nāśnīyāt / yadi prātaḥ skanded ā hotoḥ sāyaṃ nāśnīyāt //
meaning: यदि सायम्̐ स्कन्देद् आ होतोः प्रातर् नाश्नीयात् / यदि प्रातः स्कन्देद् आ होतोः सायं नाश्नीयात् //
text_mt: If it spills in the evening, he should not eat until the morning offering; if it spills in the morning, he should not eat until the evening offering.

sanskrit_iast: divyā vā etam aśanir abhyavaiti yasyāgnihotram̐ śiriśirā bhavati / samoṣāmum iti brūyād yaṃ dviṣyāt //
meaning: दिव्या वा एतम् अशनिर् अभ्यवैति यस्याग्निहोत्रम्̐ शिरिशिरा भवति / समोषामुम् इति ब्रूयाद् यं द्विष्यात् //
text_mt: A divine thunderbolt indeed descends upon him whose Agnihotra makes a hissing noise. He should say, 'Burn up so-and-so!' referring to someone whom he hates.

sanskrit_iast: yasyāgnihotre 'dhiśrite śvāntarā dhāved gārhapatyād bhasmādāya \\ idaṃ viṣṇur vicakrame \\ iti vaiṣṇavyarcāhavanīyād dhvam̐saṃyann uddraved etayaiva bhasmanā śunaḥ padam upavapati //
meaning: यस्याग्निहोत्रे ऽधिश्रिते श्वान्तरा धावेद् गार्हपत्याद् भस्मादाय \\ इदं विष्णुर् विचक्रमे \\ इति वैष्णव्यर्चाहवनीयाद् ध्वम्̐संयन्न् उद्द्रवेद् एतयैव भस्मना शुनः पदम् उपवपति //
text_mt: If a dog runs between when his Agnihotra is placed on [the fire], having taken ashes from the gārhapatya fire, scattering [them] from the āhavanīya fire with the verse addressed to Viṣṇu: 'Through this Viṣṇu strode...', he should run forward; with this very [verse] he strews ashes upon the dog's footprint.

sanskrit_iast: yasyānāhṛtam agnim̐ sūryo 'bhinimroced yatra dīpyamānaṃ parāpaśyet tata āhṛtya \\ etaṃ praviśāni \\ iti vaiṣa ādhīyate //
meaning: यस्यानाहृतम् अग्निम्̐ सूर्यो ऽभिनिम्रोचेद् यत्र दीप्यमानं परापश्येत् तत आहृत्य \\ एतं प्रविशानि \\ इति वैष आधीयते //
text_mt: If the sun should set upon one whose [dakṣiṇa] fire has not been brought, having brought [fire] from wherever he sees it blazing in the distance, it is set down with: 'May I enter this'.

sanskrit_iast: iti dakṣiṇāgner anugatasyādhānakalpaḥ //
meaning: इति दक्षिणाग्नेर् अनुगतस्याधानकल्पः //
text_mt: Such is the procedure for establishing the dakṣiṇāgni fire when it has gone out.

sanskrit_iast: yasyānuddhṛtam agnim̐ sūryo 'bhinimrocet // agnihotraṃ pūrvam̐ hareyuḥ / athāgnim uddhareyuḥ / api vā darbheṇa hiraṇyaṃ prabadhya pūrvaḥ pratipadyetānvaṅ brāhmaṇa ārṣeyo bahuvid agnim uddharet / anvaṅṅ agnihotreṇānudraved agniṃ pratiṣṭhāpyāgnihotram upasādyātamitor aprāṇann āsitvā varaṃ dattvā hutvā bhūr bhuvaḥ suvar ity upatiṣṭheta vāruṇaṃ caruṃ nirvapet // doṣā vastor namaḥ svāhā \\ iti juhuyāt //
meaning: यस्यानुद्धृतम् अग्निम्̐ सूर्यो ऽभिनिम्रोचेत् // अग्निहोत्रं पूर्वम्̐ हरेयुः / अथाग्निम् उद्धरेयुः / अपि वा दर्भेण हिरण्यं प्रबध्य पूर्वः प्रतिपद्येतान्वङ् ब्राह्मण आर्षेयो बहुविद् अग्निम् उद्धरेत् / अन्वङ्ङ् अग्निहोत्रेणानुद्रवेद् अग्निं प्रतिष्ठाप्याग्निहोत्रम् उपसाद्यातमितोर् अप्राणन्न् आसित्वा वरं दत्त्वा हुत्वा भूर् भुवः सुवर् इत्य् उपतिष्ठेत वारुणं चरुं निर्वपेत् // दोषा वस्तोर् नमः स्वाहा \\ इति जुहुयात् //
text_mt: If the sun should set upon one whose [āhavanīya] fire has not been taken out: they should carry the Agnihotra first; then they should take out the fire. Or, having tied gold with a blade of darbha-grass, [a priest] should go first; following behind, a learned brāhmaṇa of ṛṣi descent should take out the fire; following behind, [the adhvaryu] should run after with the Agnihotra; having established the fire, having placed down the Agnihotra, having sat without breathing until he is suffocated, having given a choice gift, [and] having offered, he should attend upon [the fire] with 'Bhūr bhuvaḥ suvar'; he should apportion a caru for Varuṇa; he should offer with: 'In the evening and at dawn, homage, svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: yadi sāyam agnihotrasyartumati nayet prātar vastar namaḥ svāhā \\ iti juhuyāt //
meaning: यदि सायम् अग्निहोत्रस्यर्तुमति नयेत् प्रातर् वस्तर् नमः स्वाहा \\ इति जुहुयात् //
text_mt: If he lets the proper time of the evening Agnihotra pass, he should offer with: 'In the morning at dawn, homage, svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: yadi prātar agnihotrasyartumati nayet kālasamāpanīyam etābhyāṃ mantrābhyām̐ hutvā nityam agnihotraṃ juhoti //
meaning: यदि प्रातर् अग्निहोत्रस्यर्तुमति नयेत् कालसमापनीयम् एताभ्यां मन्त्राभ्याम्̐ हुत्वा नित्यम् अग्निहोत्रं जुहोति //
text_mt: If he lets the proper time of the morning Agnihotra pass, having offered the time-completing [offering] with these two mantras, he offers the regular Agnihotra.

sanskrit_iast: sāyam agnihotram upasādya bhūr bhuvaḥ suvar iti purastād dhotor vadati hutvā ca prātar agnihotram upasādyātamitor aprāṇann āsitvā varaṃ dattvā hutvā bhūr bhuvaḥ suvar ity upatiṣṭhetānugamayaty āhavanīyam anv agnir uṣasām agram akhyat \\ ity anyaṃ praṇīya \\ ihaiva kṣemyā edhi mā prahāsīn māmum āmuṣyāyaṇam ity upatiṣṭheta / maitraṃ caruṃ nirvapet //
meaning: सायम् अग्निहोत्रम् उपसाद्य भूर् भुवः सुवर् इति पुरस्ताद् धोतोर् वदति हुत्वा च प्रातर् अग्निहोत्रम् उपसाद्यातमितोर् अप्राणन्न् आसित्वा वरं दत्त्वा हुत्वा भूर् भुवः सुवर् इत्य् उपतिष्ठेतानुगमयत्य् आहवनीयम् अन्व् अग्निर् उषसाम् अग्रम् अख्यत् \\ इत्य् अन्यं प्रणीय \\ इहैव क्षेम्या एधि मा प्रहासीन् मामुम् आमुष्यायणम् इत्य् उपतिष्ठेत / मैत्रं चरुं निर्वपेत् //
text_mt: Having placed down the evening Agnihotra, before offering he speaks 'Bhūr bhuvaḥ suvar', and having offered, having placed down the morning Agnihotra, having sat without breathing until he is suffocated, having given a choice gift, [and] having offered, he should attend upon [the fire] with 'Bhūr bhuvaḥ suvar'; he lets the āhavanīya fire go out; having led forth another [fire] with: 'Agni has looked after the vanguard of the dawns...', he should attend upon [it] with: 'Be restful right here, do not abandon me, so-and-so, son of so-and-so'; he should apportion a caru for Mitra.

sanskrit_iast: sauryam ekakapālam eke samāmananti //
meaning: सौर्यम् एककपालम् एके समामनन्ति //
text_mt: Some teach [a cake] on one potsherd for Sūrya.

sanskrit_iast: tasyām̐ sam̐sthitāyām anaśnantau vāgyatāv etad ahar jāyāpatī agnim indhānāv āsāte //
meaning: तस्याम्̐ सम्̐स्थितायाम् अनश्नन्तौ वाग्यताव् एतद् अहर् जायापती अग्निम् इन्धानाव् आसाते //
text_mt: When that is completed, fasting, restrained in speech, keeping the fire kindled, husband and wife sit for that day.

sanskrit_iast: dvayoḥ payasā sāyam agnihotraṃ juhuyāt / pūrvam adhiśrityottaram ānayet //
meaning: द्वयोः पयसा सायम् अग्निहोत्रं जुहुयात् / पूर्वम् अधिश्रित्योत्तरम् आनयेत् //
text_mt: He should offer the evening Agnihotra with the milk of two [cows]; having put the first on the fire, he should pour in the second.

sanskrit_iast: yasyānuddhṛtam agnim̐ sūryo 'bhyudiyāc caturgṛhītam ājyaṃ gṛhītvā pūrvaḥ pratipadyetānvaṅ brāhmaṇa ārṣeyo bahuvid agnim uddharet / anvaṅṅ agnihotreṇānudraved agniṃ pratiṣṭhāpyāgnihotram upasādya // purastāt pratyaṅṅ āsīnas \\ uṣāḥ ketunā juṣatām ity etac caturgṛhītam̐ hutvā nityam agnihotraṃ juhuyāt //
meaning: यस्यानुद्धृतम् अग्निम्̐ सूर्यो ऽभ्युदियाच् चतुर्गृहीतम् आज्यं गृहीत्वा पूर्वः प्रतिपद्येतान्वङ् ब्राह्मण आर्षेयो बहुविद् अग्निम् उद्धरेत् / अन्वङ्ङ् अग्निहोत्रेणानुद्रवेद् अग्निं प्रतिष्ठाप्याग्निहोत्रम् उपसाद्य // पुरस्तात् प्रत्यङ्ङ् आसीनस् \\ उषाः केतुना जुषताम् इत्य् एतच् चतुर्गृहीतम्̐ हुत्वा नित्यम् अग्निहोत्रं जुहुयात् //
text_mt: If the sun should rise upon one whose [āhavanīya] fire has not been taken out, having taken a fourfold ladling of clarified butter, [a priest] should go first; following behind, a learned brāhmaṇa of ṛṣi descent should take out the fire; following behind, [the adhvaryu] should run after with the Agnihotra; having established the fire, having placed down the Agnihotra, seated in front facing west, having offered this fourfold ladling with: 'May the Dawn enjoy with her banner...', he should offer the regular Agnihotra.

sanskrit_iast: tasya sa eva homakalpaḥ sā prayaścittiḥ / yat prātar ṛtāv atīte //
meaning: तस्य स एव होमकल्पः सा प्रयश्चित्तिः / यत् प्रातर् ऋताव् अतीते //
text_mt: For it, the procedure of offering is the same, and the expiation is the same, as when the morning time has elapsed.

sanskrit_iast: etāvan nānā / nātrānugamayaty āhavanīyam //
meaning: एतावन् नाना / नात्रानुगमयत्य् आहवनीयम् //
text_mt: Only this is different: here he does not let the āhavanīya fire go out.

sanskrit_iast: yasyāhutam agnihotram̐ sūryo 'bhyudiyād unnīyātamitor apraṇann āsitvā hutvā bhūr ity upatiṣṭheta / varo dakṣiṇā //
meaning: यस्याहुतम् अग्निहोत्रम्̐ सूर्यो ऽभ्युदियाद् उन्नीयातमितोर् अप्रणन्न् आसित्वा हुत्वा भूर् इत्य् उपतिष्ठेत / वरो दक्षिणा //
text_mt: If the sun should rise upon one whose Agnihotra has not been offered, having drawn up [the milk], having sat without breathing until he is suffocated, [and] having offered, he should attend upon [the fire] with 'Bhūḥ'; a choice gift is the sacrificial fee.

sanskrit_iast: yady ante syād unnīya prāṅ udādravet sa upasādyātamitor āsīta yad ā tāmyed atha bhūḥ svāhā \\ iti juhuyāt //
meaning: यद्य् अन्ते स्याद् उन्नीय प्राङ् उदाद्रवेत् स उपसाद्यातमितोर् आसीत यद् आ ताम्येद् अथ भूः स्वाहा \\ इति जुहुयात् //
text_mt: If he should be at the end, having drawn up [the milk], he should run forward to the east; having placed [it] down, he should sit until he is suffocated; when he is suffocated, then he should offer with: 'Bhūḥ svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: yasya hoṣyāmīti pravṛtte hutam agnihotram̐ sūryo 'bhyudiyād dhutvā tad athotsādya punarādheya ity ekeṣām //
meaning: यस्य होष्यामीति प्रवृत्ते हुतम् अग्निहोत्रम्̐ सूर्यो ऽभ्युदियाद् धुत्वा तद् अथोत्साद्य पुनराधेय इत्य् एकेषाम् //
text_mt: For one who has set out thinking 'I will offer' and upon whose offered Agnihotra the sun rises: having offered that, then having removed [the fires], re-establishment of the fires is to be performed, according to some.

sanskrit_iast: yasyobhāv anugatau sūryo 'bhyudiyāt / apivāstam iyāt / yad ivāraṇyoḥ samārūḍho naśyet punarādheyam eva / tatra prāyaścittam //
meaning: यस्योभाव् अनुगतौ सूर्यो ऽभ्युदियात् / अपिवास्तम् इयात् / यद् इवारण्योः समारूढो नश्येत् पुनराधेयम् एव / तत्र प्रायश्चित्तम् //
text_mt: If the sun rises upon one whose both [fires] have gone out, or if it sets, or if [the fire] that had mounted into the two kindling sticks is lost, re-establishment of the fires alone is the expiation in that case.

sanskrit_iast: agnaye tanumate 'ṣṭākapālaṃ nirvaped yasyāgnihotraṃ vicchidyeta dvyahe tryahe vā //
meaning: अग्नये तनुमते ऽष्टाकपालं निर्वपेद् यस्याग्निहोत्रं विच्छिद्येत द्व्यहे त्र्यहे वा //
text_mt: One should apportion [a cake] on eight potsherds to Agni Tanumat, if one's Agnihotra should be interrupted for two days or for three days.

sanskrit_iast: svayaṃ kṛṇvānaḥ sugam aprayāvam \\ tigmaśṛṅgo vṛṣabhaḥ śoṣucānaḥ / \ pratnam̐ sadhastham anupaśyamānas \\ ā tantum agnir divyaṃ tatāna // \ tvaṃ nas tantur uta setur agne \ tvaṃ panthā bhavasi devayānaḥ / \ tvayāgne pṛṣṭhaṃ vayam āruhema \\ athā devaiḥ sadhamādaṃ madema \\ iti yājyānuvākye //
meaning: स्वयं कृण्वानः सुगम् अप्रयावम् \\ तिग्मशृङ्गो वृषभः शोषुचानः / \ प्रत्नम्̐ सधस्थम् अनुपश्यमानस् \\ आ तन्तुम् अग्निर् दिव्यं ततान // \ त्वं नस् तन्तुर् उत सेतुर् अग्ने \ त्वं पन्था भवसि देवयानः / \ त्वयाग्ने पृष्ठं वयम् आरुहेम \\ अथा देवैः सधमादं मदेम \\ इति याज्यानुवाक्ये //
text_mt: 'Making of himself an easy passage, unwavering, / the sharp-horned bull, gleaming brightly, / looking upon the ancient seat, / Agni has extended the divine thread. / You are our thread and bridge, O Agni; / you become the path that goes to the gods; / by you, O Agni, may we mount the ridge; / then may we rejoice in fellowship with the gods' — these are the introductory and offering verses.

sanskrit_iast: yasyāhavanīye 'nudvāte gārhapatya udvāyed āhavanīyam udvāpya gārhapatyasyāvakṣāṇāni saṃnidhāya \\ itaḥ prathamaṃ jajñe agnis \\ iti manthed āhavanīyaṃ praṇīya \\ agne samrāḍ iṣe rayyai ramasva sahase dyumnāyorje 'patyāya \ samrāḍ asi \ svarāḍ asi \ suṣadā sīda \ sārasvatau tvotsau samindhātām ity upasamindhe 'gnaye tapasvate janadvate pāvakavate 'ṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet //
meaning: यस्याहवनीये ऽनुद्वाते गार्हपत्य उद्वायेद् आहवनीयम् उद्वाप्य गार्हपत्यस्यावक्षाणानि संनिधाय \\ इतः प्रथमं जज्ञे अग्निस् \\ इति मन्थेद् आहवनीयं प्रणीय \\ अग्ने सम्राड् इषे रय्यै रमस्व सहसे द्युम्नायोर्जे ऽपत्याय \ सम्राड् असि \ स्वराड् असि \ सुषदा सीद \ सारस्वतौ त्वोत्सौ समिन्धाताम् इत्य् उपसमिन्धे ऽग्नये तपस्वते जनद्वते पावकवते ऽष्टाकपालं निर्वपेत् //
text_mt: If, while his āhavanīya fire has not gone out, the gārhapatya fire should go out: having extinguished the āhavanīya fire, having brought together the embers of the gārhapatya fire, he should churn [out fire] with: 'From here Agni was born first...'; having led forth the āhavanīya fire, he kindles it with: 'O Agni, sovereign, delight in food, in wealth, in might, in splendor, in vigor, in offspring; you are sovereign; you are self-ruler; sit well-seated; may the two fountains of Sarasvatī kindle you'; he should apportion [a cake] on eight potsherds to Agni Tapasvat, Janadvat, and Pāvakavat.

sanskrit_iast: āyāhi tapasā janeṣu \\ agne pāvako arciṣā / \ upemāṃ suṣṭutiṃ mama // \ ā no yāhi tapasā janeṣu \\ agne pāvaka dīyat / \ havyā deveṣu no dadhat \\ iti yājyānuvākye //
meaning: आयाहि तपसा जनेषु \\ अग्ने पावको अर्चिषा / \ उपेमां सुष्टुतिं मम // \ आ नो याहि तपसा जनेषु \\ अग्ने पावक दीयत् / \ हव्या देवेषु नो दधत् \\ इति याज्यानुवाक्ये //
text_mt: 'Come with heat among the folk, / O Agni, purifying with your flame, / unto this, my fine praise. / Come to us with heat among the folk, / O purifying Agni, shining, / placing our oblations among the gods' — these are the introductory and offering verses.

sanskrit_iast: etad evāhavanīye 'nugate prāyaścittam / nātra gārhapatyam anugamayaty agnaye jyotiṣmate 'ṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapati //
meaning: एतद् एवाहवनीये ऽनुगते प्रायश्चित्तम् / नात्र गार्हपत्यम् अनुगमयत्य् अग्नये ज्योतिष्मते ऽष्टाकपालं निर्वपति //
text_mt: This very [rite] is the expiation when the āhavanīya fire has gone out. Here he does not cause the gārhapatya fire to go out; he apportions [a cake] on eight potsherds to Agni Jyotiṣmat,

sanskrit_iast: na tapasvate //
meaning: न तपस्वते //

sanskrit_iast: yadi sāyam ahute 'gnihotre pūrvo 'gnir anugacched agnihotram adhiśrityonnīyety ekeṣām / agninā pūrveṇoddhṛtyāgnihotreṇānudraved yo brāhmaṇo bahuvit so 'gnim uddharet / yat punarādhānam ādāyī syāt tad dadyāt //
meaning: यदि सायम् अहुते ऽग्निहोत्रे पूर्वो ऽग्निर् अनुगच्छेद् अग्निहोत्रम् अधिश्रित्योन्नीयेत्य् एकेषाम् / अग्निना पूर्वेणोद्धृत्याग्निहोत्रेणानुद्रवेद् यो ब्राह्मणो बहुवित् सो ऽग्निम् उद्धरेत् / यत् पुनराधानम् आदायी स्यात् तद् दद्यात् //
text_mt: If in the evening, when the Agnihotra has not yet been offered, the eastern fire should go out, [he should do so] after placing the Agnihotra [milk] on the fire and scooping it up, according to some. Having taken [it] up with the eastern fire, he should run after it with the Agnihotra; a brahmin who knows much should take up the fire. He should give whatever is received at a re-establishment of the fires.

sanskrit_iast: yadi prātar ahute 'gnihotre 'paro 'gnir anugacched anugamayitvā pūrvaṃ mathitvāparam uddhṛtya juhuyāt //
meaning: यदि प्रातर् अहुते ऽग्निहोत्रे ऽपरो ऽग्निर् अनुगच्छेद् अनुगमयित्वा पूर्वं मथित्वापरम् उद्धृत्य जुहुयात् //
text_mt: If in the morning, when the Agnihotra has not yet been offered, the western fire should go out, having caused the eastern [fire] to go out, having churned [a new fire] and taken up the western one, he should offer.

sanskrit_iast: yadi tvareta pūrvam agnim anvavasāya tataḥ prāñcam uddhṛtya juhuyāt //
meaning: यदि त्वरेत पूर्वम् अग्निम् अन्ववसाय ततः प्राञ्चम् उद्धृत्य जुहुयात् //
text_mt: If he should be in haste, having set down [fire] in place of the eastern fire, having taken [it] up toward the east from there, he should offer.

sanskrit_iast: jāmi tu tad yo 'sya pūrvo 'gnis tam aparaṃ karoti / anyatraivāvasāyāgniṃ mathitvoddhṛtya juhuyāt / śvo 'gnaye tapasvate janadvate pāvakavate 'ṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet //
meaning: जामि तु तद् यो ऽस्य पूर्वो ऽग्निस् तम् अपरं करोति / अन्यत्रैवावसायाग्निं मथित्वोद्धृत्य जुहुयात् / श्वो ऽग्नये तपस्वते जनद्वते पावकवते ऽष्टाकपालं निर्वपेत् //
text_mt: It is, however, an error that one turns his eastern fire into the western one. Having set [fire] down elsewhere, having churned fire and taken it up, he should offer. On the next day, he should offer a cake on eight potsherds to Agni Tapasvat, Janadvat, and Pāvakavat.

sanskrit_iast: yasyāparo 'gnir anugacched ity ekeṣām //
meaning: यस्यापरो ऽग्निर् अनुगच्छेद् इत्य् एकेषाम् //
text_mt: “Whose western fire should go out,” according to some.

sanskrit_iast: na kālam avadhārayati / tato 'trāgniṃ mathitvoddhṛtyābhimantrayate \\ itaḥ prathamaṃ jajñe agnis \\ ity etayā \\ agne samrāḍ iṣe rayyai ramasva sarase dyumnāyorje 'patyāya \ samrāḍ asi \ svarāḍ asi \ suṣadā sīda \ sārasvatau tvotsau prāvatām ity upasamindhe 'gnaye jyotiṣmate puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālaṃ nirvaped vāruṇaṃ yavamayaṃ carum //
meaning: न कालम् अवधारयति / ततो ऽत्राग्निं मथित्वोद्धृत्याभिमन्त्रयते \\ इतः प्रथमं जज्ञे अग्निस् \\ इत्य् एतया \\ अग्ने सम्राड् इषे रय्यै रमस्व सरसे द्युम्नायोर्जे ऽपत्याय \ सम्राड् असि \ स्वराड् असि \ सुषदा सीद \ सारस्वतौ त्वोत्सौ प्रावताम् इत्य् उपसमिन्धे ऽग्नये ज्योतिष्मते पुरोडाशम् अष्टाकपालं निर्वपेद् वारुणं यवमयं चरुम् //
text_mt: He does not fix a time.
