meaning: अध्वरो यज्ञो ऽयम् अस्तु देवास् \\ ओषधीभ्यः पशुभ्यो नो धनाय \ विश्वस्मै भूतायाध्वरो ऽसि \ स पिन्वस्व घृतवद् देव यज्ञस्य \ ध्रुवा द्यौर् ध्रुवा पृथिवी \ ध्रुवं विश्वम् इदं जगत् / \ ध्रुवा ह पर्वता इमे \ ध्रुवो राजा विशाम् अयम् // \ इहैवैधि मा व्यथिष्टाः \ पर्वत इवाविचाचलिः / \ इन्द्र इवेह ध्रुवस् तिष्ठ \\ इह राष्ट्रम् उ धारय / \ अभितिष्ठ पृतन्यतस् \\ अधरे सन्तु शत्रवः / \ इन्द्र इव वृत्रहा तिष्ठ \\ अपः क्षेत्राणि संजयन् // \ इन्द्र एनम् अदीधरत् \\ ध्रुवं ध्रुवेण हविषा / \ तस्मै देवा अधिब्रुवन् \\ अयं च ब्रह्मणस्पतिर् इति चतसृभिर् अभिमन्त्र्य वरं ददाति //
text_mt: "May this sacrifice be non-injurious, O gods, / for plants, for animals, for our wealth! / You are non-injurious to all creation; / as such, swell rich in ghee, of the divine sacrifice! / Firm is heaven, firm is the earth; / firm is this entire universe; / firm indeed are these mountains; / firm is this king of the subjects. / Be here indeed; do not waver, / unmoving like a mountain; / stand firm here like Indra, / and uphold the realm here! / Trample down those who fight against us; / may our enemies be laid low! / Stand like Indra, slayer of Vṛtra, / winning waters and fields! / Indra has upheld him, / firm with the firm oblation; / to him the gods have spoken favor, / and so too this Brahmaṇaspati"—having addressed [the soma] with these four [verses], he gives a boon.

sanskrit_iast: yadi nārāśam̐sam̐ skanded yam adhvaryur uttaraṃ grahaṃ gṛhṇīyāt / taṃ vaṣaṭkārānuvaṣaṭkṛte hutvā \\ āpyāyasva madintama \\ iti tasmād enam āpyāyayati tenainaṃ bhakṣavantaṃ karoti //
meaning: यदि नाराशम्̐सम्̐ स्कन्देद् यम् अध्वर्युर् उत्तरं ग्रहं गृह्णीयात् / तं वषट्कारानुवषट्कृते हुत्वा \\ आप्यायस्व मदिन्तम \\ इति तस्माद् एनम् आप्याययति तेनैनं भक्षवन्तं करोति //
text_mt: If a Nārāśaṃsa cup should spill, whatever subsequent cup the adhvaryu draws—having offered it after the vaṣaṭ-call and the second vaṣaṭ-call [are made], he swells this [Nārāśaṃsa cup] from that one with the words, "Swell, O most exhilarating one!" and thereby makes it possessed of a portion for consumption.

sanskrit_iast: devāñ janam agan yajñas \\ iti prātaḥsavane somam̐ skannam abhimantrayeta / gandharvāñ janam agan yajñas \\ iti mādhyaṃdine / pitṝñ janam agan yajñas \\ iti tṛtīyasavane / apa oṣadhīr vanaspatīñ janam agan yajñas \\ iti naktam / dyāvāpṛthivī janam agan yajñas \\ iti / tiroahniyān some somam abhigṛhya nidadhāti //
meaning: देवाञ् जनम् अगन् यज्ञस् \\ इति प्रातःसवने सोमम्̐ स्कन्नम् अभिमन्त्रयेत / गन्धर्वाञ् जनम् अगन् यज्ञस् \\ इति माध्यंदिने / पितॄञ् जनम् अगन् यज्ञस् \\ इति तृतीयसवने / अप ओषधीर् वनस्पतीञ् जनम् अगन् यज्ञस् \\ इति नक्तम् / द्यावापृथिवी जनम् अगन् यज्ञस् \\ इति / तिरोअह्नियान् सोमे सोमम् अभिगृह्य निदधाति //
text_mt: With the words, "The sacrifice has gone to the divine folk," he addresses spilled soma at the morning pressing; with "The sacrifice has gone to the gandharva folk," at the midday pressing; with "The sacrifice has gone to the fathers' folk," at the third pressing; with "The sacrifice has gone to the waters, plants, and trees folk," at night; with "The sacrifice has gone to the heaven and earth folk," [at any other time]. In the case of soma kept overnight, he takes a portion of soma into the soma and sets it down.

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣadājyam̐ skanded yady athānyad dadhi pṛṣadājyaṃ gṛhītvā drapsaś caskanda \ mano jyotir juṣatām iti sam̐hitābhyām ekāhutiṃ juhoti //
meaning: पृषदाज्यम्̐ स्कन्देद् यद्य् अथान्यद् दधि पृषदाज्यं गृहीत्वा द्रप्सश् चस्कन्द \ मनो ज्योतिर् जुषताम् इति सम्̐हिताभ्याम् एकाहुतिं जुहोति //
text_mt: If clotted butter should spill, then, having taken other curd for clotted butter, he offers a single oblation with the two combined [verses], "A drop spilled..." [and] "May the mind enjoy the light..."

sanskrit_iast: yady ṛtugrahaiḥ pracarantau muhyeyātāṃ visṛṣṭadhenāḥ sarito ghṛtaścutas \\ vasanto grīṣmo madhumati varṣāḥ \ śarad dhemanta ṛtavo mayobhuvas \\ udapruṣo nabhasī saṃvasāthām / \ ā naḥ prajāṃ janayatu prajāpatir \ dhātā dadātu parivatsaro naḥ / \ saṃvatsara ṛtubhiś cākrapāṇas \\ mayi puṣṭiṃ puṣṭipatir dadhātu // \ ā devānām \\ tvam agne vratapā asi \ yad vo vayaṃ pramināma vratāni / \ madhuś ca mādhavaś ca \ vāsantikāv ṛtū / \ imaṃ yajñam avantu \ te mām avantu \ anu va ārabhe \\ anu mārabhadhvam̐ svāhā \\ ity etaiḥ saha daśabhir ṛgyajurbhir daśāhutīr juhoti / pratyāhuti varaṃ dadāti //
meaning: यद्य् ऋतुग्रहैः प्रचरन्तौ मुह्येयातां विसृष्टधेनाः सरितो घृतश्चुतस् \\ वसन्तो ग्रीष्मो मधुमति वर्षाः \ शरद् धेमन्त ऋतवो मयोभुवस् \\ उदप्रुषो नभसी संवसाथाम् / \ आ नः प्रजां जनयतु प्रजापतिर् \ धाता ददातु परिवत्सरो नः / \ संवत्सर ऋतुभिश् चाक्रपाणस् \\ मयि पुष्टिं पुष्टिपतिर् दधातु // \ आ देवानाम् \\ त्वम् अग्ने व्रतपा असि \ यद् वो वयं प्रमिनाम व्रतानि / \ मधुश् च माधवश् च \ वासन्तिकाव् ऋतू / \ इमं यज्ञम् अवन्तु \ ते माम् अवन्तु \ अनु व आरभे \\ अनु मारभध्वम्̐ स्वाहा \\ इत्य् एतैः सह दशभिर् ऋग्यजुर्भिर् दशाहुतीर् जुहोति / प्रत्याहुति वरं ददाति //
text_mt: If the two [priests] performing the rites with the seasonal cups should become confused, with the verses: "With udders flowing, the streams dripping ghee, / spring, summer, the rainy season rich in sweet drink, / autumn, winter, the seasons that bring joy, / spraying waters, may the two atmospheres dwell together! / May Prajāpati generate offspring for us, / may the year-regulator Dhātṛ grant us [life]; / may the Year, rolling along with the seasons, / may the lord of nourishment place nourishment in me!" / "Hither of the gods..." / "You, O Agni, are the guardian of vows..." / "Whatever vows of yours we may break..." / "Madhu and Mādhava, / the two seasons belonging to spring, / may they protect this sacrifice, / may they protect me! / I commence after you; / commence after me, svāhā!"—together with these ten ṛc and yajus mantras he offers ten oblations. At each oblation, he gives a boon.

sanskrit_iast: yadi somaḥ skandet \\ brahman somo 'skān iti brahmaṇa āvedya yatra skandet tad apo ninīya \\ abhūd devaḥ savitā vandyo nu nas \\ idānīm ahna upavācyo nṛbhiḥ / \ vi yo ratnā bhajati mānavebhyaḥ \ śreṣṭhaṃ no atra draviṇaṃ yathā dadhat \\ ity abhimantrya hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatāgre \\ iti juhuyāt //
meaning: यदि सोमः स्कन्देत् \\ ब्रह्मन् सोमो ऽस्कान् इति ब्रह्मण आवेद्य यत्र स्कन्देत् तद् अपो निनीय \\ अभूद् देवः सविता वन्द्यो नु नस् \\ इदानीम् अह्न उपवाच्यो नृभिः / \ वि यो रत्ना भजति मानवेभ्यः \ श्रेष्ठं नो अत्र द्रविणं यथा दधत् \\ इत्य् अभिमन्त्र्य हिरण्यगर्भः समवर्तताग्रे \\ इति जुहुयात् //
text_mt: If soma should spill, having informed the brahman with the words, "O brahman, the soma has spilled," and having poured water where it spilled, having addressed it with: "Divine Savitṛ has now become worthy of our praise, / at this time of the day to be invoked by men, / he who distributes treasures to the mortals, / so that he may bestow the best wealth upon us here," he offers with: "The Golden Germ arose in the beginning..."

sanskrit_iast: yadi camasam abhakṣitam̐ stotreṇābhyupākuryāt //
meaning: यदि चमसम् अभक्षितम्̐ स्तोत्रेणाभ्युपाकुर्यात् //
text_mt: If he should initiate a chant over an unconsumed soma cup...

sanskrit_iast: indur hinvānam avāgat \\ indor ubhayoḥ somāḥ sāma sṛkṣata divyāś ca pārthivāś ca \ tasya ta indrapītasya madhumata upahūtasyopahūto bhakṣayāmi \\ ity abhivṛṣṭasya somasya bhakṣayati //
meaning: इन्दुर् हिन्वानम् अवागत् \\ इन्दोर् उभयोः सोमाः साम सृक्षत दिव्याश् च पार्थिवाश् च \ तस्य त इन्द्रपीतस्य मधुमत उपहूतस्योपहूतो भक्षयामि \\ इत्य् अभिवृष्टस्य सोमस्य भक्षयति //
text_mt: With the words, "The drop came down stimulating; / of the drop both earthly and heavenly somas have released the chant; / of that which has been drunk by Indra, sweet, invited, invited I partake," he consumes the soma upon which rain has fallen.

sanskrit_iast: yadi dīkṣato 'vakiret \\ apsv agne \\ ity eṣā / tapo ṣv agne antarām̐ amitrān
meaning: यदि दीक्षतो ऽवकिरेत् \\ अप्स्व् अग्ने \\ इत्य् एषा / तपो ष्व् अग्ने अन्तराम्̐ अमित्रान्
text_mt: If the consecrated person should discharge semen, [he performs an expiation with] this verse: "In the waters, O Agni..."; [and with] "Burn well, O Agni, the inner enemies..."

sanskrit_iast: yo naḥ sanutyo abhidāsad agne \ yo antaro mitramaho 'vanuṣyāt / \ tam ajarebhir vṛṣabhis tapa svais \ tapā tapasva tapasā tapiṣṭha //
meaning: यो नः सनुत्यो अभिदासद् अग्ने \ यो अन्तरो मित्रमहो ऽवनुष्यात् / \ तम् अजरेभिर् वृषभिस् तप स्वैस् \ तपा तपस्व तपसा तपिष्ठ //
text_mt: "He who, far off, would harm us, O Agni, / he who, close by, would plot evil, O you honored by friends, / burn him with your unfading bulls; / burn, O hot one, with your most fervent heat!"

sanskrit_iast: sa smā kṛṇotu ketum ā \ naktaṃ cid dūra āsate / \ pāvako yad vanaspatīn \ prāsmā minoty ajaraḥ / \ nahi te agne tanuvai \ krūraṃ cakāra martyaḥ / \ kapir babhasti tejanam \\ svaṃ jarāyu gaur iva / \ meṣa iva yad upa ca vi ca śarvarī \ yad apsuragroruparasya khādati / \ śīrṣṇā giro vakṣasā vakṣaṇāṃ jayan \\ am̐śūn babhasti haritebhir āsabhis \\ ity etaiḥ saha daśabhir ṛgyajurbhir daśāhutīr juhoti / pratyāhuti varān dadāti //
meaning: स स्मा कृणोतु केतुम् आ \ नक्तं चिद् दूर आसते / \ पावको यद् वनस्पतीन् \ प्रास्मा मिनोत्य् अजरः / \ नहि ते अग्ने तनुवै \ क्रूरं चकार मर्त्यः / \ कपिर् बभस्ति तेजनम् \\ स्वं जरायु गौर् इव / \ मेष इव यद् उप च वि च शर्वरी \ यद् अप्सुरग्रोरुपरस्य खादति / \ शीर्ष्णा गिरो वक्षसा वक्षणां जयन् \\ अम्̐शून् बभस्ति हरितेभिर् आसभिस् \\ इत्य् एतैः सह दशभिर् ऋग्यजुर्भिर् दशाहुतीर् जुहोति / प्रत्याहुति वरान् ददाति //
text_mt: "May he indeed make a beacon; / even at night they sit far off, / when the purifier destroys the trees, / he the unaging one. / For no mortal has done / harm to your body, O Agni; / the monkey chews the shaft, / like a cow its own afterbirth. / When like a ram he approaches and departs in the night, / when in the waters he eats the tip of the lower one, / winning the songs with his head, the breasts with his chest, / he chews the stalks with his green mouths"—together with these ten ṛc and yajus mantras he offers ten oblations. At each oblation, he gives boons.

sanskrit_iast: yad devā devaheḍanam iti vā ( daśāhutīr hutvā pavamānaḥ suvarjanas \\ ity etenānuvākenābhiṣiñcet ) //
meaning: यद् देवा देवहेडनम् इति वा ( दशाहुतीर् हुत्वा पवमानः सुवर्जनस् \\ इत्य् एतेनानुवाकेनाभिषिञ्चेत् ) //
text_mt: Or, having offered ten oblations with "Whatever offense to the gods, O gods...", he sprinkles [the sacrificer] with this section: "Pavamāna, who produces the sun..."

sanskrit_iast: yadi hutāhutau somau sam̐sṛjeyātām antaḥparidhy āhavanīyād aṅgāraṃ nirvartya yajñasya hi stha ṛtviyau \\ indrāgnī cetanasya ca \ hutāhutasya tṛpyatam \ ahutasya hutasya ca \ hutasya cāhutasya ca \\ ahutasya hutasya ca \\ indrāgnī asya somasya \ vītaṃ pibataṃ juṣethām̐ svāhā \\ iti hutāhutau somau juhuyāt //
meaning: यदि हुताहुतौ सोमौ सम्̐सृजेयाताम् अन्तःपरिध्य् आहवनीयाद् अङ्गारं निर्वर्त्य यज्ञस्य हि स्थ ऋत्वियौ \\ इन्द्राग्नी चेतनस्य च \ हुताहुतस्य तृप्यतम् \ अहुतस्य हुतस्य च \ हुतस्य चाहुतस्य च \\ अहुतस्य हुतस्य च \\ इन्द्राग्नी अस्य सोमस्य \ वीतं पिबतं जुषेथाम्̐ स्वाहा \\ इति हुताहुतौ सोमौ जुहुयात् //
text_mt: If an offered soma and an unoffered soma should become mixed together, having rolled an ember out from the āhavanīya fire within the enclosing sticks, he offers the offered and unoffered somas with: "For you two are the seasonal [priests] of the sacrifice / and of the conscious [sacrificer], O Indra and Agni! / Be satisfied with the offered and the unoffered, / with the unoffered and the offered, / with the offered and the unoffered, / with the unoffered and the offered! / O Indra and Agni, partake of this soma, / drink, enjoy it, svāhā!"

sanskrit_iast: mā no dhvariṣuḥ pitaro mota vīrān \ mā naḥ sabandhur uta vānyabandhuḥ / \ mā no duścakṣā aghaśam̐sa īśata \\ āhuto 'yaṃ yajñam apyetu devās \\ iti hutāhutau somau bhakṣayati //
meaning: मा नो ध्वरिषुः पितरो मोत वीरान् \ मा नः सबन्धुर् उत वान्यबन्धुः / \ मा नो दुश्चक्षा अघशम्̐स ईशत \\ आहुतो ऽयं यज्ञम् अप्येतु देवास् \\ इति हुताहुतौ सोमौ भक्षयति //
text_mt: With the words, "May the fathers not injure us, nor our heroes; / may neither our kinsman nor a stranger [harm us]; / may the evil-eyed and the slanderer not have power over us; / may this offered [soma] go to the sacrifice, O gods!" he consumes the offered and unoffered somas.

sanskrit_iast: mā yajamānaṃ tamo vidat \\ martvijo mā imāḥ prajāḥ / \ mā yaḥ somam imaṃ pibāt \ sam̐sṛṣṭam ubhayaṃ kṛtam iti bhakṣayantam abhimantrayate //
meaning: मा यजमानं तमो विदत् \\ मर्त्विजो मा इमाः प्रजाः / \ मा यः सोमम् इमं पिबात् \ सम्̐सृष्टम् उभयं कृतम् इति भक्षयन्तम् अभिमन्त्रयते //
text_mt: With the words, "May darkness not reach the sacrificer, / nor the priests, nor these offspring; / may it not reach whoever drinks this soma / that has been mixed and doubly prepared!" he addresses [the priest] while consuming [it].

sanskrit_iast: saptartvijaḥ sapta sadām̐sy eṣām \\ daśa kṣipo aśvinā pañca vājāḥ / \ prāṇo vyāno 'pāno mana ākūtam agniḥ \ svāhākṛtam̐ havir adantu devāḥ // \ prajāpate na tvad etān iti bhakṣaṃ vyāpannam uttarārdhapūrvārdha uparave 'vanayet //
meaning: सप्तर्त्विजः सप्त सदाम्̐स्य् एषाम् \\ दश क्षिपो अश्विना पञ्च वाजाः / \ प्राणो व्यानो ऽपानो मन आकूतम् अग्निः \ स्वाहाकृतम्̐ हविर् अदन्तु देवाः // \ प्रजापते न त्वद् एतान् इति भक्षं व्यापन्नम् उत्तरार्धपूर्वार्ध उपरवे ऽवनयेत् //
text_mt: "Seven are the officiating priests, seven their sitting places; / ten are the fingers, the two Aśvins, five the provisions; / in-breath, out-breath, diffused breath, mind, intention, Agni: / may the gods eat the oblation prepared with the svāhā-call!" [and] with "O Prajāpati, none other than you [encompasses] these..." he pours the spoiled consumption portion into the sounding-hole in the northeastern quarter.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇārdhapūrvardhe vā //
meaning: दक्षिणार्धपूर्वर्धे वा //
text_mt: Or in the southeastern quarter.

sanskrit_iast: skannā dyauḥ skannā pṛthivī \ skannaṃ viśvam idaṃ jagat / \ skannādo viśvā bhūtāni \ praskannāj jāyatām̐ haviḥ //
meaning: स्कन्ना द्यौः स्कन्ना पृथिवी \ स्कन्नं विश्वम् इदं जगत् / \ स्कन्नादो विश्वा भूतानि \ प्रस्कन्नाज् जायताम्̐ हविः //
text_mt: "Spilled is heaven, spilled is the earth; / spilled is this entire universe; / all creatures eat from what is spilled; / from what has spilled forth may the oblation arise!

sanskrit_iast: iha gāvaḥ prajāyadhvam \ ihāśvā iha pūruṣāḥ //
meaning: इह गावः प्रजायध्वम् \ इहाश्वा इह पूरुषाः //
text_mt: Here, O cows, multiply; / here, O horses; here, O men!

sanskrit_iast: iho sahasradakṣiṇas \\ rāyaspoṣo niṣīdatu //
meaning: इहो सहस्रदक्षिणस् \\ रायस्पोषो निषीदतु //
text_mt: And here may abundance of wealth, / accompanied by a thousand sacrificial gifts, settle down!

sanskrit_iast: ayaṃ yajño vardhatāṃ gobhir aśvair \ iyaṃ vediḥ svapatyā suvīrā / \ idaṃ barhir ati barhīm̐ṣy anyā \\ imaṃ yajñaṃ viśve avantu devāḥ //
meaning: अयं यज्ञो वर्धतां गोभिर् अश्वैर् \ इयं वेदिः स्वपत्या सुवीरा / \ इदं बर्हिर् अति बर्हीम्̐ष्य् अन्या \\ इमं यज्ञं विश्वे अवन्तु देवाः //
text_mt: May this sacrifice increase with cattle and horses; / may this altar be blessed with good offspring, with good heroes; / may this sacred grass surpass other sacred grasses; / may all the gods favor this sacrifice!"

sanskrit_iast: payasvatīroṣadhayas \\ ity etābhiḥ pṛṣadājyam̐ skannam abhimantryāpo 'bhyavahṛtya pātraṃ nirṇijya punar niṣṭapya nidadhāti / tasmin hiraṇyam̐ śatamānam avadhāya \\ ekam iṣe \ viṣṇus tvānvetu \\ iti vaiṣṇavyarcāthānyad dadhi pṛṣadājyaṃ gṛhītvā drapsaś caskanda \\ ity abhimṛśyāśvenāvaghrāpya sādayati //
meaning: पयस्वतीरोषधयस् \\ इत्य् एताभिः पृषदाज्यम्̐ स्कन्नम् अभिमन्त्र्यापो ऽभ्यवहृत्य पात्रं निर्णिज्य पुनर् निष्टप्य निदधाति / तस्मिन् हिरण्यम्̐ शतमानम् अवधाय \\ एकम् इषे \ विष्णुस् त्वान्वेतु \\ इति वैष्णव्यर्चाथान्यद् दधि पृषदाज्यं गृहीत्वा द्रप्सश् चस्कन्द \\ इत्य् अभिमृश्याश्वेनावघ्राप्य सादयति //
text_mt: Having addressed the spilled clotted butter with [the verses], 'Rich in milk the plants...', and having thrown [it] into water, cleansed the vessel, and heated it again over the fire, he places it down. Having placed a gold piece of one hundred mānas weight into it, with the verse to Viṣṇu, 'One for food, may Viṣṇu go after you...', and then taking another portion of curds [and] clotted butter, touching it with, 'The drop spilt...', and having made a horse smell it, he sets it down.

sanskrit_iast: yad apāmṛkṣac chakunir \ mukhena nirṛte tava / \ agniṣ ṭat sarvam̐ śundhatu \ havyavāḍ ghṛtasūdanas \\ iti śakunyavamṛṣṭaṃ tasyaitad eva prāyaścittaṃ nirlikhyate 'tra pātram //
meaning: यद् अपामृक्षच् छकुनिर् \ मुखेन निरृते तव / \ अग्निष् टत् सर्वम्̐ शुन्धतु \ हव्यवाड् घृतसूदनस् \\ इति शकुन्यवमृष्टं तस्यैतद् एव प्रायश्चित्तं निर्लिख्यते ऽत्र पात्रम् //
text_mt: 'What the bird has touched with its beak, O Nirṛti, of yours, may Agni, the bearer of oblations who clarifies ghee, purify all that'—[with this verse he addresses] what has been touched by a bird. Its expiation is this very [rite]. Here the vessel is scraped clean.

sanskrit_iast: yad avālikṣac chvapāt \\ mukhena nirṛte tava / \ agniṣ ṭat sarvaṃ śundhatu \ havyavāḍ ghṛtasūdanas \\ iti śvāpadāvalīḍham abhimantrayate / tasyaitad eva prāyaścittam / ( abhyavaharaṇādi pūrvavat ) / nātra pātraṃ prayujyate //
meaning: यद् अवालिक्षच् छ्वपात् \\ मुखेन निरृते तव / \ अग्निष् टत् सर्वं शुन्धतु \ हव्यवाड् घृतसूदनस् \\ इति श्वापदावलीढम् अभिमन्त्रयते / तस्यैतद् एव प्रायश्चित्तम् / ( अभ्यवहरणादि पूर्ववत् ) / नात्र पात्रं प्रयुज्यते //
text_mt: 'What the wild beast has licked with its mouth, O Nirṛti, of yours, may Agni, the bearer of oblations who clarifies ghee, purify all that'—with this [verse] he addresses what has been licked by a wild beast. Its expiation is this very [rite]. (The throwing into water and the rest are as before.) The vessel is not used here.

sanskrit_iast: yad asya pāre rajasas \\ iti juhuyāt / yadi paśur upākṛto vepeta niṣīded vāśyetocchrayet palāyetā kāmasaṃjñapane ca / yasmād bhīṣāvepiṣṭhās \ tato no abhayaṃ kṛdhi / \ prajābhyaḥ sarvābhyo mṛḍa \ namo rudrāya mīḍuṣe \\ iti dvitīyāṃ vepāmāne //
meaning: यद् अस्य पारे रजसस् \\ इति जुहुयात् / यदि पशुर् उपाकृतो वेपेत निषीदेद् वाश्येतोच्छ्रयेत् पलायेता कामसंज्ञपने च / यस्माद् भीषावेपिष्ठास् \ ततो नो अभयं कृधि / \ प्रजाभ्यः सर्वाभ्यो मृड \ नमो रुद्राय मीडुषे \\ इति द्वितीयां वेपामाने //
text_mt: He should offer with: 'Beyond the realm of this dust...'. If the animal, when dedicated, should tremble, lie down, cry out, rear up, or run away, and in the case of unintentional killing: 'From which fear you trembled, from that make us free from fear; be gracious to all creatures, homage to the bounteous Rudra'—[he offers] the second [oblation] with this [verse] if it trembles.

sanskrit_iast: yasmād bhīṣā nyaṣadas \\ iti dvitīyāṃ niṣaṇṇe //
meaning: यस्माद् भीषा न्यषदस् \\ इति द्वितीयां निषण्णे //
text_mt: 'From which fear you sat down...'—[he offers] the second [oblation] with this [verse] if it has sat down.

sanskrit_iast: ud usra tiṣṭha pratitiṣṭha mā riṣas \\ memaṃ yajñaṃ yajamānaṃ ca rīriṣaḥ / \ suvarge loke yajamānam̐ hi dhehi \ śaṃ na edhi dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade \\ ity usram utthāpayet //
meaning: उद् उस्र तिष्ठ प्रतितिष्ठ मा रिषस् \\ मेमं यज्ञं यजमानं च रीरिषः / \ सुवर्गे लोके यजमानम्̐ हि धेहि \ शं न एधि द्विपदे शं चतुष्पदे \\ इत्य् उस्रम् उत्थापयेत् //
text_mt: 'Stand up, O bull, stand firm, do not be harmed; do not harm this sacrifice and the sacrificer. Place the sacrificer in the heavenly world; be auspicious to our two-footed, auspicious to our four-footed'—with this [verse] he should make the bull stand up.

sanskrit_iast: uc chāga \\ iti cchāgam / un meṣa \\ iti meṣam / ūrdhva ū ṣu ṇa ūtaye \\ iti dvitīyām / ūrdhvo naḥ pāhy am̐haso ni ketunā \ viśvam̐ sam atriṇaṃ daha / \ kṛdhī na ūrdhvāṃ carathāya jīvase \ vidā deveṣu no duvas \\ iti tṛtīyām //
meaning: उच् छाग \\ इति च्छागम् / उन् मेष \\ इति मेषम् / ऊर्ध्व ऊ षु ण ऊतये \\ इति द्वितीयाम् / ऊर्ध्वो नः पाह्य् अम्̐हसो नि केतुना \ विश्वम्̐ सम् अत्रिणं दह / \ कृधी न ऊर्ध्वां चरथाय जीवसे \ विदा देवेषु नो दुवस् \\ इति तृतीयाम् //
text_mt: 'Arise, O goat'—in the case of a goat. 'Arise, O ram'—in the case of a ram. With 'Erect unto us for help...' [he offers] the second [oblation]. With 'Stand erect, protect us from distress with your banner, burn down every ravenous demon; make us erect for walking, for living; find our worship among the gods'—[he offers] the third [oblation].

sanskrit_iast: yasmād bhīṣāvāśiṣṭhās \\ iti dvitīyāṃ vāśyamāne yasmād bhīṣā samutkram̐sthās \\ iti dvitīyām ucchrayati //
meaning: यस्माद् भीषावाशिष्ठास् \\ इति द्वितीयां वाश्यमाने यस्माद् भीषा समुत्क्रम्̐स्थास् \\ इति द्वितीयाम् उच्छ्रयति //
text_mt: 'From which fear you cried out...'—[he offers] the second [oblation] with this [verse] if it cries out. 'From which fear you reared up...'—[he offers] the second [oblation] if it rears up.

sanskrit_iast: yasmād bhīṣāpalāyiṣṭhās \\ iti dvitīyāṃ palāyite 'nāgacchaty anyaṃ tadrūpaṃ tadvarṇaṃ tadvayasaṃ tajjātīyaṃ taddaivatam upākṛtya tena sam̐sthāpayet //
meaning: यस्माद् भीषापलायिष्ठास् \\ इति द्वितीयां पलायिते ऽनागच्छत्य् अन्यं तद्रूपं तद्वर्णं तद्वयसं तज्जातीयं तद्दैवतम् उपाकृत्य तेन सम्̐स्थापयेत् //
text_mt: 'From which fear you ran away...'—[he offers] the second [oblation] with this [verse] if it has run away. If it does not return, having dedicated another [animal] of the same appearance, the same color, the same age, the same species, [and] dedicated to the same deity, he should conclude [the sacrifice] with it.

sanskrit_iast: tajjātīye 'vidyamāne ajā avayo gāva ity anyonyasya pratinidhayo bhavanti //
meaning: तज्जातीये ऽविद्यमाने अजा अवयो गाव इत्य् अन्योन्यस्य प्रतिनिधयो भवन्ति //
text_mt: If one of the same species is not available, goats, sheep, and cattle serve as substitutes for one another.

sanskrit_iast: teṣv avidyamāneṣv ājyena śeṣam̐ sam̐sthāpayet //
meaning: तेष्व् अविद्यमानेष्व् आज्येन शेषम्̐ सम्̐स्थापयेत् //
text_mt: If these are not available, he should conclude the remainder [of the sacrifice] with clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: yasmād bhīṣā samajñāsthās \\ iti dvitīyām akāmasaṃjñapane //
meaning: यस्माद् भीषा समज्ञास्थास् \\ इति द्वितीयाम् अकामसंज्ञपने //
text_mt: 'From which fear you were stilled...'—[he offers] the second [oblation] with this [verse] in the case of unintentional killing.

sanskrit_iast: ya idam akas tasmai svāhā \\ iti sarvottamāṃ juhoti //
meaning: य इदम् अकस् तस्मै स्वाहा \\ इति सर्वोत्तमां जुहोति //
text_mt: 'To him who did this, svāhā'—with this [verse] he offers the final oblation of all.

sanskrit_iast: na vā uv etan mriyase / \ āśānāṃ tvā \ viśvā āśāḥ / \ āpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuvas \\ iti catasṛbhiḥ paśuṃ vyāpannam abhimantryāpo 'bhyavahṛtyānyaṃ tadrūpaṃ tadvarṇaṃ tadvayasaṃ tajjātīyaṃ taddaivatam upākṛtya tena sam̐sthāpayet / tajjātīye 'vidyamāne // palāyite vyākhyātam //
meaning: न वा उव् एतन् म्रियसे / \ आशानां त्वा \ विश्वा आशाः / \ आपो हि ष्ठा मयोभुवस् \\ इति चतसृभिः पशुं व्यापन्नम् अभिमन्त्र्यापो ऽभ्यवहृत्यान्यं तद्रूपं तद्वर्णं तद्वयसं तज्जातीयं तद्दैवतम् उपाकृत्य तेन सम्̐स्थापयेत् / तज्जातीये ऽविद्यमाने // पलायिते व्याख्यातम् //
text_mt: Having addressed a stricken animal with the four [verses], 'You do not die at all in this way...', 'The quarters of the sky to you...', 'All the quarters...', and 'The waters are indeed refreshing...', and having thrown [it] into water, having dedicated another [animal] of the same appearance, the same color, the same age, the same species, [and] dedicated to the same deity, he should conclude [the sacrifice] with it. If one of the same species is not available, [the rule] has been explained under [the case of the animal that has] run away.

sanskrit_iast: ukhām̐ sravantīm agadām akarma \\ agnir hotā pṛthivy antarikṣam \\ dyaur yataś cyutad agnāv eva tat \\ na tat prāpnoti nirṛtiṃ parācair iti paśūkhām̐ sravantīm abhimantrayeta //
meaning: उखाम्̐ स्रवन्तीम् अगदाम् अकर्म \\ अग्निर् होता पृथिव्य् अन्तरिक्षम् \\ द्यौर् यतश् च्युतद् अग्नाव् एव तत् \\ न तत् प्राप्नोति निरृतिं पराचैर् इति पशूखाम्̐ स्रवन्तीम् अभिमन्त्रयेत //
text_mt: 'The leaking pot we have made sound; Agni is the hotṛ, the earth, the midspace, and the sky. Whence it dropped, into Agni alone it has gone; it does not reach Nirṛti, turned away'—with this [verse] he should address the animal-pot when it leaks.

sanskrit_iast: yāvanti paśor avadānāni na vindeyus tāvat kṛtva ājyasyāvadyeta //
meaning: यावन्ति पशोर् अवदानानि न विन्देयुस् तावत् कृत्व आज्यस्यावद्येत //
text_mt: As many portions of the animal as they might not find, so many times he should cut portions of clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast: ye paśuṃ vimathnīran yas tān kāmayetārtim ārcheyur iti kuvid aṅga \\ iti namovṛktivatyarcāgnīdhre juhuyāt / āhavanīye śāmitre vā nirūḍhapaśubandhe //
meaning: ये पशुं विमथ्नीरन् यस् तान् कामयेतार्तिम् आर्छेयुर् इति कुविद् अङ्ग \\ इति नमोवृक्तिवत्यर्चाग्नीध्रे जुहुयात् / आहवनीये शामित्रे वा निरूढपशुबन्धे //
text_mt: If [robbers] carry off the animal, and if he desires that they incur misfortune, he should offer in the āgnīdhra fire with the verse containing the word namovṛkti: 'Surely indeed...'. [He offers it] in the āhavanīye or the slaughtering fire in an independent animal sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: yady aṣṭāpadīty anubudhyeran dhātā rātiḥ \ sūryo devas \\ iti dvābhyāṃ gārhapatye juhoti //
meaning: यद्य् अष्टापदीत्य् अनुबुध्येरन् धाता रातिः \ सूर्यो देवस् \\ इति द्वाभ्यां गार्हपत्ये जुहोति //
text_mt: If they discover that [the animal] has eight feet [being pregnant], he offers into the gārhapatya fire with two verses: 'Dhātṛ gives...' and 'The divine Sūrya...'.

sanskrit_iast: yasyās te harito garbhas \\ ity abhimantrya \\ āvartana vartaya \\ iti pradakṣiṇaṃ garbham āvartayati //
meaning: यस्यास् ते हरितो गर्भस् \\ इत्य् अभिमन्त्र्य \\ आवर्तन वर्तय \\ इति प्रदक्षिणं गर्भम् आवर्तयति //
text_mt: Having addressed [it] with, 'Whose fetus is tawny...', he turns the fetus clockwise with, 'O turner, turn...'

sanskrit_iast: vi te bhinadmi takarīm ity antarā śroṇī garbhaṃ niṣkhidati //
meaning: वि ते भिनद्मि तकरीम् इत्य् अन्तरा श्रोणी गर्भं निष्खिदति //
text_mt: With 'I split apart your pudendum', he draws out the fetus between the thighs.

sanskrit_iast: bahiste astu bāl ity āśayād garbhaṃ nirasya \\ urudrapso viśvarūpa indur iti rasāya pātram upayacchati / śūlena paśuśrapaṇe nihatya garbham̐ śrapayati //
meaning: बहिस्ते अस्तु बाल् इत्य् आशयाद् गर्भं निरस्य \\ उरुद्रप्सो विश्वरूप इन्दुर् इति रसाय पात्रम् उपयच्छति / शूलेन पशुश्रपणे निहत्य गर्भम्̐ श्रपयति //
text_mt: With 'May the hair be outside', having cast the fetus out of the amnion, he holds a vessel beneath for the broth with 'The great drop, of manifold form, the moon...'. Having fastened it onto a spit at the animal-cooking place, he cooks the fetus.

sanskrit_iast: paśupuroḍāśaṃ nirupya bhaktī dyāvāpṛthivīyaṃ garbhapuroḍāśaṃ nirvapati //
meaning: पशुपुरोडाशं निरुप्य भक्ती द्यावापृथिवीयं गर्भपुरोडाशं निर्वपति //
text_mt: Having apportioned the animal sacrificial cake, he separately portions out a fetus sacrificial cake for Heaven and Earth.

sanskrit_iast: paśor avadānāny avadāya garbhasya purastān nābhyā anyad avadyed upariṣṭād anyad avadāya daivateṣv avadadhāti //
meaning: पशोर् अवदानान्य् अवदाय गर्भस्य पुरस्तान् नाभ्या अन्यद् अवद्येद् उपरिष्टाद् अन्यद् अवदाय दैवतेष्व् अवदधाति //
text_mt: Having cut the portions of the animal, he should cut one [portion] from the front of the fetus's navel, and having cut another from above [it], he adds them to the portions for the deities.

sanskrit_iast: rasaṃ traidhaṃ karoti / daivateṣu sauviṣṭakṛteṣv aiḍeṣu ca //
meaning: रसं त्रैधं करोति / दैवतेषु सौविष्टकृतेष्व् ऐडेषु च //
text_mt: He divides the broth into three parts: for the deities, for the Sviṣṭakṛt offerings, and for the Iḍā portions.

sanskrit_iast: ekapadī dvipadīti vaṣaṭkṛte juhoti //
meaning: एकपदी द्विपदीति वषट्कृते जुहोति //
text_mt: When the vaṣaṭ-call has been uttered, he offers with 'Ekapadī, dvipadī...'.

sanskrit_iast: vaṣaṭkṛte viṣṇo pra tat te adya śipiviṣṭa nāma \\ ity anyatarayā garbhasya dakṣiṇapūrvam̐ sakthiṃ juhoti //
meaning: वषट्कृते विष्णो प्र तत् ते अद्य शिपिविष्ट नाम \\ इत्य् अन्यतरया गर्भस्य दक्षिणपूर्वम्̐ सक्थिं जुहोति //
text_mt: When the vaṣaṭ-call has been uttered, he offers the right fore-thigh of the fetus with either [verse beginning], 'O Viṣṇu, forth that name of yours today, Śipiviṣṭa...'.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇākāle 'ṣṭāprūḍḍhiraṇyaṃ dakṣiṇā / tṛtīye 'ntarakośa uṣṇīṣeṇāviṣṭitaṃ bhavati / tad dadāti / vibalān kośān karoti //
meaning: दक्षिणाकाले ऽष्टाप्रूड्ढिरण्यं दक्षिणा / तृतीये ऽन्तरकोश उष्णीषेणाविष्टितं भवति / तद् ददाति / विबलान् कोशान् करोति //
text_mt: At the time of the priestly gifts, an eight-prūḍa piece of gold is the priestly gift. In the third inner case it is wrapped in a turban. That he gives. He makes the cases of unequal strength.

sanskrit_iast: maruto yasya hi kṣaye \ yajñair vā yajñavāhasas ity anyatarayā paśuśrapaṇe garbhaṃ juhoti //
meaning: मरुतो यस्य हि क्षये \ यज्ञैर् वा यज्ञवाहसस् इत्य् अन्यतरया पशुश्रपणे गर्भं जुहोति //
text_mt: With either [verse], 'The Maruts, in whose dwelling...' or 'Or with sacrifices, O bearers of the sacrifice...', he offers the fetus at the animal-cooking place.

sanskrit_iast: garbhapuroḍāśaṃ ca na svāhākaroti //
meaning: गर्भपुरोडाशं च न स्वाहाकरोति //
text_mt: And he does not utter svāhā over the fetus sacrificial cake.

sanskrit_iast: api vā mahī dyauḥ pṛthivī ca nas \\ iti paśuśrapaṇasya śīte bhasmani garbham upohati //
meaning: अपि वा मही द्यौः पृथिवी च नस् \\ इति पशुश्रपणस्य शीते भस्मनि गर्भम् उपोहति //
text_mt: Or else, with 'Great heaven and earth for us...', he pushes the fetus into the cooled ashes of the animal-cooking place.

sanskrit_iast: garbhapuroḍāśaṃ //
meaning: गर्भपुरोडाशं //

sanskrit_iast: etaṃ yuvānaṃ pari vo dadāmi \\ iti // pañcabhir abhimantrya //
meaning: एतं युवानं परि वो ददामि \\ इति // पञ्चभिर् अभिमन्त्र्य //
text_mt: Having addressed [the animal] with the five [verses beginning], 'This youth I commit to you...',

sanskrit_iast: yasyānapravṛtto yūpo virohet tasmim̐s tvāṣṭram̐ sāṇḍaṃ lomaśaṃ piṅgalaṃ bahurūpaṃ savanīyasyopalambhyaṃ kuryāt trayastrim̐śat tantavo ye vitatnire \\ iti juhuyāt //
meaning: यस्यानप्रवृत्तो यूपो विरोहेत् तस्मिम्̐स् त्वाष्ट्रम्̐ साण्डं लोमशं पिङ्गलं बहुरूपं सवनीयस्योपलम्भ्यं कुर्यात् त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शत् तन्तवो ये वितत्निरे \\ इति जुहुयात् //
text_mt: If a sacrificial post that has not fallen should sprout, he should seize for it an uncastrated, hairy, reddish-brown, variegated animal sacred to Tvaṣṭṛ as an addition to the savanīya animal, and should offer with: 'The thirty-three threads which were stretched out...'.

sanskrit_iast: yadi kṛṣṇaśakunir dhvam̐sayann uparyupari sadohavirdhānāny atipated bhaya utpanne śakye yaṣṭum̐ sarvebhyo havirbhyaḥ somebhyaś ca droṇakalaśe samavadāya ye devā yeṣām idaṃ bhāgadheyaṃ babhūva \ yeṣāṃ prayājā utānūyājāḥ / \ indrajyeṣṭhebhyo varuṇarājabhyas \\ agnihotṛbhyo devebhyaḥ svāhā \\ ity āhutiṃ juhoti //
meaning: यदि कृष्णशकुनिर् ध्वम्̐सयन्न् उपर्युपरि सदोहविर्धानान्य् अतिपतेद् भय उत्पन्ने शक्ये यष्टुम्̐ सर्वेभ्यो हविर्भ्यः सोमेभ्यश् च द्रोणकलशे समवदाय ये देवा येषाम् इदं भागधेयं बभूव \ येषां प्रयाजा उतानूयाजाः / \ इन्द्रज्येष्ठेभ्यो वरुणराजभ्यस् \\ अग्निहोतृभ्यो देवेभ्यः स्वाहा \\ इत्य् आहुतिं जुहोति //
text_mt: If a black bird, shaking [its wings], should fly across over the sadas and the havirdhāna sheds, when danger has arisen, if it is possible to sacrifice, having collected together portions from all the sacrificial oblations and from the somas into the droṇakalaśa, he offers an oblation with: 'Those gods whose share this became, whose are the fore-offerings and after-offerings, to those gods whose eldest is Indra, whose king is Varuṇa, who have Agni as hotṛ, svāhā!'.

sanskrit_iast: abhaye punar yajeta //
meaning: अभये पुनर् यजेत //

sanskrit_iast: yady ṛkto yajñabhreṣa ṛcchet \\ bhūr iti gārhapatye juhuyāt / yadi yajuṣṭas \\ bhuvas \\ iti dakṣiṇāgnau / yadi sāmataḥ suvar ity āhavanīye / yadi sarvataḥ sarvābhir ekām āhavanīye brahmā vā juhuyāt //
meaning: यद्य् ऋक्तो यज्ञभ्रेष ऋच्छेत् \\ भूर् इति गार्हपत्ये जुहुयात् / यदि यजुष्टस् \\ भुवस् \\ इति दक्षिणाग्नौ / यदि सामतः सुवर् इत्य् आहवनीये / यदि सर्वतः सर्वाभिर् एकाम् आहवनीये ब्रह्मा वा जुहुयात् //
text_mt: If a mishap in the sacrifice should occur through an ṛc, he should offer in the gārhapatya fire with 'Bhūḥ'. If through a yajus, in the dakṣiṇāgni fire with 'Bhuvaḥ'. If through a sāman, in the āhavanīya fire with 'Suvaḥ'. If from all, he should offer one [oblation] into the āhavanīya fire with all [three words], or the brahman priest should offer it.

sanskrit_iast: manasā vā dhyāyet //
meaning: मनसा वा ध्यायेत् //

sanskrit_iast: audumbarī naśyed bhajyeta vānyāṃ pracchidya \\ ūrg asi \\ ūrjaṃ mayi dhehi \ śriyo tiṣṭha pratiṣṭhitā \ divam̐ stabdhāntarikṣaṃ ca pṛthivyāṃ ca dṛḍhā bhava \ dhamitrī dharitrī janitrī \\ ity ucchrayati //
meaning: औदुम्बरी नश्येद् भज्येत वान्यां प्रच्छिद्य \\ ऊर्ग् असि \\ ऊर्जं मयि धेहि \ श्रियो तिष्ठ प्रतिष्ठिता \ दिवम्̐ स्तब्धान्तरिक्षं च पृथिव्यां च दृढा भव \ धमित्री धरित्री जनित्री \\ इत्य् उच्छ्रयति //
text_mt: If the audumbarī post should be lost or broken, after cutting another one, he erects it with: "You are strength; place strength in me! Stand established for prosperity! Support the sky and the intermediate space, and be firm upon the earth! O blower, sustainer, generator!"

sanskrit_iast: adhvaryur yajamāno brahmā vocchrayati //
meaning: अध्वर्युर् यजमानो ब्रह्मा वोच्छ्रयति //
text_mt: The adhvaryu, the sacrificer, or the brahman priest erects [it].

sanskrit_iast: saṃmitāṃ nityena yajuṣābhimantrayate //
meaning: संमितां नित्येन यजुषाभिमन्त्रयते //
text_mt: He addresses [the post] that has been measured with the regular yajus mantra.

sanskrit_iast: yadi havirdhāne padyeyātāṃ dakṣiṇām adhvaryur udgṛhṇīyāt pratiprasthātopastabhnuyāt / uttaraṃ pratiprasthātodgṛhṇīyād adhvaryur upastabhnuyāt //
meaning: यदि हविर्धाने पद्येयातां दक्षिणाम् अध्वर्युर् उद्गृह्णीयात् प्रतिप्रस्थातोपस्तभ्नुयात् / उत्तरं प्रतिप्रस्थातोद्गृह्णीयाद् अध्वर्युर् उपस्तभ्नुयात् //
text_mt: If the two havirdhāna carts should collapse, the adhvaryu should lift up the southern one, [and] the pratiprasthātṛ should prop it up; the pratiprasthātṛ should lift up the northern one, [and] the adhvaryu should prop it up.

sanskrit_iast: vaiṣṇavyopastabhnutaḥ / vaiṣṇavyopaminute / āśvinyā saṃmṛśataḥ //
meaning: वैष्णव्योपस्तभ्नुतः / वैष्णव्योपमिनुते / आश्विन्या संमृशतः //
text_mt: Both prop [them] up with [a verse] addressed to Viṣṇu; he fastens [them] with [a verse] addressed to Viṣṇu; both touch [them] with [a verse] addressed to the Aśvins.

sanskrit_iast: agne vājasya gomatas \\ iti tisṛbhir uṣṇigbhir adhvaryur āgnīdhre juhoti / kakudbhiḥ pratiprasthātā // bhadro no agnir āhutas \\ bhadrā rātiḥ subhaga bhadro adhvaraḥ / \ bhadrā uta praśastayaḥ / \ bhadrā uta praśastayas \\ bhadraṃ manaḥ kṛṇuṣva vṛtratūrye / \ yenā samatsu sāsahaḥ / \ yenā samatsu sāsahas \\ ava sthirā tanuhi bhūri śardhatām / \ vanemā te abhiṣṭibhir ity etā āmnātā bhavanti //
meaning: अग्ने वाजस्य गोमतस् \\ इति तिसृभिर् उष्णिग्भिर् अध्वर्युर् आग्नीध्रे जुहोति / ककुद्भिः प्रतिप्रस्थाता // भद्रो नो अग्निर् आहुतस् \\ भद्रा रातिः सुभग भद्रो अध्वरः / \ भद्रा उत प्रशस्तयः / \ भद्रा उत प्रशस्तयस् \\ भद्रं मनः कृणुष्व वृत्रतूर्ये / \ येना समत्सु सासहः / \ येना समत्सु सासहस् \\ अव स्थिरा तनुहि भूरि शर्धताम् / \ वनेमा ते अभिष्टिभिर् इत्य् एता आम्नाता भवन्ति //
text_mt: The adhvaryu offers into the āgnīdhra fire with three uṣṇih verses: "O Agni, of prize, rich in cattle..."; the pratiprasthātṛ with kakubh verses: "Auspicious to us is Agni when invoked, / auspicious the gift, O fortunate one, auspicious the sacrifice; / auspicious also the praises. / Auspicious also the praises: / make an auspicious mind at the slaying of Vṛtra, / wherewith you may overcome in battles. / Wherewith you may overcome in battles: / unbend the stiff [bows] of the many that are arrogant; / may we win through your assistances." Thus these are handed down in the sacred text.

sanskrit_iast: śiro yajñasya pratidhīyatām \ amṛtaṃ devatāmayam \\ vaiṣṇavyā kriyatām̐ śiras \\ āśvinyā pratidhīyatām iti caturgṛhītaṃ pañcagṛhītaṃ vā gṛhītvā samānau homau juhutaḥ //
meaning: शिरो यज्ञस्य प्रतिधीयताम् \ अमृतं देवतामयम् \\ वैष्णव्या क्रियताम्̐ शिरस् \\ आश्विन्या प्रतिधीयताम् इति चतुर्गृहीतं पञ्चगृहीतं वा गृहीत्वा समानौ होमौ जुहुतः //
text_mt: Having taken four ladlings or five ladlings, both make identical offerings with: "May the head of the sacrifice be set on, immortal, consisting of deities; let the head be made with [a verse] addressed to Viṣṇu; let it be set on with [a verse] addressed to the Aśvins!"

sanskrit_iast: yady āgniky ukhāmā bhidyeta saṃkṛṣya punaḥ kuryāt //
meaning: यद्य् आग्निक्य् उखामा भिद्येत संकृष्य पुनः कुर्यात् //
text_mt: If the unbaked ukhā pot related to the fire-altar should break, having scraped it together, he should make it again.

sanskrit_iast: yadi pakvā bhidyeta tair eva kapālaiḥ supiṣṭair anyāṃ mṛdam̐ sam̐sṛjya kuryāt //
meaning: यदि पक्वा भिद्येत तैर् एव कपालैः सुपिष्टैर् अन्यां मृदम्̐ सम्̐सृज्य कुर्यात् //
text_mt: If the baked one should break, he should make it by mixing other clay with those very pot-sherds well ground.

sanskrit_iast: yasyāgnir ukhya udvāyed āhavanīyaṃ praṇīya sa eva punaḥ parīdhyaḥ //
meaning: यस्याग्निर् उख्य उद्वायेद् आहवनीयं प्रणीय स एव पुनः परीध्यः //
text_mt: For whomever the fire in the ukhā pot should go out, having brought forward the āhavanīya fire, that very one is to be enclosed again.

sanskrit_iast: kṛṣṇaṃ vāso deyam / kṛṣṇā dhenuḥ kṛṣṇo vā gauḥ śatamānaṃ ca hiraṇyam //
meaning: कृष्णं वासो देयम् / कृष्णा धेनुः कृष्णो वा गौः शतमानं च हिरण्यम् //
text_mt: A black garment is to be given, a black milk-cow or a black bull, and gold weighing a hundred mānas.

sanskrit_iast: yat pūrvasminn ahany uttarasmā ahne yajñāyajñiyaṃ prati vasatīvarīr gṛhṇāti / tenāhar abhyāsajati / tena yajñam̐ saṃtanoti //
meaning: यत् पूर्वस्मिन्न् अहन्य् उत्तरस्मा अह्ने यज्ञायज्ञियं प्रति वसतीवरीर् गृह्णाति / तेनाहर् अभ्यासजति / तेन यज्ञम्̐ संतनोति //
text_mt: Because on the preceding day he takes the vasatīvarī waters in view of the yajñāyajñiya chant for the subsequent day, thereby he links the day; thereby he extends the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: yat pūrvasminn ahany uttarasmā ahne stotryam anurūpaṃ kṛtvā śam̐sati / tenāhar abhyāsajati / tena yajñam̐ saṃtanoti / yad atipreṣyati tenāhar abhyāsajati tena yajñam̐ saṃtanotīti //
meaning: यत् पूर्वस्मिन्न् अहन्य् उत्तरस्मा अह्ने स्तोत्र्यम् अनुरूपं कृत्वा शम्̐सति / तेनाहर् अभ्यासजति / तेन यज्ञम्̐ संतनोति / यद् अतिप्रेष्यति तेनाहर् अभ्यासजति तेन यज्ञम्̐ संतनोतीति //
text_mt: Because on the preceding day he recites making the stotriya verse corresponding for the subsequent day, thereby he links the day; thereby he extends the sacrifice. Because he sends forth the call beyond, thereby he links the day; thereby he extends the sacrifice—so [it is said].

sanskrit_iast: eteṣām ekasminn akriyamāṇe namo brahmaṇe namo astv agnaye \ namaḥ pṛthivyai nama oṣadhībhyaḥ / \ namo vāce namo vācaspataye \ namo viṣṇave bṛhate karomi svāhā \\ ity etat prāyaścittaṃ juhuyād etat prāyaścittaṃ juhuyāt //
meaning: एतेषाम् एकस्मिन्न् अक्रियमाणे नमो ब्रह्मणे नमो अस्त्व् अग्नये \ नमः पृथिव्यै नम ओषधीभ्यः / \ नमो वाचे नमो वाचस्पतये \ नमो विष्णवे बृहते करोमि स्वाहा \\ इत्य् एतत् प्रायश्चित्तं जुहुयाद् एतत् प्रायश्चित्तं जुहुयात् //
text_mt: When one of these is not performed, he should make this expiatory offering: "Homage to the brahman, homage be to Agni, / homage to the earth, homage to the plants; / homage to speech, homage to the lord of speech; / homage to great Viṣṇu I make, svāhā!" He should make this expiatory offering.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśāhena praiva jāyate //
meaning: द्वादशाहेन प्रैव जायते //
text_mt: By means of the twelve-day rite, he indeed prospers with offspring.

sanskrit_iast: jyaiṣṭhyam aśnute sa hy enam anubhavati //
meaning: ज्यैष्ठ्यम् अश्नुते स ह्य् एनम् अनुभवति //
text_mt: He attains pre-eminence, for it conforms to him.

sanskrit_iast: ahīnaḥ satraṃ ca //
meaning: अहीनः सत्रं च //

sanskrit_iast: tasyāgnikalpo vyākhyātaḥ //
meaning: तस्याग्निकल्पो व्याख्यातः //
text_mt: Its procedure for the fire has been explained.

sanskrit_iast: gataśriyaś chandasā yajeran //
meaning: गतश्रियश् छन्दसा यजेरन् //
text_mt: Those who have attained prosperity should sacrifice with the metre.

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ kāmayeta cchandasā yajate so 'smai kāmaḥ samṛdhyate / yajate yajanta iti codanaṃ yo 'tapasvī syād asam̐śliṣṭo 'sya yajñaḥ syāt tapasvī syād yajñam eva tat sam̐śleṣayatīti vijñāyate //
meaning: यं कामयेत च्छन्दसा यजते सो ऽस्मै कामः समृध्यते / यजते यजन्त इति चोदनं यो ऽतपस्वी स्याद् असम्̐श्लिष्टो ऽस्य यज्ञः स्यात् तपस्वी स्याद् यज्ञम् एव तत् सम्̐श्लेषयतीति विज्ञायते //
text_mt: Whatever desire he may have, who sacrifices with the metre, that desire is fulfilled for him. "He sacrifices", "they sacrifice" is the injunction. He who might be without ascetic heat, his sacrifice would be unjoined; he should have ascetic heat: thereby he joins the sacrifice—so it is known [from the Brāhmaṇa].

sanskrit_iast: pīvā dīkṣate / kṛśo yajate //
meaning: पीवा दीक्षते / कृशो यजते //
text_mt: Fat, he undergoes consecration; lean, he sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast: kāmyā vidyād aṣṭācatvārim̐śataṃ krāmayati //
meaning: काम्या विद्याद् अष्टाचत्वारिम्̐शतं क्रामयति //
text_mt: One should know [the numbers as] optional; he causes forty-eight to pass.

sanskrit_iast: pañcadaśa dīkṣerann ardhamāsāyatanāḥ //
meaning: पञ्चदश दीक्षेरन्न् अर्धमासायतनाः //
text_mt: Fifteen should undergo consecration, having the half-month as their domain.

sanskrit_iast: saptadaśa prajākāmāḥ //
meaning: सप्तदश प्रजाकामाः //

sanskrit_iast: ekavim̐śatim̐ rukkāmāḥ / trayovim̐śatiṃ pratiṣṭhākāmāḥ / caturvim̐śatiṃ brahmavarcasakāmāḥ / trim̐śataṃ māsāyatanāḥ / trayastrim̐śatam ojaskāmāḥ / catvārim̐śatam indriyakāmāḥ / catuścatvārim̐śataṃ vīryakāmāḥ / aṣṭācatvārim̐śataṃ paśukāmāḥ //
meaning: एकविम्̐शतिम्̐ रुक्कामाः / त्रयोविम्̐शतिं प्रतिष्ठाकामाः / चतुर्विम्̐शतिं ब्रह्मवर्चसकामाः / त्रिम्̐शतं मासायतनाः / त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शतम् ओजस्कामाः / चत्वारिम्̐शतम् इन्द्रियकामाः / चतुश्चत्वारिम्̐शतं वीर्यकामाः / अष्टाचत्वारिम्̐शतं पशुकामाः //
text_mt: Twenty-one, if desiring brightness; twenty-three, if desiring stability; twenty-four, if desiring holy lustre; thirty, having the month as their domain; thirty-three, if desiring vigor; forty, if desiring faculty of the senses; forty-four, if desiring virility; forty-eight, if desiring cattle.

sanskrit_iast: aparimitaṃ dīkṣerann ity antato vadanti //
meaning: अपरिमितं दीक्षेरन्न् इत्य् अन्ततो वदन्ति //
text_mt: "An unlimited number should undergo consecration," they say at the end.

sanskrit_iast: te 'py ahīnasya yājamāne sthāninaḥ //
meaning: ते ऽप्य् अहीनस्य याजमाने स्थानिनः //
text_mt: They too occupy the place of the sacrificer in the ahīna.

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇā ṛtvijo dīkṣitānām adīkṣitānām ahīnasya tena yājayanti //
meaning: ब्राह्मणा ऋत्विजो दीक्षितानाम् अदीक्षितानाम् अहीनस्य तेन याजयन्ति //
text_mt: The brāhmaṇa priests officiate for consecrated or unconsecrated [sacrificers] of an ahīna with that [rite].

sanskrit_iast: tasmād dvādaśāhena na yājyaṃ pāpmano vyāvṛttyā iti
meaning: तस्माद् द्वादशाहेन न याज्यं पाप्मनो व्यावृत्त्या इति
text_mt: Therefore one should not officiate at the twelve-day rite, for the sake of separation from evil—so [says the Brāhmaṇa].

sanskrit_iast: ya evaṃ vidvān dvādaśāhena yajate //
meaning: य एवं विद्वान् द्वादशाहेन यजते //
text_mt: He who, knowing thus, sacrifices with the twelve-day rite—

sanskrit_iast: yajamāna ṛdhnoti //
meaning: यजमान ऋध्नोति //

sanskrit_iast: ya evaṃ vidvān dvādaśāhena pratigṛhṇāti //
meaning: य एवं विद्वान् द्वादशाहेन प्रतिगृह्णाति //
text_mt: He who, knowing thus, accepts [dakṣiṇās] at the twelve-day rite—

sanskrit_iast: ṛtvijo yajamānaṃ cādhikṛtya vadati //
meaning: ऋत्विजो यजमानं चाधिकृत्य वदति //
text_mt: [The Brāhmaṇa] speaks referring both to the priests and to the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇānāṃ tu satram ato dīkṣitānām̐ saptadaśānām āsata upayanti //
meaning: ब्राह्मणानां तु सत्रम् अतो दीक्षितानाम्̐ सप्तदशानाम् आसत उपयन्ति //
text_mt: A satra, however, belongs to brāhmaṇas; hence, seventeen consecrated persons sit, enter upon [it].

sanskrit_iast: codanā sarva iṣṭaprathamayajñā gṛhapatir vā //
meaning: चोदना सर्व इष्टप्रथमयज्ञा गृहपतिर् वा //
text_mt: The injunction is that all have performed their first sacrifice, or the master of the house [has].

sanskrit_iast: sarve yājamānam ārtvijyenāvipratiṣiddhaṃ kuryuḥ //
meaning: सर्वे याजमानम् आर्त्विज्येनाविप्रतिषिद्धं कुर्युः //
text_mt: All should perform the duties of the sacrificer that are not in conflict with the duties of an officiating priest.

sanskrit_iast: gṛhapatiḥ parārthāni yathā yūpāñjanam ṛtuyājyām ity evam̐rūpāṇi dharmapratiṣedhe bhūyasāṃ dharmo 'nugrahyate ( gṛhapater vā ) //
meaning: गृहपतिः परार्थानि यथा यूपाञ्जनम् ऋतुयाज्याम् इत्य् एवम्̐रूपाणि धर्मप्रतिषेधे भूयसां धर्मो ऽनुग्रह्यते ( गृहपतेर् वा ) //
text_mt: The master of the house performs those for the sake of others, such as the anointing of the sacrificial post and the seasonal offering verses; in such cases, when there is an incompatibility of ritual practices, the practice of the majority is adopted (or that of the master of the house).

sanskrit_iast: gṛhapater eva sāmidhenīkalpeneti kurvīran //
meaning: गृहपतेर् एव सामिधेनीकल्पेनेति कुर्वीरन् //
text_mt: They should perform according to the procedure of the enkindling verses of the master of the house alone.

sanskrit_iast: tvaṃ varuṇas \\ iti vasiṣṭharājanyānām̐ sāmidhenīparidhānīyā / ājuhota \\ itītareṣāṃ gotrāṇām //
meaning: त्वं वरुणस् \\ इति वसिष्ठराजन्यानाम्̐ सामिधेनीपरिधानीया / आजुहोत \\ इतीतरेषां गोत्राणाम् //
text_mt: "You are Varuṇa..." is the concluding enkindling verse for descendants of Vasiṣṭha and royals; "Offer ye..." for other lineages.

sanskrit_iast: nārāśaṃso dvitīyaḥ prayājo vasiṣṭhaśunakānām / tanūnapād itareṣāṃ gotrāṇām //
meaning: नाराशंसो द्वितीयः प्रयाजो वसिष्ठशुनकानाम् / तनूनपाद् इतरेषां गोत्राणाम् //
text_mt: Nārāśaṃsa is the second fore-offering for descendants of Vasiṣṭha and Śunaka; Tanūnapāt for other lineages.

sanskrit_iast: sāvitrāṇi hoṣyantaḥ saṃnivaperan hutvā vinivaperan //
meaning: सावित्राणि होष्यन्तः संनिवपेरन् हुत्वा विनिवपेरन् //
text_mt: About to offer the Sāvitra offerings, they should bring [their fires] together; having offered, they should separate them.

sanskrit_iast: paśubhir yakṣyamāṇāḥ saṃnivaperann iṣṭvā nivaperan gṛhapatir vāraṇyoḥ saṃnivaperan //
meaning: पशुभिर् यक्ष्यमाणाः संनिवपेरन्न् इष्ट्वा निवपेरन् गृहपतिर् वारण्योः संनिवपेरन् //
text_mt: About to sacrifice with animals, they should bring [their fires] together; having sacrificed, they should separate them; or they should bring them together in the two kindling sticks of the master of the house.

sanskrit_iast: ya ito 'gnir janiṣyate sa naḥ sarveṣām \\ yad anena yajñena jeṣyāmo 'nena paśubandhena tan naḥ saha \ saha naḥ sādhutulyā \ ya evaṃ pāpaṃ karavat tasyaiva tat \\ ity uktam //
meaning: य इतो ऽग्निर् जनिष्यते स नः सर्वेषाम् \\ यद् अनेन यज्ञेन जेष्यामो ऽनेन पशुबन्धेन तन् नः सह \ सह नः साधुतुल्या \ य एवं पापं करवत् तस्यैव तत् \\ इत्य् उक्तम् //
text_mt: "Which fire shall be produced from here, that belongs to all of us. What we shall win by this sacrifice, by this animal sacrifice, that is together for us. Together for us be the equal share of goodness. Whoever may do wrong in this manner, his alone it shall be"—thus it is declared.

sanskrit_iast: gṛhaptiḥ samāropayate / svayam itare gṛhapatir vā //
meaning: गृहप्तिः समारोपयते / स्वयम् इतरे गृहपतिर् वा //
text_mt: The master of the house mounts [the fire into the kindling sticks]; or the others themselves, or the master of the house [does so for them].

sanskrit_iast: sarveṣām //
meaning: सर्वेषाम् //

sanskrit_iast: śiśire dīkṣante / vasanta uttiṣṭhata iti vijñāyate //
meaning: शिशिरे दीक्षन्ते / वसन्त उत्तिष्ठत इति विज्ञायते //
text_mt: They undergo consecration in the cool season; they conclude in the spring—so it is known [from the Brāhmaṇa].

sanskrit_iast: śiśiro vai tasya prāyaṇaṃ vasanta udayanam //
meaning: शिशिरो वै तस्य प्रायणं वसन्त उदयनम् //
text_mt: The cool season is indeed its starting point, the spring its conclusion.

sanskrit_iast: ṛdhnuvante ya evaṃ vidvām̐saḥ śiśire dīkṣante vasanta uttiṣṭhantīti vijñāyate //
meaning: ऋध्नुवन्ते य एवं विद्वाम्̐सः शिशिरे दीक्षन्ते वसन्त उत्तिष्ठन्तीति विज्ञायते //
text_mt: They thrive who, knowing thus, undergo consecration in the cool season and conclude in the spring—so it is known [from the Brāhmaṇa].

sanskrit_iast: ṣaṭsu vyuṣṭāsv āpūryamāṇapakṣasya ceṣyamāṇā dīkṣeran //
meaning: षट्सु व्युष्टास्व् आपूर्यमाणपक्षस्य चेष्यमाणा दीक्षेरन् //
text_mt: When six days have dawned in the waxing fortnight, those who are about to pile [the fire-altar] should undergo consecration.

sanskrit_iast: saṃvādam̐ saṃnivapanaṃ kṛtvā dīkṣaṇīyāprabhṛtīni karmāṇi kurvate / ya ito 'gnir janiṣyate sa naḥ sarveṣām \\ yad anena yajñena jeṣyāmo 'nena satreṇa \\ iti //
meaning: संवादम्̐ संनिवपनं कृत्वा दीक्षणीयाप्रभृतीनि कर्माणि कुर्वते / य इतो ऽग्निर् जनिष्यते स नः सर्वेषाम् \\ यद् अनेन यज्ञेन जेष्यामो ऽनेन सत्रेण \\ इति //
text_mt: Having made the agreement and the bringing together [of the fires], they perform the rites beginning with the consecration-offering, saying: "Which fire shall be produced from here, that belongs to all of us; what we shall win by this sacrifice, by this satra..."

sanskrit_iast: atra saṃvāde brūyur adhvaryur gṛhapatiṃ dīkṣayitvā madhyataḥ kāriṇo dīkṣayati hotāraṃ brahmāṇam udgātāram / pratiprasthātādhvaryuṃ dīkṣayitvārdhino dīkṣayati maitrāvaruṇaṃ brāhmaṇāccham̐sinaṃ stotāram / neṣṭā pratiprasthātāraṃ dīkṣayitvā tṛtīyino dīkṣayati / acchāvākam āgnīdhraṃ pratihartāram / unnetā neṣṭāraṃ dīkṣayitvā pādino dīkṣayati grāvastutaṃ potāraṃ subrahmaṇyam / tatas taṃ pratiprasthātā dīkṣayati / anyo vā dīkṣito brāhmaṇa evam anupūrvaṃ dīkṣeran / nātantrībhāvād ekaikam apavargayati / anyagotravyavāyāt / samānagotrāṇām ārṣeyāṇām abhyāvartate / patnīnām ekasthāne patnīr dīkṣayanti / tāsāṃ yājamānair dharmā vyākhyātāḥ //
meaning: अत्र संवादे ब्रूयुर् अध्वर्युर् गृहपतिं दीक्षयित्वा मध्यतः कारिणो दीक्षयति होतारं ब्रह्माणम् उद्गातारम् / प्रतिप्रस्थाताध्वर्युं दीक्षयित्वार्धिनो दीक्षयति मैत्रावरुणं ब्राह्मणाच्छम्̐सिनं स्तोतारम् / नेष्टा प्रतिप्रस्थातारं दीक्षयित्वा तृतीयिनो दीक्षयति / अच्छावाकम् आग्नीध्रं प्रतिहर्तारम् / उन्नेता नेष्टारं दीक्षयित्वा पादिनो दीक्षयति ग्रावस्तुतं पोतारं सुब्रह्मण्यम् / ततस् तं प्रतिप्रस्थाता दीक्षयति / अन्यो वा दीक्षितो ब्राह्मण एवम् अनुपूर्वं दीक्षेरन् / नातन्त्रीभावाद् एकैकम् अपवर्गयति / अन्यगोत्रव्यवायात् / समानगोत्राणाम् आर्षेयाणाम् अभ्यावर्तते / पत्नीनाम् एकस्थाने पत्नीर् दीक्षयन्ति / तासां याजमानैर् धर्मा व्याख्याताः //
text_mt: At this dialogue they should say: having consecrated the master of the house, the adhvaryu consecrates those who act in the middle: the hotṛ, the brahman, [and] the udgātṛ. Having consecrated the adhvaryu, the pratiprasthātṛ consecrates the half-share holders: the maitrāvaruṇa, the brāhmaṇācchaṃsin, [and] the stotṛ. Having consecrated the pratiprasthātṛ, the neṣṭṛ consecrates the third-share holders: the acchāvāka, the āgnīdhra, [and] the pratihartṛ. Having consecrated the neṣṭṛ, the unnetṛ consecrates the quarter-share holders: the grāvastut, the potṛ, [and] the subrahmaṇya. Then the pratiprasthātṛ consecrates him. Or another consecrated brāhmaṇa [does so]. In this order they should be consecrated. Because it is not a state of separate frameworks, he finishes [consecrating] each one individually; because of the intervention of different gotras; among those of the same gotra, of common ṛṣi-ancestry, he returns [to the order]. In the place of the wives, they consecrate the wives. Their duties are explained by the duties of the sacrificer.

sanskrit_iast: anvahaṃ dīkṣām eke samāmananti //
meaning: अन्वहं दीक्षाम् एके समामनन्ति //
text_mt: Some authorities prescribe a consecration day by day.

sanskrit_iast: dvyahe tryaha iti krāmayati ā dvādaśāhāt //
meaning: द्व्यहे त्र्यह इति क्रामयति आ द्वादशाहात् //
text_mt: He causes [the consecration] to proceed by two-day periods [or] three-day periods up to twelve days.

sanskrit_iast: upasatsu trayodaśo dīkṣeta / tena brāhmaṇā bhavitavyam upadīkṣamāṇā agnīn upavapan nyupyātmasam̐skāreṇa prakrāmed dvādaśa dīkṣāḥ //
meaning: उपसत्सु त्रयोदशो दीक्षेत / तेन ब्राह्मणा भवितव्यम् उपदीक्षमाणा अग्नीन् उपवपन् न्युप्यात्मसम्̐स्कारेण प्रक्रामेद् द्वादश दीक्षाः //
text_mt: During the upasads a thirteenth [person] may be consecrated. There should be a brāhmaṇa for that purpose; being additionally consecrated, strewing the fires, having poured them down, he should proceed through the twelve consecrations by means of personal purification.

sanskrit_iast: na sanīhārasam̐śāsanam̐ satrabhūte vidyate //
meaning: न सनीहारसम्̐शासनम्̐ सत्रभूते विद्यते //
text_mt: There is no order to bring dakṣiṇā gifts when it has become a sacrificial session (satra).

sanskrit_iast: ṣoḍaśī somavikrayaṇī //
meaning: षोडशी सोमविक्रयणी //

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśāhāyāptam̐ rājānaṃ krīṇāti //
meaning: द्वादशाहायाप्तम्̐ राजानं क्रीणाति //
text_mt: He purchases King [Soma] sufficient for twelve days.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśopasadaḥ //
meaning: द्वादशोपसदः //

sanskrit_iast: anūpasadam agniṃ cinoti //
meaning: अनूपसदम् अग्निं चिनोति //
text_mt: Following the upasads, he piles the fire-altar.

sanskrit_iast: dvyaham ekaikā citiḥ //
meaning: द्व्यहम् एकैका चितिः //

sanskrit_iast: caturaham uttamā //
meaning: चतुरहम् उत्तमा //

sanskrit_iast: ā trirātraṃ catustanāni vratāni bhavanti //
meaning: आ त्रिरात्रं चतुस्तनानि व्रतानि भवन्ति //
text_mt: Up to a three-night period the fast-milk portions are four-teated.

sanskrit_iast: evaṃ tristanāni dvistanāni ekastanāni //
meaning: एवं त्रिस्तनानि द्विस्तनानि एकस्तनानि //
text_mt: Likewise [successively] three-teated, two-teated, [and] one-teated.

sanskrit_iast: bhūyo vratam icchan dadhna ekam̐ sruvam abhyunnayeta //
meaning: भूयो व्रतम् इच्छन् दध्न एकम्̐ स्रुवम् अभ्युन्नयेत //
text_mt: If he desires more fast-food, he may ladle up one sruva-spoon of curd.

sanskrit_iast: ekavim̐śatiśchadi sadaḥ //
meaning: एकविम्̐शतिश्छदि सदः //
text_mt: The sadas has twenty-one roof-mats.

sanskrit_iast: saṃtṛṇṇe adhiṣavaṇaphalake //
meaning: संतृण्णे अधिषवणफलके //
text_mt: The two pressing boards are perforated through.

sanskrit_iast: vyākhyāta ekayūpaḥ //
meaning: व्याख्यात एकयूपः //

sanskrit_iast: yadi yūpaikādaśinī syād anvaham ekaikaṃ yūpam̐ saṃminuyāt sarvān vā //
meaning: यदि यूपैकादशिनी स्याद् अन्वहम् एकैकं यूपम्̐ संमिनुयात् सर्वान् वा //
text_mt: If there should be an eleven-post set, he should erect one sacrificial post day by day, or all of them [at once].

sanskrit_iast: aupavasathye 'hany anvahaṃ mīyamāneṣv aharahar upaśayo 'bhyāvarteta // agniṣṭha evodayanīye paśum upākuryāt //
meaning: औपवसथ्ये ऽहन्य् अन्वहं मीयमानेष्व् अहरहर् उपशयो ऽभ्यावर्तेत // अग्निष्ठ एवोदयनीये पशुम् उपाकुर्यात् //
text_mt: On the day of preparation, while they are being measured day by day, the extra post would return day by day. Only at the post standing nearest the fire should he dedicate the animal on the concluding day.

sanskrit_iast: śvo bhūte pratāyate jyotiṣṭomaḥ //
meaning: श्वो भूते प्रतायते ज्योतिष्टोमः //
text_mt: On the next day the Jyotiṣṭoma is extended.

sanskrit_iast: vaiśvānaro 'tirātraḥ upāvaharaṇakāle yāvān ekāhāyāptas tāvantam̐ rājānam anyasmin vāsasy upanahyopāvaharati //
meaning: वैश्वानरो ऽतिरात्रः उपावहरणकाले यावान् एकाहायाप्तस् तावन्तम्̐ राजानम् अन्यस्मिन् वासस्य् उपनह्योपावहरति //
text_mt: An Atirātra dedicated to Vaiśvānara [is performed]. At the time of taking down [the soma], tying up in another cloth as much of King [Soma] as is sufficient for one day, he brings it down.

sanskrit_iast: pratyupanahyetaraṃ nidadhāti //
meaning: प्रत्युपनह्येतरं निदधाति //
text_mt: Having tied up the other portion again, he puts it away.

sanskrit_iast: evam aharahaḥ kriyate / anvahaṃ yogavimokṣaṇe //
meaning: एवम् अहरहः क्रियते / अन्वहं योगविमोक्षणे //
text_mt: Thus it is done day by day. Day by day [take place] the yoking and unyoking [of the press].

sanskrit_iast: prathame 'hani yunakti / uttame vimuñcatīty ekeṣām //
meaning: प्रथमे ऽहनि युनक्ति / उत्तमे विमुञ्चतीत्य् एकेषाम् //
text_mt: On the first day he yokes; on the last he unyokes—according to some teachers.

sanskrit_iast: prāyaṇīyodayanīyayor atirātrayor daśame cāhni pṛśniprāṇagrahān gṛhṇāty abhiṣavamāṇena prākṛtasya yajurmānasya prathamena mantreṇa mītvā vāyur asi prāṇo nāma \\ iti daśabhir mantrair daśa pṛśnimānāni mimīte //
meaning: प्रायणीयोदयनीययोर् अतिरात्रयोर् दशमे चाह्नि पृश्निप्राणग्रहान् गृह्णात्य् अभिषवमाणेन प्राकृतस्य यजुर्मानस्य प्रथमेन मन्त्रेण मीत्वा वायुर् असि प्राणो नाम \\ इति दशभिर् मन्त्रैर् दश पृश्निमानानि मिमीते //
text_mt: On the introductory and concluding Atirātra days and on the tenth day, he draws the pṛśni and prāṇa cups. Having measured with the first mantra of the standard yajus-measurement for the one being pressed, he measures out the ten pṛśni measures with the ten mantras: "You are Vāyu, Prāṇa by name...".

sanskrit_iast: uttareṇottareṇa yajurmānena mītvā \\ ayaṃ puro bhuvas \\ iti daśabhir mantrair daśa prāṇagrahamānāni mimīte //
meaning: उत्तरेणोत्तरेण यजुर्मानेन मीत्वा \\ अयं पुरो भुवस् \\ इति दशभिर् मन्त्रैर् दश प्राणग्रहमानानि मिमीते //
text_mt: Having measured with each subsequent yajus-measurement, he measures out the ten prāṇa-cup measures with the ten mantras: "This one in front, Bhuvas...".

sanskrit_iast: uttarottare yajurmānena vyatiṣajati //
meaning: उत्तरोत्तरे यजुर्मानेन व्यतिषजति //
text_mt: He interweaves them with each subsequent yajus-measurement.

sanskrit_iast: aindravāyavāgrau prāyaṇīyodayanīyāv atirātrau daśamaṃ cāhaḥ / athetareṣāṃ navānām aindravāyavāgraṃ prathamam ahar atha śukrāgram athāgrayaṇāgram evaṃ tryanīkās triḥ parivartante samūḍhaṃ chandasi //
meaning: ऐन्द्रवायवाग्रौ प्रायणीयोदयनीयाव् अतिरात्रौ दशमं चाहः / अथेतरेषां नवानाम् ऐन्द्रवायवाग्रं प्रथमम् अहर् अथ शुक्राग्रम् अथाग्रयणाग्रम् एवं त्र्यनीकास् त्रिः परिवर्तन्ते समूढं छन्दसि //
text_mt: The introductory and concluding Atirātras and the tenth day have the Aindravāyava cup first. Now of the other nine days, the first day has the Aindravāyava first, then the Śukra first, then the Āgrayaṇa first; thus having three fronts they revolve three times in the samūḍha arrangement of metres.

sanskrit_iast: atha vyūḍhaṃ chandasy aindravāyavāgrau prāyaṇīyodayanīyāv atirātrāv athetareṣāṃ daśānām aindravāyavāgraṃ prathamam ahaḥ / atha śukrāgram atha dve āgrayaṇāgre / athaindravāyavāgram atha dve śukrāgre / athāgrayaṇāgram atha dve aindra
meaning: अथ व्यूढं छन्दस्य् ऐन्द्रवायवाग्रौ प्रायणीयोदयनीयाव् अतिरात्राव् अथेतरेषां दशानाम् ऐन्द्रवायवाग्रं प्रथमम् अहः / अथ शुक्राग्रम् अथ द्वे आग्रयणाग्रे / अथैन्द्रवायवाग्रम् अथ द्वे शुक्राग्रे / अथाग्रयणाग्रम् अथ द्वे ऐन्द्र
text_mt: Now in the vyūḍha arrangement of metres, the introductory and concluding Atirātras have the Aindravāyava first. Now of the other ten days, the first day has the Aindravāyava first, then the Śukra first, then two having the Āgrayaṇa first, then the Aindravāyava first, then two having the Śukra first, then the Āgrayaṇa first, then two having the Aindra[vāyava first]...

sanskrit_iast: tatra bhakṣamantrāḥ pavamānābhimantraṇāni ca yenayena cchandasā nigadāś ca tasya sthāne tābhiḥ saṃnameta vyūhena vyākhyātam //
meaning: तत्र भक्षमन्त्राः पवमानाभिमन्त्रणानि च येनयेन च्छन्दसा निगदाश् च तस्य स्थाने ताभिः संनमेत व्यूहेन व्याख्यातम् //
text_mt: There, the consumption mantras, the invocations over the purifying [soma], and the prose calls with whichever metre [they are associated], one should adapt to them in place of that [standard one]; it has been explained by the rearrangement (vyūha).

sanskrit_iast: evam uttareṣu pṛṣṭhyāheṣu trīn atigrāhyān gṛhṇāti / āgneyam ekavim̐śe / aindraṃ triṇave / sauryaṃ trayastrim̐śe //
meaning: एवम् उत्तरेषु पृष्ठ्याहेषु त्रीन् अतिग्राह्यान् गृह्णाति / आग्नेयम् एकविम्̐शे / ऐन्द्रं त्रिणवे / सौर्यं त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शे //
text_mt: In this manner, on the subsequent days of the Pṛṣṭhya [ṣaḍaha], he draws three atigrāhya cups: one dedicated to Agni on the twenty-one-fold [day], one dedicated to Indra on the twenty-seven-fold [day], and one dedicated to Sūrya on the thirty-three-fold [day].

sanskrit_iast: pūrvasmiṃs tryahe vājasaneyinaḥ samāmananti / yatra gauravītam̐ sāma tatra sarvān pūrṇān grahān gṛhṇīyāt //
meaning: पूर्वस्मिंस् त्र्यहे वाजसनेयिनः समामनन्ति / यत्र गौरवीतम्̐ साम तत्र सर्वान् पूर्णान् ग्रहान् गृह्णीयात् //
text_mt: The Vājasaneyins teach: In the first three-day period, wherever there is the Gauravīta sāman, there he should draw all the cups full.

sanskrit_iast: atha paśukḷptir āgneyaṃ prāyaṇīyo 'tirātra ālabhante śvo bhūte sārasvatīṃ meṣīm / evam̐ hi vihatān aikādaśinān anvaham ālabhanta āgneyam udayanīye sauryaṃ brahmavarcasakāmānām //
meaning: अथ पशुकॢप्तिर् आग्नेयं प्रायणीयो ऽतिरात्र आलभन्ते श्वो भूते सारस्वतीं मेषीम् / एवम्̐ हि विहतान् ऐकादशिनान् अन्वहम् आलभन्त आग्नेयम् उदयनीये सौर्यं ब्रह्मवर्चसकामानाम् //
text_mt: Now the arrangement of animals: on the introductory Atirātra they seize an animal dedicated to Agni; on the next day, a female sheep dedicated to Sarasvatī. In this way, indeed, distributed day by day, they seize the eleven animals; on the concluding day, one dedicated to Agni, [or] one dedicated to Sūrya for those who desire spiritual splendour.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇākāle 'nvahaṃ dvādaśa śatāny ahīnabhūte dadāti //
meaning: दक्षिणाकाले ऽन्वहं द्वादश शतान्य् अहीनभूते ददाति //
text_mt: At the time of the dakṣiṇā gifts, day by day he gives twelve hundred [cows], when it is an ahīna sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: satre tu dākṣiṇau homau hutvā \\ idam ahaṃ māṃ kalyāṇyai kīrtyai svargāya lokāya dakṣiṇāṃ nayāmi \\ iti yajamānāḥ kṛṣṇājināni dhūnvanta udañco dakṣiṇāpathenātiyanti //
meaning: सत्रे तु दाक्षिणौ होमौ हुत्वा \\ इदम् अहं मां कल्याण्यै कीर्त्यै स्वर्गाय लोकाय दक्षिणां नयामि \\ इति यजमानाः कृष्णाजिनानि धून्वन्त उदञ्चो दक्षिणापथेनातियन्ति //
text_mt: In a sacrificial session (satra), however, having offered the two dakṣiṇā offerings, reciting: "Here I lead myself as dakṣiṇā toward auspicious fame, toward the heavenly world," the sacrificers, shaking their black-antelope skins, pass northward along the dakṣiṇā-path.

sanskrit_iast: evam aharahaḥ kriyate //
meaning: एवम् अहरहः क्रियते //

sanskrit_iast: uttame 'hani kṛṣṇaviṣāṇāḥ prāsyanti //
meaning: उत्तमे ऽहनि कृष्णविषाणाः प्रास्यन्ति //
text_mt: On the last day they throw away the black-buck horns.

sanskrit_iast: sakhyāni visṛjante //
meaning: सख्यानि विसृजन्ते //

sanskrit_iast: pūrvasminn ahany uttarasmā ahne yajñāyajñīyaṃ prati vasatīvarīr gṛhṇāti //
meaning: पूर्वस्मिन्न् अहन्य् उत्तरस्मा अह्ने यज्ञायज्ञीयं प्रति वसतीवरीर् गृह्णाति //
text_mt: On the preceding day, at the time of the Yajñāyajñīya [sāman], he draws the vasatīvarī waters for the following day.

sanskrit_iast: pūrvasminn ahany uttarasmā ahne stotrīyam anurūpaṃ kṛtvā śam̐sati //
meaning: पूर्वस्मिन्न् अहन्य् उत्तरस्मा अह्ने स्तोत्रीयम् अनुरूपं कृत्वा शम्̐सति //
text_mt: On the preceding day he recites [the śastra] for the following day after making the stotriya [hymn] into the anurūpa.

sanskrit_iast: vartamāne 'tirātre payām̐si viśāsti //
meaning: वर्तमाने ऽतिरात्रे पयाम्̐सि विशास्ति //
text_mt: While the Atirātra is going on, he directs the milks.

sanskrit_iast: śvaḥsutyām indrāgnibhyāṃ viśvebhyo devebhyo brāhmaṇebhyaḥ somapebhyaḥ somaṃ prabrūtāt \\ iti maitrāvaruṇenocyamāne svam agāraṃ praviśyāgnīdhraḥ śvaḥsutyām indrāgnibhyāṃ viśvebhyo devebhyo brāhmaṇebhyaḥ somapebhyaḥ somaṃ prabravīmi \ brahman vācaṃ yaccha \ subrahmaṇya subrahmaṇyām āhvaya \\ iti saṃpreṣyati //
meaning: श्वःसुत्याम् इन्द्राग्निभ्यां विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यो ब्राह्मणेभ्यः सोमपेभ्यः सोमं प्रब्रूतात् \\ इति मैत्रावरुणेनोच्यमाने स्वम् अगारं प्रविश्याग्नीध्रः श्वःसुत्याम् इन्द्राग्निभ्यां विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यो ब्राह्मणेभ्यः सोमपेभ्यः सोमं प्रब्रवीमि \ ब्रह्मन् वाचं यच्छ \ सुब्रह्मण्य सुब्रह्मण्याम् आह्वय \\ इति संप्रेष्यति //
text_mt: When it is said by the maitrāvaruṇa: "For tomorrow's pressing announce the soma to Indra and Agni, to the All-Gods, to the soma-drinking brāhmaṇas!", the āgnīdhra, having entered his own shed, issues the direction: "For tomorrow's pressing I announce the soma to Indra and Agni, to the All-Gods, to the soma-drinking brāhmaṇas. O brahman, restrain your speech! O subrahmaṇya, call out the Subrahmaṇyā litany!"

sanskrit_iast: adyasutyām etasminn ahani brūyāl lupyeta vā śvaḥsutyām itareṣu //
meaning: अद्यसुत्याम् एतस्मिन्न् अहनि ब्रूयाल् लुप्येत वा श्वःसुत्याम् इतरेषु //
text_mt: On this day he should say, "for today's pressing," or on the other [days] "for tomorrow's pressing" may be omitted.

sanskrit_iast: patnīsaṃyājāntam ahaḥ saṃtiṣṭhate //
meaning: पत्नीसंयाजान्तम् अहः संतिष्ठते //
text_mt: The day concludes with the offerings to the wives of the gods (patnīsaṃyājas).

sanskrit_iast: sam̐sthite brahmā vācaṃ visṛjate //
meaning: सम्̐स्थिते ब्रह्मा वाचं विसृजते //
text_mt: When it is concluded, the brahman releases his speech.

sanskrit_iast: pariharanty udakaṃ patnībhyaḥ //
meaning: परिहरन्त्य् उदकं पत्नीभ्यः //
text_mt: They carry around water for the wives.

sanskrit_iast: haranti samiddhārāḥ //
meaning: हरन्ति समिद्धाराः //

sanskrit_iast: pratyetyāhavanīye samidho 'bhyādadhati //
meaning: प्रत्येत्याहवनीये समिधो ऽभ्यादधति //
text_mt: Having returned, they put sticks of firewood onto the āhavanīya fire.

sanskrit_iast: evam aharahaḥ kriyeran //
meaning: एवम् अहरहः क्रियेरन् //
text_mt: Thus they should do day by day.

sanskrit_iast: tasminn ahani pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍahaḥ //
meaning: तस्मिन्न् अहनि पृष्ठ्यः षडहः //
text_mt: On that day [begins] the Pṛṣṭhya six-day period (ṣaḍaha).

sanskrit_iast: trivṛd agniṣṭomo rathaṃtarasāmā //
meaning: त्रिवृद् अग्निष्टोमो रथंतरसामा //
text_mt: It is a ninefold Agniṣṭoma having the Rathaṃtara sāman.

sanskrit_iast: rathaśabdena māhendrasya stotram upākaroti //
meaning: रथशब्देन माहेन्द्रस्य स्तोत्रम् उपाकरोति //
text_mt: With the sound of a chariot he brings near (upākaroti) the stotra of the Māhendra cup.

sanskrit_iast: upākaraṇamantrasya śabdo vikāraḥ //
meaning: उपाकरणमन्त्रस्य शब्दो विकारः //
text_mt: The sound is a modification of the upākaraṇa mantra.

sanskrit_iast: pañcadaśa ukthyo bṛhatsāmā //
meaning: पञ्चदश उक्थ्यो बृहत्सामा //
text_mt: The fifteenfold [day] is an Ukthya having the Bṛhat sāman.

sanskrit_iast: dundubhiśabdena māhendrasya stotram upākaroti //
meaning: दुन्दुभिशब्देन माहेन्द्रस्य स्तोत्रम् उपाकरोति //
text_mt: With the sound of a war-drum he brings near the stotra of the Māhendra cup.

sanskrit_iast: yadi stanayitnur bhavati sa eva syād upākaraṇamantrasya śabdo vikāraḥ //
meaning: यदि स्तनयित्नुर् भवति स एव स्याद् उपाकरणमन्त्रस्य शब्दो विकारः //
text_mt: If there should be thunder, that itself would be the modification of the sound of the upākaraṇa mantra.

sanskrit_iast: saptadaśa ukthyo vairūpasāmā //
meaning: सप्तदश उक्थ्यो वैरूपसामा //
text_mt: The seventeenfold [day] is an Ukthya having the Vairūpa sāman.

sanskrit_iast: ādhāvena māhendrastotram upākaroti //
meaning: आधावेन माहेन्द्रस्तोत्रम् उपाकरोति //
text_mt: With a whisk (ādhāva) he brings near the stotra of the Māhendra cup.

sanskrit_iast: barhiṣo vikāras tasminn upākṛte prastuta udgātādhāvena dhunute //
meaning: बर्हिषो विकारस् तस्मिन्न् उपाकृते प्रस्तुत उद्गाताधावेन धुनुते //
text_mt: It is a modification of the barhis grass; when that is brought near and the prastāva has been chanted, the udgātṛ shakes [it] with the whisk.

sanskrit_iast: ekavim̐śaḥ ṣoḍaśī vairājasāmā //
meaning: एकविम्̐शः षोडशी वैराजसामा //
text_mt: [The fourth day is] a twenty-one-fold ṣoḍaśin having the Vairāja sāman.

sanskrit_iast: nyūṅkhaṃ bhavati haviṣkṛtāśrutapratyāśruteṣu pratigare nyūṅkhati //
meaning: न्यूङ्खं भवति हविष्कृताश्रुतप्रत्याश्रुतेषु प्रतिगरे न्यूङ्खति //
text_mt: There is a nyūṅkha; during the haviṣkṛt call, the call, and the counter-call, he performs the nyūṅkha at the response.

sanskrit_iast: araṇībhyāṃ māhendrasya stotram upākaroti barhiṣo vikāraḥ //
meaning: अरणीभ्यां माहेन्द्रस्य स्तोत्रम् उपाकरोति बर्हिषो विकारः //
text_mt: With two fire-churning sticks he introduces the chant of the Māhendra cup; this is a modification of the sacrificial grass.

sanskrit_iast: tasminn upākṛte prastute //
meaning: तस्मिन्न् उपाकृते प्रस्तुते //
text_mt: When it has been introduced and the prologue chanted,

sanskrit_iast: udgātā dakṣiṇam ūrum avakābhir avacchādya tatrāraṇī saṃnidhāyāgniṃ manthati //
meaning: उद्गाता दक्षिणम् ऊरुम् अवकाभिर् अवच्छाद्य तत्रारणी संनिधायाग्निं मन्थति //
text_mt: the udgātṛ, having covered his right thigh with avakā plants and placed the two fire-churning sticks there, churns fire.

sanskrit_iast: jātam udgātābhihiṃkṛtya prastotre prayacchati //
meaning: जातम् उद्गाताभिहिंकृत्य प्रस्तोत्रे प्रयच्छति //
text_mt: Over the generated [fire], the udgātṛ utters the sound hiṃ and hands it to the prastotṛ.

sanskrit_iast: prastotādhvaryave //
meaning: प्रस्तोताध्वर्यवे //

sanskrit_iast: tam̐ so 'greṇa dhiṣṇiyān paryāhṛtyāhavanīye 'nuprahṛtya preddho agne dīdihi \\ iti virājābhijuhoti //
meaning: तम्̐ सो ऽग्रेण धिष्णियान् पर्याहृत्याहवनीये ऽनुप्रहृत्य प्रेद्धो अग्ने दीदिहि \\ इति विराजाभिजुहोति //
text_mt: Having carried it around in front of the dhiṣṇya hearths and cast it into the āhavanīya fire, he offers upon it with a Virāj verse: "Kindled, O Agni, shine brightly!"

sanskrit_iast: triṇava ukthyaḥ śākvarasāmā //
meaning: त्रिणव उक्थ्यः शाक्वरसामा //
text_mt: [The fifth day is] a twenty-seven-fold ukthya having the Śākvara sāman.

sanskrit_iast: adbhir avakāvās tābhir māhendrasya stotram upākaroti / barhiṣo vikāras tasminn upākṛte prastute //
meaning: अद्भिर् अवकावास् ताभिर् माहेन्द्रस्य स्तोत्रम् उपाकरोति / बर्हिषो विकारस् तस्मिन्न् उपाकृते प्रस्तुते //
text_mt: With water containing avakā plants he introduces the chant of the Māhendra cup; this is a modification of the sacrificial grass. When it has been introduced and the prologue chanted,

sanskrit_iast: tisraḥ saharṣabhā gāvo 'greṇa sado 'pareṇāgnīdhram udīcīnaṃ dakṣiṇāpathenātikramayanti //
meaning: तिस्रः सहर्षभा गावो ऽग्रेण सदो ऽपरेणाग्नीध्रम् उदीचीनं दक्षिणापथेनातिक्रमयन्ति //
text_mt: they cause three cows accompanied by a bull to cross from south to north in front of the sadas and to the west of the Āgnīdhra along the southern pathway.

sanskrit_iast: trayastrim̐śa ukthyo raivatasāmā //
meaning: त्रयस्त्रिम्̐श उक्थ्यो रैवतसामा //
text_mt: [The sixth day is] a thirty-three-fold ukthya having the Raivata sāman.

sanskrit_iast: nyūṅkham etad ahar bhavati //
meaning: न्यूङ्खम् एतद् अहर् भवति //
text_mt: This day has a nyūṅkha.

sanskrit_iast: svayam ṛtuyājaṃ bhavati //
meaning: स्वयम् ऋतुयाजं भवति //
text_mt: There is a self-performed ṛtuyāja offering.

sanskrit_iast: adhvaryū yajatam ity ucyamāne havirdhāne praviśyādhvaryuḥ praiṣottarayarcā yajati ṛguttareṇa vā praiṣeṇa //
meaning: अध्वर्यू यजतम् इत्य् उच्यमाने हविर्धाने प्रविश्याध्वर्युः प्रैषोत्तरयर्चा यजति ऋगुत्तरेण वा प्रैषेण //
text_mt: When "O two adhvaryus, offer!" is said, the adhvaryu, entering the havirdhāna shed, offers with a verse whose direction follows, or with a direction whose verse follows.

sanskrit_iast: aśvinā pibataṃ sutam \\ dīdyagnī śucivratā / \ ṛtunā yajñavāhasā / \ ṛtunā somaṃ pibatam \\ vauṣaṭ \\ iti yady avyūḍhaḥ //
meaning: अश्विना पिबतं सुतम् \\ दीद्यग्नी शुचिव्रता / \ ऋतुना यज्ञवाहसा / \ ऋतुना सोमं पिबतम् \\ वौषट् \\ इति यद्य् अव्यूढः //
text_mt: If it is not transposed: "O Aśvins, drink the pressed soma, O gleaming with fires, pure in vows, / In due season, O conveyors of the sacrifice! / In due season drink the soma, vauṣaṭ!"

sanskrit_iast: vyūḍhe tu \\ arvāñcam adya yayyaṃ nṛvāhaṇam \\ rathaṃ yuñjāthām iha vāṃ vimocanam / \ pṛṅktam̐ havīm̐ṣi madhunā hi kaṃ gatam \ athā somaṃ pibataṃ vājinīvasū / \ ṛtunā somaṃ pibatam \\ vauṣaṭ \\ iti tasya pracaritaṃ marutvatīyair bhavati //
meaning: व्यूढे तु \\ अर्वाञ्चम् अद्य यय्यं नृवाहणम् \\ रथं युञ्जाथाम् इह वां विमोचनम् / \ पृङ्क्तम्̐ हवीम्̐षि मधुना हि कं गतम् \ अथा सोमं पिबतं वाजिनीवसू / \ ऋतुना सोमं पिबतम् \\ वौषट् \\ इति तस्य प्रचरितं मरुत्वतीयैर् भवति //
text_mt: When it is transposed, however: "Hitherward today your chariot bringing men, fit to go, / harness ye; here is your unyoking. / Mix the oblations with honey, for go ye to delight, / then drink the soma, O possessors of abundant wealth! / In due season drink the soma, vauṣaṭ!" With this, its performance belongs with the Marutvatīya cups.

sanskrit_iast: yat prāṅ māhendrāt tasmin kṛte pratiprasthātāpareṇāgnīdhram udīcīṃ tantiṃ vitatya tasyāṃ vatsān badhnāti //
meaning: यत् प्राङ् माहेन्द्रात् तस्मिन् कृते प्रतिप्रस्थातापरेणाग्नीध्रम् उदीचीं तन्तिं वितत्य तस्यां वत्सान् बध्नाति //
text_mt: Whatever [rites take place] prior to the Māhendra [stotra], when that is completed, the pratiprasthātṛ, having stretched a northward tether-rope west of the Āgnīdhra, binds calves to it.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇena mārjālīyaṃ mātṝr uparundhanti //
meaning: दक्षिणेन मार्जालीयं मातॄर् उपरुन्धन्ति //
text_mt: South of the mārjālīya, they shut in the mothers [the cows].

sanskrit_iast: barhiḥsthāne 'dbhir dūrvāvāstābhir māhendrasya stotram upākaroti / barhiṣo vikāraḥ //
meaning: बर्हिःस्थाने ऽद्भिर् दूर्वावास्ताभिर् माहेन्द्रस्य स्तोत्रम् उपाकरोति / बर्हिषो विकारः //
text_mt: In place of the sacrificial grass, he introduces the chant of the Māhendra cup with water containing dūrvā grass; this is a modification of the sacrificial grass.

sanskrit_iast: tasminn upākṛte prastute vatsān pramucya mātṛbhiḥ sam̐sṛjyodīcīras tasya dakṣiṇāpathena saṃcāryamānā ativitsanti ( saṃtiṣṭhate pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍahaḥ ) //
meaning: तस्मिन्न् उपाकृते प्रस्तुते वत्सान् प्रमुच्य मातृभिः सम्̐सृज्योदीचीरस् तस्य दक्षिणापथेन संचार्यमाना अतिवित्सन्ति ( संतिष्ठते पृष्ठ्यः षडहः ) //
text_mt: When it has been introduced and the prologue chanted, having released the calves and united them with their mothers, [the cows,] led northward across along the southern pathway, bypass [the shed]. (The Pṛṣṭhya six-day period is concluded.)

sanskrit_iast: sam̐sthite pṛṣṭhye ṣaḍahe / ghṛtaṃ madhu vā prāśnanti //
meaning: सम्̐स्थिते पृष्ठ्ये षडहे / घृतं मधु वा प्राश्नन्ति //
text_mt: When the Pṛṣṭhya six-day period has concluded, they partake of ghee or honey.

sanskrit_iast: anvaham ukthyās trayaś chandomāḥ //
meaning: अन्वहम् उक्थ्यास् त्रयश् छन्दोमाः //
text_mt: Day after day the three Chandoma days are ukthya sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast: caturvim̐śaś catuścatvārim̐śo 'ṣṭācatvārim̐śaś caturvim̐śam avivākyam // daśamam ahar agniṣṭomaḥ somo rathaṃtarasāmā //
meaning: चतुर्विम्̐शश् चतुश्चत्वारिम्̐शो ऽष्टाचत्वारिम्̐शश् चतुर्विम्̐शम् अविवाक्यम् // दशमम् अहर् अग्निष्टोमः सोमो रथंतरसामा //
text_mt: The twenty-four-fold, the forty-four-fold, [and] the forty-eight-fold; the twenty-four-fold day is not to be spoken about. The tenth day is an agniṣṭoma soma sacrifice having the Rathaṃtara sāman.

sanskrit_iast: nātra kaścana kasmaica no vyāhate //
meaning: नात्र कश्चन कस्मैच नो व्याहते //
text_mt: Here no one speaks discordant words to anyone.

sanskrit_iast: ye bāhyā dṛśīkavaḥ syus te vibrūyur yadi tatra na vindeyur antaḥsadasād vyucyam //
meaning: ये बाह्या दृशीकवः स्युस् ते विब्रूयुर् यदि तत्र न विन्देयुर् अन्तःसदसाद् व्युच्यम् //
text_mt: Those who may be outsiders possessing clear sight, they may speak out; if they do not find any there, it is to be spoken by one within the sadas.

sanskrit_iast: yadi tatra na vindeyur gṛhapatinā vyucyam //
meaning: यदि तत्र न विन्देयुर् गृहपतिना व्युच्यम् //
text_mt: If they do not find one there, it is to be spoken by the master of the house.

sanskrit_iast: gṛhapatim ānuṣṭubham uktvā tad brūyāt //
meaning: गृहपतिम् आनुष्टुभम् उक्त्वा तद् ब्रूयात् //
text_mt: Having spoken an anuṣṭubh verse to the master of the house, he should speak it.

sanskrit_iast: yasminn upahvayaty etāv api vā tenaiva sahānuṣṭubham̐ saṃpādayet // dvayor etad ahaḥ samidha āharanti //
meaning: यस्मिन्न् उपह्वयत्य् एताव् अपि वा तेनैव सहानुष्टुभम्̐ संपादयेत् // द्वयोर् एतद् अहः समिध आहरन्ति //
text_mt: In which he invites, these two also, or along with that he should accomplish the anuṣṭubh. On this day they bring two kinds of firewood:

sanskrit_iast: nityā audumbarīś ca //
meaning: नित्या औदुम्बरीश् च //

sanskrit_iast: abhyādadhati nityāḥ //
meaning: अभ्यादधति नित्याः //

sanskrit_iast: uttareṇāhavanīyam audumbarīr upasādayanti //
meaning: उत्तरेणाहवनीयम् औदुम्बरीर् उपसादयन्ति //
text_mt: North of the āhavanīya fire, they set down those of udumbara wood.

sanskrit_iast: amūr yā upa sūrye \ yābhir vā sūryaḥ saha / \ tā no hinvanty adhvaram \ iha ratir \ iha rantir \ iha ramadhvam \ iha rantir \ iha ramatir \ iha ramadhvam \ iha vo ramatiḥ / \ upasṛjaṃ dharuṇam iti dvābhyāṃ gārhapatye juhoti //
meaning: अमूर् या उप सूर्ये \ याभिर् वा सूर्यः सह / \ ता नो हिन्वन्त्य् अध्वरम् \ इह रतिर् \ इह रन्तिर् \ इह रमध्वम् \ इह रन्तिर् \ इह रमतिर् \ इह रमध्वम् \ इह वो रमतिः / \ उपसृजं धरुणम् इति द्वाभ्यां गार्हपत्ये जुहोति //
text_mt: With two [verses], "Those [waters] which are near the sun, or with which the sun is associated, may they speed our sacrifice; here is rest, here is delight, here delight yourselves; here is delight, here is resting, here delight yourselves, here is your resting; emitting the supporter...", he offers into the gārhapatya fire.

sanskrit_iast: ayam̐ sahasramānavo dṛśaḥ kavīnāṃ matir jyotir vidharmā \ dadhruḥ samīcīr uṣasaḥ samairayat \\ arepasaḥ samokasaḥ saretasaḥ sacetasaḥ svaramanyumantaś cidākos \\ ity aticchandasarcāhavanīyam upatiṣṭhante //
meaning: अयम्̐ सहस्रमानवो दृशः कवीनां मतिर् ज्योतिर् विधर्मा \ दध्रुः समीचीर् उषसः समैरयत् \\ अरेपसः समोकसः सरेतसः सचेतसः स्वरमन्युमन्तश् चिदाकोस् \\ इत्य् अतिच्छन्दसर्चाहवनीयम् उपतिष्ठन्ते //
text_mt: With the aticchandas verse, "This insight of the poets, possessing a thousand minds, light, distributor, he directed the matching dawns, spotless, having the same abode, of the same seed, of common mind, possessing heaven's ardour...", they attend upon the āhavanīya fire.

sanskrit_iast: prājāpatyāya manograhāya saṃprasarpanti //
meaning: प्राजापत्याय मनोग्रहाय संप्रसर्पन्ति //
text_mt: They glide forward for the mind-cup for Prajāpati.

sanskrit_iast: prasṛpteṣu \\ anayā tvā pātreṇa \\ iti pṛthivīṃ manasā dhyāyan prajāpataye manave juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmi \\ iti prājāpatyaṃ manograhaṃ gṛhṇāti / yathārūpam ākāśāt / tārtīyasavanikād vā somāt pariśāyayed yāvān ekasmai camasagaṇāyāptaḥ //
meaning: प्रसृप्तेषु \\ अनया त्वा पात्रेण \\ इति पृथिवीं मनसा ध्यायन् प्रजापतये मनवे जुष्टं गृह्णामि \\ इति प्राजापत्यं मनोग्रहं गृह्णाति / यथारूपम् आकाशात् / तार्तीयसवनिकाद् वा सोमात् परिशाययेद् यावान् एकस्मै चमसगणायाप्तः //
text_mt: When they have glided forward, meditating in mind upon the earth with "With this vessel...", he draws the mind-cup for Prajāpati with "I take you, agreeable to Prajāpati, the wise Manu," according to form from the ether; or he should leave over from the soma of the third pressing as much as is sufficient for one set of goblets.

sanskrit_iast: tasmād vopām̐śupātreṇa gṛhṇīyād dhotṛcamasamukhyām̐ś camasān unnayati //
meaning: तस्माद् वोपाम्̐शुपात्रेण गृह्णीयाद् धोतृचमसमुख्याम्̐श् चमसान् उन्नयति //
text_mt: Or from that he should draw with the upāṃśu cup; he draws the goblets headed by the hotṛ's goblet.

sanskrit_iast: stutaśastre bhavataḥ //
meaning: स्तुतशस्त्रे भवतः //

sanskrit_iast: tasya sarvaṃ manasā kriyate //
meaning: तस्य सर्वं मनसा क्रियते //
text_mt: All of it is performed in the mind.

sanskrit_iast: manasā stotram upākaroti //
meaning: मनसा स्तोत्रम् उपाकरोति //
text_mt: He introduces the chant in the mind.

sanskrit_iast: manasā prastauti //
meaning: मनसा प्रस्तौति //

sanskrit_iast: manasodgāyati //
meaning: मनसोद्गायति //

sanskrit_iast: manasā pratiharati //
meaning: मनसा प्रतिहरति //

sanskrit_iast: manasā tisṛṇām̐ sārparājñīnām̐ ṣaṭkṛtvaḥ pratigṛhṇāti //
meaning: मनसा तिसृणाम्̐ सार्पराज्ञीनाम्̐ षट्कृत्वः प्रतिगृह्णाति //
text_mt: In the mind he responds six times to the three Sārparājñī verses.
