text_mt: Having made the fifteenfold chant the Agniṣṭoma-sāman of this very rite on verses addressed to Vāyu, he should cause one who is chronically ill to sacrifice, or one desirous of food, or one desirous of offspring, or one desirous of cattle.

sanskrit_iast: etasyaiva revatīṣu vāravantīyam agniṣṭomasāma kṛtvā brahmavarcasakāmam / etasyaiva śakvarīṣu vāravantīyam agniṣṭomasāma kṛtvā paśukāmam / etam eva catuḥṣṭomaṃ kṛtvā grāmakāmaḥ / apravargyā bhavantīty eke / trivṛtāgniṣṭutā brahmavarcasakāmaḥ / pañcadaśenāgniṣṭutā vīryakāmaḥ //
meaning: एतस्यैव रेवतीषु वारवन्तीयम् अग्निष्टोमसाम कृत्वा ब्रह्मवर्चसकामम् / एतस्यैव शक्वरीषु वारवन्तीयम् अग्निष्टोमसाम कृत्वा पशुकामम् / एतम् एव चतुःष्टोमं कृत्वा ग्रामकामः / अप्रवर्ग्या भवन्तीत्य् एके / त्रिवृताग्निष्टुता ब्रह्मवर्चसकामः / पञ्चदशेनाग्निष्टुता वीर्यकामः //
text_mt: Having made the Vāravantīya chant the Agniṣṭoma-sāman of this very rite on Revatī verses, for one desirous of spiritual luster; having made the Vāravantīya chant the Agniṣṭoma-sāman of this very rite on Śakvarī verses, for one desirous of cattle; having made this very rite into a four-stoma one, for one desirous of a village; according to some, these rites are without the Pravargya; with the threefold Agniṣṭut, for one desirous of spiritual luster; with the fifteenfold Agniṣṭut, for one desirous of heroism.

sanskrit_iast: saptadaśenāgniṣṭutāgniṣṭomena yajñavibhraṣṭo yajeta / yasmin vā yajñakratau vibhram̐śet //
meaning: सप्तदशेनाग्निष्टुताग्निष्टोमेन यज्ञविभ्रष्टो यजेत / यस्मिन् वा यज्ञक्रतौ विभ्रम्̐शेत् //
text_mt: One who has fallen from a sacrifice should sacrifice with the seventeenfold Agniṣṭut Agniṣṭoma, or at whichever sacrificial rite he may have fallen away.

sanskrit_iast: trivṛd avādyaṃ vadataḥ //
meaning: त्रिवृद् अवाद्यं वदतः //
text_mt: The threefold chant is for one who speaks blameable speech.

sanskrit_iast: pañcadaśo 'nihatyasya nighnataḥ //
meaning: पञ्चदशो ऽनिहत्यस्य निघ्नतः //
text_mt: The fifteenfold chant is for one who slays someone who ought not to be slain.

sanskrit_iast: saptadaśo 'nāśānnasya bhojane prāśyaikavim̐śo janaṃ yato gāndhārakaliṅgamāgadhān pāraskarān sauvīrān vā //
meaning: सप्तदशो ऽनाशान्नस्य भोजने प्राश्यैकविम्̐शो जनं यतो गान्धारकलिङ्गमागधान् पारस्करान् सौवीरान् वा //
text_mt: The seventeenfold chant is for one who has eaten the food of someone whose food should not be eaten; having consumed [such food], the twenty-one-fold chant is for one going among the people of Gandhāra, Kaliṅga, Magadha, Pāraskara, or Sauvīra.

sanskrit_iast: triṇavenaujaskāmaḥ //
meaning: त्रिणवेनौजस्कामः //

sanskrit_iast: pañcadaśena vīryakāmaḥ / saptadaśena prajākamaḥ / ekavim̐śena pratiṣṭhākāmaḥ / trayastrim̐śena svargakāmaḥ //
meaning: पञ्चदशेन वीर्यकामः / सप्तदशेन प्रजाकमः / एकविम्̐शेन प्रतिष्ठाकामः / त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शेन स्वर्गकामः //
text_mt: With the fifteenfold chant, for one desirous of heroism; with the seventeenfold chant, for one desirous of offspring; with the twenty-one-fold chant, for one desirous of stability; with the thirty-three-fold chant, for one desirous of heaven.

sanskrit_iast: apivā jyotiṣṭoma eva / agniṣṭome sarvān kāmān kāmayet //
meaning: अपिवा ज्योतिष्टोम एव / अग्निष्टोमे सर्वान् कामान् कामयेत् //
text_mt: Or rather, in the Jyotiṣṭoma alone, in the Agniṣṭoma, he should desire all desires.

sanskrit_iast: trivṛtāgniṣṭomenāniruktenānnādyakāmo yajeta //
meaning: त्रिवृताग्निष्टोमेनानिरुक्तेनान्नाद्यकामो यजेत //
text_mt: One desirous of food should sacrifice with the threefold Agniṣṭoma without recitation of specific deity names.

sanskrit_iast: aniruktaṃ prātaḥsavanam ity eke //
meaning: अनिरुक्तं प्रातःसवनम् इत्य् एके //
text_mt: According to some, the morning pressing is without recitation of specific deity names.

sanskrit_iast: aśvaḥ śveto dakṣiṇā / sa brahmaṇe deyaḥ //
meaning: अश्वः श्वेतो दक्षिणा / स ब्रह्मणे देयः //
text_mt: A white horse is the sacrificial gift; it is to be given to the brahman priest.

sanskrit_iast: bṛhaspatisavo dvitīyaḥ //
meaning: बृहस्पतिसवो द्वितीयः //
text_mt: The Bṛhaspatisava is the second.

sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇo brahmavarcasakāmaḥ purodhākāmo vā yajeta / yaṃ vā sthāpatyāyābhiṣiñceyuḥ //
meaning: ब्राह्मणो ब्रह्मवर्चसकामः पुरोधाकामो वा यजेत / यं वा स्थापत्यायाभिषिञ्चेयुः //
text_mt: A brāhmaṇa desirous of spiritual luster or desirous of the office of domestic priest should sacrifice, or one whom they would consecrate to governorship.

sanskrit_iast: parisrajī hotā bhavati //
meaning: परिस्रजी होता भवति //
text_mt: The hotṛ wears a garland around his neck.

sanskrit_iast: aruṇo mirmiras triśukraḥ //
meaning: अरुणो मिर्मिरस् त्रिशुक्रः //
text_mt: [The victim is] reddish-brown, blinking, and white-spotted in three places.

sanskrit_iast: bṛhaspate juṣasva nas iti bārhaspatyam atigrāhyaṃ gṛhṇāti //
meaning: बृहस्पते जुषस्व नस् इति बार्हस्पत्यम् अतिग्राह्यं गृह्णाति //
text_mt: He draws the extra cup for Bṛhaspati with the mantra: 'O Bṛhaspati, take pleasure in us.'

sanskrit_iast: bārhaspatyaḥ paśur upālambhyaḥ //
meaning: बार्हस्पत्यः पशुर् उपालम्भ्यः //
text_mt: An animal sacred to Bṛhaspati is to be seized.

sanskrit_iast: prātaḥsavane sanneṣu nārāśam̐seṣv ekādaśa dakṣiṇā vyādiśati //
meaning: प्रातःसवने सन्नेषु नाराशम्̐सेष्व् एकादश दक्षिणा व्यादिशति //
text_mt: At the morning pressing, when the Nārāśaṃsa cups are placed down, he assigns eleven sacrificial gifts.

sanskrit_iast: ājyena mādhyaṃdine savane 'gnim anvārabdhaṃ kṛṣṇājine 'bhiṣiñcati / yathāgnicityāyām̐ śukrāmanthinor vā sam̐srāveṇa //
meaning: आज्येन माध्यंदिने सवने ऽग्निम् अन्वारब्धं कृष्णाजिने ऽभिषिञ्चति / यथाग्निचित्यायाम्̐ शुक्रामन्थिनोर् वा सम्̐स्रावेण //
text_mt: At the midday pressing, while [the sacrificer] holds onto the fire, he consecrates him on a black antelope skin with clarified butter, as in the piling of the fire altar, or with the residue of the Śukra and Manthin cups.

sanskrit_iast: aśvadvādaśa mādhyaṃdine savane tā ubhayīr upākaroti / dvādaśa tṛtīyasavane //
meaning: अश्वद्वादश माध्यंदिने सवने ता उभयीर् उपाकरोति / द्वादश तृतीयसवने //
text_mt: Twelve, including a horse, at the midday pressing—he brings up both of these; twelve at the third pressing.

sanskrit_iast: tā vaśāyām upākaroti //
meaning: ता वशायाम् उपाकरोति //

sanskrit_iast: apivāṣṭau prātaḥsavana ekādaśa mādhyaṃdine savane dvādaśa tṛtīyasavane / aśvaṃ tṛtīyaśo 'nusavanaṃ dadyād ity ekeṣām / sarvā mādhyaṃdine savana ity eke //
meaning: अपिवाष्टौ प्रातःसवन एकादश माध्यंदिने सवने द्वादश तृतीयसवने / अश्वं तृतीयशो ऽनुसवनं दद्याद् इत्य् एकेषाम् / सर्वा माध्यंदिने सवन इत्य् एके //
text_mt: Or else, eight at the morning pressing, eleven at the midday pressing, twelve at the third pressing; according to some, one should give a horse at each pressing in three parts; according to some, all at the midday pressing.

sanskrit_iast: manasetarayoḥ savanayor na vā manasā ca na //
meaning: मनसेतरयोः सवनयोर् न वा मनसा च न //
text_mt: Mentally at the other two pressings, or not even mentally.

sanskrit_iast: trivṛto 'gniṣṭomasyeṣuṃ vikṛtiṃ kṛtvābhicaran yajeta //
meaning: त्रिवृतो ऽग्निष्टोमस्येषुं विकृतिं कृत्वाभिचरन् यजेत //
text_mt: Having made the Iṣu rite a modification of the threefold Agniṣṭoma, one practicing malevolent sorcery should sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: samānam itarac chyenena //
meaning: समानम् इतरच् छ्येनेन //
text_mt: The rest is the same as the Śyena.

sanskrit_iast: trivṛto 'gniṣṭomaḥ //
meaning: त्रिवृतो ऽग्निष्टोमः //

sanskrit_iast: śunaskarṇastomaḥ / sarvasvāraḥ //
meaning: शुनस्कर्णस्तोमः / सर्वस्वारः //
text_mt: The Śunaskarṇastoma [and] the Sarvasvāra.

sanskrit_iast: maraṇakāmo yajeta yaḥ kāmayetānāmayatāṃ svargaṃ lokam iyām iti vijñāyate //
meaning: मरणकामो यजेत यः कामयेतानामयतां स्वर्गं लोकम् इयाम् इति विज्ञायते //
text_mt: One wishing for death should sacrifice; 'He who desires, "May I go to the heavenly world free from disease,"' so it is known [from the Brāhmaṇa].

sanskrit_iast: yāmyaḥ paśuḥ śukaharita upālambhyaḥ //
meaning: याम्यः पशुः शुकहरित उपालम्भ्यः //
text_mt: A victim for Yama, yellowish-green like a parrot, is to be seized.

sanskrit_iast: kṛtānnaṃ dakṣiṇā //
meaning: कृतान्नं दक्षिणा //

sanskrit_iast: ārbhave stūyamāne dakṣiṇenaudumbarīm ahatena vāsasā pattodaśena prāvṛtya dakṣiṇāśirāḥ saṃviśati brāhmaṇāḥ samāpayatam etaṃ yajñam iti // yajñasam̐sthām anu saṃtiṣṭhate //
meaning: आर्भवे स्तूयमाने दक्षिणेनौदुम्बरीम् अहतेन वाससा पत्तोदशेन प्रावृत्य दक्षिणाशिराः संविशति ब्राह्मणाः समापयतम् एतं यज्ञम् इति // यज्ञसम्̐स्थाम् अनु संतिष्ठते //
text_mt: While the Ārbhava-stotra is being chanted, having covered himself to the south of the audumbarī post with an unwashed garment with fringes at the feet, with his head toward the south, he lies down, saying: 'O brahmins, bring this sacrifice to completion!' He departs following the conclusion of the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: pṛthag araṇīṣv agnīn samārohyottaranārāyaṇenādityam upasthāyāraṇyam abhipraiti / yadi grāme vivaset pṛthag araṇīṣv agnīn samārohyottaranārāyaṇenādityam upasthāya gṛheṣu pratyavasyet / yady anabhiprāpnuyāt tān yajñakratūn āha / tena bhūr ukthyo rathaṃtarasāmā / bhūtikāmo yajeta / dhenur dakṣiṇā //
meaning: पृथग् अरणीष्व् अग्नीन् समारोह्योत्तरनारायणेनादित्यम् उपस्थायारण्यम् अभिप्रैति / यदि ग्रामे विवसेत् पृथग् अरणीष्व् अग्नीन् समारोह्योत्तरनारायणेनादित्यम् उपस्थाय गृहेषु प्रत्यवस्येत् / यद्य् अनभिप्राप्नुयात् तान् यज्ञक्रतून् आह / तेन भूर् उक्थ्यो रथंतरसामा / भूतिकामो यजेत / धेनुर् दक्षिणा //
text_mt: Having mounted the fires separately onto the kindling sticks and worshipped the sun with the Uttaranārāyaṇa hymn, he goes out toward the forest. If he should reside in a settlement, having mounted the fires separately onto the kindling sticks and worshipped the sun with the Uttaranārāyaṇa hymn, he should settle down into the houses. If he should not attain [his wish], he mentions those sacrificial rites: By that, [one performs] the Bhūḥ rite, an Ukthya with the Rathaṃtara-sāman; one desiring prosperity should sacrifice; a milch-cow is the sacrificial fee.

sanskrit_iast: akṣayyam̐ ha vai sukṛtaṃ cāturmāsyayājinaḥ //
meaning: अक्षय्यम्̐ ह वै सुकृतं चातुर्मास्ययाजिनः //
text_mt: Imperishable indeed is the good deed of one who performs the seasonal sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast: trivṛd agniṣṭomo vaiśvadevasya loke //
meaning: त्रिवृद् अग्निष्टोमो वैश्वदेवस्य लोके //
text_mt: A ninefold Agniṣṭoma in place of the Vaiśvadeva.

sanskrit_iast: vaiśvadevaḥ paśuḥ / bārhaspatyānūbandhyā //
meaning: वैश्वदेवः पशुः / बार्हस्पत्यानूबन्ध्या //
text_mt: An animal victim for the Viśvedevas; a concluding animal sacrifice for Bṛhaspati.

sanskrit_iast: na yūpaṃ minvanti //
meaning: न यूपं मिन्वन्ति //

sanskrit_iast: nottaravedim upavapanti //
meaning: नोत्तरवेदिम् उपवपन्ति //
text_mt: They do not strew the high altar.

sanskrit_iast: paridhau paśuṃ niyuñjanti / ulmuke barhiṣi vā / uttareṣu viminvanti / yūpān uttaravedim upavapanti //
meaning: परिधौ पशुं नियुञ्जन्ति / उल्मुके बर्हिषि वा / उत्तरेषु विमिन्वन्ति / यूपान् उत्तरवेदिम् उपवपन्ति //
text_mt: They tie the animal victim to an enclosure stick, or to a firebrand, or to the sacred grass. In the subsequent ones, they erect [the posts]; they strew the sacrificial posts [and] the high altar.

sanskrit_iast: tataś caturṣu māseṣu varuṇapraghāsānāṃ loke trirātro 'gniṣṭoma ukthyo 'tirātraḥ / mārutaḥ paśuḥ / vāruṇo dvitīyaḥ / maitrāvaruṇy anūbandhyā //
meaning: ततश् चतुर्षु मासेषु वरुणप्रघासानां लोके त्रिरात्रो ऽग्निष्टोम उक्थ्यो ऽतिरात्रः / मारुतः पशुः / वारुणो द्वितीयः / मैत्रावरुण्य् अनूबन्ध्या //
text_mt: Then, in the fourth month, in place of the Varuṇapraghāsa rites, a three-day rite consisting of an Agniṣṭoma, an Ukthya, and an Atirātra; an animal victim for the Maruts, a second for Varuṇa; a concluding animal sacrifice for Mitra-Varuṇa.

sanskrit_iast: tataś caturṣu māseṣu sākamedhānāṃ loke trirātro 'gniṣṭoma utkhyo 'tirātraḥ //
meaning: ततश् चतुर्षु मासेषु साकमेधानां लोके त्रिरात्रो ऽग्निष्टोम उत्ख्यो ऽतिरात्रः //
text_mt: Then, in the fourth month, in place of the Sākamedha rites, a three-day rite consisting of an Agniṣṭoma, an Ukthya, and an Atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: āgneyaḥ paśur aindrāgno dvitīyaḥ / aikādaśinās tṛtīye prājāpatyo vā saury anūbandhyā //
meaning: आग्नेयः पशुर् ऐन्द्राग्नो द्वितीयः / ऐकादशिनास् तृतीये प्राजापत्यो वा सौर्य् अनूबन्ध्या //
text_mt: An animal victim for Agni, a second for Indra-Agni; in the third, eleven animal victims or one for Prajāpati; a concluding animal sacrifice for Sūrya.

sanskrit_iast: tataś caturṣu māseṣu śunāsīrīyasya loke catuḥṣṭomo 'gniṣṭomaḥ / vāyavyaḥ paśur āśviny anūbandhyā //
meaning: ततश् चतुर्षु मासेषु शुनासीरीयस्य लोके चतुःष्टोमो ऽग्निष्टोमः / वायव्यः पशुर् आश्विन्य् अनूबन्ध्या //
text_mt: Then, in the fourth month, in place of the Śunāsīrīya, a fourfold-stoma Agniṣṭoma; an animal victim for Vāyu, a concluding animal sacrifice for the Aśvins.

sanskrit_iast: sarvatrāhataṃ vāso vasāno 'vabhṛthād udetya kratvantarāleṣu / nānṛtaṃ vadati / na mām̐sam aśnāti / na striyam upaiti / noparyāste / jugupsetānṛtāt / prāṅ śete / na madhv aśnāti / nāñjīta / nābhyañjīta / ṛtau jāyām upeyāt //
meaning: सर्वत्राहतं वासो वसानो ऽवभृथाद् उदेत्य क्रत्वन्तरालेषु / नानृतं वदति / न माम्̐सम् अश्नाति / न स्त्रियम् उपैति / नोपर्यास्ते / जुगुप्सेतानृतात् / प्राङ् शेते / न मध्व् अश्नाति / नाञ्जीत / नाभ्यञ्जीत / ऋतौ जायाम् उपेयात् //
text_mt: Throughout, wearing an unwashed garment after stepping out from the purificatory bath during the intervals between the rites: he does not speak falsehood; he does not eat meat; he does not approach a woman; he does not sit on an elevated seat; he should guard himself against untruth; he sleeps facing east; he does not eat honey; he should not apply collyrium; he should not anoint himself; he may approach his wife in her fertile period.

sanskrit_iast: pañcāśad vaiśvadevasya dakṣiṇāḥ / śataṃ varuṇapraghāseṣu / adhyardhaśatam̐ sākamedheṣu / dvādaśaśatam̐ śunāsīrīye //
meaning: पञ्चाशद् वैश्वदेवस्य दक्षिणाः / शतं वरुणप्रघासेषु / अध्यर्धशतम्̐ साकमेधेषु / द्वादशशतम्̐ शुनासीरीये //
text_mt: Fifty are the sacrificial fees of the Vaiśvadeva; a hundred in the Varuṇapraghāsas; one hundred and fifty in the Sākamedhas; one hundred and twelve in the Śunāsīrīya.

sanskrit_iast: yathartujā vā yathāsvaṃ cāturmāsyeṣu //
meaning: यथर्तुजा वा यथास्वं चातुर्मास्येषु //
text_mt: Or [they are given] according to each season, appropriately in the seasonal sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast: vatsām̐s tṛtīyasavane saha mātṛbhiḥ //
meaning: वत्साम्̐स् तृतीयसवने सह मातृभिः //
text_mt: [He gives] calves at the third pressing together with their mothers.

sanskrit_iast: upahavyenāgniṣṭomena rathaṃtarasāmnā bṛhatsāmnobhayasāmnā vāmayāvinaṃ yājayed etenānnādyakāmaṃ prajākāmaṃ paśukāmaṃ vāśvaḥ śyāvo dakṣiṇā / sa brahmaṇe deyaḥ //
meaning: उपहव्येनाग्निष्टोमेन रथंतरसाम्ना बृहत्साम्नोभयसाम्ना वामयाविनं याजयेद् एतेनान्नाद्यकामं प्रजाकामं पशुकामं वाश्वः श्यावो दक्षिणा / स ब्रह्मणे देयः //
text_mt: With the Upahavya Agniṣṭoma having the Rathaṃtara-sāman, the Bṛhat-sāman, or both sāmans, one should perform the sacrifice for a sick person; with this [he sacrifices] for one desiring food, one desiring offspring, or one desiring cattle; a dark horse is the sacrificial fee; it is to be given to the brahman priest.

sanskrit_iast: yathāprakṛtītarebhyaḥ //
meaning: यथाप्रकृतीतरेभ्यः //
text_mt: To the others, according to the standard model.

sanskrit_iast: ṛtapeyenāgniṣṭomena bṛhatsāmnā brāhmaṇaḥ svargakāmaḥ //
meaning: ऋतपेयेनाग्निष्टोमेन बृहत्साम्ना ब्राह्मणः स्वर्गकामः //
text_mt: With the Ṛtapeya Agniṣṭoma having the Bṛhat-sāman, a brahmin desiring heaven [sacrifices].

sanskrit_iast: ṣaḍ dīkṣāḥ / ṣaḍ upasadaḥ / ghṛtavrato bhavati //
meaning: षड् दीक्षाः / षड् उपसदः / घृतव्रतो भवति //
text_mt: There are six initiations, six Upasad days; he observes the clarified-butter vow.

sanskrit_iast: yāvad idaṃ prathamam aṅgulikāṇḍaṃ tāvat krīte some vratam //
meaning: यावद् इदं प्रथमम् अङ्गुलिकाण्डं तावत् क्रीते सोमे व्रतम् //
text_mt: His vow [subsists on food measuring] as much as this first joint of the finger once the soma is bought.

sanskrit_iast: uttareṇottarakāṇḍena vratam upaiti //
meaning: उत्तरेणोत्तरकाण्डेन व्रतम् उपैति //
text_mt: With the next [joint], he approaches the vow with the subsequent joint.

sanskrit_iast: naktam agnim abhyāvṛtyāste / divādityam //
meaning: नक्तम् अग्निम् अभ्यावृत्यास्ते / दिवादित्यम् //
text_mt: At night he sits facing the fire; by day, facing the sun.

sanskrit_iast: ṛtam uktvā prasarpanti / ṛtaṃ vadanto bhakṣayanti //
meaning: ऋतम् उक्त्वा प्रसर्पन्ति / ऋतं वदन्तो भक्षयन्ति //
text_mt: Having spoken the truth, they glide forward; speaking the truth, they consume [the soma].

sanskrit_iast: audumbaraś camasaś catuḥsraktiḥ somasya pūrṇaḥ sagotrāya priyāya brahmaṇe deyaḥ //
meaning: औदुम्बरश् चमसश् चतुःस्रक्तिः सोमस्य पूर्णः सगोत्राय प्रियाय ब्रह्मणे देयः //
text_mt: A four-cornered drinking cup made of udumbara wood filled with soma is to be given to a beloved brahman priest belonging to the same gotra.

sanskrit_iast: yathāprakṛtītarebhyaḥ //
meaning: यथाप्रकृतीतरेभ्यः //
text_mt: To the others, according to the standard model.

sanskrit_iast: bahuhiraṇyenāgniṣṭomenānaḍuho lokam āpnoti / jyotiṣmato lokāñ jayati //
meaning: बहुहिरण्येनाग्निष्टोमेनानडुहो लोकम् आप्नोति / ज्योतिष्मतो लोकाञ् जयति //
text_mt: With the Bahuhiraṇya Agniṣṭoma, one attains the world of the draft-ox; he conquers radiant worlds.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśamānaṃ hiraṇyaṃ dīkṣaṇīyāyāṃ dadāti / dvis tāvat prāyaṇīyāyām //
meaning: द्वादशमानं हिरण्यं दीक्षणीयायां ददाति / द्विस् तावत् प्रायणीयायाम् //
text_mt: He gives gold weighing twelve mānas at the initiation offering; twice as much at the introductory rite.

sanskrit_iast: evam ata ūrdhvaṃ dviguṇābhyāsenātithyāyām upasatsu pravargyeṣv agnīṣomīyasya vapāyām̐ hutāyām agnīṣomīye savanīyasya hutāyāṃ vapāyām̐ savanīye prātaḥsavane //
meaning: एवम् अत ऊर्ध्वं द्विगुणाभ्यासेनातिथ्यायाम् उपसत्सु प्रवर्ग्येष्व् अग्नीषोमीयस्य वपायाम्̐ हुतायाम् अग्नीषोमीये सवनीयस्य हुतायां वपायाम्̐ सवनीये प्रातःसवने //
text_mt: In this manner, thereafter with twofold doubling: at the guest offering, at the Upasads, at the Pravargyas, when the omentum of the animal for Agni-Soma has been offered, at the Agni-Soma animal rite, when the omentum of the offering-victim has been offered, at the offering-victim, at the morning pressing,

sanskrit_iast: sanneṣu nārāśam̐seṣv avabhṛtheṣṭāv udayanīyāyām anūbandhyāvapāyām̐ hutāyām anūbandhyāyām udavasānīyāyām antataḥ //
meaning: सन्नेषु नाराशम्̐सेष्व् अवभृथेष्टाव् उदयनीयायाम् अनूबन्ध्यावपायाम्̐ हुतायाम् अनूबन्ध्यायाम् उदवसानीयायाम् अन्ततः //
text_mt: when the Nārāśaṃsa cups are deposited, at the purificatory bath offering, at the concluding rite, when the omentum of the concluding animal sacrifice has been offered, at the concluding animal sacrifice, [and] at the concluding bath at the end.

sanskrit_iast: trivṛtāgniṣṭutāgniṣṭomena rathaṃtarasāmnā brāhmaṇo brahmavarcasakāmaḥ //
meaning: त्रिवृताग्निष्टुताग्निष्टोमेन रथंतरसाम्ना ब्राह्मणो ब्रह्मवर्चसकामः //
text_mt: With the ninefold Agniṣṭut Agniṣṭoma having the Rathaṃtara-sāman, a brahmin desiring spiritual splendor [sacrifices].

sanskrit_iast: pañcadaśenendrastutenendrastomenokthyena bṛhatsāmnā rājanyo vīryakāmaḥ //
meaning: पञ्चदशेनेन्द्रस्तुतेनेन्द्रस्तोमेनोक्थ्येन बृहत्साम्ना राजन्यो वीर्यकामः //
text_mt: With the fifteenfold Indrastuta [or] Indrastoma Ukthya having the Bṛhat-sāman, a kṣatriya desiring valor [sacrifices].

sanskrit_iast: saptadaśenāgniṣṭutāgniṣṭomena kaṇvarathaṃtarasāmnā vaiśyaḥ paśukāmaḥ //
meaning: सप्तदशेनाग्निष्टुताग्निष्टोमेन कण्वरथंतरसाम्ना वैश्यः पशुकामः //
text_mt: With the seventeenfold Agniṣṭut Agniṣṭoma having the Kaṇvarathaṃtara-sāman, a vaiśya desiring cattle [sacrifices].

sanskrit_iast: pratidhuṣā prātaḥsavane sarvānt somāñ cchrīṇāti / śṛtena mādhyaṃdine savane / dadhnā tṛtīyasavane //
meaning: प्रतिधुषा प्रातःसवने सर्वान्त् सोमाञ् च्छ्रीणाति / शृतेन माध्यंदिने सवने / दध्ना तृतीयसवने //
text_mt: At the morning pressing, he mixes all the soma libations with fresh warm milk; with boiled milk at the midday pressing; with curd at the third pressing.

sanskrit_iast: nītamiśreṇa vā //
meaning: नीतमिश्रेण वा //

sanskrit_iast: tīvrasutokthyena rathaṃtarasāmnā bṛhatsāmnobhayasāmnā vā somavāminaṃ yājayet //
meaning: तीव्रसुतोक्थ्येन रथंतरसाम्ना बृहत्साम्नोभयसाम्ना वा सोमवामिनं याजयेत् //
text_mt: With the Tīvrasut Ukthya having the Rathaṃtara-sāman, the Bṛhat-sāman, or both sāmans, one should perform the sacrifice for one who has vomited soma.

sanskrit_iast: somātipavitaṃ yājayed rājānam aparuddhaṃ grāmakāmaṃ prajākāmaṃ paśukāmam̐ śriyā pratyavarūḍham abhicaran yajetābhicaryamāṇo yajeta //
meaning: सोमातिपवितं याजयेद् राजानम् अपरुद्धं ग्रामकामं प्रजाकामं पशुकामम्̐ श्रिया प्रत्यवरूढम् अभिचरन् यजेताभिचर्यमाणो यजेत //
text_mt: One should perform the sacrifice for one who has had soma pass through him, for an expelled king, for one desiring a village, for one desiring offspring, for one desiring cattle, or for one fallen from prosperity; one practicing sorcery should sacrifice; one against whom sorcery is practiced should sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: pratidhuṣā prātaḥsavane sarvān somāñ chrīṇāti / śṛtena mādhyaṃdine savane / dadhnā tṛtīyasavane / nītamiśreṇa vā //
meaning: प्रतिधुषा प्रातःसवने सर्वान् सोमाञ् छ्रीणाति / शृतेन माध्यंदिने सवने / दध्ना तृतीयसवने / नीतमिश्रेण वा //
text_mt: At the morning pressing, he mixes all the soma libations with fresh warm milk; with boiled milk at the midday pressing; with curd at the third pressing; or with what is mixed with freshly churned milk.

sanskrit_iast: śṛtam āśire duhanti //
meaning: शृतम् आशिरे दुहन्ति //

sanskrit_iast: śṛtam āśireṇābhivānyavatsā duhanti //
meaning: शृतम् आशिरेणाभिवान्यवत्सा दुहन्ति //
text_mt: They milk cows whose calves are fostered by others for boiled milk as the milk-admixture.

sanskrit_iast: tā dakṣiṇā bhavanti //
meaning: ता दक्षिणा भवन्ति //

sanskrit_iast: adhicamasān unnayanti //
meaning: अधिचमसान् उन्नयन्ति //
text_mt: They draw the extra cups.

sanskrit_iast: avajighranty ṛtvijo na bhakṣayanti //
meaning: अवजिघ्रन्त्य् ऋत्विजो न भक्षयन्ति //
text_mt: The priests smell them; they do not consume them.

sanskrit_iast: tān acchāvākasya stotre bhakṣayanti //
meaning: तान् अच्छावाकस्य स्तोत्रे भक्षयन्ति //
text_mt: They consume them during the chant of the Acchāvāka.

sanskrit_iast: brahmaṇi hotrakā upahavam icchante //
meaning: ब्रह्मणि होत्रका उपहवम् इच्छन्ते //
text_mt: The subsidiary Hotṛs ask permission from the brahman priest.

sanskrit_iast: yajamāna ṛtvija ubhāv adhvaryū sarve camasādhvaryavo 'cchāvākāya pratigṛṇanti //
meaning: यजमान ऋत्विज उभाव् अध्वर्यू सर्वे चमसाध्वर्यवो ऽच्छावाकाय प्रतिगृणन्ति //
text_mt: The sacrificer, the priests, both adhvaryus, and all the cup-adhvaryus make the response to the Acchāvāka.

sanskrit_iast: prācy ekādaśinī saṃmīyate //
meaning: प्राच्य् एकादशिनी संमीयते //
text_mt: The set of eleven posts is erected facing east.

sanskrit_iast: yāvad yūpaṃ vedim uddhanti //
meaning: यावद् यूपं वेदिम् उद्धन्ति //
text_mt: He raises the altar up to the sacrificial post.

sanskrit_iast: vaḍavā śvetā dakṣiṇā / sā brahmaṇe deyā //
meaning: वडवा श्वेता दक्षिणा / सा ब्रह्मणे देया //
text_mt: A white mare is the sacrificial fee; it is to be given to the brahman priest.

sanskrit_iast: yathāprakṛtītarebhyaḥ //
meaning: यथाप्रकृतीतरेभ्यः //
text_mt: To the others, according to the standard model.

sanskrit_iast: marutstomena rājapurohitau sāyujyam //
meaning: मरुत्स्तोमेन राजपुरोहितौ सायुज्यम् //
text_mt: With the Marutstoma, a king and his domestic chaplain [attain] union.

sanskrit_iast: athaiṣa rāṭ / yo rājyam āśam̐samāno na labheta sa etena yajeta //
meaning: अथैष राट् / यो राज्यम् आशम्̐समानो न लभेत स एतेन यजेत //
text_mt: Now this Rāṭ rite: one who, hoping for kingship, does not obtain it, should sacrifice with this.

sanskrit_iast: virājānnādyakāmaḥ / svarājā pratiṣṭhākamaḥ //
meaning: विराजान्नाद्यकामः / स्वराजा प्रतिष्ठाकमः //
text_mt: With the Virāj, one desiring food [sacrifices]; with the Svarāj, one desiring a firm footing.

sanskrit_iast: bahu pratigṛhya yo garagīr iva manyeta sa punaḥstomena / anāśyānnasya vā bhuktvā / ayājyaṃ vā yājayitvety eke / yo laghur ivāpratiṣṭhitaḥ syāt sa etena / ekavim̐śenaupacchadena prajākāma ity eke //
meaning: बहु प्रतिगृह्य यो गरगीर् इव मन्येत स पुनःस्तोमेन / अनाश्यान्नस्य वा भुक्त्वा / अयाज्यं वा याजयित्वेत्य् एके / यो लघुर् इवाप्रतिष्ठितः स्यात् स एतेन / एकविम्̐शेनौपच्छदेन प्रजाकाम इत्य् एके //
text_mt: He who, having accepted much, should consider himself as if swallowing poison, [should sacrifice] with the Punaḥstoma; or having eaten the food of one whose food must not be eaten; or, according to some, having sacrificed for one for whom one should not sacrifice; he who is, as it were, unstable and without a firm footing, should [sacrifice] with this; with the twenty-onefold Upacchada, one desiring offspring [sacrifices], according to some.

sanskrit_iast: aupacchadena pratiṣṭhākāmaḥ //
meaning: औपच्छदेन प्रतिष्ठाकामः //
text_mt: One desirous of firm standing [sacrifices] with the Aupacchada.

sanskrit_iast: ekaikayā stotriyayopagāyate //
meaning: एकैकया स्तोत्रिययोपगायते //
text_mt: He sings along with each stotriya verse.

sanskrit_iast: gandharvāpsaraso mādayantām iti prātaḥsavane 'dhastāt pūtabhṛtaḥ pām̐sūn upāsyati //
meaning: गन्धर्वाप्सरसो मादयन्ताम् इति प्रातःसवने ऽधस्तात् पूतभृतः पाम्̐सून् उपास्यति //
text_mt: With [the mantra]: 'May the Gandharvas and Apsarases rejoice,' he casts dust beneath the pūtabhṛt at the morning soma-pressing.

sanskrit_iast: gandharvā devā mādayantām iti mādhyaṃdine savane / gandharvāḥ pitaro mādayantām iti tṛtīyasavane //
meaning: गन्धर्वा देवा मादयन्ताम् इति माध्यंदिने सवने / गन्धर्वाः पितरो मादयन्ताम् इति तृतीयसवने //
text_mt: With: 'May the Gandharvas, the gods, rejoice,' at the midday soma-pressing; with: 'May the Gandharvas, the ancestors, rejoice,' at the third soma-pressing.

sanskrit_iast: apadhvam̐sata ity ācakṣate //
meaning: अपध्वम्̐सत इत्य् आचक्षते //
text_mt: They declare that this is 'scattering away.'

sanskrit_iast: punastomena bahu pratigṛhya yo garagīr iva manyetābhiśasyamānasya bhūtvaiteṣām //
meaning: पुनस्तोमेन बहु प्रतिगृह्य यो गरगीर् इव मन्येताभिशस्यमानस्य भूत्वैतेषाम् //
text_mt: With the Punaḥstoma [sacrifices] one who, having accepted much [in gifts], thinks himself as if swallowed poison, or having become the [sacrificial priest] of one accused [of sin]—among these.

sanskrit_iast: gotamacatuṣṭomābhyāṃ paśukāmaḥ //
meaning: गोतमचतुष्टोमाभ्यां पशुकामः //
text_mt: One desirous of cattle [sacrifices] with the two Gotamacatuṣṭomas.

sanskrit_iast: ukthyaḥ ṣoḍaśimān uttaraḥ //
meaning: उक्थ्यः षोडशिमान् उत्तरः //
text_mt: The second is an Ukthya possessing the Ṣoḍaśin.

sanskrit_iast: napum̐sakapaśū iva bhavataḥ //
meaning: नपुम्̐सकपशू इव भवतः //
text_mt: The two victims are as if neuter.

sanskrit_iast: udbhidbalabhidbhyāṃ paśukāmaḥ //
meaning: उद्भिद्बलभिद्भ्यां पशुकामः //
text_mt: One desirous of cattle [sacrifices] with the Udbhid and Balabhid.

sanskrit_iast: udbhideṣṭvā saṃvatsare balabhidā yajeta //
meaning: उद्भिदेष्ट्वा संवत्सरे बलभिदा यजेत //
text_mt: Having sacrificed with the Udbhid, he should sacrifice after a year with the Balabhid.

sanskrit_iast: āgneyenāṣṭākapālenāntarālaṃ pratipadyate //
meaning: आग्नेयेनाष्टाकपालेनान्तरालं प्रतिपद्यते //
text_mt: He fills the interval with an [iṣṭi of] an eight-pot-sherd [cake] to Agni.

sanskrit_iast: ubhayatra gāyatrīḥ saṃpūrṇā dakṣiṇā dadāti //
meaning: उभयत्र गायत्रीः संपूर्णा दक्षिणा ददाति //
text_mt: In both cases, he gives dakṣiṇās fully made up of the gāyatrī [number].

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭau pūrvasminn aṣṭā uttarasmin //
meaning: अष्टौ पूर्वस्मिन्न् अष्टा उत्तरस्मिन् //
text_mt: Eight at the first, eight at the second.

sanskrit_iast: apacitikāmo 'pacitibhyām //
meaning: अपचितिकामो ऽपचितिभ्याम् //
text_mt: One desirous of honor [sacrifices] with the two Apacitis.

sanskrit_iast: ubhayasāmānau bhavataḥ //
meaning: उभयसामानौ भवतः //
text_mt: They are both characterized by both Sāmans.

sanskrit_iast: pakṣibhyāṃ sāgnicityābhyāṃ yaḥ kāmayeta pakṣī jyotiṣmataḥ svargām̐l lokān anusaṃcareyam iti //
meaning: पक्षिभ्यां साग्निचित्याभ्यां यः कामयेत पक्षी ज्योतिष्मतः स्वर्गाम्̐ल् लोकान् अनुसंचरेयम् इति //
text_mt: With the two Pakṣin sacrifices accompanied by fire-altar piling, [one sacrifices] who desires: 'May I, possessing wings, traverse the luminous heavenly worlds.'

sanskrit_iast: ṛṣabheṇāgniṣṭomena rājanyaṃ vīryakāmam //
meaning: ऋषभेणाग्निष्टोमेन राजन्यं वीर्यकामम् //
text_mt: With the Ṛṣabha Agniṣṭoma [he sacrifices] for a nobleman desirous of vigor.

sanskrit_iast: ṛṣābho dakṣiṇā //
meaning: ऋषाभो दक्षिणा //

sanskrit_iast: gosavenokthyena bṛhadrathaṃtarasāmnā svārājyakāmaḥ //
meaning: गोसवेनोक्थ्येन बृहद्रथंतरसाम्ना स्वाराज्यकामः //
text_mt: One desirous of sovereignty [sacrifices] with the Gosava, an Ukthya having the Bṛhat and Rathaṃtara sāmans.

sanskrit_iast: ayutaṃ dakṣiṇā //
meaning: अयुतं दक्षिणा //

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇenāhavanīyam anuddhate vedyai pratidhuṣā māhendrastotraṃ pratyabhiṣicyate // revaj jātaḥ sahasā vṛddhaḥ \ kṣatrāṇāṃ kṣatrabhṛttamo vayodhāḥ / \ mahān mahitve tastabhānaḥ \ kṣatre rāṣṭre ca jāgṛhi / \ prajāpates tvā parameṣṭhinaḥ svārājyenābhiṣiñcāmi \\ iti //
meaning: दक्षिणेनाहवनीयम् अनुद्धते वेद्यै प्रतिधुषा माहेन्द्रस्तोत्रं प्रत्यभिषिच्यते // रेवज् जातः सहसा वृद्धः \ क्षत्राणां क्षत्रभृत्तमो वयोधाः / \ महान् महित्वे तस्तभानः \ क्षत्रे राष्ट्रे च जागृहि / \ प्रजापतेस् त्वा परमेष्ठिनः स्वाराज्येनाभिषिञ्चामि \\ इति //
text_mt: To the south of the āhavanīya fire, on [ground] not excavated for the altar, he is consecrated with fresh milk during the Māhendrastotra, with [the mantra]: 'Born wealthy, grown with force, greatest bearer of dominion among dominions, bestower of vitality, / great, established in greatness, be watchful over the dominion and realm! / With the sovereignty of Prajāpati Parameṣṭhin, I consecrate you!'

sanskrit_iast: gosaveneṣṭvā saṃvatsaraṃ dvādaśāhaṃ vā govrato bhavati //
meaning: गोसवेनेष्ट्वा संवत्सरं द्वादशाहं वा गोव्रतो भवति //
text_mt: Having sacrificed with the Gosava, he observes the vow of a bull for a year or for twelve days.

sanskrit_iast: upa mātaram iyād upa svasāram upa sagotrām upa nigāyodakaṃ pibati tṛṇāni vā cchinatti //
meaning: उप मातरम् इयाद् उप स्वसारम् उप सगोत्राम् उप निगायोदकं पिबति तृणानि वा च्छिनत्ति //
text_mt: He may approach his mother, he may approach his sister, he may approach a woman of the same gotra; bending down, he drinks water or crops grass.

sanskrit_iast: yatrayatrainaṃ viṣṭhā vindet tatratatra vitiṣṭhito 'pavagāhaṃ gaurīva siṣam //
meaning: यत्रयत्रैनं विष्ठा विन्देत् तत्रतत्र वितिष्ठितो ऽपवगाहं गौरीव सिषम् //
text_mt: Wherever the urge to defecate overtakes him, there he voids it, plunging in like a cow.

sanskrit_iast: marutām̐ stomenāparimitāṃ puṣṭiṃ puṣyati //
meaning: मरुताम्̐ स्तोमेनापरिमितां पुष्टिं पुष्यति //
text_mt: With the Marutstoma, he prospers with boundless prosperity.

sanskrit_iast: etena trīn yājayet //
meaning: एतेन त्रीन् याजयेत् //

sanskrit_iast: indrastomenokthyena rathaṃtarasāmnā bṛhatsāmnobhayasāmnā vā tena dvau yājayet //
meaning: इन्द्रस्तोमेनोक्थ्येन रथंतरसाम्ना बृहत्साम्नोभयसाम्ना वा तेन द्वौ याजयेत् //
text_mt: With the Indrastoma, an Ukthya having the Rathaṃtara sāman, having the Bṛhat sāman, or having both sāmans, he should cause two persons to sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: ṛṣabheṇāgniṣṭomena bṛhatsāmnā brāhmaṇo 'dhipatiḥ samānānāṃ bhavati //
meaning: ऋषभेणाग्निष्टोमेन बृहत्साम्ना ब्राह्मणो ऽधिपतिः समानानां भवति //
text_mt: With the Ṛṣabha Agniṣṭoma having the Bṛhat sāman, a Brahmin becomes the overlord of his equals.

sanskrit_iast: indrāgnyoḥ kulāyena rājapurohitāv ubhāv ekasyāṃ yājayet //
meaning: इन्द्राग्न्योः कुलायेन राजपुरोहिताव् उभाव् एकस्यां याजयेत् //
text_mt: With the Kulāya of Indra and Agni, he should cause both a king and his domestic priest to sacrifice on the same [rite].

sanskrit_iast: tejo brahmavarcasaṃ prāvaruddhyai viśam̐ rājā praviśati //
meaning: तेजो ब्रह्मवर्चसं प्रावरुद्ध्यै विशम्̐ राजा प्रविशति //
text_mt: In order to secure fiery energy and spiritual luster, the king enters the peasantry.

sanskrit_iast: vighanena vi pāpmānaṃ bhrātṛvyam̐ hate / tena sarvā mṛdho vihate //
meaning: विघनेन वि पाप्मानं भ्रातृव्यम्̐ हते / तेन सर्वा मृधो विहते //
text_mt: With the Vighana, he smites away evil and his rival; with it he smites away all foes.

sanskrit_iast: saṃdam̐śena bhrātṛvyavān vajreṇa ṣoḍaśinābhicarañ śyenena vyākhyātaḥ //
meaning: संदम्̐शेन भ्रातृव्यवान् वज्रेण षोडशिनाभिचरञ् श्येनेन व्याख्यातः //
text_mt: With the Saṃdaṃśa [sacrifices] one who has a rival; performing sorcery with the Vajra and Ṣoḍaśin, he is explained by [the procedure of] the Śyena.

sanskrit_iast: trayodaśarātras trirātro varddhikāmaḥ /
meaning: त्रयोदशरात्रस् त्रिरात्रो वर्द्धिकामः /
text_mt: One desirous of prosperity [performs] a thirteen-night [or] three-night [sacrifice].

sanskrit_iast: sarvastomena bubhūṣan //
meaning: सर्वस्तोमेन बुभूषन् //
text_mt: One wishing to thrive [sacrifices] with the Sarvastoma.

sanskrit_iast: aptoryāmeṇa paśukāmaḥ //
meaning: अप्तोर्यामेण पशुकामः //
text_mt: One desirous of cattle [sacrifices] with the Aptoryāma,

sanskrit_iast: yasmāt paśavaḥ prapreva bhram̐śerann iti //
meaning: यस्मात् पशवः प्रप्रेव भ्रम्̐शेरन्न् इति //
text_mt: from whom cattle might utterly slip away.

sanskrit_iast: ekādaśināḥ paśavo bhavanti //
meaning: एकादशिनाः पशवो भवन्ति //
text_mt: The animal victims are [offered] in a group of eleven.

sanskrit_iast: navasaptadaśena prajākāmaḥ //
meaning: नवसप्तदशेन प्रजाकामः //
text_mt: One desirous of offspring [sacrifices] with the Navasaptadaśa.

sanskrit_iast: viṣuvatā jyeṣṭho jyaiṣṭhineyo jyaiṣṭhyam āpnoti //
meaning: विषुवता ज्येष्ठो ज्यैष्ठिनेयो ज्यैष्ठ्यम् आप्नोति //
text_mt: By the Viṣuvant, an eldest son born of the senior wife attains supremacy.

sanskrit_iast: goṣṭomena bhrātṛvyavatā //
meaning: गोष्टोमेन भ्रातृव्यवता //
text_mt: By the Goṣṭoma, one who has a rival.

sanskrit_iast: āyuṣā svargakāmaḥ //
meaning: आयुषा स्वर्गकामः //

sanskrit_iast: abhijitā paśukāmaḥ //
meaning: अभिजिता पशुकामः //

sanskrit_iast: viśvajitā grāmakāmaḥ //
meaning: विश्वजिता ग्रामकामः //

sanskrit_iast: trivṛtā brahmavarcasakāmaḥ //
meaning: त्रिवृता ब्रह्मवर्चसकामः //
text_mt: One desirous of spiritual luster with the Trivṛt.

sanskrit_iast: pañcadaśena vīryakāmaḥ //
meaning: पञ्चदशेन वीर्यकामः //
text_mt: One desirous of vigor with the Pañcadaśa.

sanskrit_iast: saptadaśena prajākāmaḥ //
meaning: सप्तदशेन प्रजाकामः //
text_mt: One desirous of offspring with the Saptadaśa.

sanskrit_iast: ekavim̐śena pratiṣṭhākāmaḥ //
meaning: एकविम्̐शेन प्रतिष्ठाकामः //
text_mt: One desirous of firm standing with the Ekaviṃśa.

sanskrit_iast: dvirātraprabhṛtaya upariṣṭādatirātrā ahīnā ekādaśarātrāt //
meaning: द्विरात्रप्रभृतय उपरिष्टादतिरात्रा अहीना एकादशरात्रात् //
text_mt: The ahīna sacrifices beginning with the two-night rite up to the eleven-night rite have an Atirātra at the end.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ dvādaśāhenāhīnabhūtena kalpo vyākhyātaḥ //
meaning: तेषां द्वादशाहेनाहीनभूतेन कल्पो व्याख्यातः //
text_mt: Their ritual procedure is explained by the Dvādaśāha in its form as an ahīna.

sanskrit_iast: dvirātrasya trirātrasya catūrātrasya pañcarātrasya saptarātrasya navarātrasyottamam aindravāyavāgram / śukrāgraṃ vā //
meaning: द्विरात्रस्य त्रिरात्रस्य चतूरात्रस्य पञ्चरात्रस्य सप्तरात्रस्य नवरात्रस्योत्तमम् ऐन्द्रवायवाग्रम् / शुक्राग्रं वा //
text_mt: For the two-night rite, the three-night rite, the four-night rite, the five-night rite, the seven-night rite, and the nine-night rite, the last [day] has the Aindravāyava cup first, or the Śukra cup first.

sanskrit_iast: dvirātrasyottare 'han ṣoḍaśinaṃ gṛhṇāti //
meaning: द्विरात्रस्योत्तरे ऽहन् षोडशिनं गृह्णाति //
text_mt: On the second day of the two-night rite, he draws the Ṣoḍaśin cup.

sanskrit_iast: madhyame trirātrasya catūrātraprabhṛtiṣu nānāhīneṣu //
meaning: मध्यमे त्रिरात्रस्य चतूरात्रप्रभृतिषु नानाहीनेषु //
text_mt: On the middle [day] of the three-night rite; [and similarly] in the various ahīnas beginning with the four-night rite.

sanskrit_iast: āṅgirasena yaḥ puṇye 'hīna iva syāt sa etena yajeta //
meaning: आङ्गिरसेन यः पुण्ये ऽहीन इव स्यात् स एतेन यजेत //
text_mt: With the Āṅgirasa, one who is as if deficient in virtue should sacrifice with this.

sanskrit_iast: tasya jyotiṣṭomo 'gniṣṭomaḥ pūrvam ahar bhavati //
meaning: तस्य ज्योतिष्टोमो ऽग्निष्टोमः पूर्वम् अहर् भवति //
text_mt: Its first day is an Agniṣṭoma Jyotiṣṭoma.

sanskrit_iast: sarvastomo 'tirātra uttaram //
meaning: सर्वस्तोमो ऽतिरात्र उत्तरम् //
text_mt: The second is a Sarvastoma Atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: gāyatraṃ pūrve 'han sāma bhavati / traiṣṭubham uttare //
meaning: गायत्रं पूर्वे ऽहन् साम भवति / त्रैष्टुभम् उत्तरे //
text_mt: The sāman on the first day is in the gāyatrī metre; on the second, in the triṣṭubh metre.

sanskrit_iast: rathaṃtaraṃ pūrve 'han sāma bhavati //
meaning: रथंतरं पूर्वे ऽहन् साम भवति //
text_mt: The sāman on the first day is the Rathaṃtara;

sanskrit_iast: bṛhad uttare //
meaning: बृहद् उत्तरे //

sanskrit_iast: vaikhānasaṃ pūrve 'han sāma bhavati ṣoḍaśy uttare //
meaning: वैखानसं पूर्वे ऽहन् साम भवति षोडश्य् उत्तरे //
text_mt: The sāman on the first day is the Vaikhānasa; on the second, the Ṣoḍaśin.

sanskrit_iast: haviṣman nidhanaṃ pūrvam ahar bhavati / haviṣkṛn nidhanam uttaram //
meaning: हविष्मन् निधनं पूर्वम् अहर् भवति / हविष्कृन् निधनम् उत्तरम् //
text_mt: The first day has the word havis as its finale; the second day has the word haviṣkṛt as its finale.

sanskrit_iast: amāvāsyāyāṃ pūrvam ahar yajanīya uttaram //
meaning: अमावास्यायां पूर्वम् अहर् यजनीय उत्तरम् //
text_mt: The first day is on the new-moon day, the second on the day of sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: kāpivanena yaṃ kāmaṃ kāmayeta tametenābhyaśnute //
meaning: कापिवनेन यं कामं कामयेत तमेतेनाभ्यश्नुते //
text_mt: Whatever desire one may desire, one attains it through the Kāpivana rite.

sanskrit_iast: tasya jyotiṣṭomo 'gniṣṭomaḥ pūrvam ahar bhavati / atirātra uttaram //
meaning: तस्य ज्योतिष्टोमो ऽग्निष्टोमः पूर्वम् अहर् भवति / अतिरात्र उत्तरम् //
text_mt: Its first day is a Jyotiṣṭoma Agniṣṭoma; the second is an Atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: caitrarathena sarvam annādyam avarundhe //
meaning: चैत्ररथेन सर्वम् अन्नाद्यम् अवरुन्धे //
text_mt: Through the Caitraratha rite, one secures all edible food.

sanskrit_iast: tasya trivṛtpañcadaśo 'gniṣṭomaḥ pūrvam ahar āyuratirātra uttaram //
meaning: तस्य त्रिवृत्पञ्चदशो ऽग्निष्टोमः पूर्वम् अहर् आयुरतिरात्र उत्तरम् //
text_mt: Its first day is a Trivṛt-Pañcadaśa Agniṣṭoma; the second is an Āyus-Atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: gargatrirātreṇa vasūn rudrān ādityān abhyārohati //
meaning: गर्गत्रिरात्रेण वसून् रुद्रान् आदित्यान् अभ्यारोहति //
text_mt: Through the Garga three-day rite, one ascends to the Vasus, the Rudras, [and] the Ādityas.

sanskrit_iast: eṣu lokeṣu pratitiṣṭhati //
meaning: एषु लोकेषु प्रतितिष्ठति //
text_mt: One firmly establishes oneself in these worlds.

sanskrit_iast: agniṣṭoma ukthyo 'tirātras tryahāni rathaṃtaraṃ vāmadevyaṃ bṛhad iti pṛṣṭhāni //
meaning: अग्निष्टोम उक्थ्यो ऽतिरात्रस् त्र्यहानि रथंतरं वामदेव्यं बृहद् इति पृष्ठानि //
text_mt: The three days are an Agniṣṭoma, an Ukthya, [and] an Atirātra; the pṛṣṭha-stotras are the Rathaṃtara, the Vāmadevya, [and] the Bṛhat.

sanskrit_iast: āgnāvaiṣṇava ekādaśakapālaḥ sārasvataś carur bārhaspatyaś carur iti // dīkṣaṇīyā traidhātavīyā vā //
meaning: आग्नावैष्णव एकादशकपालः सारस्वतश् चरुर् बार्हस्पत्यश् चरुर् इति // दीक्षणीया त्रैधातवीया वा //
text_mt: The dīkṣaṇīyā rite consists of an eleven-potsherd cake to Agni-and-Viṣṇu, a pap to Sarasvatī, and a pap to Bṛhaspati, or it is the Traidhātavīyā.

sanskrit_iast: babhrur aruṇā rohiṇī piṅgākṣy ekahāyanī somakrayaṇī //
meaning: बभ्रुर् अरुणा रोहिणी पिङ्गाक्ष्य् एकहायनी सोमक्रयणी //
text_mt: The cow with which soma is purchased is brown, ruddy, red, yellow-eyed, and one year old.

sanskrit_iast: sahasraṃ dakṣiṇā prathame 'ham̐s trīṇi ca śatāni nayet / trayastrim̐śataṃ caivaṃ dvitīye tṛtīye ca sahasryātiricyate / dvirūpā rohiṇy ubhayataeny anyataenī vā //
meaning: सहस्रं दक्षिणा प्रथमे ऽहम्̐स् त्रीणि च शतानि नयेत् / त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शतं चैवं द्वितीये तृतीये च सहस्र्यातिरिच्यते / द्विरूपा रोहिण्य् उभयतएन्य् अन्यतएनी वा //
text_mt: On the first day, he should bring out three hundred and thirty-three as the sacrificial fee of a thousand; similarly on the second; and on the third, the thousandth cow is left over; [she is] of two colors, red, piebald on both sides, or piebald on one side.

sanskrit_iast: tāṃ prathame 'hani nayet / uttame vottamā //
meaning: तां प्रथमे ऽहनि नयेत् / उत्तमे वोत्तमा //
text_mt: He should bring her on the first day, or the best [cow] on the last [day].

sanskrit_iast: prathame 'hani deyas tvam agne sahasram ānaya \\ ud balasyābhi nas tvam / \ sa naḥ sahasram ānaya \ prajayā paśubhiḥ saha \ punar māviśatād rayir iti // ud bhṛṣṭis tam anumantrayate / vehad dvitīye tvam apām oṣadhīnām \\ rasena rasinī babhuditha / \ sā mā sahasra ābhaja \ prajayā paśubhiḥ saha \ punar mā viśatād rayir iti vehataṃ vāmanas tṛtīye pratiṣṭhāsi sahasrasya \ vaiṣṇavo vāmanas tvam / \ sa naḥ sahasram ādhehi \ prajayā paśubhiḥ saha \ punar mā viśatād rayir iti //
meaning: प्रथमे ऽहनि देयस् त्वम् अग्ने सहस्रम् आनय \\ उद् बलस्याभि नस् त्वम् / \ स नः सहस्रम् आनय \ प्रजया पशुभिः सह \ पुनर् माविशताद् रयिर् इति // उद् भृष्टिस् तम् अनुमन्त्रयते / वेहद् द्वितीये त्वम् अपाम् ओषधीनाम् \\ रसेन रसिनी बभुदिथ / \ सा मा सहस्र आभज \ प्रजया पशुभिः सह \ पुनर् मा विशताद् रयिर् इति वेहतं वामनस् तृतीये प्रतिष्ठासि सहस्रस्य \ वैष्णवो वामनस् त्वम् / \ स नः सहस्रम् आधेहि \ प्रजया पशुभिः सह \ पुनर् मा विशताद् रयिर् इति //
text_mt: To be given on the first day: with 'You, O Agni, bring a thousand; raise us above strength; do you bring us a thousand, together with offspring and cattle; may wealth enter into me again,' he consecrates a steer. On the second, a barren cow, with 'You have become juicy with the juice of waters and plants; as such, make me share in a thousand, together with offspring and cattle; may wealth enter into me again.' On the third, a dwarf, with 'You are the support of the thousand, you are a dwarf belonging to Viṣṇu; as such, place a thousand in us, together with offspring and cattle; may wealth enter into me again.'

sanskrit_iast: vāmanaṃ taṃ jyeṣṭhad yathainaṃ sahasram utsṛjati //
meaning: वामनं तं ज्येष्ठद् यथैनं सहस्रम् उत्सृजति //
text_mt: Just as he releases that eldest dwarf cow, so he releases the thousand.

sanskrit_iast: yat tenaikāṃ prativaraṃ pratyutsṛjeyus tādarkasahasrayājī punaḥ sahasraṃ prajāyate //
meaning: यत् तेनैकां प्रतिवरं प्रत्युत्सृजेयुस् तादर्कसहस्रयाजी पुनः सहस्रं प्रजायते //
text_mt: If by that they release one as an excellent choice, the sacrificer of such a thousand reproduces another thousand.

sanskrit_iast: tām uttareṇāgnīdhraṃ paryāṇīyāhavanīyasyānte droṇakalaśam avaghrāpayet //
meaning: ताम् उत्तरेणाग्नीध्रं पर्याणीयाहवनीयस्यान्ते द्रोणकलशम् अवघ्रापयेत् //
text_mt: Having led her around to the north of the āgnīdhra fire, he should make her smell the droṇakalaśa vessel near the āhavanīya fire.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇena vā vediṃ nītvāntarā yūpam āhavanīyaṃ cāvasthāpyāgnīdhrahavirdhānayor vā \\ ājighra kalaśam iti droṇakalaśam avaghrāpayet //
meaning: दक्षिणेन वा वेदिं नीत्वान्तरा यूपम् आहवनीयं चावस्थाप्याग्नीध्रहविर्धानयोर् वा \\ आजिघ्र कलशम् इति द्रोणकलशम् अवघ्रापयेत् //
text_mt: Or having led her south of the vedi and having made her stand between the sacrificial post and the āhavanīya fire, or between the āgnīdhra fire and the havirdhāna shed, he should make her smell the droṇakalaśa vessel with the mantra, 'Smell the cup.'

sanskrit_iast: udīcīm āgnīdhram ānīya tasyāṃ tārpyam adhyasya purastāt pratīcyāṃ tiṣṭhantyām ubhā jigyathur iti āgnīdhre juhoti / tasmim̐s tārpye 'dhiṣṇiyānāṃ rūpaṃ vigrathitaṃ bhavati //
meaning: उदीचीम् आग्नीध्रम् आनीय तस्यां तार्प्यम् अध्यस्य पुरस्तात् प्रतीच्यां तिष्ठन्त्याम् उभा जिग्यथुर् इति आग्नीध्रे जुहोति / तस्मिम्̐स् तार्प्ये ऽधिष्णियानां रूपं विग्रथितं भवति //
text_mt: Having brought her northwards to the āgnīdhra fire and placed a silken garment upon her, while she stands facing west in the east, he offers an oblation into the āgnīdhra fire with 'You both have conquered'; upon that silken garment the form of the dhiṣṇya hearths is woven.

sanskrit_iast: pratīcīm̐ sadasaḥ sraktim ānīya \\ iḍe rante \\ iti tasyā dakṣiṇe karṇe japati //
meaning: प्रतीचीम्̐ सदसः स्रक्तिम् आनीय \\ इडे रन्ते \\ इति तस्या दक्षिणे कर्णे जपति //
text_mt: Having led her westward to the corner of the sadas, he whispers into her right ear: 'O Iḍā, O Rantā…'

sanskrit_iast: tām utsṛjya vijñānam upaiti yady apuruṣābhivītā prācīyād arātsīd ayaṃ yajamānaḥ // kalyāṇaṃ lokam ajaiṣīd iti vidyāt / yadi dakṣiṇā kṣipre 'smāl lokāt preṣyatīti vidyāt / yadi pratīcī bahudhānyo bhaviṣyatīti vidyāt / yady udīcī śreyān asmim̐l loke bhaviṣyatīti vidyāt //
meaning: ताम् उत्सृज्य विज्ञानम् उपैति यद्य् अपुरुषाभिवीता प्राचीयाद् अरात्सीद् अयं यजमानः // कल्याणं लोकम् अजैषीद् इति विद्यात् / यदि दक्षिणा क्षिप्रे ऽस्माल् लोकात् प्रेष्यतीति विद्यात् / यदि प्रतीची बहुधान्यो भविष्यतीति विद्यात् / यद्य् उदीची श्रेयान् अस्मिम्̐ल् लोके भविष्यतीति विद्यात् //
text_mt: Having released her, he obtains an omen: if, without being guided by a man, she goes eastward, one should know, 'This sacrificer has prospered; he has conquered a good world'; if southward, one should know, 'He will soon depart from this world'; if westward, one should know, 'He will have abundant grain'; if northward, one should know, 'He will become better off in this world.'

sanskrit_iast: tām agnīdhe vā brahmaṇe vā hotre vādhvaryave vā dadyāt //
meaning: ताम् अग्नीधे वा ब्रह्मणे वा होत्रे वाध्वर्यवे वा दद्यात् //
text_mt: He should give her to the āgnīdhra, or to the brahman, or to the hotṛ, or to the adhvaryu.

sanskrit_iast: dvau vodgātārau kurvīta yataro nāśrāvayet tasmai dadyāt / dve vā tṛtīye brahmaṇe dadyāt / tṛtīyam agnīdhe //
meaning: द्वौ वोद्गातारौ कुर्वीत यतरो नाश्रावयेत् तस्मै दद्यात् / द्वे वा तृतीये ब्रह्मणे दद्यात् / तृतीयम् अग्नीधे //
text_mt: Or he should appoint two udgātṛs: whichever does not chant the prelude, to him he should give her; or he should give two thirds to the brahman and the third to the āgnīdhra.

sanskrit_iast: sā mā suvargaṃ lokaṃ gamaya \ sā mā jyotiṣmantaṃ lokaṃ gamaya \ sā mā sarvān puṇyām̐l lokān gamaya \ sā mā pratiṣṭhāṃ gamaya \ prajayā paśubhiḥ saha \ punar mā viśatād rayir ity abhimantrya dadātīti //
meaning: सा मा सुवर्गं लोकं गमय \ सा मा ज्योतिष्मन्तं लोकं गमय \ सा मा सर्वान् पुण्याम्̐ल् लोकान् गमय \ सा मा प्रतिष्ठां गमय \ प्रजया पशुभिः सह \ पुनर् मा विशताद् रयिर् इत्य् अभिमन्त्र्य ददातीति //
text_mt: Addressing [her] with 'Make me go to the heavenly world; make me go to the world of light; make me go to all holy worlds; make me go to stability, together with offspring and cattle; may wealth enter into me again,' he gives her.

sanskrit_iast: tāṃ pratigṛhṇīyāt \\ ekāsi na sahasram ekāṃ tvāṃ bhūtāṃ pratigṛhṇāmi na sahasram ekā mā bhūtāviśa mā sahasram \\ syonāsi suṣadā suśevā \ syonā māviśa \ suṣadā māviśa \ suśevā māviśa \\ iti //
meaning: तां प्रतिगृह्णीयात् \\ एकासि न सहस्रम् एकां त्वां भूतां प्रतिगृह्णामि न सहस्रम् एका मा भूताविश मा सहस्रम् \\ स्योनासि सुषदा सुशेवा \ स्योना माविश \ सुषदा माविश \ सुशेवा माविश \\ इति //
text_mt: He should accept her with: 'You are one, not a thousand; I accept you who have become one, not a thousand; having become one, enter into me, not a thousand; you are pleasant, easy to sit upon, very gracious; enter into me pleasant; enter into me easy to sit upon; enter into me very gracious.'

sanskrit_iast: tām anyayā gavā niṣkrīya yajamānasya goṣṭheṣv apisṛjati //
meaning: ताम् अन्यया गवा निष्क्रीय यजमानस्य गोष्ठेष्व् अपिसृजति //
text_mt: Having ransomed her with another cow, he releases her into the sacrificer's cow-pens.

sanskrit_iast: yās tisras trim̐śaty adhi tām upasamāhṛtya daśa prathame 'hany āśire duhanti / vim̐śatiṃ dvitīye trim̐śataṃ tṛtīye //
meaning: यास् तिस्रस् त्रिम्̐शत्य् अधि ताम् उपसमाहृत्य दश प्रथमे ऽहन्य् आशिरे दुहन्ति / विम्̐शतिं द्वितीये त्रिम्̐शतं तृतीये //
text_mt: Having brought near the thirty-three [cows], they milk ten for the milk mixture on the first day, twenty on the second, and thirty on the third.

sanskrit_iast: kṛtānnaṃ prathame 'hani deyam / hiraṇyaṃ gaur vāsa iti dvitīye / ano ratho 'śvo hastī puruṣa iti tṛtīye //
meaning: कृतान्नं प्रथमे ऽहनि देयम् / हिरण्यं गौर् वास इति द्वितीये / अनो रथो ऽश्वो हस्ती पुरुष इति तृतीये //
text_mt: Cooked food is to be given on the first day; gold, a cow, and clothing on the second; a cart, a chariot, a horse, an elephant, and a slave on the third.

sanskrit_iast: ya ārṣeyo vidvām̐s tasmai prathame 'hani dadyāt / yo 'nārṣeyo vidvām̐s tasmai dvitīye / ya ārṣeyo 'vidvām̐s tasmai tṛtīye /
meaning: य आर्षेयो विद्वाम्̐स् तस्मै प्रथमे ऽहनि दद्यात् / यो ऽनार्षेयो विद्वाम्̐स् तस्मै द्वितीये / य आर्षेयो ऽविद्वाम्̐स् तस्मै तृतीये /
text_mt: He should give to one who is of ṛṣi descent and learned on the first day; to one who is not of ṛṣi descent and learned on the second; to one who is of ṛṣi descent and unlearned on the third.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇā nayan nyūnā daśato nayed yasmā ekāṃ gāṃ ditset trayodaśabhyo daśatam upasamākuryād yasmai pañcabhyas tebhyo daśataṃ yasmai tisras tribhyas tebhyo daśatam anekasmai vaikāṃ yasmai pañca dvābhyāṃ tābhyāṃ daśatam evam ā śatād ā vā sahasrāt sahasreti kiṃcid dadyāt //
meaning: दक्षिणा नयन् न्यूना दशतो नयेद् यस्मा एकां गां दित्सेत् त्रयोदशभ्यो दशतम् उपसमाकुर्याद् यस्मै पञ्चभ्यस् तेभ्यो दशतं यस्मै तिस्रस् त्रिभ्यस् तेभ्यो दशतम् अनेकस्मै वैकां यस्मै पञ्च द्वाभ्यां ताभ्यां दशतम् एवम् आ शताद् आ वा सहस्रात् सहस्रेति किंचिद् दद्यात् //
text_mt: When leading the sacrificial fees, he should lead them in groups deficient from ten: to whom he intends to give one cow, he should add ten from thirteen; to whom five, a decade to them; to whom three, a decade to the three; or one to many; to whom five, a decade to the two; thus up to a hundred or up to a thousand, he should give something of the thousand.

sanskrit_iast: yadi dadyād anūbandhyāvapāyām̐ hutāyāṃ dadyād udavasānīyāyāṃ veṣṭvottamāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ nītvodavasāya vā //
meaning: यदि दद्याद् अनूबन्ध्यावपायाम्̐ हुतायां दद्याद् उदवसानीयायां वेष्ट्वोत्तमां दक्षिणां नीत्वोदवसाय वा //
text_mt: If he should give [it], he should give it when the omentum of the anūbandhyā cow has been offered, or having sacrificed in the udavasānīyā rite, having led the final dakṣiṇā, or having departed.

sanskrit_iast: śabali samudro 'si viśvavyacās \\ brahmā devānāṃ prathamajā ṛtasya \\ annam asi \ śukram asi \ jyotir asi \ tejo 'si \\ amṛtam asi \ tāṃ tvā vidma śabali dīdyānām \\ tasyās te pṛthivī pādo 'ntarikṣaṃ pādo dyauḥ pādaḥ samudraḥ pādaḥ \ parorajās te pañcamaḥ pādas \\ eṣāsi śabaliḥ sā na iṣam ūrjaṃ dhukṣva vasor dhārām \\ śabali prajātām̐ śraviṣṭhāvratam upageṣam̐ svāhā \\ iti śabalihomaṃ juhoti //
meaning: शबलि समुद्रो ऽसि विश्वव्यचास् \\ ब्रह्मा देवानां प्रथमजा ऋतस्य \\ अन्नम् असि \ शुक्रम् असि \ ज्योतिर् असि \ तेजो ऽसि \\ अमृतम् असि \ तां त्वा विद्म शबलि दीद्यानाम् \\ तस्यास् ते पृथिवी पादो ऽन्तरिक्षं पादो द्यौः पादः समुद्रः पादः \ परोरजास् ते पञ्चमः पादस् \\ एषासि शबलिः सा न इषम् ऊर्जं धुक्ष्व वसोर् धाराम् \\ शबलि प्रजाताम्̐ श्रविष्ठाव्रतम् उपगेषम्̐ स्वाहा \\ इति शबलिहोमं जुहोति //
text_mt: He offers the Śabalī offering with: 'O Śabalī, you are the ocean, all-encompassing; the priest of the gods, the first-born of truth; you are food; you are light; you are radiance; you are power; you are immortality; as such we know you, O shining Śabalī; the earth is your foot, the atmosphere your foot, the sky your foot, the ocean your foot; beyond the realm of light is your fifth foot; such you are, O Śabalī; do you yield us food, strength, a stream of wealth; O Śabalī, born to the vow of Śraviṣṭhā, may I approach [you], svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: nityaḥ kāmyo vā //
meaning: नित्यः काम्यो वा //

sanskrit_iast: baidatrirātreṇa yo rājyam āśam̐samāno na labheta sa etena yajeta //
meaning: बैदत्रिरात्रेण यो राज्यम् आशम्̐समानो न लभेत स एतेन यजेत //
text_mt: One who, hoping for kingship, does not obtain it, should sacrifice with the Baida three-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: tasya trayas trivṛto 'tirātrāḥ sarve ṣoḍaśimanto rathaṃtaraṃ vāmadevyaṃ bṛhad iti pṛṣṭhāni gargatrirātreṇottareṣāṃ trayāṇām ahāni vyākhyātāni //
meaning: तस्य त्रयस् त्रिवृतो ऽतिरात्राः सर्वे षोडशिमन्तो रथंतरं वामदेव्यं बृहद् इति पृष्ठानि गर्गत्रिरात्रेणोत्तरेषां त्रयाणाम् अहानि व्याख्यातानि //
text_mt: Its [days] are three Trivṛt Atirātras, all having the Ṣoḍaśin cup; the pṛṣṭha-stotras are the Rathaṃtara, the Vāmadevya, [and] the Bṛhat; the days of the subsequent three rites are explained by the Garga three-day rite.

sanskrit_iast: chandomapavamānena paśukāmaḥ //
meaning: छन्दोमपवमानेन पशुकामः //
text_mt: One desirous of cattle [sacrifices] with the Chandomapavamāna rite.

sanskrit_iast: antarvasūnāṃ paśūn āpnoti //
meaning: अन्तर्वसूनां पशून् आप्नोति //
text_mt: He obtains cattle among the wealthy.

sanskrit_iast: parākeṇa svargakāmaḥ //
meaning: पराकेण स्वर्गकामः //

sanskrit_iast: atreś caturvim̐śaś catūrātraś catvāro 'sya vīrā ājāyante suhotā sūdgātā svadhvaryuḥ susabheyaḥ //
meaning: अत्रेश् चतुर्विम्̐शश् चतूरात्रश् चत्वारो ऽस्य वीरा आजायन्ते सुहोता सूद्गाता स्वध्वर्युः सुसभेयः //
text_mt: The four-day rite of Atri is twenty-four-fold; four heroes are born to him: a good hotṛ, a good udgātṛ, a good adhvaryu, and a good member of the assembly.

sanskrit_iast: agniṣṭomaḥ prathamam ahaḥ //
meaning: अग्निष्टोमः प्रथमम् अहः //
text_mt: The first day is an Agniṣṭoma.

sanskrit_iast: ukthyo madhyamo 'tirātraś caturvim̐śāḥ pavamānā udyantastomā evam itareṣāṃ trayāṇām ahāni vyākhyātāni //
meaning: उक्थ्यो मध्यमो ऽतिरात्रश् चतुर्विम्̐शाः पवमाना उद्यन्तस्तोमा एवम् इतरेषां त्रयाणाम् अहानि व्याख्यातानि //
text_mt: The middle day is an Ukthya; the [last is an] Atirātra; the pavamāna-stotras are twenty-four-fold, with rising stomas; thus the days of the other three rites are explained.

sanskrit_iast: jāmadagnyena / pūrvān poṣān puṣyanti //
meaning: जामदग्न्येन / पूर्वान् पोषान् पुष्यन्ति //
text_mt: By means of the [rite] of Jamadagni, they foster their former prosperities.

sanskrit_iast: puroḍāśinya upasado bhavanti / āgneya ekakapāla āśvino dvikapālo vaiṣṇavas trikapālaḥ saumyaś catuṣkapālaḥ / sāvitraḥ pañcakapālaḥ / dhātraḥ ṣaṭkapālaḥ / mārutaḥ saptakapālaḥ / bārhaspatyo 'ṣṭākapālaḥ / maitro navakapālaḥ / vāruṇo daśakapālaḥ aindra ekādaśakapālaḥ / vaiśvadevo dvādaśakapālaḥ //
meaning: पुरोडाशिन्य उपसदो भवन्ति / आग्नेय एककपाल आश्विनो द्विकपालो वैष्णवस् त्रिकपालः सौम्यश् चतुष्कपालः / सावित्रः पञ्चकपालः / धात्रः षट्कपालः / मारुतः सप्तकपालः / बार्हस्पत्यो ऽष्टाकपालः / मैत्रो नवकपालः / वारुणो दशकपालः ऐन्द्र एकादशकपालः / वैश्वदेवो द्वादशकपालः //
text_mt: The upasad days have cake offerings: [a cake] on one potsherd for Agni, on two potsherds for the Aśvins, on three potsherds for Viṣṇu, on four potsherds for Soma, on five potsherds for Savitṛ, on six potsherds for Dhātṛ, on seven potsherds for the Maruts, on eight potsherds for Bṛhaspati, on nine potsherds for Mitra, on ten potsherds for Varuṇa, on eleven potsherds for Indra, [and] on twelve potsherds for the Viśvedevas.

sanskrit_iast: darvihomā bhavanti / agne ver hotraṃ ver adhvaram \ ā pitaraṃ vaiśvānaram avase 'kar \ indrāya devebhyo juṣatām̐ haviḥ svāhā /
meaning: दर्विहोमा भवन्ति / अग्ने वेर् होत्रं वेर् अध्वरम् \ आ पितरं वैश्वानरम् अवसे ऽकर् \ इन्द्राय देवेभ्यो जुषताम्̐ हविः स्वाहा /
text_mt: There are ladle-offerings: 'O Agni, accept the hotṛ's office, accept the solemn rite; you have brought Father Vaiśvānara for help. May he accept the oblation for Indra [and] for the gods, svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: devāv aśvinā madhukaśayādyāsmi yajñaṃ yajamānāya mimikṣatam /
meaning: देवाव् अश्विना मधुकशयाद्यास्मि यज्ञं यजमानाय मिमिक्षतम् /
text_mt: 'O divine Aśvins, with your honey-whip sprinkle today this sacrifice for the sacrificer!'

sanskrit_iast: deva viṣṇav urv adyemaṃ yajñaṃ yajamānāyānuvikramasva /
meaning: देव विष्णव् उर्व् अद्येमं यज्ञं यजमानायानुविक्रमस्व /
text_mt: 'O divine Viṣṇu, stride widely today through this sacrifice for the sacrificer!'

sanskrit_iast: deva soma retodhā adyāsmin yajñe yajamānāyaidhi /
meaning: देव सोम रेतोधा अद्यास्मिन् यज्ञे यजमानायैधि /
text_mt: 'O divine Soma, be the placer of seed today in this sacrifice for the sacrificer!'

sanskrit_iast: deva savitaḥ suṣāvitram adyāsmin yajñe yajamānāyānusuvasva /
meaning: देव सवितः सुषावित्रम् अद्यास्मिन् यज्ञे यजमानायानुसुवस्व /
text_mt: 'O divine Savitṛ, impel good impulsion today in this sacrifice for the sacrificer!'

sanskrit_iast: deva dhātaḥ sudhātādyāsmin yajñe yajamānāyaidhi /
meaning: देव धातः सुधाताद्यास्मिन् यज्ञे यजमानायैधि /
text_mt: 'O divine Dhātṛ, be a good supporter today in this sacrifice for the sacrificer!'

sanskrit_iast: devā grāvāṇo madhumatīm adyāsmin yajñe yajamānāya vācaṃ vadata /
meaning: देवा ग्रावाणो मधुमतीम् अद्यास्मिन् यज्ञे यजमानाय वाचं वदत /
text_mt: 'O divine pressing-stones, speak today honeyed speech in this sacrifice for the sacrificer!'

sanskrit_iast: devy adite 'nv adyemaṃ yajñaṃ yajamānāyaidhi /
meaning: देव्य् अदिते ऽन्व् अद्येमं यज्ञं यजमानायैधि /
text_mt: 'O divine Aditi, favour today this sacrifice for the sacrificer!'

sanskrit_iast: devy adite svādityam adyāsmin yajñe yajamānāya sunavasva /
meaning: देव्य् अदिते स्वादित्यम् अद्यास्मिन् यज्ञे यजमानाय सुनवस्व /
text_mt: 'O divine Aditi, give good sun-impulsion today in this sacrifice for the sacrificer!'

sanskrit_iast: devy anumate 'nv adyemaṃ yajñaṃ yajamānāya manyasva /
meaning: देव्य् अनुमते ऽन्व् अद्येमं यज्ञं यजमानाय मन्यस्व /
text_mt: 'O divine Anumati, approve today this sacrifice for the sacrificer!'

sanskrit_iast: divyā āpo 'tra namyadhvam adyāsmin yajñe yajamānāya /
meaning: दिव्या आपो ऽत्र नम्यध्वम् अद्यास्मिन् यज्ञे यजमानाय /
text_mt: 'O divine waters, yield here today in this sacrifice for the sacrificer!'

sanskrit_iast: sadaḥsadaḥ prajāvān ṛbhur juṣāṇaḥ /
meaning: सदःसदः प्रजावान् ऋभुर् जुषाणः /
text_mt: 'Occupying every seat, possessing offspring, may the Ṛbhu be pleased!'

sanskrit_iast: devendrendriyam adyāsmin yajñe yajamānāyaidhi /
meaning: देवेन्द्रेन्द्रियम् अद्यास्मिन् यज्ञे यजमानायैधि /
text_mt: 'O divine Indra, be [the source of] virility today in this sacrifice for the sacrificer!'

sanskrit_iast: deva tvaṣṭaḥ suretodhā adyāsmin yajñe yajamānāyaidhi /
meaning: देव त्वष्टः सुरेतोधा अद्यास्मिन् यज्ञे यजमानायैधि /
text_mt: 'O divine Tvaṣṭṛ, be the placer of good seed today in this sacrifice for the sacrificer!'

sanskrit_iast: iti pratinigadya homāḥ / indrāya devebhyo juṣatām̐ haviḥ svāhā \\ iti sarvatrānuṣajati //
meaning: इति प्रतिनिगद्य होमाः / इन्द्राय देवेभ्यो जुषताम्̐ हविः स्वाहा \\ इति सर्वत्रानुषजति //
text_mt: These offerings are made after reciting each [formula]. To all of them he appends: 'May he accept the oblation for Indra [and] for the gods, svāhā!'

sanskrit_iast: vasiṣṭhasya sam̐sarpaḥ / yaḥ puṇyo 'hīna iva syāt sa etena yajeta //
meaning: वसिष्ठस्य सम्̐सर्पः / यः पुण्यो ऽहीन इव स्यात् स एतेन यजेत //
text_mt: The Saṃsarpa [rite] of Vasiṣṭha: one who is virtuous but feels as if he were waning should sacrifice with this.

sanskrit_iast: viśvāmitrasya saṃjayo bhrātṛvyavān yajeta //
meaning: विश्वामित्रस्य संजयो भ्रातृव्यवान् यजेत //
text_mt: The Saṃjaya [rite] of Viśvāmitra: one who has rivals should sacrifice [with this].

sanskrit_iast: saṃvatsarasya pañcāhena praiva jāyate //
meaning: संवत्सरस्य पञ्चाहेन प्रैव जायते //
text_mt: By means of the five-day rite of the year, he indeed procreates.

sanskrit_iast: pra sahasraṃ paśūn āpnoti //
meaning: प्र सहस्रं पशून् आप्नोति //
text_mt: He attains a thousand cattle.

sanskrit_iast: vācaḥ pravaditā bhavati //
meaning: वाचः प्रवदिता भवति //
text_mt: He becomes an eloquent speaker of speech.

sanskrit_iast: trivṛd agniṣṭomaḥ pañcadaśa ukthyaḥ / sapatadaśa ukthyaḥ / pañcavim̐śo 'gniṣṭomo mahāvratavān //
meaning: त्रिवृद् अग्निष्टोमः पञ्चदश उक्थ्यः / सपतदश उक्थ्यः / पञ्चविम्̐शो ऽग्निष्टोमो महाव्रतवान् //
text_mt: A Trivṛt Agniṣṭoma, a Pañcadaśa Ukthya, a Saptadaśa Ukthya, a Pañcaviṃśa Agniṣṭoma possessing the Mahāvrata,

sanskrit_iast: viśvajit sarvapṛṣṭho 'tirātraḥ //
meaning: विश्वजित् सर्वपृष्ठो ऽतिरात्रः //
text_mt: [and] an all-pṛṣṭha Viśvajit Atirātra [make up the five days].

sanskrit_iast: abhyāsaṅgyena //
meaning: अभ्यासङ्ग्येन //

sanskrit_iast: yaṃ kāmaṃ kāmayate tam abhyaśnute 'gniṣṭomas traya utkhyo 'tirātraḥ / trivṛtī dve savane pañcadaśam ekaṃ pañcadaśe dve savane saptadaśam ekam̐ saptadaśe dve savane ekavim̐śam ekam ekavim̐śe dve savane triṇavam ekaṃ triṇave dve savane trayastrim̐śam anyam //
meaning: यं कामं कामयते तम् अभ्यश्नुते ऽग्निष्टोमस् त्रय उत्ख्यो ऽतिरात्रः / त्रिवृती द्वे सवने पञ्चदशम् एकं पञ्चदशे द्वे सवने सप्तदशम् एकम्̐ सप्तदशे द्वे सवने एकविम्̐शम् एकम् एकविम्̐शे द्वे सवने त्रिणवम् एकं त्रिणवे द्वे सवने त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शम् अन्यम् //
text_mt: he attains whatever desire he desires. [It consists of] an Agniṣṭoma, three Ukthyas, and an Atirātra: two Trivṛt pressings and one Pañcadaśa; two Pañcadaśa pressings and one Saptadaśa; two Saptadaśa pressings and one Ekaviṃśa; two Ekaviṃśa pressings and one Triṇava; two Triṇava pressings and the other a Trayastriṃśa.

sanskrit_iast: pañcaśāradīyena bahor bhūyān bhavati //
meaning: पञ्चशारदीयेन बहोर् भूयान् भवति //
text_mt: By means of the Pañcaśāradīya [rite], one becomes greater than the great.

sanskrit_iast: anusaṃvatsaraṃ paśubandhena yajeta //
meaning: अनुसंवत्सरं पशुबन्धेन यजेत //
text_mt: Year after year he should sacrifice with an animal sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: saptadaśa pṛśnīr ukṣṇaḥ pañcavarṣān ānayanti saptadaśa pṛśnīr vatsatarīs trivatsā apravītāḥ //
meaning: सप्तदश पृश्नीर् उक्ष्णः पञ्चवर्षान् आनयन्ति सप्तदश पृश्नीर् वत्सतरीस् त्रिवत्सा अप्रवीताः //
text_mt: They bring seventeen dapple bulls, five years old, and seventeen dapple heifers, three years old, that have not been covered.

sanskrit_iast: tān prokṣitān paryagnikṛtān itarān ālabhante //
meaning: तान् प्रोक्षितान् पर्यग्निकृतान् इतरान् आलभन्ते //
text_mt: When they have been sprinkled and fire has been carried around them, they immolate the other ones;

sanskrit_iast: itarān utsṛjanti //
meaning: इतरान् उत्सृजन्ति //

sanskrit_iast: tataḥ saṃvatsare navanītapṛśnīr aruṇā ānayantītarām̐ś caivokṣṇas tān prokṣitān paryagnikṛtān itarān ālabhante / pretarān sṛjanti //
meaning: ततः संवत्सरे नवनीतपृश्नीर् अरुणा आनयन्तीतराम्̐श् चैवोक्ष्णस् तान् प्रोक्षितान् पर्यग्निकृतान् इतरान् आलभन्ते / प्रेतरान् सृजन्ति //
text_mt: Then, in the [next] year, they bring butter-dappled reddish [heifers] and the other bulls; when they have been sprinkled and fire has been carried around them, they immolate the other ones [and] release the others.

sanskrit_iast: tataḥ saṃvatsare piśaṅgīḥ sāraṅgīr ānayanti / tām̐ś caivokṣṇas tān prokṣitān paryagnikṛtān itarān ālabhante / pretarān sṛjanti //
meaning: ततः संवत्सरे पिशङ्गीः सारङ्गीर् आनयन्ति / ताम्̐श् चैवोक्ष्णस् तान् प्रोक्षितान् पर्यग्निकृतान् इतरान् आलभन्ते / प्रेतरान् सृजन्ति //
text_mt: Then, in the [next] year, they bring reddish-brown spotted [heifers] and the bulls; when they have been sprinkled and fire has been carried around them, they immolate the other ones [and] release the others.

sanskrit_iast: tataḥ saṃvatsare rājīvā ānayanti / tām̐ś caivokṣṇas tān prokṣitān paryagnikṛtān itarān ālabhante / pretarān sṛjanti //
meaning: ततः संवत्सरे राजीवा आनयन्ति / ताम्̐श् चैवोक्ष्णस् तान् प्रोक्षितान् पर्यग्निकृतान् इतरान् आलभन्ते / प्रेतरान् सृजन्ति //
text_mt: Then, in the [next] year, they bring striped [heifers] and the bulls; when they have been sprinkled and fire has been carried around them, they immolate the other ones [and] release the others.

sanskrit_iast: pañcame varṣe somā bhavanti / trivṛd agniṣṭomaḥ / pañcadaśa ukthyaḥ / saptadaśa ukthyaḥ / pañcadaśo 'gniṣṭomaḥ / saptadaśo 'tirātraḥ / pūrvāṃ paurṇamāsīm utthānam̐ saṃpādayed eta ukṣāṇaḥ savanīyā bhavanti / ajo 'gnīṣomīyo 'nvaham̐s trīm̐strīn ālabhate evam evottareṇaindramārutā ukṣāṇo mārutyo vatsataryaḥ //
meaning: पञ्चमे वर्षे सोमा भवन्ति / त्रिवृद् अग्निष्टोमः / पञ्चदश उक्थ्यः / सप्तदश उक्थ्यः / पञ्चदशो ऽग्निष्टोमः / सप्तदशो ऽतिरात्रः / पूर्वां पौर्णमासीम् उत्थानम्̐ संपादयेद् एत उक्षाणः सवनीया भवन्ति / अजो ऽग्नीषोमीयो ऽन्वहम्̐स् त्रीम्̐स्त्रीन् आलभते एवम् एवोत्तरेणैन्द्रमारुता उक्षाणो मारुत्यो वत्सतर्यः //
text_mt: In the fifth year the soma days take place: a Trivṛt Agniṣṭoma, a Pañcadaśa Ukthya, a Saptadaśa Ukthya, a Pañcadaśa Agniṣṭoma, [and] a Saptadaśa Atirātra. He should arrange the conclusion on the first full-moon day. These oxen become the pressing animals. The victim dedicated to Agni and Soma is a he-goat; day after day he immolates three [oxen] each; in the very same way, next, the oxen are for Indra and the Maruts, and the heifers are for the Maruts.

sanskrit_iast: yady ukṣṇo rudro 'bhimanyetāgnaye rudravate puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālaṃ nirupyāthānyam upākuryāt / yady apsu mriyetāponaptrīyaṃ carum / yady avasīden nairṛtaṃ carum / yadi sam̐śīryeta bhaumam ekakapālam / yadi śvabhraṃ pated vaiṣṇavaṃ trikapālam / yadi śloṇaḥ kūṭo vā bārhaspatyaṃ carum / yady andhaḥ kāṇo vā sauryam ekakapālam / yadi prasahānayeyur indrāya prasahvana ekādaśakapālam / yadi senāyā abhītvarīṃ vindec chārdūlo vā hanyād indrāya yajata ekādaśakapālam / yadi naśyed vāyavyaṃ carum / yady annena mṛtyunā prājāpatyaṃ dvādaśakapālam //
meaning: यद्य् उक्ष्णो रुद्रो ऽभिमन्येताग्नये रुद्रवते पुरोडाशम् अष्टाकपालं निरुप्याथान्यम् उपाकुर्यात् / यद्य् अप्सु म्रियेतापोनप्त्रीयं चरुम् / यद्य् अवसीदेन् नैरृतं चरुम् / यदि सम्̐शीर्येत भौमम् एककपालम् / यदि श्वभ्रं पतेद् वैष्णवं त्रिकपालम् / यदि श्लोणः कूटो वा बार्हस्पत्यं चरुम् / यद्य् अन्धः काणो वा सौर्यम् एककपालम् / यदि प्रसहानयेयुर् इन्द्राय प्रसह्वन एकादशकपालम् / यदि सेनाया अभीत्वरीं विन्देच् छार्दूलो वा हन्याद् इन्द्राय यजत एकादशकपालम् / यदि नश्येद् वायव्यं चरुम् / यद्य् अन्नेन मृत्युना प्राजापत्यं द्वादशकपालम् //
text_mt: If Rudra should afflict an ox, he should assign a cake on eight potsherds to Agni with Rudra and then dedicate another. If it should die in water, a mess of boiled rice for Apāṃ Napāt; if it should collapse, a mess of boiled rice for Nirṛti; if it should be crushed, [a cake] on one potsherd for the Earth; if it should fall into a pit, [a cake] on three potsherds for Viṣṇu; if it is lame or hornless, a mess of boiled rice for Bṛhaspati; if it is blind or one-eyed, [a cake] on one potsherd for Sūrya; if they carry it off by force, [a cake] on eleven potsherds for Indra the Forceful; if an attacking army finds it or a tiger kills it, [a cake] on eleven potsherds for Indra the Worshipful; if it is lost, a mess of boiled rice for Vāyu; if it dies by natural death, [a cake] on twelve potsherds for Prajāpati.

sanskrit_iast: mahāvrate spardhamānas trivṛd agniṣṭomaḥ / gaur ukthyo mahāvrataṃ gaur ukthya āyur atirātraḥ //
meaning: महाव्रते स्पर्धमानस् त्रिवृद् अग्निष्टोमः / गौर् उक्थ्यो महाव्रतं गौर् उक्थ्य आयुर् अतिरात्रः //
text_mt: One striving for the Mahāvrata [performs]: a Trivṛt Agniṣṭoma, a Go Ukthya, a Mahāvrata, a Go Ukthya, [and] an Āyus Atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: sādhyānām̐ ṣaḍahena suvargakāmaḥ //
meaning: साध्यानाम्̐ षडहेन सुवर्गकामः //
text_mt: One desiring heaven [sacrifices] with the six-day rite of the Sādhyas.

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍahaḥ //
meaning: पृष्ठ्यः षडहः //

sanskrit_iast: bṛhadrathaṃtarābhyāṃ yanti //
meaning: बृहद्रथंतराभ्यां यन्ति //
text_mt: They proceed with the Bṛhat and Rathaṃtara [sāmans].

sanskrit_iast: āśvatthī havirdhānaṃ cāgnīdhraṃ ca bhavataḥ //
meaning: आश्वत्थी हविर्धानं चाग्नीध्रं च भवतः //
text_mt: The havirdhāna shed and the āgnīdhra shed are made of aśvattha wood.

sanskrit_iast: cakrīvatī bhavataḥ //
meaning: चक्रीवती भवतः //

sanskrit_iast: ulūkhalabudhno yūpo bhavati //
meaning: उलूखलबुध्नो यूपो भवति //
text_mt: The sacrificial post has its base in a mortar.

sanskrit_iast: prāñco yānti //
meaning: प्राञ्चो यान्ति //

sanskrit_iast: sarasvatyā yānti / ākrośanto yānti //
meaning: सरस्वत्या यान्ति / आक्रोशन्तो यान्ति //
text_mt: They advance along the Sarasvatī; they advance shouting loudly.

sanskrit_iast: yadā daśaśataṃ kurvanty athaikam utthānam //
meaning: यदा दशशतं कुर्वन्त्य् अथैकम् उत्थानम् //
text_mt: When they have gained ten hundred [cows], then comes the conclusion.

sanskrit_iast: yadā śatam̐ sahasraṃ kurvanty athaikam utthānam //
meaning: यदा शतम्̐ सहस्रं कुर्वन्त्य् अथैकम् उत्थानम् //
text_mt: When they have gained a hundred thousand, then comes the conclusion.

sanskrit_iast: yadaiṣāṃ pramīyeta / yadā vā jīyeran / athaikam utthānam //
meaning: यदैषां प्रमीयेत / यदा वा जीयेरन् / अथैकम् उत्थानम् //
text_mt: When one of them dies, or when they are defeated, then comes the conclusion.

sanskrit_iast: ṛtūnāṃ ṣaḍahena suvargakāmaḥ //
meaning: ऋतूनां षडहेन सुवर्गकामः //
text_mt: One desiring heaven [sacrifices] with the six-day rite of the Seasons.

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍahena //
meaning: पृष्ठ्यः षडहेन //

sanskrit_iast: devānām upariṣṭāt trikadrukeṇa sarvam āyur eti vasīyān bhavati //
meaning: देवानाम् उपरिष्टात् त्रिकद्रुकेण सर्वम् आयुर् एति वसीयान् भवति //
text_mt: By means of the Trikadruka [rite] of the gods from above, he attains a full lifespan and becomes wealthier.

sanskrit_iast: trivṛd agniṣṭomaḥ pañcadaśa ukthyaḥ saptadaśa ukthya āyur gaur jyotir atirātraḥ satrasaṃmitenānnādyaṃ prajāṃ paśūn ojo vīryam āpnoti / abhyāsaṅgyaḥ pañcāho viśvajid atirātraḥ //
meaning: त्रिवृद् अग्निष्टोमः पञ्चदश उक्थ्यः सप्तदश उक्थ्य आयुर् गौर् ज्योतिर् अतिरात्रः सत्रसंमितेनान्नाद्यं प्रजां पशून् ओजो वीर्यम् आप्नोति / अभ्यासङ्ग्यः पञ्चाहो विश्वजिद् अतिरात्रः //
text_mt: A Trivṛt Agniṣṭoma, a Pañcadaśa Ukthya, a Saptadaśa Ukthya, an Āyus, a Go, [and] a Jyotis Atirātra: by means of this rite commensurate with a sacrificial session, he obtains food, offspring, cattle, vigour, and valour. The Abhyāsaṅgya is a five-day rite with a Viśvajit Atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: kausurubindena saptarātreṇa paśavas tān evāvarundhe / pañca pṛṣṭhāhāni / pañcavim̐śo 'gniṣṭomo mahāvratavān viśvajit sarvapṛṣṭho 'tirātraḥ //
meaning: कौसुरुबिन्देन सप्तरात्रेण पशवस् तान् एवावरुन्धे / पञ्च पृष्ठाहानि / पञ्चविम्̐शो ऽग्निष्टोमो महाव्रतवान् विश्वजित् सर्वपृष्ठो ऽतिरात्रः //
text_mt: By means of the Kausurubinda seven-day rite, [he obtains] cattle: he indeed secures them. There are five Pṛṣṭha days, a Pañcaviṃśa Agniṣṭoma possessing the Mahāvrata, [and] an all-pṛṣṭha Viśvajit Atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: saptarṣīṇām ṛddhikāmaḥ //
meaning: सप्तर्षीणाम् ऋद्धिकामः //
text_mt: One desiring prosperity [sacrifices with the rite] of the Seven Seers.

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍahas trayastrim̐śaṃ mahāvratam atirātre //
meaning: पृष्ठ्यः षडहस् त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शं महाव्रतम् अतिरात्रे //
text_mt: A Pṛṣṭhya-ṣaḍaha, and a Trayastriṃśa Mahāvrata on the Atirātra [day].

sanskrit_iast: prājāpatyas tṛtīyaḥ prajākāmaḥ //
meaning: प्राजापत्यस् तृतीयः प्रजाकामः //
text_mt: A third [rite] sacred to Prajāpati [is performed] by one desiring offspring.

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍahaḥ prājāpatyas trayastrim̐śaṃ mahāvratam atirātre //
meaning: पृष्ठ्यः षडहः प्राजापत्यस् त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शं महाव्रतम् अतिरात्रे //
text_mt: A Pṛṣṭhya-ṣaḍaha sacred to Prajāpati, and a Trayastriṃśa Mahāvrata on the Atirātra [day].

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣṭhyāvalambena pratiṣṭhākāmaḥ / pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍahaḥ pṛṣṭhyāvalambyas trayastrim̐śaṃ mahāvratam atirātre //
meaning: पृष्ठ्यावलम्बेन प्रतिष्ठाकामः / पृष्ठ्यः षडहः पृष्ठ्यावलम्ब्यस् त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शं महाव्रतम् अतिरात्रे //
text_mt: One desiring support [sacrifices] with the Pṛṣṭhyāvalamba: a Pṛṣṭhya-ṣaḍaha dependent on the Pṛṣṭhya, and a Trayastriṃśa Mahāvrata on the Atirātra [day].

sanskrit_iast: chandomapavamānena paśukāmaḥ / pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍahaś chandomapavamānaṃ mahāvratam atirātre //
meaning: छन्दोमपवमानेन पशुकामः / पृष्ठ्यः षडहश् छन्दोमपवमानं महाव्रतम् अतिरात्रे //
text_mt: One desirous of cattle [should sacrifice] with the Chandomapavamāna: a Pṛṣṭhya six-day period, a Chandomapavamāna, a Mahāvrata, [and] an Atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: janakaḥ saptarātreṇa puruṣakāmaḥ //
meaning: जनकः सप्तरात्रेण पुरुषकामः //
text_mt: Janaka, desirous of men, [sacrificed] with a seven-day sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast: tasya catvāri trivṛnty ahāny agniṣṭomamukhāni / viśvajin mahāvratamatirātre / aindreṇa saptarātreṇātyanyā prajā bhavati / ojiṣṭho bhavati / trivṛd agniṣṭomaḥ pañcadaśa ukthyaḥ / saptadaśa ukthyo 'bhijid agniṣṭomaḥ / sarvastomo 'tirātraḥ //
meaning: तस्य चत्वारि त्रिवृन्त्य् अहान्य् अग्निष्टोममुखानि / विश्वजिन् महाव्रतमतिरात्रे / ऐन्द्रेण सप्तरात्रेणात्यन्या प्रजा भवति / ओजिष्ठो भवति / त्रिवृद् अग्निष्टोमः पञ्चदश उक्थ्यः / सप्तदश उक्थ्यो ऽभिजिद् अग्निष्टोमः / सर्वस्तोमो ऽतिरात्रः //
text_mt: Its [order is]: four nine-versed days beginning with Agniṣṭomas, a Viśvajit, a Mahāvrata, [and] an Atirātra. By the seven-day sacrifice belonging to Indra, one becomes superior to other creatures; he becomes most vigorous. [Its order is]: a nine-versed Agniṣṭoma, a fifteen-versed Ukthya, a seventeen-versed Ukthya, an Abhijit Agniṣṭoma, [and] an all-stoma Atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭarātreṇa brahmavarcasakāmaḥ / pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍahaḥ pañcavim̐śo 'gniṣṭomo mahāvratavān viśvajit sarvapṛṣṭho 'tirātraḥ //
meaning: अष्टरात्रेण ब्रह्मवर्चसकामः / पृष्ठ्यः षडहः पञ्चविम्̐शो ऽग्निष्टोमो महाव्रतवान् विश्वजित् सर्वपृष्ठो ऽतिरात्रः //
text_mt: One desirous of spiritual lustre [should sacrifice] with an eight-day sacrifice: a Pṛṣṭhya six-day period, a twenty-five-versed Agniṣṭoma having the Mahāvrata, [and] a Viśvajit Sarvapṛṣṭha Atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: trayo navarātrā āyuṣkāmo yajeta //
meaning: त्रयो नवरात्रा आयुष्कामो यजेत //
text_mt: There are three nine-day sacrifices; one desirous of long life should sacrifice [with the first]:

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍaho gauś cāyuś ca dve ahanī viśvajid atirātraḥ //
meaning: पृष्ठ्यः षडहो गौश् चायुश् च द्वे अहनी विश्वजिद् अतिरात्रः //
text_mt: A Pṛṣṭhya six-day period, two days consisting of the Go and the Āyus, [and] a Viśvajit Atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: dvitīyena brahmavarcasakāmo jyotir gaur āyus tryaho 'bhyāsaṅgyaḥ pañcāho viśvajid atirātraḥ //
meaning: द्वितीयेन ब्रह्मवर्चसकामो ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुस् त्र्यहो ऽभ्यासङ्ग्यः पञ्चाहो विश्वजिद् अतिरात्रः //
text_mt: One desirous of spiritual lustre [should sacrifice] with the second: a three-day period of Jyotis, Go, and Āyus, an Abhyāsaṅgya five-day period, [and] a Viśvajit Atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: śalalīpiśaṅgena / yaṃ kāmaṃ kāmayeta tam abhyaśnute jyotir gaur āyus tryaho jyotir gaur āyus tryaha āyur gaur āyur atirātraḥ //
meaning: शललीपिशङ्गेन / यं कामं कामयेत तम् अभ्यश्नुते ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुस् त्र्यहो ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुस् त्र्यह आयुर् गौर् आयुर् अतिरात्रः //
text_mt: With the Śalalīpiśaṅga, whatever desire one desires, that he attains: a three-day period of Jyotis, Go, and Āyus, a three-day period of Jyotis, Go, and Āyus, [and] an Āyus-Go-Āyus Atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: catvāro daśarātrāḥ //
meaning: चत्वारो दशरात्राः //

sanskrit_iast: daśarātrāya dīkṣiṣyamāṇo daśahotāraṃ juhoti //
meaning: दशरात्राय दीक्षिष्यमाणो दशहोतारं जुहोति //
text_mt: When about to undergo initiation for a ten-day sacrifice, he offers the Daśahotṛ formula.

sanskrit_iast: bhuvata indrasya trikakud daśarātro yaḥ kāmayeta trikakud eva samānānām̐ syām iti / sa etena yajeta //
meaning: भुवत इन्द्रस्य त्रिककुद् दशरात्रो यः कामयेत त्रिककुद् एव समानानाम्̐ स्याम् इति / स एतेन यजेत //
text_mt: "The three-peaked ten-day sacrifice of Indra of Bhuvana"—whoever desires: "May I be the three-peaked among my equals," he should sacrifice with this.

sanskrit_iast: trivṛdagniṣṭud agniṣṭomaḥ / pañcadaśa ukthyas trivṛd agniṣṭomaḥ saptadaśo 'gniṣṭoma ekavim̐śa ukthyaḥ / saptadaśo 'gniṣṭomas triṇavo 'gniṣṭomas trayastrim̐śa ukthyas triṇavo 'gniṣṭomaḥ / viśvajit sarvapṛṣṭho 'tirātraḥ //
meaning: त्रिवृदग्निष्टुद् अग्निष्टोमः / पञ्चदश उक्थ्यस् त्रिवृद् अग्निष्टोमः सप्तदशो ऽग्निष्टोम एकविम्̐श उक्थ्यः / सप्तदशो ऽग्निष्टोमस् त्रिणवो ऽग्निष्टोमस् त्रयस्त्रिम्̐श उक्थ्यस् त्रिणवो ऽग्निष्टोमः / विश्वजित् सर्वपृष्ठो ऽतिरात्रः //
text_mt: A nine-versed Agniṣṭut Agniṣṭoma, a fifteen-versed Ukthya, a nine-versed Agniṣṭoma, a seventeen-versed Agniṣṭoma, a twenty-one-versed Ukthya, a seventeen-versed Agniṣṭoma, a twenty-seven-versed Agniṣṭoma, a thirty-three-versed Ukthya, a twenty-seven-versed Agniṣṭoma, [and] a Viśvajit Sarvapṛṣṭha Atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: pura itarā abhicaryamāṇo yajeta / trivṛd agniṣṭomo jyotir agniṣṭomas trivṛd agniṣṭomo jyotir ukthyo gaur ukthya āyur ukthyo 'bhijid agniṣṭomo viśvajid agniṣṭomaḥ sarvajid agniṣṭomaḥ sarvastomo 'tirātraḥ //
meaning: पुर इतरा अभिचर्यमाणो यजेत / त्रिवृद् अग्निष्टोमो ज्योतिर् अग्निष्टोमस् त्रिवृद् अग्निष्टोमो ज्योतिर् उक्थ्यो गौर् उक्थ्य आयुर् उक्थ्यो ऽभिजिद् अग्निष्टोमो विश्वजिद् अग्निष्टोमः सर्वजिद् अग्निष्टोमः सर्वस्तोमो ऽतिरात्रः //
text_mt: One against whom sorcery is being practiced should sacrifice with the Puraitarā: a nine-versed Agniṣṭoma, a Jyotis Agniṣṭoma, a nine-versed Agniṣṭoma, a Jyotis Ukthya, a Go Ukthya, an Āyus Ukthya, an Abhijit Agniṣṭoma, a Viśvajit Agniṣṭoma, a Sarvajit Agniṣṭoma, [and] an all-stoma Atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: kausurubindo daśarātraḥ / yaḥ kāmayeta sarvam idaṃ bhaveyam iti / sa etena yajeta / tasya trayas trivṛto 'gniṣṭomās trayaḥ pañcadaśā ukthyā / trayaḥ saptadaśā ukthyā atirātraḥ //
meaning: कौसुरुबिन्दो दशरात्रः / यः कामयेत सर्वम् इदं भवेयम् इति / स एतेन यजेत / तस्य त्रयस् त्रिवृतो ऽग्निष्टोमास् त्रयः पञ्चदशा उक्थ्या / त्रयः सप्तदशा उक्थ्या अतिरात्रः //
text_mt: The Kausurubinda ten-day sacrifice: whoever desires: "May I become all this," he should sacrifice with this. Its [order is]: three nine-versed Agniṣṭomas, three fifteen-versed Ukthyas, three seventeen-versed Ukthyas, [and] an Atirātra.

sanskrit_iast: pauṇḍarīka ekādaśarātraḥ / ayutaṃ dakṣiṇā / aśvasahasram eke / daśa dakṣiṇāḥ / sarvām ṛddhim ṛdhnoti / parameṣṭhitāṃ gacchati / abhyāsaṅgyaḥ pañcāhaḥ ṣaḍahaḥ syād ahnas trayastrim̐śaṃ dve savane ṣaṭtrim̐śatam antyaś catuṣṭomo 'gniṣṭomas trayaś chandomā viśvajit sarvapṛṣṭho 'tirātraḥ / anvahaṃ daśa sahasrāṇi dadyāt / aśvasahasram uttame 'hany aśvasahasram uttame 'hani //
meaning: पौण्डरीक एकादशरात्रः / अयुतं दक्षिणा / अश्वसहस्रम् एके / दश दक्षिणाः / सर्वाम् ऋद्धिम् ऋध्नोति / परमेष्ठितां गच्छति / अभ्यासङ्ग्यः पञ्चाहः षडहः स्याद् अह्नस् त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शं द्वे सवने षट्त्रिम्̐शतम् अन्त्यश् चतुष्टोमो ऽग्निष्टोमस् त्रयश् छन्दोमा विश्वजित् सर्वपृष्ठो ऽतिरात्रः / अन्वहं दश सहस्राणि दद्यात् / अश्वसहस्रम् उत्तमे ऽहन्य् अश्वसहस्रम् उत्तमे ऽहनि //
text_mt: The Pauṇḍarīka eleven-day sacrifice: ten thousand [cows] are the priestly gift; according to some, a thousand horses; [or] ten [thousand] priestly gifts. He succeeds in all prosperity; he reaches the highest position. An Abhyāsaṅgya five-day period, there should be a six-day period; of the day, thirty-three [stomas] for two pressings, thirty-six for the last; a Catuṣṭoma Agniṣṭoma, three Chandomas, [and] a Viśvajit Sarvapṛṣṭha Atirātra. Each day he should give ten thousand; a thousand horses on the last day, a thousand horses on the last day.

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśāhaprajādīni satrāṇi //
meaning: द्वादशाहप्रजादीनि सत्राणि //
text_mt: The sacrificial sessions begin with the Twelve-Day Rite and its offspring.

sanskrit_iast: yāni purastāt saṃvatsarād gavāmayanaprakṛtīny uttarāṇy ubhayato'tirātrāṇi satrāṇi //
meaning: यानि पुरस्तात् संवत्सराद् गवामयनप्रकृतीन्य् उत्तराण्य् उभयतोऽतिरात्राणि सत्राणि //
text_mt: Those sacrificial sessions prior to the year whose archetype is the Gavāmayana, and the subsequent ones, have Atirātras on both sides.

sanskrit_iast: upariṣṭād atirātras tṛtīyaḥ pañcadaśa ukthyaḥ //
meaning: उपरिष्टाद् अतिरात्रस् तृतीयः पञ्चदश उक्थ्यः //
text_mt: The Atirātra is placed after; the third is a fifteen-versed Ukthya.

sanskrit_iast: tathā kuṇḍapāyināmayanam //
meaning: तथा कुण्डपायिनामयनम् //
text_mt: Likewise the Kuṇḍapāyinām Ayana.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ dvādaśāhena kalpo vyākhyātaḥ //
meaning: तेषां द्वादशाहेन कल्पो व्याख्यातः //
text_mt: The procedure for them has been explained by the Twelve-Day Rite.
